Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den MIME-Typ einer Datei basierend auf ihrer Dateierweiterung. Verwenden Sie vordefinierte Konstanten für gängige Typen und einen Fallback für unbekannte Erweiterungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `CASE` Anweisung mit `WHEN OTHERS` und Konstanten aus `cl_fxs_mime_types`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type.
    DATA(lv_extension_upper) = to_upper( iv_file_extension ).

    CASE lv_extension_upper.
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf.
      WHEN 'XML'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml.
      WHEN 'HTM' OR 'HTML'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_html.
      WHEN 'TXT'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain.
      WHEN 'JPG' OR 'JPEG'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_image_jpeg.
      WHEN 'PNG'.
        rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_image_png.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_mime_type = 'application/octet-stream'. " Generischer Fallback
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Dateinamen und weisen Sie jedem Eintrag einen MIME-Typ zu. Aggregieren Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle und behandeln Sie unbekannte Dateierweiterungen mit einem Standard-MIME-Typ.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und einer `COND` Expression, um die MIME-Typen zuzuweisen. `WHEN OTHERS` kann in der `COND` Expression verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_info.
    TYPES tt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_files
      IMPORTING
        it_file_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_files) TYPE tt_file_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_files.
    rt_processed_files = VALUE #( FOR file_name IN it_file_names
                                  LET lv_extension = substring_after( val = file_name sep = '.' )
                                      lv_mime_type = COND string(
                                        WHEN lv_extension = 'PDF' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf
                                        WHEN lv_extension = 'XML' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml
                                        WHEN lv_extension = 'TXT' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain
                                        WHEN OTHERS THEN 'application/octet-stream' )
                                  IN ( file_name = file_name, mime_type = lv_mime_type ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Operation, die fehlschlagen kann (z.B. eine ungültige MIME-Typ-Konvertierung). Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und einem generischen `WHEN OTHERS` Block für unerwartete Ausnahmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen sowie `CX_ROOT` mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.

    METHODS simulate_mime_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lv_mime_type) = ``.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a specific error for 'INVALID'
        IF iv_input = 'INVALID'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid MIME type extension provided.'.
        ENDIF.

        lv_mime_type = simulate_mime_conversion( iv_input ).
        rv_result = |Operation successful: { lv_mime_type }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conversion_error).
        rv_result = |Specific error: { lx_conversion_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch all other exceptions
        rv_result = |Unexpected error (WHEN OTHERS): { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_mime_conversion.
    " In a real scenario, this would involve complex logic or external calls
    " For this example, we just return a dummy MIME type or raise an error
    IF iv_extension = 'INVALID'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ELSE IF iv_extension = 'PDF'.
      rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf.
    ELSE.
      rv_mime_type = 'text/plain'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = |Operation successful: { cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unexpected_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    " Simulate an unexpected error by passing a non-string to a method expecting string, if possible
    " For this example, we'll just ensure the WHEN OTHERS path is covered conceptually.
    " A direct way to trigger CX_ROOT for WHEN OTHERS is harder without a more complex setup.
    " Let's assume 'UNKNOWN_FATAL' triggers a generic error in a more complex scenario.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 'UNKNOWN_FATAL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Operation successful' ). " In this simplified example, it will succeed.
    " To truly test WHEN OTHERS, a more complex exception hierarchy or a different error simulation would be needed.
    " For the purpose of demonstrating WHEN OTHERS, the structure is correct.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Struktur ist der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Das Fangen spezifischer Ausnahmen (z.B. `cx_sy_conversion_error`) und die Verwendung von `WHEN OTHERS` mit `cx_root` als Fallback stellt sicher, dass alle möglichen Fehler abgefangen und behandelt werden, was die Robustheit des Programms erhöht. String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit der Fehlermeldungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Dateierweiterungen in einen lesbaren Satz umwandelt, wobei für jede Erweiterung der entsprechende MIME-Typ aus `cl_fxs_mime_types` verwendet wird. Wenn eine Erweiterung unbekannt ist, soll ein generischer MIME-Typ verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `STRING_CONCAT_LINES` oder String-Templates und eine `COND` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_mime_types
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_mime_types.
    rv_formatted_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR extension IN it_extensions
      LET mime_type = COND string(
                        WHEN extension = 'PDF' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf
                        WHEN extension = 'XML' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml
                        WHEN OTHERS THEN 'application/octet-stream' )
      IN s = |
{ s }Extension: { extension }, MIME Type: { mime_type }| ).

    " Remove leading newline if present
    IF rv_formatted_string IS NOT INITIAL AND rv_formatted_string(1) = |
|.
      rv_formatted_string = rv_formatted_string+1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine dynamische Methode, die basierend auf einem übergebenen MIME-Typ eine spezifische 'Verarbeitungs'-Methode aufruft. Nutzen Sie RTTI, um die Methode zu finden und aufzurufen. Stellen Sie einen Fallback mit `WHEN OTHERS` bereit, falls keine spezifische Methode gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und `CALL METHOD` für dynamische Aufrufe. Implementieren Sie eine `WHEN OTHERS` Logik für den Fall, dass keine passende Methode existiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS process_pdf RETURNING VALUE(rv_msg) TYPE string.
    METHODS process_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_msg) TYPE string.
    METHODS process_default RETURNING VALUE(rv_msg) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_mime_type.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = ``.

    CASE iv_mime_type.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf.
        lv_method_name = 'PROCESS_PDF'.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml.
        lv_method_name = 'PROCESS_XML'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_method_name = 'PROCESS_DEFAULT'.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF ME RECEIVING rv_msg = rv_message.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_message = |Error calling dynamic method { lv_method_name }: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_pdf.
    rv_msg = 'Processing PDF document...'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_xml.
    rv_msg = 'Processing XML data...'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_default.
    rv_msg = 'Processing unknown MIME type with default handler.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen 'MIME-Typ-Score' für eine Liste von Dateierweiterungen. Weisen Sie gängigen MIME-Typen höhere Werte zu und unbekannten Typen einen Standardwert. Summieren Sie die Scores.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `COND` Expression und `WHEN OTHERS` für die Score-Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_score_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_mime_score
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_score) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_score_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_mime_score.
    rv_total_score = REDUCE i(
      INIT score = 0
      FOR extension IN it_extensions
      LET current_score = COND i(
                            WHEN extension = 'PDF' THEN 10
                            WHEN extension = 'XML' THEN 8
                            WHEN extension = 'TXT' THEN 5
                            WHEN OTHERS THEN 1 ) " Default score for unknown types
      IN score = score + current_score ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_handler_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_handler.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = ``.

    CASE iv_mime_type.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PDF_HANDLER'.
      WHEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_XML_HANDLER'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_GENERIC_HANDLER'.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_handler TYPE (lv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        " Fallback to generic handler if dynamic creation fails (e.g., class not found)
        CREATE OBJECT ro_handler TYPE zcl_generic_handler.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie einen berechneten 'Dokumenttyp' hinzu, der auf einem fiktiven Dateityp basiert, der aus der Fluggesellschaft oder Flugnummer abgeleitet wird. Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für einen Standardtyp.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und eine `COND` Expression für die Typzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_mime_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_enriched,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             document_mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    TYPES tt_sflight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_mime_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    rt_enriched_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
                                    LET lv_derived_extension = COND string(
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' THEN 'PDF' " Lufthansa documents
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA' THEN 'XML' " American Airlines data
                                      WHEN ls_sflight-connid MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'TXT' " Even connection IDs are text reports
                                      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'BIN' ) " Default for others
                                        lv_mime_type = COND string(
                                          WHEN lv_derived_extension = 'PDF' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf
                                          WHEN lv_derived_extension = 'XML' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml
                                          WHEN lv_derived_extension = 'TXT' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain
                                          WHEN OTHERS THEN 'application/octet-stream' )
                                    IN ( ls_sflight, document_mime_type = lv_mime_type ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrichment.
    DATA(lo_enricher) = NEW zcl_sflights_mime_enricher( ).
    DATA(lt_enriched) = lo_enricher->get_enriched_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_enriched ).

    " Check a few entries based on the logic
    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = lt_enriched[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT VALUE ty_sflight_enriched( ) ].
    IF ls_lh_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_entry-document_mime_type exp = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aa_entry) = lt_enriched[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT VALUE ty_sflight_enriched( ) ].
    IF ls_aa_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_entry-document_mime_type exp = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml ).
    ENDIF.

    " Find an entry with an even connid for TXT
    DATA(ls_txt_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflights_mime_enricher=>ty_sflight_enriched(
      FOR entry IN lt_enriched WHERE ( entry-connid MOD 2 = 0 AND entry-carrid <> 'LH' AND entry-carrid <> 'AA' ) ( entry ) ).
    IF ls_txt_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_txt_entry-document_mime_type exp = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain ).
    ENDIF.

    " Find an entry with an odd connid for BIN (WHEN OTHERS)
    DATA(ls_bin_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflights_mime_enricher=>ty_sflight_enriched(
      FOR entry IN lt_enriched WHERE ( entry-connid MOD 2 <> 0 AND entry-carrid <> 'LH' AND entry-carrid <> 'AA' ) ( entry ) ).
    IF ls_bin_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bin_entry-document_mime_type exp = 'application/octet-stream' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Dateinamen nach ihrem MIME-Typ. Zählen Sie, wie viele Dateien zu jedem MIME-Typ gehören. Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für unbekannte Typen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `COND` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS` zur Bestimmung des Gruppierungsschlüssels.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_count,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_mime_count.
    TYPES tt_mime_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_files_by_mime
      IMPORTING
        it_file_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mime_counts) TYPE tt_mime_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_files_by_mime.
    DATA: lt_file_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF struct_file_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_file_info,
             file_name TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF struct_file_info.

    " First, determine MIME type for each file
    lt_file_info = VALUE #( FOR file_name IN it_file_names
                             LET lv_extension = substring_after( val = file_name sep = '.' )
                                 lv_mime_type = COND string(
                                   WHEN lv_extension = 'PDF' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf
                                   WHEN lv_extension = 'XML' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml
                                   WHEN lv_extension = 'TXT' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain
                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN 'application/octet-stream' )
                             IN ( file_name = file_name, mime_type = lv_mime_type ) ).

    " Then, group by MIME type and count
    LOOP AT lt_file_info INTO DATA(ls_file_info) GROUP BY ls_file_info-mime_type.
      APPEND VALUE #( mime_type = ls_file_info-mime_type
                      count     = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_mime_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extension_to_name DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_extension_to_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_friendly_name.
    DATA(lv_extension_upper) = to_upper( iv_extension ).

    rv_friendly_name = SWITCH string(
      lv_extension_upper
      WHEN 'PDF' THEN 'Portable Document Format'
      WHEN 'XML' THEN 'Extensible Markup Language'
      WHEN 'HTM' OR 'HTML' THEN 'HyperText Markup Language'
      WHEN 'TXT' THEN 'Plain Text File'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unknown File Type' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von MIME-Typen auf ihre Gültigkeit. Ein MIME-Typ ist gültig, wenn er einer der bekannten Typen aus `cl_fxs_mime_types` entspricht oder wenn er einem bestimmten benutzerdefinierten Muster folgt. Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für alle anderen Fälle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `COND` Expression, die `CONTAINS` oder `MATCHES` für Musterprüfung und `WHEN OTHERS` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_mime_types
      IMPORTING
        it_mime_types TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_validation_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF abap_bool WITH EMPTY KEY.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_custom_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_custom) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_mime_types.
    rt_validation_results = VALUE #( FOR mime_type IN it_mime_types
                                     IN ( COND abap_bool(
                                            WHEN mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf THEN abap_true
                                            WHEN mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml THEN abap_true
                                            WHEN mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_text_plain THEN abap_true
                                            WHEN is_custom_mime_type( mime_type ) THEN abap_true
                                            WHEN OTHERS THEN abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_custom_mime_type.
    " Custom MIME types start with 'x-' or 'vnd.'
    IF iv_mime_type CP 'x-*' OR iv_mime_type CP 'vnd.*'.
      rv_is_custom = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_custom = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf dem aktuellen Datum und einem 'MIME-Typ-Event-Kalender' den Status eines MIME-Typ-bezogenen Events (z.B. 'aktiv', 'abgelaufen', 'zukünftig'). Verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` für einen Standardstatus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` mit `WHEN OTHERS` und Datumsvergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_event_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_event,
             mime_type TYPE string,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_mime_event.
    TYPES tt_mime_event TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mime_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_event_status
      IMPORTING
        is_mime_event TYPE ty_mime_event
        id_current_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_event_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_event_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN id_current_date BETWEEN is_mime_event-start_date AND is_mime_event-end_date THEN 'aktiv'
      WHEN id_current_date < is_mime_event-start_date THEN 'zukünftig'
      WHEN id_current_date > is_mime_event-end_date THEN 'abgelaufen'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'unbekannt' ). " Fallback for undefined date ranges
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Dateipfaden. Extrahieren Sie für jeden Pfad die Dateierweiterung und den zugehörigen MIME-Typ. Wenn der MIME-Typ 'application/octet-stream' ist, ersetzen Sie ihn durch einen spezifischeren Typ, falls die Erweiterung bekannt ist, aber nicht in der ursprünglichen Logik berücksichtigt wurde. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REPLACE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und eine `COND` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS` für die anfängliche MIME-Typ-Bestimmung, gefolgt von einer `REPLACE` Expression für die Verfeinerung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_refiner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_data,
             path      TYPE string,
             extension TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_data.
    TYPES tt_file_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS refine_mime_types
      IMPORTING
        it_file_paths TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_refined_data) TYPE tt_file_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_refiner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD refine_mime_types.
    rt_refined_data = VALUE #( FOR path IN it_file_paths
                                LET lv_extension = substring_after( val = path sep = '.' )
                                    lv_initial_mime = COND string(
                                      WHEN lv_extension = 'PDF' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf
                                      WHEN lv_extension = 'XML' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml
                                      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'application/octet-stream' ) " Initial broad classification
                                IN ( path      = path,
                                     extension = lv_extension,
                                     mime_type = COND string(
                                       WHEN lv_initial_mime = 'application/octet-stream' AND lv_extension = 'JPG' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_image_jpeg
                                       WHEN lv_initial_mime = 'application/octet-stream' AND lv_extension = 'PNG' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_image_png
                                       WHEN OTHERS THEN lv_initial_mime ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Dateierweiterungen akzeptiert und für jede Erweiterung dynamisch eine Methode aufruft, die den MIME-Typ zurückgibt. Wenn keine spezifische Methode für eine Erweiterung existiert, soll eine Standardmethode aufgerufen werden. Nutzen Sie `WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL FUNCTION` oder `CALL METHOD` dynamisch. Für die MIME-Typ-Bestimmung in der dynamischen Methode können Sie `cl_fxs_mime_types` und `WHEN OTHERS` nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS resolve_mime_types_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mime_types) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_for_pdf RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_mime_for_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_mime_for_default RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_mime_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resolve_mime_types_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = ``.
    DATA(lv_mime_type) = ``.

    LOOP AT it_extensions INTO DATA(lv_extension).
      CASE to_upper( lv_extension ).
        WHEN 'PDF'.
          lv_method_name = 'GET_MIME_FOR_PDF'.
        WHEN 'XML'.
          lv_method_name = 'GET_MIME_FOR_XML'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_method_name = 'GET_MIME_FOR_DEFAULT'.
      ENDCASE.

      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF ME RECEIVING rv_mime = lv_mime_type.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
          " Fallback if dynamic call fails (e.g., method not found, though unlikely here)
          lv_mime_type = 'error/dynamic-call-failed'.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND lv_mime_type TO rt_mime_types.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_for_pdf.
    rv_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_pdf.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_for_xml.
    rv_mime = cl_fxs_mime_types=>c_application_xml.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_for_default.
    rv_mime = 'application/octet-stream'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, die einen String-Parameter akzeptiert und einen String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_class_name)->(lv_method_name)` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    DATA lv_result TYPE string.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_GREETING'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_returning.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_class_name)=>(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit einem Eintrag.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_p_by_name` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Verbindung mit `CREATE DATA` und Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_sflight_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    " Get description of SFLIGHT structure
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    " Create a table type description based on SFLIGHT
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Create dynamic work area
    CREATE DATA lo_struct_descr->get_relative_name( ) INTO DATA(lo_wa).
    ASSIGN lo_wa->* TO <fs_line>.

    " Fill work area dynamically (example for SFLIGHT fields)
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_connid>).
    IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0017'. ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fldate>).
    IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.

    " Append to dynamic table
    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should contain one entry' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ANY.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String gegeben ist, und rufen Sie eine Methode dieser Instanz auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_object_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_dynamic_callable.

    METHODS create_and_call_dynamic_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_dynamic_callable.
  METHODS process_value
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_object_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_dynamic_object.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lt_parameters     TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter      TYPE abap_parmbind.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_callable> TYPE if_dynamic_callable.

    TRY.
        " Create object dynamically
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        ASSIGN lo_dynamic_object TO <fs_dynamic_callable>.

        IF <fs_dynamic_callable> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Prepare parameters for dynamic method call
          ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
          ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_importing.
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
          INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

          DATA lv_method_result TYPE string.
          GET REFERENCE OF lv_method_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
          ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
          ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_returning.
          INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

          " Call method dynamically
          CALL METHOD lo_dynamic_object->(iv_method_name)
            PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

          rv_result = lv_method_result.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic object not callable'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic object creation or call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_dynamic_callable~process_value.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_task_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_status,
             open         TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'O',
             in_progress  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
             closed       TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
             cancelled    TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM task_status.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_task_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN task_status-open        THEN rv_description = 'Offen'.
      WHEN task_status-in_progress THEN rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN task_status-closed      THEN rv_description = 'Geschlossen'.
      WHEN task_status-cancelled   THEN rv_description = 'Abgebrochen'.
      WHEN OTHERS                  THEN rv_description = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_status.
    rv_status = task_status-open.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie die Fluggesellschaft mit der höchsten durchschnittlichen Sitzplatzkapazität (Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT) unter Verwendung von Table Expressions und funktionalen Operatoren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, `GROUP BY`, `FOR` und `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ts_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_carrier_capacity,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_capacity   TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ts_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_carrier_by_avg_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_top_carrier) TYPE ts_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carrier_by_avg_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, max_seats FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Group flights by carrier and calculate average capacity
    DATA(lt_carrier_avg_capacity) = REDUCE tt_carrier_capacity(
      INIT l_result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      " Using REDUCE within GROUP BY to calculate sum and count for average
      LET l_sum_capacity = REDUCE decfloat34(
                              INIT sum = 0
                              FOR flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                              NEXT sum = sum + flight-max_seats )
          l_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
      NEXT l_result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity(
                         BASE l_result
                         ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                           avg_capacity = l_sum_capacity / l_count )
                       )
    ).

    " Find the carrier with the maximum average capacity
    rs_top_carrier = VALUE #( lt_carrier_avg_capacity[ 1 ] OPTIONAL ) . " Initialize with first element
    IF lines( lt_carrier_avg_capacity ) > 1. " Only process if more than one carrier
        rs_top_carrier = REDUCE #( 
            INIT l_max_carrier = rs_top_carrier ( carrid = '' avg_capacity = 0 ) 
            FOR carrier IN lt_carrier_avg_capacity 
            WHERE ( carrier-avg_capacity > l_max_carrier-avg_capacity ) 
            NEXT l_max_carrier = carrier ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_top_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_carrier.
    DATA(lo_analysis) = NEW zcl_sflight_analysis( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_analysis->get_top_carrier_by_avg_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-carrid msg = 'Initial check, carrid should not be empty' ).
    IF ls_result-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_result-avg_capacity msg = 'Average capacity should be calculated' ).
      WRITE: / 'Top Carrier:', ls_result-carrid, 'Avg Capacity:', ls_result-avg_capacity.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'No top carrier found (perhaps SFLIGHT is empty)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code demonstriert die hochgradig funktionalen Operatoren `REDUCE`, `FOR GROUPS OF` und `LET` (seit ABAP 7.40). `REDUCE` wird verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren und gleichzeitig Aggregationen (Durchschnitt) pro Gruppe (`GROUP BY carrid`) zu berechnen. Der `LET` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert. Das Finden des Maximums wird ebenfalls mit `REDUCE` elegant gelöst.
keywords: REDUCE, GROUP BY, FOR, LET, Table Expressions, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazitäten (MAX_SEATS) aller Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt wurden, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_lh_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_lh_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, max_seats FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-max_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_sum_calc) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_sum_calc->get_total_lh_capacity( ).

    " Due to test data variability, we can only assert it's not negative
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total GE 0 ) msg = 'Total capacity should be non-negative' ).
    " For more precise testing, populate SFLIGHT with known test data first.
    WRITE: / 'Total LH Capacity:', lv_total.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.40) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt Schleifen mit manueller Summenbildung durch einen deklarativen Ausdruck, der das Ergebnis einer Reduktionsoperation liefert. Die Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` ermöglicht es, die Operation auf spezifische Teilmengen der Tabelle anzuwenden, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der `sflights`-Tabelle alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' mit mehr als 200 freien Sitzplätzen (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) heraus und speichern Sie diese in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_available,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ts_flight_available.
    TYPES tt_flights_available TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_available WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_available_flights) TYPE tt_flights_available.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_available_flights = FILTER tt_flights_available(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 200
      " Constructing new components for the result table
      ( COMPONENTS carrid,
                 connid,
                 fldate,
                 free_seats = ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter_demo) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter_demo->get_available_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_filtered ) GE 0 ) msg = 'Filtered table should not be negative in size' ).
    IF lines( lt_filtered ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_filtered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrier should be AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <fs_flight>-free_seats > 200 ) msg = 'Free seats should be > 200' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    WRITE: / 'Number of filtered AA flights with > 200 free seats:', lines( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator (seit ABAP 7.40) erlaubt es, interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern und eine neue gefilterte Tabelle zu erzeugen. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft effizienter als eine explizite Schleife mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` unter Bedingungen. Die Möglichkeit, direkt im Filterausdruck neue Komponenten zu definieren (`( COMPONENTS ... )`), ist ein weiteres modernes Feature, das die Datenprojektion vereinfacht.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Data Selection, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für alle Flüge aus `sflights` nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID), die Flugnummer (CONNID) und die maximale Sitzplatzanzahl (MAX_SEATS) enthält. Benennen Sie 'MAX_SEATS' in 'TOTAL_CAPACITY' um.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `COMPONENTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_projection,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ts_flight_projection.
    TYPES tt_flight_projection TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_projection WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_projected_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_projected_flights) TYPE tt_flight_projection.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_projected_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_projected_flights = VALUE tt_flight_projection(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                   total_capacity = ls_flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_projection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_projection.
    DATA(lo_proj_demo) = NEW zcl_sflight_projection( ).
    DATA(lt_projected) = lo_proj_demo->get_projected_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_projected ) GE 0 ) msg = 'Projected table should not be negative in size' ).
    IF lines( lt_projected ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_projected ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_proj_flight>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_proj_flight>-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_proj_flight>-connid msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_proj_flight>-total_capacity msg = 'Total capacity should not be initial' ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    WRITE: / 'Number of projected flights:', lines( lt_projected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` (seit ABAP 7.40) und `COMPONENTS` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und effiziente Projektion ('Mapping') von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine neue. Dies ähnelt den 'SELECT-FROM'-Statements in SQL und ersetzt manuelle Schleifen mit einzelnen Zuweisungen. Das Umbenennen von Feldern (`total_capacity = ls_flight-seatsmax`) direkt im Ausdruck ist ein klares Zeichen für modernes ABAP.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COMPONENTS, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Projection, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die die Flugnummer (CONNID) und das Flugdatum (FLDATE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der `sflights`-Tabelle abruft und die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle mit inline-deklarierter Struktur zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen für die Ergebnistabelle (`DATA(...)`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE TABLE OF REF TO data. " Generic return type, type safety handled by data ref
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA lt_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw).
    
    " Construct a new table with only specific fields and inline declaration
    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR flight_item IN lt_flights_raw
                               ( NEW data( ) ) ). " This is a placeholder for actual data manipulation, showing generic result type
    
    " A more direct approach to fill structures instead of REF TO data
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ts_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_specific_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_raw
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
    
    " To return dynamic data using REF TO data, one needs to dynamically create the data objects.
    " For simplicity and clear typing in modern ABAP, it is more common to define concrete types or use VALUE/FOR expressions for direct assignments.
    " For this example, we demonstrate inline declaration in SELECT and the concept of returning dynamic data (simplified).
    
    " If we wanted to return a concrete table type, the method signature would be:
    " METHODS get_flight_details ... RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
    " And then: rt_flight_data = lt_specific_flights.

    " For the generic REF TO DATA scenario, a more complex dynamic approach:
    CLEAR rt_flight_data.
    LOOP AT lt_specific_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_specific_flight>).
      DATA(lr_data) = REF TO data( <fs_specific_flight> ).
      APPEND lr_data TO rt_flight_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_sflight_info) = NEW zcl_sflight_info( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_sflight_info->get_flight_details( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flights ) GE 0 ) msg = 'Returned data should not be negative in size' ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lr_first_entry) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      ASSIGN lr_first_entry->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_flight>-connid msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_flight>-fldate msg = 'Flight date should not be initial' ).
    ENDIF.
    WRITE: / 'Number of LH flights found:', lines( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (seit ABAP 7.40) erlauben die Deklaration von Variablen und Feldsymbolen direkt an ihrer ersten Verwendungsstelle, z.B. in `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_variable)`. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Variablen separat zu deklarieren, was den Code kompakter und leichter lesbar macht. Dieser Ansatz fördert einen Top-Down-Programmierstil und hilft, ungenutzte Deklarationen zu vermeiden.
keywords: Inline Declaration, DATA, SFLIGHT, Dynamic Programming, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen Zahlungsprozessor und zwei konkrete Implementierungen ('Kreditkarte', 'PayPal'). Nutzen Sie ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbare Features wie `FINAL` für Methoden, wo angebracht, und die Möglichkeit, Interfaces direkt zu implementieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACES`, `ABSTRACT CLASS`, `FINAL` Methoden und Inline-Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_payment_processor PUBLIC.
  TYPES tv_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
  METHODS process_payment
    IMPORTING
      iv_amount TYPE tv_amount
      iv_currency TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_payment_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_payment_processor.
    METHODS get_processor_name ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_creditcard_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_payment_processor FINAL. " FINAL class
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_payment_processor~process_payment.
    METHODS get_processor_name OVERRIDING. " OVERRIDING explicitly
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_creditcard_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_payment_processor~process_payment.
    " Simulate credit card processing
    IF iv_amount > 0 AND iv_currency IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_processor_name.
    rv_name = 'Kreditkarte'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paypal_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_payment_processor FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_payment_processor~process_payment.
    METHODS get_processor_name OVERRIDING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paypal_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_payment_processor~process_payment.
    " Simulate PayPal processing
    IF iv_amount > 100 AND iv_currency = 'EUR'. " PayPal specific condition
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_processor_name.
    rv_name = 'PayPal'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_creditcard_processor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_paypal_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_creditcard_processor.
    DATA(lo_cc_processor) = NEW zcl_creditcard_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cc_processor->zif_payment_processor~process_payment( iv_amount = '150.00' iv_currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Credit card payment should succeed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cc_processor->get_processor_name( ) exp = 'Kreditkarte' msg = 'Processor name should be Kreditkarte' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_paypal_processor.
    DATA(lo_pp_processor) = NEW zcl_paypal_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_success_ok) = lo_pp_processor->zif_payment_processor~process_payment( iv_amount = '200.00' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_success_fail) = lo_pp_processor->zif_payment_processor~process_payment( iv_amount = '50.00' iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success_ok exp = abap_true msg = 'PayPal payment should succeed for >100 EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success_fail exp = abap_false msg = 'PayPal payment should fail for <100 EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_pp_processor->get_processor_name( ) exp = 'PayPal' msg = 'Processor name should be PayPal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes ABAP (insbesondere ab 7.50) unterstützt fortschrittliche objektorientierte Konzepte wie `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen, was die Kapselung und Stabilität von Interfaces und Implementierungen verbessert. Abstrakte Klassen und Interfaces sind dabei die Basis für polymorphes Verhalten. Die explizite Angabe von `OVERRIDING` macht die Klassenstruktur klarer und ist eine gute Praxis für die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Abstract Class, Final, Polymorphism, Design Patterns

CLASS zcl_error_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Wrap standard exception in custom exception for better context
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_division_error(
          text = |Division durch Null oder arithmetischer Fehler: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_division_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_error_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_divider->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 msg = '10 / 2 should be 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_divider) = NEW zcl_error_division( ).
    TRY.
        lo_divider->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Division by zero should raise zcx_division_error' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught zcx_division_error for division by zero' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes ABAP setzt auf klassenbasierte Exceptions (`TRY ... CATCH ... ENDTRY`), um Fehler präzise und strukturiert zu behandeln. Seit ABAP 7.40 können Catch-Blöcke mehrere Exception-Klassen behandeln und in Kombination mit eigenen Exception-Klassen (`zcx_division_error`) können spezifische Fehlerkontexte bereitgestellt werden. Dies verbessert die Robustheit und Wartbarkeit des Codes gegenüber traditionellen `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfungen.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR, Custom Exception

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert des Feldes `CARRID` aus einer Datenreferenz, die auf eine Zeile vom Typ `SFLIGHT` zeigt, und geben Sie den Wert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und den Operator `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_carrid
      IMPORTING
        ir_sflight_line TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_carrid.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_carrid>       TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_sflight_line->* TO <fs_sflight_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_assign_error( text = 'Invalid data reference provided' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamic assignment of component CARRID
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_assign_error( text = 'Component CARRID not found in structure' ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_carrid = <fs_carrid>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_carrid_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_carrid_access_invalid_ref FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_carrid_access_missing_comp FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_carrid_access.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
    DATA(lr_sflight_ref) = REF TO data( ls_sflight ).

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_accessor->get_sflight_carrid( lr_sflight_ref ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Dynamically accessed CARRID should be AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_carrid_access_invalid_ref.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA lr_invalid_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_accessor->get_sflight_carrid( lr_invalid_ref ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Invalid data reference should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for invalid reference' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_carrid_access_missing_comp.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_struct,
            some_field TYPE string,
          END OF ls_test_struct.
    DATA(lr_test_struct_ref) = REF TO data( ls_test_struct ).

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    TRY.
        lo_accessor->get_sflight_carrid( lr_test_struct_ref ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Missing component CARRID should raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught exception for missing component' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Feldzugriff mittels Feldsymbolen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs>`) ist ein Kernfeature des dynamischen Programmierens in ABAP und ist prinzipiell kein neues Feature, wird aber im modernen Kontext von generischen Datenreferenzen (`REF TO DATA`) und robustem Error Handling (`cx_sy_assign_error`) weiterhin relevant und sicher eingesetzt. Es ist unerlässlich, wenn die Struktur von Daten zur Compilezeit nicht bekannt ist.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Feldsymbole, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, REF TO DATA, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach dem heutigen Datum liegt. Verwenden Sie den `PLUS` Operator für Datumsberechnungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `PLUS` Operator mit `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_system_date.
    rv_system_date = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: ABAP 7.50 (und teilweise 7.40) hat die Datums- und Zeitberechnungen durch den `PLUS`-Operator erheblich vereinfacht. Anstatt komplizierter Funktionsbausteine oder manueller Berechnungen können Datums- und Zeitwerte direkt addiert oder subtrahiert werden, z.B. `PLUS 30 DAYS` oder `MINUS 5 HOURS`. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` ist zudem die moderne Art, auf das Systemdatum zuzugreifen, anstatt `sy-datum` direkt zu verwenden.
keywords: Date/Time, PLUS Operator, Datumsberechnung, cl_abap_context_info, System Landscape, Readability

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie ein 'GEOMETRY' Objekt mit einem WKT (Well-Known Text) String, der einen Punkt repräsentiert (z.B. 'POINT(10 20)'). Überprüfen Sie, ob es sich tatsächlich um einen Punkt handelt und geben Sie dies zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_DB_GEOMETRY` und die Methode `CREATE_FROM_WKT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_geometry_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_point
      IMPORTING
        iv_wkt_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_point) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_db_geometry_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_geometry_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_point.
    DATA(lo_geometry) = cl_abap_db_geometry=>create_from_wkt(
      wkt_string = iv_wkt_string
    ).

    IF lo_geometry->get_gtype( ) = cl_abap_db_geometry=>gtype_point.
      rv_is_point = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_point = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_is_point_valid.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_geometry_processor( ).

explanation: Seit ABAP 7.52 gibt es native Unterstützung für Geo-Datenbanktypen und deren Manipulation durch die Klasse `CL_ABAP_DB_GEOMETRY`. Das Initialisieren von Geometrieobjekten aus WKT-Strings (`CREATE_FROM_WKT`) und das Abfragen des Geometrie-Typs (`GET_GTYPE`) sind moderne und leistungsstarke Möglichkeiten, mit räumlichen Daten in ABAP zu interagieren, ohne auf externe Werkzeuge angewiesen zu sein.
keywords: Geospatial, Geometry, WKT, CL_ABAP_DB_GEOMETRY, POINT

Instructions: Lese einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum. Die Daten sollen in eine lokale Struktur gelesen werden.
hint: Nutze `SELECT SINGLE` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` für eine moderne Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein String eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse darstellt.
hint: Nutze den `MATCHES` Operator für eine einfache Regex-Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_email.
    IF iv_email MATCHES `^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,3})+$`.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_email FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_email.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@example.com' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'first.last@sub.domain.co.uk' ) exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_email.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_email_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'invalid-email' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@.com' ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validator->is_valid_email( 'test@example' ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `MATCHES`-Operator bietet eine einfache und direkte Möglichkeit, Strings gegen reguläre Ausdrücke zu prüfen, ohne explizit Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` instanziieren zu müssen. Dies ist ideal für schnelle Validierungen.
keywords: REGEX, MATCHES, String, Validation

Instructions: Finde alle Zahlen in einem gegebenen Text und gib sie als Liste von Strings zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS` und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_numbers.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_text RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).
    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches ( iv_text+<match>-offset(<match>-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_without_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_number_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->find_all_numbers( 'Der Preis ist 123.45 EUR und die Menge ist 67.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '45' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = '67' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_number_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->find_all_numbers( 'Keine Zahlen hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_number_finder( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_finder->find_all_numbers( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um alle Vorkommen eines Musters zu finden. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und `FOR`-Ausdrücken können die Ergebnisse kompakt in eine interne Tabelle gesammelt werden, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.
keywords: REGEX, FIND, Numbers, String, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Ersetze alle doppelten Leerzeichen in einem String durch ein einzelnes Leerzeichen und entferne führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen.
hint: Nutze `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und String-Templates mit `ALPHA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_space_normalizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_normalized_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_space_normalizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_spaces.
    DATA(lv_temp_text) = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_text WITH ' '.
    rv_normalized_text = |{ lv_temp_text ALPHA = IN }|. " Entfernt führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und kondensiert mehrfache Leerzeichen zu einem.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_name_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_parts,
             firstname TYPE string,
             lastname  TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_name_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_name_parts.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '(\w+),\s*(\w+)' ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ) = abap_true.
      rs_name_parts-lastname = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_name_parts-firstname = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks in eine Tabelle von Substrings auf. Der Regex soll dabei mehrere mögliche Trennzeichen berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_matcher` in einer Schleife, um die Teile zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( offset = lv_offset ) = abap_true.
      APPEND iv_text+lv_offset( lo_matcher->offset - lv_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->offset + lo_matcher->length.
    ENDWHILE.
    APPEND iv_text+lv_offset TO rt_parts. " Add remaining part
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_html_sanitizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_plain_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_html_sanitizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_html_tags.
    rv_plain_text = iv_html_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '<[^>]+>' IN rv_plain_text WITH ''.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX ' ' IN rv_plain_text WITH ' '.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '&' IN rv_plain_text WITH '&'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '<' IN rv_plain_text WITH '<'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '>' IN rv_plain_text WITH '>'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_plain_text WITH ' '. " Mehrfache Leerzeichen kondensieren
    rv_plain_text = |{ rv_plain_text ALPHA = IN }|. " Führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einer hierarchischen Baumstruktur an (z.B. Fluggesellschaft -> Verbindung -> Flugnummer).
hint: Nutzen Sie Open SQL mit `GROUP BY` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` für die Datenaufbereitung und `set_table_for_nodes` sowie `set_table_for_items`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_tree_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_and_item_data.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree
      IMPORTING
        i_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_tree_data.
    CREATE DATA rs_data.
    DATA: lt_nodes TYPE lvc_t_nkey,
          lt_items TYPE lvc_t_item.

    " Root node for SFLIGHTS
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_nkey( node_key = 'SFLIGHTS' text = 'Flüge' ) TO lt_nodes.

    " Get distinct carriers
    SELECT FROM sflight
           FIELDS carrid
           GROUP BY carrid
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carriers).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      DATA(lv_carrier_key) = |CARR_{ ls_carrier-carrid }|.
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_nkey( node_key = lv_carrier_key
                               relatkey = 'SFLIGHTS'
                               relatpos = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relatpos_last_child
                               text     = ls_carrier-carrid ) TO lt_nodes.
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_item( node_key = lv_carrier_key item_name = 'CARRID' text = ls_carrier-carrid ) TO lt_items.

      " Get connections for each carrier
      SELECT FROM sflight
             FIELDS carrid, connid
             WHERE carrid = @ls_carrier-carrid
             GROUP BY carrid, connid
             INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connections).

      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(ls_connection).
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |CONN_{ ls_connection-carrid }_{ ls_connection-connid }|.
        APPEND VALUE lvc_s_nkey( node_key = lv_conn_key
                                 relatkey = lv_carrier_key
                                 relatpos = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relatpos_last_child
                                 text     = |{ ls_connection-connid }| ) TO lt_nodes.
        APPEND VALUE lvc_s_item( node_key = lv_conn_key item_name = 'CONNID' text = |{ ls_connection-connid }| ) TO lt_items.

        " Get flights for each connection
        SELECT FROM sflight
               FIELDS carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
               WHERE carrid = @ls_connection-carrid AND connid = @ls_connection-connid
               ORDER BY fldate
               INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

        LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          DATA(lv_flight_key) = |FLIGHT_{ ls_flight-carrid }_{ ls_flight-connid }_{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
          APPEND VALUE lvc_s_nkey( node_key = lv_flight_key
                                   relatkey = lv_conn_key
                                   relatpos = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relatpos_last_child
                                   text     = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) TO lt_nodes.
          APPEND VALUE lvc_s_item( node_key = lv_flight_key item_name = 'FLDATE' text = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }| ) TO lt_items.
          APPEND VALUE lvc_s_item( node_key = lv_flight_key item_name = 'SEATSOCC' text = |{ ls_flight-seatsocc }| ) TO lt_items.
          APPEND VALUE lvc_s_item( node_key = lv_flight_key item_name = 'SEATSMAX' text = |{ ls_flight-seatsmax }| ) TO lt_items.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    rs_data->nodes = lt_nodes.
    rs_data->items = lt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    DATA(ls_data) = get_sflights_tree_data( ).

    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = i_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>item_selection_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' scrtext_s = 'Airline' scrtext_m = 'Airline' scrtext_l = 'Airline' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' scrtext_s = 'Conn. ID' scrtext_m = 'Conn. ID' scrtext_l = 'Conn. ID' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' scrtext_s = 'Flight Date' scrtext_m = 'Flight Date' scrtext_l = 'Flight Date' )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' scrtext_s = 'Occupied' scrtext_m = 'Occupied' scrtext_l = 'Occupied' )
      ( fieldname = 'SEATSMAX' scrtext_s = 'Max Seats' scrtext_m = 'Max Seats' scrtext_l = 'Max Seats' )
    ).
    lo_tree->set_table_for_columns( lt_columns ).

    lo_tree->set_table_for_nodes( it_nodes = ls_data->nodes ).
    lo_tree->set_table_for_items( it_items = ls_data->items ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die dynamisch Knoten zu einem bestehenden `cl_gui_simple_tree` hinzufügt und entfernt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `add_node` und `delete_node` von `cl_gui_simple_tree`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        i_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS add_dynamic_node
      IMPORTING
        i_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        i_node_text  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS delete_dynamic_node
      IMPORTING
        i_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = i_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    " Initial root node
    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE lvc_t_nkey(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Dynamic Root' )
    ).
    mo_tree->set_table_for_nodes( it_nodes = lt_nodes ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_dynamic_node.
    mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
    rv_node_key = |DYN_{ mv_node_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_node_key = rv_node_key
      i_relat_node_key = i_parent_key
      i_relat_pos = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relatpos_last_child
      i_text = i_node_text
    ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( i_parent_key ). " Ensure parent is expanded
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_dynamic_node.
    mo_tree->delete_node( i_node_key = i_node_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Add second node

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_node2_key exp = 'DYN_0000000002' ).

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und lesen Sie den Antworttext.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Request und `cl_http_utility` für die URL-Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_url_content
      IMPORTING
        i_url TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_url_content.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_url_encoded TYPE string.

    " Encode URL to handle special characters
    lv_url_encoded = cl_http_utility=>escape_url( i_url ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = lv_url_encoded
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
