Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine externe URL und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` für den Request und `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals` für die JSON-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             status TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        i_url       TYPE string
        i_name      TYPE string
        i_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Prepare JSON request payload
    DATA(ls_request_data) = VALUE ty_request_data( name = i_name value = i_value ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( EXPORTING data = ls_request_data PRETTY_PRINT = abap_false CHANGING json = lv_json_request ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = i_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    " Deserialize JSON response
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_response CHANGING data = rs_response ).

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_http_query_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_query_params.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_full_url    TYPE string.

    " Construct URL with query parameters using String Templates and URL encoding
    lv_full_url = |{ i_base_url }?{ cl_http_utility=>escape_url( i_param1_name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>escape_url( i_param1_value ) }&{ cl_http_utility=>escape_url( i_param2_name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>escape_url( i_param2_value ) }|.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = lv_full_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    rv_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Authentifizierung (Basic Authentication) durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client->request->set_header_field` für den `Authorization`-Header.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_with_basic_auth
      IMPORTING
        i_url      TYPE string
        i_username TYPE string
        i_password TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_basic_auth.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_auth_string TYPE string,
          lv_encoded_auth TYPE string.

    " Construct Basic Auth string: 'username:password'
    lv_auth_string = |{ i_username }:{ i_password }|.

    " Encode to Base64
    cl_http_utility=>encode_base64(
      EXPORTING
        iv_data = lv_auth_string
      IMPORTING
        ev_data = lv_encoded_auth
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = i_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    " Set Authorization header
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Authorization' value = |Basic { lv_encoded_auth }| ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    rv_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und setzen Sie einen Timeout für die Kommunikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client->property_set_runtime` mit `if_http_client=>co_timeout`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_timeout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_with_timeout
      IMPORTING
        i_url    TYPE string
        i_timeout TYPE i " Timeout in seconds
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING   cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_timeout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_timeout.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = i_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    " Set timeout for the request
    lo_http_client->property_set_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_name  = if_http_client=>co_timeout
        i_value = i_timeout
    ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    rv_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_with_timeout_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_with_timeout_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_with_timeout_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout( ).
    DATA(lv_test_url) = 'https://www.example.com'.
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 10. " 10 seconds, should be enough
    DATA(lv_content) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_content = lo_cut->get_with_timeout( i_url = lv_test_url i_timeout = lv_timeout ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_content msg = 'Content should not be empty' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |HTTP request failed: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_with_timeout_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_timeout( ).
    " Use a URL that is known to be slow or a mock server that delays response
    " For a real test, you'd need a controlled slow endpoint.
    " httpbin.org/delay/X can simulate this, but might be unreliable for very short timeouts.
    DATA(lv_test_url) = 'https://httpbin.org/delay/3'. " Delays for 3 seconds
    DATA(lv_timeout) = 1. " 1 second timeout
    DATA(lv_content) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_content = lo_cut->get_with_timeout( i_url = lv_test_url i_timeout = lv_timeout ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected HTTP request to time out, but it succeeded.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'HTTP communication failure' msg = 'Expected timeout error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einen Timeout für HTTP-Requests setzt. Mit `cl_http_client->property_set_runtime` und der Konstante `if_http_client=>co_timeout` kann die maximale Wartezeit in Sekunden für die Serverantwort konfiguriert werden. Dies ist wichtig, um zu verhindern, dass Anwendungen bei langsamen oder nicht reagierenden Servern blockiert werden. Der Unit-Test demonstriert sowohl einen erfolgreichen Request innerhalb des Timeouts als auch einen erwarteten Timeout-Fehler.
keywords: HTTP, Timeout, cl_http_client, property_set_runtime, if_http_client=>co_timeout, Web Service

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus, die in einer internen Tabelle vorliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = it_carrids-carrid
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fae_selection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_selection.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE zcl_fae_basic=>tt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_carrids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carriers( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Check if flights for LH exist
    DATA(lv_lh_flights) = lines( FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_lh_flights > 0 ).
    " Check if flights for AA exist
    DATA(lv_aa_flights) = lines( FILTER #( lt_flights WHERE carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_aa_flights > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug, um Daten aus der Datenbank basierend auf Werten in einer internen Tabelle abzurufen. Es vermeidet N+1-Probleme und wird von der Datenbank optimiert. Es ist wichtig, die interne Tabelle vor der Verwendung auf `IS NOT INITIAL` zu prüfen, um Syntaxfehler zu vermeiden.
keywords: FAE, SELECT, Database, Internal Table, sflights

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus und filtern Sie anschließend die Ergebnisse, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität anzuzeigen, unter Verwendung moderner interner Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `FILTER` oder `FOR` für die Nachbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_modern_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_modern_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.
    IF it_carrids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carrids
        WHERE carrid = it_carrids-carrid
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_all_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsocc >= iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fae_and_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fae_and_filter.
    DATA: lt_carrids TYPE zcl_fae_modern_itab=>tt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_carrids.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' ) TO lt_carrids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_modern_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      it_carrids      = lt_carrids
      iv_min_capacity = 100 ). " Assuming some flights have seatsocc >= 100

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Check if all remaining flights meet the capacity criteria
    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_flight>-seatsocc >= 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die effiziente Datenbeschaffung mittels `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit modernen ABAP-Sprachkonstrukten zur internen Tabellenverarbeitung. Der `FILTER`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht eine deklarative und performante Filterung von internen Tabellen, was zu kürzerem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: FAE, SELECT, FILTER, Internal Table, sflights, ABAP 7.40+

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdaten zusammen mit den entsprechenden Fluggesellschaftsnamen aus `scarr` ab, ohne `FOR ALL ENTRIES` zu verwenden, sondern mit einem `JOIN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... JOIN ...`.

CLASS zcl_db_join_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_with_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_join_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_names.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_selection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_join_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_names( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ). " Assuming Lufthansa is the name for LH
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `JOIN`-Operationen sind oft die bevorzugte Methode, um Daten aus mehreren Datenbanktabellen in einem einzigen Datenbankzugriff zu kombinieren. Im Gegensatz zu `FOR ALL ENTRIES`, das mehrere Datenbankzugriffe verursachen kann (wenn auch optimiert), führt ein `JOIN` zu einem einzigen, komplexeren Datenbank-Statement, das in der Regel effizienter ist, wenn die Daten direkt in der Datenbank verknüpft werden können. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist moderne ABAP-Syntax (ABAP 7.40+).
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, Database, scarr, sflights, ABAP 7.40+

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Werten validiert. Sammeln Sie alle Validierungsfehler mithilfe von `cl_message_helper` und geben Sie sie als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper=>add_message` und `cl_message_helper=>get_messages_as_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_values
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_messages) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_values.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      IF lv_value IS INITIAL.
        " Annahme: Eine Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_APP mit Nachricht 001 existiert.
        " Nachrichtentext: 'Value at index &1 is initial.'
        lo_msg_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
          iv_msgno = '001'
          iv_msgv1 = lv_index
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_messages = lo_msg_helper->get_messages_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Value1' ) ( '' ) ( 'Value3' ) ( '' ) ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->validate_values( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_messages
      msg = 'Expected messages for initial values'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_messages
      exp = 'Value at index 2 is initial.' " Annahme: Nachricht 001 aus ZMSG_APP
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_messages
      exp = 'Value at index 4 is initial.' " Annahme: Nachricht 001 aus ZMSG_APP
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_errors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_collector( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Value1' ) ( 'Value2' ) ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->validate_values( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_messages
      msg = 'Expected no messages for valid values'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_message_helper` bietet eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, Nachrichten zu sammeln und zu verwalten, anstatt direkt `MESSAGE` Anweisungen zu verwenden. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Validierungsszenarien, wo mehrere Fehler gesammelt und am Ende als konsolidierte Liste präsentiert werden sollen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von internen Tabellen ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: MESSAGE, Error Handling, Validation, cl_message_helper, String Table

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflight` in ein XSTRING serialisiert und eine andere Methode, die dieses XSTRING zurück in eine `sflight`-Tabelle deserialisiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_data` und `cl_abap_container_utilities=>deserialize_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_data) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS deserialize_sflight
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflight.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>serialize_data(
      EXPORTING
        data   = it_sflight
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rx_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_sflight.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>deserialize_data(
      EXPORTING
        buffer = ix_data
      IMPORTING
        data   = rt_sflight
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_deserialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_serializer( ).
    DATA(lt_original_sflight) = VALUE zcl_sflight_serializer=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lx_serialized_data) = lo_cut->serialize_sflight( lt_original_sflight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lx_serialized_data
      msg = 'Serialized data should not be initial'
    ).

    DATA(lt_deserialized_sflight) = lo_cut->deserialize_sflight( lx_serialized_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_deserialized_sflight )
      exp = lines( lt_original_sflight )
      msg = 'Number of lines should match after deserialization'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_deserialized_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_original_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'First entry CARRIER ID should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_deserialized_sflight[ 2 ]-price
      exp = lt_original_sflight[ 2 ]-price
      msg = 'Second entry PRICE should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_container_utilities` ermöglicht die einfache Serialisierung und Deserialisierung von ABAP-Datenobjekten (wie internen Tabellen) in ein binäres XSTRING-Format und umgekehrt. Dies ist nützlich für die Speicherung von Daten in Datenbankfeldern vom Typ RAWSTRING oder für den Datenaustausch. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Testdaten ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: Serialization, Deserialization, XSTRING, Internal Table, cl_abap_container_utilities

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und verwenden Sie `cl_message_helper`, um eine Fehlermeldung zu erstellen, die die Ausnahmeinformationen enthält. Geben Sie die gesammelte Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `cl_message_helper=>add_message_from_exception`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Returns message if error, else result
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Division successful: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        lo_msg_helper->add_message_from_exception(
          io_exception = lx_zerodivide
          iv_msgty     = 'E'
        ).
        rv_result = lo_msg_helper->get_messages_as_string( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_result
      msg = 'Expected an error message for division by zero'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' " Check for exception class name in message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Division successful: 5'
      msg = 'Expected successful division result'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `cl_message_helper` nahtlos in die ABAP-Ausnahmebehandlung integriert werden kann. Mit `add_message_from_exception` können detaillierte Fehlermeldungen direkt aus einer gefangenen Ausnahme generiert und gesammelt werden, was die Fehleranalyse und -protokollierung vereinfacht. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung der Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: Exception Handling, Division by Zero, cl_message_helper, TRY-CATCH, String Templates

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen langen String komprimiert und eine andere Methode, die das komprimierte XSTRING dekomprimiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_container_utilities=>compress_xstring` und `cl_abap_container_utilities=>decompress_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_compressed_data) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS decompress_string
      IMPORTING
        ix_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING

  METHOD compress_string.
    DATA(lx_raw_data) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_data ). " Convert string to xstring
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>compress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        uncompressed_xstring = lx_raw_data
      IMPORTING
        compressed_xstring   = rx_compressed_data

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_string.
    DATA(lx_decompressed_raw) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_container_utilities=>decompress_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        compressed_xstring   = ix_compressed_data
      IMPORTING
        uncompressed_xstring = lx_decompressed_raw
    ).
    rv_decompressed_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( lx_decompressed_raw ). " Convert xstring to string
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) filtert, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten, und diese in eine neue Tabelle kopiert. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer `sflight`-Tabelle berechnet. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_reducer=>tt_sflight_data( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabewert einen Status-String zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für die bedingte Logik.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Active'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'Pending'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 3 THEN 'Blocked'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) nach Flügen filtert, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für eine deklarative Filterung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_data,
      tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_date        TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate > iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Date, SFLIGHT, Declarative Programming

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        field_a TYPE string,
        field_b TYPE i,
        field_c TYPE string,
        extra_s TYPE string,

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte externe Datei, die UTF-16LE-kodierte Daten enthält. Konvertieren Sie diese Daten in die Systemkodierung und verarbeiten Sie sie anschließend, um eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Carrier, Connection, Date, Max Seats) zu füllen, wobei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität berücksichtigt werden. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Konvertierung und die Tabellenverarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Konvertierung und geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `LET`, `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_data_utf16 TYPE xstring " Simulated UTF-16LE raw data
        iv_min_capacity   TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA: lv_string_data TYPE string.

    " 1. Convert UTF-16LE xstring to system codepage string
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepages=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            raw    = iv_raw_data_utf16
          IMPORTING
            buffer = lv_string_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Process the string data using nested FOR expressions
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR <line> IN ( SPLIT lv_string_data AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_lines) ) 
      LET parts = VALUE string_table( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT <line> AT ',' ) ( <part> ) ) IN 
      WHERE ( parts[4] >= iv_min_capacity ) 
      ( carrid   = parts[1]
        connid   = parts[2]
        fldate   = parts[3]
        seatsmax = parts[4] ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks, der eine Hash-Tabelle aggregiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen, wobei der Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft und der Wert die aggregierte Kapazität ist. Nutzen Sie die `LET`-Expression, um bestehende Einträge zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_carrier_capacity,
      tt_carrier_capacity TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_capacity) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rt_carrier_capacity = REDUCE tt_carrier_capacity(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity( )
      FOR <flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET existing_entry = result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = <flight>-carrid ] IN
      result = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity(
        result
        ( carrid = <flight>-carrid
          total_capacity = existing_entry-total_capacity + <flight>-seatsmax ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen String, der in der Codepage 'ISO-8859-1' vorliegt, in die interne Systemkodierung. Der Eingabestring wird hierbei als bereits in ISO-8859-1 kodiert angenommen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit der entsprechenden Quellkodierung. Beachten Sie, dass der Eingabestring intern in ein XSTRING umgewandelt wird, um die Konvertierung zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_iso_to_system DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_iso_to_system
      IMPORTING
        iv_iso_string TYPE string " String assumed to be in ISO-8859-1 characters
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_system_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_iso_to_system IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_iso_to_system.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    " Simulate raw bytes from an external source by converting the input string
    " (which is in system codepage) to ISO-8859-1 xstring.
    " This step would typically be replaced by actual file/network read into xstring.
    lv_xstring = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' )->convert( iv_iso_string ).

    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        raw    = lv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        buffer = rv_system_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte externe Datei, die UTF-8-kodierte Daten mit Byte Order Mark (BOM) enthält. Konvertieren Sie diese Daten in die Systemkodierung und stellen Sie sicher, dass das BOM korrekt behandelt (entfernt) wird.

CLASS zcl_utf8_bom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_with_bom
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_data_utf8_bom TYPE xstring " Simulated UTF-8 raw data with BOM

CLASS zcl_utf8_bom_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-8'

        ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            raw    = iv_raw_data_utf8_bom
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_system_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine komplexe geschachtelte Datenstruktur (Tabelle von Strukturen mit geschachtelten Tabellen) unter Verwendung von `VALUE`-Ausdrücken. Die Struktur soll Fluggesellschaften, deren Flüge und für jeden Flug die Passagierkapazität enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit geschachtelten `FOR GROUPS`-Ausdrücken, um die Daten aus `sflights` zu gruppieren und zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_detail,
      tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid  TYPE s_carr_id,
        flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights,
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nested_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rt_nested_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <flight_group> IN lt_sflights BY <flight_group>-carrid 
      ( carrid = <flight_group>-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR <flight> IN GROUP <flight_group> 
          ( connid   = <flight>-connid
            fldate   = <flight>-fldate
            seatsmax = <flight>-seatsmax ) 
        ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen simulierten JSON-String, der als XSTRING in UTF-16BE vorliegt, in die Systemkodierung und parsen Sie ihn anschließend in eine ABAP-Datenstruktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Konvertierung und `/ui2/cl_json` für das Parsen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_utf16_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_json_data,
        name TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_json_data.

    METHODS parse_utf16be_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_xstring_utf16be TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_parsed_data) TYPE ty_json_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error,
        cx_sy_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_utf16_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_utf16be_json.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.

    " 1. Convert UTF-16BE xstring to system codepage string
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepages=>endian_big
        ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            raw    = iv_json_xstring_utf16be
          IMPORTING
            buffer = lv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. Parse the JSON string
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_json_string
          CHANGING
            data        = rs_parsed_data
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_json_parse_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_json_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Flugstatus (z.B. 'C' for Cancelled, 'D' for Delayed, 'X' for On Time) und der Fluggesellschaft ('LH', 'AA') eine entsprechende Statusmeldung zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `SWITCH`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für die äußere und innere Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_message.
    rv_message = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
      WHEN 'LH' THEN SWITCH #( iv_status
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Lufthansa Flug storniert.'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Lufthansa Flug verspätet.'
        WHEN 'X' THEN 'Lufthansa Flug pünktlich.'
        ELSE 'Lufthansa Flugstatus unbekannt.'
      )
      WHEN 'AA' THEN SWITCH #( iv_status
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'American Airlines Flug storniert.'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'American Airlines Flug verspätet.'
        WHEN 'X' THEN 'American Airlines Flug pünktlich.'
        ELSE 'American Airlines Flugstatus unbekannt.'
      )
      ELSE SWITCH #( iv_status
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Flug storniert.'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Flug verspätet.'
        WHEN 'X' THEN 'Flug pünktlich.'
        ELSE 'Flugstatus unbekannt.'
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte externe Datei, die UTF-16-kodierte Daten enthält, deren Endianness (Byte-Reihenfolge) unbekannt ist. Konvertieren Sie diese Daten in die Systemkodierung, indem Sie die Endianness automatisch erkennen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_utf16_endian_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf16_auto_endian
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_data_utf16 TYPE xstring " Simulated UTF-16 raw data (LE or BE)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_system_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utf16_endian_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf16_auto_endian.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = 'UTF-16'
          input_bom = cl_abap_conv_codepages=>input_bom_detect " Detect BOM and endianness
          endian    = cl_abap_conv_codepages=>endian_detect    " Explicitly detect endianness
        ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            raw    = iv_raw_data_utf16
          IMPORTING
            buffer = rv_system_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Standardwert für die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität eines Fluges zurückgibt. Der Standardwert hängt von der Fluggesellschaft ab ('LH' hat 180, 'AA' hat 200). Wenn die Fluggesellschaft unbekannt ist, soll ein globaler Standardwert von 150 zurückgegeben werden. Wenn jedoch ein expliziter `iv_default_capacity` übergeben wird, soll dieser verwendet werden, es sei denn, er ist 0, dann gelten die Regeln für die Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `COND`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` für die äußere und innere Bedingung, um die Prioritäten der Standardwerte zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_default_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_default_capacity TYPE s_seatsmax OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_capacity) TYPE s_seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_default_capacity.
    rv_capacity = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_default_capacity IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_default_capacity <> 0 THEN iv_default_capacity 
      ELSE COND #( iv_carrid 
        WHEN 'LH' THEN 180 
        WHEN 'AA' THEN 200 
        ELSE 150 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine simulierte externe CSV-Datei (UTF-8 kodiert) inklusive Header-Zeile. Konvertieren Sie die Daten in die Systemkodierung und parsen Sie die Datenzeilen in eine interne Tabelle, wobei Sie die Header-Informationen für das Mapping nutzen und geschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Konvertierung. Trennen Sie Header und Daten, und nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `LET` und `VALUE` für das zeilenweise Parsen und Mapping.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_record,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_record,
      tt_flight_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_xstring_utf8 TYPE xstring " Simulated UTF-8 raw CSV data with header
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_records) TYPE tt_flight_records
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error,
        cx_sy_data_access_error. " For missing columns
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_header.
    DATA: lv_csv_string TYPE string.

    " 1. Convert UTF-8 xstring to system codepage string
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        lo_conv->convert(
          EXPORTING
            raw    = iv_csv_xstring_utf8
          IMPORTING
            buffer = lv_csv_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.

    " Split into lines
    DATA(lt_lines) = SPLIT lv_csv_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE DATA(lt_temp_lines).
    DELETE lt_lines WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. " Remove empty lines

    IF lines( lt_lines ) < 2.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_data_access_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_data_access_error=>no_data.
    ENDIF.

    " Extract header (for demonstration, not used for dynamic mapping in this simplified example)
    DATA(lv_header_line) = lt_lines[1].
    DATA(lt_header_cols) = VALUE string_table( FOR <col> IN ( SPLIT lv_header_line AT ',' ) ( <col> ) ).

    " Remove header from data lines
    DELETE lt_lines INDEX 1.

    " 2. Process data lines using nested FOR expressions and map
    rt_records = VALUE #( 
      FOR <data_line> IN lt_lines 
      LET parts = VALUE string_table( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT <data_line> AT ',' ) ( <part> ) ) IN 
      ( carrid = parts[1] 
        connid = parts[2]
        fldate = parts[3] ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Nach der Konvertierung des UTF-8 XSTRING in einen System-String werden die Zeilen getrennt und der Header extrahiert. Anschließend werden die Datenzeilen mit einer `FOR`-Schleife verarbeitet, wobei `LET` und eine innere `FOR`-Schleife verwendet werden, um die einzelnen Spalten einer Zeile zu extrahieren und in die Zielstruktur zu mappen. Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'LH' oder 'AA' durchgeführt werden UND deren Flugdatum im Jahr 2025 liegt UND deren maximale Sitzplatzkapazität über 150 liegt. Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FILTER`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER`, indem Sie die Ausgabe eines Filters als Eingabe für den nächsten Filter verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    " Nested FILTER expressions
    DATA(lt_filtered_by_carrier) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_by_date) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_filtered_by_carrier
      WHERE ( fldate CP '2025*' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_filtered_by_date
      WHERE ( seatsmax > 150 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen einer großen externen Datei (UTF-8 kodiert) in Chunks (Teilen) und konvertieren Sie jeden Chunk einzeln in die Systemkodierung. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `flush` und `reset` in `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit `convert` in einer Schleife, `flush` nach dem letzten Chunk und `reset` für eine neue Konvertierung (nicht direkt im Beispiel gezeigt, aber relevant für wiederholte Nutzung).
solution:
CLASS zcl_chunk_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_xstring_utf8 TYPE xstring " Simulated large UTF-8 raw data
        iv_chunk_size        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chunk_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA: lv_chunk_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lv_converted_chunk TYPE string.
    DATA: lo_conv TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce.

    TRY.
        lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

        WHILE lv_offset < xstrlen( iv_full_xstring_utf8 ).
          lv_chunk_xstring = iv_full_xstring_utf8+lv_offset(iv_chunk_size).

          lo_conv->convert(
            EXPORTING
              raw    = lv_chunk_xstring
            IMPORTING
              buffer = lv_converted_chunk
          ).
          rv_full_string = rv_full_string && lv_converted_chunk.
          CLEAR lv_converted_chunk. " Clear buffer for next chunk

          lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
        ENDWHILE.

        " Flush any remaining data in the converter's internal buffer
        lo_conv->flush( IMPORTING buffer = lv_converted_chunk ).
        rv_full_string = rv_full_string && lv_converted_chunk.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität und die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS` für die äußere Gruppierung und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_stats,
        carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
        fldate         TYPE s_date,
        avg_capacity   TYPE decfloat16,
        flight_count   TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_stats,
      tt_flight_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_stats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_stats) TYPE tt_flight_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_stats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    rt_flight_stats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <flight_group> IN lt_sflights BY ( carrid = <flight_group>-carrid fldate = <flight_group>-fldate ) 
      ( carrid       = <flight_group>-carrid
        fldate       = <flight_group>-fldate
        avg_capacity = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum_cap = 0.0
               count = 0
          FOR <flight> IN GROUP <flight_group>
          NEXT sum_cap = sum_cap + <flight>-seatsmax
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY = sum_cap / count
        )
        flight_count = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR <flight> IN GROUP <flight_group>
          NEXT count = count + 1
        ) 
      ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_grouped_stats.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check for a specific group (e.g., 'LH' on a specific date)
    " This requires knowing the test data in sflights.
    " Assuming sflights has data for 'LH' and '20250101'
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'LH' fldate = '20250101' INTO DATA(ls_lh_20250101_stats).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_lh_20250101_stats-flight_count exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_20250101_stats-avg_capacity ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check for consistency: flight_count should be positive if avg_capacity is calculated
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_stats).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_stats-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`-Ausdrücken zur komplexen Datenaggregation. Flüge werden zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe werden dann mit `REDUCE` die durchschnittliche Kapazität und die Anzahl der Flüge berechnet. Diese geschachtelte, funktionale Syntax ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP und ermöglicht sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Datenverarbeitungspipelines.
keywords: NESTING, FOR GROUPS, REDUCE, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights

CLASS zcl_appointment_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             guid        TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_guid,
             description TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_description,
             date_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_from,
             time_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_from,
             date_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_to,
             time_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_to,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data.

    METHODS get_filtered_appointments
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_date TYPE d OPTIONAL
        iv_search_term TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_guids) TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_guids_tab.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    LOOP AT it_appointments INTO DATA(ls_app_data).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( iv_guid = ls_app_data-guid ).
          lo_appointment->set_description( ls_app_data-description ).
          lo_appointment->set_date_from( ls_app_data-date_from ).
          lo_appointment->set_time_from( ls_app_data-time_from ).
          lo_appointment->set_date_to( ls_app_data-date_to ).
          lo_appointment->set_time_to( ls_app_data-time_to ).
          INSERT lo_appointment INTO TABLE mt_appointments.
        CATCH cx_appointment_error.
          " Handle error, e.g., log it. For this example, we skip invalid appointments.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_appointments.
    rt_filtered_guids = VALUE #( FOR <app> IN FILTER #( mt_appointments WHERE
                                                          get_date_from( ) = COND d( WHEN iv_filter_date IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_filter_date ELSE get_date_from( ) ) AND
                                                          get_description( ) CP COND string( WHEN iv_search_term IS NOT INITIAL THEN '*' && iv_search_term && '*' ELSE get_description( ) ) ) 
                                 ( <app>->get_guid( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             guid        TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_guid,
             description TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_description,
             date_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_from,
             time_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_from,
             date_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_to,
             time_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_to,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES: tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_appointment_count,
             appointment_date TYPE d,
             count            TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_appointment_count.
    TYPES: tt_daily_appointment_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_appointment_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_daily_counts) TYPE tt_daily_appointment_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    DATA: lt_appointments_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_appointments INTO DATA(ls_app_data).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( iv_guid = ls_app_data-guid ).
          lo_appointment->set_description( ls_app_data-description ).
          lo_appointment->set_date_from( ls_app_data-date_from ).
          lo_appointment->set_time_from( ls_app_data-time_from ).
          lo_appointment->set_date_to( ls_app_data-date_to ).
          lo_appointment->set_time_to( ls_app_data-time_to ).
          INSERT lo_appointment INTO TABLE lt_appointments_objects.
        CATCH cx_appointment_error.
          " Skip invalid appointments
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_daily_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <app> IN lt_appointments_objects GROUP BY ( date = <app>->get_date_from( ) ) 
                               ( appointment_date = GROUP KEY-date
                                 count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_appointment_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_daily_counts) = lo_grouper->group_appointments_by_date( it_appointments = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_daily_counts ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_today_count) = lt_daily_counts[ KEY appointment_date = sy-datum ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_today_count-count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_tomorrow_count) = lt_daily_counts[ KEY appointment_date = lv_tomorrow ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_tomorrow_count-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, um Termine nach ihrem Startdatum zu gruppieren. Innerhalb der Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Anzahl der Termine pro Tag zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: CL_APPOINTMENT, Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_appointment.
    DATA(lv_guid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( iv_guid = lv_guid ).
    lo_appointment->set_description( 'Projektbesprechung' ).
    lo_appointment->set_date_from( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_from( '100000' ).
    lo_appointment->set_date_to( sy-datum ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_to( '113000' ).

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_appointment_formatter( ).
    DATA(lv_formatted_string) = lo_formatter->format_appointment_details( io_appointment = lo_appointment ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date_from) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_expected_date_to) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_expected_time_from) = '100000'.
    DATA(lv_expected_time_to) = '113000'.

    CONVERT DATE lv_expected_date_from INTO MASK '____.__.__' AND TIME lv_expected_time_from INTO MASK '__:__:__'
            INTO DATA(lv_display_date_from) AND DATA(lv_display_time_from).
    CONVERT DATE lv_expected_date_to INTO MASK '____.__.__' AND TIME lv_expected_time_to INTO MASK '__:__:__'
            INTO DATA(lv_display_date_to) AND DATA(lv_display_time_to).

    DATA(lv_expected_string) = |Termin: Projektbesprechung\n| &&
                               |Datum: { lv_display_date_from } - { lv_display_date_to }\n| &&
                               |Zeit: { lv_display_time_from } - { lv_display_time_to }|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax zur dynamischen Erstellung von Strings. Hier werden die Attribute des `CL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekts direkt in den String eingebettet und mit Formatierungsoptionen (`DATE = USER`, `TIME = USER`) versehen.

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).

CLASS zcl_app_ctmenu_integrator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             guid        TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_guid,
             description TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_description,
             date_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_from,
             time_from   TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_from,
             date_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_date_to,
             time_to     TYPE cl_appointment=>ty_time_to,

CLASS zcl_app_ctmenu_integrator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointment_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'CREATE_NEW_APP' text = 'Neuen Termin erstellen' ).
    ro_menu->add_separator( ).

    IF it_appointments IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_submenu_actions) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
      LOOP AT it_appointments INTO DATA(ls_app_data).
        DATA(lv_fcode_view) = |VIEW_{ ls_app_data-guid }|.
        DATA(lv_text_view) = |Details: { ls_app_data-description }|.
        lo_submenu_actions->add_function( fcode = lv_fcode_view text = lv_text_view ).

        DATA(lv_fcode_edit) = |EDIT_{ ls_app_data-guid }|.
        DATA(lv_text_edit) = |Bearbeiten: { ls_app_data-description }|.
        lo_submenu_actions->add_function( fcode = lv_fcode_edit text = lv_text_edit ).
        lo_submenu_actions->add_separator( ).
      ENDLOOP.
      ro_menu->add_submenu( fcode = 'APP_ACTIONS' text = 'Termin-Aktionen' submenu = lo_submenu_actions ).
    ELSE.
      ro_menu->add_function( fcode = 'NO_APPS' text = 'Keine Termine verfügbar' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und aktualisieren Sie ein Feld direkt, ohne eine explizite `MODIFY` Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS modify_prices IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_prices.
    rt_sflights = it_sflights.
    LOOP AT rt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.10'. " Increase price by 10%
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_fld_modify_table=>ty_t_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_new>).
    <fs_new>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_new>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_new>-price = '100.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_modify_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->modify_prices( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_new>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_new>-price exp = '110.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle, ohne dass eine `MODIFY` Anweisung erforderlich ist. Dies ist effizienter, da keine Daten kopiert werden.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer internen Tabelle zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_field_value IMPORTING is_data     TYPE ty_data
                                      iv_field_name TYPE string
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_fld_dynamic_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Value A' field2 = 'Value B' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_dynamic_access( ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Value A' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = 'Value B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_value_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ist der moderne Weg, um dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur zur Kompilierzeit nicht vollständig bekannt ist.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie über ein Feldsymbol auf deren Inhalt zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF` und `ASSIGN <data_reference>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_table_by_ref IMPORTING ir_items TYPE REF TO ty_t_items
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_first_item_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table_by_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_items> TYPE ty_t_items,
                   <fs_item>  TYPE ty_item.

    ASSIGN ir_items->* TO <fs_items>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_items> IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE <fs_items> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_first_item_name = <fs_item>-name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_fld_data_ref=>ty_t_items(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_items) = REF TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_data_ref( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->process_table_by_ref( lr_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Item A' ).

    " Test with empty table
    DATA(lt_empty_items) = zcl_fld_data_ref=>ty_t_items( ).
    DATA(lr_empty_items) = REF TO lt_empty_items.
    DATA(lv_empty_name) = lo_cut->process_table_by_ref( lr_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_empty_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus Datenreferenzen und Feldsymbolen ermöglicht eine flexible und performante Übergabe und Bearbeitung von Datenobjekten, insbesondere von internen Tabellen. `ASSIGN <data_reference>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL` dereferenziert die Referenz und weist den Inhalt einem Feldsymbol zu, was direkten Zugriff ohne Kopieren ermöglicht.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Data Reference, Dereferencing, Internal Tables

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede eindeutige Fluggesellschaft die maximale Flugverbindungs-ID aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.

CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_max_connid,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             max_connid TYPE sflight-connid,

    METHODS get_max_connid_per_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_t_carrid_max_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_connid_per_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, MAX( connid ) AS max_connid
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_connid_per_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_connid_per_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sel_distinct_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_max_connid_per_carrid( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHTS contains data for 'LH' and 'AA'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Check if not empty

    " Find max connid for LH (example, actual value depends on DB content)
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh-max_connid ).

explanation: Obwohl `DISTINCT` hier nicht explizit verwendet wird, erzielt `GROUP BY` in Kombination mit einer Aggregatfunktion (wie `MAX`) einen ähnlichen Effekt, indem es eindeutige Gruppen bildet und für jede Gruppe einen aggregierten Wert liefert. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke SQL-Funktion, die in modernem ABAP direkt genutzt wird.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT (implied), GROUP BY, Aggregation, Database Access, Open SQL

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Datenreferenz akzeptiert und den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes in jeder Zeile ausliest.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN <data_reference>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_rtti_generic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_values_from_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_rtti_generic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_values_from_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_field_values_from_table FOR TESTING.
