CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_values_from_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES ty_t_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_t_test_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'First' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Second' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Third' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_rtti_generic( ).
    DATA(lt_texts) = lo_cut->get_field_values_from_table( ir_table = lr_data iv_field_name = 'TEXT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_texts ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_texts[ 1 ] exp = 'First' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_texts[ 2 ] exp = 'Second' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_texts[ 3 ] exp = 'Third' ).

    DATA(lt_ids) = lo_cut->get_field_values_from_table( ir_table = lr_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_ids[ 1 ] exp = '1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von Feldsymbolen in Kombination mit Datenreferenzen für generische Tabellenverarbeitung. Ohne Kenntnis des genauen Tabellentyps zur Kompilierzeit kann über `ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>` dynamisch auf Daten zugegriffen werden. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und generische Frameworks.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Data Reference, Generic

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugverbindungs-ID in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT DISTINCT` in Kombination mit einer Subquery und `EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES ty_t_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrids_with_connid IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE ty_t_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_connid.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights AS s1
      WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT * 
                           FROM sflights AS s2
                           WHERE s2~carrid = s1~carrid
                             AND s2~connid = @iv_connid )
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrids_with_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrids_with_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sel_distinct_exists( ).

    " Assuming '0400' is a valid connid for 'LH'
    DATA(lt_carrids_0400) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_connid( '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_carrids_0400[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
    " Assuming '9999' is an invalid connid
    DATA(lt_carrids_9999) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_connid( '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_carrids_9999 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `SELECT DISTINCT` mit einer `EXISTS`-Subquery ist ein fortgeschrittenes SQL-Muster, um Datensätze basierend auf der Existenz verwandter Datensätze zu filtern. Dies ist effizienter als das Laden aller Daten und das anschließende Filtern im Anwendungsserver, da die Datenbank die Filterung übernimmt.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, Subquery, EXISTS, Database Access, Open SQL

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle und transformieren Sie die gefilterten Zeilen in einer `FOR`-Expression, wobei Sie Feldsymbole für den direkten Zugriff verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_t_connid_price TYPE TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY. " For transformed output

    METHODS get_filtered_connid_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connid_prices) TYPE ty_t_connid_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connid_prices.
    rt_connid_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( |{ <fs_sflight>-connid } - { <fs_sflight>-price }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_connid_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_connid_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_fld_for_expression=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' price = '150.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_connid_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '0400 - 100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '0500 - 150.00' ).

    DATA(lt_result_aa) = lo_cut->get_filtered_connid_prices( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_aa ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_aa[ 1 ] exp = '0017 - 200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu transformieren. Das Feldsymbol bietet direkten, performanten Zugriff auf die Zeilen der Quelltabelle, ohne dass temporäre Variablen oder explizite `LOOP`s erforderlich sind.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, FOR Expression, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die im aktuellen Mandanten vorhanden sind.
hint: `SELECT DISTINCT` berücksichtigt standardmäßig den Mandanten, wenn die Tabelle mandantenabhängig ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES ty_t_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_unique_carrids_client RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE ty_t_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sel_distinct_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carrids_client.
    " SFLIGHTS is a client-dependent table, so the SELECT will automatically
    " filter by the current client (sy-mandt) unless CLIENT SPECIFIED is used.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_carrids_client FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_carrids_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sel_distinct_client( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_unique_carrids_client( ).

    " Assert that some common carrier exists (assuming standard SFLIGHTS data in current client)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_carrids ). " Check if not empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_carrids[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei mandantenabhängigen Tabellen wie `SFLIGHTS` filtert `SELECT` automatisch nach dem aktuellen Mandanten (`SY-MANDT`), es sei denn, `CLIENT SPECIFIED` wird verwendet. `SELECT DISTINCT` funktioniert hier wie erwartet und liefert eindeutige Werte nur für den aktuellen Mandanten, was eine sichere und standardkonforme Datenabfrage gewährleistet.
keywords: SELECT DISTINCT, Client Handling, Database Access, Open SQL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Zeilentyp und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und Feldsymbole für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simple_data.
    METHODS create_and_populate_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'ZCL_FLD_DYNAMIC_ITAB=>TY_SIMPLE_DATA'
        iv_num_rows       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_col1>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_col2>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_line_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Error creating table
    ENDIF.

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col1>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_col1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_col2>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_col2> = sy-index * 10.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Übergeben Sie ein Feldsymbol als Parameter an eine Methode, um den Inhalt direkt zu bearbeiten.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Parameter als `TYPE ANY TABLE` oder `TYPE ANY` und verwenden Sie `CHANGING` oder `EXPORTING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fld_param_passing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES ty_t_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_first_value
      CHANGING
        cs_value TYPE ty_value.

    METHODS update_table_entry
      CHANGING
        ct_values TYPE ty_t_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fld_param_passing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_first_value.
    cs_value-value = 'Updated Value'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_table_entry.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE ty_value.
    READ TABLE ct_values INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_value>-value = 'Table Entry Updated'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_first_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_table_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_first_value.
    DATA(ls_value) = VALUE zcl_fld_param_passing=>ty_value( id = 1 value = 'Original' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_param_passing( ).
    lo_cut->update_first_value( CHANGING cs_value = ls_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_value-value exp = 'Updated Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_table_entry.
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE zcl_fld_param_passing=>ty_t_values(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Original Table Entry' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Another Entry' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fld_param_passing( ).
    lo_cut->update_table_entry( CHANGING ct_values = lt_values ).

    READ TABLE lt_values INTO DATA(ls_first_entry) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-value exp = 'Table Entry Updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_values INTO DATA(ls_second_entry) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_entry-value exp = 'Another Entry' ). " Should not be changed
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Übergabe von Feldsymbolen (oder Variablen, die später einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen werden) an Methoden über `CHANGING`-Parameter ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung des Originalinhalts. Dies ist besonders nützlich für interne Tabellen, da es das Kopieren von Daten vermeidet und somit die Performance verbessert.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Parameter Passing, CHANGING, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8 kodierten Byte-String (XSTRING) in einen internen ABAP-String.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_str DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_to_str IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Byte-String, der ungültige Zeichen für die Zielkodierung enthält, und fangen Sie die dabei auftretende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_encoding
          input    = iv_xstring
        ).
        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_string ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        " For this example, we re-raise to demonstrate catching
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_error_handling( ).
    " Create an XSTRING that is invalid for a simple ASCII conversion
    " e.g., a UTF-8 string with non-ASCII characters, but trying to convert to ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_invalid_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                      source      = 'Invalid character: €'
                                      target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
                                    ).

    " Expecting an exception when converting UTF-8 with Euro sign to ISO-8859-1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = CLASS-POOL->lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
              iv_xstring  = lv_invalid_utf8_xstring
              iv_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' " This codepage cannot represent €
            )
      exp_exception_class = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE'
      msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE for invalid conversion'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` um `cx_sy_conversion_codepage` ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei der Konvertierung von Byte-Strings, die Zeichen enthalten, die in der Zielkodierung nicht darstellbar sind. Dies verhindert Programmabbrüche und erlaubt eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf Dateninkonsistenzen.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, Error Handling, CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAGE, XSTRING, STRING, Codepage Conversion

    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(

explanation: Durch die Angabe von `output_encoding` im `create`-Aufruf kann `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` direkt eine Konvertierung von einem XSTRING in einen anderen XSTRING mit einer neuen Kodierung durchführen. Dies ist nützlich für die Verarbeitung von Binärdaten, deren Kodierung sich ändern muss.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Byte-String von einer Quellkodierung in eine Zielkodierung. Zeichen, die in der Zielkodierung nicht darstellbar sind, sollen durch ein spezifisches Ersatzzeichen ersetzt werden, anstatt eine Ausnahme auszulösen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_with_replacement DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_replacement_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_replacement_char TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT '#'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_with_replacement IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_replacement_char.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding    = iv_source_encoding
      input       = iv_xstring
      replacement = iv_replacement_char
    ).
    lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = rv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replacement_char FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replacement_char.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_with_replacement( ).
    " Source string with a character not representable in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_source_string) = 'Hello € World'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                                  source      = lv_source_string
                                  target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
                                ).
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Hello # World'. " € replaced by #

    DATA(lv_actual_string) = lo_cut->convert_with_replacement_char(
                                   iv_xstring         = lv_utf8_xstring
                                   iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                                   iv_target_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
                                   iv_replacement_char = '#'
                                 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Conversion with replacement character failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `replacement`-Parameter in `cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create` ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, Konvertierungsfehler zu vermeiden, indem nicht darstellbare Zeichen durch ein definiertes Ersatzzeichen ersetzt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Quelldaten nicht vollständig kontrolliert werden können und eine strikte Fehlerbehandlung unerwünscht ist.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_in_ce, Replacement Character, Error Handling, XSTRING, STRING, Codepage Conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen XSTRING, der eine Folge von 4-Byte-Integern in Little Endian darstellt, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Integern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit `endian` und lesen Sie in eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_le_int_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_le_xstring_to_int_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_le_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_int_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_le_int_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_le_xstring_to_int_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Encoding doesn't matter for raw bytes, but required
      endian   = 'LITTLE'
      input    = iv_le_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_length) TYPE i VALUE 4. " 4 bytes for an integer
    DATA(lv_int) TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_offset < xstrlen( iv_le_xstring ).
      lo_conv->read(
        EXPORTING
          len = lv_length
        IMPORTING
          data = lv_int
      ).
      APPEND lv_int TO rt_int_table.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + lv_length.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_le_int_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_le_int_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_le_int_table( ).
    DATA(lt_expected_ints) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i (
      ( 1 )
      ( 256 )
      ( 65536 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_le_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    " Manually create little-endian xstring for 1, 256, 65536
    " 1 (0x00000001) -> 01000000
    " 256 (0x00000100) -> 00010000
    " 65536 (0x00010000) -> 00000100
    lv_le_xstring = '010000000001000000000100'.

    DATA(lt_actual_ints) = lo_cut->convert_le_xstring_to_int_table( lv_le_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_ints
      exp = lt_expected_ints
      msg = 'Little Endian integer conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung eines XSTRING, der eine Sequenz von Little-Endian-Integern enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Integern. Durch die Angabe von `endian = 'LITTLE'` und das iterative Lesen mit fester Länge (`len = 4`) können binäre Datenstrukturen korrekt interpretiert werden. Dies ist entscheidend für die Verarbeitung von Daten aus Systemen mit unterschiedlicher Byte-Reihenfolge.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutze die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe der Preise zu bilden, und teile diese durch die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_flight_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte nicht 0 sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind' act = lv_avg_price exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ne ).

    " Beispiel für einen erwarteten Wert (muss an Testdaten angepasst werden)

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_above_average RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).

  METHOD get_flights_above_average.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_all_flights.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwende `FOR ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                         LET lv_total_price = REDUCE f(
                                                INIT sum = 0.0
                                                FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                NEXT sum = sum + member-price
                                              )
                               lv_count = lines( GROUP flight )
                         IN ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                              average_price = COND f( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_by_carrier( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ne ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfe den Durchschnittspreis für eine spezifische Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH')
    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = VALUE zcl_avg_price_by_carrier=>ty_carrier_avg_price(
      FOR entry IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( entry )
    ).
    IF ls_lh_avg IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für LH sollte nicht 0 sein' act = ls_lh_avg-average_price exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ne ).
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Falscher Durchschnittspreis für LH' act = ls_lh_avg-average_price exp = 450.0 ). " An Testdaten anpassen
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Werte zu berechnen. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifenkonstrukte und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Berechne den gewichteten Durchschnittspreis von Flügen aus `sflights`, wobei die Gewichtung durch die Anzahl der freien Sitze (SEATSOCC - SEATSMAX) erfolgt. Flüge ohne freie Sitze sollen nicht berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` für die Summe der Produkte (Preis * freie Sitze) und die Summe der Gewichte (freie Sitze).
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weighted_average_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_weighted_avg) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weighted_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_weighted_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum_weighted_price = 0.0
           sum_weights = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
      WHERE ( lv_free_seats > 0 )
      NEXT sum_weighted_price = sum_weighted_price + ( flight-price * lv_free_seats ),
           sum_weights = sum_weights + lv_free_seats
    ).

    IF lv_total_weighted_price IS INITIAL OR lv_total_weighted_price = 0 OR lv_sum_weights = 0.
      rv_weighted_avg = 0.
    ELSE.
      rv_weighted_avg = lv_total_weighted_price / lv_sum_weights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittswert eines numerischen Feldes in `sflights` dynamisch, basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen (z.B. 'PRICE' oder 'SEATSMAX').
hint: Nutze `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_average
      IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_literal_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_average.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_sum) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + CAST f( flight-(iv_field_name) )
    ).

    rv_average = lv_total_sum / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') haben.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um die relevanten Flüge zu filtern, und dann `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.

CLASS zcl_conditional_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermittle den durchschnittlichen Wert aller numerischen Attribute einer beliebigen Klasse zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` für RTTI und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_avg_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_of_numeric_attributes
      IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f
      RAISING   cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_avg_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_of_numeric_attributes.
    DATA: lv_total_sum TYPE f,
          lv_count     TYPE i.

    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_class_descr->get_static_attributes( ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = ls_component-type.
      IF lo_type_descr->is_numeric( ) = abap_true.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE io_object TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          lv_total_sum = lv_total_sum + CAST f( <fs_value> ).
          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_total_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) eine spezifische Strategie-Klasse zur Berechnung eines 'Bonus-Durchschnitts' zurückgibt. Die Strategie-Klassen sollen eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementieren.

INTERFACE zif_bonus_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_bonus_average
    IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
    RETURNING VALUE(rv_bonus_average) TYPE f.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_lh DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_bonus_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_lh IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_bonus_calculator~calculate_bonus_average.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( flight ) ) ).
    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_bonus_average = lv_total_price / lv_count * 1.1. " 10% Bonus für LH
    ELSE.
      rv_bonus_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_ua DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_bonus_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_ua IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_bonus_calculator~calculate_bonus_average.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'UA' )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'UA' ) ( flight ) ) ).
    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_bonus_average = lv_total_price / lv_count * 1.05. " 5% Bonus für UA
    ELSE.
      rv_bonus_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_calculator
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_calculator) TYPE REF TO zif_bonus_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bonus_calculator_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_calculator.
    CASE iv_carrid.
      WHEN 'LH'.
        ro_calculator = NEW zcl_bonus_calculator_lh( ).
      WHEN 'UA'.
        ro_calculator = NEW zcl_bonus_calculator_ua( ).

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis und die Anzahl der Flüge in einem lesbaren Format zusammenfasst.
hint: Nutze String Templates für die Formatierung und die `REDUCE`-Expression für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary RETURNING VALUE(rv_summary_string) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_average_price) = get_average_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    rv_summary_string = |Es gibt { lv_flight_count } Flüge mit einem durchschnittlichen Preis von { lv_average_price STYLE = CL_ABAP_FORMAT=>SCIENTIFIC } EUR.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Monat und Jahr stattfinden.
hint: Nutze `FOR` mit `WHERE` und String-Operationen, um Monat und Jahr aus dem Datum zu extrahieren, und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_by_month
      IMPORTING iv_year  TYPE syear
                iv_month TYPE sy_monat
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_price_by_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_month.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_search_year) = |{ iv_year ALPHA = OUT }|.
    DATA(lv_search_month) = |{ iv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD LEFT BY '0' }|.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                         WHERE ( flightdate CP |{ lv_search_year }{ lv_search_month }*| )
                                         ( flight ) ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_price_by_month( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge im Jahr 2025, Monat 12
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_month( iv_year = 2025 iv_month = 12 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte nicht 0 sein' act = lv_avg_price exp = 0.0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-ne ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Falscher Durchschnittspreis für 12.2025' act = lv_avg_price exp = 300.0 ). " An Testdaten anpassen
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_for_empty_month.

    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_month( iv_year = 1999 iv_month = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte 0 sein, wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden' act = lv_avg_price exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert String Templates für die Datumsextraktion und -formatierung mit `FOR WHERE` und `REDUCE` für die bedingte Aggregation. Die Verwendung von `CP` (Contains Pattern) mit einem dynamisch erstellten Muster im `WHERE`-Ausdruck ist eine flexible Methode, um Datumsbereiche zu filtern, ohne explizite Datumsfunktionen verwenden zu müssen. `ALPHA = OUT` und `PAD LEFT BY '0'` in String Templates sind nützlich für die korrekte Formatierung von numerischen Werten in Strings.
keywords: AVERAGE, Date/Time, String Templates, FOR WHERE, REDUCE, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) akzeptiert und für jede Flugverbindung einen Barcode generiert, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält. Die Barcodes sollen in einer neuen internen Tabelle zusammen mit den ursprünglichen Flugdaten zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle und `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_barcodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_barcode,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             barcode  TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_sflight_barcode.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_barcode TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_barcode WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_barcodes
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_barcodes) TYPE tt_sflight_barcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_barcodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_barcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer(
      i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_type_code128
    ).

    rt_sflight_barcodes = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                   LET lv_content = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid }|
                                       lv_barcode = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode( lv_content )
                                   IN
                                   ( carrid  = <fs_sflight>-carrid,
                                     connid  = <fs_sflight>-connid,
                                     fldate  = <fs_sflight>-fldate,
                                     barcode = lv_barcode ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sflight_barcodes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_barcodes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_barcodes( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_barcodes) = lo_cut->generate_sflight_barcodes( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of barcodes should match number of flights' act = lines( lt_sflight_barcodes ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_barcodes INTO DATA(ls_barcode_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Barcode should not be initial' act = ls_barcode_data-barcode ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für jeden Eintrag wird ein Barcode generiert und zusammen mit den ursprünglichen Daten in einer neuen internen Tabelle gesammelt. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Barcode-Inhalte verwendet. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art der Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Splitter-Container auf einem Dynpro, der den Bildschirm in zwei vertikale Bereiche teilt. Platzieren Sie in jedem Bereich einen einfachen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container` und `cl_gui_custom_container`.
solution:
REPORT z_splitter_basic.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
      go_text_left        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
      go_text_right       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 9000 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 9000.

INITIALIZATION.
  CALL SCREEN 9000.

MODULE pbo_9000 OUTPUT.
  IF go_custom_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' " Muss auf dem Dynpro existieren
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Custom Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = go_custom_container
        rows    = 1
        columns = 2
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Splitter Containers' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT go_text_left
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Textfeldes links' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    go_text_left->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist der linke Bereich.' ).

    CREATE OBJECT go_text_right
      EXPORTING
        parent = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Erstellen des Textfeldes rechts' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    go_text_right->set_text_as_stream( 'Dies ist der rechte Bereich.' ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE pai_9000 INPUT.
  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.
ENDMODULE.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Hier wird nur die Instanziierung der Objekte getestet.

          lo_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,

    CREATE OBJECT lo_custom_container

    CREATE OBJECT lo_splitter

        parent  = lo_custom_container
        rows    = 1

    CREATE OBJECT lo_text_left
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_text_right

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Custom Container should be created' act = lo_custom_container ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container, der zwei vertikale Bereiche hat. Im linken Bereich soll eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (aus SFLIGHTS) angezeigt werden. Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft ausgewählt wird, sollen im rechten Bereich die zugehörigen Flugverbindungen angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container` und `cl_salv_table` für die Listenanzeige. Implementieren Sie ein Event-Handling für die Auswahl in der linken Liste.
solution:
REPORT z_splitter_sflight_alv.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
      go_alv_carrid       TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
      go_alv_connid       TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
      gt_carrids          TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY,
      gt_connids          TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL FOR EVENTS cl_salv_events_table.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_salv_events_table
      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_double_click.
    READ TABLE gt_carrids INTO DATA(ls_carrid) INDEX row.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_connids WHERE carrid = @ls_carrid-carrid.
      go_alv_connid->set_data_ref( CHANGING r_data = gt_connids ).
      go_alv_connid->display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA: go_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.

SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 9003 AS WINDOW TITLE TEXT-001.

MODULE pbo_9003 OUTPUT.
  IF go_custom_container IS INITIAL.
    CREATE OBJECT go_custom_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    CREATE OBJECT go_splitter EXPORTING parent = go_custom_container rows = 1 columns = 2.

    " Left ALV for Carriers
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE @gt_carrids.
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 )
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = go_alv_carrid
      CHANGING
        t_table      = gt_carrids
    ).
    go_alv_carrid->display( ).

    " Register event handler for left ALV
    CREATE OBJECT go_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER go_event_handler->on_double_click FOR go_alv_carrid->get_event_handler( ).

    " Right ALV for Connections (initially empty)
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 )
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = go_alv_connid
      CHANGING
        t_table      = gt_connids
    ).
    go_alv_connid->display( ).
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.

  CASE sy-ucomm.
    WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
      LEAVE PROGRAM.
  ENDCASE.

Im rechten Bereich soll ein Barcode (Code 128) angezeigt werden, der den Inhalt des linken Textfeldes darstellt. Der Barcode soll sich dynamisch aktualisieren, wenn der Benutzer den Text ändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container`, `cl_gui_textedit` und `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer`. Implementieren Sie ein Event-Handling für die Textänderung im Textfeld.
solution:
REPORT z_splitter_barcode_input.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
      go_text_input       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
      go_picture_display  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture,
      go_barcode_renderer TYPE REF TO cl_rstx_barcode_renderer.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL FOR EVENTS cl_gui_textedit.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS on_text_changed FOR EVENT text_changed OF cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_text_changed.
    DATA(lv_content) = go_text_input->get_text_as_string( ).
    IF lv_content IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = go_barcode_renderer->render_barcode( lv_content ).
          go_picture_display->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_fit_center ).
          go_picture_display->set_image_x_by_url( lv_barcode_xstring ).
        CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      go_picture_display->set_image_x_by_url( '' ). " Clear barcode if text is empty
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer(
      i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_type_code128
    ).

    rt_barcodes = VALUE #( FOR lv_content IN it_contents
                           LET lv_barcode = COND xstring( WHEN lv_content IS NOT INITIAL
                                                              THEN lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode( lv_content )
                                                          ELSE
                                                              '' ) " Empty xstring for invalid content
                           WHERE lv_barcode IS NOT INITIAL

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD on_node_double_click.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.

    SPLIT node_key AT '_' INTO lv_carrid lv_connid.

    IF lv_connid IS NOT INITIAL. " It's a connection node
      READ TABLE gt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_details) = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_sflight-carrid }\n|

                           && |Flugdatum: { ls_sflight-fldate }\n|
                           && |Abflugort: { ls_sflight-cityfrom }\n|
                           && |Zielort: { ls_sflight-cityto }\n|
                           && |Preis: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }|.
        go_text_details->set_text_as_stream( lv_details ).
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      go_text_details->set_text_as_stream( |Details für Fluggesellschaft { lv_carrid }| ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Barcode (Code 128) für eine gegebene Zeichenkette und speichern Sie das Ergebnis als BMP-Datei im temporären Verzeichnis des Anwendungsservers. Geben Sie den vollständigen Dateipfad zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` und `cl_abap_file_utilities` oder `cl_gui_frontend_services` (für Frontend-Speicherung). Für den Anwendungsserver ist `OPEN DATASET` erforderlich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_barcode_to_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_barcode_to_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_path) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_barcode_to_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_barcode_to_file.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer(
      i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_type_code128
    ).

    DATA(lv_barcode_xstring) = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode( iv_content ).

    DATA(lv_temp_dir) = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory( ).
    DATA(lv_file_name) = |barcode_{ sy-uzeit }-{ sy-datum }.bmp|.
    rv_file_path = |{ lv_temp_dir }/{ lv_file_name }|.

    OPEN DATASET rv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Could not open file for writing'.
    ENDIF.
    TRANSFER lv_barcode_xstring TO rv_file_path.
    CLOSE DATASET rv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_save_barcode_to_file FOR TESTING RAISING cx_rstx_barcode_error cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_save_barcode_to_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_barcode_to_file( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = 'SAVE_TO_FILE_TEST'.
    DATA(lv_file_path) = lo_cut->save_barcode_to_file( lv_content ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'File path should not be initial' act = lv_file_path ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'File path should end with .bmp' act = lv_file_path CS '.bmp' ).

    " Further checks would require mocking file system operations or actual file existence checks,
    " which are complex in ABAP Unit for application server files.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein generierter Barcode als BMP-Datei auf dem Anwendungsserver gespeichert werden kann. Es verwendet `cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_directory()` für einen plattformunabhängigen temporären Pfad und die `OPEN DATASET`/`TRANSFER`/`CLOSE DATASET`-Anweisungen für den binären Dateizugriff. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit Ausnahmen ist hier ebenfalls integriert. Beachten Sie, dass der Unit-Test die tatsächliche Dateisysteminteraktion nur begrenzt überprüfen kann.
keywords: Barcode, File Save, BMP, Application Server, XSTRING, cl_rstx_barcode_renderer, cl_abap_file_utilities

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) akzeptiert. Für jede Flugverbindung soll ein QR-Code generiert werden, der eine URL zu einer fiktiven Flugdetailseite enthält (z.B. `https://example.com/flight?carrid=LH&connid=0400`). Die Methode soll die QR-Codes als interne Tabelle von XSTRINGs zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation der internen Tabelle, String-Templates für die URL-Erstellung und `cl_rstx_barcode_renderer` für den QR-Code.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_qrcodes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_sflight_qrcodes
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_qrcodes) TYPE xstring_table.

CLASS zcl_sflight_qrcodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_qrcodes.
    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer(
      i_barcode_type = cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_barcode_type_qrcode
    ).

    rt_qrcodes = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                           LET lv_url = |https://example.com/flight?carrid={ <fs_sflight>-carrid }&connid={ <fs_sflight>-connid }|
                               lv_qrcode = lo_barcode_renderer->render_barcode( lv_url )
                           IN
                           ( lv_qrcode ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Splitter-Container mit zwei vertikalen Bereichen. Im linken Bereich soll ein Textfeld sein, in das der Benutzer eine Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') eingeben kann. Im rechten Bereich soll ein ALV Grid die zugehörigen Flugverbindungen aus SFLIGHTS anzeigen. Die Anzeige soll sich dynamisch aktualisieren, wenn der Benutzer die Fluggesellschaft ändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container`, `cl_gui_textedit` und `cl_salv_table`. Implementieren Sie Event-Handling für die Textänderung im Textfeld und nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
REPORT z_splitter_alv_dynamic.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container,
      go_text_input       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
      go_alv_sflight      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
      gt_sflights_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL FOR EVENTS cl_gui_textedit.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS on_text_changed FOR EVENT text_changed OF cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD on_text_changed.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = go_text_input->get_text_as_string( ).
    CLEAR gt_sflights_display.
    IF lv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @gt_sflights_display WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
    go_alv_sflight->set_data_ref( CHANGING r_data = gt_sflights_display ).
    go_alv_sflight->display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING

solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    METHODS get_calculated_flight_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_discounted_price,
             carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid         TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate         TYPE sflight-fldate,
             original_price TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,

CLASS zcl_calculate_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flight_prices.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price VALUE '500',
               lc_discount_factor TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '0.9'.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price AS original_price,
           CALCULATE( CASE WHEN price > @lc_price_threshold
                            THEN price * @lc_discount_factor
                            ELSE price
                       END ) AS discounted_price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_discounted_prices.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.

Instructions: Rufe eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, unter Verwendung von Datenreferenzen.
hint: Nutze `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      say_hello IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string,
      say_goodbye IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string,
      call_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          iv_param_name  TYPE string
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD say_hello.
    rv_message = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD say_goodbye.
    rv_message = |Goodbye, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lr_object TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_method_caller,
          lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    CREATE OBJECT lr_object.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_name INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lr_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING RESULTS INTO DATA(lr_result).
        GET DATA REFERENCE lr_result INTO DATA(lr_string).
        IF lr_string IS BOUND.
          rv_result = lr_string->*.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'SAY_HELLO' iv_param_name = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello, World!' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'SAY_GOODBYE' iv_param_name = 'User' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Goodbye, User!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_param_name = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Methode `CALL METHOD (method_name)` in Kombination mit Datenreferenzen (`REF TO`) ermöglicht es, Methoden zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem String-Namen aufzurufen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder Plugins, die zur Laufzeit auf unbekannte Objekte oder Methoden reagieren müssen.
keywords: REF TO, Dynamic Call, Object Orientation, CALL METHOD, ABAP_PARMBIND_TAB

CLASS zcl_ref_to_generic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Zeilentyp-Struktur und fülle sie mit Daten.
hint: Nutze `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `TABLE OF` sowie Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_row_structure,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_row_structure.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data_to_fill TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_row_structure
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lr_line_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_REF_TO_DYNAMIC_TABLE=>TY_ROW_STRUCTURE' ).

    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_line_type ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT it_data_to_fill ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA: lt_input_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table=>ty_row_structure,
          ls_input_row  TYPE zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table=>ty_row_structure.

    ls_input_row-col1 = 'Entry A'.
    ls_input_row-col2 = 10.
    APPEND ls_input_row TO lt_input_data.

    ls_input_row-col1 = 'Entry B'.
    ls_input_row-col2 = 20.
    APPEND ls_input_row TO lt_input_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_input_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE zcl_ref_to_dynamic_table=>ty_row_structure.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_dynamic_line> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_dynamic_line>-col1 exp = 'Entry A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_dynamic_line>-col2 exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teile einen String von Zahlen (durch Kommas getrennt) auf und berechne die Summe dieser Zahlen.
hint: Nutze `SPLIT` in Kombination mit einem `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers.
    DATA(lt_parts) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR lv_part IN lt_parts WHERE ( lv_part IS NOT INITIAL )
                       NEXT s = s + CONV i( lv_part ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 100 ).

    lv_sum = lo_cut->sum_numbers( '5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 5 ).

    lv_sum = lo_cut->sum_numbers( '' ).

CLASS zcl_str_split_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_origin
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE s_from_cit
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_origin.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fromcity = iv_origin ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_fra FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_jfk FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_fra.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_all_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-fromcity = 'FRA'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'NYC'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_all_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-fromcity = 'JFK'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'LAX'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_all_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'. <fs_flight>-fromcity = 'FRA'. <fs_flight>-tocity = 'MUC'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_origin( iv_origin = 'FRA' it_flights = lt_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-fromcity exp = 'FRA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-fromcity exp = 'FRA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_jfk.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der `sflights` Tabelle um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz.
hint: Lesen Sie die Daten in eine interne Tabelle, aktualisieren Sie diese und verwenden Sie dann `MODIFY DATABASE TABLE`.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_abap_db_error. " Example exception for DB errors
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " Read relevant flights
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Update prices in internal table using FOR
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                             ( <fs_flight> WITH price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) ).

      " Update database table
      MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Handle error, e.g., RAISE EXCEPTION
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_db_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Database update failed'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN flight-tocity = 'NYC' AND flight-price < 500
                                            THEN flight WITH price = flight-price * '1.10'
                                            ELSE flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists_in_filtered
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE s_from_cit
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights

CLASS zcl_flight_exists_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists_in_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fromcity = iv_origin ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten dynamisch basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen und Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen Ausdruck oder einer Hilfsmethode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
        it_flights    TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight,
                   <fs_field>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_access
          EXPORTING
            text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field> = iv_value.
        APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_filtered_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten das Feld 'CURRENCY' auf 'EUR' für alle Flüge, die von 'FRA' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` oder `LET` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_flight_currency_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_currency_for_origin
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE s_from_cit
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_currency_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_for_origin.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN flight-fromcity = iv_origin
                                            THEN flight WITH currency = 'EUR'
                                            ELSE flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_origin
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE s_from_cit
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_origin.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( ) )
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fromcity = iv_origin )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 300 enthält, und sortieren Sie diese nach Flugdatum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `SORT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fromcity TYPE s_from_cit,
             tocity   TYPE s_to_city,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_sort_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_sort_by_price.
    rt_filtered_sorted_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE price > 300 ).
    SORT rt_filtered_sorted_flights BY fldate ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der `sflights` Tabelle, aber nur für Flüge, die noch nicht abgeflogen sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und `MODIFY` mit einer gefilterten internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_planetype_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_planetype_for_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_planetype TYPE s_planetye
      RAISING
        cx_abap_db_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_planetype_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_for_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE s_date VALUE sy-datum.

    " Read relevant flights that are in the future
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate >= lv_current_date.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Update planetype in internal table using FOR
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                               ( <fs_flight> WITH planetype = iv_new_planetype ) ).

      " Update database table
      MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_db_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Database update failed'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA mt_sflights_mock TYPE tt_sflight_mock.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_planetype_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_planetype_no_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    CLEAR mt_sflights_mock.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mock>).
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_mock>-connid = '0400'. <fs_mock>-fldate = sy-datum - 1. <fs_mock>-planetype = 'A320'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING <fs_mock>.
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_mock>-connid = '0401'. <fs_mock>-fldate = sy-datum + 1. <fs_mock>-planetype = 'A320'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_sflights_mock ASSIGNING <fs_mock>.
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_mock>-connid = '0001'. <fs_mock>-fldate = sy-datum + 2. <fs_mock>-planetype = 'B747'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_planetype_success.
    DATA(lv_new_planetype) = 'A380'.

    " Simulate the SELECT
    DATA(lt_selected_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_planetype_updater=>tt_sflights(
      FOR flight IN mt_sflights_mock WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate >= sy-datum
      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) )
    ).

    " Simulate the update logic from the solution class
    lt_selected_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_selected_flights
                                   ( <fs_flight> WITH planetype = lv_new_planetype ) ).

    " Simulate the MODIFY
    LOOP AT lt_selected_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_updated_flight>).
      MODIFY TABLE mt_sflights_mock FROM <fs_updated_flight>.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_sflights_mock[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 1 ]-planetype exp = 'A320' ). " Past flight, unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_sflights_mock[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum + 1 ]-planetype exp = lv_new_planetype ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_sflights_mock[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum + 2 ]-planetype exp = 'B747' ). " Different carrier, unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_planetype_no_future_flights.
    DATA(lv_new_planetype) = 'A380'.

    " Simulate the SELECT (no future flights for this carrier)
    DATA(lt_selected_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_planetype_updater=>tt_sflights(
      FOR flight IN mt_sflights_mock WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate < sy-datum
      ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) )
    ). " This filter will yield no results for AA with fldate < sy-datum

    " Simulate the update logic from the solution class
    lt_selected_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_selected_flights
                                   ( <fs_flight> WITH planetype = lv_new_planetype ) ).

    " Simulate the MODIFY
    LOOP AT lt_selected_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_updated_flight>).
      MODIFY TABLE mt_sflights_mock FROM <fs_updated_flight>.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_sflights_mock[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum + 2 ]-planetype exp = 'B747' ). " Unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Lesen von Daten aus der Datenbank mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um nur zukünftige Flüge zu berücksichtigen. Die Aktualisierung der internen Tabelle erfolgt mit dem `FOR` Operator, und die Änderungen werden dann effizient mit `MODIFY DATABASE TABLE` zurück in die Datenbank geschrieben. Dies ist ein robuster Ansatz für bedingte Massenaktualisierungen.
keywords: UPDATE, MODIFY, SELECT, FOR, Internal Tables, Database Operations, Conditional

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

CLASS zcl_math_min_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
