Instructions: Finden Sie den minimalen Wert einer berechneten Expression für jede Zeile in einer internen Tabelle. Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug (aus einer Liste) die Differenz zwischen dem Preis und einem Referenzpreis und finden Sie die kleinste positive Differenz.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_math=>min` und `cl_abap_math=>abs`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate TYPE s_date,
         price  TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_flight.
TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_math_min_calculated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_price_difference
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_flights
        iv_ref_price  TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_diff) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_min_calculated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_difference.
    DATA(lt_differences) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_price WITH EMPTY KEY
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( cl_abap_math=>abs( flight-price - iv_ref_price ) ).

    IF lt_differences IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_diff = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_diff = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT min_val = lt_differences[1]
      FOR diff IN lt_differences
      NEXT min_val = cl_abap_math=>min( iv_val1 = min_val iv_val2 = diff )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) den niedrigsten Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_math=>min` innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate TYPE s_date,
         price  TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_flight.
TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_min_price_by_carrier,
         carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
         min_price TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_min_price_by_carrier.
TYPES tt_min_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_min_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_math_min_grouped DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_price_per_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_min_prices) TYPE tt_min_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_min_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_per_carrier.
    DATA(lt_result) = VALUE tt_min_price_by_carrier( ).

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ls_flight_entry-carrid.
      DATA(lv_min_price_for_group) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT min_val = ls_flight_entry-price
        FOR flight IN GROUP ls_flight_entry
        NEXT min_val = cl_abap_math=>min( iv_val1 = min_val iv_val2 = flight-price )
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_min_price_by_carrier(
        carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
        min_price = lv_min_price_for_group
      ) TO lt_result.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_min_prices = lt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '75.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250104' price = '60.00' )

  METHOD test_min_price_grouped_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min_grouped( ).

  METHOD test_min_price_grouped_single_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_min_grouped( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(

      ( carrid = 'BB' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    DATA(ls_bb_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'BB' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_bb_result-min_price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_math=>min`. Es ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Daten nach einem Kriterium (hier: Fluggesellschaft) und das anschließende Finden des Minimalwerts innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_known) = '20231027100000000000'. " 2023-10-27 10:00:00 UTC
    DATA(ls_expected_cet) TYPE zcl_utclong_to_local=>ty_local_datetime.
    ls_expected_cet-date = '20231027'.
    ls_expected_cet-time = '120000'. " Assuming CET (UTC+2 on this date due to DST)

    DATA(ls_actual_cet) TYPE zcl_utclong_to_local=>ty_local_datetime.
    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_tstmpl(

        time    = ls_actual_cet-time
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_cet-date exp = ls_expected_cet-date msg = 'Date conversion incorrect for CET' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_diff( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_earlier) = '20231027100000000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_later) = '20231027103000000000'. " 30 minutes later

    DATA(lv_expected_diff) = 1800. " 30 minutes * 60 seconds/minute

    DATA(lv_result_diff) = lo_cut->get_difference_in_seconds(
                              iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_later
                              iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_earlier
                            ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_diff exp = lv_expected_diff msg = 'Difference calculation failed' ).

                                   iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_later
                                 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_diff_rev exp = -lv_expected_diff msg = 'Difference calculation failed for reversed order' ).

    DATA(lv_result_diff_same) = lo_cut->get_difference_in_seconds(
                                    iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_earlier
                                    iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_earlier
                                  ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_diff_same exp = 0 msg = 'Difference calculation failed for same timestamps' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei UTCLONG-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.
hint: UTCLONG kann direkt mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`, etc.) verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_utclong1_earlier
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_earlier) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS is_utclong_equal
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_utclong1_earlier.
    rv_is_earlier = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_utclong1 < iv_utclong2 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_utclong_equal.
    rv_is_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_utclong1 = iv_utclong2 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_a) = '20231027100000000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_b) = '20231027110000000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_c) = '20231027100000000000'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_utclong1_earlier( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_a iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_b ) msg = 'A should be earlier than B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_utclong1_earlier( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_b iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_a ) msg = 'B should not be earlier than A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_utclong1_earlier( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_a iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_c ) msg = 'A should not be earlier than C (equal)' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_utclong_equal( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_a iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_c ) msg = 'A and C should be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_utclong_equal( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_a iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_b ) msg = 'A and B should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UTCLONG`-Felder können direkt mit Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren verglichen werden, was die Logik für Zeitvergleiche vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Die Verwendung von `COND` für die Zuweisung von `abap_bool` ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.

CLASS zcl_utclong_in_interval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Runden Sie einen UTCLONG-Zeitstempel auf die nächste volle Stunde in einer bestimmten Zeitzone.
hint: Konvertieren Sie den UTCLONG in Datum/Uhrzeit, passen Sie die Uhrzeit an und konvertieren Sie zurück zu UTCLONG.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_round_hour DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS round_utclong_to_nearest_hour
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_tzone   TYPE timezone DEFAULT sy-zonlo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rounded_utclong) TYPE utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_round_hour IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD round_utclong_to_nearest_hour.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_time TYPE sy-uzeit.

    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_tstmpl(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utclong
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = lv_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_hour) = lv_time(2).
    DATA(lv_minute) = lv_time+2(2).
    DATA(lv_second) = lv_time+4(2).

    DATA(lv_add_hour) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    IF lv_minute >= '30'. " Round up if minute is 30 or more
      lv_add_hour = 1.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_rounded_utclong_local) TYPE utclong.
    cl_abap_utclong=>tstmpl_to_utclong(
      EXPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = |{ lv_hour }0000|
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        utclong = lv_rounded_utclong_local
    ).

    rv_rounded_utclong = cl_abap_utclong=>add(
      utclong = lv_rounded_utclong_local
      seconds = lv_add_hour * 3600
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_round_hour FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_round_hour.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_round_hour( ).
    DATA(lv_tzone) = 'UTC'. " Use UTC for simplicity in this test

    " Test case 1: Round down (10:29:59 -> 10:00:00)
    DATA(lv_utclong_1) = '20231027102959000000'.
    DATA(lv_expected_1) = '20231027100000000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->round_utclong_to_nearest_hour(
                                           iv_utclong = lv_utclong_1
                                           iv_tzone   = lv_tzone
                                         ) exp = lv_expected_1 msg = 'Rounding down failed' ).

    " Test case 2: Round up (10:30:00 -> 11:00:00)
    DATA(lv_utclong_2) = '20231027103000000000'.
    DATA(lv_expected_2) = '20231027110000000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->round_utclong_to_nearest_hour(
                                           iv_utclong = lv_utclong_2
                                           iv_tzone   = lv_tzone
                                         ) exp = lv_expected_2 msg = 'Rounding up (exact 30) failed' ).

    " Test case 3: Round up (10:45:00 -> 11:00:00)
    DATA(lv_utclong_3) = '20231027104500000000'.
    DATA(lv_expected_3) = '20231027110000000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->round_utclong_to_nearest_hour(
                                           iv_utclong = lv_utclong_3
                                           iv_tzone   = lv_tzone
                                         ) exp = lv_expected_3 msg = 'Rounding up failed' ).

    " Test case 4: Rounding up across day boundary (23:30:00 -> next day 00:00:00)
    DATA(lv_utclong_4) = '20231027233000000000'.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Beginn des nächsten Monats für einen gegebenen UTCLONG-Zeitstempel in einer bestimmten Zeitzone.
hint: Konvertieren Sie den UTCLONG in Datum/Uhrzeit, nutzen Sie `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_next_month()` und konvertieren Sie zurück zu UTCLONG.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_next_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_day_of_next_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_tzone   TYPE timezone DEFAULT sy-zonlo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_month_utclong) TYPE utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_next_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_day_of_next_month.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE sy-datum,
          lv_time TYPE sy-uzeit.

    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_tstmpl(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utclong
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = lv_time
    ).

    DATA(lv_first_day_next_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_next_month( iv_date = lv_date ).

    " Set time to 00:00:00 for start of day
    cl_abap_utclong=>tstmpl_to_utclong(
      EXPORTING
        date    = lv_first_day_next_month
        time    = '000000'
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        utclong = rv_next_month_utclong
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die teurer als 100 sind, unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE` Expression mit `WHEN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... INIT ... FOR ... WHEN ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_conditional_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_sum.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_sum.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_cond_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251207' price = '100' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Excluded (price not > 100)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20251207' price = '200' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Excluded (carrid not LH)
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fldate = '20251208' price = '150' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Included
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '402' fldate = '20251207' price = '120' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Included
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '403' fldate = '20251209' price = '90' ) TO lt_test_flights.  " Excluded (price not > 100)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cond_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum(
      it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
      iv_carrid      = 'LH'
      iv_min_price   = '100'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '270' msg = 'Sum should be 150 + 120 = 270' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit der `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht sie eine deklarative und effiziente bedingte Aggregation, die komplexe Schleifen und `IF`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht und den Code erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: REDUCE, WHEN, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_for_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.

CLASS zcl_for_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carriers.
    rt_filtered_carriers = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid CP 'A*' )
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_filtered_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflight_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_first_flight_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_info) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_sflight_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( get_first_flight_info( ) ).

  METHOD get_first_flight_info.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_info = |Flugnummer: { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|.
    ELSE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    out->write( |Anzahl der LH-Flüge: { lines( lt_flights ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge in `SFLIGHT` berechnet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( |Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge: { calculate_total_capacity( ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_calculate_total_capacity FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has some data, so capacity should be > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater(
      act = lv_total_capacity
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Die Gesamtkapazität sollte größer als 0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, um den Wert schrittweise zu akkumulieren. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `LOOP AT`.
keywords: IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die für einen gegebenen Flugstatus ('X', 'Y', 'Z') eine beschreibende Textnachricht zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `COND` und `SWITCH`.
hint: `COND` für IF-ELSE-Logik, `SWITCH` für CASE-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_status_description IMPORTING iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( |Status 'X': { get_status_description( 'X' ) }| ).
    out->write( |Status 'Y': { get_status_description( 'Y' ) }| ).
    out->write( |Status 'A': { get_status_description( 'A' ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_status
                               WHEN 'X' THEN 'Flug verspätet'
                               WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Flug pünktlich'
                               WHEN 'Z' THEN 'Flug gestrichen'
                               ELSE COND string( WHEN iv_status IS INITIAL THEN 'Status nicht angegeben'
                                                 ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_status_description FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_status_description.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_all_airlines RETURNING VALUE(rt_airlines) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_airlines) = get_all_airlines( ).
    out->write( |Anzahl der gefundenen Fluggesellschaften: { lines( lt_airlines ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_airlines.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO lv_carrid.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_carrid TO rt_airlines.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die alle Flüge von 'LH' aus `SFLIGHT` nach Abflugdatum sortiert mit `OPEN CURSOR` liest und die ersten 5 Flugnummern zurückgibt.
hint: Fügen Sie `WHERE` und `ORDER BY` in die `OPEN CURSOR`-Anweisung ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_top_5_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_flights) = get_top_5_lh_flights( ).
    out->write( |Top 5 LH-Flüge (nach Datum):| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(lv_flight_id).
      out->write( lv_flight_id ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_top_5_lh_flights.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lv_cursor  TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_count   TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ORDER BY fldate ASC.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_count >= 5.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }| TO rt_flight_ids.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_5_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_5_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_cursor_order( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_5_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Es sollten maximal 5 Flüge zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
        act = lt_result[ 1 ]
        exp = `^LH \w{4}$`
        msg = 'Der erste Flug sollte von LH sein und korrekt formatiert.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`- und `ORDER BY`-Klauseln können direkt in der `OPEN CURSOR`-Anweisung verwendet werden, um die Datenmenge vor dem Lesen zu filtern und zu sortieren. Dies delegiert die Arbeit an die Datenbank, was in der Regel effizienter ist, als die Daten erst im ABAP-Programm zu filtern und zu sortieren. Die Begrenzung auf 5 Einträge erfolgt im ABAP-Code.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, WHERE, ORDER BY, Database Access, Filtering, Sorting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` mit `OPEN CURSOR` paketweise liest und für jedes Paket die Flugnummern in eine neue interne Tabelle mit dem `FOR`-Operator transformiert. Geben Sie die Anzahl der transformierten Einträge aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit einem `FOR`-Loop über das Datenpaket.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS transform_flights_in_packages RETURNING VALUE(rv_transformed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( |Anzahl der transformierten Flüge: { transform_flights_in_packages( ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_sflight_package TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lv_cursor            TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_package_size      TYPE i VALUE 50.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_sflight_package PACKAGE SIZE lv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Transformiere das aktuelle Paket mit FOR
      lt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( BASE lt_transformed_flights
                                        FOR flight IN lt_sflight_package
                                        ( |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| ) ).

    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_transformed_count = lines( lt_transformed_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights_in_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights_in_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->transform_flights_in_packages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Es sollten transformierte Flüge gezählt werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Effizienz von `OPEN CURSOR` für die paketweise Datenbeschaffung mit der Modernität des `FOR`-Operators für die Transformation der Daten innerhalb jedes Pakets. Der `FOR`-Operator mit `BASE` ermöglicht das Hinzufügen von Elementen zu einer bestehenden internen Tabelle, was eine sehr funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die versucht, einen Cursor auf eine nicht existierende Tabelle zu öffnen und den Fehler mit `sy-subrc` abfängt. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung aus.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS test_invalid_cursor RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    out->write( test_invalid_cursor( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_dummy  TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    " Versuch, einen Cursor auf eine nicht existierende Tabelle zu öffnen
    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM z_non_existent_table.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_error_message = |Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors: Tabelle existiert nicht (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc })|.
    ELSE.
      " Dies sollte nicht erreicht werden, wenn die Tabelle nicht existiert
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO lv_dummy.
      CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
      rv_error_message = 'Cursor erfolgreich geöffnet (unerwartet).'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex(
      act = lv_error_msg
      exp = `^Fehler beim Öffnen des Cursors: Tabelle existiert nicht \(SY-SUBRC: \d+\)$`
      msg = 'Es sollte eine Fehlermeldung für eine nicht existierende Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` nach Datenbankoperationen ist ein grundlegender Bestandteil der Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Im Falle von `OPEN CURSOR` signalisiert ein `sy-subrc` ungleich 0, dass der Cursor nicht erfolgreich geöffnet werden konnte, beispielsweise weil die angegebene Tabelle nicht existiert oder keine Berechtigungen vorliegen. CLASS zcl_pak_subpackages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_subpackages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_subpackages) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_pak_subpackages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_subpackages.
    TRY.
        cl_pak_package_queries=>get_all_subpackages(
          EXPORTING
            i_package_name = iv_package_name
          RECEIVING
            r_subpackages  = DATA(lt_subpackages)
        ).
        LOOP AT lt_subpackages INTO DATA(ls_subpackage).
          APPEND ls_subpackage-package_name TO rt_subpackages.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_pak_exception INTO DATA(lx_pak_exception).
        " Handle exception, e.g., package not found
        MESSAGE lx_pak_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Expecting some subpackages, adjust assertion if needed
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Entwicklungsobjekte (z.B. Klassen, Funktionsgruppen) innerhalb eines bestimmten ABAP-Pakets und filtern Sie diese nach einem Objekttyp.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_contents` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_filter_objects DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_info,
             object_type TYPE trobjtype,
             object_name TYPE trobj_name,
           END OF ty_object_info.
    TYPES tt_object_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_objects
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
        iv_object_type  TYPE trobjtype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_objects) TYPE tt_object_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_filter_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_objects.
    TRY.
        cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_contents(
          EXPORTING
            i_package_name = iv_package_name
          RECEIVING
            r_objects      = DATA(lt_objects)
        ).

        rt_filtered_objects = FILTER #( lt_objects USING KEY primary_key WHERE object_type = iv_object_type ).

      CATCH cx_pak_exception INTO DATA(lx_pak_exception).

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_contents` in einer `FOR` Schleife mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_class_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_class_count,
             package_name TYPE devclass,
             class_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_package_class_count.
    TYPES tt_package_class_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_package_class_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_packages TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_package_class_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_class_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_counts.
    LOOP AT it_packages INTO DATA(lv_package).
      TRY.
          cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_contents(
            EXPORTING
              i_package_name = lv_package
            RECEIVING
              r_objects      = DATA(lt_objects)
          ).

          DATA(lv_class_count) = REDUCE i(
            INIT count = 0
            FOR ls_object IN lt_objects
            WHERE ( object_type = 'CLAS' )
            NEXT count = count + 1
          ).

          APPEND VALUE ty_package_class_count(
            package_name = lv_package
            class_count  = lv_class_count
          ) TO rt_counts.

        CATCH cx_pak_exception.
          " Ignore packages that do not exist or cause errors
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_colored,

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_secret_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_secret) = lo_accessor->get_secret_from_data( lo_secret_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_secret exp = lv_expected_secret msg = 'Secret value should be accessible via friend class' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lo_secret_data->get_public_value( ) exp = lv_expected_secret msg = 'Public method should not expose secret' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Ergänzung in der Klassendefinition von `ZCL_SECRET_DATA` erlaubt der Klasse `ZCL_SECRET_ACCESSOR` den Zugriff auf private Komponenten, ohne die Kapselung für andere Klassen aufbrechen zu müssen. Dies ist ein kontrollierter Weg, um Ausnahmen von der strikten Kapselung zu definieren, was zu saubereren Architekturen führen kann.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Kapselung, Private Attribute

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Pattern für eine Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT`, die verschiedene Produktvarianten (z.B. `ZCL_PRODUCT_A`, `ZCL_PRODUCT_B`) erzeugt. Die Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` soll als 'Friend' von `ZCL_PRODUCT` deklariert werden, um private Konstruktoren der Produktklassen aufrufen zu können und somit die Instanziierung zu kontrollieren.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor der Produktklassen als `PRIVATE` und die Factory als `FRIENDS`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product IMPORTING iv_type TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle error or default
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product_a msg = 'Product A should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_a->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Product A name mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product_b msg = 'Product B should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_b->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' msg = 'Product B name mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Deklaration des Konstruktors als `PRIVATE` wird die direkte Instanziierung der Produktklassen von außen verhindert. Die `FRIENDS` Beziehung zur Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` erlaubt es dieser, die privaten Konstruktoren aufzurufen und somit die Erzeugung von Objekten zu zentralisieren und zu steuern (Factory-Pattern). Dies fördert eine saubere Architektur und erleichtert die Wartung.
keywords: FRIENDS, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Object Orientation, Kapselung

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER` mit einem geschützten Attribut `mv_data`. Implementieren Sie eine 'Friend'-Klasse `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR`, die auf dieses geschützte Attribut zugreifen und es verändern kann, obwohl `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR` keine Unterklasse von `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER` ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PROTECTED SECTION` für das Attribut und `FRIENDS` für die Zugriffskontrolle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_data TYPE string.
    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_data = iv_initial_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rv_data = mv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO zcl_data_container CHANGING cv_new_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    io_container->mv_data = cv_new_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_protected_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_protected_access.
    DATA(lv_initial_data) = 'Initial Data'.
    DATA(lv_new_data) = 'Processed Data'.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW zcl_data_container( lv_initial_data ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).

explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht es `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR`, auf das `PROTECTED` Attribut `mv_data` von `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER` zuzugreifen, obwohl keine Vererbungshierarchie besteht. Dies ist nützlich für eng gekoppelte Klassen, die sich gegenseitig vertrauen und Zugriff auf geschützte Implementierungsdetails benötigen, ohne diese öffentlich zu machen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Protected Attribute, Object Orientation, Kapselung

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes 'CARRID' aus der internen Tabelle `sflights` (oder einer ähnlichen Struktur) in einer Schleife und weisen Sie ihn einem Feldsymbol zu. Demonstrieren Sie den Zugriff auf den Wert über das Feldsymbol.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrids_dynamically IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <lv_carrid>  TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_sflight> TO <lv_carrid>.
      IF <lv_carrid> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND <lv_carrid> TO rt_carrids.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dynamic_read=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_carrids_dynamically( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 carrid entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' msg = 'First carrid should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 2 ] exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second carrid should be AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs>` ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Komponenten einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn der Feldname zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist oder wenn generische Verarbeitungsroutinen benötigt werden. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen vermeidet unnötige Datenkopien und ist effizient.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, LOOP AT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)=>METHOD_NAME') TO <field_symbol>` für den dynamischen Methodenaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method IMPORTING iv_class_name  TYPE string
                                        iv_method_name TYPE string
                                        iv_parameter   TYPE string
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_method_ref> TYPE REF TO object.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    IF lo_object IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN (iv_class_name)=>(iv_method_name) TO <lv_method_ref>.
      IF <lv_method_ref> IS ASSIGNED.
        " This part is tricky for dynamic parameters/returns without RTTI or specific interfaces.
        " For simplicity, we assume a known interface or method signature.
        " A more robust solution would involve RTTI (CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR) and dynamic parameter handling.
        " For this example, we'll simulate a call to a known method signature.
        " In a real scenario, you'd need to cast <lv_method_ref> to a specific interface or use CALL METHOD.
        " For the purpose of demonstrating ASSIGN, we'll use a simplified approach.
        " Let's assume the method is 'process_input' and takes a string and returns a string.
        TRY.
            CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name) EXPORTING iv_input = iv_parameter RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
          CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
            rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic method call failed'.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Error: Class not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for dynamic method call demonstration
CLASS zcl_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_input IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_TARGET_CLASS'
                                                     iv_method_name = 'PROCESS_INPUT'
                                                     iv_parameter   = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Hello' msg = 'Dynamic method call should succeed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_TARGET_CLASS'
                                                     iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
                                                     iv_parameter   = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Error: Dynamic method call failed' msg = 'Invalid method call should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)` in Kombination mit der dynamischen Objekterzeugung `CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder Plugins. Obwohl `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)=>METHOD_NAME') TO <fs>` für die Referenzierung von Methoden existiert, ist der direkte `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen oft praktischer, wenn die Signatur bekannt ist. Für vollständig dynamische Parameterübergabe wäre RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) erforderlich.
keywords: ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Method Call, RTTI, Field Symbols

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle `sflights` (oder eine ähnliche Struktur) und weisen Sie jede Zeile einem Feldsymbol zu. Geben Sie für jede Zeile die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_carrids IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_carrids.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
      APPEND <ls_sflight>-carrid TO rt_carrids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_assign.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_loop_assign=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '100' fldate = '20250301' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '200' fldate = '20250302' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = lo_cut->get_all_carrids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 carrid entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 1 ] exp = 'DL' msg = 'First carrid should be DL' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_carrids[ 2 ] exp = 'UA' msg = 'Second carrid should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` Syntax ist die effizienteste Art, über interne Tabellen zu iterieren, da keine Datenkopie der Zeile in einen Arbeitsbereich erfolgt. Stattdessen zeigt das Feldsymbol direkt auf die aktuelle Zeile in der internen Tabelle, was besonders bei großen Tabellen zu Performance-Vorteilen führt. Dies ist ein grundlegendes, aber wichtiges modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: ASSIGN, LOOP AT, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch ein Attribut eines Objekts ausliest, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Das Attribut soll vom Typ String sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)->ATTRIBUTE_NAME') TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_attr_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attribute_dynamically IMPORTING io_object      TYPE REF TO object
                                              iv_attribute_name TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_attr_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attribute_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_attribute> TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_full_path) = |{ cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( io_object )->get_name( ) }->{ iv_attribute_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_path) TO <lv_attribute>.

    IF <lv_attribute> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = <lv_attribute>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Error: Attribute not found or not accessible'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_public_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Public Value'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_private_attr TYPE string VALUE 'Private Value'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_attr_read FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_attr_read_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_attr_read.
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW zcl_test_object( ).
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attr_reader( ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_reader->get_attribute_dynamically( io_object = lo_test_obj
                                                          iv_attribute_name = 'MV_PUBLIC_ATTR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Public Value' msg = 'Public attribute should be read dynamically' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_attr_read_fail.
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW zcl_test_object( ).
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_dynamic_attr_reader( ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_reader->get_attribute_dynamically( io_object = lo_test_obj
                                                          iv_attribute_name = 'MV_PRIVATE_ATTR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Error: Attribute not found or not accessible' msg = 'Private attribute should not be readable dynamically without FRIENDS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN ('(CLASS_NAME)->ATTRIBUTE_NAME') TO <field_symbol>` Syntax ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Attribute eines Objekts zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitungsroutinen oder wenn der Attributname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Es ist wichtig zu beachten, dass der Zugriff auf private Attribute ohne `FRIENDS` oder spezielle Berechtigungen fehlschlägt, was die Kapselung schützt.
keywords: ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Attributes, Field Symbols, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_SECURE_LOG` mit einer privaten Methode `log_internal_message`. Implementieren Sie eine 'Friend'-Schnittstelle `ZIF_LOG_ACCESS`, die es Klassen, die diese Schnittstelle implementieren, erlaubt, die private Methode von `ZCL_SECURE_LOG` aufzurufen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Schnittstelle als `FRIENDS` in der Klassendefinition.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_log_access DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS write_log IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_secure_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_internal_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zif_log_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_secure_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_internal_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a secure log.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Secure Log: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_log_access.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_secure_log TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_log.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_secure_log TYPE REF TO zcl_secure_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_secure_log = io_secure_log.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_log_access~write_log.
    mo_secure_log->log_internal_message( iv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_interface_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_interface_access.
    DATA(lo_secure_log) = NEW zcl_secure_log( ).
    DATA(lo_app_logger) = NEW zcl_application_logger( lo_secure_log ).

    " This will call the private method via the friend interface
    lo_app_logger->zif_log_access~write_log( 'Test message from friend interface' ).

    " No direct assertion possible for cl_demo_output, but the call should execute without dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Test executed without runtime error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration einer Schnittstelle ermöglicht es allen Klassen, die diese Schnittstelle implementieren, auf private oder geschützte Komponenten der 'befreundeten' Klasse zuzugreifen. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges Konzept, um eine kontrollierte 'White-Box'-Beziehung zwischen Klassen und ihren Implementierern zu schaffen, ohne die Kapselung vollständig aufzuheben. Es ist ideal für Frameworks oder erweiterbare Komponenten.
keywords: FRIENDS, Interface, Object Orientation, Kapselung, Private Method

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer bestimmten Struktur erzeugt und diese mit Daten befüllt. Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN` für die dynamische Typisierung und Datenmanipulation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (structure_name)` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf die Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_struct.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    DATA(lv_struct_name) = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_TABLE_CREATOR=>TY_DYNAMIC_STRUCT'.

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lv_struct_name).
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      DO 3 TIMES.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
        IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field1>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field2>).
          IF <lv_field1> IS ASSIGNED AND <lv_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
            <lv_field1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
            <lv_field2> = sy-index * 10.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.

Dies ermöglicht es, Datenstrukturen und Tabellen zur Laufzeit zu definieren und zu manipulieren, was für generische Tools, Metadaten-basierte Anwendungen oder flexible Schnittstellen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ist hierbei entscheidend für den effizienten Zugriff.
keywords: ASSIGN, CREATE DATA, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Field Symbols, RTTI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Typ eines beliebigen übergebenen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit ermittelt und den Namen des Typs zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN` in Kombination mit RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_name IMPORTING ir_data TYPE REF TO data RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_name.
    DATA: lr_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        rv_type_name = lr_typedescr->get_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
        rv_type_name = 'Error: Could not determine type'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `REF #()` für die Übergabe einer Referenz auf ein beliebiges Datenobjekt ist dies ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen, Serialisierung/Deserialisierung oder Metadaten-basierte Anwendungen. `ASSIGN` ist hier nicht direkt im Aufruf, aber das Konzept der dynamischen Referenzierung und Typisierung ist eng verwandt.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die interne Tabelle `sflights` (oder eine ähnliche Struktur) nach Fluggesellschaften, die mit 'A' beginnen, und sammeln Sie die Flugnummern (CONNID) in einer neuen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `ASSIGNING`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `ASSIGNING` für effizientes Filtern und Sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_connids IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connids.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR <ls_sflight> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid CP 'A*' ) ( <ls_sflight>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_assign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_assign.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_filter_assign=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250104' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_connids) = lo_cut->get_filtered_connids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_connids ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 filtered connid entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 1 ] exp = '0010' msg = 'First connid should be 0010' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_connids[ 2 ] exp = '0020' msg = 'Second connid should be 0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `VALUE #()` und implizitem `ASSIGNING` (durch die Iteration über die Tabelle) ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und zu transformieren. Es ist effizient, da es keine expliziten `APPEND` oder `READ TABLE` Anweisungen benötigt und die Daten direkt in die Zieltabelle überführt werden. Dies ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filter, ASSIGNING, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse `ZCL_BASE_CONFIG` mit einem geschützten Attribut `mv_config_data`. Implementieren Sie eine 'Friend'-Klasse `ZCL_CONFIG_LOADER`, die auf dieses Attribut zugreifen und es initialisieren kann, auch wenn `ZCL_CONFIG_LOADER` keine Unterklasse ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PROTECTED SECTION` und `FRIENDS` für den kontrollierten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_base_config DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_config_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_config_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_config_loader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_base_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_config_value.
    rv_value = mv_config_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_loader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS load_config IMPORTING io_config_obj TYPE REF TO zcl_base_config IV_DATA TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_loader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD load_config.
    io_config_obj->mv_config_data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_config DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_base_config PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_derived_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Can't directly set mv_config_data here without explicit call to super->constructor or direct access if not friend
    " For this example, we'll rely on the friend class to set it.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friend_protected_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friend_protected_access.
    DATA(lv_config_data) = 'Loaded Configuration'.
    DATA(lo_derived_config) = NEW zcl_derived_config( 'Initial' ).
    DATA(lo_loader) = NEW zcl_config_loader( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_derived_config->get_config_value( ) msg = 'Config should be initial before loading' ).

    lo_loader->load_config( io_config_obj = lo_derived_config iv_data = lv_config_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_derived_config->get_config_value( ) exp = lv_config_data msg = 'Config should be loaded by friend class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ähnlich wie bei privaten Attributen ermöglicht `FRIENDS` auch den Zugriff auf `PROTECTED` Attribute von Klassen, die nicht in der Vererbungshierarchie stehen. Dies ist nützlich, um eine enge Kopplung zwischen bestimmten Klassen zu ermöglichen, z.B. eine Ladeklasse, die Konfigurationsdaten in eine Basisklasse injiziert, ohne die Kapselung für die breite Öffentlichkeit zu lockern. Es ist eine Form der kontrollierten Verletzung der Kapselung.
keywords: FRIENDS, Protected Attribute, Object Orientation, Kapselung, Inheritance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (z.B. `STANDARD TABLE OF ANY TABLE LINE`) als Eingabe akzeptiert und dynamisch die Werte einer bestimmten Spalte (Name als String übergeben) in einer neuen String-Tabelle sammelt. Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Zeile und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_column_values IMPORTING it_generic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                                            iv_column_name   TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_generic_line> TYPE any,
                   <lv_column_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_generic_table ASSIGNING <ls_generic_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_generic_line> TO <lv_column_value>.
      IF <lv_column_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND <lv_column_value> TO rt_column_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper structure for testing
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
         id     TYPE i,

explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` in Verbindung mit generischen Tabellen (`STANDARD TABLE`). Sie ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit beliebige Spalten aus einer Tabelle zu extrahieren, deren Struktur zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt sein muss. Dies ist ein Schlüsselmuster für generische Datenverarbeitung, Reporting-Tools oder Schnittstellen, die mit variablen Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ist hierbei für die Performance entscheidend.
keywords: ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Field Symbols, Generic Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur dynamisch aktualisiert. Der Feldname und der neue Wert werden als Strings übergeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` und weisen Sie dem Feldsymbol den neuen Wert zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             key_field   TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE string,
             status_field TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_data_record.

    METHODS update_field_dynamically IMPORTING CHANGING cs_data_record TYPE ty_data_record
                                              iv_field_name  TYPE string
                                              iv_new_value   TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data_record TO <lv_target_field>.

    IF <lv_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      <lv_target_field> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_update_value_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_status_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_record) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_updater=>ty_data_record( key_field = 'K1' value_field = 'Old Value' status_field = 'X' ).
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dynamic_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data_record = ls_record
                                                            iv_field_name  = 'VALUE_FIELD'
                                                            iv_new_value   = 'New Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_record-value_field exp = 'New Value' msg = 'Value field should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_status_field.
    DATA(ls_record) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_updater=>ty_data_record( key_field = 'K2' value_field = 'Test' status_field = 'A' ).
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dynamic_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_updater->update_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data_record = ls_record
                                                            iv_field_name  = 'STATUS_FIELD'
                                                            iv_new_value   = 'B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_record-status_field exp = 'B' msg = 'Status field should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_field.
    DATA(ls_record) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_updater=>ty_data_record( key_field = 'K3' value_field = 'Test' status_field = 'A' ).
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_dynamic_updater( ).

explanation: Das dynamische Aktualisieren von Feldern in einer Struktur mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` ist ein flexibles Muster für Szenarien, in denen der zu aktualisierende Feldname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist typisch für generische Schnittstellen, Konfigurations-Engines oder Datenmapping-Tools. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff und die Modifikation ohne Datenkopien, was effizient ist.
keywords: ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Structures, Field Symbols, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_EVENT_MANAGER` mit einer privaten Methode `raise_event_internal`. Implementieren Sie eine 'Friend'-Klasse `ZCL_EVENT_PUBLISHER`, die diese private Methode aufrufen kann, um Events zu publizieren, ohne dass `raise_event_internal` öffentlich ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die Methode und `FRIENDS` für die Zugriffskontrolle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS raise_event_internal IMPORTING iv_event_name TYPE string iv_event_data TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_event_publisher.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD raise_event_internal.
    " In a real scenario, this would trigger an actual event.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Event '{ iv_event_name }' raised with data: { iv_event_data }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS publish_event IMPORTING io_event_manager TYPE REF TO zcl_event_manager
                                    iv_event_name    TYPE string
                                    iv_event_data    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD publish_event.
    io_event_manager->raise_event_internal( iv_event_name = iv_event_name iv_event_data = iv_event_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_event_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).

explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht es, eine private Methode einer Klasse von einer anderen, 'befreundeten' Klasse aufrufen zu lassen. Dies ist ideal für Implementierungen des Publisher-Subscriber-Patterns, bei denen nur bestimmte Publisher-Klassen Events über eine interne Methode des Event-Managers auslösen dürfen, während die Methode selbst vor externem Zugriff geschützt bleibt. Es bietet eine kontrollierte Entkopplung und Zugriffskontrolle.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und den `LINES` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_airline.
    TYPES tt_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_airline RETURNING VALUE(rs_airline) TYPE ty_airline.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_airline.
    DATA(lt_airlines) = VALUE tt_airlines(
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' carrname = 'United Airlines' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' carrname = 'Delta Airlines' )
    ).

    IF lt_airlines IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_airlines ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 einzigartigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und eine Hash-Tabelle zur Überprüfung der Einzigartigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_low   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_high  TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lt_generated) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = iv_low high = iv_high ).

    DO.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_generated.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. " Successfully inserted (unique)
        APPEND lv_random_num TO rt_random_numbers.
        IF lines( rt_random_numbers ) = iv_count.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      IF lines( lt_generated ) > ( iv_high - iv_low + 1 ). " All possible numbers generated
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife mit `INSERT` und `DELETE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE tt_any_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    IF ct_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_size) = lines( ct_table ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_size ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = VALUE tt_any_table( ).

    DO lv_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE ct_table INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(lv_line).
      APPEND lv_line TO lt_shuffled.
      DELETE TABLE ct_table INDEX lv_random_index.
      lo_random = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lines( ct_table ) ). " Re-create with new upper bound
    ENDDO.

    ct_table = lt_shuffled.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_shuffle_table=>tt_any_table(
      ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lt_original.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) msg = 'Table size should remain the same' ).

    " Check if all original elements are still present (just in a different order)
    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_sorted_original.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original msg = 'Shuffled table should contain same elements' ).

    " It's highly unlikely but possible for a shuffled table to be identical to the original
    " so we don't assert inequality, but rather that it's a valid shuffle.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_shuffle_table( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_shuffle_table=>tt_any_table( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_empty msg = 'Empty table should remain empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert, wie man die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig mischt. Es wird `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren, und dann werden Elemente aus der Quelltabelle entfernt und in eine neue Zieltabelle eingefügt. Die Obergrenze des Zufallszahlengenerators muss in jeder Iteration angepasst werden, da sich die Größe der Quelltabelle ändert.
keywords: Random, Shuffle, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, cl_abap_random_int

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in eine UTC-Zeitstempelzeichenfolge unter Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datfm=>get_utc_timestamp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utc_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_date    TYPE d
        iv_time    TYPE t
        iv_tzone   TYPE tznzone

CLASS zcl_utc_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utc_timestamp.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utc_conversion_berlin.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231225'.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = lo_cut->convert_to_utc_timestamp( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time iv_tzone = lv_tzone ).

  METHOD test_utc_conversion_ny.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231225'.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = lo_cut->convert_to_utc_timestamp( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time iv_tzone = lv_tzone ).
    " 2023-12-25 10:00:00 EST is 2023-12-25 15:00:00 UTC (EST is UTC-5)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_timestamp exp = '20231225150000' msg = 'UTC conversion for New York failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_utc_timestamp` von `cl_abap_datfm` ist entscheidend für die korrekte Handhabung von Datums- und Zeitangaben über verschiedene Zeitzonen hinweg. Sie konvertiert ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit unter Berücksichtigung der angegebenen Zeitzone in einen universellen UTC-Zeitstempel, was für globale Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.
