Instructions: Kopieren Sie numerische Felder von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei die Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind, unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen zu verknüpfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             old_price TYPE sflight-price,
             old_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             new_cost TYPE sflight-price,
             new_amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_values
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_values.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING new_cost = old_price
                                                    new_amount = old_quantity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_source( old_price = '123.45' old_quantity = 10 ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_values( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_cost exp = '123.45' msg = 'Price mapping incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_amount exp = 10 msg = 'Quantity mapping incorrect' ).

    ls_source = VALUE zcl_corresponding_mapping=>ty_source( old_price = '0.00' old_quantity = 0 ).
    ls_target = lo_cut->map_values( ls_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_cost exp = '0.00' msg = 'Zero price mapping incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-new_amount exp = 0 msg = 'Zero quantity mapping incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren, auch wenn die Feldnamen nicht übereinstimmen. Dies ist besonders nützlich bei der Transformation von numerischen Daten zwischen verschiedenen Datenmodellen und reduziert den Bedarf an manuellen Zuweisungen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, MAPPING, Structures, Transformation, Numbers, Object Orientation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `COUNT`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `COUNT` für die Anzahl, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( 'LH' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies zeigt die Flexibilität und Ausdrucksstärke der modernen ABAP-Syntax bei der Verarbeitung numerischer Daten.

CLASS zcl_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Datenstruktur aus SFLIGHTS, die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach Flugdatum gruppiert. Die Ausgabe soll eine Tabelle von Strukturen sein, die jeweils eine Fluggesellschaft und eine Tabelle ihrer Flüge für jedes Datum enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_by_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flights TYPE tt_flight_detail,
           END OF ty_flights_by_date.
    TYPES: tt_flights_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flights_by_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_by_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flights_per_date TYPE tt_flights_by_date,
           END OF ty_flights_by_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_flights_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flights_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE tt_flights_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_flights.
    rt_hierarchy = VALUE tt_flights_by_carrier(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_carrier IN sflights GROUP BY ls_carrier-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_carrier-carrid
        flights_per_date = VALUE tt_flights_by_date(
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_date IN GROUP ls_carrier GROUP BY ls_date-fldate
          ( fldate = ls_date-fldate
            flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
              FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_date
              ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
                fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                planetype = ls_flight-planetype )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_hierarchical_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hierarchical_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_hierarchy( ).
    DATA(lt_hierarchy) = lo_cut->get_hierarchical_flights( ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Hierarchie nicht leer ist, wenn SFLIGHTS Daten enthält.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_hierarchy ) >= 0 ) ).
    IF lines( lt_hierarchy ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_hierarchy[ 1 ]-flights_per_date ) >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte FOR GROUPS OF Ausdrücke ermöglichen die Erstellung komplexer, hierarchischer Datenstrukturen in einer sehr deklarativen und funktionalen Weise. Dies ersetzt mehrere explizite Schleifen und COLLECT/APPEND Anweisungen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Flüge in SFLIGHTS und gruppieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft. Für jede Gruppe sollen die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge ausgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight.
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                            flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    " Prüfen, ob das Ergebnis nicht leer ist, wenn SFLIGHTS Daten enthält.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_counts ) >= 0 ) ).
    IF lines( lt_counts ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_counts[ 1 ]-flight_count >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: LOOP AT GROUP BY ist die moderne Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und gruppenweise zu verarbeiten. Es bietet eine klare Struktur zur Aggregation oder Transformation von Daten innerhalb jeder Gruppe, ohne manuelle Sortierung oder AT NEW/AT END Konstrukte.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Count

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS _method_a
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _method_b
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_caller.
    lo_ref = me. " Referenz auf sich selbst

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_ref->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULTS rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit übergebenen Tabellentyp (z.B. 'SFLIGHTS_TAB'). Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit einigen Daten und geben Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE DATA und Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA dref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
        ASSIGN dref->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Füllen mit Beispieldaten, falls der Typ bekannt ist.
          " Für eine wirklich generische Lösung wäre hier mehr dynamische Logik oder ein generisches Interface erforderlich.
          IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHTS_TAB'.
            DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ).
            APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
            APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_dynamic_table>. " Eine weitere Zeile hinzufügen
          ELSEIF iv_table_type_name = 'STRING_TABLE'.
            APPEND 'Hello' TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
            APPEND 'World' TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDIF.

          rv_line_count = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Typname ungültig ist
        rv_line_count = -1. " Fehler anzeigen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Strukturen dynamisch nach einem Feld, dessen Name als String übergeben wird. Geben Sie die sortierte Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie SORT itab BY (field_name).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflights_dynamically.
    rt_sorted_sflights = it_sflights. " Kopie zum Sortieren

    TRY.
        SORT rt_sorted_sflights BY (iv_sort_field).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_sort_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Feldname ungültig ist.
        " In einem realen Szenario würde man dies protokollieren oder eine Ausnahme auslösen.
        " Für dieses Beispiel geben wir die unsortierte Tabelle zurück.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_sflights_dynamically( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_sflights_dynamically( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'FLDATE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250102' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250103' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_invalid_field.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' ) TO lt_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_sflights_dynamically( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_sort_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Die neue Tabelle soll nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthalten und die Felder `carrid`, `connid`, `fldate`, `price`, `currency` und `planetype` umfassen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` um die sortierte Tabelle zu initialisieren und zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_lufthansa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lufthansa_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung und Initialisierung einer `SORTED TABLE` mit der `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und einer `WHERE`-Klausel. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten aus einer Quelltabelle zu filtern und in eine neue, sortierte Tabelle zu überführen, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Verbindungsnummer (`connid`) zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie die `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_connid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( mt_all_flights WHERE connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_flights_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'. "Example connid, adjust if needed
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_connid( lv_connid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Filtered table should not be initial' act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid should match filter' act = ls_flight-connid exp = lv_connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu extrahieren. Für `SORTED TABLE`s kann dies besonders performant sein, da der Zugriff auf die Schlüsselkomponenten optimiert ist.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer sortierten Tabelle. Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT lv_sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN mt_all_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT lv_sum = lv_sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in eine sortierte Tabelle ein und löschen Sie anschließend einen bestehenden Datensatz anhand seines Schlüssels. Demonstrieren Sie, wie die Sortierung beibehalten wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` und `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS modify_flights
      IMPORTING is_new_flight TYPE ty_flight
                is_flight_to_delete TYPE ty_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_flights.
    rt_modified_flights = mt_flights.

    " Insert new flight
    INSERT is_new_flight INTO TABLE rt_modified_flights.

    " Delete existing flight
    DELETE TABLE rt_modified_flights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_flight_to_delete-carrid
                                                connid = is_flight_to_delete-connid
                                                fldate = is_flight_to_delete-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_flight_to_delete-fldate = '20250101'. "Adjust with actual data from sflights

                                                        is_flight_to_delete = ls_flight_to_delete ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'New flight should exist' act = LINE_EXISTS( lt_modified_flights[ carrid = ls_new_flight-carrid

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge in einer sortierten Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ( ... )` und `COUNT(*)` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_groupby DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_groupby IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT mt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA ls_flight_group TYPE ty_flight_group.
      ls_flight_group-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_flight_group-count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_flight_group TO rt_flight_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_flights_groupby( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_groups) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Grouped table should not be initial' act = lines( lt_flight_groups ) ).
    " Example: Check if LH has at least one flight
    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_flight_groups[ carrid = 'LH' ] ).
      DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_flight_groups[ carrid = 'LH' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH should have flights' act = ls_lh_group-count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und innerhalb jeder Gruppe Operationen durchzuführen, wie z.B. das Zählen der Einträge (`GROUP SIZE`). Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für Gruppierungsaufgaben.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie Daten von einer Standardtabelle mit Flugdaten, die aus `sflights` gelesen wurden, einer sortierten Tabelle zu. Nutzen Sie die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung, um Felder mit gleichem Namen automatisch zu übertragen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab_sorted = CORRESPONDING #( itab_standard )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS assign_with_corresponding RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_with_corresponding.
    DATA lt_standard_flights TYPE tt_flights_standard.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_standard_flights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_sorted_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_standard_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_assignment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_assignment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_flights_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = lo_cut->assign_with_corresponding( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Sorted table should not be initial' act = lines( lt_sorted_flights ) ).
    " Verify sorting (implicit for SORTED TABLE, but can be checked explicitly)
    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    DATA lv_prev_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted by carrid' act = ls_flight-carrid GE lv_prev_carrid ).
        IF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted by connid' act = ls_flight-connid GE lv_prev_connid ).
          IF ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid = lv_prev_connid.
            cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted by fldate' act = ls_flight-fldate GE lv_prev_fldate ).
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und sehr nützliche Funktion, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit gleichen Feldnamen zu übertragen. Sie reduziert den Boilerplate-Code erheblich und ist besonders praktisch, wenn man Daten aus einer Standardtabelle in eine `SORTED TABLE` überführen möchte, da die Sortierung automatisch durch den Tabellentyp gewährleistet wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             is_expensive TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_all_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN mt_all_flights
                                    WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
                                    ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
                                      connid    = ls_flight-connid,
                                      fldate    = ls_flight-fldate,
                                      price     = ls_flight-price,
                                      currency  = ls_flight-currency,
                                      planetype = ls_flight-planetype,
                                      is_expensive = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten und aktualisieren Sie den Preis für einen bestimmten Flug. Nutzen Sie die moderne Syntax für den direkten Zeilenzugriff und `CORRESPONDING` für die Aktualisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key_field = value ]-field = new_value` oder `itab[ key_field = value ] = CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    mt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                              ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price.
    rt_updated_flights = mt_flights.

    TRY.
        rt_updated_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                            connid = iv_connid
                            fldate = iv_fldate ]-price = iv_new_price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where flight is not found
        MESSAGE 'Flight not found for update' TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Join'-Operation zwischen zwei sortierten Tabellen durch, um zusätzliche Informationen zu Flügen zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `IN` und `LET` für eine kompakte Lösung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... LET ... )` um eine Art 'Join' zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_basic,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_basic.
    TYPES: tt_flights_basic_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_basic WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flights_detail_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             has_details TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES: tt_joined_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS join_flight_data
      IMPORTING it_basic_flights TYPE tt_flights_basic_sorted
                it_detail_flights TYPE tt_flights_detail_sorted
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_joined_flights) TYPE tt_joined_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_flights_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_flight_data.
    rt_joined_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_basic IN it_basic_flights
                                 LET ls_detail = VALUE ty_flight_detail( )
                                     lv_found = abap_false
                                 IN
                                   COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_detail_flights[ carrid = ls_basic-carrid
                                                                                connid = ls_basic-connid
                                                                                fldate = ls_basic-fldate ] )
                                           THEN ( LET ls_found_detail = it_detail_flights[ carrid = ls_basic-carrid
                                                                                             connid = ls_basic-connid
                                                                                             fldate = ls_basic-fldate ] IN
                                                  ( carrid = ls_basic-carrid,
                                                    connid = ls_basic-connid,
                                                    fldate = ls_basic-fldate,
                                                    price = ls_found_detail-price,
                                                    currency = ls_found_detail-currency,
                                                    planetype = ls_found_detail-planetype,
                                                    has_details = abap_true ) )
                                           ELSE ( carrid = ls_basic-carrid,
                                                  connid = ls_basic-connid,
                                                  fldate = ls_basic-fldate,
                                                  has_details = abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_flights_join( ).

    DATA lt_basic_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_flights_join=>tt_flights_basic_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_basic_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' ) INTO TABLE lt_basic_flights.

    DATA lt_detail_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_flights_join=>tt_flights_detail_sorted.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '500.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' ) INTO TABLE lt_detail_flights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '600.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' ) INTO TABLE lt_detail_flights.

    DATA(lt_joined_flights) = lo_cut->join_flight_data( it_basic_flights = lt_basic_flights
                                                        it_detail_flights = lt_detail_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Joined table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_joined_flights ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_joined) = lt_joined_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH price should be 500.00' act = ls_lh_joined-price exp = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH has_details should be true' act = ls_lh_joined-has_details exp = abap_true ).

Die `LET`-Anweisung ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb der Expression, was die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes erheblich verbessert. Der direkte Zeilenzugriff auf die Detailtabelle ist für `SORTED TABLE`s sehr effizient.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, LET, COND, Internal Tables, Join, Functional Programming

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine sortierte Tabelle mit einem nicht-eindeutigen Schlüssel und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu, um zu zeigen, wie Duplikate im Schlüssel behandelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_non_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_items RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_non_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item B' ) INTO TABLE rt_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ) INTO TABLE rt_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item C' ) INTO TABLE rt_items.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 3 name = 'Item D' ) INTO TABLE rt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_non_unique_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_non_unique_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_non_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_cut->add_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 4 entries' act = lines( lt_items ) exp = 4 ).

    " Verify sorting and duplicate handling
    DATA lv_prev_id TYPE i.
    LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should be sorted by ID' act = ls_item-id GE lv_prev_id ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_id = ls_item-id.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check specific entries
    DATA(lt_items_id2) = FILTER #( lt_items WHERE id = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should have 2 items with ID 2' act = lines( lt_items_id2 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item with ID 2 should be Item B' act = lt_items_id2[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second item with ID 2 should be Item C' act = lt_items_id2[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Item C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `SORTED TABLE` mit einem `NON-UNIQUE KEY` behält die Sortierung bei, erlaubt aber mehrere Einträge mit demselben Schlüsselwert. Neue Einträge werden an der korrekten sortierten Position eingefügt. Dies ist nützlich, wenn eine schnelle Suche nach einem Schlüssel erforderlich ist, aber Duplikate erlaubt sein sollen, und ist eine effiziente Alternative zu Standardtabellen, die manuell sortiert werden müssen.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, NON-UNIQUE KEY, Internal Tables, Duplicates

Instructions: Ändern Sie den Wert eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem eindeutigen Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_single_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id      TYPE i
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data    TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_single_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_entry.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id text = iv_new_text ).
    MODIFY TABLE ct_data FROM ls_data TRANSPORTING text WHERE id = iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_existing.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_mod_single_line=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Original Text 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Original Text 2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mod_single_line( ).
    lo_cut->modify_entry( iv_id = 1 iv_new_text = 'Updated Text 1' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_data INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH KEY id = 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-text exp = 'Updated Text 1' msg = 'Existing entry should be updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_data INTO ls_result WITH KEY id = 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-text exp = 'Original Text 2' msg = 'Other entries should remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_mod_single_line=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Original Text 1' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mod_single_line( ).
    lo_cut->modify_entry( iv_id = 99 iv_new_text = 'New Text' CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_data WITH KEY id = 99 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'Non-existing entry should not be added by MODIFY TABLE ... WHERE' ).

explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` Syntax ermöglicht die gezielte Aktualisierung spezifischer Felder in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung. Dies ist effizienter als ein `LOOP` mit `READ TABLE` und `MODIFY`. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Inline-Initialisierung der Struktur ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, TRANSPORTING, WHERE, VALUE

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status aller Flüge in der internen Tabelle `sflights`, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen, auf 'CANCELLED'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) WHERE ...`.

CLASS zcl_mod_multi_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 10, " Custom status field
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_cutoff_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_status  TYPE c LENGTH 10
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights    TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_multi_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE fldate < iv_cutoff_date.
      <fs_sflight>-status = iv_new_status.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_upsert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.

        is_item TYPE ty_item
      CHANGING
        ct_items TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_upsert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_item.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_items FROM is_item. " Acts as UPSERT due to unique key
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie eine Inline-Deklaration für die zu ändernde Zeile verwenden und dabei `LINE_EXISTS` und `VALUE` nutzen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `IF line_exists(...)` mit `MODIFY TABLE ... FROM VALUE ... TRANSPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mod_inline_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_product_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_id TYPE i
        iv_new_price  TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_products   TYPE tt_product
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mod_inline_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_price.
    rv_updated = abap_false.
    IF line_exists( ct_products[ id = iv_product_id ] ).
      MODIFY TABLE ct_products FROM VALUE #( id = iv_product_id price = iv_new_price ) TRANSPORTING price.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Listen Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer gegebenen Klasse auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( )` und die Methode `get_methods()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_list_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             is_static TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_list_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
          IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_classdescr=>public.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_method-name is_static = ls_method-is_static ) TO rt_methods.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle class not found error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt einer bestimmten Klasse angehört oder von dieser erbt.

CLASS zcl_rtt_check_inheritance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS cl_base DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS cl_base IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS cl_sub DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_base.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS cl_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS is_object_subclass_of
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_super_class TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_sub) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_check_inheritance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_object_subclass_of.
    rv_is_sub = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( io_object ).
        DATA(lo_super_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_super_class ).
        rv_is_sub = lo_object_descr->is_subclass_of( lo_super_class_descr ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle class not found error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Attribute (Felder) einer Struktur oder einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit, einschließlich deren Typen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_descr( )` oder `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_descr( )` und die Methode `get_components()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
             decimals TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.

    METHODS get_table_line_components
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_get_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_descr( iv_struct_type_name ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE #(
            name      = ls_component-name
            type_kind = ls_component-type_descr_ref->type_kind
            length    = ls_component-type_descr_ref->length
            decimals  = ls_component-type_descr_ref->decimals
          ) TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle type not found error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_table_line_components.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_descr( iv_table_type_name ).
        DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE #(
            name      = ls_component-name
            type_kind = ls_component-type_descr_ref->type_kind
            length    = ls_component-type_descr_ref->length
            decimals  = ls_component-type_descr_ref->decimals
          ) TO rt_components.
        END LOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle type not found error
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle case where table line type is not a structure
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie dynamisch ein Feld in einer internen Tabelle, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, unter Verwendung von RTTI und Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_modify_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS modify_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_id         TYPE i
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data       TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_modify_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_field.
    rv_modified = abap_false.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE ty_data,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_data> WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        rv_modified = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-status exp = 'NEW' msg = 'Status field should be unchanged' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Feldzugriffsmöglichkeit von Feld-Symbolen (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>`) mit der direkten Modifikation einer internen Tabelle. Zuerst wird der gewünschte Eintrag über den Schlüssel gefunden und einem Feld-Symbol zugewiesen. Dann wird das spezifische Feld innerhalb dieses Eintrags dynamisch über seinen Namen angesprochen und aktualisiert. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für generische Datenmanipulationen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Objekten eines beliebigen Typs empfängt und ein spezifisches Attribut aller Objekte in dieser Tabelle dynamisch aktualisiert, wenn der Attributname und der neue Wert als Parameter übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN (<fs_object>->*) TO <fs_attribute> CASTING` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message. " For generic object handling

    CLASS lcl_test_object DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: id TYPE i,
              name TYPE string.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_name TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        me->id = iv_id.
        me->name = iv_name.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS update_object_attribute
      IMPORTING
        iv_attribute_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_objects        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_object_attribute.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object,
                   <fs_attribute> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_objects ASSIGNING <fs_object>.
      TRY.
          ASSIGN (<fs_object>->*) TO <fs_attribute> CASTING. " Dynamic access to object attributes
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_attribute_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_attribute> TO <fs_attribute>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_attribute> = iv_new_value.
            rv_updated_count = rv_updated_count + 1.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Object is not a structure or attribute not found
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_name_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_id_attribute FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent_attribute FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_name_attribute.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object.
    APPEND NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Object A' ) TO lt_objects.
    APPEND NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( iv_id = 2 iv_name = 'Object B' ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_object_attribute(
      iv_attribute_name = 'NAME'
      iv_new_value      = 'Updated Name'
      CHANGING
        ct_objects        = lt_objects
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 2 msg = 'Two objects should be updated' ).
    DATA(lo_obj1) = CAST zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( lt_objects[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj1->name exp = 'Updated Name' msg = 'Name of Object 1 should be updated' ).
    DATA(lo_obj2) = CAST zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( lt_objects[ 2 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj2->name exp = 'Updated Name' msg = 'Name of Object 2 should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj1->id exp = 1 msg = 'ID of Object 1 should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_id_attribute.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object.
    APPEND NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Object A' ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_object_attribute(
      iv_attribute_name = 'ID'
      iv_new_value      = '99' " Note: iv_new_value is string, implicit conversion happens
      CHANGING
        ct_objects        = lt_objects
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 1 msg = 'One object should be updated' ).
    DATA(lo_obj1) = CAST zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( lt_objects[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj1->id exp = 99 msg = 'ID of Object 1 should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_attribute.
    DATA: lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO object.
    APPEND NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( iv_id = 1 iv_name = 'Object A' ) TO lt_objects.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_object_attribute(
      iv_attribute_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_ATTR'
      iv_new_value      = 'Some Value'
      CHANGING
        ct_objects        = lt_objects
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_count exp = 0 msg = 'No objects should be updated' ).
    DATA(lo_obj1) = CAST zcl_dyn_update_obj_attr=>lcl_test_object( lt_objects[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj1->name exp = 'Object A' msg = 'Name should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses fortgeschrittene Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Manipulation von Objektattributen in einer Tabelle von Objektreferenzen. Durch die Verwendung von Feld-Symbolen und der `ASSIGN (<fs_object>->*) TO <fs_attribute> CASTING` Syntax kann auf die Attribute eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zugegriffen werden. Anschließend wird `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...` verwendet, um das spezifische Attribut zu identifizieren und zu aktualisieren. Dies ist ein mächtiges Muster für generische Objektverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN, RTTI, Object Attributes, Generic Programming

CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur für Flugdaten mit vordefinierten Werten unter Verwendung des VALUE-Operators.

CLASS zcl_flight_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS create_flight_structure
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'LH'
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id DEFAULT '0400'
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date    DEFAULT '20251207'
        iv_price    TYPE s_price   DEFAULT '1000.00'
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode DEFAULT 'EUR'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_structure.
    rs_flight = VALUE #( 
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den doppelten Preis aller Flüge aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Preis über 500 liegt. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             double_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES ty_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE ty_transformed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > 500 )
      (
        carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
        connid       = ls_flight-connid
        double_price = ls_flight-price * 2
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_transformed ). " Initially empty, as SFLIGHTS might be empty or not match criteria
    IF lines( lt_transformed ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_transformed[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_flight-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_flight-double_price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_flight-double_price > 1000 ). " Original price > 500, so double > 1000
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus VALUE-Operator und FOR-Schleife mit WHERE-Bedingung ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist sehr effizient und lesbar, da es die Notwendigkeit expliziter LOOP-Anweisungen und APPEND-Befehle eliminiert.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Table, Transformation, CALCULATE, DATA

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ... IN ... NEXT sum = sum + ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Reduktionen von internen Tabellen oder anderen Datenmengen. Er ermöglicht es, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable iterativ zu berechnen, was den Code für Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen sehr kompakt und funktional macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, CALCULATE

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um alle Flüge zu erhalten, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER #( base_table WHERE ( condition ) ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             cityfrom  TYPE s_city,
             cityto    TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_city
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_no_match FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_flights_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).

      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_filtered[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).

keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Data Selection, DATA

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Preis einen Status ('Günstig', 'Standard', 'Teuer') zu. Nutzen Sie den COND-Operator.

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_price_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price < 1000 THEN 'Standard'
      ELSE 'Teuer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_price_status( '500.00' ) exp = 'Standard' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_price_status( '1500.00' ) exp = 'Teuer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_price_status( '200.00' ) exp = 'Standard' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( field1 field2 ... ) INTO DATA(group_key) ... ENDLOOP.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier.
    TYPES ty_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_avg_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT total = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN group_key
        NEXT total = total + <fs_member>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( group_key ).
      IF lv_count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carrier(
          carrid = group_key-carrid
          average_price = lv_sum_price / lv_count
        ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_avg_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_avg_price_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_avg_price.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_grouper->calculate_avg_price_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_avg_prices ) >= 0 ).

    IF lines( lt_avg_prices ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_avg) = lt_avg_prices[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_avg-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_avg-average_price >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_avg_price_empty.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_avg_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisung ermöglicht die Gruppierung von Zeilen einer internen Tabelle und die Verarbeitung jeder Gruppe. In Kombination mit REDUCE für Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppen ist dies eine sehr mächtige und moderne Methode zur Datenanalyse und -transformation, die komplexe Logik kompakt darstellt.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Table, Aggregation, CALCULATE, DATA
