Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den höchsten Preis enthält. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife und GROUP BY.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ... ) mit REDUCE für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES ty_carrier_stats_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_stats) TYPE ty_carrier_stats_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      UP TO 200 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_carrier_stats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      (
        carrid       = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        max_price    = REDUCE s_price(
                           INIT max_p = 0
                           FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP
                           NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = <fs_member>-price ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_statistics FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_statistics.
    DATA(lo_stats) = NEW zcl_flight_stats( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_stats->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_stats ) >= 0 ).

    IF lines( lt_stats ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_stat) = lt_stats[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_stat-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_stat-flight_count >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_first_stat-max_price >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus VALUE-Operator, FOR GROUPS OF und GROUP BY ermöglicht die deklarative und hochperformante Aggregation und Transformation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Syntax, um komplexe Gruppierungs- und Berechnungslogik kompakt zu implementieren.
keywords: VALUE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, CALCULATE, DATA

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden. Nutzen Sie LINE_EXISTS und LINE_INDEX mit Tabellenausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie LINE_EXISTS( itab[ condition ] ) und LINE_INDEX( itab[ condition ] ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_index.
    TRY.
        rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ carrid = is_key-carrid AND connid = is_key-connid ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
        rv_index = -1. " Indicate not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_existence FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_index FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_existence.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_key_exists) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ).
    DATA(ls_key_not_exists) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->check_flight_existence( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key_exists ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->check_flight_existence( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key_not_exists ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_index.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_key_exists) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_index( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key_exists ) exp = 2 ). " Index is 1-based
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flights(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(ls_key_not_exists) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_flight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_index( it_flights = lt_test_flights is_key = ls_key_not_exists ) exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: LINE_EXISTS und LINE_INDEX in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken bieten eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Existenz von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu READ TABLE und verbessert die Performance und den Code-Stil.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Table Expression, Internal Table, DATA

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur, die die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Endpreis eines Fluges enthält, wobei der Endpreis aus dem Grundpreis plus einer Servicegebühr und Mehrwertsteuer berechnet wird. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit direkten Berechnungen.
hint: Berechnungen können direkt im VALUE-Operator durchgeführt werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_detail,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             base_price TYPE s_price,
             final_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_detail.

    METHODS calculate_final_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_base_price TYPE s_price
        iv_service_fee TYPE s_price DEFAULT '50.00'
        iv_vat_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 DEFAULT '0.19' " 19%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_price_detail) TYPE ty_flight_price_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_final_price.
    rs_price_detail = VALUE #( 
      carrid    = iv_carrid
      connid    = iv_connid
      base_price = iv_base_price
      final_price = ( iv_base_price + iv_service_fee ) * ( 1 + iv_vat_rate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_final_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_final_price.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_price_calculator( ).
    DATA(ls_detail) = lo_calc->calculate_final_price(
                        iv_carrid = 'LH'
                        iv_connid = '0400'
                        iv_base_price = '100.00' ).
    " Expected: (100 + 50) * 1.19 = 150 * 1.19 = 178.50
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_detail-final_price exp = '178.50' ).

    DATA(ls_detail2) = lo_calc->calculate_final_price(
                         iv_carrid = 'AA'
                         iv_connid = '0017'
                         iv_base_price = '200.00'
                         iv_service_fee = '20.00'
                         iv_vat_rate = '0.07' ). " 7%
    " Expected: (200 + 20) * 1.07 = 220 * 1.07 = 235.40
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_detail2-final_price exp = '235.40' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator erlaubt nicht nur die Zuweisung von Literalen oder Variablen, sondern auch die direkte Durchführung komplexer arithmetischer Berechnungen. Dies macht den Code für die Initialisierung von Datenobjekten mit berechneten Werten sehr kompakt und effizient.
keywords: VALUE, Arithmetic, Calculation, DATA, CALCULATE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus SFLIGHTS die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis nach Abzug eines Rabatts von 10% enthält. Nutzen Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife und einem LET-Ausdruck für die Rabattberechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie LET var = expression IN ( ... ) innerhalb der FOR-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_discounted_flight,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             discounted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_discounted_flight.
    TYPES ty_discounted_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_discounted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 DEFAULT '0.10' " 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE ty_discounted_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example data

    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_discount = ls_flight-price * iv_discount_rate IN
      (
        carrid         = ls_flight-carrid
        connid         = ls_flight-connid
        discounted_price = ls_flight-price - lv_discount
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_discounted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_discounted_flights.
    DATA(lo_discount) = NEW zcl_flight_discount( ).
    DATA(lt_discounted) = lo_discount->get_discounted_flights( iv_discount_rate = '0.10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_discounted ) >= 0 ).

    IF lines( lt_discounted ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_discounted) = lt_discounted[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_discounted-carrid ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer `sflights`-Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `REDUCE` um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_utclong_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_utclong1) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( iv_utclong1 ).
    DATA(lo_utclong2) = cl_abap_utclong=>create( iv_utclong2 ).
    rv_seconds_diff = lo_utclong1->get_difference( lo_utclong2 ).

  METHOD test_time_difference.
    DATA(lo_diff_calc) = NEW zcl_utclong_diff( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_start) = '20231026100000000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_end)   = '20231026100130000000'. " 1 minute 30 seconds later
    DATA(lv_expected_diff) = 90. " 90 seconds

    DATA(lv_result_diff) = lo_diff_calc->get_time_difference(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_end
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_start
    ).

    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_avg,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_seatsocc TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carr_avg.
    TYPES tt_carr_avg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_avg) TYPE tt_carr_avg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_carrier.
    rt_carr_avg = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
                             ( carrid = carrier_group-carrid
                               avg_seatsocc = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                                                 FOR member IN carrier_group
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc
                                                                      count = count + 1
                                                                 FINAL = sum / count ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_num
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR ls_num IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + ls_num-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck, was den Code sehr prägnant und leicht verständlich macht. Es ist eine moderne Alternative zu Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum, Functional Programming

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(method_name)` und `CAST` für die Objektreferenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: method_a
               IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
               RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string,
             method_b
               IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
               RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' processed by Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' processed by Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_ref) = CAST REF TO zcl_dynamic_method_call( me ).
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_ref->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input
          IMPORTING
            rv_output = rv_output.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_dyn_call_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A' iv_input = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello processed by Method A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B' iv_input = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'World processed by Method B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' iv_input = 'Test' ) ) EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name)` ermöglicht flexible Programmierstrukturen, bei denen die aufzurufende Logik zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Handler.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Reflection, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur (Liste von Feldnamen und Typen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `HANDLE` und RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
         name TYPE fieldname,
         type TYPE string,
       END OF ty_field_def.
TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_creation_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or raise error
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_itab_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_itab_with_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_itab_creation.
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'FIELD1' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'FIELD2' type = 'INT' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab_create( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_table ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 1 ]-name exp = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 2 ]-name exp = 'FIELD2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_itab_with_data.
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID' type = 'INT' )
      ( name = 'DESCRIPTION' type = 'STRING' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab_create( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line> TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 1.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DESCRIPTION' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0. <lv_field> = 'Dynamic Entry'.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 1 ).
    ASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>[ 1 ]-('ID') TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen mit `CREATE DATA` und RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_tabledescr` ermöglicht es, die Struktur von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit zu definieren. Dies ist für generische Anwendungen, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, unerlässlich.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA, RTTI, Internal Tables, Reflection

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE (structure) TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
         field1 TYPE string,
         field2 TYPE i,
         field3 TYPE d,
       END OF ty_data.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_fs_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_fs_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_error
          name   = iv_field_name.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = CONV string( <lv_field> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle, um nur die Einträge zu erhalten, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
         id TYPE i,
         status TYPE string,
         value TYPE i,
       END OF ty_item.
TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_by_status_and_value
      IMPORTING
        it_items  TYPE tt_item
        iv_status TYPE string
        iv_min_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_status_and_value.
    rt_filtered_items = FILTER #( it_items WHERE status = iv_status AND value >= iv_min_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_multiple_conditions FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_source FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_multiple_conditions.
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 1 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 status = 'INACTIVE' value = 5 )
      ( id = 3 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 20 )
      ( id = 4 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 8 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE tt_item(
      ( id = 1 status = 'ACTIVE' value = 10 )

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_by_status_and_value( it_items = lt_items iv_status = 'INACTIVE' iv_min_value = 10 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der verschiedene Datentypen (Integer, Datum, String) enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) und den `CONV` Operator implizit oder explizit.

CLASS zcl_string_template_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_mixed_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        iv_date   TYPE d
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_time   TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_mixed_data.
    rv_formatted_string = |Number: { iv_number }, Date: { CONV string( iv_date ) }, Time: { iv_time }, Text: { iv_text }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_template FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_template.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_template_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_test_time) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->format_mixed_data( iv_number = 42 iv_date = lv_test_date iv_text = 'Hello World' iv_time = lv_test_time ).

    DATA(lv_expected_date_str) = CONV string( lv_test_date ).
    DATA(lv_expected_time_str) = CONV string( lv_test_time ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax zur Erstellung von Strings aus verschiedenen Datentypen, wobei Konvertierungen oft implizit erfolgen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit im Vergleich zur Verkettung mit `&&` oder `CONCATENATE`.
keywords: String Templates, CONV, Type Conversion, String Processing

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und lesen Sie deren Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `INDEX (lv_index)` oder `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_OF`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
         id TYPE i,
         value TYPE string,
       END OF ty_data.
TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_line_by_dynamic_index
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_line) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_line_by_dynamic_index.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_data[ iv_index ] ).
      rs_line = it_data[ iv_index ].
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_itab_line_not_found=>line_not_found
          index  = iv_index.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine generische Referenzvariable (z.B. zu einer Oberklasse oder Schnittstelle) in eine spezifischere Klasse (Down-Cast).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CAST` Operator.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cast_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cast_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    DATA: lo_circle TYPE REF TO zcl_circle.
    TRY.
        lo_circle = CAST zcl_circle( io_shape ).
        rv_area = lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_move_cast_error=>move_cast_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cast_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cast_failure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cast_success.
    DATA(lo_circle_instance) = NEW zcl_circle( 5 ).
    DATA(lo_shape_ref) = CAST zif_shape( lo_circle_instance ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_example( ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_cut->process_shape( lo_shape_ref ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_area exp = '78.53981633974483' ). " PI * 5 * 5
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cast_failure.
    " Create a dummy class that implements zif_shape but is not zcl_circle
    CLASS lcl_square DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_shape.
        METHODS zif_shape~get_area.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_area. RETURN. ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_square_instance) = NEW lcl_square( ).
    DATA(lo_shape_ref) = CAST zif_shape( lo_square_instance ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_example( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->process_shape( lo_shape_ref ) ) EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CAST` Operator ermöglicht die sichere Typumwandlung von Objektreferenzen. Dies ist entscheidend für polymorphe Designs, bei denen eine generische Schnittstelle oder Oberklasse verwendet wird, aber spezifische Methoden einer Unterklasse aufgerufen werden müssen.
keywords: CAST, Object Orientation, Type Conversion, Polymorphism, Down-Cast

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit in einen Zeitstempel (UTC) und umgekehrt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktionen `CONVERT DATE TIME INTO TIME STAMP` und `CONVERT TIME STAMP INTO DATE TIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_time TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

    METHODS convert_from_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      EXPORTING
        ev_date      TYPE d
        ev_time      TYPE t
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_timestamp.
    TRY.
        CONVERT DATE iv_date TIME iv_time INTO TIME STAMP rv_timestamp TIME ZONE 'UTC'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_conversion_error=>conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_from_timestamp.
    TRY.
        CONVERT TIME STAMP iv_timestamp INTO DATE ev_date TIME ev_time TIME ZONE 'UTC'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_conversion_error=>conversion_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timestamp_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_timestamp FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timestamp_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_conversion( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = lo_cut->convert_to_timestamp( iv_date = lv_date iv_time = lv_time ).

    DATA: lv_converted_date TYPE d,
          lv_converted_time TYPE t.
    lo_cut->convert_from_timestamp( EXPORTING iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp IMPORTING ev_date = lv_converted_date ev_time = lv_converted_time ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_date exp = lv_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_time exp = lv_time ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_conversion( ).
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->convert_from_timestamp( EXPORTING iv_timestamp = '00000000000000000' IMPORTING ev_date = lv_date ev_time = lv_time ) ) EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CONVERT` Anweisungen für Zeitstempel sind essenziell für die Arbeit mit Datums- und Zeitangaben, insbesondere bei der Synchronisierung von Daten über verschiedene Zeitzonen hinweg. Die Verwendung von `TIMESTAMPL` (long timestamp) ist für moderne Anwendungen zu bevorzugen.
keywords: CONVERT, Date/Time, Timestamp, Type Conversion, UTC

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
         id TYPE i,
         name TYPE string,
         created_at TYPE d,
       END OF ty_test_struct.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_struct_descr_error=>not_a_structure.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_component_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_components_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_components_non_struct FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_components_success.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_test_struct( id = 1 name = 'Test' created_at = sy-datum ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ] exp = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 3 ] exp = 'CREATED_AT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_components_non_struct.
    DATA(lv_string) = 'Just a string'.
    DATA(lr_string) = REF TO lv_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_rtti_struct( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( ACT = #( lo_cut->get_structure_components( lr_string ) ) EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_STRUCT_DESCR_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Runtime Type Identification (RTTI) mit Klassen wie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` ermöglicht es, die Metadaten von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu analysieren. Dies ist grundlegend für generische Frameworks, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Reflection, Structure, Metaprogramming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine zirkuläre Verschiebung (Rotation) einer Zeichenkette um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach links durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und Offset/Length-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_left
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_positions TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_left.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length = 0.
      rv_output = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_actual_shift) = iv_positions MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = |{ iv_input+lv_actual_shift(lv_length - lv_actual_shift) }{ iv_input(lv_actual_shift) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 50.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in einer Schleife und eine Hash-Tabelle für die Eindeutigkeitsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_ints
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_ints.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = iv_min p_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lv_attempts) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_max_attempts) TYPE i.

    lv_max_attempts = ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) * 2.

    WHILE lines( lt_temp_numbers ) < iv_count AND lv_attempts < lv_max_attempts.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          " Duplicate, try again
      ENDTRY.
      lv_attempts = lv_attempts + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rt_random_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN lt_temp_numbers ( number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_and_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_impossible_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 msg = 'Incorrect number of unique random numbers' ).

    DATA(lt_unique_check) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_check.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 5 msg = 'Numbers are not unique' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_and_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 3 iv_min = 10 iv_max = 12 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number for small range' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 10 AND lv_num <= 12 ) msg = 'Number out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_impossible_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_gen( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_ints( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) < 5 ) msg = 'Should not return 5 unique numbers' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) <= 3 ) msg = 'Should return at most 3 unique numbers' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Generierung eindeutiger Zufallszahlen erfordert eine Schleife und eine effiziente Prüfung auf Duplikate. Die Verwendung einer `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` ist hierfür eine moderne und performante Lösung. Die `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax wird für die Transformation der Hash-Tabelle in eine Standardtabelle verwendet.
keywords: Random, Unique, Internal Tables, Hashed Table, cl_abap_random_int, VALUE

Instructions: Verschieben Sie eine Zeichenkette dynamisch nach rechts, bis ein bestimmtes Zeichen am Anfang steht, oder um eine variable Anzahl von Positionen.

        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1

    METHODS shift_by_places
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einer Zeichenkette, indem Sie `SHIFT` in einer Schleife verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE` und `SHIFT` in einer `DO`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_remove_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_all_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_remove_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_all_spaces.
    rv_output = iv_input.
    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ' ' IN rv_output MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_output = |{ rv_output(lv_offset) }{ rv_output+lv_offset+1 }|.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine Produkt-ID, indem Sie führende 'P-' entfernen und die verbleibende Nummer auf 8 Stellen mit führenden Nullen auffüllen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT LEFT DELETING LEADING` mit String-Templates und `ALPHA` Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_product_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_product_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_id.
    DATA(lv_temp_id) = iv_raw_id.
    SHIFT lv_temp_id LEFT DELETING LEADING 'P-'.
    " Ensure it's numeric after shift, then use ALPHA conversion for leading zeros
    rv_formatted_id = |{ CONV alpha=>alpha_out( lv_temp_id ) ALPHA = IN }|.
    " The ALPHA conversion fills with leading zeros to the length of the data type.
    " If the target length is fixed (e.g., 8), we might need more control.
    " For a fixed length of 8, assuming lv_temp_id is numeric:
    rv_formatted_id = |{ lv_temp_id ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 8 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 10 zufälligen Flugdaten (SFLIGHT-CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE) für Testzwecke.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für numerische Felder und `cl_abap_random_char` (oder ähnliches) für Zeichenfelder, kombiniert mit `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_random_connid) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 9999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_day) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 28 ).
    DATA(lo_random_month) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 12 ).
    DATA(lo_random_year) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 2024 p_max = 2026 ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'SQ' ) ( 'DL' ) ).
    DATA(lo_random_carrier_idx) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = lines( lt_carriers ) ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_carrid_idx) = lo_random_carrier_idx->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_carriers INDEX lv_carrid_idx INTO DATA(lv_carrid).

      DATA(lv_connid) = lo_random_connid->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_day) = lo_random_day->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_month) = lo_random_month->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_year) = lo_random_year->get_next( ).

      DATA(lv_fldate_str) = |{ lv_year ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 4 }{ lv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 2 }{ lv_day ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 2 }|.
      DATA(lv_fldate) TYPE s_date.
      lv_fldate = lv_fldate_str.

      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight(
        carrid = lv_carrid
        connid = lv_connid
        fldate = lv_fldate
      ) TO rt_sflights.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Zeichenkette um eine bestimmte Anzahl von Positionen nach rechts verschiebt und dabei die am Ende herausfallenden Zeichen an den Anfang der Zeichenkette anfügt (zirkuläre Verschiebung nach rechts).
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und Offset/Length-Operationen, um die Zeichenkette in zwei Teile zu teilen und neu zusammenzusetzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_circular_right DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_circular_right
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_positions TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_circular_right IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_circular_right.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_input ).
    IF lv_length = 0.
      rv_output = ''.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_actual_shift) = iv_positions MOD lv_length.
    IF lv_actual_shift = 0.
      rv_output = iv_input.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_split_point) = lv_length - lv_actual_shift.
    rv_output = |{ iv_input+lv_split_point(lv_actual_shift) }{ iv_input(lv_split_point) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein sicheres, zufälliges Passwort mit einer bestimmten Länge, das Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit ASCII-Werten und String-Templates, um Zeichen zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    DATA(lv_char_type) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_char_code) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    DATA(lo_random_type) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 1 p_max = 3 ). " 1: digit, 2: lower, 3: upper
    DATA(lo_random_digit) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 48 p_max = 57 ). " ASCII 0-9
    DATA(lo_random_lower) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 97 p_max = 122 ). " ASCII a-z
    DATA(lo_random_upper) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 65 p_max = 90 ). " ASCII A-Z

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      lv_char_type = lo_random_type->get_next( ).
      CASE lv_char_type.
        WHEN 1.
          lv_char_code = lo_random_digit->get_next( ).
        WHEN 2.
          lv_char_code = lo_random_lower->get_next( ).
        WHEN 3.
          lv_char_code = lo_random_upper->get_next( ).
      ENDCASE.
      lv_char = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_by_encoding( 'UTF-8' )->convert_x_to_string( xstr = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_char_code ) ).
      rv_password = rv_password && lv_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens aus einer Zeichenkette, ohne `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` zu verwenden, sondern mit `SHIFT`.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Zeichenkette und verwenden Sie `SHIFT` in Kombination mit String-Templates, um das Zeichen zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_remove_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_char.
    DATA(lv_temp) = iv_input.
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i.

    DO.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_char IN lv_temp MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_result = lv_result && lv_temp(lv_offset).
        lv_temp = lv_temp+lv_offset+1.
      ELSE.
        lv_result = lv_result && lv_temp.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_output = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Anonymisieren Sie eine Liste von Kundennummern, indem Sie jede Nummer durch eine zufällige, aber eindeutige 8-stellige Nummer ersetzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Hash-Tabelle, um die Eindeutigkeit der generierten IDs zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_anonymize_customer_ids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_customer_id TYPE string,
           ty_t_customer_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_customer_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS anonymize_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_customer_ids TYPE ty_t_customer_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_anonymized_ids) TYPE ty_t_customer_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_anonymize_customer_ids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD anonymize_ids.
    DATA(lt_mapping) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_customer_id WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lo_random_id) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( p_min = 10000000 p_max = 99999999 ).

    LOOP AT it_customer_ids INTO DATA(lv_original_id).
      DATA(lv_anonymized_id) TYPE ty_customer_id.
      DO.
        DATA(lv_new_random) = lo_random_id->get_next( ).
        lv_anonymized_id = |{ lv_new_random ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' WIDTH = 8 }|.
        TRY.
            INSERT lv_anonymized_id INTO TABLE lt_mapping.
            EXIT.
          CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
            " Try again if duplicate
        ENDTRY.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND lv_anonymized_id TO rt_anonymized_ids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(

CLASS zcl_grp_avg_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_grp_having_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_tz_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_time_zone     TYPE timezone
      EXPORTING
        ev_local_date    TYPE d
        ev_local_time    TYPE t
      RAISING
        cx_xco_cp_time_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_tz_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_utc_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_time_zone) = xco_cp_time=>time_zone( iv_time_zone ).

    DATA(lo_local_date_time) = lo_timestamp->convert_to_time_zone( lo_time_zone ).

    ev_local_date = lo_local_date_time->date( )->value( ).
    ev_local_time = lo_local_date_time->time( )->value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_utc_to_local FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_tz_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_utc_ts) = '20250101100000.0000000'. " Jan 1, 2025, 10:00:00 UTC

    " CET is UTC+1 normally, UTC+2 during DST. For Jan 1, it's UTC+1.
    DATA(lv_local_date) TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_local_time) TYPE t.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local(
          EXPORTING
            iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_ts
            iv_time_zone     = 'CET'
          IMPORTING
            ev_local_date    = lv_local_date
            ev_local_time    = lv_local_time
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_date exp = '20250101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_time exp = '110000' ). " 10:00 UTC + 1 hour = 11:00 CET

        " Test another timezone, e.g., EST (UTC-5)
        lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local(
          EXPORTING
            iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_ts
            iv_time_zone     = 'EST'
          IMPORTING
            ev_local_date    = lv_local_date
            ev_local_time    = lv_local_time
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_date exp = '20250101' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_time exp = '050000' ). " 10:00 UTC - 5 hours = 05:00 EST

      CATCH cx_xco_cp_time_exception INTO DATA(lx_xco_time).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_xco_time->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum und sammeln Sie alle Verbindungs-IDs pro Gruppe in einer neuen internen Tabelle.

solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_collect_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES ty_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE ty_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_collect_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_connids.
    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid fldate = flight-fldate )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        fldate = flight-fldate
        connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ( member-connid ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe den Flug mit der höchsten Sitzplatzbelegung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` oder `MAX` um das Element mit dem höchsten Wert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_max_seats_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             highest_occ_flight TYPE ty_flight,
           END OF ty_result.
    TYPES ty_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_max_seats_flights) TYPE ty_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_max_seats_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    rt_max_seats_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        highest_occ_flight = REDUCE #( 
          INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_flight( seatsocc = -1 )
          FOR member IN GROUP
          WHERE ( member-seatsocc > max_flight-seatsocc )
          NEXT max_flight = member ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i(
      INIT product = 1
      FOR number IN it_numbers

CLASS zcl_xml_signature_verifier IMPLEMENTATION.

            certificate = iv_certificate
        ).
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT) nach einem bestimmten Zielort und bilden Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flugnummer und Preis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_destination
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_destination.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( cityto = iv_destination )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        price = ls_flight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Begrüßungsnachricht, die den Namen eines Benutzers und eine bedingte Begrüßung basierend auf der Tageszeit enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und den `COND`-Operator innerhalb des Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_greeting_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_time TYPE tims
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_greeting.
    DATA(lv_time_int) = iv_time.

    rv_greeting = |Hallo { iv_name }, { COND string(
      WHEN lv_time_int >= '060000' AND lv_time_int < '120000' THEN 'Guten Morgen!'
      WHEN lv_time_int >= '120000' AND lv_time_int < '180000' THEN 'Guten Tag!'
      WHEN lv_time_int >= '180000' AND lv_time_int < '220000' THEN 'Guten Abend!'
      ELSE 'Gute Nacht!'
    ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle mittels Tabellenausdruck. Falls der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, soll ein vordefinierter Standardwert zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ key = value ] OPTIONAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_value_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_id   TYPE i
        iv_default_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_by_id.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_data[ id = iv_id ]-value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_value = iv_default_value.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über Schlüssel. In Kombination mit einem `TRY...CATCH` Block für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` kann elegant auf nicht gefundene Einträge reagiert und ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden, was den Code robuster macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Beispiel für eine Fluent Interface, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt verketten.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden so, dass sie `ME->` zurückgeben, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = |{ mv_value1 } - { mv_value2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_value1( 'Hello' )->set_value2( 'World' )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello - World' msg = 'Fluent interface chaining failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, auch bekannt als Fluent Interface, verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe an einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME->`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen, um nur die geraden Zahlen zu erhalten, unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_number_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER tt_numbers(
      it_all_numbers WHERE ( ( ipow( base = 2 exp = 0 ) = 0 ) ) " Placeholder for actual modulo logic
    ).
    " Correct logic for even numbers:
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER tt_numbers(
      it_all_numbers WHERE ( ( table_line MOD 2 ) = 0 )
    ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_even.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_number_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_number_filter=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_even_numbers( lt_numbers ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktion `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik mit `sy-datum`.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birthdate TYPE d
        iv_current_date TYPE d DEFAULT sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_years_diff) = iv_current_date-iv_birthdate / 365.
    rv_age = trunc( lv_years_diff ).

    " More precise calculation considering month/day
    IF iv_current_date < iv_birthdate.
      rv_age = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_age_in_years) = iv_current_date(4) - iv_birthdate(4).
    IF iv_current_date(6) < iv_birthdate(6).
      lv_age_in_years = lv_age_in_years - 1.
    ENDIF.
    rv_age = lv_age_in_years.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` mit Typ-Referenz und `CASE` oder `COND` im Factory-Methoden-Body.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.1415926535'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_shape
      IMPORTING
        iv_shape_type TYPE string
        iv_param1     TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
        iv_param2     TYPE decfloat16 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_shape) TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_shape.
    CASE iv_shape_type.
      WHEN 'CIRCLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = iv_param1 ).
      WHEN 'RECTANGLE'.
        ro_shape = NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = iv_param1 iv_width = iv_param2 ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Shape-Typ: { iv_shape_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings und konvertieren Sie den String in Großbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die String-Funktionen `condense`, `to_upper` und `replace` oder `find` mit `replace`.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_and_upper_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_and_upper_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and condense multiple spaces to single
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string.

    " Convert to upper case
    TRANSLATE lv_temp_string TO UPPER CASE.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_clean_and_upper.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = `  hello   world  abap   `.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_and_and_upper_string( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELLO WORLD ABAP' msg = 'Cleaning and upper casing failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_and_upper_string( lv_input ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Funktionen `CONDENSE` und `TRANSLATE ... TO UPPER CASE` sind klassische ABAP-Befehle, die auch in modernen Kontexten nützlich sind. `CONDENSE` entfernt führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und reduziert interne Leerzeichen auf ein einzelnes. `TRANSLATE` ist effizient für die Groß-/Kleinschreibung. In Kombination bieten sie eine einfache Lösung für die String-Bereinigung.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        total_flights = GROUP SIZE,
        avg_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum_price = 0.0
               count = 0
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price,
               count = count + 1
          FINALLY
            IF count > 0 THEN sum_price / count ELSE 0.0 ENDIF
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 msg = 'Expected grouped flights' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_flights exp = 2 msg = 'Total flights for AA incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-avg_price exp = '400.00' msg = 'Avg price for AA incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    " This test is harder to implement without mocking SFLIGHT or having a test fixture.
    " For simplicity, we'll assume SFLIGHT always has data for this example.
    " A more robust test would involve clearing SFLIGHT or using a test double.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).
    " If SFLIGHT is empty, the result should be empty.
    " As SFLIGHT is usually not empty, we assert it's not empty.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'SFLIGHT is expected to have data for this test' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife können komplexe Aggregationen wie die Berechnung von Summen und Durchschnitten sehr effizient und lesbar durchgeführt werden.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

    rv_latin1_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String und fangen Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler ab, z.B. wenn Zeichen in der Ziel-Codepage nicht darstellbar sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION` um Fehler abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cp_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_string TYPE string
        iv_target_cp     TYPE cpic_cp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cp_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lv_system_cp) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ).

    TRY.
        rv_converted_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
          text = iv_source_string
          encoding = lv_system_cp
          target_encoding = iv_target_cp
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Log error or re-raise with more context
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_codepage_conversion(
          text = |Codepage conversion failed: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_conversion EXPECTING CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cp_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_expected_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_unicode_to_codepage(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_input
        codepage    = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( )
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_expected_xstring
    ).

    DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_source_string = lv_input
      iv_target_cp     = lv_target_cp
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_xstring exp = lv_expected_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cp_error_handling( ).
    " A character not representable in a simple codepage like 1100 (Latin-1)
    DATA(lv_input) = '€uro'. " Euro symbol is not in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = '1100'. " ISO-8859-1

    lo_cut->convert_with_error_handling(
      iv_source_string = lv_input
      iv_target_cp     = lv_target_cp
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt, wie man mit der Ausnahme `CX_SY_CODEPAGE_CONVERSION` umgeht, die auftritt, wenn Zeichen während der Codepage-Konvertierung nicht abgebildet werden können. Dies ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen, die mit verschiedenen Zeichensätzen arbeiten.
keywords: Codepage, error handling, cx_sy_codepage_conversion, cl_abap_codepage, try-catch

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT` Daten) in ein XSTRING und dekomprimiere ihn zurück. Verwenden Sie JSON für die Serialisierung.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst mit `CL_ABAP_JSON=>SERIALIZE` in einen String, konvertieren Sie diesen in ein XSTRING und verwenden Sie dann `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_XSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_decompressed_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json=>serialize( it_data ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_from_json) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_json_string ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_from_json ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_decompressed_json) = cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_in( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).
    cl_abap_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_decompressed_json IMPORTING r_result = rt_decompressed_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_compress_decompress_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_decompress_table.
    DATA: lt_original_data TYPE zcl_gzip_compress_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_original_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_original_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_compress_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_decompressed_data[ 2 ]-price,
      exp = lt_original_data[ 2 ]-price,
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile PRICE sollte übereinstimmen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man strukturierte Daten (interne Tabelle) komprimiert. Zuerst wird die Tabelle in einen JSON-String serialisiert, dann in ein XSTRING umgewandelt und schließlich mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_XSTRING` komprimiert. Die Dekomprimierung erfolgt in umgekehrter Reihenfolge. Dies ist nützlich für die Speicherung oder Übertragung großer Datenmengen.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_invalid_xstring.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( iv_invalid_xstring ).
        rv_error_message = 'Keine Ausnahme ausgelöst, obwohl erwartet.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error INTO DATA(lx_compression_error).
