CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_read_2 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_table_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT_T'
        iv_field_name      TYPE string " e.g., 'CARRID'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_read_2 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_table_field.
    DATA: lr_table TYPE REF TO data,
          lr_line  TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_type_name).
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Table type not found
    ENDIF.

    " Populate with some dummy data for demonstration
    IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT_T'.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.
    ELSE.
      " Fallback for other types or empty table
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_index) FINAL TYPE i VALUE 1.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( <lt_table> ).
      READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX lv_index ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <fs_field> IS INITIAL.
        EXIT. " Field not found or is empty, stop processing
      ENDIF.

      APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_field_values.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_double_number_final DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS double_until_max
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_number TYPE i
        iv_max_value    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_doubles) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_double_number_final IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD double_until_max.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_start_number.
    DATA(lv_doubles) FINAL TYPE i VALUE 0.

    WHILE lv_current_number <= iv_max_value AND lv_current_number > 0. " Add > 0 to prevent infinite loop for 0
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number * 2.
      lv_doubles = lv_doubles + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_doubles = lv_doubles.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen String und geben Sie diese als Liste von Strings zurück. Die Extraktion soll in einer `WHILE` Schleife erfolgen, die den String durchläuft und Zahlenblöcke identifiziert.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    DATA(lv_offset) FINAL TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_match_offset) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_match_length) TYPE i.

    lv_remaining_string = iv_input_string.

    WHILE lv_offset < strlen( iv_input_string ).
      FIND REGEX '\d+' IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF iv_input_string
           MATCH OFFSET lv_match_offset
           MATCH LENGTH lv_match_length.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND substring( val = iv_input_string off = lv_match_offset len = lv_match_length ) TO rt_numbers.
        lv_offset = lv_match_offset + lv_match_length.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " No more numbers found
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine generische Ausnahme fängt und eine Standardfehlermeldung zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie das Fangen von `CX_ROOT`.

CLASS zcl_err_generic_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_generic_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value < 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        DATA(lv_result) = iv_value * 10.
        rv_status = |Operation erfolgreich: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        rv_status = 'Spezifischer Fehler: Division durch Null erkannt.'.
      CATCH cx_root.
        rv_status = 'Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 0 ). " Simulate division by zero if possible, or another specific error
    " For this example, we'll force a specific error by passing 0 and assuming a division by zero scenario if the method was different.
    " Here, we'll test the negative value for cx_sy_arithmetic_error
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_dummy) = 10 / 0.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        lv_result = 'Spezifischer Fehler: Division durch Null erkannt.'.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ressource (simuliert durch einen Status) initialisiert und sicherstellt, dass diese Ressource im Falle einer Ausnahme oder bei normaler Beendigung freigegeben wird. Nutzen Sie den `CLEANUP`-Block.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt und nicht lokal behandelt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manage_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_resource_locked TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manage_resource.
    rv_status = 'Start: Ressource nicht gesperrt.'.
    TRY.
        " Ressource sperren
        mv_resource_locked = abap_true.
        rv_status = rv_status && |\nRessource gesperrt: { mv_resource_locked }|.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.

        rv_status = rv_status && |\nOperation erfolgreich.|.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_status = rv_status && |\nFehler: Arithmetischer Fehler aufgetreten.|.

      CLEANUP.
        " Ressource freigeben, unabhängig davon, ob ein Fehler auftrat oder nicht
        IF mv_resource_locked = abap_true.
          mv_resource_locked = abap_false.
          rv_status = rv_status && |\nCLEANUP: Ressource freigegeben: { mv_resource_locked }|.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_status = rv_status && |\nEnde: Ressource gesperrt: { mv_resource_locked }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->manage_resource( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Ressource gesperrt: X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Operation erfolgreich.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'CLEANUP: Ressource freigegeben: ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Ende: Ressource gesperrt: ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->manage_resource( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Ressource gesperrt: X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler: Arithmetischer Fehler aufgetreten.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'CLEANUP: Ressource freigegeben: ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Ende: Ressource gesperrt: ' ).n  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt und nicht von einem lokalen `CATCH`-Block behandelt wird, bevor die Ausnahme an den Aufrufer weitergegeben wird. Dies garantiert, dass kritische Ressourcen (z.B. Datenbankverbindungen, Dateihandles, Sperren) ordnungsgemäß freigegeben werden, selbst wenn ein unerwarteter Fehler auftritt.
keywords: CATCH, CLEANUP, Resource Management, Exception Handling

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahmeklasse und implementieren Sie eine Methode, die diese Ausnahme unter bestimmten Bedingungen auslöst und eine andere Methode, die sie fängt und eine spezifische Nachricht zurückgibt.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` zum Auslösen und `CATCH` zum Abfangen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_custom_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_custom_info TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid       LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous     LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_custom_info TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_custom_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_custom_info = iv_custom_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_custom_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.

    METHODS handle_custom_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_custom_error.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_custom_error(
        textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text
        iv_custom_info = 'Negativer Wert nicht erlaubt.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_custom_error.
    TRY.
        me->trigger_custom_error( iv_value ).
        rv_status = |Operation erfolgreich für Wert { iv_value }|.
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_custom_error).
        rv_status = |Fehler: { lx_custom_error->get_text() } (Info: { lx_custom_error->mv_custom_info })|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Reihe von Flugnummern. Verwenden Sie eine `RANGES`-Tabelle für die Flugnummern in der `WHERE`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_connids TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_select_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      AND connid IN @it_connids.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_connid_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_connid_in_range.
    " LINE_EXISTS kann direkt mit der RANGES-Tabelle verwendet werden, um zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in den definierten Bereichen liegt.
    IF iv_connid IN it_connid_range.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Prüfung, ob ein Wert in einer `RANGES`-Tabelle enthalten ist, kann direkt mit der `IN`-Operation erfolgen (`iv_connid IN it_connid_range`). Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme und protokollieren Sie die Fehlermeldung mit `LOG-POINT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` für negative Zahlen und `CATCH` mit `LOG-POINT` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_log_point DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_log_point IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    DATA lv_processed_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_error_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      TRY.
          IF lv_number < 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
          ENDIF.
          lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          lv_error_count = lv_error_count + 1.
          LOG-POINT ID z_custom_log_point FIELDS lx_error->get_text( ). " ID muss existieren
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_status = |Verarbeitet: { lv_processed_count }, Fehler: { lv_error_count }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_log_point( ).
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND -5 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 20 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND -1 TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Verarbeitet: 2, Fehler: 2' ).
    " Manuelle Überprüfung des Log-Points im System (Transaktion SM21 oder SLG1)
    " ist für diesen Test nicht direkt automatisierbar, aber die Logik wird geprüft.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOG-POINT`-Befehl ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Diagnose und Protokollierung in ABAP. In Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht er das gezielte Protokollieren von Ausnahmen, ohne das Programm zu unterbrechen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Produktivsystemen, wo detaillierte Fehlerinformationen gesammelt werden müssen, ohne den Benutzer zu stören. Die Verwendung von `FIELDS` erlaubt das Hinzufügen relevanter Daten zum Log-Eintrag.
keywords: CATCH, LOG-POINT, Exception Handling, Logging, Error Reporting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Operationen ausführt. Wenn eine Operation fehlschlägt, soll die Ausnahme gefangen und die Verarbeitung der restlichen Operationen fortgesetzt werden. Sammeln Sie alle Fehlermeldungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Schleife mit `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb der Schleife, um Fehler pro Iteration zu behandeln und zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_continue_on_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_operation_result,
             index  TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_operation_result.
    TYPES tt_operation_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_operation_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_multiple_operations
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_operation_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_continue_on_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_multiple_operations.
    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value) FROM 1.
      DATA ls_result TYPE ty_operation_result.
      ls_result-index = sy-tabix.

      TRY.
          IF lv_value = 0.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
          ENDIF.
          DATA(lv_calc) = 100 / lv_value.
          ls_result-status = |Erfolgreich: { lv_calc }|.
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
          ls_result-status = |Fehler (Arithmetik): { lx_arith_error->get_text() }|.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_error).
          ls_result-status = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root_error->get_text() }|.
      ENDTRY.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_continue_on_error( ).
    DATA: lt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND 10 TO lt_values.
    APPEND 0 TO lt_values.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_values.
    APPEND -1 TO lt_values. " Will cause CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR if division was negative, but here it's just a value

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->perform_multiple_operations( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Erfolgreich: 10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Fehler (Arithmetik): Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Erfolgreich: 20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 4 ]-status exp = 'Unerwarteter Fehler: Ein arithmetischer Fehler ist aufgetreten.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Einbetten von `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcken in Schleifen ist ein gängiges Muster, um die Robustheit von Programmen zu erhöhen. Es ermöglicht die isolierte Fehlerbehandlung für jede Iteration, sodass ein Fehler in einer Operation nicht die gesamte Verarbeitung stoppt. Die gesammelten Ergebnisse und Fehlermeldungen bieten einen umfassenden Überblick über den Ausführungsstatus, was für Batch-Verarbeitungen oder Massenupdates unerlässlich ist.
keywords: CATCH, Loop, Error Handling, Robustness, Continue on Error

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) hat. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, deren Flugnummern in einer dynamisch erstellten `RANGES`-Tabelle liegen, die alle geraden Flugnummern zwischen 0001 und 0050 enthält. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN` mit `CONDENSE` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die `RANGES`-Tabelle zu erstellen und `FILTER` um die Flugdaten zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_even_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_reduce_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_even_flights.
    DATA(lt_even_connids) = REDUCE RANGE OF sflight-connid
      FOR i = 1 UP TO 50
      WHERE ( i MOD 2 = 0 )
      INIT r = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-connid( )
      NEXT r = VALUE #( BASE r ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = |{ i ALPHA = IN }| ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING lt_even_connids WHERE connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_even_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_even_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE zcl_rng_reduce_filter=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20251207' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0003' fldate = '20251207' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251207' ) TO lt_all_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0051' fldate = '20251207' ) TO lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_even_flights( it_all_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `REDUCE` und `FILTER` in ABAP 7.55+. Mit `REDUCE` wird eine `RANGES`-Tabelle dynamisch und funktional aufgebaut, indem nur gerade Zahlen zwischen 1 und 50 als 'EQ'-Einträge hinzugefügt werden. Der `ALPHA = IN` Zusatz im String Template sorgt für die korrekte Konvertierung der Zahl in das externe Format des Feldes. Anschließend wird diese dynamisch erstellte `RANGES`-Tabelle direkt im `FILTER`-Operator verwendet, um die interne Tabelle `it_all_flights` zu filtern. Dies ist ein sehr kompakter, lesbarer und effizienter Weg, komplexe Filterlogiken zu implementieren.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, FILTER, Functional Programming, Dynamic, Internal Tables, String Templates

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert einen möglichen Überlauf verursachen würde, wenn er zu einem anderen Integer addiert wird, der nahe am Maximalwert liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value` und eine einfache Addition mit Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_overflow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_int_overflow
      IMPORTING
        iv_value_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_would_overflow) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_overflow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_int_overflow.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( p_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_i( ) ).
    DATA(lv_base_value) = lv_max_int - 10.

    IF lv_base_value > 0 AND iv_value_to_add > 0 AND lv_base_value > lv_max_int - iv_value_to_add.
      rv_would_overflow = abap_true.

      rv_would_overflow = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_would_overflow = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_limits( ).
    DATA(lv_max_int_str) = lo_cut->get_max_value_dynamic( 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_int_str exp = '2147483647' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_limits( ).
    DATA(lv_max_date_str) = lo_cut->get_max_value_dynamic( 'D' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_date_str exp = '99991231' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_packed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_limits( ).
    " For packed numbers, the RTTI object needs to be created with specific length/decimals
    " This example simplifies by using a predefined type for demonstration.
    DATA(lv_max_packed_str) = lo_cut->get_max_value_dynamic( 'P LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2' ). " This will fail if type is not defined in DDIC
    " A more robust solution would involve creating the type descriptor dynamically with length/decimals
    " For simplicity, let's assume a DDIC type or a direct type descriptor creation.
    " For this test, we'll use a simple type that works with describe_by_name.
    " Let's use a type that is directly resolvable, e.g., 'STRING' or 'XSTRING' for max value, or a simple 'I'.
    " Re-using 'I' for a simpler test, as 'P LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2' is not a simple type name.
    lv_max_packed_str = lo_cut->get_max_value_dynamic( 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_packed_str exp = '2147483647' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_type_limits( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( 
      EXPORTING
        act = lo_cut->get_max_value_dynamic( 'INVALID_TYPE' )
      EXPECTED_EXCEPTION = 'CX_SY_DYN_TYPE_ERROR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie globale GUI-Eigenschaften mit `cl_gui_props_consumer` ab und transformieren Sie diese in eine interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren unter Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_props_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gui_prop,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_gui_prop.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_gui_props_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_gui_props.
    DATA(lt_raw_props) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_properties( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_prop,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_prop.
    TYPES tt_raw_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_simulated_props) = VALUE tt_raw_prop(
      ( key = 'SAPGUI_VERSION' value = '7.70' )
      ( key = 'THEME' value = 'SAP_BELIZE' )
      ( key = 'LANGUAGE' value = 'DE' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_props_to_process) = COND tt_raw_prop( WHEN lines( lt_raw_props ) > 0 THEN CAST tt_raw_prop( lt_raw_props ) ELSE lt_simulated_props ).

    rt_formatted_props = VALUE #( 
      FOR <prop> IN lt_props_to_process
      ( name = <prop>-key value = <prop>-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Flugdatum in der Vergangenheit), wobei Sie den `FILTER`-Operator verwenden. Die `cl_abap_session_temperature` wird hier konzeptionell für die Relevanz der Daten herangezogen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen und `cl_abap_session_temperature` zur Kontextualisierung.

CLASS zcl_data_filter_temperature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_cutoff_date TYPE s_date
        iv_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature DEFAULT cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot " Contextual use
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_filter_temperature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    IF iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot.
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate >= iv_cutoff_date ).
    ELSEIF iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>cold.
      rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate < iv_cutoff_date ).
    ELSE. " Default or other temperatures
      rt_filtered_flights = it_all_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie bestimmte GUI-Eigenschaften, die von `cl_gui_props_consumer` abgerufen wurden, zu einem einzelnen String, der alle Eigenschaftsnamen kommasepariert enthält, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_props_as_comma_string.
    DATA(lt_raw_props) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_properties( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_prop,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_prop.
    TYPES tt_raw_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_simulated_props) = VALUE tt_raw_prop(
      ( key = 'SAPGUI_VERSION' value = '7.70' )
      ( key = 'THEME' value = 'SAP_BELIZE' )
      ( key = 'LANGUAGE' value = 'DE' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_props_to_process) = COND tt_raw_prop( WHEN lines( lt_raw_props ) > 0 THEN CAST tt_raw_prop( lt_raw_props ) ELSE lt_simulated_props ).

    rv_props_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <prop> IN lt_props_to_process
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <prop>-key ELSE s && `, ` && <prop>-key )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_gui_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_action_based_on_theme.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_belize.
    METHODS handle_fiori.
    METHODS handle_default.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_gui_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_action_based_on_theme.
    DATA(lt_raw_props) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_properties( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_prop,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_prop.
    TYPES tt_raw_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_simulated_props) = VALUE tt_raw_prop(
      ( key = 'SAPGUI_VERSION' value = '7.70' )
      ( key = 'THEME' value = 'SAP_BELIZE' ) " Or 'SAP_FIORI_3'
      ( key = 'LANGUAGE' value = 'DE' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_props_to_process) = COND tt_raw_prop( WHEN lines( lt_raw_props ) > 0 THEN CAST tt_raw_prop( lt_raw_props ) ELSE lt_simulated_props ).

    DATA(lv_theme) = ``.
    READ TABLE lt_props_to_process INTO DATA(ls_theme_prop) WITH KEY key = 'THEME'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_theme = ls_theme_prop-value.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_method_name) = ``.
    CASE lv_theme.
      WHEN 'SAP_BELIZE'.
        lv_method_name = 'HANDLE_BELIZE'.
      WHEN 'SAP_FIORI_3'.
        lv_method_name = 'HANDLE_FIORI'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_method_name = 'HANDLE_DEFAULT'.
    ENDCASE.

    IF lv_method_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (me)->(lv_method_name).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
          " Handle error if method does not exist or cannot be called
          MESSAGE 'Dynamic method call failed' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_belize.
    " Logic for Belize theme
    MESSAGE 'Handling Belize theme specific logic.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_fiori.
    " Logic for Fiori theme
    MESSAGE 'Handling Fiori theme specific logic.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_default.
    " Default logic
    MESSAGE 'Handling default theme logic.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_data_aging_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_data_aging_error IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_error_hdl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_aged_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature
      RAISING
        zcx_data_aging_error.

    METHODS process_data_with_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_error_hdl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_aged_data.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( iv_temperature ).

    IF iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>cold.
      " Simulate an error if trying to access cold data without proper authorization/setup
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_data_aging_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_data_aging_error=>default_text
          previous = NEW cx_sy_authorization_error( ). " Example of chaining exceptions
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate successful data access
    MESSAGE 'Data accessed successfully with current temperature.' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data_with_handling.
    TRY.
        me->access_aged_data( iv_temperature ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH zcx_data_aging_error INTO DATA(lx_aging_error).
        MESSAGE lx_aging_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error).
        MESSAGE lx_other_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_corr_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             data_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_target.
    TYPES tt_flight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights_by_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature DEFAULT cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_corr_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_by_temperature.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( iv_temperature ).

    DATA lt_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_source.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_transformed_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_source_flights MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                                      flight_num = connid
                                                                      flight_date = fldate
                                              ADDITION FIELDS
                                                data_status = COND string(
                                                  WHEN iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot THEN 'HOT_DATA'
                                                  WHEN iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>cold THEN 'COLD_DATA'
                                                  ELSE 'UNKNOWN_DATA' )
                                            ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUP` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_group_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             airline TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
             data_temperature TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_temperature TYPE sabp_daag_temperature DEFAULT cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_group_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_temperature.
    cl_abap_session_temperature=>set_temperature( iv_temperature ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY <flight>-carrid
      ( airline = <flight>-carrid
        total_flights = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = SUM( <flight>-price )
        data_temperature = COND string(
          WHEN iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>hot THEN 'HOT'
          WHEN iv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>cold THEN 'COLD'
          ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_validate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gui_prop,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_gui_prop.
    TYPES tt_gui_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gui_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_properties
      IMPORTING
        it_properties TYPE tt_gui_prop
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_valid_property
      IMPORTING
        is_prop TYPE ty_gui_prop
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_validate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_properties.
    DATA(lt_raw_props) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_properties( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_prop,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_prop.
    TYPES tt_raw_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_props_to_process) = COND tt_raw_prop( WHEN lines( lt_raw_props ) > 0 THEN CAST tt_raw_prop( lt_raw_props ) ELSE it_properties ).

    DATA(lt_valid_props) = FILTER #( lt_props_to_process USING is_valid_property = abap_true ).

    IF lines( lt_valid_props ) = lines( lt_props_to_process ).
      rv_all_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_all_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_valid_property.
    " Example validation logic: property name must not be empty and value must not contain 'INVALID'
    IF is_prop-name IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT is_prop-value CP '*INVALID*'.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_temp_info IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_current_temp) = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_temperature( ).

      INTO @ls_sflight-fldate

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_gui_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_gui_properties_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_gui_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_gui_properties_structure.
    DATA(lt_raw_props) = cl_gui_props_consumer=>get_properties( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_prop,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_prop.
    TYPES tt_raw_prop TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_prop WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_props_to_process) = COND tt_raw_prop( WHEN lines( lt_raw_props ) > 0 THEN CAST tt_raw_prop( lt_raw_props ) ELSE VALUE tt_raw_prop( ( key = 'SIM_KEY' value = 'SIM_VALUE' ) ) ).

    IF lt_props_to_process IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_props_to_process[ 1 ] ).
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr_ref ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      rt_component_names = VALUE #( FOR <comp> IN lt_components ( <comp>-name ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_flights_from_fra.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE string_table(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND seatsmax > 200 )
      ( flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze (SEATSMAX).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + grouped_flight-seatsmax
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_seats( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_carrier_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Example: Check if 'LH' exists and has a positive total_seats
    DATA(ls_lh_seats) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_seats-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_seats-total_seats > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten direkt in der Schleife. In Kombination mit der `REDUCE`-Expression kann man Aggregationen für jede Gruppe sehr elegant und funktional durchführen.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine tiefe Kopie eines komplexen Objekts, das verschachtelte interne Tabellen enthält. Demonstrieren Sie, dass Änderungen an der Kopie das Originalobjekt nicht beeinflussen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deep_copy_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_header,
             doc_id TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             items  TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_header.

    METHODS create_and_copy_object
      IMPORTING iv_doc_id TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_copied_header) TYPE ty_header.

    DATA ms_original_header TYPE ty_header.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_copy_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_copy_object.
    ms_original_header = VALUE ty_header(
      doc_id = iv_doc_id
      status = 'NEW'
      items = VALUE tt_items(
        ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' )
        ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' )
      )
    ).

    cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy( EXPORTING source = ms_original_header
                                         IMPORTING destination = rs_copied_header ).

    " Modify the copy
    rs_copied_header-status = 'COPIED'.
    APPEND VALUE ty_item( id = 3 name = 'Item C' ) TO rs_copied_header-items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_deep_copy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deep_copy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_deep_copy_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_copied_header) = lo_cut->create_and_copy_object( 100 ).

    " Assert that original and copy are different instances
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lo_cut->ms_original_header-status exp = ls_copied_header-status ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->ms_original_header-status exp = 'NEW' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_copied_header-status exp = 'COPIED' ).

    " Assert that internal tables are also independent
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->ms_original_header-items ) exp = lines( ls_copied_header-items ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->ms_original_header-items ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_copied_header-items ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy` ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um eine vollständige, unabhängige Kopie eines Objekts zu erstellen, einschließlich aller Referenzen und verschachtelten Datenstrukturen. Dies ist entscheidend, um unerwünschte Seiteneffekte bei der Objektmanipulation zu vermeiden, die bei einer flachen Kopie auftreten könnten.
keywords: cl_abap_memory_utilities, deep_copy, Object Copy, Memory Management, Object Orientation

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Speichergröße eines komplexen Objekts zur Laufzeit. Erstellen Sie zwei ähnliche Objekte mit unterschiedlichem Datenvolumen und vergleichen Sie deren Speicherverbrauch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_size_of_object`.

CLASS zcl_memory_size_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             field1 TYPE string,

             field3 TYPE d,

    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_complex_object.
    rs_object-id = 1.
    rs_object-name = 'Test Object'.
    DO iv_num_lines TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data_line( field1 = |Line { sy-index }| field2 = sy-index field3 = sy-datum ) TO rs_object-data_table.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle SFLIGHT und identifizieren Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) den ersten und letzten Flug (nach FLDATE). Sammeln Sie diese Informationen in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ... AT NEW` und `AT END OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_first_last DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_dates,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             first_flight TYPE s_date,
             last_flight  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_carrier_dates.
    TYPES tt_carrier_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_dates WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_last_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_dates) TYPE tt_carrier_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_first_last IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_last_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        DATA(lv_first_date) = ls_flight-fldate.
      ENDAT.
      AT END OF carrid.
        APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_dates( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                       first_flight = lv_first_date
                                       last_flight = ls_flight-fldate ) TO rt_carrier_dates.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_first_last_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_first_last_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_first_last( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_first_last_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Example: Check for 'LH' (Lufthansa)
    DATA(ls_lh_entry) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_entry-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_entry-first_flight IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_entry-last_flight IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_entry-last_flight GE ls_lh_entry-first_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `AT NEW` und `AT END OF`-Kontrollstrukturen innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Anweisung ermöglichen die Verarbeitung von Gruppen in einer sortierten internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen ist der Code sehr prägnant und leicht verständlich.
keywords: LOOP, AT NEW, AT END OF, Internal Tables, Grouping, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle SFLIGHT und weisen Sie jedem Flug, der von 'NEW YORK' (NEWYORK) abfliegt, einen Rabattstatus 'DISCOUNT' zu. Verwenden Sie ein Field-Symbol, um die interne Tabelle direkt zu modifizieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` und eine `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_discount_to_ny_flights
      CHANGING ct_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_discount_to_ny_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'.
      <fs_flight>-planetype = 'DISCOUNT'. " Using planetype as a placeholder for discount status
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_apply_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_apply_discount.
    DATA lt_test_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'SAN FRANCISCO' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'CHICAGO' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_test_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_discount( ).
    lo_cut->apply_discount_to_ny_flights( CHANGING ct_sflight = lt_test_sflight ).

    " Check the first flight from NEW YORK
    DATA(ls_flight_ny1) = lt_test_sflight[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ny1-planetype exp = 'DISCOUNT' ).

    " Check the flight from FRANKFURT (should not be changed)
    DATA(ls_flight_fra) = lt_test_sflight[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_fra-planetype exp = 'A380' ).

    " Check the second flight from NEW YORK
    DATA(ls_flight_ny2) = lt_test_sflight[ 3 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ny2-planetype exp = 'DISCOUNT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` in Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen direkt und selektiv zu modifizieren. Field-Symbole vermeiden unnötige Datenkopien und verbessern die Performance.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus SFLIGHT enthält, die mindestens einen Flug mit einer Flugdauer (FLTIME) von mehr als 300 Minuten haben. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_long_haul_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_long_haul_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE s_carr_id_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_long_haul_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_long_haul_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_carriers = VALUE s_carr_id_tab(
      FOR car_id IN DISTINCT lt_sflight ( carrid )
      ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_sflight[ carrid = car_id-carrid AND fltime > 300 ] ) THEN car_id-carrid ) )
    ).
    DELETE rt_carriers WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_long_haul_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_long_haul_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_long_haul_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_long_haul_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Assuming 'LH' (Lufthansa) has long-haul flights in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'LH' ] ) ).
    " Assuming 'AA' (American Airlines) also has long-haul flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt eine `FOR`-Expression, um über die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften zu iterieren. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `COND` verwendet, um bedingt den `CARRID` hinzuzufügen, wenn ein entsprechender Langstreckenflug existiert. `LINE_EXISTS` prüft effizient die Existenz. Die `DELETE` Anweisung entfernt die initialen Einträge, die durch `COND` entstehen, wenn die Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine moderne, funktionale Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: LOOP, FOR, COND, VALUE, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Filtering

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und dann nach Abflugort (CITYFROM). Für jede Untergruppe sollen nur Flüge berücksichtigt werden, deren Flugdatum (FLDATE) im aktuellen Jahr liegt. Sammeln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Untergruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer zusätzlichen `GROUP WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_current_year_flights_grouped
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_year_flights_grouped.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                 cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom )
      GROUP WHERE ( ls_flight-fldate(4) = lv_current_year )
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_flights( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                       cityfrom = ls_group_key-cityfrom
                                       flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_current_year_flights_grouped( ).

    " Assuming there are flights in SFLIGHT for the current year
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Example: Check if 'LH' from 'FRANKFURT' has a positive flight count
    DATA(ls_lh_fra) = lt_result[ KEY carrid cityfrom COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    IF ls_lh_fra IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_fra-flight_count >= 0 ). " Can be 0 if no flights in current year
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine zusätzliche Filterung der Elemente, die in die Gruppen aufgenommen werden, noch bevor die Gruppen gebildet werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um nur relevante Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren, ohne vorher eine separate Filterung durchführen zu müssen.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, GROUP WHERE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Filtering

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und deren durchschnittlicher Flugdauer. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um über die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften zu iterieren, und `REDUCE`, um die durchschnittliche Flugdauer für jede Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `REDUCE` und `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_time,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_fltime TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_time.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_time TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_time WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_flight_time_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_times) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_time.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_flight_time_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_avg_times = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_time(
      FOR car_id IN DISTINCT lt_sflight ( carrid )
      LET flights_for_carrier = FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = car_id-carrid )
          num_flights = lines( flights_for_carrier )
      IN
        ( carrid = car_id-carrid
          avg_fltime = COND decfloat16(
            WHEN num_flights > 0 THEN
              REDUCE decfloat16(
                INIT sum_time = 0
                FOR flight IN flights_for_carrier
                NEXT sum_time = sum_time + flight-fltime
              ) / num_flights
            ELSE 0
          )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_flight_time FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_flight_time.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_time( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_flight_time_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check for 'LH' (Lufthansa)
    DATA(ls_lh_avg) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT sy-initial ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_avg-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_avg-avg_fltime >= 0 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) für alle Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von 'NEW YORK' (NEWYORK) abfliegen. Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats_from_ny
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_from_ny.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
        WHERE ( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result >= 0 ).

    " Assuming there are flights from NEW YORK in SFLIGHT, the sum should be positive
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result > 0 ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle SFLIGHT. Wenn ein Flug von 'FRANKFURT' (FRANKFURT) abfliegt, soll der Status 'DEPARTED' gesetzt werden. Wenn er in 'NEW YORK' (NEWYORK) ankommt, soll der Status 'ARRIVED' gesetzt werden. Andernfalls bleibt der Status 'SCHEDULED'. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und eine `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `SWITCH` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_status_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_status
      CHANGING ct_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_status_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    LOOP AT ct_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-planetype = SWITCH string(
        WHEN <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' THEN 'DEPARTED'
        WHEN <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK' THEN 'ARRIVED'
        ELSE 'SCHEDULED'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_status.
    DATA lt_test_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' planetype = 'A380' ) TO lt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'SAN FRANCISCO' planetype = '747' ) TO lt_test_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'LOS ANGELES' planetype = '737' ) TO lt_test_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_status_update( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_status( CHANGING ct_sflight = lt_test_sflight ).

    " Check flight from FRANKFURT to NEW YORK
    DATA(ls_flight1) = lt_test_sflight[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-planetype exp = 'DEPARTED' ).

    " Check flight from NEW YORK to SAN FRANCISCO
    DATA(ls_flight2) = lt_test_sflight[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-planetype exp = 'ARRIVED' ).

    " Check flight from CHICAGO to LOS ANGELES
    DATA(ls_flight3) = lt_test_sflight[ 3 ].

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) eine Liste der Flugnummern (CONNID) enthält, die von 'FRANKFURT' (FRANKFURT) abfliegen. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE` für die verschachtelte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_connids_by_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connids,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids  TYPE s_conn_id_tab,
           END OF ty_carrier_connids.
    TYPES tt_carrier_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_connids_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_connids) TYPE tt_carrier_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_connids_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_connids_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_carrier_connids = VALUE tt_carrier_connids(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight
        WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
        GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connids = VALUE s_conn_id_tab(
          FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP flight
          ( grouped_flight-connid )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie Rohbilddaten im BMP-Format (repräsentiert als XSTRING) in das PNG-Format. Handeln Sie mögliche Fehler bei der Konvertierung ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Instanz von `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER`, stellen Sie `INPUT_IMAGE_TYPE` und `OUTPUT_IMAGE_TYPE` ein und rufen Sie `CONVERT` auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_bmp_to_png DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_bmp_to_png
      IMPORTING
        iv_bmp_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_png_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_igs_image_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_bmp_to_png IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_bmp_to_png.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).

    TRY.
        lo_converter->input_image_type  = lo_converter->co_bmp.
        lo_converter->input_image_xstr  = iv_bmp_xstring.
        lo_converter->output_image_type = lo_converter->co_png.
        lo_converter->output_image_xstr = rv_png_xstring.

        lo_converter->convert( ).
        rv_png_xstring = lo_converter->output_image_xstr.

      CATCH cx_igs_image_converter INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_igs_image_converter
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_igs_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_bmp_to_png_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_img_bmp_to_png( ).
    " A 1x1 black pixel BMP image (57 bytes)
    DATA(lv_bmp_xstring) = '424D390000000000000036000000280000000100000001000000010018000000000000000300000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'.
    DATA(lv_dummy_bmp) TYPE xstring.
    lv_dummy_bmp = CONV xstring( lv_bmp_xstring ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_png_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_bmp_to_png( iv_bmp_xstring = lv_dummy_bmp ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_png_xstring exp = lv_dummy_bmp msg = 'Output should be different from input' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_png_xstring exp = '' msg = 'Output XSTRING should not be initial' ).
    CATCH cx_igs_image_converter INTO DATA(lx_exp).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Exception occurred: { lx_exp->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_img_bmp_to_png( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE '00'. "Invalid image data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_igs_image_converter ).
    lo_cut->convert_bmp_to_png( iv_bmp_xstring = lv_invalid_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_igs_image_converter ).

Instructions: Skalieren Sie ein Bild (BMP als XSTRING) auf eine neue Breite und Höhe und konvertieren Sie es gleichzeitig in das PNG-Format.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER` mit den Methoden `SCALE_IMAGE` und `CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_resize_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS resize_and_convert
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_new_width     TYPE i
        iv_new_height    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_igs_image_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_resize_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD resize_and_convert.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).

    TRY.
        lo_converter->input_image_type  = lo_converter->co_bmp.
        lo_converter->input_image_xstr  = iv_image_xstring.
        lo_converter->scale_image(
          width       = iv_new_width
          height      = iv_new_height
        ).

        lo_converter->output_image_type = lo_converter->co_png.
        lo_converter->convert( ).
        rv_output_xstring = lo_converter->output_image_xstr.

      CATCH cx_igs_image_converter INTO DATA(lx_igs_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_igs_image_converter
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_igs_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resize_and_convert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_img_resize_convert( ).
    " A 1x1 black pixel BMP image (57 bytes)
    DATA(lv_bmp_xstring_hex) = '424D390000000000000036000000280000000100000001000000010018000000000000000300000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000'.
    DATA(lv_dummy_bmp) TYPE xstring.
    lv_dummy_bmp = CONV xstring( lv_bmp_xstring_hex ).

    DATA(lv_new_width)  = 10.
    DATA(lv_new_height) = 10.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_output_png) = lo_cut->resize_and_convert(
                                 iv_image_xstring = lv_dummy_bmp
                                 iv_new_width     = lv_new_width
                                 iv_new_height    = lv_new_height ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_output_png exp = '' msg = 'Output XSTRING should not be initial' ).

        " Further validation would involve getting dimensions of the output PNG,
        " which would require another call to GET_PIXEL_INFO on lv_output_png.
        DATA(lo_validation_converter) = NEW cl_igs_image_converter( ).
        lo_validation_converter->input_image_xstr = lv_output_png.
        lo_validation_converter->get_pixel_info( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validation_converter->input_image_width  exp = lv_new_width msg = 'Resized width incorrect' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_validation_converter->input_image_height exp = lv_new_height msg = 'Resized height incorrect' ).
    CATCH cx_igs_image_converter INTO DATA(lx_exp).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Exception occurred: { lx_exp->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_parameters.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält und bilden Sie die Ergebniszeilen auf eine neue Struktur mit `CARRID` und `CONNID` ab. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator und eine `FOR`-Iteration mit `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR <line_struc> IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( carrid = <line_struc>-carrid connid = <line_struc>-connid ) )`.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                             (
                               carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                               connid = ls_flight-connid
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der tatsächlich belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers (z.B. 'AA') in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `FOR`-Iteration und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Populate with some dummy data for demonstration/testing if sflights is empty
    " In a real scenario, this would select from DB or be passed as parameter
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 50 ) 
                           ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) 
                           ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsocc = 30 ) ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
                         INIT sum_seats = 0
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                         NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zur Summenbildung zu verwenden, ermöglicht `REDUCE` eine deklarative und konsignierte Berechnung, was den Code lesbarer, wartbarer und funktionaler macht.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Flugstatus (`'VERFÜGBAR'`, `'BEGRENZT'`, `'AUSGEBUCHT'`) basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze eines Fluges zu. Wenn mehr als 10 Sitze frei sind, ist er 'VERFÜGBAR'; zwischen 1 und 10 Sitzen 'BEGRENZT'; und bei 0 Sitzen 'AUSGEBUCHT'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_max TYPE s_seats
        iv_seats_occ TYPE s_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = iv_seats_max - iv_seats_occ.

    rv_status = COND string(
                  WHEN lv_free_seats > 10 THEN 'VERFÜGBAR'
                  WHEN lv_free_seats > 0 AND lv_free_seats LE 10 THEN 'BEGRENZT'
                  ELSE 'AUSGEBUCHT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_prev_month_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_prev_month_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_prev_month.
    " Erster Tag des aktuellen Monats
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lfs_date_comp> TYPE rcl_date_date_components.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit den meisten freien Plätzen (`seatsmax - seatsocc`) für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der `sflights`-Tabelle. Nutzen Sie eine funktionale Programmierung mit Inlinetrainingsdaten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR`, `REDUCE` und ggf. Table Expressions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary.
    METHODS get_flight_with_most_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_best_flight) TYPE ty_s_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_most_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " In-line dummy data for demonstration if sflights is empty
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 170 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' seatsmax = 220 seatsocc = 180 ) " 40 free
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 190 ) )
        .
    ENDIF.

    rs_best_flight = REDUCE ty_s_flight_summary(
                         INIT ls_best = VALUE ty_s_flight_summary(
                                             free_seats = -1 ) " Initialize with an impossibly low value
                         FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                         DATA(lv_current_free_seats) = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc
                         NEXT ls_best = COND #(
                                WHEN lv_current_free_seats > ls_best-free_seats THEN
                                  VALUE ty_s_flight_summary(
                                    carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                    connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                    free_seats = lv_current_free_seats )
                                ELSE ls_best ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
