CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    " Mock the 3D viewer for testing purposes
    DATA(lo_mock_viewer) = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer( ). " Dummy instance
    DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW zcl_3dviewer_events( lo_mock_viewer ).

    " To verify event registration, one would typically check if the SET HANDLER
    " statement was executed. This is hard to test directly without a framework
    " that allows introspection of event subscriptions or mocking the event source.
    " For this example, we'll trigger the custom event and check if the handler is called.
    DATA(lv_event_id) = 123.
    CALL METHOD lo_event_handler->on_viewer_event
      EXPORTING
        i_event_id = lv_event_id.

    " In a real test, you'd assert side effects of handle_viewer_event,
    " e.g., if a global variable was set or a mock method was called.
    " Here, we just ensure the call doesn't dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Placeholder assertion
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` eigene Events hat, wird hier ein internes Event verwendet, um die `SET HANDLER` Syntax zu zeigen. In einer realen Anwendung würde man `SET HANDLER` für die Events des `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` verwenden. Unit-Tests für Events erfordern oft fortgeschrittene Mocking-Techniken.

                              p_line_type = lo_struct_descr

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_table( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_sflights_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <lt_table> ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lo_line_descr->get_name( ),
      exp = 'SFLIGHTS'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflights.
    CREATE DATA DATA(lr_sflight) TYPE sflights.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight->* TO <ls_sflight>.
    <ls_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <ls_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    INSERT <ls_sflight> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung von Datentypen und Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit mittels RTTI. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder wenn die genaue Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ist der moderne Weg.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS field_exists_in_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_check IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

CLASS zcl_fend_file_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_file_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_fend_file_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_file_exists.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_exist(
      EXPORTING
        file = iv_file_path
      RECEIVING
        result = rv_exists
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung: Annahme, dass die Datei nicht existiert oder ein Fehler auftrat.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_not_exists.
    " cl_gui_frontend_services interagiert mit dem Frontend und kann in einer
    " nicht-interaktiven Testumgebung nicht zuverlässig getestet werden.
    " Dieser Test prüft lediglich, dass die Methode aufgerufen werden kann
    " und für eine nicht-existente Datei 'false' zurückgibt (was in den meisten
    " Testumgebungen der Fall sein sollte, da keine Datei erstellt wird).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fend_file_exist( ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT berechnet. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Auswahl der Flüge und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_no_flights_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_no_flights_found IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_avg_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE s_price
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE price IS NOT INITIAL ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        MESSAGE e002(zmsg_flights) WITH iv_carrid. " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 002 exists
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) transformiert. Für jeden Flug soll ein neuer Eintrag erstellt werden, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer kombiniert. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft oder Flugnummer leer ist, soll dieser Eintrag übersprungen und eine Ausnahme protokolliert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` in Kombination mit einer lokalen Klasse für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_incomplete_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_incomplete_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
         flight_id TYPE string,
       END OF ty_flight_summary.
TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary
      RAISING
        zcx_incomplete_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_data.
    rt_flight_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
      ( COND #(
          WHEN flight-carrid IS INITIAL OR flight-connid IS INITIAL
            THEN THROW zcx_incomplete_flight_data( MESSAGE e003(zmsg_flights) WITH flight-carrid flight-connid ) " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 003 exists
          ELSE
            VALUE ty_flight_summary( flight_id = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_transform_valid_data.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = 'LH-400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = '' connid = '200' ) TO lt_sflight. " Invalid entry

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).

        lo_transformer->transform_flight_data( lt_sflight ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected zcx_incomplete_flight_data' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'zcx_incomplete_flight_data caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

        zcx_calculation_error.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        MESSAGE e004(zmsg_flights) WITH 'Division durch Null nicht erlaubt.'. " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 004 exists
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_calculation.
    TRY.
        rv_final_result = me->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_val1 iv_denominator = iv_val2 ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_div_by_zero).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_calculation_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_div_by_zero
            textid   = zcx_calculation_error=>default_text " Or a specific message ID
            .
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_unknown_method_call.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B handled: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_unknown_method_call
          MESSAGE e005(zmsg_flights) WITH iv_method_name lx_dyn_error->get_text( ). " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 005 exists
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

            iv_connid = flight-connid
            iv_fldate = flight-fldate

          CONTINUE.

    ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge ermittelt. Wenn keine Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft gefunden werden, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUP` und `GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.

CLASS zcx_no_flights_for_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         flight_count TYPE i,
       END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_for_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    IF it_sflight IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_for_carrier
        MESSAGE e013(zmsg_flights) WITH 'Keine Flüge zur Gruppierung vorhanden.'. " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 013 exists
    ENDIF.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE tt_carrier_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflight GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    IF rt_grouped_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_for_carrier
        MESSAGE e014(zmsg_flights) WITH 'Keine Flüge nach Gruppierung gefunden.'. " Assuming ZMSG_FLIGHTS with message 014 exists
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen einem Flug (SFLIGHTS) und einem generischen Dokument (z.B. 'ZDOC').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>create_link` und die Business-Objekt-Typen 'BUS1077' für SFLIGHTS und einen fiktiven 'ZDOC'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bor_create_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_doc_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_doc_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bor_create_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_doc_link.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b TYPE sibflporb.

    " Object A: SFLIGHTS
    ls_object_a-instid = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a-typeid = 'BUS1077'. " SFLIGHTS Business Object Type
    ls_object_a-catid  = 'BO'.

    " Object B: Generic Document (fictional)
    ls_object_b-instid = iv_doc_id.
    ls_object_b-typeid = 'ZDOC'. " Fictional Document Type
    ls_object_b-catid  = 'BO'.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = ls_object_a
            is_object_b = ls_object_b
            ip_reltype  = 'ATTA' " Attachment relationship
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_create_link FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bor_create_link( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_doc_id) = 'TESTDOC_001'.

    " Ensure SFLIGHT entry exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Create a dummy entry if not found
      ls_sflight-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_sflight-connid = lv_connid.
      ls_sflight-fldate = lv_fldate.
      ls_sflight-planetype = '747'.
      ls_sflight-seatsmax = 300.
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_doc_id = lv_doc_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Link creation failed' ).

    " Clean up: Delete the created link for repeatable tests
    DATA: ls_object_a_cleanup TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b_cleanup TYPE sibflporb.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-instid = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-typeid = 'BUS1077'.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-instid = lv_doc_id.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-typeid = 'ZDOC'.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = ls_object_a_cleanup
            is_object_b = ls_object_b_cleanup
            ip_reltype  = 'ATTA'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Ignore error during cleanup
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von `create_link` ist der moderne Weg, solche Beziehungen zu etablieren, anstatt auf ältere, weniger flexible Methoden zurückzugreifen. String-Templates (`|...|`) und Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle mit einem bestimmten Flug (SFLIGHTS) verknüpften Dokumente.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>read_links` und filtern Sie nach dem Objekttyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bor_read_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_linked_object,
             instid TYPE sibflporb-instid,
             typeid TYPE sibflporb-typeid,
           END OF ty_linked_object.
    TYPES: tt_linked_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_linked_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flight_documents
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_linked_docs) TYPE tt_linked_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bor_read_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight_documents.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          lt_links    TYPE obl_t_link,
          ls_link     TYPE obl_s_link.

    ls_object_a-instid = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a-typeid = 'BUS1077'.
    ls_object_a-catid  = 'BO'.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
          EXPORTING
            is_object           = ls_object_a
            ip_role             = 'B' " Object A is source, we want objects linked to it
            ip_reltype          = 'ATTA'
          IMPORTING
            et_links            = lt_links
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_links INTO ls_link.
          IF ls_link-object_b-typeid = 'ZDOC'. " Filter for our fictional document type
            APPEND VALUE #( instid = ls_link-object_b-instid typeid = ls_link-object_b-typeid ) TO rt_linked_docs.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_read_links FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_links.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bor_read_links( ).
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_bor_create_link( ). " Re-use create link logic
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_doc_id_1) = 'TESTDOC_READ_001'.
    DATA(lv_doc_id_2) = 'TESTDOC_READ_002'.

    " Ensure SFLIGHT entry exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_sflight-connid = lv_connid.
      ls_sflight-fldate = lv_fldate.
      ls_sflight-planetype = 'A320'.
      ls_sflight-seatsmax = 150.
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    " Create dummy links
    lo_create->create_flight_doc_link( lv_carrid, lv_connid, lv_fldate, lv_doc_id_1 ).
    lo_create->create_flight_doc_link( lv_carrid, lv_connid, lv_fldate, lv_doc_id_2 ).

    DATA(lt_linked_docs) = lo_cut->read_flight_documents(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_linked_docs ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of linked documents' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( p_act = lt_linked_docs[ instid = lv_doc_id_1 ] IS INITIAL msg = 'Doc 1 not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( p_act = lt_linked_docs[ instid = lv_doc_id_2 ] IS INITIAL msg = 'Doc 2 not found' ).

    " Clean up
    DATA: ls_object_a_cleanup TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b_cleanup TYPE sibflporb.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-instid = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-typeid = 'BUS1077'.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.

    ls_object_b_cleanup-instid = lv_doc_id_1.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-typeid = 'ZDOC'.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.
    TRY. cl_binary_relation=>delete_link( is_object_a = ls_object_a_cleanup is_object_b = ls_object_b_cleanup ip_reltype = 'ATTA' ). COMMIT WORK. CATCH cx_bo_error. ENDTRY.

    ls_object_b_cleanup-instid = lv_doc_id_2.
    TRY. cl_binary_relation=>delete_link( is_object_a = ls_object_a_cleanup is_object_b = ls_object_b_cleanup ip_reltype = 'ATTA' ). COMMIT WORK. CATCH cx_bo_error. ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bor_check_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bor_check_link IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b TYPE sibflporb.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_check_link_exists FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_link_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bor_check_link( ).
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_bor_create_link( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'UA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_doc_id) = 'TESTDOC_CHECK_001'.

    " Ensure SFLIGHT entry exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_sflight-connid = lv_connid.
      ls_sflight-fldate = lv_fldate.
      ls_sflight-planetype = '737'.
      ls_sflight-seatsmax = 180.
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    " Test non-existent link first
    DATA(lv_exists_before) = lo_cut->check_flight_doc_link_exists(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_doc_id = lv_doc_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_before exp = abap_false msg = 'Link should not exist yet' ).

    " Create link
    lo_create->create_flight_doc_link( lv_carrid, lv_connid, lv_fldate, lv_doc_id ).

    " Test existent link
    DATA(lv_exists_after) = lo_cut->check_flight_doc_link_exists(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_doc_id = lv_doc_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_after exp = abap_true msg = 'Link should exist' ).

    " Clean up
    DATA: ls_object_a_cleanup TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b_cleanup TYPE sibflporb.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-instid = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-typeid = 'BUS1077'.
    ls_object_a_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-instid = lv_doc_id.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-typeid = 'ZDOC'.
    ls_object_b_cleanup-catid  = 'BO'.
    TRY. cl_binary_relation=>delete_link( is_object_a = ls_object_a_cleanup is_object_b = ls_object_b_cleanup ip_reltype = 'ATTA' ). COMMIT WORK. CATCH cx_bo_error. ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `check_link_exists` der Klasse `cl_binary_relation` bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, das Vorhandensein einer spezifischen Verknüpfung zwischen zwei Business-Objekten zu überprüfen, ohne alle Verknüpfungen lesen zu müssen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bor_delete_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_flight_doc_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

        iv_doc_id TYPE string

CLASS zcl_bor_delete_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_doc_link.
    DATA: ls_object_a TYPE sibflporb,
          ls_object_b TYPE sibflporb.

    ls_object_a-instid = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid ALPHA = IN }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    ls_object_a-typeid = 'BUS1077'.
    ls_object_a-catid  = 'BO'.

    ls_object_b-instid = iv_doc_id.
    ls_object_b-typeid = 'ZDOC'.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_link.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bor_delete_link( ).
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_bor_create_link( ).
    DATA(lo_check) = NEW zcl_bor_check_link( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'DL'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0002'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_doc_id) = 'TESTDOC_DELETE_001'.

    " Ensure SFLIGHT entry exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight-carrid = lv_carrid.
      ls_sflight-connid = lv_connid.
      ls_sflight-fldate = lv_fldate.
      ls_sflight-planetype = 'A380'.
      ls_sflight-seatsmax = 500.
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    " Create link first
    lo_create->create_flight_doc_link( lv_carrid, lv_connid, lv_fldate, lv_doc_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_check->check_flight_doc_link_exists( lv_carrid, lv_connid, lv_fldate, lv_doc_id ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Link not created for deletion test' ).

    " Delete link
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid

    ).

      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate

    ).

CLASS zcl_dyn_comp_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_dyn_comp_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.

  METHOD test_modify_variable.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_var_access( ).

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und verarbeiten Sie die Zeilen effizient mit Feld-Symbolen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_loop_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_info
        iv_percent TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_loop_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_updated_flights = it_flights. " Copy table

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE ty_flight_info.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percent / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_loop_fs( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_loop_fs=>tt_flight_info(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->increase_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_percent = '10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated[ 1 ]-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price 1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated[ 2 ]-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Price 2 mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` ist die performanteste und modernste Art, interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen, wenn Zeilen direkt modifiziert werden sollen. Es vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten und arbeitet direkt mit dem Speicherbereich der Tabelle.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, Performance

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer generischen internen Tabelle zu und casten Sie diese in einen spezifischen Typ, um auf Komponenten zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN LINE OF itab INDEX ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>) CASTING TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_casting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_key_from_generic
      IMPORTING
        it_generic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_index         TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_casting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_key_from_generic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_flight_key> TYPE zcl_dyn_table_casting=>ty_flight_key.

    ASSIGN LINE OF it_generic_table INDEX iv_index TO <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN <fs_line> TO <fs_flight_key> CASTING.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rs_flight_key = <fs_flight_key>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie dynamisch den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte in einer internen Tabelle basierend auf dem Spaltennamen, wobei Sie moderne ABAP-Konstrukte verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_field_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_flights     TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_field_name  TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field_dynamically.
    rt_updated_flights = REDUCE #( " Use REDUCE for functional style
      INIT lt_result = it_flights
      FOR <fs_line> IN lt_result
      LET lv_field_name = iv_field_name IN
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any IN <fs_line>
      WHERE ( lv_field_name IS NOT INITIAL ) " Ensure field name is provided
      DO.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO
      RESULT lt_result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_type_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_dyn_type_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_descr_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_descr_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " For demonstration, let's assume iv_type_name is SFLIGHT
          " and we want to add some dummy data.
          " In a real scenario, data would come from DB or other source.
          IF iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
            SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).
            LOOP AT lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
              APPEND <fs_sflight> TO <lt_table>.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bekannten Typnamen, füllen Sie diese mit Daten und filtern Sie diese dann mit einem modernen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (name)`, `ASSIGN` und den `FOR`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_fill_filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        iv_filter_field TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_fill_filter_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_descr_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_descr_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

        IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Fill with dummy data (assuming SFLIGHT)
          IF iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
            SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).
            LOOP AT lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
              APPEND <fs_sflight> TO <lt_table>.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDIF.

          " Filter dynamically using FOR
          rt_filtered_data = VALUE string_table(
            FOR <fs_line> IN <lt_table>
            LET lv_filter_field = iv_filter_field IN
            FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any IN <fs_line>
            WHERE ( lv_filter_field IS NOT INITIAL ) " Ensure field name is provided
            (
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_filter_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0 AND |{ <fs_component> }| = iv_filter_value.
                THEN |{ <fs_line> }| " Convert entire line to string for result
              ELSE
                CONTINUE.
              ENDIF
            )
          ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_for( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_filter) = 'LH'.

    " Ensure SFLIGHT entry exists for testing
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid_filter.
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      " Create a dummy entry if not found
      ls_sflight_check-carrid = lv_carrid_filter.
      ls_sflight_check-connid = '0400'.
      ls_sflight_check-fldate = sy-datum.
      ls_sflight_check-planetype = 'A320'.
      ls_sflight_check-seatsmax = 150.
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_check.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->create_fill_filter_dynamic_table(
      iv_type_name    = 'SFLIGHT'
      iv_filter_field = 'CARRID'
      iv_filter_value = lv_carrid_filter
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( p_act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered table should not be initial' ).
    " Check if all results contain the filter value
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(lv_line).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( act = lv_line exp = lv_carrid_filter msg = 'Filtered line does not contain expected CARRID' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_filtered_none) = lo_cut->create_fill_filter_dynamic_table(
      iv_type_name    = 'SFLIGHT'
      iv_filter_field = 'CARRID'
      iv_filter_value = 'XX' " Non-existent
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( p_act = lt_filtered_none msg = 'Filtering for non-existent value should return empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung, während `ASSIGN COMPONENT` den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_category_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_category_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_category.
    rv_category =
      CASE abap_true.
        WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Success (2xx)'
        WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_redirection( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Redirection (3xx)'
        WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Client Error (4xx)'
        WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Server Error (5xx)'
        WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Informational (1xx) or Unknown'
      END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             reason_phrase TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_info.
    TYPES tt_status_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_status_codes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_status_codes
      IMPORTING
        it_status_codes TYPE tt_status_codes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_analysis) TYPE tt_status_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_status_codes.
    rt_status_analysis = VALUE #( FOR code IN it_status_codes
                                  LET category = CASE abap_true.
                                                   WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( code ) THEN 'Success'
                                                   WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_redirection( code ) THEN 'Redirection'
                                                   WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( code ) THEN 'Client Error'
                                                   WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( code ) THEN 'Server Error'
                                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Informational/Unknown'
                                                 END
                                      reason_phrase = cl_rest_status_code=>get_reason_phrase( code )
                                  IN ( status_code = code,
                                       category = category,
                                       reason_phrase = reason_phrase ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verschlüsselung eines XML-Elements innerhalb eines Dokuments unter Verwendung eines konzeptionellen Schlüssels aus einem PSE.
hint: Fokus auf die logische Struktur der Verschlüsselung. Die eigentliche Verschlüsselung ist hier abstrahiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_encryptor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS encrypt_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_document TYPE string
        iv_element_name TYPE string
        iv_pse_name     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encrypted_xml) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_encryptor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encrypt_xml_element.
    " Konzeptionelle Implementierung: In einem realen Szenario würde CL_SECXML_HELPER
    " oder eine spezialisierte XML-Verschlüsselungs-API verwendet, um ein Element
    " zu finden, den Schlüssel aus dem PSE zu laden und das Element zu verschlüsseln.
    " Hier simulieren wir die Verschlüsselung durch Ersetzen des Elements.

    IF iv_pse_name IS INITIAL OR iv_xml_document IS INITIAL OR iv_element_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_tag) = |<{ iv_element_name }>|.
    DATA(lv_end_tag)   = |</{ iv_element_name }>|.

    DATA(lv_offset_start) = 0.
    DATA(lv_offset_end)   = 0.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_start_tag IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset_start OF iv_xml_document MATCH OFFSET lv_offset_start.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Element not found
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.

    lv_offset_start = lv_offset_start + strlen( lv_start_tag ).

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_end_tag IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset_start OF iv_xml_document MATCH OFFSET lv_offset_end.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " End tag not found
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_static_check( textid = cx_static_check=>default_text ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_encrypted_content) = '<!-- Encrypted Data -->'. " Simulierte verschlüsselte Daten

    rv_encrypted_xml = |
      { iv_xml_document(lv_offset_start) }
      { lv_encrypted_content }
      { iv_xml_document+lv_offset_end( strlen( iv_xml_document ) - lv_offset_end ) }
    |.

    REPLACE SECTION OFFSET lv_offset_start LENGTH ( lv_offset_end - lv_offset_start ) OF rv_encrypted_xml WITH lv_encrypted_content.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine finale Klasse, die den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` berechnet und eine Tabelle mit den Ergebnissen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         price  TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         avg_price TYPE f,
       END OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier.
TYPES: tt_avg_price_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_grouped_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_data).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_data INTO DATA(ls_flight)
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_sum_prices) = REDUCE f(
        INIT s = 0.0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      DATA(ls_result) = VALUE ty_avg_price_by_carrier(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        avg_price = COND f( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_prices / lv_count ELSE 0.0 )
      ).
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_avg_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grouped_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_avg_prices_by_carrier( ).

    " Annahme: SFLIGHTS enthält Daten für 'LH' und 'AA'.
    " Überprüfen, ob Ergebnisse für bekannte Fluggesellschaften vorhanden sind.
    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_avg_lh).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_avg_lh IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Ergebnis für LH sollte gefunden werden' ).
    IF ls_avg_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Hier müsste man den erwarteten Wert basierend auf Testdaten in SFLIGHTS anpassen.
      " Für dieses Beispiel nehmen wir an, der Durchschnitt für LH ist 200.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_avg_lh-avg_price exp = 200.0 msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für LH sollte 200.0 sein' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_avg_prices WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_avg_aa).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_avg_aa IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Ergebnis für AA sollte gefunden werden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb jeder Gruppe können komplexe Aggregationen wie der Durchschnitt pro Gruppe sehr elegant und effizient implementiert werden. Die Klasse ist `FINAL`, um ihre Funktionalität zu sichern.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine finale Methode, die den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen berechnet und dabei eine Division durch Null sicher abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Division durch Null und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_avg_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_safe_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_avg_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_safe_average.
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0.0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).

    TRY.
        rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Fängt Division durch Null ab, falls lv_count 0 wäre (was hier durch IF abgefangen wird)
        rv_average = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_safe_average FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_safe_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_avg_calculator( ).
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16 VALUE #( ( '10.5' ) ( '20.5' ) ( '30.0' ) ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_safe_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '20.333333333333333333333333333333' msg = 'Durchschnitt sollte korrekt sein' ).

    CLEAR lt_numbers.
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_safe_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.0' msg = 'Durchschnitt einer leeren Tabelle sollte 0.0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode ist `FINAL`, um ihre robuste Implementierung zu sichern. Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts erfolgt mit dem `REDUCE` Operator für die Summenbildung. Eine explizite Prüfung auf eine leere Tabelle und die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für arithmetische Fehler (obwohl die Vorabprüfung die Division durch Null hier verhindert) demonstrieren eine sichere Programmierung. `decfloat16` wird für präzise Dezimalberechnungen verwendet.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine finale Klasse, die den gewichteten Durchschnitt einer Liste von Werten berechnet, wobei jeder Wert ein Gewicht hat.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe der Produkte (Wert * Gewicht) und die Summe der Gewichte.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_value,
         value  TYPE decfloat16,
         weight TYPE decfloat16,
       END OF ty_weighted_value.
TYPES: tt_weighted_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_weighted_average
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_values TYPE tt_weighted_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weighted_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_avg_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_weighted_average.
    DATA(lv_sum_products) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0.0
      FOR ls_item IN it_weighted_values
      NEXT s = s + ( ls_item-value * ls_item-weight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum_weights) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0.0
      FOR ls_item IN it_weighted_values
      NEXT s = s + ls_item-weight
    ).

    IF lv_sum_weights = 0.
      rv_weighted_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_weighted_average = lv_sum_products / lv_sum_weights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_weighted_average FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_avg_calc( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_weighted_values VALUE #(
      ( value = '10.0' weight = '1.0' )
      ( value = '20.0' weight = '2.0' )
      ( value = '30.0' weight = '1.0' )
    ).
    " (10*1 + 20*2 + 30*1) / (1+2+1) = (10+40+30) / 4 = 80 / 4 = 20.0
    DATA(lv_weighted_avg) = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weighted_avg exp = '20.0' msg = 'Gewichteter Durchschnitt sollte 20.0 sein' ).

    CLEAR lt_data.
    lv_weighted_avg = lo_cut->calculate_weighted_average( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_weighted_avg exp = '0.0' msg = 'Gewichteter Durchschnitt einer leeren Tabelle sollte 0.0 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese `FINAL` Klasse demonstriert die Flexibilität des `REDUCE` Operators für komplexere Aggregationen. Durch zwei separate `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke werden die Summe der Produkte aus Wert und Gewicht sowie die Summe der Gewichte berechnet. Dies ermöglicht die Ermittlung des gewichteten Durchschnitts auf eine funktionale und gut lesbare Weise. Eine Division durch Null wird sicher abgefangen.
keywords: FINAL CLASS, WEIGHTED AVERAGE, REDUCE, Math

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine temporäre Sortierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shuffle_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lines( it_original_table )
    ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_rand,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight_data TYPE ty_sflight,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_rand.
    TYPES ty_sflight_with_rand_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_rand WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_temp) = VALUE ty_sflight_with_rand_tab(
      FOR wa IN it_original_table
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( )
        sflight_data = wa )
    ).

    SORT lt_shuffled_temp BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_table = VALUE ty_sflight_tab(
      FOR wa IN lt_shuffled_temp
      ( wa-sflight_data )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_len) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_chars_len - 1
    ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 TO iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS generate_random_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_data_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_sflights.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY = VALUE #(
      ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'DL' ) ( 'BA' ) ).

    rt_sflights = VALUE ty_sflight_data_tab(
      FOR i = 1 TO iv_number_of_entries
      LET lv_rand_carrier_idx = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( lc_carriers ) )
          lv_rand_connid    = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 100 max = 999 )
          lv_rand_day       = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 1 max = 28 )
          lv_rand_month     = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 1 max = 12 )
          lv_rand_year      = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 2025 max = 2026 )
          lv_rand_price     = lo_random_int->get_next( min = 10000 max = 100000 ) / 100.00
      IN
      ( carrid = lc_carriers[ lv_rand_carrier_idx ]
        connid = CONV sflight-connid( lv_rand_connid )
        fldate = CONV d( |{ lv_rand_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_rand_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }{ lv_rand_day ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }| )
        price  = CONV sflight-price( lv_rand_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie dynamisch ein zufälliges Feld aus einer Struktur und konvertieren Sie dessen Wert in einen String.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_field_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
             field4 TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    METHODS get_random_field_as_string
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE ty_test_struct
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_field_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_field_as_string.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_num_components) = lines( lt_components ).

    IF lv_num_components = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_num_components - 1
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    DATA(ls_component) = lt_components[ lv_random_index + 1 ].

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = CONV string( <fs_field> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine Tabelle von Integern, wobei ungültige Einträge übersprungen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `CONV` in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_tab_to_int_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_int
      IMPORTING
        it_string_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_int_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_tab_to_int_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_int.
    rt_int_table = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_string_table
                             LET lv_int = 0 IN
                             ( TRY. lv_int = CONV i( lv_string ).
                               CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number. CONTINUE. ENDTRY.
                               lv_int ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `FOR`-Iteration in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `CONV` in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block verwendet, um Konvertierungsfehler abzufangen. `CONTINUE` im `CATCH`-Block sorgt dafür, dass ungültige Einträge übersprungen werden. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die basierend auf einer zufälligen Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30%) einen bestimmten Wert zurückgibt, ansonsten einen Standardwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und den `COND`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_with_probability
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability_percent TYPE i " e.g., 30 for 30%
        iv_special_value     TYPE string
        iv_default_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_with_probability.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = 100
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN lv_random_num <= iv_probability_percent THEN iv_special_value
      ELSE iv_default_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen Buchstaben aus einem gegebenen String aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_random_char_from_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_character
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_char_from_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_character.
    IF iv_input_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_string_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_string_length - 1
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_char = iv_input_string+lv_random_index(1).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit nur den Flugnummern und Abflugdaten dieser Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_add_new_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_details
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_add_new_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_details.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rt_flight_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered
                                 ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es wurden keine Flugdetails für LH gefunden.' act = lt_details ).
    LOOP AT lt_details INTO DATA(ls_detail).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in `sflights` die Flugnummer und den um 10% erhöhten Preis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_calc_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_increased_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_calc_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_increased_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                                  price  = ls_flight-price * '1.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increased_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increased_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_calc_for( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_increased_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es wurden keine Preise berechnet.' act = lt_prices ).
    READ TABLE lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_original_price) = VALUE sflight-price( SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = ls_price-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_price-price exp = lv_original_price * '1.1' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife ermöglicht die Transformation und Berechnung von Werten während der Konstruktion einer neuen internen Tabelle, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Calculations, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge, die von 'FRA' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_fra
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_fra.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE cityfrom = 'FRA' ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price_fra FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_fra.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_fra( ).
    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_sum WHERE cityfrom = 'FRA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, Daten in einem Schritt zu filtern und dann zu aggregieren (z.B. summieren), was eine sehr funktionale und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SUM

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflight`, indem Sie Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle (`scarr`) hinzufügen, wobei nur die Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übernommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflight_from_scarr
      IMPORTING it_scarr TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_from_scarr.
    rt_sflight = VALUE #( FOR ls_scarr IN it_scarr
                          ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_scarr ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_corresponding( ).
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr UP TO 2 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_scarr. 

    DATA(lt_sflight_result) = lo_cut->create_sflight_from_scarr( lt_scarr ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_result ) exp = lines( lt_scarr ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_result INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      READ TABLE lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr) WITH KEY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = ls_scarr-carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine interne Tabelle ihrer Flüge enthält. Filtern Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die mindestens einen Flug nach 'NYC' anbieten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `EXISTS` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_flights,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flights TYPE tt_flight,
           END OF ty_airline_flights.
    TYPES tt_airline_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airlines_to_nyc
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_airlines) TYPE tt_airline_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airlines_to_nyc.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_all_airlines_with_flights) = VALUE tt_airline_flights(
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
      LET flights_for_airline = VALUE tt_flight(
                                  FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid )
                                  ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                    connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                    cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
                                    cityto = ls_sflight-cityto ) )
      IN
      ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid
        carrname = ls_scarr-carrname
        flights = flights_for_airline )
    ).

    rt_airlines = FILTER #( lt_all_airlines_with_flights WHERE flights IS NOT INITIAL AND
                            EXISTS flights[ cityto = 'NYC' ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_airlines_to_nyc FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_airlines_to_nyc.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_nested( ).
    DATA(lt_airlines_to_nyc) = lo_cut->get_airlines_to_nyc( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es wurden keine Fluggesellschaften gefunden, die nach NYC fliegen.' act = lt_airlines_to_nyc ).
    LOOP AT lt_airlines_to_nyc INTO DATA(ls_airline).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = EXISTS ls_airline-flights[ cityto = 'NYC' ] ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `FILTER` und der `EXISTS` Bedingung auf geschachtelte interne Tabellen zugreifen kann, um komplexe Filterkriterien zu erfüllen. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und performante Methode, um in komplexen Datenstrukturen zu suchen.
keywords: FILTER, EXISTS, Nested Tables, Complex Data, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge nach ihrer Abflugstadt und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Stadt die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der Preise aller Flüge enthält, die von dieser Stadt abfliegen und deren Preis über 100 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `VALUE`, `FOR`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_filter_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_city_summary,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_city_summary.
    TYPES tt_city_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_city_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_city_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_city_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom )
      LET lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( GROUP ls_flight WHERE price > 100 ) IN
      ( cityfrom     = ls_flight-cityfrom
        flight_count = lines( lt_filtered_flights )
        total_price  = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price
                                 FOR ls_filtered IN lt_filtered_flights
                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_filtered-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_city_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_city_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_filter_group( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_city_flight_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Es wurden keine Stadtzusammenfassungen generiert.' act = lt_summary ).
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_summary-cityfrom ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary-flight_count >= 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary-total_price >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `VALUE`, `FOR GROUPS OF`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Es ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation und Transformation von Daten basierend auf Gruppierungen und Filterkriterien.
keywords: GROUP BY, VALUE, FOR GROUPS OF, FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Complex

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), die um ein UUID-Feld erweitert wurde, basierend auf einer bestimmten UUID. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Erweitern Sie die Struktur von `sflights` um ein UUID-Feld und verwenden Sie dann den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_uuid,

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie simulierte Mitarbeiterdaten nach Abteilung und zählen Sie die Mitarbeiter pro Abteilung, unter Verwendung des `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Statements.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE` Operator für die Zählung innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_department_count,
             department TYPE string,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_department_count.
    TYPES: tt_department_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_department_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_employees_by_department RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_department_counts.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_mock_employees RETURNING VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE zcl_mock_employee_api=>tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_employees_by_department.
    DATA(lt_employees) = get_mock_employees( ).

    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(ls_employee) GROUP BY ls_employee-department ASCENDING
                                                 INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_employee NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_department_count( department = ls_group_key-department count = lv_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_employees.
    DATA(lo_mock_api) = NEW zcl_mock_employee_api( ).
    rt_employees = lo_mock_api->get_employees( ).
    " Add more data for better grouping test
    APPEND VALUE #( employee_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) employee_id = 'EMP004' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'IT' is_active = abap_true ) TO rt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( employee_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) employee_id = 'EMP005' first_name = 'Hans' last_name = 'Meier' department = 'HR' is_active = abap_true ) TO rt_employees.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen dynamischen Methodenaufruf, der basierend auf einem String-Namen eine Methode der Klasse `CL_SYSTEM_UUID` aufruft (z.B. `CREATE_UUID_X16` oder `CONVERT_UUID_X16_TO_C32`). Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR` und `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ, gefolgt von einem dynamischen Methodenaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_uuid_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_uuid_method_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_uuid_x16    TYPE sysuuid_x16 OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_uuid_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_uuid_method_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr,
          lo_data         TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_parameters   TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter    TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'CL_SYSTEM_UUID' ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).

        CASE iv_method_name.
          WHEN 'CREATE_UUID_X16'.
            CALL METHOD ('CL_SYSTEM_UUID')=>('CREATE_UUID_X16') RECEIVING r_uuid = DATA(lv_uuid_x16).
            rv_result = cl_system_uuid=>convert_uuid_x16_to_c32( lv_uuid_x16 ).
          WHEN 'CONVERT_UUID_X16_TO_C32'.
            IF iv_uuid_x16 IS INITIAL.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_param_value EXPORTING parameter = 'IV_UUID_X16'.
            ENDIF.
            CALL METHOD ('CL_SYSTEM_UUID')=>('CONVERT_UUID_X16_TO_C32') EXPORTING i_uuid_x16 = iv_uuid_x16 RECEIVING r_uuid_c32 = DATA(lv_uuid_c32).
            rv_result = lv_uuid_c32.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_param_value EXPORTING parameter = 'IV_METHOD_NAME'.
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_abap_class_not_found cx_abap_invalid_name cx_abap_invalid_param_value INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine UUID, konvertieren Sie sie in einen 32-stelligen String und formatieren Sie sie dann mit String-Templates in ein benutzerfreundliches Format (z.B. mit Bindestrichen).

CLASS zcl_uuid_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Formatierung mit String-Templates: 8-4-4-4-12 Schema
    rv_formatted_uuid = |{ lv_uuid_c32(8) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+8(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+12(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+16(4) }-{ lv_uuid_c32+20(12) }|.

hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um eine Liste von Strings zu einem einzigen String zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_active_first_names RETURNING VALUE(rv_names_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_mock_employees RETURNING VALUE(rt_employees) TYPE zcl_mock_employee_api=>tt_employees.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_active_first_names.
    DATA(lt_employees) = get_mock_employees( ).

    rv_names_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_employee IN lt_employees
      WHERE ( is_active = abap_true )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_employee-first_name ELSE s && ', ' && ls_employee-first_name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_employees.
    DATA(lo_mock_api) = NEW zcl_mock_employee_api( ).
    rt_employees = lo_mock_api->get_employees( ).
    APPEND VALUE #( employee_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) employee_id = 'EMP004' first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' department = 'IT' is_active = abap_true ) TO rt_employees.
  ENDMETHOD.

    METHODS is_valid_uuid_string IMPORTING iv_uuid_c32 TYPE sysuuid_c32 RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_uuid.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_uuid_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>convert_uuid_x16_to_c32( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_uuid_string( lv_valid_uuid ) msg = 'Gültige UUID sollte als gültig erkannt werden' ).

  METHOD test_invalid_uuid.

CLASS zcl_gos_extract_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_attachment_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,

CLASS zcl_gos_extract_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_summary.
    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = get_mock_attachments(
                                   iv_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type
                                   iv_bus_obj_key  = iv_bus_obj_key ).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR <attachment> IN lt_raw_attachments
                          ( filename   = <attachment>-filename
                            created_on = <attachment>-created_on ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_attachments.
    " Simulate different attachments based on object key for testing
    IF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY1'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT1' filename = 'Document1.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231001' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 102400 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT2' filename = 'Image.jpg' filetype = 'JPG' created_on = '20231005' created_at = '110000' creator = 'USERB' filesize = 51200 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT3' filename = 'Report.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_on = '20231010' created_at = '120000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 20480 )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY2'.

        ( object_id = 'ATT4' filename = 'Presentation.pptx' filetype = 'PPTX' created_on = '20231101' created_at = '090000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 204800 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT5' filename = 'AnotherDoc.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231102' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 76800 )
      ).
    ELSE.

    ENDIF.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,

    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY2'.

        ( object_id = 'ATT5' filename = 'AnotherDoc.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231102' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 76800 )

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_stats,
             count     TYPE i,
             total_size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_attachment_stats.

    METHODS get_attachment_statistics
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_attachment_stats.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,
             created_at  TYPE so_crtim,
             creator     TYPE so_crnam,
             filesize    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_gos_attachment.
    TYPES tt_gos_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gos_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_mock_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_gos_attachments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_statistics.
    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = get_mock_attachments(
                                   iv_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type
                                   iv_bus_obj_key  = iv_bus_obj_key ).

    rs_stats = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0 total_size = 0
                             FOR <attachment> IN lt_raw_attachments
                             NEXT count = count + 1
                                  total_size = total_size + <attachment>-filesize ).
  ENDMETHOD.
