        ( object_id = 'ATT3' filename = 'Report.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_on = '20231010' created_at = '120000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 20480 )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY2'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT4' filename = 'Presentation.pptx' filetype = 'PPTX' created_on = '20231101' created_at = '090000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 204800 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT5' filename = 'AnotherDoc.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231102' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 76800 )
      ).
    ELSE.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Liste der GOS-Anlagen eines Business-Objekts, die jeweils Dateiname, Typ und Ersteller enthält, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Ausgabeformatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_format_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_attachment_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,
             created_at  TYPE so_crtim,
             creator     TYPE so_crnam,
             filesize    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_gos_attachment.
    TYPES tt_gos_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gos_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_mock_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_gos_attachments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_format_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_attachment_list.
    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = get_mock_attachments(
                                   iv_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type
                                   iv_bus_obj_key  = iv_bus_obj_key ).

    IF lt_raw_attachments IS INITIAL.
      rv_list = 'Keine Anlagen gefunden.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_output) = VALUE string_table( FOR <attachment> IN lt_raw_attachments
                                          ( |Dateiname: { <attachment>-filename }, Typ: { <attachment>-filetype }, Ersteller: { <attachment>-creator }| ) ).

    rv_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR <line> IN lv_output NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE s && |
| && <line> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_attachments.
    " Simulate different attachments based on object key for testing
    IF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY1'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT1' filename = 'Document1.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231001' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 102400 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT2' filename = 'Image.jpg' filetype = 'JPG' created_on = '20231005' created_at = '110000' creator = 'USERB' filesize = 51200 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT3' filename = 'Report.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_on = '20231010' created_at = '120000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 20480 )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY2'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT4' filename = 'Presentation.pptx' filetype = 'PPTX' created_on = '20231101' created_at = '090000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 204800 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT5' filename = 'AnotherDoc.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231102' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 76800 )
      ).
    ELSE.
      " No attachments for other keys
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_obj_attachment_count,
             bus_obj_key TYPE sibfinstid,
             attachment_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_obj_attachment_count.
    TYPES tt_obj_attachment_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_obj_attachment_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachment_counts_for_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_bus_obj_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sibfinstid WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_obj_attachment_count.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,
             created_at  TYPE so_crtim,
             creator     TYPE so_crnam,
             filesize    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_gos_attachment.
    TYPES tt_gos_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gos_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_mock_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_gos_attachments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_counts_for_objects.
    rt_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR <key> IN it_bus_obj_keys
      LET lt_attachments = get_mock_attachments( iv_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type iv_bus_obj_key = <key> )
      IN ( bus_obj_key = <key> attachment_count = lines( lt_attachments ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_attachments.
    " Simulate different attachments based on object key for testing

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus und prüfen Sie für jeden Flug, ob GOS-Anlagen (z.B. Flugdokumente) vorhanden sind. Geben Sie eine Liste der Flüge mit einem Indikator für vorhandene Anlagen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL Syntax (`SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) und rufen Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` (simuliert) innerhalb einer Schleife auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_gos_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_gos,
             carrid     TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflights-fldate,
             has_attachments TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_with_gos.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_gos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_gos WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_gos_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_gos.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,
             created_at  TYPE so_crtim,
             creator     TYPE so_crnam,
             filesize    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_gos_attachment.
    TYPES tt_gos_attachments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gos_attachment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_mock_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_gos_attachments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_gos_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_gos_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Modern Open SQL: SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for demo purposes

    rt_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR <flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_bus_obj_key = |{ <flight>-carrid }{ <flight>-connid }{ <flight>-fldate DATE = ISO }|
          lt_attachments = get_mock_attachments( iv_bus_obj_type = 'FLIGHT' iv_bus_obj_key = lv_bus_obj_key )
      IN ( carrid = <flight>-carrid
           connid = <flight>-connid
           fldate = <flight>-fldate
           has_attachments = COND abap_bool( WHEN lt_attachments IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_attachments.
    " Simulate different attachments based on object key for testing
    " For SFLIGHTS, we might construct a key like CARRIER+CONNECTION+DATE
    IF iv_bus_obj_key = 'AA0012023-01-01'. " Example key for a flight
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'FLT1' filename = 'Manifest_AA001.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20230101' created_at = '080000' creator = 'PILOT1' filesize = 30000 )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'LH04002023-01-02'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'FLT2' filename = 'PassengerList_LH400.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_on = '20230102' created_at = '090000' creator = 'CREW2' filesize = 15000 )
        ( object_id = 'FLT3' filename = 'CargoDoc_LH400.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20230102' created_at = '093000' creator = 'CREW2' filesize = 45000 )
      ).
    ELSE.
      " No attachments for other keys
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_unique_filetypes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_unique_filetypes
      IMPORTING
        iv_bus_obj_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_bus_obj_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filetypes) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock for cl_gos_attachment_query for demonstration purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_gos_attachments.

CLASS zcl_gos_unique_filetypes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_filetypes.
    DATA(lt_raw_attachments) = get_mock_attachments(
                                   iv_bus_obj_type = iv_bus_obj_type
                                   iv_bus_obj_key  = iv_bus_obj_key ).

    DATA(lt_extracted_types) = VALUE string_table( FOR <attachment> IN lt_raw_attachments
                                                   LET lv_dot_pos = find( val = <attachment>-filename sub = '.' occ = -1 )
                                                   IN COND string( WHEN lv_dot_pos IS NOT INITIAL THEN <attachment>-filename+lv_dot_pos( ) ELSE '' ) ).

    " Remove duplicates and empty entries
    DELETE lt_extracted_types WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
    SORT lt_extracted_types BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_extracted_types COMPARING table_line.

    rt_filetypes = lt_extracted_types.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mock_attachments.
    " Simulate different attachments based on object key for testing
    IF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY1'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT1' filename = 'Document1.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231001' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 102400 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT2' filename = 'Image.jpg' filetype = 'JPG' created_on = '20231005' created_at = '110000' creator = 'USERB' filesize = 51200 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT3' filename = 'Report.txt' filetype = 'TXT' created_on = '20231010' created_at = '120000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 20480 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT6' filename = 'NoExtension' filetype = '' created_on = '20231011' created_at = '130000' creator = 'USERA' filesize = 500 )
      ).
    ELSEIF iv_bus_obj_key = 'OBJKEY2'.
      rt_attachments = VALUE #(
        ( object_id = 'ATT4' filename = 'Presentation.pptx' filetype = 'PPTX' created_on = '20231101' created_at = '090000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 204800 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT5' filename = 'AnotherDoc.pdf' filetype = 'PDF' created_on = '20231102' created_at = '100000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 76800 )
        ( object_id = 'ATT7' filename = 'Archive.zip' filetype = 'ZIP' created_on = '20231103' created_at = '110000' creator = 'USERC' filesize = 10000 )
      ).
    ELSE.
      " No attachments for other keys
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_rtti_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_gos_attachment_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Mock structure for GOS attachment data
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_attachment,
             object_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             filename    TYPE so_obj_des,
             filetype    TYPE so_obj_tp,
             created_on  TYPE so_crdat,
             created_at  TYPE so_crtim,

             filesize    TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_gos_rtti_fields IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_GOS_RTTI_FIELDS=>TY_GOS_ATTACHMENT' ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Datenreferenz für einen bestimmten Typ (z.B. 'STRING', 'I') und weisen Sie optional einen Wert zu. Behandeln Sie mögliche Konvertierungsfehler.
hint: `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` sind die Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_data.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
    IF lo_type_descr IS INITIAL. " Typ nicht gefunden
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.

    IF iv_value IS SUPPLIED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_data>. " Zuweisung der Datenreferenz zu einem Feldsymbol
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            <fs_data> = iv_value. " Wertzuweisung, kann Konvertierungsfehler werfen
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            CLEAR rr_data. " Referenz bei Fehler ungültig machen
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_packed_decimals DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Dateien und Unterverzeichnisse in einem bestimmten Verzeichnis auf dem Applikationsserver auf. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse, um nur Dateien anzuzeigen.
hint: `cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_listing` liefert die Verzeichnisliste. Verwenden Sie `FOR` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_dir_listing DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'F' for file, 'D' for directory
           END OF ty_file_entry.
    TYPES tt_file_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_files_in_directory
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_files) TYPE tt_file_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_dir_listing IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_files_in_directory.
    DATA: lt_listing TYPE cl_abap_file_utilities=>tt_directory_listing.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_listing(
          EXPORTING
            iv_directory_name = iv_directory_path
          IMPORTING
            et_directory_listing = lt_listing
        ).

        " Moderne FOR-Expression zum Filtern nur der Dateien
        rt_files = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_listing
                            WHERE ( type = cl_abap_file_utilities=>c_type_file )
                            ( name = ls_entry-name type = ls_entry-type ) ).

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error. " Fehler beim Lesen des Verzeichnisses abfangen
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leere Tabelle zurückgeben
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_files_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_file_dir_listing( ).
    DATA(lv_temp_dir) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_file1) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_file2) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_subdir) TYPE string.

    " Temporäres Verzeichnis und Dateien/Unterverzeichnis erstellen
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_temp_filename( EXPORTING iv_prefix = 'DIR' IMPORTING ev_filename = lv_temp_dir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_temp_dir ).

    lv_file1 = lv_temp_dir && '/file1.txt'.
    lv_file2 = lv_temp_dir && '/file2.log'.
    lv_subdir = lv_temp_dir && '/subdir'.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_text_file( EXPORTING iv_file_name = lv_file1 it_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'Content' ) ) ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_text_file( EXPORTING iv_file_name = lv_file2 it_content = VALUE string_table( ( 'Log' ) ) ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_subdir ).

    DATA(lt_files) = lo_cut->get_files_in_directory( lv_temp_dir ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_files ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_files[ 1 ]-name exp = 'file1.txt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_files[ 2 ]-name exp = 'file2.log' ).

    " Aufräumen
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file1 ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file2 ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_temp_dir ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_temp_dir ).

    DATA(lt_files) = lo_cut->get_files_in_directory( lv_temp_dir ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_files ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für ein Zeitdiagramm, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft anzuzeigen. Demonstrieren Sie dabei die Verwendung des FILTER-Operators und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten zu erstellen. Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_chart_data
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_chart_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        SELECT fldate, price, carrid
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
          UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'No flight data found.'.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lt_filtered_sflight) = FILTER #( lt_raw_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

        IF lt_filtered_sflight IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = |No flights found for carrier { iv_carrid }|.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_points(
          FOR flight IN lt_filtered_sflight
          ( date = flight-fldate, value = flight-price, category = flight-carrid )
        ).

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = |Flüge von { iv_carrid }| i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Flugdatum aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für ein Zeitdiagramm. Nutzen Sie dabei den REDUCE-Operator und fangen Sie mögliche Fehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen. Implementieren Sie TRY...CATCH für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_chart_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_chart_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        SELECT fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
          UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'No flight data found for aggregation.'.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = REDUCE tt_chart_points(
          INIT result = VALUE tt_chart_points( )
          FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( date = flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
          LET sum_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
                            INIT s = 0
                            FOR member IN GROUP flight
                            NEXT s = s + member-price )
          IN
          NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( date = flight-fldate value = sum_price category = 'Total Price' ) )
        ).

        IF rt_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Aggregation resulted in no data.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = 'Aggregierte Flugpreise' i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `CORRESPONDING` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation. Fügen Sie TRY...CATCH für die Fehlerbehandlung hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_chart_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_chart_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
          UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'No flight data found for grouping.'.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_points(
          FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, fldate = flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
          LET avg_occupancy = REDUCE decfloat16(
                                INIT total_seats_occ = 0, total_seats_max = 0
                                FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                NEXT total_seats_occ = total_seats_occ + member-seatsocc,
                                     total_seats_max = total_seats_max + member-seatsmax )
                            IN
                            COND decfloat16( WHEN avg_occupancy-total_seats_max > 0 THEN avg_occupancy-total_seats_occ / avg_occupancy-total_seats_max * 100 ELSE 0 )
          IN
          ( date = flight-fldate, value = avg_occupancy, category = flight-carrid )
        ).

        IF rt_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Grouping resulted in no data.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = 'Durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft' i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.

CLASS zcl_chart_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_chart_data
      IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE tt_chart_points
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   zcx_invalid_chart_data.

    METHODS get_chart_with_error_handling
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_chart_data.
    LOOP AT it_raw_data INTO DATA(ls_point).
      IF ls_point-value < 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_chart_data EXPORTING text = |Negative value found for chart data: { ls_point-value }|.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_point TO rt_processed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_chart_with_error_handling.
    DATA lt_sample_data TYPE tt_chart_points.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sample_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_point>).
    <fs_point>-date = sy-datum.
    <fs_point>-value = 100.
    <fs_point>-category = 'Valid Data'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sample_data ASSIGNING <fs_point>.
    <fs_point>-date = sy-datum.
    <fs_point>-value = -50. " Invalid data
    <fs_point>-category = 'Invalid Data'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lt_valid_data) = process_chart_data( lt_sample_data ).
        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = lt_valid_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = 'Daten mit Fehlerbehandlung' i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_chart_data INTO DATA(lx_invalid_data).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_data->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_config_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mv_title TYPE string.
    DATA mv_color TYPE string.
    DATA mt_data  TYPE tt_chart_points.

    METHODS set_title
      IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config_builder.

    METHODS set_color
      IMPORTING iv_color TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config_builder.

    METHODS add_data
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_chart_points
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chart_config_builder.

    METHODS render_chart
      RAISING cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_config_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_title.
    me->mv_title = iv_title.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_color.
    me->mv_color = iv_color.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_data.
    APPEND LINES OF it_data TO me->mt_data.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD render_chart.
    TRY.
        IF me->mv_title IS INITIAL OR me->mt_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Chart title or data is missing.'.
        ENDIF.
        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den konfigurierten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->set_title( me->mv_title )->set_color( me->mv_color )->add_data( me->mt_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).
        MESSAGE |Chart '{ me->mv_title }' rendered with color '{ me->mv_color }' and { lines( me->mt_data ) } data points.| TYPE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
          UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'No flight data found.'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_price = lt_sflight[ KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate ]-price.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit dem ermittelten Preis
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->set_title( |Preis für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate }: { rv_price }| ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } not found.|.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             flight_date TYPE d,
             flight_value TYPE decfloat16,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_data_for_chart
      IMPORTING it_source_data TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data_for_chart.
    TRY.
        IF it_source_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Source data for mapping is empty.'.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_data MAPPING date = flight_date
                                                          value = flight_value
                                                          category = carrier_id ).

        IF rt_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Mapping resulted in no data.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_switch_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status_data,
             fldate TYPE d,
             status TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_status_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_status_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_by_status
      IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE tt_flight_status_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_switch_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_by_status.
    TRY.
        IF it_raw_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Input data for categorization is empty.'.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_points(
          FOR data_point IN it_raw_data
          ( date = data_point-fldate,
            value = data_point-value,
            category = SWITCH string(
                         data_point-status
                         WHEN 'C' THEN 'Confirmed'
                         WHEN 'X' THEN 'Cancelled'
                         WHEN 'D' THEN 'Delayed'
                         ELSE 'Unknown Status' )
          )
        ).

        IF rt_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Categorization resulted in no data.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = 'Flugstatus-Verteilung' i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_optional_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD configure_and_render_chart.
    DATA lv_final_title TYPE string.
    DATA lv_final_color TYPE string VALUE 'Default'.
    DATA lv_final_source TYPE string VALUE 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT'.

    TRY.
        IF it_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Chart data is missing.'.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_title IS SUPPLIED AND iv_title IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_final_title = iv_title.
        ELSE.
          lv_final_title = 'Standard Chart Title'.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_color IS SUPPLIED AND iv_color IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_final_color = iv_color.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_source IS SUPPLIED AND iv_source IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_final_source = iv_source.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit optionalen Parametern
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = it_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = lv_final_title i_color = lv_final_color i_source = lv_final_source ).
        MESSAGE |Chart '{ lv_final_title }' rendered with color '{ lv_final_color }' from source '{ lv_final_source }'.| TYPE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_conv_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_point,
             date     TYPE d,
             value    TYPE decfloat16,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_point.
    TYPES tt_chart_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_point WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_chart_data_with_string_conv
      IMPORTING iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_points
      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_conv_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_chart_data_with_string_conv.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TRY.
        SELECT fldate, price, carrid
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data)
          UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'No flight data found.'.
        ENDIF.

        rt_chart_data = VALUE tt_chart_points(
          FOR flight IN lt_raw_data
          ( date = flight-fldate,
            value = flight-price,
            category = CONV string( flight-price ) && ' EUR' )
        ).

        IF rt_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Conversion resulted in no data.'.
        ENDIF.

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den vorbereiteten Daten
        " DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
        " lo_chart->add_data( i_data = rt_chart_data ).
        " lo_chart->render( i_title = 'Preise als String-Kategorien' i_source = 'S_DBMON_ORA_COCKPIT' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = lx_invalid_value->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_root EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_chart_advanced INHERITING FROM zif_chart_base.

CLASS zcl_chart_implementation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_chart_advanced.
    DATA mv_axis_label TYPE string.

    METHODS zif_chart_base~add_data.

      RAISING   cx_abap_invalid_value.

CLASS zcl_chart_implementation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_chart_base~add_data.
    APPEND LINES OF it_data TO me->mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_chart_advanced~set_custom_axis_label.
    me->mv_axis_label = iv_label.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD render_chart_with_cast.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_advanced_chart) = CAST zif_chart_advanced( io_chart_base ).
        lo_advanced_chart->set_custom_axis_label( 'Custom Time Axis' ).
        lo_advanced_chart->add_data( VALUE #( ( date = sy-datum value = 100 category = 'Cast Test' ) ) ).

        " Hypothetische Verwendung von cl_time_chart_simple mit den konfigurierten Daten

        MESSAGE |Chart rendered with custom axis label: { lo_advanced_chart->mv_axis_label }| TYPE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_cast_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING text = 'Invalid cast: Object is not of type zif_chart_advanced.'.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.

        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die aus der `sflights` Tabelle nur die Flugnummern und die Währung enthält, wobei die Flugnummern in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid_lower TYPE string, " Flugnummer in Kleinbuchstaben
             currency     TYPE sflight-loccur,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                              ( connid_lower = to_lower( <fs_flight>-connid )
                                currency     = <fs_flight>-loccur ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflights_transform( ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights` Tabelle, um alle Flüge von 'FRA' nach 'NYC' zu finden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_route
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_from_city   TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_to_city     TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_route.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_from_city AND cityto = iv_to_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_not_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_found.
    DATA lt_mock_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '400'.
    <fs_sflight>-cityfrom = 'FRA'.
    <fs_sflight>-cityto = 'NYC'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '100'.
    <fs_sflight>-cityfrom = 'JFK'.
    <fs_sflight>-cityto = 'LAX'.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_route(
                           it_all_flights = lt_mock_sflights
                           iv_from_city   = 'FRA'
                           iv_to_city     = 'NYC' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 flight from FRA to NYC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRA' msg = 'City From mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityto exp = 'NYC' msg = 'City To mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_not_found.

    <fs_sflight>-cityfrom = 'FRA'.
    <fs_sflight>-cityto = 'NYC'.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_route(
                           it_all_flights = lt_mock_sflights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL exp = abap_true msg = 'No flights should be found for non-existent route' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (SITAS) aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der `sflights` Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR <fs_flight> IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-sitas ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Plätze (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) einen Status ('Available', 'Limited', 'Full') zu. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `COND` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `WHEN` und `ELSE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                    LET lv_free_seats = <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc IN
                                    ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                                      connid = <fs_flight>-connid,
                                      fldate = <fs_flight>-fldate,
                                      status = COND string( WHEN lv_free_seats > 50 THEN 'Available'
                                                           WHEN lv_free_seats > 10 THEN 'Limited'
                                                           ELSE 'Full' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `RECEIVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_static_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_another_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_result> TYPE any.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING r = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_static_string.
    rv_text = 'This is a static string.'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_another_string.
    rv_text = 'This is another string.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Listen Sie alle Dateien und Unterverzeichnisse in einem bestimmten Verzeichnis auf dem Applikationsserver auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `get_directory_listing` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_FILE_UTILITIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dir_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_file_entry,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string, " 'F' for file, 'D' for directory
      END OF ty_file_entry,
      tt_file_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dir_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_directory_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_entries) TYPE tt_file_entries
      RAISING
        cx_abap_file_utilities.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dir_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dir_content.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_listing) = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_directory_listing( iv_directory_path ).
        rt_entries = VALUE #( FOR entry IN lt_listing ( 
          name = entry-name
          type = COND string( WHEN entry-is_directory = abap_true THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' )
        ) ).
      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_file_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dir_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dir_list( ).
    DATA(lv_test_dir) = '/tmp/test_dir_listing'.
    DATA(lv_file1) = lv_test_dir && '/file1.txt'.
    DATA(lv_subdir) = lv_test_dir && '/subdir'.
    DATA(lv_file2) = lv_subdir && '/file2.txt'.

    " Setup test directory and files
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_test_dir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_file_as_string( i_file_name = lv_file1 i_content = 'Content 1' ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>create_directory( lv_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>write_file_as_string( i_file_name = lv_file2 i_content = 'Content 2' ).

    DATA(lt_entries) = lo_cut->get_dir_content( lv_test_dir ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_entries )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should find 2 entries'
    ).

    DATA(ls_entry_file1) = lt_entries[ KEY name = 'file1.txt' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_file1-type exp = 'F' msg = 'file1.txt should be a file' ).

    DATA(ls_entry_subdir) = lt_entries[ KEY name = 'subdir' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry_subdir-type exp = 'D' msg = 'subdir should be a directory' ).

    " Clean up
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file2 ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_subdir ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_file( lv_file1 ).
    cl_abap_file_utilities=>delete_directory( lv_test_dir ).

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflights=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      ( sign = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = if_fsbp_const_range=>sign_include option = if_fsbp_const_range=>option_equal low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrid(
      it_all_flights  = lt_all_flights
      it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_flights )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should filter 3 flights (LH, UA)'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE, RANGE, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS
