Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Anzeige, die die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme auslöst, wenn die Anzahl der angezeigten Flüge einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, um eine Überlastung zu verhindern.
hint: Verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_overflow, wenn die Anzahl der Zeilen zu groß ist.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_limit_exceeded DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_actual_count TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_limit TYPE i OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_actual_count TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_limit TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_limit_exceeded IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_actual_count = iv_actual_count.
    me->mv_limit = iv_limit.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_limit_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flights_with_limit
      IMPORTING iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RAISING zcx_flight_limit_exceeded.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_limit_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_limit.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > iv_max_flights.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_limit_exceeded
        EXPORTING
          iv_actual_count = lv_flight_count
          iv_limit        = iv_max_flights.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = VALUE #( )
            IMPORTING
              r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights
          ).
          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flüge gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_limit_exceeded FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_flight_limit_exceeded.
    METHODS test_limit_not_exceeded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_limit_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_limit_check( ).
    DATA lv_sflights_total TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_sflights_total.

    IF lv_sflights_total > 1.
      TRY.
          lo_cut->display_flights_with_limit( iv_max_flights = 1 ). " Set a low limit to force exception
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'zcx_flight_limit_exceeded was expected but not raised.' ).
        CATCH zcx_flight_limit_exceeded INTO DATA(lx_limit_exceeded).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
            act = lx_limit_exceeded->mv_limit
            exp = 1
            msg = 'Limit should be correctly passed to exception.'
          ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( 'SFLIGHTS has too few entries to test limit exceeded.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_limit_not_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_limit_check( ).
    DATA lv_sflights_total TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_sflights_total.

    IF lv_sflights_total > 0.
      TRY.
          lo_cut->display_flights_with_limit( iv_max_flights = lv_sflights_total + 1 ). " Set limit higher than actual count
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( 1 = 1 )
            msg = 'Method should complete without exception when limit is not exceeded.' ).
        CATCH zcx_flight_limit_exceeded.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'zcx_flight_limit_exceeded should not be raised.' ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>skip( 'SFLIGHTS has no entries to test limit not exceeded.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (ZCX_FLIGHT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) verwendet, um eine Überlastung der ALV-Anzeige zu verhindern, wenn zu viele Datenzeilen vorhanden sind. Die Ausnahme wird mit RAISE EXCEPTION ausgelöst, wenn die Anzahl der Flüge einen definierten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Dies ist eine proaktive Fehlerbehandlung, die die Systemstabilität verbessert und eine bessere Benutzererfahrung bietet, indem sie verhindert, dass zu große Datenmengen angezeigt werden. Die Verwendung von LINES(...) für die Zeilenanzahl ist ein modernes Feature.
keywords: RAISE, Custom Exception, Exception Handling, LINES, cl_salv_table, SFLIGHTS, Performance

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Anzeige, die die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Fügen Sie eine Spalte 'Travel_Time_Category' hinzu, die 'Short', 'Medium' oder 'Long' basierend auf der Flugdauer (fldate - arrdate) zuweist. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine Kombination aus COND und arithmetischen Operationen.
hint: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen Flug- und Ankunftsdatum und verwenden Sie COND für die Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_travel_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid             TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid             TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate             TYPE s_date,
             arrdate            TYPE s_date,
             travel_time_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.
    TYPES: tt_flight_duration TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_with_duration
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_duration) TYPE tt_flight_duration.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_travel_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_duration.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_duration = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid             = flight-carrid
                                    connid             = flight-connid
                                    fldate             = flight-fldate
                                    arrdate            = flight-arrdate
                                    travel_time_category = COND string(
                                                             LET lv_duration = flight-arrdate - flight-fldate IN
                                                             WHEN lv_duration <= 1 THEN `Short`
                                                             WHEN lv_duration > 1 AND lv_duration <= 3 THEN `Medium`
                                                             WHEN lv_duration > 3 THEN `Long`
                                                             ELSE `Unknown` )
                                  ) ).

    IF rt_flight_duration IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Anzeige, die die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Fügen Sie eine Spalte 'Booking_Status' hinzu, die 'Confirmed' anzeigt, wenn die Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze (booked) kleiner als die maximale Kapazität (max_seats) ist, andernfalls 'Full'. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine REDUCE-Expression, um den Status zu aggregieren, falls mehrere Flüge pro Verbindung existieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE mit GROUP BY und einer COND-Expression, um den aggregierten Buchungsstatus zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_booking_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_status,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             booking_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_booking_status.
    TYPES: tt_booking_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_booking_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_booking_status) TYPE tt_booking_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_booking_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_booking_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_booking_status = REDUCE tt_booking_status(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_booking_status(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid, flight-connid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid
        connid = flight-connid
        booking_status = COND string(
                           WHEN SUM( flight-booked ) < SUM( flight-max_seats ) THEN `Confirmed`
                           ELSE `Full` )
      ) ) ).

    IF rt_booking_status IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = VALUE #( )
            IMPORTING
              r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
            CHANGING
              t_table = rt_booking_status
          ).
          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Buchungsstatusdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von REDUCE mit GROUP BY, um aggregierte Daten zu verarbeiten und einen 'Booking_Status' zu ermitteln. Innerhalb der REDUCE-Expression wird eine COND-Expression verwendet, um den Status basierend auf der Summe der gebuchten Sitze und der maximalen Kapazität zu bestimmen. Dies ist ein sehr leistungsstarkes und modernes Feature (ABAP 7.50+), das komplexe Aggregationslogik in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung zusammenfasst.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ALV-Anzeige, die die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Fügen Sie eine Spalte 'Average_Occupancy' hinzu, die die durchschnittliche Auslastung des Fluges in Prozent berechnet (booked / max_seats * 100). Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass max_seats 0 ist, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden, und lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, wenn dies auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine COND-Expression, um die Division durch Null zu vermeiden, und RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error bei Bedarf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid           TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid           TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate           TYPE s_date,
             booked           TYPE s_booked,
             max_seats        TYPE s_max_seats,
             average_occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES: tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_avg_occupancy
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy
      RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_avg_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid           = flight-carrid
                                     connid           = flight-connid
                                     fldate           = flight-fldate
                                     booked           = flight-booked
                                     max_seats        = flight-max_seats
                                     average_occupancy = COND #( WHEN flight-max_seats > 0
                                                                 THEN ( CONV p( flight-booked ) / flight-max_seats ) * 100
                                                                 ELSE THROW cx_sy_arithmetic_error( textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero ) ) )
                                   ).

    IF rt_flight_occupancy IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = VALUE #( )
            IMPORTING
              r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
            CHANGING
              t_table = rt_flight_occupancy
          ).
          lo_salv_table->display( ).
        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten mit Auslastung gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_occupancy_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_avg_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_occupancy) = lo_cut->display_avg_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_flight_occupancy
      msg = 'Occupancy data should not be initial if SFLIGHTS has data.'
      p_reverse = abap_true
    ).
    IF lt_flight_occupancy IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_flight_occupancy[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_first_entry-average_occupancy ).
      IF ls_first_entry-max_seats > 0.
        DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) = ( CONV p( ls_first_entry-booked ) / ls_first_entry-max_seats ) * 100.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_first_entry-average_occupancy
          exp = lv_expected_occupancy
          msg = 'Average occupancy should be calculated correctly.'
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    " To test division by zero, we need to simulate a flight with max_seats = 0.
    " This is not directly possible with SFLIGHTS. We'll simulate it by creating a dummy table.
    DATA lt_dummy_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum booked = 10 max_seats = 0 ) TO lt_dummy_sflights.

    " Temporarily replace the SELECT statement with a mock for testing.
    " This requires advanced test double techniques not easily shown in a simple example.
    " For this example, we'll assume the THROW in COND is tested.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_avg_occupancy( ).
    TRY.
        " This call would ideally use a mocked SFLIGHTS with max_seats = 0.
        " As direct mocking of SELECT is complex, we rely on the THROW in COND.
        " We cannot easily inject a row with max_seats = 0 into SFLIGHTS for a unit test.
        " The test here is conceptual for the THROW part.
        " A real test would involve a test double for the database access.
        lo_cut->display_avg_occupancy( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_arithmetic_error was expected but not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_arith_error->textid
          exp = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero
          msg = 'Division by zero error should be raised.'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel berechnet die durchschnittliche Auslastung von Flügen und demonstriert die Verwendung von THROW innerhalb einer COND-Expression. THROW ermöglicht das Auslösen einer Ausnahme direkt innerhalb eines Ausdrucks, was eine sehr kompakte Fehlerbehandlung für spezifische Bedingungen (wie Division durch Null) ermöglicht. Die Konvertierung zu Typ P (packed number) ist wichtig für präzise Dezimalberechnungen. Die Ausnahme CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Division durch Null versucht wird.
keywords: COND, THROW, Arithmetic, Exception Handling, cx_sy_arithmetic_error, Internal Tables, cl_salv_table, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die nächsten 5 Arbeitstage ab heute (ohne Wochenenden) und zeigen Sie diese mit `cl_demo_output` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_reca_date=>create_today`, `add_days`, `get_weekday` und eine `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_next_working_days.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_next_working_days.
    DATA: lt_working_days TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lo_date TYPE REF TO cl_reca_date.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d.
    DATA: lv_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    lo_date = cl_reca_date=>create_today( ).

    DO.
      lv_current_date = lo_date->get_date( ).
      IF lo_date->get_weekday( ) <> 6 AND lo_date->get_weekday( ) <> 7. " 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
        APPEND lv_current_date TO lt_working_days.
        lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lo_date->add_days( 1 ).
      IF lv_counter = 5.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_demo_output=>display_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = lt_working_days
        name  = 'Next 5 Working Days'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen einzeln aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO iv_count TIMES.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
        ELSE.
          EXIT. " Keine weiteren Zeilen oder Fehler
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    lv_where_clause = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrier }'|.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflights
        WHERE (lv_where_clause)
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
        ELSE.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse mit einer modernen `FOR`-Schleife, um eine interne Tabelle zu füllen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit `FOR ... IN` für die Iteration über die Cursor-Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flights_with_for
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_with_for.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rt_flights = VALUE #( 
        FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_max_rows
        LET ls_sflight = CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_data( VALUE #( ) ) IN
          ( FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight. 
            IF sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_sflight ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) ENDIF ) 
      OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
        FROM sflights
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
          CLEAR lt_package.
        ELSE.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit der Cursor-Verarbeitung, um die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft zu berechnen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_seats,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_seats.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_seats.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
        FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE sy-subrc = 0
        LET ls_current_flight = CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_seats( VALUE #( ) ) IN
          ( FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_current_flight.
            IF sy-subrc = 0 THEN sum = sum + ls_current_flight-seatsocc ELSE sum = sum ENDIF ) ).
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,

    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_cursor_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_plane.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, planetype
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_flight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights_raw.
        ELSE.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_plane_counts = REDUCE tt_plane_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_plane_count( )
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_flights_raw
      LET lv_index = result[ KEY planetype = ls_raw-planetype ]-flight_count IN
        ( result = VALUE tt_plane_count( 
                     FOR ls_res IN result WHERE ( ls_res-planetype <> ls_raw-planetype ) ( ls_res )
                     ( planetype = ls_raw-planetype flight_count = lv_index + 1 )
                   ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. sflights) in ein CSV-Format als XSTRING, um es als E-Mail-Anhang zu versenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert` mit der Methode `string_to_xstring` nach der Konvertierung der Tabelle in einen String.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_csv_line TYPE string.

    " Add header row
    lv_csv_line = 'Airline,Connection,Flight Date,Price,Currency'.
    APPEND lv_csv_line TO DATA(lt_csv_lines).

    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_line = |{ ls_sflight-carrid },{ ls_sflight-connid },{ ls_sflight-fldate },{ ls_sflight-price },{ ls_sflight-currency }|.
      APPEND lv_csv_line TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Concatenate lines into a single string
    lv_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR line IN lt_csv_lines NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line ) ).

    " Convert string to xstring using cl_bcs_convert
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
          iv_string = lv_string
          iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        " Handle error
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_csv_conversion FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_conversion.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_bcs_csv_convert=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_sflight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_csv_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_sflight_to_csv_xstring( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'XSTRING should not be initial' ).

    " Convert back to string for assertion
    DATA(lv_string_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(

    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = |Airline,Connection,Flight Date,Price,Currency{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }LH,0400,{ sy-datum },100.00,EUR|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_back exp = lv_expected_string msg = 'Converted CSV string mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung einer internen Tabelle in ein CSV-Format und anschließend in ein XSTRING mittels `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring`. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie String-Templates (`|...|`), `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung und Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`). Dies ist effizient für die Erstellung von E-Mail-Anhängen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) unter Verwendung der REDUCE-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einem INIT-Wert und der NEXT-Anweisung, um die Preise zu addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0.00
      FOR ls_price IN it_sflight_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_price-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_calculation.
    DATA: lt_prices TYPE zcl_cmp_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( price = '100.00' ) TO lt_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( price = '250.50' ) TO lt_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( price = '50.00' ) TO lt_prices.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' msg = 'Total price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_prices TYPE zcl_cmp_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_prices ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' msg = 'Empty table sum should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ist eine moderne Möglichkeit, Aggregationen über interne Tabellen durchzuführen. Anstatt einer expliziten `LOOP`-Anweisung mit einer `SUM`-Variable, ermöglicht `REDUCE` eine kompakte und lesbare Syntax zur Berechnung der Gesamtsumme. Der `COMPUTE`-Operator ist hier implizit in der `sum = sum + ls_price-price`-Operation enthalten.
keywords: REDUCE, COMPUTE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Sum

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei ein neues Feld `total_cost` berechnet wird, das den `price` multipliziert mit einem `factor` darstellt. Nutzen Sie die `VALUE`-Anweisung für die Inline-Erstellung und Berechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... IN ... )` mit einer `total_cost = ls_sflight-price * iv_factor` Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_value_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             total_cost TYPE sflight-price, " New field for calculated cost
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_in,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_in.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_extended_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_in TYPE tt_sflight_in
        iv_factor     TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_ext) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_value_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_extended_prices.
    rt_sflight_ext = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight_in
      ( carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid     = ls_sflight-connid
        price      = ls_sflight-price
        total_cost = ls_sflight-price * iv_factor " Inline calculation
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculation_with_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculation_with_value.
    DATA: lt_sflight_in TYPE zcl_cmp_value_calc=>tt_sflight_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight_in.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = '200.50' ) TO lt_sflight_in.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_value_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_ext) = lo_cut->calculate_extended_prices(
      it_sflight_in = lt_sflight_in
      iv_factor     = '1.2'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight_ext ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of lines mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflight_ext INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-total_cost exp = '120.00' msg = 'First entry total_cost mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflight_ext INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_second_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_second_entry-total_cost exp = '240.60' msg = 'Second entry total_cost mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight_in TYPE zcl_cmp_value_calc=>tt_sflight_in.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_value_calc( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_ext) = lo_cut->calculate_extended_prices(
      it_sflight_in = lt_sflight_in
      iv_factor     = '1.5'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflight_ext msg = 'Result table should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Anweisung ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen. In diesem Beispiel wird sie verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, wobei für jedes Element der Quelltabelle ein neues Feld `total_cost` inline berechnet wird. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu transformieren und Berechnungen direkt in der Zuweisung durchzuführen, was die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Anweisungen reduziert.
keywords: VALUE, COMPUTE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Inline Calculation

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn ein Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll ein erhöhter Preis zugewiesen werden, ansonsten der Originalpreis. Nutzen Sie die `COND`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND #( WHEN condition THEN value1 ELSE value2 )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_cond_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_adjusted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_price      TYPE sflight-price
        iv_threshold  TYPE sflight-price
        iv_surcharge  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_adjusted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_cond_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_price.
    rv_adjusted_price = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_price > iv_threshold
      THEN iv_price + iv_surcharge " Compute new price
      ELSE iv_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Rabattprozentsatz basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft zu. Nutzen Sie die `SWITCH`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH #( expression WHEN value1 THEN result1 WHEN value2 THEN result2 ELSE default_result )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_switch_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_discount_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discount_percent) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_switch_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discount_percentage.
    rv_discount_percent = SWITCH #( iv_carrid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in ein JSON-Format konvertiert und dieses JSON als XSTRING zurückgibt, um es als E-Mail-Anhang zu versenden. Nutzen Sie die `cl_bcs_convert` für die XSTRING-Konvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_json_writer` oder `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für die JSON-Serialisierung und `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_json_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_json_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_json_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_json_xstring.
    DATA: lv_json_string TYPE string.

    " Convert internal table to JSON string
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = it_sflight
            pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-camel_case
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Convert JSON string to xstring
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
          iv_string = lv_json_string
          iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights` den durchschnittlichen Preis und die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und innerhalb des Gruppen-Loops `REDUCE` für die Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_group_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_stats,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price     TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_stats.
    TYPES: tt_carr_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_carrier_stats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carr_stats) TYPE tt_carr_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_group_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_carrier_stats.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight_line) GROUP BY ls_sflight_line-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT s = 0.00
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight_line
        NEXT s = s + ls_grouped_flight-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT c = 0
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight_line
        NEXT c = c + 1
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( 
        carrid       = ls_sflight_line-carrid
        avg_price    = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_price / lv_count ELSE 0.00 ) " Compute average
        flight_count = lv_count
      ) TO rt_carr_stats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_stats-flight_count exp = 3 msg = 'LH flight count mismatch' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_stats-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'AA flight count mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_cmp_group_reduce=>tt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->calculate_carrier_stats( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_stats ) exp = 1 msg = 'Number of carriers mismatch for single carrier' ).
    READ TABLE lt_stats WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' INTO DATA(ls_ba_stats).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `REDUCE`-Anweisung. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb von Gruppen auf eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Weise. Anstatt manueller Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen für jede Aggregation, können `REDUCE`-Ausdrücke direkt verwendet werden, um Summen und Zählungen zu berechnen. Die Division zur Berechnung des Durchschnitts ist eine direkte Anwendung des `COMPUTE`-Operators.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Average, COMPUTE

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und berechnen Sie dann die Summe dieser gefilterten Preise. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die `FILTER`-Anweisung mit der `REDUCE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cmp_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = FILTER zcl_cmp_filter_reduce=>tt_sflight(
      it_sflight WHERE price > iv_threshold
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0.00
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_expensive_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cmp_group_min_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,

CLASS zcl_cmp_group_min_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_carrier_price_range.
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight_line) GROUP BY ls_sflight_line-carrid.
      DATA(lv_min_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT min_p = '999999999.99'
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight_line
        NEXT min_p = COND #( WHEN ls_grouped_flight-price < min_p THEN ls_grouped_flight-price ELSE min_p ) " Compute min
      ).
      DATA(lv_max_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
        INIT max_p = '0.00'
        FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight_line
        NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN ls_grouped_flight-price > max_p THEN ls_grouped_flight-price ELSE max_p ) " Compute max
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( 
        carrid    = ls_sflight_line-carrid
        min_price = lv_min_price
        max_price = lv_max_price
      ) TO rt_carr_price_range.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_cmp_group_min_max=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_group_min_max( ).
    DATA(lt_price_range) = lo_cut->calculate_carrier_price_range( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_price_range ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of carriers mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_price_range WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_range).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_range-min_price exp = '50.00' msg = 'LH min price mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_range-max_price exp = '150.00' msg = 'LH max price mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_price_range WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_range).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_range-max_price exp = '250.00' msg = 'AA max price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_price_range msg = 'Result table should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_flight_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_cmp_group_min_max=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cmp_group_min_max( ).
    DATA(lt_price_range) = lo_cut->calculate_carrier_price_range( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_price_range ) exp = 1 msg = 'Number of carriers mismatch for single flight' ).
    READ TABLE lt_price_range WITH KEY carrid = 'BA' INTO DATA(ls_ba_range).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_range-min_price exp = '300.00' msg = 'BA min price mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ba_range-max_price exp = '300.00' msg = 'BA max price mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` um die Berechnung von Minimum- und Maximumwerten innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Die `COND`-Anweisung wird innerhalb von `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Vergleichslogik für `MIN` und `MAX` kompakt zu implementieren. Dies zeigt, wie komplexe Aggregationen mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxelementen effizient und lesbar durchgeführt werden können, wobei `COMPUTE`-Operationen für die Vergleiche und Zuweisungen genutzt werden.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der eine Base64-kodierte Zeichenkette enthält, in ein XSTRING. Dies ist nützlich, wenn binäre Daten als Text übertragen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>base64_to_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_base64_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_base64_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_base64_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_base64_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_base64_to_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_xstring = cl_bcs_convert=>base64_to_xstring(
          iv_base64_string = iv_base64_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_base64_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_base64 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_base64 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base64_conversion.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello, Base64!'.
    DATA(lv_base64_encoded) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_base64(
      iv_string = lv_original_string
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_base64_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_base64_to_xstring( lv_base64_encoded ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'XSTRING should not be initial' ).

    DATA(lv_string_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string(
      iv_xstring = lv_xstring
      iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_back exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Base64 conversion mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_base64.
    DATA(lv_base64_encoded) = ''.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_base64_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_base64_to_xstring( lv_base64_encoded ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'Empty Base64 should result in empty XSTRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_base64.
    DATA(lv_invalid_base64) = 'Invalid Base64 String!'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_base64_to_xstring( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_base64_to_xstring( lv_invalid_base64 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_BCS_ERROR for invalid Base64' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_BCS_ERROR caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_bcs_convert=>base64_to_xstring` ist unerlässlich, wenn binäre Daten (z.B. Bilder, Dokumente) als Base64-kodierter String übertragen werden und dann im ABAP-System als XSTRING weiterverarbeitet werden müssen. Dies ist eine häufige Anforderung in der Integration mit Web-Services oder bei der Verarbeitung von E-Mail-Anhängen, die in diesem Format vorliegen.
keywords: cl_bcs_convert, Base64, XSTRING, Data Conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine externe Datums-/Uhrzeit-Kombination in die interne ABAP-Darstellung, unter Berücksichtigung einer Zeitzone und eines externen Formats.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( )->convert_date_time_to_internal()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_conv_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_datetime_int,
             date TYPE sy-datum,
             time TYPE sy-uzeit,
           END OF ty_datetime_int.

    METHODS convert_to_internal
      IMPORTING
        iv_ext_date TYPE string
        iv_ext_time TYPE string
        iv_tzone    TYPE timezone
        iv_datfm    TYPE datfm
        iv_timfm    TYPE timfm
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_datetime_int) TYPE ty_datetime_int
      RAISING
        cx_abap_datfm_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_conv_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_internal.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        lo_datfm->convert_date_time_to_internal(
          EXPORTING
            iv_ext_date = iv_ext_date
            iv_ext_time = iv_ext_time
            iv_tzone    = iv_tzone
            iv_datfm    = iv_datfm
            iv_timfm    = iv_timfm
          IMPORTING
            ev_date     = rs_datetime_int-date
            ev_time     = rs_datetime_int-time
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder erneutes Werfen
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_datfm_error EXPORTING previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflight`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und den verdoppelten Preis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price_x2 TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_flight>-connid
        price_x2 = <fs_flight>-price * 2 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_sflights( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2, msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte 2 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price_x2 exp = '200.00', msg = 'Preis des ersten Fluges sollte verdoppelt sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price_x2 exp = '400.00', msg = 'Preis des zweiten Fluges sollte verdoppelt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als traditionelle `LOOP`-Konstrukte und nutzt moderne funktionale Programmieransätze.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflight`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_sflights.

solution:
CLASS zcl_distinct_carrier_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_distinct_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_distinct_carrier_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_distinct_carriers.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0
                             FOR DISTINCT carrid IN it_flights
                             WHERE ( carrid IS NOT INITIAL )
                             NEXT c = c + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben, und geben Sie deren Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT COUNT(*)` mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_having_count_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_having_count_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_carriers_with_many_flights.
    DATA lt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Elemente in einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und verwenden Sie dabei eine Lambda-Funktion für die Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COUNT` mit `FOR` und einer `COND` Expression, die eine Lambda-Funktion aufruft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lambda_count_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lambda_count_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_even_numbers.
    rv_count = COUNT( FOR num IN it_numbers WHERE ( num-value MOD 2 = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_even_numbers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_lambda_count_demo( ).
    DATA lt_numbers TYPE zcl_lambda_count_demo=>tt_numbers.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 1 ) TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 2 ) TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 3 ) TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 4 ) TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 5 ) TO lt_numbers.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_even_numbers( it_numbers = lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `COUNT` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer Bedingung verwendet werden kann, um Elemente zu zählen. Die Bedingung `num-value MOD 2 = 0` ist ein einfaches Beispiel für eine Inline-Logik.
keywords: COUNT, Internal Tables, FOR, Lambda, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Anzahl der Instanzen einer bestimmten Klasse zählt, die aktiv sind (z.B. in einer globalen Tabelle gespeichert).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Attribut in der Klasse, um die Anzahl der Instanzen zu verfolgen, und den `COUNT` Operator für eine interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_instance_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gt_instances TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_instance_counter WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS get_instance_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS destructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_instance_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    APPEND me TO gt_instances.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destructor.
    DELETE gt_instances WHERE table_line = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_instance_count.
    rv_count = COUNT( gt_instances ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_instance_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_instance_count.
    DATA(lv_initial_count) = zcl_instance_counter=>get_instance_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial_count exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lo_instance1) = NEW zcl_instance_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count1) = zcl_instance_counter=>get_instance_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count1 exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_instance2) = NEW zcl_instance_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_count2) = zcl_instance_counter=>get_instance_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count2 exp = 2 ).

    CLEAR lo_instance1.
    DATA(lv_count3) = zcl_instance_counter=>get_instance_count( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count3 exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Anzahl der aktiven Instanzen einer Klasse verfolgen kann, indem man eine statische interne Tabelle von Referenzen verwendet. Der `COUNT` Operator wird verwendet, um die Anzahl der Einträge in dieser Tabelle zu ermitteln. Die Methoden `constructor` und `destructor` werden genutzt, um die Tabelle zu aktualisieren.
keywords: COUNT, Object Orientation, Class, Static Attributes, Internal Tables

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der eindeutigen Flugverbindungen (CONNID) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.

      RETURNING

Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Duplikate direkt in der Datenbankabfrage zu eliminieren.
keywords: COUNT, Open SQL, DISTINCT, SFLIGHT, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstelle einen Custom Container und sorge für dessen korrekte Zerstörung beim Verlassen des Dynpros, um Speicherlecks zu vermeiden.
hint: Nutze die Methode `SET_LIFETIME_MANAGEMENT` des Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_container_lifetime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS free_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_container_lifetime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name.
    mo_container->set_lifetime_management( cl_gui_control=>lifetime_dynpro ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD free_container.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Error freeing container' TYPE 'E'.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lifetime_management FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_free_container FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lifetime_management.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_container_lifetime( 'MY_CONTAINER_LT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_free_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_container_lifetime( 'MY_CONTAINER_FREE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
    lo_cut->free_container( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Lifetime-Management von GUI-Controls ist entscheidend, um Speicherlecks zu verhindern. Die Methode `SET_LIFETIME_MANAGEMENT` mit `cl_gui_control=>lifetime_dynpro` (seit ABAP 7.40) ist der moderne Weg, um sicherzustellen, dass der Container automatisch freigegeben wird, wenn das zugehörige Dynpro verlassen wird. Die explizite `FREE`-Methode bietet zusätzliche Kontrolle.
keywords: cl_gui_custom_container, Lifetime Management, GUI, Object Orientation

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             function TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>function,
             text     TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>text,

      IMPORTING

    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_toolbar.
    " In a real scenario, io_container would be provided (e.g., cl_gui_custom_container).
    " For unit testing and demonstration without a full GUI context, we can omit it.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = io_container.
    ENDIF.

    rt_button_data = VALUE #( " Moderne Syntax für interne Tabelleninitialisierung
      ( function = 'SAVE' text = 'Speichern' )
      ( function = 'DELETE' text = 'Löschen' )
      ( function = 'REFRESH' text = 'Aktualisieren' )
    ).

    " Add buttons to the toolbar if it was created
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT rt_button_data INTO DATA(ls_button). " Inline-Deklaration
        mo_toolbar->add_button(
          fcode = ls_button-function
          text  = ls_button-text
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
      mo_toolbar->set_toolbar_design( cl_gui_toolbar=>design_flat ). " Modernes Design
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine `cl_gui_toolbar` instanziiert und Schaltflächen hinzufügt. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Sichtbarkeit einer Schaltfläche basierend auf einer Bedingung dynamisch ändert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_toolbar=>set_button_state` und moderne `COND` Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
    METHODS set_button_visibility
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode    TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>function
        iv_visible  TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS is_button_visible
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>function
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_visible) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mt_button_states TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_gui_toolbar=>ty_button_state WITH KEY fcode. " Zum Verfolgen des Zustands für Tests
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = io_container.
      mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'EDIT' text = 'Bearbeiten' ).
      mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'VIEW' text = 'Anzeigen' ).
    ENDIF.
    " Internen Zustand für Testzwecke initialisieren
    mt_button_states = VALUE #( " Moderne Syntax
      ( fcode = 'EDIT' visible = abap_true )
      ( fcode = 'VIEW' visible = abap_true )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_button_visibility.
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar->set_button_state(
        fcode = iv_fcode
        visible = iv_visible
      ).
    ENDIF.
    " Internen Zustand für Testzwecke aktualisieren
    READ TABLE mt_button_states WITH KEY fcode = iv_fcode INTO DATA(ls_state). " Inline-Deklaration
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_state-visible = iv_visible.
      MODIFY TABLE mt_button_states FROM ls_state.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_button_visible.
    READ TABLE mt_button_states WITH KEY fcode = iv_fcode INTO DATA(ls_state). " Inline-Deklaration
    rv_visible = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_state-visible ELSE abap_false ). " Moderner COND-Ausdruck
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_gui_toolbar_dynamic.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_button_visibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mo_cut = NEW zcl_gui_toolbar_dynamic( ). " Keine Container-Instanz für diesen Test erforderlich
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_button_visibility.
    " Initial sollten beide Schaltflächen sichtbar sein (gemäß interner Verfolgung)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = mo_cut->is_button_visible( 'EDIT' )
      msg = 'EDIT-Schaltfläche sollte initial sichtbar sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = mo_cut->is_button_visible( 'VIEW' )
      msg = 'VIEW-Schaltfläche sollte initial sichtbar sein.'
    ).

    " 'EDIT'-Schaltfläche ausblenden
    mo_cut->set_button_visibility( iv_fcode = 'EDIT' iv_visible = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = mo_cut->is_button_visible( 'EDIT' )
      msg = 'EDIT-Schaltfläche sollte unsichtbar sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = mo_cut->is_button_visible( 'VIEW' )
      msg = 'VIEW-Schaltfläche sollte weiterhin sichtbar sein.'
    ).

    " 'EDIT'-Schaltfläche wieder anzeigen
    mo_cut->set_button_visibility( iv_fcode = 'EDIT' iv_visible = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = mo_cut->is_button_visible( 'EDIT' )
      msg = 'EDIT-Schaltfläche sollte wieder sichtbar sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Klasse zeigt, wie die Sichtbarkeit von Toolbar-Schaltflächen dynamisch mit `set_button_state` geändert werden kann. Die Verwendung von `COND #(...)` im `is_button_visible`-Getter ist ein Beispiel für moderne Ausdruckssyntax. Der Unit-Test überprüft die korrekte Aktualisierung des internen Zustands der Schaltflächensichtbarkeit.
keywords: cl_gui_toolbar, Dynamic Programming, COND, abap_bool, GUI Controls, Visibility

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_calendar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS date_selected_from_dialog EXPORTING VALUE(e_date) TYPE d.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_toolbar_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
    METHODS get_selected_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_calendar_dialog TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mv_selected_date TYPE d.

    METHODS handle_toolbar_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING fcode.
    METHODS handle_calendar_date_selected FOR EVENT date_selected OF cl_gui_calendar
      IMPORTING selected_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_calendar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_toolbar_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = io_toolbar_container.
      mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'OPEN_CAL' text = 'Datum wählen' icon = icon_date ).
      SET HANDLER handle_toolbar_button_click FOR mo_toolbar. " Ereignis-Handler registrieren
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_button_click.
    IF fcode = 'OPEN_CAL'.
      " Kalender-Dialog erstellen
      cl_gui_calendar=>create_calendar_dialog(
        EXPORTING
          parent_container = mo_toolbar " Toolbar als logisches Parent für den Dialog verwenden
          title            = 'Datum auswählen'
          initial_date     = mv_selected_date
        IMPORTING
          calendar         = mo_calendar_dialog
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS           = 1
      ).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        SET HANDLER handle_calendar_date_selected FOR mo_calendar_dialog. " Ereignis-Handler für Dialog registrieren
        mo_calendar_dialog->set_display_mode( cl_gui_calendar=>display_mode_month ).
        mo_calendar_dialog->set_selected_date( mv_selected_date ).
        mo_calendar_dialog->set_visible( abap_true ). " Dialog anzeigen
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_calendar_date_selected.
    mv_selected_date = selected_date.
    RAISE EVENT date_selected_from_dialog EXPORTING e_date = selected_date. " Eigenes Ereignis auslösen
    mo_calendar_dialog->set_visible( abap_false ). " Dialog nach Auswahl ausblenden
    FREE mo_calendar_dialog. " Dialog freigeben
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_selected_date.
    rv_date = mv_selected_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_calendar_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
    METHODS set_displayed_month_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_year  TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>year
        iv_month TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>month.
    METHODS get_displayed_month_year
      EXPORTING
        ev_year  TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>year
        ev_month TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>month.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mv_displayed_year TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>year.  " Für Tests
    DATA mv_displayed_month TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>month. " Für Tests
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_calendar_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar EXPORTING parent = io_container.
      mo_calendar->set_display_mode( cl_gui_calendar=>display_mode_month ).
      mo_calendar->set_displayed_date( sy-datum ).
    ENDIF.
    mv_displayed_year = sy-datum(4). " Für Tests initialisieren
    mv_displayed_month = sy-datum+4(2). " Für Tests initialisieren
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_displayed_month_year.
    DATA(lv_date) = |{ iv_year ALPHA=OUT }{ iv_month ALPHA=OUT }01|. " String Template für Datumserstellung
    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      mo_calendar->set_displayed_date( lv_date ).
    ENDIF.
    mv_displayed_year = iv_year.
    mv_displayed_month = iv_month.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_displayed_month_year.
    DATA lv_date TYPE d.
    IF mo_calendar IS BOUND.
      mo_calendar->get_displayed_date( IMPORTING displayed_date = lv_date ).
    ELSE.
      lv_date = |{ mv_displayed_year ALPHA=OUT }{ mv_displayed_month ALPHA=OUT }01|. " Für Tests
    ENDIF.
    ev_year = lv_date(4).
    ev_month = lv_date+4(2).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD setup.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_month_year.
    DATA: lv_year  TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>year,
          lv_month TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>month.

    " Initial angezeigtes Jahr/Monat sollte SY-DATUM entsprechen
    mo_cut->get_displayed_month_year( EXPORTING ev_year = lv_year ev_month = lv_month ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_year  exp = sy-datum(4) msg = 'Initiales Jahr ist falsch.' ).

    mo_cut->get_displayed_month_year( EXPORTING ev_year = lv_year ev_month = lv_month ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_year  exp = '2026' msg = 'Gesetztes Jahr ist falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_month exp = '03'   msg = 'Gesetzter Monat ist falsch.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_toggle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
    METHODS toggle_edit_mode.
    METHODS is_edit_mode_active RETURNING VALUE(rv_active) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mv_edit_mode_active TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false. " Zustandsvariable

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING fcode.
    METHODS update_edit_button_icon.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_toggle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = io_container.
      mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = 'EDIT_TOGGLE' text = 'Bearbeiten' icon = icon_edit ).
      SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    IF fcode = 'EDIT_TOGGLE'.
      toggle_edit_mode( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD toggle_edit_mode.
    mv_edit_mode_active = COND #( WHEN mv_edit_mode_active = abap_true THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ). " Moderner COND-Ausdruck
    update_edit_button_icon( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_edit_button_icon.
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      DATA(lv_icon) = SWITCH cl_gui_toolbar=>icon(
        mv_edit_mode_active
        WHEN abap_true THEN icon_locked " Beispiel-Icon für aktiven Modus
        WHEN abap_false THEN icon_edit " Beispiel-Icon für inaktiven Modus
      ). " Moderner SWITCH-Ausdruck
      mo_toolbar->change_button( fcode = 'EDIT_TOGGLE' icon = lv_icon ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_edit_mode_active.
    rv_active = mv_edit_mode_active.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE tt_button_config( " Moderne Syntax
      ( fcode = 'BTN_A' text = 'Option A' )
      ( fcode = 'BTN_B' text = 'Option B' )
      ( fcode = 'BTN_C' text = 'Option C' )
    ).

    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar EXPORTING parent = io_container.
      LOOP AT lt_config INTO DATA(ls_config). " Inline-Deklaration
        mo_toolbar->add_button( fcode = ls_config-fcode text = ls_config-text ).
      ENDLOOP.

    " Schaltflächentexte für Testzwecke extrahieren
    mt_button_texts = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN lt_config ( ls_item-text ) ). " Moderner FOR-Ausdruck
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_concatenated_button_texts.
    rv_texts = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR text IN mt_button_texts

    ). " Moderner REDUCE-Ausdruck
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_sflights_to_xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_zip_compress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_to_xstring.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_xml_data TYPE xstring.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          "#EC CI_SERIALIZE
          CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE sflights = lt_sflights RESULT XML lv_xml_data.

          DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
          lo_zip->add(
            name   = 'sflights.xml'
            content = lv_xml_data
          ).
          lo_zip->save( EXPORTING compress_level = 9 IMPORTING zip_data = rv_compressed_data ).

        CATCH cx_transformation_error cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          " Handle error appropriately, e.g., log it
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_xstring_to_sflights
      IMPORTING iv_compressed_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_decompress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_xstring_to_sflights.
    DATA lv_xml_data TYPE xstring.

    IF iv_compressed_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
          lo_zip->load( iv_compressed_data ).
          lo_zip->get(
            EXPORTING
              name    = 'sflights.xml'
            IMPORTING
              content = lv_xml_data
          ).

          "#EC CI_DESERIALIZE
          CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_xml_data RESULT sflights = rt_sflights.

        CATCH cx_abap_zip_error cx_transformation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          " Handle error appropriately
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_content,
             name    TYPE string,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_content.
    TYPES: tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_content WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_zip_from_strings
      IMPORTING it_files TYPE tt_file_content
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_zip_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_multi_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_zip_from_strings.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring.

    IF it_files IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
          LOOP AT it_files INTO DATA(ls_file).
            " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
            CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
              EXPORTING
                text     = ls_file-content
                encoding = 'UTF-8'
              IMPORTING
                buffer   = lv_xstring_content.

            lo_zip->add(
              name    = ls_file-name
              content = lv_xstring_content
            ).
          ENDLOOP.
          lo_zip->save( EXPORTING compress_level = 9 IMPORTING zip_data = rv_zip_data ).

        CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
          MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_create_zip_multi_file.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_zip_multi_file,
          lt_files TYPE zcl_zip_multi_file=>tt_file_content,
          lv_zip_data TYPE xstring.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'file1.txt' content = 'Hello World 1' ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'file2.txt' content = 'Hello World 2' ) TO lt_files.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_zip_multi_file( ).
    lv_zip_data = lo_cut->create_zip_from_strings( lt_files ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_zip_data
      msg = 'ZIP data should not be initial'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).

    " Optional: Verify content by decompressing
    DATA(lo_zip_read) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip_read->load( lv_zip_data ).
    DATA(lt_zip_files) = lo_zip_read->get_files( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_zip_files ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_column_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_column_values.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflights,
                   <fs_value>   TYPE any.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <fs_value>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
