CLASS zcl_dyn_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Handle error: table not assigned
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.

      UNASSIGN <fs_field>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols
    ENDLOOP.

    UNASSIGN <lt_table>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1_value TYPE i
        iv_param2_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_param_value> TYPE any,
                   <fs_result>      TYPE any.

    " Parameter 1
    CREATE DATA: lo_data_param1 TYPE REF TO data.
    ASSIGN lo_data_param1->* TO <fs_param_value>.
    <fs_param_value> = iv_param1_value.
    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM1'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_param_value> INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    UNASSIGN <fs_param_value>.

    " Parameter 2
    CREATE DATA: lo_data_param2 TYPE REF TO data.
    ASSIGN lo_data_param2->* TO <fs_param_value>.
    <fs_param_value> = iv_param2_value.
    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NUM2'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_param_value> INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    UNASSIGN <fs_param_value>.

    " Result parameter
    CREATE DATA: lo_data_result TYPE REF TO data.
    ASSIGN lo_data_result->* TO <fs_result>.
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_SUM'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_returning.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_result> INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    UNASSIGN <fs_result>.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
        rv_result = lo_data_result->*.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle dynamisch eine interne Tabelle eines bestimmten Typs und fülle sie mit Daten. Greife dann dynamisch auf die Daten zu.
hint: Verwende `CREATE DATA TYPE TABLE OF ...`, `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_access_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_access_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_dynamic_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        " Get description of the table type (e.g., 'SFLIGHTS')
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        " Create dynamic internal table
        CREATE DATA: lo_data_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Create dynamic line and fill with data
        CREATE DATA: lo_data_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

        " Fill some data (example for SFLIGHTS)
        IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHTS'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = 'AZ'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = '0001'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = 'BA'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = '0002'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.

        " Access and return values
        LOOP AT <lt_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING <fs_dynamic_line>.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND |{ <fs_dynamic_field> }| TO rt_values.
          ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_descr_error cx_sy_table_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
    UNASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere einen einfachen String in ein XSTRING und dekomprimiere ihn anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_ZIP` mit `ADD` und `GET` sowie `SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING` und `SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_string_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_and_decompress_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_decompressed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_string_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_string.
    DATA: lv_xstring_original TYPE xstring,
          lv_xstring_compressed TYPE xstring,
          lv_xstring_decompressed TYPE xstring.

    " Convert original string to xstring
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_original_string
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring_original.

    TRY.
        " Compress
        DATA(lo_zip_compress) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
        lo_zip_compress->add(
          name    = 'data.txt'
          content = lv_xstring_original
        ).
        lo_zip_compress->save( EXPORTING compress_level = 9 IMPORTING zip_data = lv_xstring_compressed ).

        " Decompress
        DATA(lo_zip_decompress) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
        lo_zip_decompress->load( lv_xstring_compressed ).
        lo_zip_decompress->get(
          EXPORTING
            name    = 'data.txt'
          IMPORTING
            content = lv_xstring_decompressed
        ).

        " Convert decompressed xstring back to string
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
          EXPORTING
            buffer        = lv_xstring_decompressed
            encoding      = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            text          = rv_decompressed_string.

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_decompressed) = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress_string( lv_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_decompressed

      msg = 'Decompressed string should match original string'

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,

                   <fs_dynamic_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        " Get description of the structure type (e.g., 'SFLIGHT')
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type_name ).

        " Create dynamic internal table of this structure type
        CREATE DATA: lo_data_table TYPE TABLE OF HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Create dynamic line of this structure type
        CREATE DATA: lo_data_line TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_data_line->* TO <fs_dynamic_line>.

        " Fill some data (example for SFLIGHT)
        IF iv_struct_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = '0400'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = 'UA'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_dynamic_field> = '0010'. ENDIF.
          UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_field>.

          INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDIF.

        rv_line_count = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
    UNASSIGN <lt_dynamic_table>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_dynamic_line>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_table_line
      IMPORTING
        it_table       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_key_field   TYPE string
        iv_key_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_table_line.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE sflights.
    DATA: lv_key_value_typed TYPE string.

    " Assign key value to a typed variable for comparison
    lv_key_value_typed = iv_key_value.

    READ TABLE it_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>
      WITH KEY (iv_key_field) = lv_key_value_typed. " Dynamic key field

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_sflight = <fs_line>.
    ENDIF.
    UNASSIGN <fs_line>. " Freigabe des Feldsymbols
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_test_string
      exp = 'Modified String'
      msg = 'String should be modified via reference'
    ).

    " Manipulate integer
    lo_cut->manipulate_data_via_ref(
      ir_data      = REF #( lv_test_int )
      iv_new_value = '25' " String will be converted to integer
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_test_int
      exp = 25
      msg = 'Integer should be modified via reference'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Manipulation von Daten über eine dynamische Datenreferenz. Eine Referenz auf eine Variable wird an die Methode übergeben. Mit `ASSIGN data_reference->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL` wird der Inhalt der Referenz einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen, wodurch der Wert direkt geändert werden kann. Nach der Operation wird der Feldsymbol mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben. Dies ist eine grundlegende Technik für die generische Datenübergabe und -manipulation.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, UNASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, Data Reference, Dereferencing, REF

Instructions: Erstelle ein ZIP-Archiv, das eine Datei mit einem spezifischen Pfad (z.B. 'folder/subfolder/file.txt') enthält. Extrahiere diese Datei anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_ZIP` mit `ADD` (mit Pfadangabe im Namen) und `GET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_path_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_extract_file_with_path
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path_in_zip TYPE string
        iv_file_content     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_extracted_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_path_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_extract_file_with_path.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring,
          lv_zip_data        TYPE xstring,
          lv_xstring_extracted TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_file_content
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring_content.

    TRY.
        " Create ZIP with file at specific path
        DATA(lo_zip_create) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
        lo_zip_create->add(
          name    = iv_file_path_in_zip
          content = lv_xstring_content
        ).
        lo_zip_create->save( EXPORTING compress_level = 9 IMPORTING zip_data = lv_zip_data ).

        " Extract file from ZIP
        DATA(lo_zip_extract) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
        lo_zip_extract->load( lv_zip_data ).
        lo_zip_extract->get(
          EXPORTING
            name    = iv_file_path_in_zip
          IMPORTING
            content = lv_xstring_extracted
        ).

        " Convert extracted xstring back to string
        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
          EXPORTING
            buffer        = lv_xstring_extracted
            encoding      = 'UTF-8'
          IMPORTING
            text          = rv_extracted_content.

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_zip_path_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_zip_path_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_path_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_file_path) = 'my_folder/documents/report.txt'.
    DATA(lv_original_content) = 'This is a document inside a folder structure.'.
    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = lo_cut->create_and_extract_file_with_path(
      iv_file_path_in_zip = lv_file_path
      iv_file_content     = lv_original_content
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_extracted_content
      exp = lv_original_content
      msg = 'Extracted content should match original content'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Dateien mit Pfadangaben in einem ZIP-Archiv speichert und wieder extrahiert. Der Dateiname, der an `CL_ABAP_ZIP=>ADD` übergeben wird, kann einen vollständigen Pfad enthalten (z.B. 'folder/file.txt'). Die `GET`-Methode verwendet denselben Pfad, um die Datei zu extrahieren. Dies ist wichtig für die Organisation von Dateien innerhalb eines ZIP-Archivs.
keywords: CL_ABAP_ZIP, XSTRING, File Path, Compression, Decompression, SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING, SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie den dynamischen Zugriff auf eine Komponente einer Struktur mittels Feldsymbol und die explizite Freigabe des Feldsymbols mit `UNASSIGN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        is_data           TYPE ty_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Explizite Freigabe
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' is_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field1 value mismatch' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_component_value( iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' is_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '123' msg = 'Field2 value mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_component_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_unassign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_unassign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' is_data = ls_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Component not found' msg = 'Non-existent component should return error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNASSIGN` wird hier verwendet, um ein Feldsymbol explizit von seiner Zuweisung zu lösen. Obwohl in vielen modernen Szenarien implizite Zuweisungen ausreichen, ist `UNASSIGN` bei dynamischer Programmierung oder in Schleifen, wo Feldsymbole wiederverwendet werden, weiterhin nützlich, um Ressourcen freizugeben und unerwartetes Verhalten zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbol, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie programmatisch die Attribute eines Code Inspector Prüfobjekts (z.B. einer Klasse oder eines Reports) mithilfe der Klasse `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES` und dem Service `S_CODE_INSPECTOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES=>GET_ATTRIBUTES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_query_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ci_attribute,
             attribute_name  TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_ci_attribute.
    TYPES tt_ci_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ci_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ci_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE trobjtype " e.g., 'CLAS', 'PROG'
        iv_object_name TYPE sobj_name " e.g., 'ZCL_MY_CLASS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_ci_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_ci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ci_attributes.
    DATA: lt_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_attributes.

    TRY.
        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes(
          EXPORTING
            i_service_name = 'S_CODE_INSPECTOR'
            i_object_type  = iv_object_type
            i_object_name  = iv_object_name
          IMPORTING
            e_attributes   = lt_attributes
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
          APPEND VALUE ty_ci_attribute(
            attribute_name  = ls_attr-attribute_name
            attribute_value = ls_attr-attribute_value
          ) TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_ci_error INTO DATA(lx_ci_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ci_error EXPORTING previous = lx_ci_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_ci_attributes FOR TESTING RAISING cx_ci_error.
    METHODS test_invalid_object FOR TESTING RAISING cx_ci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_ci_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_query_attrs( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_ci_attributes(
                             iv_object_type = 'CLAS'
                             iv_object_name = 'ZCL_CI_QUERY_ATTRS' " Test gegen sich selbst
                           ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_attributes msg = 'Attribute sollten für eine neue Klasse ohne CI-Prüfungen initial sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_query_attrs( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_ci_attributes(
          iv_object_type = 'CLAS'
          iv_object_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_ci_error wurde für nicht existierendes Objekt nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_ci_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_ci_error wurde korrekt für nicht existierendes Objekt ausgelöst' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES` bietet eine standardisierte Schnittstelle, um Code Inspector Attribute von Entwicklungsobjekten abzufragen. Dies ist nützlich für die Automatisierung von Qualitätsprüfungen oder die Integration in CI/CD-Pipelines, um Metadaten über die Codequalität zu erhalten.
keywords: Code Inspector, Static Analysis, CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES, S_CODE_INSPECTOR, Code Quality

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über einen Tabellenausdruck zu und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die Zeile nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `lt_table[ key_field = value ]` und `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`.

CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.

    METHODS constructor.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_products = VALUE #( 
      ( id = 'P001' name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )

      ( id = 'P003' name = 'Keyboard' price = '75.99' )

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und filtern Sie Elemente, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_for_loop_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_for_loop_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Konstruktors.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE type(...) FOR ... NEXT ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_price,
             item_id TYPE string,
             price   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_item_price.
    TYPES tt_item_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_item_prices TYPE tt_item_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_item IN it_item_prices
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_item-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_item_prices(
      ( item_id = 'A' price = '10.50' )
      ( item_id = 'B' price = '20.00' )
      ( item_id = 'C' price = '5.25' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '35.75' msg = 'Gesamtpreis stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Method Chaining durch Verkettung mehrerer Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Anweisung.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Verkettung zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_number.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_number.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->add( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 13 msg = 'Berechnungsergebnis stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, insbesondere bei Fluent Interfaces, indem es den Bedarf an temporären Variablen reduziert. Jede verkettbare Methode muss eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum für 'morgen' und 'gestern' relativ zum heutigen Datum unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder ähnlicher moderner Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` und `CONVERT TIME STAMP` oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dates,
             today    TYPE d,
             yesterday TYPE d,
             tomorrow TYPE d,
           END OF ty_dates.

    METHODS get_relative_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_dates) TYPE ty_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_relative_dates.
    DATA: lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.

    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_timestamp.

    rs_dates-today = sy-datum.

    " Gestern
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE DATA(lv_yesterday_ts) DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME ' '.
    lv_yesterday_ts = lv_yesterday_ts - 1.
    rs_dates-yesterday = lv_yesterday_ts.

    " Morgen
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE DATA(lv_tomorrow_ts) DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME ' '.
    lv_tomorrow_ts = lv_tomorrow_ts + 1.
    rs_dates-tomorrow = lv_tomorrow_ts.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_relative_dates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_relative_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc( ).
    DATA(ls_dates) = lo_cut->get_relative_dates( ).

    DATA(lv_today) TYPE d.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_current_ts).
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_current_ts TIME ZONE sy-zonlo INTO DATE lv_today DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME ' '.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates-today exp = lv_today msg = 'Heutiges Datum stimmt nicht überein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates-yesterday exp = lv_today - 1 msg = 'Gestern-Datum stimmt nicht überein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_dates-tomorrow exp = lv_today + 1 msg = 'Morgen-Datum stimmt nicht überein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `GET TIME STAMP FIELD` und `CONVERT TIME STAMP` ermöglicht präzise Datums- und Zeitberechnungen unter Berücksichtigung von Zeitzonen und Sommerzeit. Direkte arithmetische Operationen auf `sy-datum` sind zwar einfach, aber die Timestamp-Funktionen bieten eine robustere Lösung für komplexere Szenarien.
keywords: Date, Time, Timestamp, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, GET TIME STAMP, CONVERT TIME STAMP

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             name TYPE string,

             city TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der Datenaggregation in einer internen Tabelle mittels traditioneller Schleife und dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für den Vergleich und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die moderne Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_reduce_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_reduce_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_old) TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_sum_new) TYPE sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelle Schleife
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_sum_old = lv_sum_old + ls_sflight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " REDUCE Operator
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    lv_sum_new = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight NEXT s = s + ls_sflight-price ).
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregation_compare FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation_compare.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE zcl_rtm_reduce_compare=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 200 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' price = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtm_reduce_compare( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_aggregation( lt_sflight ).
    DATA(lt_runtimes) = CAST cl_abap_unit_assert=>ty_i_table( lr_runtimes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Laufzeiten' act = lines( lt_runtimes ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Laufzeit alte Methode sollte gemessen werden' act = lt_runtimes[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Laufzeit neue Methode sollte gemessen werden' act = lt_runtimes[ 2 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Vergleich der Performance zwischen einer traditionellen `LOOP AT`-Anweisung und dem modernen `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation von Daten. `REDUCE` ist oft kompakter und kann in bestimmten Szenarien performanter sein.
keywords: cl_abap_runtime, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Performance, Aggregation

Instructions: Messen Sie die Performance des Filterns einer internen Tabelle mit `LOOP AT WHERE` im Vergleich zum `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime` für den Vergleich und den `FILTER`-Operator für die moderne Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_filter_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_filtering
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_rtm_filter_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_filtering.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_old) TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_filtered_new) TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelles Filtern mit LOOP AT WHERE
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    LOOP AT it_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_filtered_old.
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " Filtern mit FILTER Operator
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    lt_filtered_new = FILTER #( it_sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der String-Verkettung mit `CONCATENATE` und String Templates.

CLASS zcl_rtm_string_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtm_string_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_string_concat.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_string_old) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_string_new) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelle Verkettung mit CONCATENATE
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      CONCATENATE lv_string_old 'Teil' sy-index INTO lv_string_old.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).

    " Verkettung mit String Templates
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      lv_string_new = |{ lv_string_new }Teil{ sy-index }|.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtm_db_read_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtm_db_read_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_db_read.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime_single) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_read) TYPE i.
    DATA(lt_all_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(ls_sflight_single) TYPE ty_sflight.
    DATA(ls_sflight_read) TYPE ty_sflight.

    " Daten einmalig in interne Tabelle lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflight
      UP TO 1000 ROWS.

    " Performance von SELECT SINGLE messen
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'SINGLE_START' ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO @ls_sflight_single
        WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'SINGLE_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'SINGLE_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'SINGLE_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_single
    ).

    " Performance von READ TABLE messen
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'READ_START' ).
    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      READ TABLE lt_all_sflight INTO ls_sflight_read
        WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101'.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'READ_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'READ_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'READ_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_read
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_single INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_read INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_db_read_compare FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_read_compare.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten in SFLIGHT vorhanden sind
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    IF lv_count = 0.
      " Testdaten einfügen, falls keine vorhanden
      INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 )
      ) ).
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtm_db_read_compare( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_db_read( 100 ).
    DATA(lt_runtimes) = CAST cl_abap_unit_assert=>ty_i_table( lr_runtimes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Laufzeiten' act = lines( lt_runtimes ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Laufzeit SELECT SINGLE sollte gemessen werden' act = lt_runtimes[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Laufzeit READ TABLE sollte gemessen werden' act = lt_runtimes[ 2 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die optimale Strategie hängt stark vom Anwendungsfall ab (Anzahl der Zugriffe, Größe der Tabelle, etc.).

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und traditionellen `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
hint: Messen Sie die Zeit für das Füllen einer Tabelle mit einer großen Anzahl von Einträgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_value_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_creation
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_value_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_data_old) TYPE tt_data.
    DATA(lt_data_new) TYPE tt_data.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelle Tabellenerstellung mit APPEND
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index text = |Text { sy-index }| ) TO lt_data_old.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " Tabellenerstellung mit VALUE Operator
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    lt_data_new = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      ( id = i text = |Text { i }| )
    ).
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der Wertzuweisung basierend auf Bedingungen mit `CASE` und dem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Messen Sie die Zeit für eine große Anzahl von Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_switch_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_conditional_assign
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_switch_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_conditional_assign.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_result_old) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_result_new) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_input) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelle Zuweisung mit CASE
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      lv_input = sy-index MOD 3.
      CASE lv_input.
        WHEN 0. lv_result_old = 'Null'.
        WHEN 1. lv_result_old = 'Eins'.
        WHEN 2. lv_result_old = 'Zwei'.
        WHEN OTHERS. lv_result_old = 'Unbekannt'.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " Zuweisung mit SWITCH Ausdruck
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      lv_input = sy-index MOD 3.
      lv_result_new = SWITCH string(
        lv_input
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Null'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Eins'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Zwei'
        ELSE 'Unbekannt'
      ).
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_assign_compare FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der Transformation einer internen Tabelle mit `LOOP AT` und dem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, indem Sie Werte aus einer Quelltabelle transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_for_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id      TYPE i,
             squared TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_transformation
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_for_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_transformation.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_target_old) TYPE tt_target.
    DATA(lt_target_new) TYPE tt_target.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Traditionelle Transformation mit LOOP AT
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    LOOP AT it_source INTO DATA(ls_source).
      APPEND VALUE #( id = ls_source-id squared = ls_source-value * ls_source-value ) TO lt_target_old.
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " Transformation mit FOR Ausdruck
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    lt_target_new = VALUE tt_target(
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( id = ls_source-id squared = ls_source-value * ls_source-value )
    ).
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformation_compare FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation_compare.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_rtm_for_compare=>tt_source.
    DO 1000 TIMES.

    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtm_for_compare( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Laufzeit alte Methode sollte gemessen werden' act = lt_runtimes[ 1 ] ).

explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator bietet eine elegante und oft performantere Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu transformieren und neue Tabellen zu erstellen, im Vergleich zu einer expliziten `LOOP AT`-Anweisung mit `APPEND`.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Performance von verketteten Methodenaufrufen im Vergleich zu separaten Aufrufen mit Zwischenvariablen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die nacheinander aufgerufen werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtm_chain_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_step1 RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_rtm_chain_compare.
    METHODS process_step2 RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_rtm_chain_compare.
    METHODS process_step3 RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_rtm_chain_compare.

    METHODS compare_method_calls
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtm_chain_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_step1.
    " Simulate some work
    DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 + 1.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_step2.
    " Simulate some work
    DATA(lv_dummy) = 2 * 2.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_step3.
    " Simulate some work
    DATA(lv_dummy) = 3 - 1.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_method_calls.
    DATA(lo_runtime) = NEW cl_abap_runtime( ).
    DATA(lo_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_rtm_chain_compare.
    DATA(lv_runtime_old) TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_runtime_new) TYPE i.

    " Separate Aufrufe mit Zwischenvariablen
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      lo_instance = NEW zcl_rtm_chain_compare( ).
      lo_instance->process_step1( ).
      lo_instance->process_step2( ).
      lo_instance->process_step3( ).
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'OLD_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'OLD_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'OLD_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_old
    ).

    " Verkettete Methodenaufrufe
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_START' ).
    DO iv_count TIMES.
      NEW zcl_rtm_chain_compare( )->process_step1( )->process_step2( )->process_step3( ).
    ENDDO.
    lo_runtime->create_checkpoint( 'NEW_END' ).
    lo_runtime->get_runtime(
      EXPORTING
        i_checkpoint_id_from = 'NEW_START'
        i_checkpoint_id_to   = 'NEW_END'
      IMPORTING
        e_runtime_ms         = lv_runtime_new
    ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE TABLE OF i.
    INSERT lv_runtime_old INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
    INSERT lv_runtime_new INTO TABLE CAST #( rs_runtimes )->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chain_compare.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtm_chain_compare( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` oder `INTO` einer Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_single_flight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr IMPLEMENTATION.

    ELSE.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Objektinstanz ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref` und `implements_interface`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_interface.
  METHODS my_method.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_my_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_my_interface.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_class IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_interface_impl
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_interface_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_interface_impl.
    IF io_object IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    rv_implements = lo_class_descr->implements_interface( iv_interface_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_my_class( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_interface_check( ).
    DATA(lv_implements) = lo_cut->check_interface_impl(
                            io_object = lo_object

  METHOD test_does_not_implement_interface.

                            io_object = lo_object

      ENDDO
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_classdescr` ist die RTTI-Klasse zur Beschreibung von Klassen. Mit `describe_by_object_ref` kann man eine Typbeschreibung einer Objektinstanz erhalten und dann mit `implements_interface` dynamisch prüfen, ob die Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert. Dies ist nützlich für generische Frameworks oder Plugin-Architekturen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch, ob ein Feld einer Struktur ein bestimmtes Attribut (z.B. 'KEY') besitzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_attribute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_field_key
      IMPORTING
        ir_struct TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_key) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial
        cx_sy_struct_component_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_attribute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_field_key.
    IF ir_struct IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_struct ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type_descr ).
    rv_is_key = lo_elem_descr->is_key( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_is_key_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_not_key_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_initial_ref RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_key_field.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN ls_sflight TO <fs_struct>.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_attribute( ).
    DATA(lv_is_key) = lo_cut->is_field_key( ir_struct = REF #( <fs_struct> ) iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_is_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_not_key_field.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN ls_sflight TO <fs_struct>.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_attribute( ).
    DATA(lv_is_key) = lo_cut->is_field_key( ir_struct = REF #( <fs_struct> ) iv_field_name = 'PLANETYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_is_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_struct> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN ls_sflight TO <fs_struct>.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_attribute( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_STRUCT_COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND'
      DO.
        lo_cut->is_field_key( ir_struct = REF #( <fs_struct> ) iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
      ENDDO
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_initial_ref.
    DATA lr_struct TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_attribute( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        i_class_name = 'CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL'
      DO.
        lo_cut->is_field_key( ir_struct = lr_struct iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
      ENDDO
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können Sie mit RTTI nicht nur den Typ, sondern auch Attribute einzelner Felder einer Struktur dynamisch abfragen. Hier wird `is_key()` auf einem `cl_abap_elemdescr` verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob ein Feld Teil des Primärschlüssels ist. Dies ist nützlich für generische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Schlüsselinformationen zur Laufzeit benötigt werden.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Field Attributes, Key Field, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_elemdescr

Instructions: Weisen Sie die Felder einer Struktur einer anderen Struktur mit identischer Definition zu, ohne das `MOVE`-Statement zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Zuweisungsoperator `=`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_struct_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS assign_structure IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_struct_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_structure.
    " Modern ABAP: Direct assignment using '=' operator
    rs_target = is_source.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_structure FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_assign_structure.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_move_struct_assign=>ty_data( field1 = 10 field2 = 'Hello' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_struct_assign( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->assign_structure( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 'Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: In modernem ABAP wird der Zuweisungsoperator `=` für die Zuweisung von Strukturen mit identischer Definition bevorzugt, da er prägnanter und lesbarer ist als das veraltete `MOVE`-Statement. Die `VALUE`-Konstruktor-Expression wird zur Initialisierung der Quellstruktur verwendet.
keywords: MOVE, Assignment, Structure, VALUE, Direct Assignment

CLASS zcl_corr_struct_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie die Details der Ausnahme in einem Anwendungsprotokoll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH cx_root` und `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_exception()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( ).

    TRY.
        " Simulate a division by zero exception
        DATA(lv_numerator)   TYPE i VALUE 10.
        DATA(lv_denominator) TYPE i VALUE 0.
        DATA(lv_result)      TYPE i.
        lv_result = lv_numerator / lv_denominator. " This will raise CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        lo_log->add_exception(
          io_exception = lx_exception
          iv_msgty     = 'E'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( fldate > '20000101' )
                               ( connid = ls_flight-connid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für die Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' (Alitalia) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Verwenden Sie dafür den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine einzelne Summe aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_alitalia_price_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alitalia_price_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ'.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflights-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND connid CP '04*' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Objekten einer einfachen Klasse `zcl_flight_data`, die Flugnummer und Flugdatum speichert. Initialisieren Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `sflights` unter Verwendung des `NEW` Operators und `FOR` Ausdrucks.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und einem zusätzlichen Feld 'STATUS'. Der 'STATUS' soll 'HIGH_PRICE' sein, wenn der Flugpreis über 500 liegt, ansonsten 'NORMAL_PRICE'. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator im `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks, um Werte bedingt zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             price  TYPE sflights-price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                   price  = ls_flight-price,
                                   status = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-price > 500 THEN 'HIGH_PRICE' ELSE 'NORMAL_PRICE' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry status should be valid' act = xsdbool( lt_result[ 1 ]-status = 'HIGH_PRICE' OR lt_result[ 1 ]-status = 'NORMAL_PRICE' ) exp = abap_true ).

In Kombination mit dem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE` kann man interne Tabellen mit komplexen, bedingten Feldwerten sehr kompakt und lesbar füllen, was explizite `IF`-Anweisungen in Schleifen überflüssig macht.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und einem Feld 'REGION'. Die 'REGION' soll basierend auf dem Abflugort (CITYFROM) zugewiesen werden: 'EUROPE' für 'FRANKFURT' oder 'BERLIN', 'AMERICA' für 'NEW YORK', ansonsten 'OTHER'. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator im `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für multiple bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_region,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflights-cityfrom,
             region   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_region.
    TYPES: tt_flight_region TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_region WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_regions RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_regions) TYPE tt_flight_region.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_regions.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, cityfrom FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_regions = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom,
                                   region   = SWITCH string( ls_flight-cityfrom
                                                            WHEN 'FRANKFURT' THEN 'EUROPE'
                                                            WHEN 'BERLIN'    THEN 'EUROPE'
                                                            WHEN 'NEW YORK'  THEN 'AMERICA'
                                                            ELSE 'OTHER' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry region should be valid' act = xsdbool( lt_result[ 1 ]-region = 'EUROPE' OR lt_result[ 1 ]-region = 'AMERICA' OR lt_result[ 1 ]-region = 'OTHER' ) exp = abap_true ).

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung des `COND`-Operators für die Handhabung mehrerer bedingter Fälle. Er ersetzt lange `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke durch eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax, ideal für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Baumstruktur (Simple Tree Control) mit `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE`, die Fluggesellschaften als Wurzelknoten und deren Flugnummern als Kindknoten darstellt. Verwenden Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` und dessen Methoden `ADD_NODE` und `ADD_ITEM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_simple_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: mo_simple_tree    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA: lv_node_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key.

    " Get data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'No flight data found' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create screen and custom container (for demo, usually done in a dynpro)
    CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 80 20.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CONTAINER_FOR_TREE'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS           = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating container' TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_simple_tree IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_simple_tree
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_custom_container
          node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating tree' TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    mo_simple_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        " Add carrier as root node
        mo_simple_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = <fs_flight>-carrid
            i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_node_root
            i_text     = <fs_flight>-carrid
          IMPORTING
            e_new_node_key = lv_node_key ).
        lv_prev_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      ENDIF.

      " Add flight connection as child node
      mo_simple_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = <fs_flight>-carrid && '-' && <fs_flight>-connid && '-' && <fs_flight>-fldate
          i_relat_node_key = <fs_flight>-carrid
          i_text     = |{ <fs_flight>-connid } ({ <fs_flight>-fldate })|
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_node_last_child ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_simple_tree->expand_tree( ).
    mo_simple_tree->set_first_visible_node( i_node_key = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_node_root ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

    " PBO/PAI for screen 100 (simplified for demo)
    MODULE status_100 OUTPUT.
      SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
      SET TITLEBAR 'TITLE100'.
    ENDMODULE.
    MODULE user_command_100 INPUT.
      CASE sy-ucomm.
        WHEN 'BACK' OR 'EXIT' OR 'CANCEL'.
          LEAVE PROGRAM.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDMODULE.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_display_flight_tree FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_flight_tree.
    " This unit test cannot directly test UI interaction.
    " It can only verify that the method can be called without syntax errors
    " and potentially that internal data structures are prepared correctly.
    " For a real UI test, integration testing or mocking of CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE would be needed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_simple_tree_display( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_flight_tree( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call successful (no dump)' act = abap_true exp = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).

Obwohl die Interaktion mit UI-Elementen in Unit Tests schwierig ist, zeigt dieses Beispiel die grundlegende Initialisierung und das Hinzufügen von Knoten und Items basierend auf Datenbankdaten. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie String Templates (`|...|`) wird für die Knotentexte verwendet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate aller geraden Zahlen in einer gegebenen Liste von Ganzzahlen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und einer `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_sum_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_even_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_even_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 )
      NEXT sum = sum + ( number ** 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_even_squares FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_even_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 4 + 16 + 36. " 2^2 + 4^2 + 6^2 = 4 + 16 + 36 = 56
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Sum of even squares should be 56' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_even_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of empty list should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_sum_squares( ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann die Iteration und Filterung sehr kompakt und lesbar gestaltet werden. Die Potenzierung `**` ist ebenfalls eine moderne Rechenoperation.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in ein komprimiertes Binärformat und deserialisieren Sie diese anschließend zurück in eine interne Tabelle. Nutzen Sie die Klasse `/UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `SERIALIZE` und `DESERIALIZE` der Klasse `/UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS deserialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring  TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lo_tiny_data) = NEW /ui2/basis_tiny_data( ).
    lo_tiny_data->serialize( EXPORTING data = it_sflights IMPORTING compressed_data = rv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_sflights.
    DATA(lo_tiny_data) = NEW /ui2/basis_tiny_data( ).
    lo_tiny_data->deserialize( EXPORTING compressed_data = iv_xstring IMPORTING data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_deserialize FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_serializer( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_original_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized_sflights) = lo_cut->deserialize_sflights( lv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deserialized_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Number of entries should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deserialized_sflights[1]-carrid exp = lt_original_sflights[1]-carrid msg = 'First entry CARRIER_ID should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_deserialized_sflights[2]-price exp = lt_original_sflights[2]-price msg = 'Second entry PRICE should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_serializer( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_original_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( lt_original_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_deserialized_sflights) = lo_cut->deserialize_sflights( lv_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_xstring msg = 'XSTRING for empty table should be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_deserialized_sflights msg = 'Deserialized table for empty input should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `/UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA` (eine 'Generic compressed serialization class') ermöglicht die effiziente Serialisierung und Deserialisierung von ABAP-Datenstrukturen in ein komprimiertes Binärformat (XSTRING). Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Speicherung oder Übertragung von Daten, wo Speicherplatz oder Bandbreite kritisch sind, z.B. in UI-Caches oder bei der Kommunikation mit dem Frontend.
keywords: Serialization, Deserialization, /UI2/BASIS_TINY_DATA, XSTRING, Compressed Data, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugverbindungen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_filtered(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_sflight-price > iv_min_price )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        price  = ls_sflight-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_expensive_flights msg = 'Should find expensive flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_expensive_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price > '500.00' ) msg = 'All prices should be above threshold' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_expensive_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( '999999.99' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_expensive_flights msg = 'Should find no expensive flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Operators filtert die Quelldaten direkt, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, Filtering

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_flight_info( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_str_flight_info=>ty_flight_data(
