explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu konstruieren. Sie ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken, was den Code wesentlich lesbarer und wartbarer macht als die klassische `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung. Die `CONV`-Funktion erlaubt die Inline-Typkonvertierung, hier für die Datumsformatierung.
keywords: String Templates, CONV, SFLIGHTS, String Processing, Formatting

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Top 5 der teuersten Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...) UP TO N ROWS` und `ORDER BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_top_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_top,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_top.
    TYPES tt_sflight_top TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_top WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_expensive_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_top.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_top_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_top_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_top_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_top_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_expensive_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should retrieve exactly 5 flights' ).
    IF lines( lt_top_flights ) = 5.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_top_flights[1]-price >= lt_top_flights[2]-price ) msg = 'Flights should be sorted by price descending' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_top_flights[2]-price >= lt_top_flights[3]-price ) msg = 'Flights should be sorted by price descending' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL-Syntax erlaubt die Inline-Deklaration von Zielvariablen (`@DATA(...)`) und die direkte Verwendung von ABAP-Variablen in SQL-Statements (`@variable`). `UP TO N ROWS` und `ORDER BY` sind Standardfunktionen, die hier in der modernen Syntax verwendet werden, um die gewünschten Daten effizient abzurufen. `CORRESPONDING #` wird für die einfache Zuweisung zwischen kompatiblen Strukturen/Tabellen verwendet.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT, INTO TABLE, DATA, UP TO N ROWS, ORDER BY, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER type(...) FROM source WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_sflight_full(
      FROM it_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_source FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_operator=>tt_sflight_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 flights for LH' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'All filtered flights should be LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_operator=>tt_sflight_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrier = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Should find no flights for UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty_source.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter_operator=>tt_sflight_full( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrier = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Filtering an empty table should result in an empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem Code, der oft auch performanter ist, da er für die interne Optimierung besser geeignet ist.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einem Statuscode. Nutzen Sie die `SWITCH`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_text.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 'A' THEN 'Abgesagt'
      WHEN 'D' THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN 'O' THEN 'Pünktlich'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für jeden Flug eine neue Struktur mit einem berechneten Feld (z.B. 'discounted_price') erstellen. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING type( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_original,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_original.
    TYPES tt_sflight_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_original WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid          TYPE sflight-connid,
             original_price  TYPE sflight-price,
             discounted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights_with_discount
      IMPORTING
        it_original_flights TYPE tt_sflight_original
        iv_discount_rate    TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_with_discount.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_transformed(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_original_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT price )
        original_price = ls_flight-price,
        discounted_price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_with_discount FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_with_discount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_itab_transform_flights=>tt_sflight_original(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_discount) = 0.1.
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights_with_discount( it_original_flights = lt_original iv_discount_rate = lv_discount ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of entries should remain 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-original_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Original price should be 100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-discounted_price exp = '90.00' msg = 'Discounted price should be 90' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[2]-discounted_price exp = '180.00' msg = 'Second discounted price should be 180' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_itab_transform_flights=>tt_sflight_original( ).
    DATA(lv_discount) = 0.1.
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights_with_discount( it_original_flights = lt_original iv_discount_rate = lv_discount ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_transformed msg = 'Transforming empty table should result in empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Transformation von internen Tabellen. `CORRESPONDING #( ... EXCEPT ... )` kopiert Felder mit gleichem Namen und erlaubt gleichzeitig die Berechnung oder Zuweisung neuer Felder, was den Code für komplexe Transformationen sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Transformation, SFLIGHTS, COMPUTE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer Struktur und deren Typen zur Laufzeit. Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_data_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_data_descr ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
        ) TO rt_components.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[1]-type exp = 'C' msg = 'First component type should be C' ).

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen und -strukturen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` bieten Methoden, um Typinformationen abzurufen, wie z.B. die Namen und Typen von Strukturkomponenten.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in `FOR`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count_by_carrier(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_counts msg = 'Should find flight counts' ).
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      lv_total_flights = lv_total_flights + ls_count-flight_count.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_count-carrid msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ) msg = 'Flight count should be positive' ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_flights > 0 ) msg = 'Total flights should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und Aggregatfunktionen (wie `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente in einer Gruppe) direkt im Ausdruck zu verwenden, was den Code für solche Szenarien extrem kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie dynamische Programmierung und RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      CASE lv_field_name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CARRID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-CARRID' ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-name = 'CONNID'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-CONNID' ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-name = 'FLDATE'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-FLDATE' ).
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          ls_component-name = 'PRICE'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT-PRICE' ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field_value>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_all UP TO 10 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_all INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <lv_field_value>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <lv_field_value> = <lv_field_value>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table_empty_fields FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table_invalid_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_creator=>tt_field_names( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_table( lt_field_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 10 msg = 'Should contain 10 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ls_line> msg = 'First line should not be initial' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lv_carrid> msg = 'CARRID component should be assigned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_price> TYPE sflight-price.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_price>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lv_price> msg = 'PRICE component should be assigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table_empty_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_creator=>tt_field_names( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_table( lt_field_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be initial for empty field list' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table_invalid_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_creator=>tt_field_names( ( 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ) ( 'CARRID' ) ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_sflight_table( lt_field_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be created even with invalid fields' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <lv_carrid> msg = 'Valid component CARRID should be assigned' ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lv_carrid> msg = 'Non-existent component should not be assigned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit RTTI ist für Szenarien unerlässlich, in denen die Struktur von Daten zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist.     "   seatsmax,

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Produkt aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle von Integern.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `MULTIPLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_product IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_product) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product.
    rv_product = REDUCE i( INIT p = 1 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT p = p * num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_product FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers1) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce_multiply=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_numbers2) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce_multiply=>tt_numbers( ( 5 ) ( 0 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lt_numbers3) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce_multiply=>tt_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers1 ) exp = 24 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers2 ) exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_product( lt_numbers3 ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird er verwendet, um das Produkt aller Zahlen zu berechnen. `INIT p = 1` setzt den Startwert für das Produkt, und `NEXT p = p * num` führt die Multiplikation für jedes Element durch. Dies ist eine moderne und sehr kompakte Art der Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, MULTIPLY, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, in der ein numerisches Feld jeder Zeile der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle (z.B. `PRICE`) mit einem Faktor multipliziert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion und den `MULTIPLY`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_for_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_new_prices IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE decfloat16 RETURNING VALUE(rt_new_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_for_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_new_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_new_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                  fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                  price  = ls_sflight-price,
                                  new_price = ls_sflight-price * iv_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_new_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_new_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_for_multiply( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_new_prices( '1.1' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-new_price exp = ls_result-price * '1.1' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `FOR`-Schleife innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen. Für jede Zeile der Quelltabelle wird das Feld `PRICE` mit einem `iv_factor` multipliziert und als `new_price` in die Zieltabelle übernommen. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und moderne Art, Tabellen zu transformieren und Berechnungen inline durchzuführen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, MULTIPLY, Internal Table, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS, Transformation

        CATCH cx_salv_ida_error.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den doppelten Wert einer Zahl innerhalb eines Ausdrucks und verwenden Sie das Ergebnis weiter, um die Summe mit einer dritten Zahl zu bilden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `LET`-Operator für lokale Zwischenberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_let_multiply DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_complex_sum IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i iv_num2 TYPE i iv_num3 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_let_multiply IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_complex_sum.
    rv_result = LET lv_doubled_num1 = iv_num1 * 2 IN lv_doubled_num1 + iv_num2 + iv_num3.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_complex_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_complex_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_let_multiply( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_complex_sum( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 iv_num3 = 2 ) exp = 15 ). " (5*2) + 3 + 2 = 15
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_complex_sum( iv_num1 = 0 iv_num2 = 10 iv_num3 = 1 ) exp = 11 ). " (0*2) + 10 + 1 = 11
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_complex_sum( iv_num1 = -2 iv_num2 = 5 iv_num3 = 1 ) exp = 2 ). " (-2*2) + 5 + 1 = -4 + 5 + 1 = 2
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET`-Operator ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks. Hier wird `lv_doubled_num1` definiert, indem `iv_num1` mit 2 multipliziert wird. Das Ergebnis dieser Zwischenberechnung kann dann im weiteren Ausdruck verwendet werden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit komplexer Ausdrücke, indem Zwischenschritte klar benannt werden.
keywords: LET, MULTIPLY, Expressions, Local Variables, Functional Programming

    " In a real scenario, you would read the data for e_row_id

                                         IMPORTING es_data   = ls_sflight ).

CLASS zcl_xlsx_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_status  TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_flights  TYPE tt_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights using FILTER operator and WHEN for status
    lt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
                           AND ( COND #( WHEN iv_status IS INITIAL THEN abap_true
                                         WHEN planetype = iv_status THEN abap_true
                                         ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true ) ).

    IF lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flugdatum' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Preis' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Währung' )
        ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' text = 'Flugzeugtyp' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Filtered Flights' it_data = lt_flights it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtpreise von Flügen pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight`. Exportieren Sie die aggregierten Daten (Fluggesellschaft, Gesamtpreis, Anzahl Flüge) in eine XLSX-Datei. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und verwenden Sie `WHEN` für die Bedingung.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation und `WHEN` innerhalb der `REDUCE`-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET current_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
                            INIT sum_price = 0
                            FOR member IN GROUP flight
                            WHERE ( member-price > iv_min_price )
                            NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price )
          current_count = REDUCE i(
                            INIT count = 0
                            FOR member IN GROUP flight
                            WHERE ( member-price > iv_min_price )
                            NEXT count = count + 1 )
      IN
      ( COND #( WHEN current_count > 0 THEN
                 VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                        total_price = current_price
                                        flight_count = current_count ) )
                 ELSE result ) ) ).

    IF lt_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID'      text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' text = 'Gesamtpreis' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' text = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Flight Summary' it_data = lt_summary it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für den XLSX-Export basierend auf einer Liste gewünschter Spalten. Wenn eine Spalte spezifische Anforderungen hat (z.B. Währungsschlüssel für den Preis), passen Sie den Feldkatalog entsprechend an. Exportieren Sie die `sflight`-Daten mit diesem dynamischen Feldkatalog.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression, um den Feldkatalog zu generieren, und `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression für bedingte Feldkatalogeigenschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_column_name TYPE string.
    TYPES tt_column_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_requested_columns TYPE tt_column_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
      FOR ls_col_name IN it_requested_columns
      ( fieldname = ls_col_name
        text      = COND string( WHEN ls_col_name = 'CARRID' THEN 'Fluggesellschaft'
                                WHEN ls_col_name = 'CONNID' THEN 'Flugnummer'
                                WHEN ls_col_name = 'FLDATE' THEN 'Flugdatum'
                                WHEN ls_col_name = 'PRICE' THEN 'Preis'
                                WHEN ls_col_name = 'CURRENCY' THEN 'Währung'
                                WHEN ls_col_name = 'PLANETYPE' THEN 'Flugzeugtyp'
                                ELSE ls_col_name )
        inttype   = COND c( WHEN ls_col_name = 'PRICE' THEN 'P'
                            WHEN ls_col_name = 'FLDATE' THEN 'D'
                            ELSE '' )
        intlen    = COND i( WHEN ls_col_name = 'PRICE' THEN 11
                            WHEN ls_col_name = 'FLDATE' THEN 8
                            ELSE 0 )
        decimals  = COND i( WHEN ls_col_name = 'PRICE' THEN 2
                            ELSE 0 )
        cfieldname = COND string( WHEN ls_col_name = 'PRICE' THEN 'CURRENCY'
                                 ELSE '' )
      )
    ).

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL AND lt_fieldcat IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Dynamic Flights' it_data = lt_sflights it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Simulieren Sie verschiedene Fehlerfälle (z.B. leere Daten, Berechtigungsfehler) und reagieren Sie darauf mit spezifischen Meldungen. Verwenden Sie `WHEN` in den `CATCH`-Blöcken, um auf unterschiedliche Ausnahmen zu reagieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` und definieren Sie eigene Ausnahmeklassen oder verwenden Sie Standardausnahmen. `WHEN` kann verwendet werden, um spezifische Ausnahmen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_simulate_error TYPE string OPTIONAL " 'EMPTY_DATA', 'AUTH_ERROR'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    " Mock exception classes for demonstration
    CLASS zcx_empty_data_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcx_empty_data_error IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcx_authorization_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcx_authorization_error IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat( ( fieldname = 'FIELD1' ) ). " Dummy fieldcat

    TRY.
        IF iv_simulate_error = 'EMPTY_DATA'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_data_error.
        ENDIF.

        IF iv_simulate_error = 'AUTH_ERROR'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_authorization_error.
        ENDIF.

        IF it_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_data_error.
        ENDIF.

        lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Data' it_data = it_data it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
        lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
        rv_message = 'Export erfolgreich durchgeführt.'.

      CATCH zcx_empty_data_error.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Keine Daten zum Exportieren vorhanden.'.
      CATCH zcx_authorization_error.
        rv_message = 'Fehler: Keine Berechtigung für den Export.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Preis) in einem String-Template für die Ausgabe in einer XLSX-Zelle. Verwenden Sie `WHEN`, um den Preis basierend auf seinem Wert unterschiedlich zu formatieren (z.B. "Günstig" oder "Standard").
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates (`|...|`) und `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression für die bedingte Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_string_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             formatted_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.

    METHODS export_formatted_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_string_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_data.
    rt_formatted_data = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
        formatted_info = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }: Preis { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency } ({ COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price < 500 THEN 'Günstig' WHEN ls_sflight-price >= 500 AND ls_sflight-price < 1000 THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Teuer' ) })|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD export_formatted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_formatted_data) = get_formatted_flight_data( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_formatted_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Preis' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Währung' )
        ( fieldname = 'FORMATTED_INFO' text = 'Fluginformationen' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Formatted Flights' it_data = lt_formatted_data it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_string_formatting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_string_format( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 350 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = 750 currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' price = 1200 currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flight_data( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 formatted lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 1 ]-formatted_info exp = 'Flug LH-0400: Preis 350 EUR (Günstig)' msg = 'Incorrect formatting for cheap flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 2 ]-formatted_info exp = 'Flug UA-0010: Preis 750 USD (Standard)' msg = 'Incorrect formatting for standard flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 3 ]-formatted_info exp = 'Flug AA-0020: Preis 1200 USD (Teuer)' msg = 'Incorrect formatting for expensive flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_export_formatted_flights.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator, um Standardwerte für bestimmte Felder zu setzen, wenn diese nicht explizit angegeben sind oder eine Bedingung erfüllen. Exportieren Sie diese Daten in eine XLSX-Datei.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator für die Initialisierung und `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression für bedingte Standardwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_value_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_default_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_input_flights TYPE tt_flight_detail OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.

    METHODS export_default_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_input_flights TYPE tt_flight_detail OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_value_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_default_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
      BASE it_input_flights
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' status = COND string( WHEN sy-datum IS INITIAL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'PLANNED' ) )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' status = COND string( WHEN sy-datum IS INITIAL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'PLANNED' ) )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = 50  currency = 'GBP' status = COND string( WHEN sy-datum IS INITIAL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'PLANNED' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD export_default_flights.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_export) = get_default_flights( it_input_flights ).

    IF lt_flights_to_export IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID'   text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID'   text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'   text = 'Flugdatum' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE'    text = 'Preis' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Währung' )
        ( fieldname = 'STATUS'   text = 'Status' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Default Flights' it_data = lt_flights_to_export it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konfigurieren Sie einen XLSX-Export durch das Verketten von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining). Fügen Sie bedingt ein zusätzliches Blatt hinzu oder setzen Sie eine spezifische Eigenschaft, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Verwenden Sie `WHEN` für die bedingte Logik.
hint: Implementieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie `WHEN` in einer `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisung für die bedingte Konfiguration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_ehfnd_fw_export_impl. " To allow chaining with the mock exporter

    METHODS configure_and_export
      IMPORTING
        it_data          TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_add_summary_sheet TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_exporter TYPE REF TO zif_ehfnd_fw_export_impl.

    METHODS set_title
      IMPORTING
        i_title TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_xlsx_method_chaining.

    METHODS add_main_sheet
      IMPORTING
        i_sheet_name TYPE string
        it_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_fieldcat  TYPE lvc_t_fcat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_xlsx_method_chaining.

    METHODS add_summary_sheet
      IMPORTING
        i_sheet_name TYPE string
        it_summary_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_fieldcat  TYPE lvc_t_fcat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_xlsx_method_chaining.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD configure_and_export.
    DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat( ( fieldname = 'FIELD1' text = 'Feld 1' ) ). " Dummy fieldcat
    DATA(lt_summary_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string( ( 'Summary Line 1' ) ). " Dummy summary

    mo_exporter = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).

    " Method Chaining
    ME->set_title( 'Flight Report' )->add_main_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Main Data' it_data = it_data it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).

    IF iv_add_summary_sheet = abap_true.
      ME->add_summary_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Summary' it_summary_data = lt_summary_data it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_exporter->download( ).
    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_title.
    ro_me = ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_main_sheet.
    mo_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = i_sheet_name it_data = it_data it_fieldcat = it_fieldcat ).
    ro_me = ME.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_summary_sheet.
    mo_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = i_sheet_name it_data = it_summary_data it_fieldcat = it_fieldcat ).
    ro_me = ME.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss von Objektinteraktionen, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgibt. Die bedingte Logik mit `WHEN` (hier implizit durch `IF`) ermöglicht es, die Kette dynamisch zu erweitern oder zu ändern.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in der `sflight`-Tabelle existiert, bevor Sie versuchen, ihn zu exportieren. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `WHEN` in einer `IF`-Anweisung, um die Existenz zu prüfen und nur bei Erfolg den Export durchzuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` für die effiziente Prüfung der Zeilenexistenz und `WHEN` in der `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_flight_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_flight_if_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] )
       AND ( COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true ). " Example WHEN usage
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
      DATA(lt_data_to_export) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight( ( ls_flight ) ).

      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flugdatum' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Preis' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Währung' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Existing Flight' it_data = lt_data_to_export it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` in eine neue Struktur, die zusätzliche berechnete Felder enthält (z.B. Flugdauer basierend auf Flugzeugtyp). Verwenden Sie den `MAP`-Operator (oder `FOR` mit `VALUE` als Alternative für ältere Versionen) und `WHEN` für die bedingte Berechnung. Exportieren Sie die transformierten Daten in eine XLSX-Datei.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` (oder `MAP` ab 7.55) für die Transformation und `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression für bedingte Berechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             currency    TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             flight_duration TYPE i, " Calculated field
             category    TYPE string,    " Calculated field
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.

    METHODS export_transformed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE tt_transformed_flight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid      = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate
        price       = ls_sflight-price
        currency    = ls_sflight-currency
        planetype   = ls_sflight-planetype
        flight_duration = COND i( WHEN ls_sflight-planetype = 'A320' THEN 120 " 2 hours
                                  WHEN ls_sflight-planetype = 'B747' THEN 480 " 8 hours
                                  ELSE 60 ) " Default 1 hour
        category    = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price < 300 THEN 'Economy'
                                  WHEN ls_sflight-price >= 300 AND ls_sflight-price < 800 THEN 'Business'
                                  ELSE 'First Class' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD export_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_transformed) = transform_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_transformed IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID'        text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID'        text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLDATE'        text = 'Flugdatum' )
        ( fieldname = 'PRICE'         text = 'Preis' )
        ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY'      text = 'Währung' )
        ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE'     text = 'Flugzeugtyp' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_DURATION' text = 'Flugdauer (Min)' )
        ( fieldname = 'CATEGORY'      text = 'Kategorie' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Transformed Flights' it_data = lt_transformed it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_data_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugzeugtyp. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Exportieren Sie diesen aggregierten Bericht in eine XLSX-Datei. Verwenden Sie `WHEN` in der Gruppierungslogik, um bestimmte Flugzeugtypen besonders zu behandeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `WHEN` in einer `COND`-Expression für bedingte Gruppierungskriterien oder Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_grouped_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_grouped_summary TYPE tt_flight_group_summary.

    SELECT carrid, planetype, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                            planetype = COND string( WHEN ls_flight-planetype = 'A380' THEN 'JUMBO' ELSE ls_flight-planetype )
                                                            group_size = GROUP SIZE
                                                            group_sum_price = GROUP SUM( price ) )
                                                            INTO DATA(ls_group).

      DATA(lv_avg_price) = COND sflight-price( WHEN ls_group-group_size > 0 THEN ls_group-group_sum_price / ls_group-group_size ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group_summary(
        carrid       = ls_group-carrid
        planetype    = ls_group-planetype
        flight_count = ls_group-group_size
        avg_price    = lv_avg_price
      ) TO lt_grouped_summary.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_grouped_summary IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID'       text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE'    text = 'Flugzeugtyp' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_COUNT' text = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
        ( fieldname = 'AVG_PRICE'    text = 'Durchschnittspreis' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Grouped Flights' it_data = lt_grouped_summary it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_switch_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             friendly_planetype TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapped_flight.
    TYPES tt_mapped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mapped_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_data) TYPE tt_mapped_flight.

    METHODS export_mapped_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_switch_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mapped_flights.
    rt_mapped_data = VALUE tt_mapped_flight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid      = ls_sflight-connid
        planetype   = ls_sflight-planetype
        friendly_planetype = SWITCH string( ls_sflight-planetype
                                  WHEN 'A320' THEN 'Airbus A320 (Short-Haul)'
                                  WHEN 'B747' THEN 'Boeing 747 (Long-Haul)'
                                  WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Airbus A380 (Super Jumbo)'
                                  WHEN 'B737' THEN 'Boeing 737 (Regional)'
                                  WHEN 'CRJ'  THEN 'Canadair Regional Jet'
                                  WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannter Flugzeugtyp' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD export_mapped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, planetype FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_mapped) = get_mapped_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_mapped IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'CARRID'           text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'CONNID'           text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE'        text = 'Flugzeugtyp (Code)' )
        ( fieldname = 'FRIENDLY_PLANETYPE' text = 'Flugzeugtyp (Bezeichnung)' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Mapped Flights' it_data = lt_mapped it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_nr  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             ticket_price TYPE sflight-price,
             ticket_currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             aircraft_type TYPE sflight-planetype,
             status_text TYPE string, " New field
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_and_export_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_and_export_flights.
    DATA: lt_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_source_flights.

    DATA(lt_target_flights) = VALUE tt_target_flight(
      FOR ls_source IN lt_source_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING carrid = airline_id
                                                connid = flight_nr
                                                fldate = flight_date
                                                price = ticket_price
                                                currency = ticket_currency
                                                planetype = aircraft_type )
            status_text = COND string( WHEN ls_source-price < 100 THEN 'Sehr Günstig'
                                      WHEN ls_source-price < 500 THEN 'Normal'
                                      ELSE 'Premium' )
          )
        ).

    IF lt_target_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(
        ( fieldname = 'AIRLINE_ID'      text = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_NR'       text = 'Flugnummer' )
        ( fieldname = 'FLIGHT_DATE'     text = 'Flugdatum' )
        ( fieldname = 'TICKET_PRICE'    text = 'Ticketpreis' )
        ( fieldname = 'TICKET_CURRENCY' text = 'Währung' )
        ( fieldname = 'AIRCRAFT_TYPE'   text = 'Flugzeugtyp' )
        ( fieldname = 'STATUS_TEXT'     text = 'Status' )
      ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Mapped Flights' it_data = lt_target_flights it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_data_processor.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      it_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_processor~process_data.
    rt_processed_data = it_raw_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_processor~process_data.
    rt_processed_data = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      FOR ls_data IN it_raw_data
      ( |Processed: { ls_data }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_new_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_processed_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_processor_type TYPE string " 'SIMPLE', 'COMPLEX'
        it_raw_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_new_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_processed_data.
    DATA(lo_processor) = COND REF TO zif_data_processor(
                           WHEN iv_processor_type = 'SIMPLE' THEN NEW zcl_simple_processor( )
                           WHEN iv_processor_type = 'COMPLEX' THEN NEW zcl_complex_processor( )
                           ELSE NEW zcl_simple_processor( ) ). " Default processor

    DATA(lt_processed_data) = lo_processor->process_data( it_raw_data ).

    IF lt_processed_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat( ( fieldname = 'TABLE_LINE' text = 'Datenzeile' ) ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Processed Data' it_data = lt_processed_data it_fieldcat = lt_fieldcat ).
      lo_xlsx_exporter->download( ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_conv_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_converted_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             price_text TYPE string, " Converted price as text
           END OF ty_converted_flight.
    TYPES tt_converted_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_converted_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_xlsx_conv_operator IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency
        price_text = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price < 100 THEN |{ CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) } { ls_sflight-currency } (Schnäppchen!)|
                                  WHEN ls_sflight-price < 500 THEN |{ CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) } { ls_sflight-currency } (Standard)|
                                  ELSE |{ CONV string( ls_sflight-price ) } { ls_sflight-currency } (Premium)| )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD export_converted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_converted) = get_converted_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_converted IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_xlsx_exporter) = zcl_ehfnd_xlsx=>create_instance( ).
      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = VALUE lvc_t_fcat(

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Konvertierung eines binären Bilddatenobjekts (XSTRING) in ein anderes Format. hint: Verwenden Sie `XSTRING` für binäre Daten und String-Templates für die Ausgabe. Die Klasse `CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER` wird hier konzeptionell verwendet, um die Schnittstelle zu zeigen.

CLASS zcl_image_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_image_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_image.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde hier CL_IGS_IMAGE_CONVERTER verwendet werden.
    " Da die Klasse externe Abhängigkeiten hat, simulieren wir hier eine einfache Manipulation.
    " Beispiel: Einfaches Hinzufügen eines Headers oder Ändern einiger Bytes.
    DATA(lv_header) = 'CONVERTED_BY_ABAP' && iv_target_format.
    DATA(lv_header_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( )->convert( lv_header ).

    rv_converted_image = lv_header_xstring && iv_original_image.

    " Eine Meldung könnte mit String-Templates formatiert werden
    DATA(lv_message) = |Image converted to { iv_target_format } with new header. Original size: { xstrlen( iv_original_image ) } bytes.|.
    " In einem echten Programm würde lv_message z.B. geloggt oder zurückgegeben.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie dynamisch eine Liste von Kontextmenüeinträgen basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Aktionen. Demonstrieren Sie die Erstellung dieser Liste mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxelementen (`VALUE`, `FOR`), die später von einer Klasse wie `CL_CTMENU` verwendet werden könnten, um ein Kontextmenü aufzubauen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke, um die interne Tabelle der Menüeinträge zu füllen. Definieren Sie eine lokale Struktur für die Menüeinträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_menu_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_menu_item,
             function_code TYPE ui_func,
             text          TYPE string,
             icon          TYPE icon_name,
             enabled       TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_menu_item,
           ty_menu_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_menu_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_menu_items
      IMPORTING
        it_actions TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_menu_items) TYPE ty_menu_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_menu_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_menu_items.
    rt_menu_items = VALUE #( FOR <action> IN it_actions
                                LET lv_func_code = |ACT_{ sy-tabix }|
                                    lv_text = <action>
                                    lv_icon = COND string( WHEN sy-tabix = 1 THEN icon_ok ELSE icon_information )
                                    lv_enabled = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0 THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true )
                                IN
                                ( function_code = lv_func_code
                                  text          = lv_text
                                  icon          = lv_icon
                                  enabled       = lv_enabled ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_build_menu_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_menu_items.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_dynamic_menu_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_actions) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Action A' ) ( 'Action B' ) ( 'Action C' ) ).

    DATA(lt_menu) = lo_builder->build_menu_items( lt_actions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_menu ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of menu items' ).

    DATA(ls_item_a) = lt_menu[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item_a-text exp = 'Action A' msg = 'First item text incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item_a-enabled exp = abap_true msg = 'First item enabled incorrect' ).

    DATA(ls_item_b) = lt_menu[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item_b-text exp = 'Action B' msg = 'Second item text incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item_b-enabled exp = abap_false msg = 'Second item enabled incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle von Menüeinträgen unter Verwendung der modernen `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung und Transformation von Daten. Die resultierende Tabelle könnte dann an eine Klasse wie `CL_CTMENU` übergeben werden, um ein tatsächliches Kontextmenü in einer GUI-Anwendung zu rendern. `COND` wird für bedingte Zuweisungen verwendet.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte maximale Kapazität überschreiten, und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck, um die interne Tabelle zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight,
           ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_above_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_capacity )
                                 ( |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_above_capacity( 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights msg = 'Should be initial if no flights exceed 200 capacity' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit Kapazität > 0
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_above_capacity( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_all_flights msg = 'Should not be initial for capacity > 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Ausdruck ermöglicht das Filtern interner Tabellen direkt in einer Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. In Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck kann die gefilterte Tabelle direkt in ein neues Format transformiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck, um eine Aggregation über die Tabellenzeilen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight,
           ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_capacity.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_capacity msg = 'Total capacity should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_capacity >= 0 msg = 'Total capacity should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, einen Startwert (`INIT`) zu definieren und diesen iterativ basierend auf den Elementen der Tabelle zu aktualisieren (`NEXT`). Dies führt zu sehr prägnantem und funktionalem Code für Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Status eines Fluges (Tabelle `sflights`) basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze bestimmt. Verwenden Sie `COND` und `SWITCH` Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` für bedingte Zuweisungen und `SWITCH` für mehrere Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_free_seats) = is_flight_data-seatsmax - is_flight_data-seatsocc.

    rv_status = SWITCH string(
      WHEN lv_free_seats = 0 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN lv_free_seats <= 10 THEN 'Fast ausgebucht'
      WHEN lv_free_seats > 10 THEN 'Verfügbar'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_status) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA ls_flight_data TYPE zcl_flight_status=>ty_flight_data.

    ls_flight_data-seatsmax = 100.
    ls_flight_data-seatsocc = 100.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_status( ls_flight_data ) exp = 'Ausgebucht' msg = 'Status for full flight incorrect' ).

    ls_flight_data-seatsocc = 95.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_status( ls_flight_data ) exp = 'Fast ausgebucht' msg = 'Status for nearly full flight incorrect' ).

    ls_flight_data-seatsocc = 50.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_status->get_flight_status( ls_flight_data ) exp = 'Verfügbar' msg = 'Status for available flight incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ausdrücke `COND` und `SWITCH` ermöglichen es, bedingte Logik direkt in Zuweisungen zu integrieren, was den Code deutlich kürzer und funktionaler macht als traditionelle `IF-ELSEIF-ENDIF` Blöcke. `SWITCH` ist besonders nützlich für mehrere diskrete Bedingungen.
keywords: COND, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHTS
