Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine einfache Hierarchie von Flugzeugtypen unter Verwendung von Interfaces und einer finalen Implementierungsklasse. Demonstrieren Sie die Polymorphie durch eine Methode, die verschiedene Flugzeugtypen verarbeitet.
hint: Definieren Sie ein `INTERFACE` für gemeinsame Methoden und implementieren Sie es in einer `FINAL CLASS`. Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_airplane.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_max_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_boeing747 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_airplane.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_boeing747 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Boeing 747'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_max_passengers.
    rv_passengers = 416.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airbusa320 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_airplane.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airbusa320 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Airbus A320'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_airplane~get_max_passengers.
    rv_passengers = 150.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airplane_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_airplane
      IMPORTING
        io_airplane TYPE REF TO zif_airplane
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_airplane_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_airplane.
    rv_info = |Flugzeugtyp: { io_airplane->get_type() }, Max. Passagiere: { io_airplane->get_max_passengers() }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_airplane_handler( ).

    DATA(lo_boeing) = NEW zcl_boeing747( ).
    DATA(lv_boeing_info) = lo_handler->process_airplane( lo_boeing ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_boeing_info exp = 'Flugzeugtyp: Boeing 747, Max. Passagiere: 416' msg = 'Boeing info incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_airbus) = NEW zcl_airbusa320( ).
    DATA(lv_airbus_info) = lo_handler->process_airplane( lo_airbus ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_airbus_info exp = 'Flugzeugtyp: Airbus A320, Max. Passagiere: 150' msg = 'Airbus info incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert grundlegende Prinzipien der Objektorientierung in modernem ABAP: Interfaces (`INTERFACE`) für die Definition gemeinsamer Verhaltensweisen, `FINAL` Klassen für konkrete Implementierungen und Polymorphie, bei der eine Methode (`process_airplane`) Objekte verschiedener Klassen über ein gemeinsames Interface verarbeitet. `NEW` wird für die Instanziierung verwendet.
keywords: Object Orientation, Interface, Final Class, Polymorphism, NEW

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf Komponenten einer Struktur zu und lesen Sie deren Werte. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Komponente nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_accessor( ).
    DATA ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_accessor=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Testwert'.
    ls_data-field2 = 123.
    ls_data-field3 = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_accessor->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Testwert' msg = 'Value for FIELD1 incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_accessor->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' msg = 'Value for FIELD2 incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_value_invalid) = lo_accessor->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD_INVALID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_invalid exp = 'Komponente nicht gefunden' msg = 'Invalid component handling incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` schon länger existieren, sind sie in modernem ABAP immer noch die primären Werkzeuge für dynamische Programmierung. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten einer Struktur zugreifen kann, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist. String-Templates werden für die Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure Access

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Datumsangaben unter Verwendung der modernen Datums- und Zeitfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder die neuen Datums-/Zeit-Typen und Operatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date = iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date = iv_date2 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_timestamp2 iv_tstmp2 = lv_timestamp1 ).

    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / 86400. " 86400 Sekunden pro Tag
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_days_between FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_days_between.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_date_start) = '20230101'.
    DATA(lv_date_end) = '20230111'.
    DATA(lv_days) = lo_calculator->get_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_date_start iv_date2 = lv_date_end ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = 10 msg = 'Days between 20230101 and 20230111 incorrect' ).

    lv_date_start = '20230111'.
    lv_date_end = '20230101'.
    lv_days = lo_calculator->get_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_date_start iv_date2 = lv_date_end ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = -10 msg = 'Days between 20230111 and 20230101 incorrect' ).

    lv_date_start = '20230101'.
    lv_date_end = '20230101'.
    lv_days = lo_calculator->get_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_date_start iv_date2 = lv_date_end ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = 0 msg = 'Days for same date incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet eine robuste und moderne Möglichkeit zur Handhabung von Zeitstempeln und zur Berechnung von Differenzen zwischen Datums- und Zeitangaben. Sie ist der bevorzugte Weg gegenüber älteren Funktionsbausteinen oder manuellen Berechnungen, da sie Zeitzonen und Sommerzeit korrekt berücksichtigt.
keywords: Date, Time, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Timestamp, Calculation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight,
           ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count,
           ty_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_flights.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_counts msg = 'Grouped counts should not be initial' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob LH vorhanden ist und eine positive Anzahl hat
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE #( lt_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_lh_count IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine leistungsstarke moderne Funktion, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Schleifen und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` Verarbeitungen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und deren Namen. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit dem `VALUE` Ausdruck und verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` um Daten aus einer anderen Struktur zu übernehmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung und `CORRESPONDING` für die Übernahme von Feldern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_initializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_data,
           ty_carrier_datas TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_initial_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE ty_carrier_datas.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_initializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_carriers.
    DATA: ls_scarr_data TYPE scarr.

    " Beispiel: Daten aus SCARR lesen (oder simulieren)
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_scarr_data.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
                           ( carrid = 'DL' carrname = 'Delta Airlines' )
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_scarr_data ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Ausdruck ist die moderne Art, interne Tabellen und Strukturen zu initialisieren. In Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` können Felder mit gleichem Namen aus einer Quellstruktur oder -tabelle automatisch in die Zielstruktur übernommen werden, was den Code für die Datenübertragung erheblich vereinfacht und Fehler reduziert.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Initialization

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft (Tabelle `sflights`). Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Berechnung und Datenaggregation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` Ausdrücke für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight,
           ty_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_flights.

    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_avg_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_avg_lh) = lo_calculator->get_average_max_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg_lh > 0 msg = 'Average for LH should be positive' ).

    DATA(lv_avg_xx) = lo_calculator->get_average_max_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Average for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert moderne ABAP-Features wie `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und `lines()` für die Zeilenanzahl, um einen Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT34` für das Ergebnis stellt sicher, dass auch Dezimalwerte korrekt gehandhabt werden. Inline-Deklarationen und die neue Open SQL Syntax tragen zur Code-Kompaktheit bei.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, DECFLOAT34

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ und die Komponenten einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Geben Sie die Namen der Komponenten zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen wie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_component_names
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_component_names.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_component_names = VALUE #( FOR component IN lt_components ( component-name ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error if it's not a table or not a structured table
        APPEND 'Error: Not a structured table' TO rt_component_names.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_rtti_scalar FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_table.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_struct,
           ty_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_struct WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA lt_test_table TYPE ty_test_table.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_analyzer->get_table_component_names( REF #( lt_test_table ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of components' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'ID' msg = 'First component name incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 2 ] exp = 'TEXT' msg = 'Second component name incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_rtti_scalar.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA lv_scalar TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_analyzer->get_table_component_names( REF #( lv_scalar ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ 1 ] exp = 'Error: Not a structured table' msg = 'Error message for scalar incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in ABAP, um Typinformationen zur Laufzeit dynamisch zu ermitteln. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` die Komponenten einer internen Tabelle auslesen kann. Der `FOR` Ausdruck wird verwendet, um die Komponentennamen kompakt in eine String-Tabelle zu transformieren. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls integriert.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, FOR

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge für eine gegebene Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer internen Tabelle von Fluggesellschafts-IDs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE zcl_fae_basic=>tt_carriers,
          ls_carrier  TYPE zcl_fae_basic=>ty_carrier.

    ls_carrier-carrid = 'AA'. " American Airlines
    APPEND ls_carrier TO lt_carriers.
    ls_carrier-carrid = 'LH'. " Lufthansa
    APPEND ls_carrier TO lt_carriers.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain AA flights' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH flights' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fae_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carriers( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty for empty input' act = lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle basierend auf Werten in einer internen Tabelle auszuwählen. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen ermöglichen die Verwendung von Hostvariablen direkt in Open SQL-Anweisungen, und die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(lt_flights)` macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer. Die Prüfung auf eine leere Driving Table (`it_carriers IS INITIAL`) ist entscheidend, um Performance-Probleme oder unerwartete Ergebnisse zu vermeiden, da FAE bei leerer Driving Table alle Einträge der Datenbanktabelle zurückgeben würde.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, Internal Tables, Open SQL, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge für spezifische Kombinationen aus Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einer strukturierten internen Tabelle, die beide Kriterien enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_multi_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_multi_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_keys.
    IF it_flight_keys IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT *
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
      WHERE carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid
        AND connid = @it_flight_keys-connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flights_by_keys FOR TESTING.

    DATA: lt_flight_keys TYPE zcl_fae_multi_fields=>tt_flight_keys,

    ls_flight_key-carrid = 'AA'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain AA 0017 flight' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain LH 0400 flight' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not contain AA 0400 flight' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0400' ] ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Dies ist nützlich, wenn Sie Datensätze basierend auf eindeutigen Kombinationen von Werten aus einer Driving Table abrufen müssen. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für eine Liste von Flügen aus `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES` und aggregieren Sie die Ergebnisse anschließend mit `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    IF it_flight_keys IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
      WHERE carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid
        AND connid = @it_flight_keys-connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Aggregate using LOOP AT ... GROUP BY
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                       FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                       NEXT s = s + ( <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_carrier_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften Flüge an einem bestimmten Datum in `sflights` geplant sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und `UP TO 1 ROWS` für eine effiziente Existenzprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_exists_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_carrier_date.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flights_exist
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_dates TYPE tt_carrier_dates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_exists_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flights_exist.
    IF it_carrier_dates IS INITIAL.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_dummy TYPE s_carr_id.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carrier_dates
      WHERE carrid = @it_carrier_dates-carrid
        AND fldate = @it_carrier_dates-fldate
      INTO @lv_dummy
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie Flugdetails aus `sflights` und den entsprechenden Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus `scarr` für eine Liste von Flügen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie zwei `SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES`-Anweisungen und kombinieren Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fae_join_alt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details_with_name
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_details) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_alt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details_with_name.
    IF it_flight_keys IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_scarr    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " 1. Get flight details
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
      WHERE carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid
        AND connid = @it_flight_keys-connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Get carrier names for the selected flights
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @lt_sflights-carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.

    " 3. Combine results
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_flight_detail) = VALUE ty_flight_detail(
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto
      ).
      READ TABLE lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_scarr) WITH KEY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_flight_detail-carrname = ls_scarr-carrname.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_detail TO rt_flight_details.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um über die interne Tabelle zu iterieren und die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total passengers should be positive' act = ( lv_total > 0 ) ).

Instructions: Exportieren Sie eine Liste von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights` als XML-Dokument, wobei jeder Flug ein Element mit Attributen für 'carrid' und 'connid' ist und die Details als Unterelemente dargestellt werden. Verwenden Sie `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `ADD_ATTRIBUTE` für die Attribute und `OPEN_ELEMENT`/`WRITE_VALUE` für die Unterelemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_xml_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_flights_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_xml_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_flights_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flights' ).
      LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flight' ).
          lo_writer->add_attribute( name = 'CarrierID' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_writer->add_attribute( name = 'ConnectionID' value = ls_flight-connid ).

          lo_writer->open_element( name = 'FlightDate' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
          lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Price' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
          lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Currency' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-currency ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).
      ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_xml_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und den `GROUP SIZE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Flügen enthält. Jeder Flug soll ein Element mit Attributen für 'carrid' und 'connid' sein. Wenn der Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, soll ein zusätzliches Attribut 'expensive' mit Wert 'true' hinzugefügt werden. Verwenden Sie `cl_sec_sxml_writer` und moderne ABAP-Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die bedingte Attributerstellung innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_cond_attr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_cond_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_cond_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_cond_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flights' ).
      LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Flight' ).
          lo_writer->add_attribute( name = 'CarrierID' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_writer->add_attribute( name = 'ConnectionID' value = ls_flight-connid ).

          IF ls_flight-price > 1000 AND ls_flight-currency = 'EUR'.
            lo_writer->add_attribute( name = 'expensive' value = 'true' ).
          ENDIF.

          lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Price' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
          lo_writer->open_element( name = 'Currency' ).
            lo_writer->write_value( ls_flight-currency ).
          lo_writer->close_element( ).
        lo_writer->close_element( ).
      ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_xml_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_cond_flight_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_cond_flight_xml.
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '1200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.
    INSERT VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_cond_attr( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_cond_flight_xml( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'XML string should not be initial' act = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'LH flight should be marked expensive' substring = '<Flight CarrierID="LH" ConnectionID="0400" expensive="true">' act = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'AA flight should not be marked expensive' substring = 'expensive="true"' act = lv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die XML-Generierung mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer` mit bedingter Logik (`IF`) zur dynamischen Hinzufügung von Attributen. Dies ist ein häufiges Szenario, um zusätzliche Metadaten basierend auf den Datenwerten in das XML aufzunehmen. Die Verwendung von `IF` innerhalb der Schleife ist hier klar und effizient.
keywords: cl_sec_sxml_writer, XML, Conditional Logic, Attributes, Internal Tables

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf 'carrid' und 'connid' in eine Struktur. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Tabellenexpression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE` mit einer Tabellenexpression `itab[ key_field = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        rs_flight = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_table_expression( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should match' act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connection ID should match' act = ls_result-connid exp = '0400' ).

  METHOD test_get_single_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_table_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_itab_line_not_found ).
    lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie sind eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY`. Bei nicht gefundenen Einträgen lösen sie eine Ausnahme (`cx_sy_itab_line_not_found`) aus, was eine klare Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Fügen Sie der Tabelle `sflights` eine neue Spalte für eine zufällige Flugverspätung (in Minuten, 0 bis 120) hinzu und füllen Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT` und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_delays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_delay,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             delay_min TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_delay.
    TYPES tt_sflight_delay TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_delay WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_delays
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_delay.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_delays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_delays.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                            delay_min = CONV i( lo_random->get_next( p_min = 0, p_max = 120 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_flights_with_delays) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_delays( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_with_delays ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_delays INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-delay_min >= 0 AND ls_flight-delay_min < 120 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks, der Kommas und/oder Leerzeichen als Trennzeichen erkennt.
hint: `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` können zum Splitten verwendet werden, indem man die Matches als Trennzeichen interpretiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '[, ]+' ). " Matches one or more commas or spaces
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND iv_text+lv_offset( lo_matcher->get_matched_offset( ) - lv_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->get_matched_offset( ) + lo_matcher->get_matched_length( ).
    ENDWHILE.
    APPEND iv_text+lv_offset TO rt_parts. " Add remaining part

    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL. " Remove empty entries
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_split( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( 'Apfel, Birne, Orange' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Apfel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Birne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Orange' ).

    lt_result = lo_cut->split_by_regex( '  Eins,  Zwei , Drei  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Eins' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Zwei' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'Drei' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Vor- und Nachnamen aus einem String im Format 'Nachname, Vorname'.
hint: Verwenden Sie Regex-Gruppen und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>GET_SUBMATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name.
    METHODS extract_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_full_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_name) TYPE ty_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_name.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^(\w+),\s*(\w+)$' ). " Group 1: Last Name, Group 2: First Name
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).

CLASS zcl_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_s_carrid(

        high = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_carrid-high )

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie mehrere Range-Bedingungen (z.B. für `CARRID` und `CONNID`) in einer einzigen Range-Tabelle für die spätere Verwendung.
hint: Erstellen Sie separate Range-Tabellen und fügen Sie deren Einträge zu einer kombinierten Range-Tabelle hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE string,
             high   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES: tt_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS combine_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE zcl_range_builder=>tt_s_carrid
        it_connid_range TYPE zcl_range_select=>tt_s_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_range) TYPE tt_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD combine_ranges.
    LOOP AT it_carrid_range INTO DATA(ls_carrid_line).
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_line(
        sign   = ls_carrid_line-sign
        option = ls_carrid_line-option
        low    = ls_carrid_line-low
        high   = ls_carrid_line-high
      ) TO rt_combined_range.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT it_connid_range INTO DATA(ls_connid_line).
      APPEND VALUE ty_range_line(
        sign   = ls_connid_line-sign
        option = ls_connid_line-option
        low    = ls_connid_line-low
        high   = ls_connid_line-high
      ) TO rt_combined_range.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_ranges.
    DATA(lo_range_builder) = NEW zcl_range_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = lo_range_builder->get_carrid_range( ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_range_select=>tt_s_connid(
      ( sign = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_connid-sign
        option = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_connid-option
        low = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_connid-low
        high = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_connid-high )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->combine_ranges( it_carrid_range = lt_carrid_range it_connid_range = lt_connid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[1]-low exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[2]-low exp = '0001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Zusammenführen von Range-Tabellen ermöglicht die Erstellung komplexer Selektionskriterien aus verschiedenen Quellen. Die moderne Syntax mit `VALUE` und `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA()` macht den Code lesbar und effizient.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String eine gültige URL enthält und extrahieren Sie das Protokoll und die Domain.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit komplexeren Regex-Gruppen und `GET_SUBMATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_url_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_parts,
             is_valid TYPE abap_bool,
             protocol TYPE string,
             domain   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url_parts.
    METHODS parse_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_url_parts) TYPE ty_url_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_url.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '^(https?|ftp):\/\/([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)(?:\/|$)' ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_url ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_url_parts-is_valid = abap_true.
      rs_url_parts-protocol = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_url_parts-domain = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
    ELSE.
      rs_url_parts-is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_url_parsing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_parsing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_url_parser( ).
    DATA(ls_parts) = lo_cut->parse_url( 'https://www.sap.com/path/to/page' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_parts-is_valid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parts-protocol exp = 'https' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parts-domain exp = 'www.sap.com' ).

    ls_parts = lo_cut->parse_url( 'ftp://ftp.example.org' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_parts-is_valid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parts-protocol exp = 'ftp' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_parts-domain exp = 'ftp.example.org' ).

    ls_parts = lo_cut->parse_url( 'invalid-url' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ls_parts-is_valid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für `CARRID` mit mehreren Einträgen (EQ und NE) und filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) entsprechend.
hint: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen zur Range-Tabelle hinzu und verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrid,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_s_carrid.
    TYPES: tt_s_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_multi_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_range_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_multi_carrid.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_s_carrid(
      ( sign = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_carrid-sign " 'I', 'EQ', 'LH'
        option = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_carrid-option
        low = zif_fsbp_const_range=>gc_carrid-low )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'NE' low = 'AA' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'S*' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_range_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_range_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'SQ'. ls_sflight-connid = '0001'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0002'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_range_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_multi_carrid( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Range-Tabellen können komplexe Filterbedingungen mit mehreren Inklusions- und Exklusionskriterien abbilden. Der `FILTER` Operator verarbeitet diese effizient. Die Kombination mit Konstanten aus `IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE` sorgt für eine standardisierte Definition der Kriterien.
keywords: RANGES, Internal Tables, FILTER, Multiple Conditions, IF_FSBP_CONST_RANGE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwende eine `FOR`-Expression mit `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                           ( ls_sflight ) ).
    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                           FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (`seatsocc`) für jeden Flug (`carrid`, `connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflight`.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einer `SUM`-Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_passenger_sum,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      END OF ty_flight_passenger_sum,
      tt_flight_passenger_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_passenger_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_passenger_sum_by_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_passenger_sums) TYPE tt_flight_passenger_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_sum_by_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_passenger_sum(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        connid = ls_group_key-connid
        total_passengers = SUM( ls_sflight-seatsocc )
      ) TO rt_passenger_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_passenger_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passenger_sum.
    DATA(lt_result) = zcl_sflight_group_sum=>get_passenger_sum_by_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_aa_0001_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_aa_0001_sum WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0001'.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_0001) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_0001-total_passengers exp = lv_expected_aa_0001_sum msg = 'Sum for AA 0001 should match' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Entry for AA 0001 not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_expected_lh_0400_sum) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_lh_0400_sum WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_0400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_0400-total_passengers exp = lv_expected_lh_0400_sum msg = 'Sum for LH 0400 should match' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Entry for LH 0400 not found in result' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit der Aggregatfunktion `SUM`. Dies ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code, ohne auf temporäre Tabellen oder manuelle Schleifen zurückgreifen zu müssen. Die Methode ist als `CLASS-METHOD` deklariert, da sie eine Utility-Funktion darstellt, die keine Instanzdaten benötigt.
keywords: SUM, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, CLASS-METHODS

Instructions: Implementiere eine einfache Factory-Klasse, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt.
hint: Verwende `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory-Methode und `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ.

INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_product.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_PRODUCT_{ iv_product_type }|.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_product TYPE (lv_class_name).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_product FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_create_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product msg = 'Product A should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Product A name should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product msg = 'Product B should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' msg = 'Product B name should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_product.
    TRY.
        zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Creating invalid product should raise an exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_create_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( sy-langu msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Factory-Design-Pattern mithilfe einer `CLASS-METHOD`. Die statische Methode `create_product` ist für die Instanziierung der konkreten Produktklassen verantwortlich, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Dies entkoppelt die Client-Logik von der konkreten Implementierung und fördert die Erweiterbarkeit. Die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (lv_class_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature im modernen ABAP.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Interface, Dynamic Object Creation

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Sitzplätze (`seatsmax`) für alle Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten.
hint: Verwende `FILTER` und `REDUCE` mit `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity_above_min
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_above_min.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab( lt_all_flights WHERE seatsmax > iv_min_capacity ).

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax( INIT sum_capacity = 0
                                                  FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                                  NEXT sum_capacity = sum_capacity + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (`price`) für alle Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Monat starten, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`).
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `SUM` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung für den Monat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_monthly_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_monthly_sum,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_price TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_carrier_monthly_sum,
      tt_carrier_monthly_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_monthly_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_monthly_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_month TYPE sy-monat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_monthly_sums) TYPE tt_carrier_monthly_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_monthly_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_monthly_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 ) = iv_month.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                    INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_monthly_sum(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        total_price = SUM( ls_sflight-price )
      ) TO rt_monthly_sums.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD capitalize_first_letter.
    IF iv_input_string IS INITIAL.

    rv_formatted_string = |{ to_upper( substring( val = iv_input_string off = 0 len = 1 ) ) }{ to_lower( substring( val = iv_input_string off = 1 ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (`price`) für alle Flüge, aber nur wenn der Flugstatus 'C' (Confirmed) ist. Andernfalls wird der Preis als 0 behandelt. Verwende eine `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einer `COND`-Expression innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_confirmed_flights_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_confirmed_flights_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                           ( ls_sflight ) ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                           FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + 
                                             COND #( WHEN ls_flight-status = 'C' THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Utility-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft und das Ergebnis zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS invoke_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_result     TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_method.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    " Example: If the method has a returning parameter
    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_NAME'. " Assuming a method returns a value into RV_NAME
    GET REFERENCE OF ev_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>ret_parameter.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflight`, die mindestens einen Flug mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben. Die Ausgabe soll ein String sein, in dem die Fluggesellschaften durch Kommas getrennt sind.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `COND` und `LINES OF` sowie `REDUCE` für die String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_high_price_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_high_price_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrier_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_high_price_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_price_carriers.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lt_unique_carriers) = VALUE string_table( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      WHERE ( LINES OF ( FILTER sflight_tab( ls_group WHERE price > iv_price_threshold ) ) > 0 )
      ( ls_group-carrid ) ).

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR carrier IN lt_unique_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN carrier ELSE s && `, ` && carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Utility-Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die den Namen aller öffentlichen Instanzmethoden eines gegebenen Objekts zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_rtti_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_public_instance_methods
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_instance_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    LOOP AT lt_methods INTO DATA(ls_method).
      IF ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public
         AND ls_method-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>instance_method.
        APPEND ls_method-name TO rt_method_names.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (`price`) für alle Flüge, die in der Tabelle `sflight` enthalten sind, aber nur für die ersten 5 Einträge, die einen Preis über 1000 haben.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `UNTIL` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_until DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_first_n_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        iv_count     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_until IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_first_n_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                           FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                           UNTIL sum_price IS NOT INITIAL AND sy-tabix > iv_count
                                           WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_first_5_over_1000 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_first_2_over_5000 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_no_flights_over_threshold FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_first_5_over_1000.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sum_until( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    DATA lt_temp_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_temp_flights WHERE price > 1000 ORDER BY price DESCENDING.
    LOOP AT lt_temp_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) UP TO 5.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_sum_of_first_n_expensive_flights( iv_threshold = 1000 iv_count = 5 ) exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Sum of first 5 expensive flights should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_first_2_over_5000.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sum_until( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    DATA lt_temp_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_temp_flights WHERE price > 5000 ORDER BY price DESCENDING.
    LOOP AT lt_temp_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) UP TO 2.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_sum_of_first_n_expensive_flights( iv_threshold = 5000 iv_count = 2 ) exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Sum of first 2 very expensive flights should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_no_flights_over_threshold.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_sum_until( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_sum_of_first_n_expensive_flights( iv_threshold = 999999 iv_count = 1 ) exp = 0 msg = 'Sum should be 0 if no flights meet criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `UNTIL`-Klausel in einer `FOR`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE`, um die Iteration zu begrenzen, sobald eine bestimmte Anzahl von Elementen verarbeitet wurde. In Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung ermöglicht dies eine effiziente Aggregation von Daten, die sowohl nach einem Kriterium gefiltert als auch in ihrer Anzahl begrenzt sind.
keywords: SUM, REDUCE, FOR, UNTIL, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_flight_util DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_util IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_long_haul.
    " Beispiel: Annahme, dass Flüge mit 'LH' und '0400' Langstreckenflüge sind
    IF iv_carrid = 'LH' AND iv_connid = '0400'.
      rv_is_long_haul = abap_true.
    ELSEIF iv_carrid = 'AA' AND iv_connid = '0017'.
      rv_is_long_haul = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_long_haul = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden und noch freie Plätze haben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_upcoming_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_upcoming_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
        iv_today       TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_upcoming_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_upcoming_available_flights.
    DATA(lv_next_week) = iv_today + 7.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE fldate BETWEEN iv_today AND lv_next_week AND seatsocc < seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_upcoming_flights.
    DATA: lt_mock_flights TYPE zcl_filter_upcoming_flights=>ty_t_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 90. " Past, available
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251208'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 145. " Future, available
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251209'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200. " Future, full
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251210'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 120. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. " Future, available

CLASS zcl_fetch_top_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die 3 Flüge mit den meisten freien Plätzen aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT UP TO N ROWS` mit `ORDER BY` und einer Berechnung der freien Plätze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_top_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_free_seats,
             carrid     TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflights-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_free_seats.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_free_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_free_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_free_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_top_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_free_seats.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) AS free_seats
      FROM sflights
      ORDER BY free_seats DESCENDING
      UP TO @iv_number_of_rows ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_3_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_3_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_top_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_free_seats( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify sorting (assuming sflights has enough data for a meaningful test)
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 3.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-free_seats >= lt_result[ 2 ]-free_seats msg = 'Sorting order incorrect' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-free_seats >= lt_result[ 3 ]-free_seats msg = 'Sorting order incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `SELECT UP TO N ROWS` mit einer `ORDER BY` Klausel und einer direkten Berechnung im `SELECT`-Statement können die Top-N-Ergebnisse basierend auf einem berechneten Wert effizient abgerufen werden. Dies ist ein Standardmuster für Ranglisten oder Top-Listen.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, ORDER BY, Database Access, Calculation

             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_page_number TYPE i
        iv_page_size   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_paginated_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_page.
    DATA(lv_offset) = ( iv_page_number - 1 ) * iv_page_size.

    SELECT * FROM sflights
      ORDER BY fldate, carrid, connid
      OFFSET @lv_offset ROWS
      FETCH NEXT @iv_page_size ROWS ONLY
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_second_page FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_second_page.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_paginated_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result_page1) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_page_number = 1 iv_page_size = 10 ).
    DATA(lt_result_page2) = lo_cut->get_flights_page( iv_page_number = 2 iv_page_size = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_page2 ) exp = 10 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights on second page' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Second page should not be initial' act = lt_result_page2 ).

    " Basic check that pages are different (assuming enough data in sflights)
    IF lines( lt_result_page1 ) > 0 AND lines( lt_result_page2 ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_result_page1[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lt_result_page2[ 1 ]-carrid msg = 'First entries of pages are identical, likely an issue' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `OFFSET ... ROWS FETCH NEXT ... ROWS ONLY` Klausel ist das moderne und performante Mittel zur Implementierung von Paginierung in Open SQL ab ABAP 7.51. Sie delegiert die Paginierungslogik direkt an die Datenbank, was die Effizienz gegenüber manueller Paginierung im Applikationsserver erheblich steigert.
keywords: SELECT, OFFSET, FETCH NEXT, Pagination, Database Access

Instructions: Lesen Sie die nächsten 5 Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die nach einem bestimmten Flugdatum liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT UP TO N ROWS` mit einer `WHERE` Klausel, die das Startdatum festlegt, und `ORDER BY` für eine konsistente Reihenfolge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_next_batch_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
