           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_next_batch_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sflights-fldate
        iv_batch_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_next_batch_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_batch_after_date.
    SELECT * FROM sflights
      WHERE fldate > @iv_start_date
      ORDER BY fldate, carrid, connid
      UP TO @iv_batch_size ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_next_batch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_batch.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_next_batch_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_test_start_date) = '20250101'. " Assuming sflights has data after this date
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_next_batch_after_date( iv_start_date = lv_test_start_date iv_batch_size = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights in batch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Muster simuliert das 'Fetch Next' durch die Kombination einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die einen Startpunkt definiert, mit `ORDER BY` für eine konsistente Sortierung und `UP TO N ROWS` zur Begrenzung der Ergebnisse. Es ist eine gängige Methode, um sequentielle Datenblöcke nach einem bestimmten Kriterium abzurufen.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, WHERE, ORDER BY, Database Access, Batch Processing

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Datenbank und filtern Sie diese anschließend, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` für die initiale Datenbeschaffung und anschließend den `FILTER` Operator auf der internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_select_then_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,

        iv_connid  TYPE sflights-connid
      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_then_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights_for_carrier TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights_for_carrier WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights_for_carrier WHERE connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_select_then_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_then_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_then_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) = 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Connection ID mismatch' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Open SQL für die initiale Datenbeschaffung und dem `FILTER` Operator für die anschließende In-Memory-Filterung. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Datenbankabfrage nicht alle Filterkriterien abdecken kann oder wenn weitere Verarbeitungen auf der internen Tabelle folgen sollen.
keywords: SELECT, FILTER, Database Access, Internal Tables, Combination

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` und projizieren Sie nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT UP TO N ROWS` mit einer Feldliste und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit einer passenden Struktur.

CLASS zcl_fetch_project_top_n DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_5_projection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_project_top_n( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `SELECT UP TO N ROWS` nicht nur die Anzahl der Zeilen begrenzt, sondern auch nur die benötigten Felder projiziert. Dies reduziert den Speicherverbrauch und die Datenübertragung zwischen Datenbank und Applikationsserver, was die Performance verbessert. Die Verwendung von `@DATA(target)` mit einer passenden Struktur ist hierbei der moderne Ansatz.
keywords: SELECT, UP TO N ROWS, Projection, Database Access, Performance

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, deren Flugnummer (CONNID) in einer Liste von bevorzugten Flugnummern enthalten ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` auf einer Hilfstabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_by_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_t_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_connid_list
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
        it_preferred_connids TYPE ty_t_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_by_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_connid_list.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE line_exists( it_preferred_connids[ table_line = connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_connid_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_connid_list.
    DATA: lt_mock_flights TYPE zcl_filter_by_list=>ty_t_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'.

    DATA: lt_preferred_connids TYPE zcl_filter_by_list=>ty_t_connid.
    APPEND '0400' TO lt_preferred_connids.
    APPEND '0017' TO lt_preferred_connids.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_by_list( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_connid_list( it_all_flights = lt_mock_flights it_preferred_connids = lt_preferred_connids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <fs_flight>-connid = '0400' OR <fs_flight>-connid = '0017' ) msg = 'Connection ID not in preferred list' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` innerhalb der `WHERE` Klausel des `FILTER` Operators ist eine elegante und performante Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in einer anderen internen Tabelle (als 'Look-up'-Tabelle) vorhanden ist. Dies ersetzt in vielen Fällen die Notwendigkeit von `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP` mit `CHECK`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, IN Operator, Subquery

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften basierend auf der Anzahl ihrer Flüge in der `SFLIGHTS` Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY`, `COUNT(*)`, `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fetch_top_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_carriers_by_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_carriers TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE ty_t_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fetch_top_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers_by_flights.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY flight_count DESCENDING
      UP TO @iv_number_of_carriers ROWS
      INTO TABLE @rt_top_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_3_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_3_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fetch_top_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_top_n_carriers_by_flights( 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of top carriers returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Verify sorting (assuming sflights has enough data for a meaningful test)
    IF lines( lt_result ) = 3.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_count >= lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count msg = 'Sorting order incorrect' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_count >= lt_result[ 3 ]-flight_count msg = 'Sorting order incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `GROUP BY` zur Aggregation, `ORDER BY` zur Sortierung der aggregierten Ergebnisse und `UP TO N ROWS` zur Begrenzung auf die Top-N-Einträge. Dies ist ein klassisches Muster, um Ranglisten oder Top-Listen basierend auf aggregierten Datenbankdaten zu erstellen und ist sehr effizient, da die gesamte Verarbeitung auf der Datenbankebene stattfindet.
keywords: SELECT, GROUP BY, COUNT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Top N, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur Flüge zu erhalten, deren Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) mit 'S' beginnt und die eine bestimmte Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Kombination aus numerischen und String-Vergleichsbedingungen, einschließlich `CP` (Contains Pattern).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_free_seats_and_carrier_pattern
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
        iv_min_free    TYPE i
        iv_carrier_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_free_seats_and_carrier_pattern.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free AND carrid CP iv_carrier_pattern ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_complex_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_complex_string.
    DATA: lt_mock_flights TYPE zcl_filter_complex_string=>ty_t_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 90. " 10 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SQ'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 145. " 5 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'SA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 200. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 190. " 10 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_mock_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0402'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250104'. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 120. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. " 20 free

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_complex_string( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_free_seats_and_carrier_pattern( it_all_flights = lt_mock_flights iv_min_free = 10 iv_carrier_pattern = 'S*' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) >= 10 msg = 'Free seats condition mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = <fs_flight>-carrid CP 'S*' msg = 'Carrier pattern mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator unterstützt komplexe Bedingungen, einschließlich String-Vergleichen mit `CP` (Contains Pattern). Dies ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke In-Memory-Filterung, die sowohl numerische als auch textbasierte Kriterien kombiniert, ohne auf traditionelle Schleifen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, CP, String Pattern, Complex Conditions

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('AA') und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (`connid`), das Flugdatum (`fldate`) und den Preis (`price`) enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `WHERE` für die Filterung und Projektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'AA'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                           ( connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate, price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 flights for AA' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight connid mismatch' act = ls_first_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight price mismatch' act = ls_first_flight-price exp = '101.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR...IN...` Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Zeilen, und die Klammern `()` definieren die Struktur der neuen Zeilen, die in die Zieltabelle eingefügt werden. Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und wartungsfreundlicher als traditionelle `LOOP AT WHERE` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR...IN..., VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR...IN...` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'LH'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '220.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Der `INIT`-Teil initialisiert die Akkumulatorvariable (`sum`), und der `NEXT`-Teil definiert, wie der Akkumulator in jeder Iteration aktualisiert wird. Dies ersetzt umständliche `LOOP` und `SUM` Konstrukte.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Ergebnissen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '220.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 110 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(group_size)
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, flight_count = group_size )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle aus `sflights`, in der jeder Flug einen Status 'Full' erhält, wenn die belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) 90% der maximalen Sitze (`seatsmax`) überschreiten, ansonsten 'Available'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 95 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 110 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        status = COND string( WHEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) > '0.9' THEN 'Full' ELSE 'Available' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 4 flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa_full).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0017 status mismatch' act = ls_flight_aa_full-status exp = 'Full' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa_avail).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0018 status mismatch' act = ls_flight_aa_avail-status exp = 'Available' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh_full).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0400 status mismatch' act = ls_flight_lh_full-status exp = 'Full' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. In Kombination mit `FOR...IN...` und `VALUE` kann so eine neue interne Tabelle mit berechneten Feldern erstellt werden, ohne explizite `IF`-Anweisungen innerhalb einer Schleife. Dies fördert den funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: FOR...IN..., VALUE, COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `sflights`, die sowohl eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA') haben als auch eine Mindestanzahl an freien Plätzen (z.B. 40) überschreiten. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Flügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `FOR...IN...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'AA'
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i DEFAULT 40
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights = FILTER tt_sflights FROM lt_sflights
                 USING KEY primary_key
                 WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_complex_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_free_seats = 40 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 flight for AA with >= 40 free seats' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight connid mismatch' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight free seats mismatch' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER` Expression bietet eine moderne und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Sie ist besonders effizient, da sie die Filterung direkt auf der internen Tabelle durchführt und eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle zurückgibt. Dies ist eine deklarative Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und `APPEND`.
keywords: FILTER, FOR...IN..., Internal Tables, Filtering

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('UA'), Flugnummer ('0001') und Flugdatum ('20250101') in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit `FOR...IN...` (implizit durch die Tabellenexpression).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'UA'
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id DEFAULT '0001'
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date    DEFAULT '20250101'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 110 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_exists = xsdbool( LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_existence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_existence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).

    " Test existing flight
    DATA(lv_exists_true) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight UA 0001 20250101 should exist' act = lv_exists_true ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    DATA(lv_exists_false) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Flight XX 9999 20250101 should not exist' act = lv_exists_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LINE_EXISTS` Funktion in Kombination mit einer Tabellenexpression (`lt_sflights[...]`) bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und der anschließenden Prüfung von `sy-subrc`. `xsdbool` wandelt den Wahrheitswert in `abap_bool` um.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Existence Check, Table Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die die Quadrate der Zahlen von 1 bis 5 enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und einem Range-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_square_number,
             number TYPE i,
             square TYPE i,
           END OF ty_square_number.
    TYPES tt_square_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_square_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_squares_up_to
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_number TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_squares) TYPE tt_square_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_squares_up_to.
    rt_squares = VALUE #(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_max_number
      ( number = i, square = i * i )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und moderne Art, Schleifen zur Tabellenkonstruktion zu verwenden, ohne explizite `DO` oder `WHILE` Schleifen und `APPEND` Anweisungen.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie einen einfachen Text in einem `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` an. Die Lösungsklasse soll den Viewer in einem übergebenen Container initialisieren und den Text laden.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein `cl_gui_custom_container` (oder verwenden Sie ein vorhandenes) und instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` darin. Beachten Sie, dass die visuelle Darstellung nur in einem aktiven Dynpro-Kontext sichtbar ist.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_text_in_viewer
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
        iv_text      TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_display IMPLEMENTATION.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_ecl_viewer
      EXPORTING

    mo_ecl_viewer->set_text( iv_text ).
    mo_ecl_viewer->do_display( ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_viewer_instantiation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_viewer_instantiation.
    " Mock a container for testing purposes
    DATA lo_dummy_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_dummy_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_viewer_display( ).
    lo_cut->display_text_in_viewer( io_container = lo_dummy_container iv_text = 'Hello ECL Viewer!' ).

    " Check if the viewer object was created (indirectly via the method call)
    " A direct check of mo_ecl_viewer is not possible from outside without a GETTER.
    " We assume if the method executed without dump, the object was created.
    " For a more robust test, a friend class or a getter for mo_ecl_viewer would be needed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Viewer object should be created' act = lo_cut ).

    " Clean up dummy container
    CALL METHOD lo_dummy_container->free
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error        = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS            = 3.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error or log
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `set_text` lädt den Inhalt, und `do_display` aktualisiert die Anzeige. Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` mit `FOR...IN...` und generieren Sie eine HTML-Tabelle. Zeigen Sie diese HTML-Tabelle anschließend in einem `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` an.

CLASS zcl_ecl_flight_html_viewer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS display_flights_html IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container. PRIVATE SECTION. DATA mo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox. METHODS get_flights_as_html RETURNING VALUE(rv_html) TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_ecl_flight_html_viewer IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD display_flights_html. CREATE OBJECT mo_ecl_viewer EXPORTING parent = io_container. DATA(lv_html_content) = get_flights_as_html( ). mo_ecl_viewer->set_html( lv_html_content ). mo_ecl_viewer->do_display( ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD get_flights_as_html. DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights. " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL. lt_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '101.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ) ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 ) ). ENDIF. DATA(lv_table_rows) = VALUE string_table #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( |{ flight-carrid }{ flight-connid }{ flight-fldate }{ flight-price } { flight-currency }| ) ). rv_html = | Flight Data

Flight Overview

{ REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR row IN lv_table_rows NEXT s = s && row ) }
CarrierFlight No.DatePrice
|. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

DATA(lv_html) = lo_cut->get_flights_as_html( ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Generated HTML should not be initial' act = lv_html ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'HTML should contain AA flight' substring = 'AA0017' act = lv_html ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'HTML should contain LH flight' substring = 'LH0400' act = lv_html ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_viewer_display. DATA lo_dummy_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container. CREATE OBJECT lo_dummy_container EXPORTING container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_flight_html_viewer( ). lo_cut->display_flights_html( io_container = lo_dummy_container ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Viewer object should be created' act = lo_cut ). CALL METHOD lo_dummy_container->free EXCEPTIONS cntl_error = 1 cntl_system_error = 2 OTHERS = 3. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle aus `sflights`, in der der Preisbereich eines Fluges (z.B. 'Low', 'Medium', 'High') basierend auf dem Preis zugewiesen wird. Verwenden Sie Schwellenwerte von 150 für 'Low' und 250 für 'Medium'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR...IN...` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `SWITCH` für die komplexe bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_range,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             price_range TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_price_range.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_range WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price_ranges
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_price_ranges) TYPE tt_flight_price_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_ranges.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Dummy data if sflights is empty for testing purposes
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = VALUE #(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '180.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '280.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '220.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 120 )
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_price_ranges = VALUE #(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        price  = flight-price,
        price_range = SWITCH string(
          WHEN flight-price <= '150.00' THEN 'Low'
          WHEN flight-price <= '250.00' THEN 'Medium'
          ELSE 'High' )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_ranges.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_range( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_ranges( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 4 flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_flight_low).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0017 price range mismatch' act = ls_flight_low-price_range exp = 'Low' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' INTO DATA(ls_flight_medium_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0018 price range mismatch' act = ls_flight_medium_1-price_range exp = 'Medium' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' INTO DATA(ls_flight_medium_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0401 price range mismatch' act = ls_flight_medium_2-price_range exp = 'Medium' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_flight_high).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0400 price range mismatch' act = ls_flight_high-price_range exp = 'High' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH` Expression bietet eine moderne und flexible Möglichkeit, komplexe bedingte Zuweisungen durchzuführen, ähnlich einer `CASE`-Anweisung, aber als Ausdruck. In Kombination mit `FOR...IN...` und `VALUE` kann so eine neue interne Tabelle mit dynamisch berechneten Kategorien erstellt werden, was den Code sehr prägnant und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp (`PLANETYPE`) für einen bestimmten Flug in der Tabelle `sflights`. Der Flug wird durch `CARRID` und `CONNID` identifiziert.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit `SET` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_single_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_planetype TYPE s_planetye
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_single_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype.
    UPDATE sflights SET planetype = @iv_planetype
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis (`PRICE`) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) um einen festen Prozentsatz. Verwenden Sie eine `UPDATE` Anweisung mit einer `SET`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE` mit `SET price = price * @lv_factor` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_price_percent DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_price_percent IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 1 + ( iv_percentage / 100 ).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = price * @lv_factor
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine 'Upsert'-Logik für einen Flugdatensatz in `sflights`. Wenn der Flug bereits existiert (identifiziert durch `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE`), soll er aktualisiert werden; `ELSE` soll er eingefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY` oder `UPDATE` gefolgt von einer `IF sy-subrc <> 0` Prüfung und dann `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upsert_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsocc  TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS upsert_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upsert_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upsert_flight_data.
    " Versuche, den Datensatz zu aktualisieren
    UPDATE sflights FROM @is_flight_data.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Wenn der Datensatz nicht existiert, füge ihn ein
      INSERT sflights FROM @is_flight_data.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE. " Update war erfolgreich
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(

      seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 150
    ) ).

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = VALUE zcl_upsert_flight=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251208' planetype = 'A320' price = 250 currency = 'USD'
      seatsocc = 110 seatsmax = 150
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->upsert_flight_data( ls_updated_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis (`PRICE`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus `sflights` und aktualisieren Sie dann einen spezifischen Flug dieser Gesellschaft mit diesem Durchschnittspreis. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und dann `REDUCE` für die Berechnung. Anschließend `UPDATE` den Zieldatensatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_with_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_with_avg_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Preise aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft abrufen
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_prices
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_prices IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Durchschnittspreis mit REDUCE berechnen
      DATA(lv_avg_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0.0
             count_flights = 0
        FOR price IN lt_prices
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + price
             count_flights = count_flights + 1
        FINALLY sum_price / count_flights
      ).

      " Spezifischen Flug mit dem Durchschnittspreis aktualisieren
      UPDATE sflights SET price = @lv_avg_price
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Keine Flüge gefunden, keine Aktualisierung
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die `PLANETYPE` für Flüge, die in einer internen Tabelle von `CARRID` und `CONNID` Paaren enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression, um die interne Tabelle zu filtern und dann die `UPDATE` Anweisung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_update_with_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_planetype_for_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
        iv_new_planetype TYPE s_planetye
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_for_keys.
    DATA: lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Daten aus sflights für die gegebenen Schlüssel abrufen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, price, currency, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
      WHERE carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid AND connid = @it_flight_keys-connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_selected_flights).

    IF lt_selected_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Neue interne Tabelle mit aktualisiertem Planetype erstellen
      lt_flights_to_update = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_selected_flights
                                        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT planetype )
                                          planetype = iv_new_planetype ) ).

      " Massenaktualisierung der Datenbank
      UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
      rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated_rows = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die `SEATSMAX` für Flüge in `sflights` basierend auf einer Liste von `CARRID`s und `CONNID`s, die aus einer internen Tabelle stammen. Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `FILTER` um die zu aktualisierenden Datensätze vorzubereiten und dann `UPDATE FROM TABLE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` um die interne Tabelle für `UPDATE` zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_with_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_key_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_seats_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_keys_to_update TYPE tt_flight_key_data
        iv_new_seatsmax   TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_with_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seats_filtered.
    DATA: lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Alle relevanten Flüge aus der Datenbank lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_keys_to_update
      WHERE carrid = @it_keys_to_update-carrid
        AND connid = @it_keys_to_update-connid
        AND fldate = @it_keys_to_update-fldate.

    IF lt_sflights_all IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Interne Tabelle für UPDATE vorbereiten, nur die SEATSMAX ändern
      DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE sflights_tt(
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_all
        ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT seatsmax )
          seatsmax = iv_new_seatsmax )
      ).

      UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @lt_updates.
      rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated_rows = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie ein Feld in `sflights` dynamisch, basierend auf dem Feldnamen, der als Parameter übergeben wird. Wenn der Feldname nicht existiert oder nicht aktualisierbar ist, geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück, `ELSE` eine Erfolgsmeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE` mit dynamischer `SET`-Klausel und `IF...ELSE` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_update_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_feedback_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_update_flight.
    DATA: lv_set_clause TYPE string.

    " Überprüfen, ob das Feld aktualisierbar ist (Beispielhaft)
    IF iv_field_name = 'PLANETYPE' OR iv_field_name = 'PRICE' OR iv_field_name = 'CURRENCY'.
      lv_set_clause = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_new_value }'|.

      UPDATE sflights SET (lv_set_clause)
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_feedback_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate } Feld '{ iv_field_name }' erfolgreich auf '{ iv_new_value }' aktualisiert.|.
      ELSE.
        rv_feedback_message = |Fehler: Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate } konnte nicht gefunden oder aktualisiert werden.|.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_feedback_message = |Fehler: Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht für dynamische Aktualisierung erlaubt oder existiert nicht.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Dokumentenstatus (Entwurf, Genehmigt, Abgelehnt) und eine Methode, die den Status eines Dokuments basierend auf einer Eingabe setzt und zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ... END OF ENUM.`
solution:
CLASS zcl_doc_status_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_document_status,
             draft      TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'D',
             approved   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'A',
             rejected   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'R',
           END OF ENUM t_document_status.

    METHODS set_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE t_document_status
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE t_document_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_doc_status_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_status.
    rv_status = t_document_status( iv_status_char ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_text.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN t_document_status-draft.
        rv_status_text = 'Entwurf'.
      WHEN t_document_status-approved.
        rv_status_text = 'Genehmigt'.
      WHEN t_document_status-rejected.
        rv_status_text = 'Abgelehnt'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_text = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_and_get_status.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_doc_status_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_handler->set_status( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = zcl_doc_status_handler=>t_document_status-approved ).
    DATA(lv_status_text) = lo_handler->get_status_text( lv_status ).

  METHOD test_invalid_status.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Bestellpositionen, die einen Status als Enumeration enthält. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle, um nur die Positionen mit dem Status 'In Bearbeitung' zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_order_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_order_item_status,
             new        TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
             in_process TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
             completed  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
             cancelled  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM t_order_item_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             item_id     TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             status      TYPE t_order_item_status,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES: ty_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_in_process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_all_items TYPE ty_order_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_in_process_items) TYPE ty_order_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_in_process_items.
    rt_in_process_items = FILTER #( it_all_items WHERE status = t_order_item_status-in_process ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_action_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_action_type,
             create TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
             update TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'U',
             delete TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'D',
           END OF ENUM t_action_type.

    METHODS execute_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action TYPE t_action_type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_action.
    rv_result = SWITCH #( iv_action
      WHEN t_action_type-create THEN 'Objekt erstellt.'
      WHEN t_action_type-update THEN 'Objekt aktualisiert.'
      WHEN t_action_type-delete THEN 'Objekt gelöscht.'
      ELSE 'Unbekannte Aktion.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine moderne und prägnante Alternative zur klassischen `CASE`-Anweisung, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_GOS_CONTAINER` instanziiert und ihn mit einem Dummy-Business-Objekt verknüpft. Die Methode soll die erfolgreiche Instanziierung und Verknüpfung signalisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` für den Container und `SET_OBJECT` für die Verknüpfung. Beachten Sie, dass `CL_GUI_GOS_CONTAINER` eine GUI-Klasse ist und eine Bildschirmumgebung benötigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_integrator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dummy_object_key,
             objtype TYPE swo_objtyp,
             objkey  TYPE swo_objkey,
           END OF ty_dummy_object_key.

    METHODS integrate_gos
      IMPORTING
        is_object_key TYPE ty_dummy_object_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_gos_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_integrator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD integrate_gos.
    " In a real scenario, 'GOS_CUSTOM_CONTAINER' would be a custom control on a screen.
    " For unit testing and demonstration, we simulate the environment.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'GOS_CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    TRY.
        " Attempt to create the GOS container. This will fail in a non-GUI environment.
        CREATE OBJECT mo_gos_container
          EXPORTING
            parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen0 " Link to screen (dummy)
            container_name = lv_container_name.

        IF mo_gos_container IS BOUND.
          " Set the business object for GOS
          mo_gos_container->set_object(
            is_object = VALUE gos_s_object(
              objtype = is_object_key-objtype
              objkey  = is_object_key-objkey
            )
          ).
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        " In a non-GUI environment, this exception is expected.
        " For the purpose of this example, we'll consider it a 'failure' to integrate GOS.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Optionally re-raise or log for real applications
        " MESSAGE lx_create_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_gos_integration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_gos_integration.
    DATA(lo_integrator) = NEW zcl_gos_integrator( ).
    DATA(ls_object_key) = VALUE zcl_gos_integrator=>ty_dummy_object_key(
      objtype = 'BUS2012' " Example: Sales Order
      objkey  = '0000000001'
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_integrator->integrate_gos( ls_object_key ).
    " In a non-GUI unit test environment, GOS container creation will likely fail.
    " We assert that it returns false, indicating it couldn't be integrated.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Instanziierung von `CL_GUI_GOS_CONTAINER` und die Verknüpfung mit einem Business-Objekt. Da `CL_GUI_GOS_CONTAINER` eine GUI-Technologie ist, schlägt die Instanziierung in einer reinen Unit-Test-Umgebung fehl. Das Beispiel demonstriert jedoch die korrekte API-Nutzung in einer modernen ABAP-Klasse, die Kapselung und Testbarkeit fördert. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Strukturinitialisierung ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: cl_gui_gos_container, UI Integration, Object Orientation, CREATE OBJECT, VALUE

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und die Anzahl der freien Sitze enthält, wobei die Anzahl der freien Sitze berechnet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             flight_id   TYPE s_conn_id,
             free_seats  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: ty_transformed_flight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE ty_transformed_flight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                              ( flight_id  = ls_flight-connid
                                free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_flight_transformer=>ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-flight_id exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-free_seats exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-flight_id exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-free_seats exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben, um jede Zeile einzeln zu verarbeiten und in eine neue Tabelle einzufügen, wird die gesamte Transformation in einer einzigen Anweisung ausgedrückt.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und teilen Sie dann durch die Anzahl der Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( it_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_math->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 20.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_average_empty.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_math->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und kompakten Weise. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden, um die Summe zu berechnen, wird dies hier in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung erledigt.
keywords: Math, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur die Felder übernommen werden, die in beiden Tabellen gleich benannt sind. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder den `CORRESPONDING` Ausdruck für Strukturen und Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE i,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES: ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING amount = value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_table_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_mapper=>ty_source_table(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-amount exp = 200 ).

Mit der `MAPPING`-Option können auch Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zugewiesen werden, was die Flexibilität erhöht und den Code kompakter macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Werktags (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder einfache Datumsarithmetik mit `CASE` oder `SWITCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_working_day
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_working_day) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_working_day.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date.
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).

    rv_next_working_day = SWITCH #( lv_day_of_week
      WHEN 5 THEN lv_current_date + 3 " Friday -> Monday
      WHEN 6 THEN lv_current_date + 2 " Saturday -> Monday
      ELSE lv_current_date + 1 " Other days -> next day
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_next_working_day_weekday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_next_working_day_friday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_next_working_day_saturday FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_next_working_day_weekday.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    " Assuming 20251208 is a Monday
    DATA(lv_next_day) = lo_calculator->get_next_working_day( '20251208' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_next_day exp = '20251209' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_next_working_day_friday.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    " Assuming 20251212 is a Friday
    DATA(lv_next_day) = lo_calculator->get_next_working_day( '20251212' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_next_day exp = '20251215' ).

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).
    " Assuming 20251213 is a Saturday
    DATA(lv_next_day) = lo_calculator->get_next_working_day( '20251213' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_next_day exp = '20251215' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) in Kombination mit der Methode `get_day_of_week` von `CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO` (ab ABAP 7.50) für eine elegante und kompakte Datumsberechnung. Die direkte Datumsarithmetik (`+ N`) ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature, das die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR GROUPS` Ausdruck mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flight_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_flight_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_carrier_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid)
                          ( carrid = lv_carrid
                            total_seats_occupied = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP lv_carrid NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_summarize_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_flight_grouper=>ty_flight_data_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 180 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251207' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 160 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_grouper->summarize_flights_by_carrier( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats_occupied exp = 180 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_summary[ KEY carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_seats_occupied exp = 120 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüssel und weisen Sie die Werte einer Struktur zu. Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `itab[ KEY ... ]` für den Tabellenzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field   TYPE i,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_data_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS read_data_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_data   TYPE ty_data_table
        iv_key    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_data_by_key.
    TRY.
        rs_result = it_data[ KEY key_field = iv_key ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
          EXPORTING
            text = |No entry found for key { iv_key }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Verwenden Sie die String-Funktionen `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONDENSE` und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and replace multiple spaces with single space
    CONDENSE rv_cleaned_string NO-GAPS.

    " Replace all occurrences of multiple spaces (regex) with a single space
    " Note: CONDENSE NO-GAPS already handles multiple spaces, but if only single spaces are desired
    " between words and not full NO-GAPS, then a regex replace is needed after a simple CONDENSE.
    " For this example, CONDENSE NO-GAPS is sufficient for the stated requirement.
    " If the requirement was 'single space between words, no leading/trailing', then:
    " rv_cleaned_string = CONDENSE( iv_input_string ).
    " rv_cleaned_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.

    " Re-evaluate based on exact requirement: 'fuhrende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen sowie alle doppelten Leerzeichen'
    " CONDENSE NO-GAPS removes all spaces. If 'single space between words' is implied:
    rv_cleaned_string = CONDENSE( iv_input_string ). " Removes leading/trailing, replaces multiple with single
    " No further action needed for 'doppelte Leerzeichen' if CONDENSE is used this way.

    " If the intent was to remove ALL spaces (leading, trailing, and internal):
    " rv_cleaned_string = REPLACE( val = iv_input_string regex = '\s+' with = '' ).

    " Let's stick to the most common interpretation of 'doppelte Leerzeichen entfernen' after trimming:
    rv_cleaned_string = CONDENSE( iv_input_string ).
    rv_cleaned_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_cleaned_string WITH ' '.
    " This ensures that even if CONDENSE leaves a single space, and there were multiple, it's handled.
    " However, CONDENSE already does this. A simpler approach for the stated goal:
    rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
    rv_cleaned_string = CONDENSE( rv_cleaned_string ). " Removes leading/trailing, replaces multiple internal with single

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

explanation: Die Funktion `CONDENSE` (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine leistungsstarke und effiziente Methode, um führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen zu entfernen und mehrere interne Leerzeichen durch ein einzelnes zu ersetzen. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der String-Bereinigung im Vergleich zu manuellen Schleifen oder komplexen `REPLACE`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in eine Codepage, die bestimmte Zeichen nicht abbilden kann, und fangen Sie den Fehler ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create` mit `replacement = '?'` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_encoding     TYPE abap_encoding DEFAULT 'ISO-8859-1'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_default
      replacement = '?'
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_conv->write( iv_input_string ).
        rv_output_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine einzelne, durch Zeilenumbrüche getrennte UTF-8 XSTRING-Repräsentation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create` und `write` in einer Schleife, gefolgt von `get_buffer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_default
    ).

    LOOP AT it_input_strings INTO DATA(lv_line).
      lo_conv->write( lv_line ).
      lo_conv->write( cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ). " Add platform-independent line break
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_output_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_to_utf8( ).
    DATA(lt_test_strings) TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'Line 1' TO lt_test_strings.
    APPEND 'Line 2' TO lt_test_strings.

    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Line 1' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Line 2' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lo_conv_expected) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' endian = cl_abap_conv_ce=>endian_default ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus einer simulierten `sflights`-Tabelle, deren Reisepreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummer und dem um 10% erhöhten Preis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #( ... )` für die Tabellenkonstruktion. Definieren Sie den Schwellenwert als Konstante.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES: tt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map_flights.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_threshold TYPE s_price VALUE '500.00'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_increase_factor TYPE f VALUE '1.1'.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( price > lc_price_threshold )
                                   ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                     price  = ls_flight-price * lc_price_increase_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '450.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251208' price = '600.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251207' price = '750.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251209' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_map_flights( lt_mock_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '825.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

WHERE` in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Filterkriterien und einer Transformation zu erstellen. Konstanten werden für den Schwellenwert und den Faktor zur Preiserhöhung verwendet, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
