Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer simulierten `sflights`-Tabelle. Der Startwert für die Summe soll eine Konstante sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ...` für die Gruppierung und Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_by_carrier.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_sum TYPE s_price VALUE '0.00'.

    rt_carrier_totals = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_flights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
                                 ( carrid    = ls_group-carrid,
                                   total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = lc_initial_sum
                                                                 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_total_price_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '300.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_by_carrier( lt_mock_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

CLASS zcl_city_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS transform_cities
      IMPORTING
        it_cities TYPE string_table

CLASS zcl_city_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_cities.
    CONSTANTS: lc_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'Neu'.

    rt_transformed_cities = VALUE #( FOR city IN it_cities
                                     ( COND string(
                                           WHEN city CP |{ lc_prefix }*|
                                             THEN to_upper( city )
                                           ELSE city ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle (Map) aus einer simulierten `sflights`-Tabelle, wobei der Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft und der Wert die Anzahl der Flüge dieser Gesellschaft ist.

CLASS zcl_flight_map_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_flight_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS create_carrier_flight_count_map
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_count_map) TYPE ty_flight_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_map_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrier_flight_count_map.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rt_flight_count_map = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     table_line = REDUCE i( INIT count = lc_initial_count
                                                            FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                            NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,

           END OF ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_future_flights.
    CONSTANTS: lc_city_from TYPE s_city VALUE 'FRANKFURT'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_city_to   TYPE s_city VALUE 'NEW YORK'.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( LET lv_current_date = sy-datum IN
                                   FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( cityfrom = lc_city_from AND
                                           cityto   = lc_city_to   AND
                                           fldate   > lv_current_date )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             price        TYPE s_price,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_status) TYPE tt_flights_with_status.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_status.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_low_threshold    TYPE s_price VALUE '300.00'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_price_medium_threshold TYPE s_price VALUE '700.00'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_status_low             TYPE string  VALUE 'LOW'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_status_medium          TYPE string  VALUE 'MEDIUM'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_status_high            TYPE string  VALUE 'HIGH'.

                                      ( ls_flight-carrid,
                                        ls_flight-connid,
                                        ls_flight-price,
                                        flight_status = SWITCH string(
                                                          WHEN ls_flight-price <= lc_price_low_threshold    THEN lc_status_low
                                                          WHEN ls_flight-price <= lc_price_medium_threshold THEN lc_status_medium
                                                          ELSE lc_status_high ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_carrier_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_carrier_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_unique_carriers.
    CONSTANTS: lc_separator TYPE string VALUE ', '.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_string TYPE string VALUE ''.

    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT result = lc_initial_string
                                            FOR DISTINCT ls_flight IN it_flights
                                            NEXT result = COND string(
                                                             WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-carrid
                                                             ELSE result && lc_separator && ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    CONSTANTS: lc_target_carrier TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_sum TYPE s_price VALUE '0.00'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE ty_flight_data(
      INIT sum   = lc_initial_sum
           count = lc_initial_count
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = lc_target_carrier )
      NEXT sum   = sum + ls_flight-price,
           count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = '0.00'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften und eine Tabelle von Flügen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den höchsten Preis anzeigt. Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR ... IN ...` und `REDUCE` oder `MAX`. Definieren Sie Konstanten für Initialwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_for_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE s_carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS: lc_initial_price TYPE s_price VALUE '0.00'.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrier IN it_carriers
                             LET lt_carrier_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = ls_carrier-carrid ) ( ls_flight ) ) IN
                             ( carrid       = ls_carrier-carrid,
                               carrname     = ls_carrier-carrname,
                               flight_count = lines( lt_carrier_flights ),
                               max_price    = REDUCE s_price( INIT max_p = lc_initial_price
                                                               FOR ls_c_flight IN lt_carrier_flights
                                                               NEXT max_p = nmax( max_p = max_p val = ls_c_flight-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_even_number_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:

CLASS zcl_even_number_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even_numbers.
    CONSTANTS: lc_threshold TYPE i VALUE 10.

    rt_even_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN it_numbers
                               WHERE ( num > lc_threshold AND num MOD 2 = 0 )

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Liste von Strings in Großbuchstaben, wenn sie eine bestimmte Unterzeichenkette enthalten. Andernfalls konvertieren Sie sie in Kleinbuchstaben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_case_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS convert_string_case
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_case_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_case.
    CONSTANTS: lc_substring TYPE string VALUE 'ABAP'.

    rt_converted_strings = VALUE #( FOR text IN it_strings
                                    ( COND string(
                                          WHEN text CS lc_substring THEN to_upper( text )
                                          ELSE to_lower( text ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_indexed_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             value TYPE string,
             index TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_with_index.
    TYPES: tt_data_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_indexed_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_index.
    CONSTANTS: lc_filter_value TYPE string VALUE 'Target'.

                               WHERE ( text = lc_filter_value )
                               ( value = text, index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_repeating DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS repeated_event EXPORTING VALUE(iv_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_repeating_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval_seconds TYPE i
        iv_max_repetitions  TYPE i.
    METHODS get_repetition_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_repetition_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_max_repetitions TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_repeating IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_repeating_timer.
    mv_repetition_count = 0.
    mv_max_repetitions = iv_max_repetitions.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval_seconds.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_repeating.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_repetition_count = mv_repetition_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT repeated_event EXPORTING iv_count = mv_repetition_count.

    IF mv_repetition_count >= mv_max_repetitions.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_repetition_count.
    rv_count = mv_repetition_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_repeating_timer.
    DATA(lo_timer_manager) = NEW zcl_timer_repeating( ).
    DATA lv_event_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->on_repeated FOR lo_timer_manager.

    " Simulate 5 repetitions
    DO 5 TIMES.
      lo_timer_manager->handle_timer_finished( ).
      lv_event_count = lv_event_count + 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lo_timer_manager->get_repetition_count( )
        exp = lv_event_count
        msg = |Repetition count should be { lv_event_count }| ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine langlaufende Hintergrundaufgabe, die nach einer zufälligen Zeit abgeschlossen wird. Verwenden Sie einen `CL_GUI_TIMER`, um in regelmäßigen Abständen den Status der Hintergrundaufgabe zu überprüfen und ein Ereignis auszulösen, sobald die Aufgabe abgeschlossen ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die zufällige Dauer und `cl_gui_timer` im `run_mode_repeating`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_background_task DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS task_completed.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_task_monitor
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS get_task_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_task_start_time TYPE i.
    DATA mv_task_duration TYPE i.
    DATA mv_task_completed TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_background_task IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_task_monitor.
    mv_task_start_time = sy-uzeit.
    " Simulate random task duration between 5 and 15 seconds
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 5 max = 15 ).
    mv_task_duration = lo_random->get_next( ).
    mv_task_completed = abap_false.
    mv_status = |Background task started. Expected duration: { mv_task_duration }s.|.

    mo_timer->interval = iv_check_interval.
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_repeating.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_elapsed_time) = lv_current_time - mv_task_start_time.

    IF lv_elapsed_time >= mv_task_duration.
      mv_task_completed = abap_true.
      mv_status = |Background task completed after { lv_elapsed_time }s.|.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
      RAISE EVENT task_completed.
    ELSE.
      mv_status = |Task in progress. Elapsed: { lv_elapsed_time }s / { mv_task_duration }s.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_task_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.

      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->on_task_completed FOR lo_task_monitor.

    lo_task_monitor->start_task_monitor( 1 ). " Check every 1 second

    " Simulate multiple timer triggers until task is completed
    DO 20 TIMES. " Max 15s duration + some buffer
      lo_task_monitor->handle_timer_finished( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` basierend auf einer externen Bedingung aktiviert oder deaktiviert. Der Timer soll nur aktiv sein, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `activate()` und `deactivate()` Methoden des Timers, gesteuert durch eine externe Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_state_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS set_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition_met TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_is_active
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_condition_met TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_is_active TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = 1. " Default interval
    mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_repeating.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_condition.
    mv_condition_met = iv_condition_met.
    IF mv_condition_met = abap_true.
      IF mv_is_active = abap_false.
        mo_timer->activate( ).
        mv_is_active = abap_true.
        RAISE EVENT timer_state_changed EXPORTING iv_is_active = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      IF mv_is_active = abap_true.
        mo_timer->deactivate( ).
        mv_is_active = abap_false.
        RAISE EVENT timer_state_changed EXPORTING iv_is_active = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    " This method would only be called if the timer is active
    " No specific action here, just to show it's triggered
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_is_active.
    rv_is_active = mv_is_active.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_timer FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_timer.
    DATA(lo_timer_manager) = NEW zcl_timer_conditional( ).
    DATA lv_active_state TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_state_changed FOR EVENT timer_state_changed OF zcl_timer_conditional
          IMPORTING iv_is_active.
        DATA mv_last_state TYPE abap_bool.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_event_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_state_changed.
        mv_last_state = iv_is_active.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_event_receiver->on_state_changed FOR lo_timer_manager.

    " Initially not active
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_timer_manager->get_is_active( ) ).

    " Activate timer
    lo_timer_manager->set_condition( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_timer_manager->get_is_active( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_event_receiver->mv_last_state ).

    " Deactivate timer
    lo_timer_manager->set_condition( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_timer_manager->get_is_active( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_event_receiver->mv_last_state ).

    " Try to activate again
    lo_timer_manager->set_condition( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_timer_manager->get_is_active( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_event_receiver->mv_last_state ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und die Methode `set_button_state` in Kombination mit einer Datenbankabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic_state DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS update_button_state.
    METHODS get_button_state
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE syfcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_enabled) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic_state IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'BOOK'
      icon = icon_flight_booking
      text = 'Buchen'
      quickinfo = 'Flug buchen' ).
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'INFO'
      icon = icon_information
      text = 'Info'
      quickinfo = 'Fluginformationen' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_button_state.
    DATA lv_flights_available TYPE abap_bool.

    SELECT SINGLE @abap_true FROM sflights INTO @lv_flights_available.

    mo_toolbar->set_button_state(
      fcode = 'BOOK'
      enabled = lv_flights_available ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button_state.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_buttons.
    mo_toolbar->get_buttons( IMPORTING et_buttons = lt_buttons ).

    READ TABLE lt_buttons INTO DATA(ls_button) WITH KEY fcode = iv_fcode.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_enabled = ls_button-enabled.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_enabled = abap_false. " Button not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_action,
             fcode     TYPE syfcode,
             icon      TYPE icon_name,
             text      TYPE string,
             quickinfo TYPE string,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dynamic_toolbar.
    LOOP AT it_actions INTO DATA(ls_action).
      mo_toolbar->add_button(
        fcode = ls_action-fcode
        icon = ls_action-icon
        butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
        text = ls_action-text
        quickinfo = ls_action-quickinfo ).
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).

    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_buttons.
    mo_toolbar->get_buttons( IMPORTING et_buttons = lt_buttons ).

CLASS zcl_toolbar_auth_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS update_button_visibility.
    METHODS get_button_visibility

        iv_fcode TYPE syfcode
      RETURNING

    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_auth_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'DEV_TOOL'
      icon = icon_development_object
      text = 'Entwickler-Tool'
      quickinfo = 'Tool für Entwickler' ).
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'REPORT'
      icon = icon_report
      text = 'Bericht'
      quickinfo = 'Standardbericht' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_button_visibility.
    DATA lv_has_auth TYPE abap_bool.

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_DEVELOP'
      ID 'DEVCLASS' FIELD '*'
      ID 'OBJTYPE' FIELD '*'
      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'. " Display access

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_has_auth = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      lv_has_auth = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    mo_toolbar->set_button_visible(
      fcode = 'DEV_TOOL'
      visible = lv_has_auth ).

  METHOD get_button_visibility.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_buttons.
    mo_toolbar->get_buttons( IMPORTING et_buttons = lt_buttons ).

    READ TABLE lt_buttons INTO DATA(ls_button) WITH KEY fcode = iv_fcode.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_visible = ls_button-visible.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_visible = abap_false. " Button not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar, die eine Schaltfläche enthält, die bei einem Klick ein Bestätigungsdialogfeld anzeigt, bevor die eigentliche Aktion ausgeführt wird. Nutzen Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES` für den Dialog.
hint: Verwenden Sie `BUTTON_CLICK`-Ereignis und `cl_gui_frontend_services=>popup_to_confirm`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_confirm_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS action_confirmed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_fcode) TYPE syfcode.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_confirm_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'DELETE_ITEM'
      icon = icon_delete
      text = 'Eintrag löschen'
      quickinfo = 'Eintrag mit Bestätigung löschen' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'DELETE_ITEM'.
        DATA(lv_answer) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>popup_to_confirm(
          text_button_1 = 'Ja'
          text_button_2 = 'Nein'
          text_question = 'Möchten Sie den Eintrag wirklich löschen?'
          default_button = '2' ).

        IF lv_answer = '1'. " 'Ja' was clicked
          RAISE EVENT action_confirmed EXPORTING iv_fcode = fcode.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EVENT action_confirmed EXPORTING iv_fcode = fcode.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA lv_confirmed_fcode TYPE syfcode.

          IMPORTING iv_fcode.

    DATA(lo_event_receiver) = NEW lcl_event_receiver( ).

    lo_toolbar_manager->create_toolbar( ).

    " Simulate button click for 'DELETE_ITEM'
    " In a real scenario, popup_to_confirm would show a dialog.
    " For unit testing, we cannot interact with the popup directly.
    " We can only test the logic that *would* be executed after confirmation.
    " Here, we directly call the event handler and assume 'Ja' was clicked.
    lo_toolbar_manager->handle_button_click( fcode = 'DELETE_ITEM' ).

    " Since we cannot simulate the popup interaction, the event will only be raised if 'Ja' is hardcoded or mocked.
    " For this test, we assume the popup returns '1' (Ja) for simplicity.
    " A more advanced test would involve mocking cl_gui_frontend_services.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_event_receiver->mv_fcode
      exp = 'DELETE_ITEM'
      msg = 'Action should be confirmed and event raised' ).

    " Clean up dummy container
    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.

hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR`, `CL_SALV_TABLE` und den `FOR`-Operator für die Datenaufbereitung.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_alv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_alv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    " Create a sub-container for ALV
    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_container
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        dynpro_field = 'ALV_CONTAINER'. " Placeholder for a dynpro field
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'SHOW_FLIGHTS'
      icon = icon_flight
      text = 'Flüge anzeigen'
      quickinfo = 'Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigen' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SHOW_FLIGHTS'.
        DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

        IF mo_alv_table IS INITIAL.
          cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = mo_alv_container
            IMPORTING
              r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights ).
          mo_alv_table->display( ).
        ELSE.
          mo_alv_table->set_data_ref( REF #( lt_sflights ) ).
          mo_alv_table->refresh( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar, die eine Schaltfläche enthält, die bei einem Klick eine Methode aufruft, die eine komplexe Datenverarbeitung mit `REDUCE` und `FILTER` für Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` durchführt und das Ergebnis als Nachricht anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR`, `REDUCE`, `FILTER` und `MESSAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_functional_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_functional_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'ANALYZE_FLIGHTS'
      icon = icon_analyze
      text = 'Flüge analysieren'
      quickinfo = 'Flugdaten mit modernen Operatoren analysieren' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'ANALYZE_FLIGHTS'.
        DATA(lv_message) = process_flight_data( ).
        MESSAGE lv_message TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filter flights with occupied seats > 50% and reduce to count them
    DATA(lv_high_occupancy_flights) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER sflights_filtered = lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc > ( seatsmax / 2 )
      NEXT count = count + 1 ).

    " Calculate total capacity for these flights
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = REDUCE i(
      INIT capacity = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER sflights_filtered = lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc > ( seatsmax / 2 )
      NEXT capacity = capacity + flight-seatsmax ).

    rv_result_message = |{ lv_high_occupancy_flights } Flüge haben eine Auslastung von über 50%. Gesamtkapazität: { lv_total_capacity } Plätze.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_functional_data_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_functional_data_processing.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_toolbar_manager) = NEW zcl_toolbar_functional_data( lo_container ).

    " Directly call the private method for data processing
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_toolbar_manager->process_flight_data( ).

    " Since SFLIGHTS content can vary, we assert the message format and presence of numbers.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_result
      msg = 'Result message should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Flüge haben eine Auslastung von über 50%.'
      msg = 'Message should contain expected phrase' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Gesamtkapazität:'
      msg = 'Message should contain total capacity info' ).

    " Clean up dummy container
    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung moderner ABAP-Operatoren wie `REDUCE` und `FILTER` (ABAP 7.40+) für die effiziente und kompakte Datenverarbeitung. Beim Klick auf eine Toolbar-Schaltfläche wird eine Methode aufgerufen, die komplexe Analysen auf `SFLIGHTS`-Daten durchführt und das Ergebnis als formatierte Nachricht (`MESSAGE ... TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'`) ausgibt. Dies zeigt, wie moderne Sprachfeatures in GUI-Anwendungen integriert werden können.
keywords: CL_GUI_TOOLBAR, REDUCE, FILTER, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming, Data Processing, MESSAGE, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar, die eine Schaltfläche enthält, die bei einem Klick eine Methode aufruft, die eine Liste von Flügen aus `SFLIGHTS` mit dem `FOR`-Operator in eine neue interne Tabelle transformiert und das Ergebnis in einem Debugger anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR`, den `FOR`-Operator und `BREAK-POINT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS create_toolbar.
    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS transform_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_container = io_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.
    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'TRANSFORM_FLIGHTS'
      icon = icon_transform
      text = 'Flüge transformieren'
      quickinfo = 'Flugdaten mit FOR-Operator transformieren' ).
    mo_toolbar->set_static_text( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'TRANSFORM_FLIGHTS'.
        DATA(lt_summary) = transform_flight_data( ).
        BREAK-POINT. " Inspect lt_summary in debugger
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   connid = flight-connid
                                   fldate = flight-fldate
                                   occupancy_rate = COND #( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_transformation.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_toolbar_manager) = NEW zcl_toolbar_for_transform( lo_container ).

    " Directly call the private method for data transformation
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_toolbar_manager->transform_flight_data( ).

    " Assert that the transformation produced some results
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      msg = 'Transformed table should not be empty' ).

    " Assert on the structure and content of the first entry (if available)
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_first_summary) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_summary-carrid
        msg = 'Carrier ID should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_summary-fldate
        msg = 'Flight date should be filled' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_first_summary-occupancy_rate >= 0 AND ls_first_summary-occupancy_rate <= 100 )
        msg = 'Occupancy rate should be between 0 and 100' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Clean up dummy container
    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Transformation von Daten mit dem `FOR`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) und dem `VALUE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) zur Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle. Die Logik wird beim Klick auf eine Toolbar-Schaltfläche ausgelöst. Der `COND`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) wird für die bedingte Berechnung der Auslastungsrate verwendet. Dies zeigt eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation in ABAP.
keywords: CL_GUI_TOOLBAR, FOR operator, VALUE operator, COND operator, SFLIGHTS, Data Transformation, Functional Programming, Object Orientation

CLASS zcl_event_duration_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_name TYPE string,
             start_date TYPE sy-datum,
             end_date   TYPE sy-datum,

CLASS zcl_types_unique_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_types_unique_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights.
    TRY.

                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum + 2 ) ). "This will cause a dump

                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 ) ).

CLASS zcl_types_range_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp für Finanztransaktionen (Datum, Betrag, Transaktionstyp). Berechnen Sie den Saldo nach Abzug aller 'Ausgaben' von allen 'Einnahmen' in der Tabelle. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `SUBTRACT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für den Tabellentyp und eine `REDUCE` Expression, um den Saldo zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_finance_balance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transaction,
             tdate TYPE sy-datum,
             amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             ttype TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'I' for Income, 'E' for Expense
           END OF ty_transaction.
    TYPES: tt_transactions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transaction WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_balance
      IMPORTING
        it_transactions TYPE tt_transactions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_balance) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_finance_balance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_balance.
    rv_balance = REDUCE #( INIT balance = 0.00
                           FOR transaction IN it_transactions
                           NEXT balance = COND #( WHEN transaction-ttype = 'I' THEN balance + transaction-amount
                                                  WHEN transaction-ttype = 'E' THEN balance - transaction-amount
                                                  ELSE balance ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_finance_balance( ).

    DATA(lt_transactions) = VALUE zcl_finance_balance=>tt_transactions(
      ( tdate = sy-datum amount = '100.00' ttype = 'I' )
      ( tdate = sy-datum amount = '20.50' ttype = 'E' )
      ( tdate = sy-datum amount = '50.00' ttype = 'I' )
      ( tdate = sy-datum amount = '15.00' ttype = 'E' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_balance) = lo_cut->calculate_balance( lt_transactions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance exp = '114.50' msg = 'Balance should be 114.50' ).

    CLEAR lt_transactions.
    lv_balance = lo_cut->calculate_balance( lt_transactions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_balance exp = '0.00' msg = 'Balance for empty table should be 0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `REDUCE` Expression (ABAP 7.50+) in Kombination mit `TYPES` für die Datenstruktur. `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung, wobei hier bedingte Subtraktion/Addition für den Saldo verwendet wird. Dies ist extrem effizient und lesbar für Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: TYPES, REDUCE, SUBTRACT, INTERNAL TABLE, AGGREGATION, COND

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Interface-Typ mit einer Methode, die eine Zahl subtrahiert. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse und demonstrieren Sie die Polymorphie.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES: INTERFACE ... END INTERFACE` und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: INTERFACE lif_subtract_operation.
             METHODS subtract_value
               IMPORTING
                 iv_operand TYPE i
               CHANGING
                 cv_result TYPE i.
           END INTERFACE lif_subtract_operation.

    CLASS zcl_sub_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES lif_subtract_operation.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sub_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD lif_subtract_operation~subtract_value.
        cv_result = cv_result - iv_operand.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS perform_subtraction
      IMPORTING
        io_sub_op TYPE REF TO lif_subtract_operation
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
        iv_subtract_by TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_subtraction.
    rv_final_value = iv_initial_value.
    io_sub_op->subtract_value( EXPORTING iv_operand = iv_subtract_by CHANGING cv_result = rv_final_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_interface_subtraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_subtraction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_interface( ).
    DATA(lo_sub_impl) = NEW zcl_subtract_interface=>zcl_sub_impl( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_subtraction( io_sub_op = lo_sub_impl
                                                  iv_initial_value = 100
                                                  iv_subtract_by = 25 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 75 msg = 'Result should be 75' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->perform_subtraction( io_sub_op = lo_sub_impl
                                             iv_initial_value = 50
                                             iv_subtract_by = 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -10 msg = 'Result should be -10' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Definition eines lokalen Interface-Typs und dessen Implementierung in einer lokalen Klasse. Die Methode `perform_subtraction` akzeptiert ein Interface-Referenz, was Polymorphie ermöglicht. Die Subtraktion erfolgt innerhalb der Interface-Methode, was die Trennung von Belangen und die Erweiterbarkeit fördert.
keywords: TYPES, INTERFACE, OBJECT ORIENTATION, POLYMORPHISM, SUBTRACT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei Uhrzeiten in Minuten. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei, dass die Uhrzeiten über Mitternacht hinausgehen können.
hint: Wandeln Sie die Uhrzeiten in Sekunden um, subtrahieren Sie diese und rechnen Sie dann in Minuten um. Oder nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` für eine robustere Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_time_minutes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_minutes_diff
      IMPORTING
        iv_time1 TYPE sy-uzeit
        iv_time2 TYPE sy-uzeit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_time_minutes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_minutes_diff.
    DATA(lv_seconds1) = ( iv_time1(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time1+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time1+4(2).
    DATA(lv_seconds2) = ( iv_time2(2) * 3600 ) + ( iv_time2+2(2) * 60 ) + iv_time2+4(2).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = lv_seconds1 - lv_seconds2.

    " Handle cases where time2 is 'later' than time1 (e.g., crosses midnight)
    IF lv_diff_seconds < 0.
      lv_diff_seconds = lv_diff_seconds + ( 24 * 3600 ). " Add a full day in seconds
    ENDIF.

    rv_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_minutes_diff FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_minutes_diff.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_time_minutes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_diff( iv_time1 = '123000' iv_time2 = '120000' ) exp = 30 msg = '12:30 - 12:00 should be 30 minutes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_diff( iv_time1 = '003000' iv_time2 = '230000' ) exp = 90 msg = '00:30 - 23:00 (next day) should be 90 minutes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_minutes_diff( iv_time1 = '100000' iv_time2 = '100000' ) exp = 0 msg = 'Same time should be 0 minutes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die direkte Subtraktion von `sy-uzeit` Feldern ist nicht so einfach wie bei Datumsfeldern, insbesondere wenn Mitternacht überschritten wird. Hier werden die Uhrzeiten manuell in Sekunden umgerechnet, subtrahiert und dann in Minuten umgewandelt. Die Berücksichtigung des Mitternachtsübergangs macht die Lösung robust.
keywords: SUBTRACT, TIME, DATE/TIME, ARITHMETIC

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Funktionsgruppen (`FUGR`) in einem ABAP-Paket unter Verwendung der `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_objects()` und die `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_function_groups
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_function_groups.
    DATA(lo_pak_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_all_objects) = lo_pak_queries->get_package_objects( iv_package_name ).
        rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR ls_object IN lt_all_objects
                             WHERE ( object_type = 'FUGR' )
                             NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      CATCH cx_pak_package_error.
        rv_count = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count >= 0 ). " SAP_BASIS should have some FUGrs or at least not error
    " For a more precise test, one would need to know the exact count for a specific package.
    " Here, we just assert it's a non-negative number.
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_cond_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_package_existence
      IMPORTING iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_cond_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_package_existence.
    DATA(lo_pak_queries) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_pak_queries->get_package_info( iv_package_name ).
        lv_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_pak_package_error.
        lv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    rv_status_message = COND string(
      WHEN lv_exists = abap_true THEN |Paket '{ iv_package_name }' existiert.|
      ELSE |Paket '{ iv_package_name }' existiert nicht.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird, unter Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` und `CATCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` und `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` oder prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_read_safe DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_read_safe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflights
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          CLEAR rs_flight.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        CLEAR rs_flight.
        " Optional: Fehler loggen oder spezifischer behandeln
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_read_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_read_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights_for_carrier.
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflights
          INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_raw)
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, price
          FROM sflights
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

        rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                ( connid = ls_flight-connid, price = ls_flight-price ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_case_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_action_type,
             create_order,
             process_order,
             complete_order,
             cancel_order,
           END OF ENUM order_action_type.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status,
             new         VALUE IS INITIAL,
             in_progress VALUE 'P',
             completed   VALUE 'C',
             cancelled   VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM order_status.

    METHODS get_next_action IMPORTING iv_status TYPE order_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_action) TYPE order_action_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_case_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_action.
    rv_action = CASE iv_status.
                  WHEN order_status-new THEN order_action_type-create_order
                  WHEN order_status-in_progress THEN order_action_type-process_order
                  WHEN order_status-completed THEN order_action_type-complete_order
                  WHEN order_status-cancelled THEN order_action_type-cancel_order
                  WHEN OTHERS THEN order_action_type-create_order " Default or error case
                END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '0001' status = flight_status_enum-booked )

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' bookid = '0005' status = flight_status_enum-booked )

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`, indem Sie die modernen Operatoren `FOR` und `REDUCE` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` zum Iterieren und `REDUCE` zum Aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt.

    " Simulate data from sflights
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_passengers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 370 ). " 100 + 150 + 120

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 250 ). " 200 + 50
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_textedit` innerhalb eines `cl_gui_custom_container` und füllen Sie diesen mit formatierten Flugdaten aus `sflights`, die mit modernen String-Templates und `FOR`-Ausdrücken aufbereitet wurden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container`, `cl_gui_textedit`, `FOR` und String-Templates. Beachten Sie, dass GUI-Elemente nicht direkt in ABAP Unit getestet werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_modern_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_display_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_modern_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_data.
    DATA: lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_text_edit      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
          lt_sflights       TYPE ty_sflight_display_tt,
          lv_output_text    TYPE string.

    " Simulate data from sflights
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 120 )
    ).

    " Filter data if carrid is provided
    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_sflights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.

    " Prepare output text using FOR and String Templates
    lv_output_text = REDUCE string( INIT s = `Flugdaten:` & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT s = s && |  Flug { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid } am { flight-fldate } - Passagiere: { flight-seatsocc }| & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).

    " Create custom container (requires a screen with a custom control area)
    " For a real scenario, this would be embedded in a dynpro.
    " Here, we simulate it for demonstration purposes.
    TRY.
        lo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
                                  container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' " Replace with actual screen element name
                                  lifetime       = cl_gui_control=>lifetime_dynpro ).

        lo_text_edit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
                           parent = lo_custom_container
                           wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
                           wordwrap_position = 255 ).

        lo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( lv_output_text ).

        " To make the GUI visible in a test environment, you'd need to call a screen.
        " For a unit test, we can only verify the data preparation.
        " CALL SCREEN 100. " Example: Call a screen with custom control 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA'
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        " Handle GUI exception, e.g., if container_name is invalid in non-GUI context
        " In a real application, this would be logged or displayed to the user.
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte, klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` ab, wobei die Fehlermeldung in eine Variable geschrieben wird.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` sowie `MESSAGE INTO` (implizit über `get_text()`).
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

    METHODS execute_processing
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text
          iv_value = iv_input.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulieren Sie eine Verarbeitung
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_processing.
    TRY.
        process_value( iv_input ).
        rv_result_message = 'Verarbeitung erfolgreich.'.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        DATA(lv_error_text) = lx_invalid_input->get_text( ).
        rv_result_message = |Fehler: { lv_error_text }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie die RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_RTTI_FIELD_TYPE=>TY_DATA' ).
        lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = iv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lr_elem_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_component-type->get_relative_name( ) ).
          rv_type_name = lr_elem_descr->get_absolute_name( ).
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_struct_descr_error=>component_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle (`sflights`) mit dem `FOR`-Operator transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_source.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_source_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: ty_flight_summary_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_sflight_source_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights
      ( airline_id     = ls_flight-carrid,
        flight_num     = ls_flight-connid,
        flight_date    = ls_flight-fldate,
        occupied_seats = ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_transform=>ty_sflight_source_tt #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 100 )

    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_summary1).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary1-flight_num exp = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary2-flight_num exp = '0017' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des letzten Tages des Vormonats vom aktuellen Datum.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden der Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder direkte Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_last_month_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_last_day_of_prev_month RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_last_month_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_last_day_of_prev_month.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_first_day_current_month) = lv_current_date - ( sy-datum+6(2) - 1 ).
    rv_date = lv_first_day_current_month - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_date_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_date_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_last_month_end( ).
    DATA(lv_result_date) = lo_cut->get_last_day_of_prev_month( ).

    " Test for a specific date, e.g., if today is 20251207, result should be 20251130
    " Since sy-datum is dynamic, we assert based on a known calculation.
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = sy-datum.
    lv_expected_date = lv_expected_date - ( sy-datum+6(2) - 1 ). " First day of current month
    lv_expected_date = lv_expected_date - 1. " Last day of previous month

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_date exp = lv_expected_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Code ist dadurch kürzer und leichter verständlich.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Gruppe unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_raw_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES: ty_flight_group_result_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_raw_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_flight_group_result_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_seats.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
      ( airline_id         = GROUP sy-tabix-carrid,
        flight_num         = GROUP sy-tabix-connid,
        total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsocc ) )
    ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_component    TYPE string
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight_data,
                   <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `add_message` der Log-Klasse, um die Ausnahmeinformationen zu protokollieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_exc_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_exc_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_and_log.
    DATA(lo_log_header) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create(
                              i_object    = 'ZTEST_OBJ'
                              i_subobject = 'ZTEST_SUB'
                              i_extnumber = 'TEST_LOG_002' ).
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lo_log_header->add_message(
          EXPORTING
            i_msg_type = 'E'
            i_msg_id   = 'SY'
            i_msg_no   = '000'
            i_msg_v1   = lx_error->get_text( )
        ).
        " Optional: Ausnahme-Details hinzufügen
        lo_log_header->add_exception( lx_error ).
        rv_result = 0. " Standardwert im Fehlerfall
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `MOVE` zur Wertzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS update_structure_component
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_structure_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Typkompatibilität prüfen, bevor der Wert zugewiesen wird
      IF iv_component = 'FIELD1'.
        <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
      ELSEIF iv_component = 'FIELD2'.
        " Versuch, in Integer zu konvertieren, potenzielle Fehler behandeln
        TRY.
            <fs_component> = CONV i( iv_new_value ).
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
            " Konvertierungsfehler behandeln, z.B. protokollieren oder Ausnahme auslösen
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_class_name)=>(lv_method_name)` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Parameterübergabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1      TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA: lv_param1 TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_param> TYPE any.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    IF iv_param1 IS SUPPLIED.
      lv_param1 = iv_param1.
      ASSIGN lv_param1 TO <fs_param>.
      CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
        EXPORTING
          i_param = <fs_param> " Annahme: Methode hat einen Importing-Parameter I_PARAM
        RECEIVING
          r_result = rv_result.
    ELSE.
      CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name)
        RECEIVING
          r_result = rv_result.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit mehreren Nachrichten und lesen Sie diese anschließend aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create`, `add_message` und `get_messages`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             msgid TYPE bal_msgid,
             msgno TYPE bal_msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE bal_msgv1,
           END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES: tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_read_log
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE tt_log_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_read_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log_header) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create(
                              i_object    = 'ZREAD_OBJ'
                              i_subobject = 'ZREAD_SUB'
                              i_extnumber = 'READ_LOG_001' ).

    LOOP AT it_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
      lo_log_header->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_msg_type = ls_message-msgty
          i_msg_id   = ls_message-msgid
          i_msg_no   = ls_message-msgno
          i_msg_v1   = ls_message-msgv1
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Das Log speichern, um es persistent und lesbar zu machen
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( i_log_handle = lo_log_header->get_log_handle( ) ).

    " Nachrichten aus dem Log lesen
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_log_header->get_messages( ).

    rt_read_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_bal_msg IN lt_bal_messages
                                ( msgty = ls_bal_msg-msgty
                                  msgid = ls_bal_msg-msgid
                                  msgno = ls_bal_msg-msgno
                                  msgv1 = ls_bal_msg-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_read_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_read_log.
    DATA: lt_messages TYPE zcl_bal_read_log=>tt_log_messages.
    APPEND VALUE #( msgty = 'I' msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '001' msgv1 = 'Message 1' ) TO lt_messages.
    APPEND VALUE #( msgty = 'W' msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '002' msgv1 = 'Message 2' ) TO lt_messages.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    DATA(lt_read_messages) = lo_cut->create_and_read_log( it_messages = lt_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Message 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_read_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `get_messages` der Log-Klasse bietet eine strukturierte Möglichkeit, alle gesammelten Nachrichten zu erhalten, was eine einfache Weiterverarbeitung oder Anzeige ermöglicht.
