Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Datenreferenz auf eine lokale Variable und greifen Sie über ein Feld-Symbol auf den Inhalt der Referenz zu, um diesen zu manipulieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE` und `ASSIGN (lr_data)->* TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS manipulate_via_reference
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD manipulate_via_reference.
    DATA: lv_data TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    lv_data = iv_initial_value.

    " Eine Referenz auf die lokale Variable erhalten
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_data INTO lr_data.

    " Den Inhalt der Datenreferenz einem Feldsymbol zuweisen
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Daten über das Feldsymbol manipulieren
      <fs_data> = |{ <fs_data> } - Modified|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_final_value = lv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_manipulate_via_reference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_manipulate_via_reference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_ref( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->manipulate_via_reference( 'Original' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Original - Modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Datenreferenzen und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` sind die Grundlage für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. `GET REFERENCE` erstellt eine Referenz auf ein Datenobjekt, und `ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs>` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf den Inhalt des referenzierten Objekts über das Feld-Symbol, was eine flexible Datenmanipulation erlaubt.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Data References, Dereferencing, GET REFERENCE, ASSIGN

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll, speichern Sie es und zeigen Sie es anschließend mit dem Standard-Viewer an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log` und `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>display_log`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_display_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_save_display_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_display_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_save_display_log.
    DATA(lo_log_header) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create(
                              i_object    = 'ZDISP_OBJ'
                              i_subobject = 'ZDISP_SUB'
                              i_extnumber = 'DISPLAY_LOG_001' ).

    lo_log_header->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msg_type = 'S'
        i_msg_id   = '00'
        i_msg_no   = '001'
        i_msg_v1   = iv_message
    ).

    rv_log_handle = lo_log_header->get_log_handle( ).

    " Das Log speichern
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( i_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).

    " Das Log anzeigen (dies würde typischerweise ein Popup in einer GUI-Umgebung öffnen)
    " In einem Unit-Test ist dies nicht direkt auf UI-Interaktion testbar.
    " Wir stellen lediglich sicher, dass der Aufruf erfolgt.
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>display_log( i_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_save_display_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_save_display_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_display_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->create_save_display_log( 'Log entry for display.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).
    " Die Assertion, dass das Log-Handle nicht initial ist, impliziert, dass das Log erstellt und gespeichert wurde.
    " Das Anzeigen des Logs ist eine UI-Aktion und kann in einem headless Unit-Test nicht direkt überprüft werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktionen `save_log` und `display_log` der Klasse `cl_s_aut_bal_log` ermöglichen es, Anwendungsprotokolle dauerhaft zu speichern und sie dem Benutzer über den Standard-Application-Log-Viewer anzuzeigen. Dies ist essenziell für die Endbenutzer-Fehleranalyse und den Support.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Struktur (`SFLIGHT`) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die Tabelle und die Zeile, `ASSIGN` und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_populate_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_structure_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_table_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lr_line_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lr_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    " Beschreibung der Struktur abrufen
    TRY.
        lr_line_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_structure_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Struktur nicht gefunden
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " Einen Tabellentyp basierend auf der Struktur erstellen
    lr_table_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_line_type ).

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle erstellen
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Dynamischen Arbeitsbereich (Zeile) erstellen
      CREATE DATA lr_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lr_line_type.
      ASSIGN lr_data_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Mit Daten füllen (Beispiel für SFLIGHT)
        " Erste Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = '0400'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = '20250101'. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        " Zweite Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = '0017'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_component> = '20250102'. ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_populate_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_populate_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_populate_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    " Inhalt der ersten Zeile überprüfen
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen mittels `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der ABAP-Programmierung. Es ermöglicht die Verarbeitung von Datenstrukturen, die zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt sind, und ist grundlegend für generische Frameworks und Metadaten-gesteuerte Anwendungen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, CREATE DATA, RTTI

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem bestehenden Anwendungsprotokoll eine weitere Nachricht hinzu, ohne ein neues Log-Header-Objekt zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance` um ein bestehendes Log-Header-Objekt abzurufen und dann `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_add_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_message_to_existing_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE bal_logh
        iv_msg_type   TYPE bal_msgty
        iv_msg_id     TYPE bal_msgid
        iv_msg_no     TYPE bal_msgno
        iv_msg_v1     TYPE bal_msgv1 OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_add_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_message_to_existing_log.
    DATA(lo_log_header) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( iv_log_handle ).

    IF lo_log_header IS BOUND.
      lo_log_header->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_msg_type = iv_msg_type
          i_msg_id   = iv_msg_id
          i_msg_no   = iv_msg_no
          i_msg_v1   = iv_msg_v1
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_message_to_existing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_message_to_existing.
    " Zuerst ein Log erstellen, um ein Handle zu bekommen
    DATA(lo_initial_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create(
                                i_object    = 'ZADD_MSG'
                                i_subobject = 'ZADD_SUB'
                                i_extnumber = 'ADD_MSG_001' ).
    lo_initial_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msg_type = 'I'
        i_msg_id   = 'SFLIGHT'
        i_msg_no   = '001'
        i_msg_v1   = 'Initial Message' ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_initial_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( lv_log_handle ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_add_message( ).
    lo_cut->add_message_to_existing_log(
      iv_log_handle = lv_log_handle
      iv_msg_type   = 'W'
      iv_msg_id     = 'SFLIGHT'
      iv_msg_no     = '002'
      iv_msg_v1     = 'Added Message' ).

    " Log erneut laden und Nachrichten zählen
    DATA(lo_reloaded_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>get_instance( lv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_reloaded_log->get_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Added Message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_instance` ermöglicht es, ein bereits existierendes Anwendungsprotokoll-Header-Objekt anhand seines Handles abzurufen. Dies ist nützlich, um Nachrichten zu einem laufenden Protokoll hinzuzufügen, ohne die Kontextinformationen des ursprünglichen Logs erneut angeben zu müssen.
keywords: cl_s_aut_bal_log, Application Log, Add Message, Existing Log

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT <fs_table> BY (lv_field_name)` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    rt_sorted_data = it_data.
    ASSIGN rt_sorted_data TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_sort_field).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_dyn_table_sort=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_dynamic_table( it_data = lt_sflight iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_dyn_table_sort=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_cut->sort_dynamic_table( it_data = lt_sflight iv_sort_field = 'CONNID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung interner Tabellen mittels `SORT <fs_table> BY (lv_field_name)` in Verbindung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für generische Berichte oder Datenverarbeitungsroutinen, bei denen die Sortierkriterien erst zur Laufzeit festgelegt werden. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wiederverwendbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, SORT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll und fügen Sie eine Nachricht mit allen vier Variablen (`MSGV1` bis `MSGV4`) hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create` und `add_message` mit den entsprechenden `i_msg_vX` Parametern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_full_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_full_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_msg_type TYPE bal_msgty
        iv_msg_id   TYPE bal_msgid
        iv_msg_no   TYPE bal_msgno
        iv_msg_v1   TYPE bal_msgv1 OPTIONAL

CLASS zcl_bal_full_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_full_message.
    DATA(lo_log_header) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create(
                              i_object    = 'ZFULL_MSG'
                              i_subobject = 'ZFULL_SUB'
                              i_extnumber = 'FULL_MSG_001' ).

    lo_log_header->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msg_type = iv_msg_type
        i_msg_id   = iv_msg_id
        i_msg_no   = iv_msg_no
        i_msg_v1   = iv_msg_v1
        i_msg_v2   = iv_msg_v2
        i_msg_v3   = iv_msg_v3
        i_msg_v4   = iv_msg_v4

    rv_log_handle = lo_log_header->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

explanation: Die `add_message`-Methode der `cl_s_aut_bal_log`-Klasse unterstützt bis zu vier Variablen (`MSGV1` bis `MSGV4`), die in der Nachrichtentextdefinition verwendet werden können. Dies ermöglicht die Erstellung von sehr flexiblen und informativen Log-Einträgen, die zur Laufzeit mit spezifischen Daten gefüllt werden.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes in einer Struktur und geben Sie dessen technische Eigenschaften aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_type_info
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_type_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_type_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_descr_ref TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA: lr_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lr_descr_ref = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_component> ).
      lr_elem_descr ?= lr_descr_ref.

      IF lr_elem_descr IS BOUND.
        APPEND |Type Kind: { lr_elem_descr->type_kind }| TO rs_type_info.
        APPEND |Length: { lr_elem_descr->length }| TO rs_type_info.
        APPEND |Output Length: { lr_elem_descr->output_length }| TO rs_type_info.
        APPEND |Decimals: { lr_elem_descr->decimals }| TO rs_type_info.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_info ) exp = 4 ).

explanation: Die Runtime Type Identification (RTTI) mit Klassen wie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit detaillierte Informationen über den Typ eines Datenobjekts zu erhalten. In Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff ist dies unerlässlich für generische Metadaten-gesteuerte Anwendungen.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_elemdescr

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert den maximalen Wert des Typs `int8` überschreitet. Geben Sie `true` zurück, wenn er überschritten wird, ansonsten `false`.

CLASS zcl_exc_check_int8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD is_int8_overflow.
    DATA(lv_max_int8) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_int8( ) ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und mehr als 200 freie Plätze haben. Geben Sie eine neue Tabelle zurück, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die Anzahl der freien Plätze enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `VALUE`-Expression mit `FOR` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE sflight-airpfrom
        iv_min_free TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( flight-airpfrom = iv_origin AND ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) > iv_min_free )
        ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
          connid   = flight-connid,
          free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nes_for_sflights( ).
    DATA lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' airpfrom = 'FRA' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' airpfrom = 'FRA' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0002' airpfrom = 'JFK' seatsmax = 400 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    " Mocking the SELECT statement for testing purposes
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles or inject data.
    " For this example, we'll assume sflight contains the test data.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_origin = 'FRA' iv_min_free = 200 ).

WHERE` Konstrukten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge, die von 'NYC' abfliegen, unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, die über eine gefilterte Tabelle iteriert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE sflight-airpfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                 WHERE ( flight-airpfrom = iv_origin )
                                 NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze und dem Abflugort. Wenn der Abflugort 'FRA' ist und weniger als 50 Sitze frei sind, ist der Status 'Fast ausgebucht'. Wenn der Abflugort 'MUC' ist und weniger als 20 Sitze frei sind, ist der Status 'Kritisch'. In allen anderen Fällen ist der Status 'Verfügbar'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine geschachtelte `COND`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_cond_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin   TYPE sflight-airpfrom
        iv_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_cond_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_origin = 'FRA' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_free_seats < 50 THEN 'Fast ausgebucht'
          ELSE 'Verfügbar'
        )
      WHEN iv_origin = 'MUC' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_free_seats < 20 THEN 'Kritisch'
          ELSE 'Verfügbar'
        )
      ELSE 'Verfügbar'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe, ob es mindestens einen Flug gibt, der von 'FRA' abfliegt und mehr als 200 freie Sitze hat. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und einem booleschen Flag zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `GROUP BY` und eine geschachtelte `COND`-Expression, die `LINE_EXISTS` verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nes_group_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             has_high_capacity_fra TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_carrier_status.
    TYPES tt_carrier_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_capacity_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_status) TYPE tt_carrier_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nes_group_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_capacity_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        has_high_capacity_fra = COND abap_bool(
          WHEN line_exists( GROUP flight[ WHERE airpfrom = 'FRA' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 200 ] )
          THEN abap_true
          ELSE abap_false
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_capacity_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nes_group_cond( ).
    DATA lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' airpfrom = 'FRA' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 0 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' airpfrom = 'FRA' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' airpfrom = 'FRA' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' airpfrom = 'JFK' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    " Mocking the SELECT statement for testing purposes
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles or inject data.
    " For this example, we'll assume sflight contains the test data.

    DATA(lt_carrier_status) = lo_cut->get_carrier_capacity_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carrier_status ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_status) = lt_carrier_status[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_status-has_high_capacity_fra exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(ls_aa_status) = lt_carrier_status[ carrid = 'AA' ].

Dies ermöglicht die deklarative Ermittlung komplexer gruppenspezifischer Bedingungen und die Erstellung einer neuen Tabelle mit den aggregierten Ergebnissen. Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_objectdescr` für RTTI und dynamischen Methodenaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_object      TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters   TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter    TYPE abap_parmbind.

    TRY.
        " Get class description
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).

        " Create instance of the class
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        " Get method description
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        " Check if method returns a value
        IF lo_method_descr->has_return_parameter = abap_true.
          ls_parameter-name = lo_method_descr->get_return_parameter( )->name.
          GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
          APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        " Call method dynamically
        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for testing dynamic call
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_hello_world RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_abap_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hello_world.
    rv_text = 'Hello World'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_abap_version.
    rv_version = sy-saprl.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).

    " Test a known method
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_HELPER' iv_method_name = 'GET_HELLO_WORLD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' ).

    " Test another known method
    lv_result = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_HELPER' iv_method_name = 'GET_ABAP_VERSION' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = sy-saprl ).

    " Test non-existent method (should raise exception)
    TRY.
        lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( iv_class_name = 'ZCL_DYN_METHOD_HELPER' iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-existent method' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for non-existent method' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe unter Verwendung von RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_objectdescr` ermöglichen es, Methoden zur Laufzeit basierend auf String-Namen aufzurufen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der dynamischen Programmierung und wird oft in Frameworks oder generischen Tools eingesetzt. Die geschachtelten Aufrufe der RTTI-Methoden sind ein gutes Beispiel für `NESTING`.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Method Call, NESTING, cl_abap_classdescr, cl_abap_objectdescr

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl an belegten Sitzen aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden, geben Sie einen leeren Flug zurück. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values` für den Initialwert.
hint: Initialisieren Sie die maximale Sitzplatzanzahl mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value` für `i` und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit geschachtelten `COND`-Expressionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_com_extreme_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_occupied
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_com_extreme_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_occupied.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_i( ) ).

    DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE sflight(
      INIT max_occupied_seats = lv_min_int
           result_flight = VALUE sflight( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        max_occupied_seats = COND i( WHEN flight-seatsocc > max_occupied_seats THEN flight-seatsocc ELSE max_occupied_seats ),
        result_flight = COND sflight( WHEN flight-seatsocc > max_occupied_seats THEN flight ELSE result_flight )
    ).

    rs_flight_key = CORRESPONDING #( ls_max_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein gegebener Wert den maximalen Wert eines zur Laufzeit bestimmten numerischen ABAP-Typs überschreitet. Der Typ wird als String übergeben (z.B. 'I', 'INT8', 'P').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`, `cl_abap_intdescr` oder `cl_abap_packeddescr` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_com_dyn_max_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_dynamic_max_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE i " Input value to check
        iv_type_name  TYPE string " e.g., 'I', 'INT8', 'P'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_overflow) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_com_dyn_max_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dynamic_max_value.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lv_max_value  TYPE i. " Use i for comparison, assuming input fits i

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).

        CASE lo_type_descr->type_kind.
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
            DATA(lo_int_descr) = CAST cl_abap_intdescr( lo_type_descr ).
            lv_max_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( lo_int_descr ).
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
            DATA(lo_int8_descr) = CAST cl_abap_intdescr( lo_type_descr ).
            lv_max_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( lo_int8_descr ).
          WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
            DATA(lo_packed_descr) = CAST cl_abap_packeddescr( lo_type_descr ).
            lv_max_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( lo_packed_descr ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Unsupported type for max value check'.
        ENDCASE.

        IF iv_value > lv_max_value.
          rv_overflow = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_overflow = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_max_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_max_check.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_com_dyn_max_check( ).

    " Test 'I' type
    DATA(lv_max_i) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_i( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_dynamic_max_value( iv_value = lv_max_i + 1 iv_type_name = 'I' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_dynamic_max_value( iv_value = lv_max_i iv_type_name = 'I' ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Test 'INT8' type
    DATA(lv_max_int8) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_intdescr=>get_int8( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_dynamic_max_value( iv_value = lv_max_int8 + 1 iv_type_name = 'INT8' ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_dynamic_max_value( iv_value = lv_max_int8 iv_type_name = 'INT8' ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Test unsupported type
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_dynamic_max_value( iv_value = 100 iv_type_name = 'STRING' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for unsupported type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for unsupported type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von dynamischer Typanalyse (RTTI) mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values` und geschachtelter `CASE`-Logik. Es ermöglicht die typsichere Überprüfung von Werten gegen die Maximalgrenzen verschiedener numerischer Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für generische Validierungsroutinen oder Metadaten-gesteuerte Anwendungen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, cl_abap_exceptional_values, NESTING, Data Types, Type Check

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table, deren Schlüssel eine UUID im X16-Format ist, und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu. Suchen Sie dann effizient nach einem Eintrag anhand der UUID.
hint: Definieren Sie den Tabellentyp mit `WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid_x16` und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY`.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_uuid_data,
             uuid_x16 TYPE cl_system_uuid=>c_uuid_x16,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_uuid_data.
    TYPES: ty_uuid_data_h_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_uuid_data WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid_x16.

    CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS add_entry
          IMPORTING
            iv_description TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rs_entry) TYPE ty_uuid_data.

        METHODS get_description_by_uuid
          IMPORTING
            iv_uuid_x16 TYPE cl_system_uuid=>c_uuid_x16
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mt_data TYPE ty_uuid_data_h_table.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD add_entry.
        rs_entry-uuid_x16 = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
        rs_entry-description = iv_description.
        INSERT rs_entry INTO TABLE mt_data.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD get_description_by_uuid.
        READ TABLE mt_data INTO DATA(ls_found) WITH KEY uuid_x16 = iv_uuid_x16.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_description = ls_found-description.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_format_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_summary,
             image_type TYPE string,
             width      TYPE i,
             height     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_image_summary.

    METHODS get_image_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_image_summary
      RAISING
        cx_fxs_image_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_format_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_summary.
    DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
    lo_image_info->set_image_xstring( iv_image_xstring ).
    lo_image_info->get_image_info(
      IMPORTING
        ev_width  = rs_summary-width
        ev_height = rs_summary-height
        ev_format = DATA(lv_format)
    ).

    rs_summary-image_type = COND string(
      WHEN lv_format = 'PNG' THEN 'Portable Network Graphics'
      WHEN lv_format = 'JPG' THEN 'Joint Photographic Experts Group'
      WHEN lv_format = 'GIF' THEN 'Graphics Interchange Format'
      ELSE 'Unbekanntes Format'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_image_xstring_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_images_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_images_xstring TYPE ty_image_xstring_table
        iv_min_width      TYPE i
        iv_format         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_images) TYPE ty_image_xstring_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_image_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_min_width     TYPE i
        iv_format        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_valid)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_images_by_criteria.
    rt_filtered_images = FILTER #( it_images_xstring USING is_image_valid
                                   WHERE iv_min_width = iv_min_width AND iv_format = iv_format ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_image_valid.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_image_info) = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( ).
        lo_image_info->set_image_xstring( iv_image_xstring ).
        lo_image_info->get_image_info(
          IMPORTING
            ev_width  = DATA(lv_width)
            ev_format = DATA(lv_format)
        ).
        IF lv_width >= iv_min_width AND lv_format = iv_format.
          rb_valid = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info.
        rb_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jedes Bild in einer Eingabetabelle eine Zusammenfassung (Breite, Höhe, Format) enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `CL_FXS_IMAGE_INFO` und Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `TRY ... CATCH` innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_summarizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_summary,
             index      TYPE i,
             width      TYPE i,
             height     TYPE i,
             format     TYPE string,
             error_msg  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_summary.
    TYPES: ty_image_summary_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_image_xstring_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_images
      IMPORTING
        it_images_xstring TYPE ty_image_xstring_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_image_summary_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_summarizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_images.
    rt_summaries = VALUE ty_image_summary_table(
      FOR ls_image_xstring IN it_images_xstring INDEX INTO lv_index
      LET lo_image_info = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( )
          ls_summary_line = VALUE ty_image_summary( index = lv_index )
      IN
      (
        TRY.
            lo_image_info->set_image_xstring( ls_image_xstring ).
            lo_image_info->get_image_info(
              IMPORTING
                ev_width  = ls_summary_line-width
                ev_height = ls_summary_line-height
                ev_format = ls_summary_line-format
            ).
          CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_error).
            ls_summary_line-error_msg = lx_image_error->get_text( ).
        ENDTRY.
        ls_summary_line
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_image_format_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_image_xstring_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_format_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS count_image_formats
      IMPORTING
        it_images_xstring TYPE ty_image_xstring_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_format_counts) TYPE ty_format_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_format_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_image_formats.
    rr_format_counts = REDUCE ty_format_count_map(
      INIT lv_map = VALUE ty_format_count_map( )
      FOR ls_image_xstring IN it_images_xstring
      LET lo_image_info = NEW cl_fxs_image_info( )
      IN
      DO.
        TRY.
            lo_image_info->set_image_xstring( ls_image_xstring ).
            lo_image_info->get_image_info(
              IMPORTING
                ev_format = DATA(lv_format)
            ).
            IF lv_map IS INITIAL OR NOT line_exists( lv_map[ lv_format ] ).
              lv_map[ lv_format ] = 1.
            ELSE.
              lv_map[ lv_format ] = lv_map[ lv_format ] + 1.
            ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_fxs_image_info.
            " Ignore invalid images for counting
        ENDTRY.
      ENDDO.
      lv_map
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_profile_param,
             name  TYPE spfl_param_name,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_profile_param.

CLASS zcl_profile_param_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_matching_params.
    DATA(lt_all_param_names) = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_all_parameter_names( ).

    rt_params = VALUE tt_profile_params(
                  FOR param_name IN lt_all_param_names
                  WHERE ( param_name CP iv_pattern )
                  ( name = param_name
                    value = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( param_name ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und bestimmen Sie die Andockseite dynamisch basierend auf einer Liste von Präferenzen, wobei die erste gültige Präferenz verwendet wird. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Andockseite aus einer Liste von Optionen zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_docking_side DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_dock_sides TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_docking_container_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_sides TYPE tt_dock_sides
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_docking_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_docking_side IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_docking_container_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_selected_side) = REDUCE i( INIT side = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left " Default
                                       FOR preferred_side IN it_preferred_sides
                                       NEXT side = COND #( WHEN preferred_side >= cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left AND
                                                            preferred_side <= cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
                                                           THEN preferred_side
                                                           ELSE side ) ).

    ro_docking_container = NEW cl_gui_docking_container(
                               repid    = sy-repid
                               dynnr    = sy-dynnr
                               side     = lv_selected_side
                               extension = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_docking_side_valid.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_docking_side( ).
    DATA(lt_sides) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_docking_side=>tt_dock_sides(
                       ( cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right )
                       ( cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left ) ).
    DATA(lo_docking) = lo_creator->create_docking_container_dynamic( lt_sides ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_docking ).
    " Cannot assert the 'side' property directly without reflection or mocking,
    " but the object creation implies the side was set.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_docking_side_invalid.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_docking_side( ).
    DATA(lt_sides) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_docking_side=>tt_dock_sides(
                       ( 999 ) " Invalid side
                       ( cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_top ) ).
    DATA(lo_docking) = lo_creator->create_docking_container_dynamic( lt_sides ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_docking ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_docking_side_empty.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_docking_side( ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle basierend auf einem simulierten Eingabewert für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID), der aus einem GUI-Feld stammen könnte. Verwenden Sie `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, die in der Zukunft liegen (Flugdatum > aktuelles Datum).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_future_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                             NEXT count = COND #( WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN count + 1 ELSE count ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " The exact count depends on the current date and SFLIGHTS data.
    " We assert it's not negative and generally plausible.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count >= 0 ).
    " For a more precise test, SFLIGHTS data would need to be controlled or mocked.

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) zeilenweise zu einem einzelnen XSTRING, wobei jede Zeile vor der Komprimierung in einen JSON-String umgewandelt wird. Nutze `REDUCE` und `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwende `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_TEXT` innerhalb eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks, nachdem jede Zeile mit `CALL TRANSFORMATION` in JSON umgewandelt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_json,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_json.
    TYPES tt_sflight_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_json WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflights_to_gzip
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_to_gzip.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_json.
    DATA lv_json_string TYPE string.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_compressed_data = REDUCE xstring(
      INIT compressed_acc = ''X
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE <fs_sflight> RESULT XML lv_json_string.
        " XML-Deklaration und Root-Element für reinen JSON-String entfernen (Workaround)
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '(?s)<\?xml.*?\?>' IN lv_json_string WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '<SFLIGHT_JSON>' IN lv_json_string WITH ''.
        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '</SFLIGHT_JSON>' IN lv_json_string WITH ''.

        compressed_acc = compressed_acc &&
                         cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
                           cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                             data = lv_json_string
                             codepage = 'UTF-8'
                           )
                         )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_sflights FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_compress_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_compress_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_data) = lo_cut->compress_sflights_to_gzip( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht initial sein' act = lv_compressed_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht leer sein' act = xstrlen( lv_compressed_data ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` für die Aggregation, `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für die Umwandlung von ABAP-Strukturen in JSON (hier als XML-Hack, da direkter JSON-Export komplexer ist ohne externe Libs) und `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_TEXT` zur Komprimierung jeder einzelnen JSON-Zeile. Die `UTF-8`-Konvertierung ist wichtig für die korrekte GZIP-Verarbeitung von Text.
keywords: GZIP, Komprimierung, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, JSON, XSTRING, Interne Tabellen, CL_ABAP_GZIP, CALL TRANSFORMATION

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_display.
    DATA lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA lo_columns TYPE REF TO cl_salv_columns_list.
    DATA lo_column TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column_list.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = iv_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        lo_columns = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_all_columns_visible( abap_false ). " Zuerst alle ausblenden

        " Spezifische Spalten sichtbar machen
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_visible( abap_true ).
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
        lo_column->set_visible( abap_true ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_filtered_sflights.
    " Dieser Test ist schwierig, da er die UI-Anzeige betrifft.
    " Wir können nur testen, ob die Methode ohne Fehler ausgeführt wird.
    " Ein echter UI-Test würde das Mocken von CL_GUI_CONTAINER und CL_SALV_TABLE erfordern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_dynamic_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_dummy_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY' ). " Dummy-Container für Factory

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_filtered_sflights( lo_dummy_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Wenn keine Ausnahme, Erfolg annehmen
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Dummy-Container aufräumen
    CALL METHOD lo_dummy_container->free
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS = 3.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung während der Bereinigung bei Bedarf
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutze `CL_SALV_TABLE->GET_COLUMNS` und dann `CL_SALV_COLUMN_LIST->GET_DDIC_FIELDNAME` oder `GET_FIELDNAME` in Kombination mit RTTI.

CLASS zcl_salv_get_col_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_datatype.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_display.
    DATA lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    DATA lo_columns TYPE REF TO cl_salv_columns_list.
    DATA lo_column TYPE REF TO cl_salv_column_list.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA ls_component TYPE abap_compdescr.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 1 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        lo_columns = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( iv_column_name ).

        " Den Feldnamen aus dem ALV-Spaltenobjekt erhalten
        DATA(lv_field_name) = lo_column->get_fieldname( ).

        " RTTI verwenden, um den Datentyp der internen Tabelle zu erhalten
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).

        READ TABLE lo_struct_descr->components INTO ls_component WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_data_descr ?= ls_component-type.
          rv_datatype = lo_data_descr->type_kind.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        " Handle case where RTTI fails or component not found
        rv_datatype = 'ERROR: Field not found or RTTI issue'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_toolbar_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD display_sflights_with_button.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_display.
    DATA lo_functions TYPE REF TO cl_salv_functions_list.
    DATA lo_event_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_salv_toolbar_event.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = iv_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        " Funktionen für die Toolbar erhalten
        lo_functions = mo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ). " Standardfunktionen aktivieren

        " Eigene Schaltfläche hinzufügen
        lo_functions->add_function(
          name     = 'MY_BUTTON'
          icon     = icon_information
          tooltip  = 'Meine benutzerdefinierte Aktion'
          text     = 'Aktion'
          position = if_salv_c_function_position=>right_of_salv_functions
        ).

        " Event-Handler registrieren
        SET HANDLER me->handle_toolbar_event FOR mo_salv_table->get_event_receiver( ).

        mo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_event.
    " Hier wird auf das Klick-Ereignis der Toolbar reagiert
    IF e_salv_function = 'MY_BUTTON'.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierte Schaltfläche geklickt!' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Liste von Strings entgegennimmt, diese zu einem einzelnen, durch Zeilenumbrüche getrennten String zusammenfügt, diesen String GZIP-komprimiert und die komprimierten Binärdaten zurückgibt. Nutze dabei String-Templates und `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit String-Templates zum Zusammenfügen und `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_TEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_string_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_string_list
      IMPORTING
        it_string_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_string_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_string_list.
    DATA lv_combined_string TYPE string.

    " Strings mit Zeilenumbrüchen zusammenfügen
    lv_combined_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN it_string_list
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ line }| )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_compressed_data = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( lv_combined_string ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'X'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_compress_string_list( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Erste Zeile' ) ( 'Zweite Zeile' ) ( 'Dritte Zeile' ) ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_data) = lo_cut->compress_string_list( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht initial sein' act = lv_compressed_data IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht leer sein' act = xstrlen( lv_compressed_data ) exp = 0 ).

    " Optional: Dekomprimieren und vergleichen
    DATA(lo_decompressor) = NEW zcl_gzip_decompress_text( ). " Annahme: ZCL_GZIP_DECOMPRESS_TEXT aus GZP_002 existiert
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = lo_decompressor->decompress_string( lv_compressed_data ).
    DATA(lv_expected_string) = 'Erste Zeile' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Zweite Zeile' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && 'Dritte Zeile'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_decompressed_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'Dekomprimierter String sollte mit dem erwarteten String übereinstimmen'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Der resultierende String wird dann mit `CL_ABAP_GZIP=>COMPRESS_TEXT` komprimiert.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Quadrate einer Liste von Zahlen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_of_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR <number> IN it_numbers
                       NEXT s = s + ( <number> * <number> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Maximalwert in einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_value_in_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_value_in_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      " Handle empty table case, e.g., return 0 or raise exception
      rv_max_value = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    rv_max_value = REDUCE i( INIT m = it_numbers[ 1 ]
                             FOR <number> IN it_numbers
                             NEXT m = COND i( WHEN <number> > m THEN <number> ELSE m ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Instanziiere ein generisches GUI-Control-Objekt (z.B. `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`) und setze eine grundlegende Eigenschaft.
hint: Verwende `NEW` und Methodenaufrufe. Beachte, dass für eine vollständige GUI-Anzeige ein Dynpro-Kontext erforderlich wäre.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_control_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_textedit_control
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_textedit) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_control_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_textedit_control.
    " In a real scenario, iv_parent_container would be a CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER
    " linked to a screen element. For this example, we can instantiate without a parent
    " if we just want to demonstrate object creation.
    " If iv_parent_container is not provided, the control will be created without a parent
    " which is valid for object creation but not for display.
    ro_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = iv_parent_container
    ).
    " Set a basic property, e.g., text
    ro_textedit->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text = 'Hello from ABAP Control Framework!'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_textedit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_textedit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_control_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_textedit) = lo_cut->create_textedit_control( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lo_textedit
      msg = 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT object should be bound'
    ).

    " Attempt to read the text back (requires a bit more setup for real textedit)
    " For a simple unit test, we primarily check if the object was created.
    " A full functional test would require a GUI environment.
    DATA(lv_text) = ''.
    TRY.
        lo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_text ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lv_text
          exp = 'Hello from ABAP Control Framework!'
          msg = 'Text property not set correctly'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_handler.
        " This might happen if the control is not fully initialized in a GUI context
        " For unit testing, we accept that some methods might not work without a full GUI.
        " The primary goal is to check object creation and method call syntax.
    ENDTRY.

    " Clean up the control (important in real GUI programs)
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>free_custom_controls.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Instanziierung von GUI-Controls erfolgt objektorientiert mit `NEW`. Methoden wie `SET_TEXT_AS_STREAM` werden verwendet, um Eigenschaften zu setzen. Für eine sichtbare Anzeige ist ein Dynpro-Container (`CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER`) und die Integration in den PBO/PAI-Zyklus erforderlich, was hier nicht vollständig abgebildet werden kann. Der Unit Test prüft die erfolgreiche Objekterstellung.
keywords: Object Orientation, CL_GUI_CFW, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, GUI Control, Instantiation, NEW

CLASS zcl_average_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0
                                     FOR <number> IN it_numbers
                                     NEXT s = s + <number> ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp_from) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date_from ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_to) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date( iv_date_to ).

    DATA(lv_seconds_diff) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract_tstmp(
      tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_to
      tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_from
    ).

    rv_days = lv_seconds_diff / ( 24 * 60 * 60 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, aber nur für Flüge, die einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreiten.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `REDUCE`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_above_threshold.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_flush_utility IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Es ist eine statische Methode, die keine spezifischen Control-Referenzen benötigt.
    " Der Import einer Liste von Controls wäre hier irreführend, da FLUSH global wirkt.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flush_call.
    " This test primarily checks if the method can be called without error.
    " Verifying the actual effect of FLUSH would require a full GUI test environment,
    " which is beyond the scope of a simple ABAP Unit test.
    TRY.
        zcl_gui_flush_utility=>perform_gui_flush( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'FLUSH call should not raise immediate error' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |FLUSH call raised exception: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) und füge eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den doppelten Flugpreis enthält. Zeige nur Flüge mit einem doppelten Preis über 1000 an.
hint: Verwende `FOR` mit `LET` und `WHERE` für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_double_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_double_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
             double_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_double_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_double_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_double_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_double_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_double_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_double_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_double_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_double_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_sflight_double_price(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_double_price = flight-price * 2 IN
      WHERE ( lv_double_price > iv_min_double_price )
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        price = flight-price,
        double_price = lv_double_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_double_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_flights_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflight_source FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_double_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_double_price( ).
    DATA(lv_min_double_price) = '1000.00'.
    DATA(lt_actual_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_double_price( lv_min_double_price ).

    DATA(lt_expected_flights) TYPE zcl_sflight_double_price=>tt_sflight_double_price.
    DATA lt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_source.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_source INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_double_price) = ls_flight-price * 2.
      IF lv_double_price > lv_min_double_price.
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                        price = ls_flight-price
                        double_price = lv_double_price ) TO lt_expected_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_flights ) exp = lines( lt_expected_flights ) msg = 'Number of filtered flights incorrect' ).
    " Further assertions could compare content if needed
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_double_price( ).
    DATA(lv_min_double_price) = '9999999.99'.
    DATA(lt_actual_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_double_price( lv_min_double_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual_flights msg = 'No flights should match high threshold' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_flights_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_double_price( ).
    DATA(lv_min_double_price) = '0.00'.

CLASS zcl_alv_display_utility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        io_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_displayed_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_display_utility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_data.
    IF io_alv_grid IS NOT BOUND.
      " Handle error: ALV grid not instantiated
      rv_displayed_rows = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD io_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT' " Example structure name
            is_variant       = VALUE #( report = sy-repid handle = 'DEFAULT' )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = it_data.

        rv_displayed_rows = lines( it_data ).

        " Important for GUI controls to update the frontend
        cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_alv_error).
        " Handle ALV specific errors
        MESSAGE lx_alv_error TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_displayed_rows = 0.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        " Handle general errors
        MESSAGE lx_general_error TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_displayed_rows = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_avg_price,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ts_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_sflight
                                GROUP BY ( month = <flight>-fldate+4(2), carrid = <flight>-carrid )
                                ( month     = <flight>-fldate+4(2),
                                  carrid    = <flight>-carrid,
                                  avg_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0
                                                         FOR <member> IN GROUP <flight>
                                                         NEXT sum = sum + <member>-price ) / lines( GROUP <flight> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Flugzeugtyp, Anzahl der Flüge und dem prozentualen Anteil sein.

CLASS zcl_chart_planetype_dist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_planetype_dist,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ts_planetype_dist.
    TYPES tt_planetype_dist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_planetype_dist WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_planetype_distribution RETURNING VALUE(rt_distribution) TYPE tt_planetype_dist.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_planetype_dist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_planetype_distribution.
    SELECT planetype, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE price > 500
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_filtered_flights).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    IF lv_total_flights = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_distribution = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                                 GROUP BY ( planetype = <flight>-planetype )
                                 ( planetype    = <flight>-planetype,
                                   flight_count = lines( GROUP <flight> ),
                                   percentage   = CONV p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2(
                                                      ( lines( GROUP <flight> ) * 100 ) / lv_total_flights ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_distribution[ 1 ]-flight_count ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_distribution[ 1 ]-percentage ).

      DATA(lv_total_percentage) = REDUCE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2( INIT sum = 0 FOR <item> IN lt_distribution NEXT sum = sum + <item>-percentage ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_percentage exp = 100 ).
    ELSE.

    ENDIF.

Anschließend wird `FOR GROUPS OF` verwendet, um die Flüge nach Flugzeugtyp zu gruppieren und die Anzahl sowie den prozentualen Anteil zu berechnen. `CONV` wird für die Typkonvertierung verwendet, um den prozentualen Anteil korrekt darzustellen.
