Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die für zwei ausgewählte Fluggesellschaften die durchschnittliche Auslastung (Anzahl Buchungen / maximale Kapazität) pro Monat aus SFlight berechnet und für ein Diagramm mit mehreren Datenreihen aufbereitet. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Monat, Fluggesellschaft und der durchschnittlichen Auslastung sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `GROUP BY`, `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die komplexe Datenaggregation und -transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_load DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_avg_load,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_load TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ts_avg_load.
    TYPES tt_avg_load TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_avg_load WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_load_for_airlines
      IMPORTING it_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_load) TYPE tt_avg_load.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_load IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_load_for_airlines.
    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, bookedseats, maxseats
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_avg_load = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_flights
                             GROUP BY ( month = <flight>-fldate+4(2), carrid = <flight>-carrid )
                             ( month    = <flight>-fldate+4(2),
                               carrid   = <flight>-carrid,
                               avg_load = COND p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2(
                                            WHEN REDUCE i( INIT total_seats = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP <flight> NEXT total_seats = total_seats + <member>-maxseats ) = 0
                                            THEN 0
                                            ELSE CONV p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2(
                                                    ( REDUCE i( INIT total_booked = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP <flight> NEXT total_booked = total_booked + <member>-bookedseats ) * 100 )
                                                    / REDUCE i( INIT total_seats = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP <flight> NEXT total_seats = total_seats + <member>-maxseats ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_avg_load_for_airlines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_avg_load_for_airlines.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_avg_load( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_avg_load) = lo_cut->get_avg_load_for_airlines( lt_carrids ).

    IF lt_avg_load IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_load ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_load[ 1 ]-month ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_avg_load[ 1 ]-carrid = 'LH' OR lt_avg_load[ 1 ]-carrid = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_avg_load[ 1 ]-avg_load ).

      DATA(lv_lh_entries) = lines( FILTER #( lt_avg_load WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) ).
      DATA(lv_aa_entries) = lines( FILTER #( lt_avg_load WHERE carrid = 'AA' ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_lh_entries > 0 OR lv_aa_entries > 0 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_avg_load ).
    ENDIF.

    lt_carrids = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid( ( 'XX' ) ).
    lt_avg_load = lo_cut->get_avg_load_for_airlines( lt_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_avg_load ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert fortgeschrittene interne Tabellenoperationen. Sie verwendet `FOR GROUPS OF` zur Gruppierung nach Monat und Fluggesellschaft. Innerhalb der Gruppe werden mit `REDUCE` die Summen der gebuchten Sitze und der maximalen Sitze berechnet. `COND` wird verwendet, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden. CLASS zcl_chart_generic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_flight_data_generic.
    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <flight> IN lt_flights
                               GROUP BY ( month = <flight>-fldate+4(2), carrid = <flight>-carrid )
                               ( x_axis_label = |{ <flight>-fldate+4(2) }|,

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data_generic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_generic_data( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_flight_data_generic( ).

    IF lt_chart_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-x_axis_label ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-y_axis_value ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-series_id ).

      DATA(lv_first_month) = lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-x_axis_label.
      DATA(lv_first_carrid) = lt_chart_data[ 1 ]-series_id.

      DATA(lv_count_for_first_point) = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                                  FOR <item> IN lt_chart_data
                                                  WHERE ( x_axis_label = lv_first_month AND series_id = lv_first_carrid )
                                                  NEXT count = count + 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_for_first_point exp = 1 ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_chart_data ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_calculated_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_sflight_with_load,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookedseats TYPE sflight-bookedseats,
             maxseats TYPE sflight-maxseats,
             load_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ts_sflight_with_load.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_calculated_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_ida_with_load.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, bookedseats, maxseats
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    DATA(lt_sflight_with_load) = VALUE tt_sflight_with_load( FOR <flight> IN lt_sflight
                                                              ( carrid        = <flight>-carrid,
                                                                connid        = <flight>-connid,
                                                                fldate        = <flight>-fldate,
                                                                bookedseats   = <flight>-bookedseats,
                                                                maxseats      = <flight>-maxseats,
                                                                load_percentage = COND p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2(
                                                                                    WHEN <flight>-maxseats = 0 THEN 0
                                                                                    ELSE ( <flight>-bookedseats * 100 ) / <flight>-maxseats ) ) ).

    TRY.
        ro_alv_ida = cl_salv_table_ida=>create_for_data( it_data = lt_sflight_with_load ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             month TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

                                 GROUP BY ( month = <flight>-fldate+4(2), carrid = <flight>-carrid )
                                 ( month        = <flight>-fldate+4(2),
                                   carrid       = <flight>-carrid,
                                   flight_count = lines( GROUP <flight> ) ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Flugdaten von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei die moderne Syntax mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > lv_today )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein, wenn Testdaten vorhanden sind.'
                                        act = lines( lt_future_flights ) ).

    " Test, ob alle Flüge in der Zukunft liegen
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flugdatum muss in der Zukunft liegen.'
                                       act = ls_flight-fldate > lv_today ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Summe über eine gefilterte Tabelle zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_passenger_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_passengers_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_passenger_counter( ).
    DATA(lv_total_passengers) = lo_cut->count_passengers_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt mindestens einen Flug für LH mit Passagieren
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( msg = 'Gesamtzahl der Passagiere sollte größer als 0 sein.'
                                        exp = 0
                                        act = lv_total_passengers ).

    " Wenn z.B. LH 400 (100 Passagiere) und LH 401 (50 Passagiere) existieren:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 150 act = lo_cut->count_passengers_by_carrier( 'LH' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzplätzen haben. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator erstellt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_temp_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary
                                        WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                          AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_temp_filtered
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Für 'LH' und 10 freie Sitze.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).

    " Test, ob die gefilterte Tabelle nicht leer ist (wenn passende Flüge existieren)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein, wenn passende Flüge vorhanden sind.'
                                        act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    " Test, ob alle Flüge der richtigen Fluggesellschaft angehören
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fluggesellschaft muss LH sein.'
                                         exp = 'LH'
                                         act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und dem manuellen `APPEND` in eine neue Tabelle.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, WHERE, Functional Programming, APPEND, ASSERT

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können (Method Chaining), um eine Flugbuchung zu simulieren.
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    METHODS with_connection IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_booking.
    METHODS on_date IMPORTING iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_booking.
    METHODS add_passengers IMPORTING iv_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_booking.
    METHODS book RETURNING VALUE(rv_booking_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.
    DATA mv_passengers TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_connection.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_date.
    mv_fldate = iv_fldate.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_passengers.
    mv_passengers = iv_passengers.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD book.
    " Hier würde die eigentliche Buchungslogik stehen, z.B. Prüfung auf Verfügbarkeit
    " und Update der sflight-Tabelle.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir einfach einen Erfolg.
    IF mv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND mv_connid IS NOT INITIAL AND
       mv_fldate IS NOT INITIAL AND mv_passengers > 0.
      rv_booking_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_booking_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_booking FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_booking) = NEW zcl_flight_booking( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_booking->with_connection( '400' )
                                 ->on_date( '20251224' )
                                 ->add_passengers( 2 )
                                 ->book( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Buchung sollte erfolgreich sein.'
                                      act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_booking.
    DATA(lo_booking) = NEW zcl_flight_booking( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_booking->with_connection( '400' )
                                 ->book( ). " Datum und Passagiere fehlen

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Buchung sollte fehlschlagen, da Daten fehlen.'
                                       act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede verkettbare Methode eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface, ABAP Objects, ASSERT

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übertragen werden sollen. Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             extra_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             another_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING carrid = carrid
                                                 connid = connid
                                                 fldate = fldate
                                                 seatsocc = seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                        connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                       FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                       NEXT sum = sum + grouped_flight-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_flight( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                                      total_seats = lv_total_seats ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    " Annahme: SFLIGHT enthält Daten, die gruppiert werden können.
    " Z.B. LH 400 mit 100 Sitzen und LH 400 mit 50 Sitzen (unterschiedliche Daten).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_flights) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_key( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Gruppierte Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein.'
                                        act = lines( lt_grouped_flights ) ).

    " Beispiel für spezifische Prüfung, wenn Testdaten bekannt sind.
    " Finden Sie den Eintrag für 'LH' '400'
    READ TABLE lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight)
      WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '400'.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Annahme: LH 400 hat insgesamt 150 Sitze (aus 2 Einträgen).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtsitze für LH 400 stimmen nicht überein.'
                                         exp = 150 " Dies müsste an Ihre Testdaten angepasst werden
                                         act = ls_grouped_flight-total_seats ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe ermöglicht es komplexe Aggregationen auf eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Weise, die ältere `AT NEW`/`AT END` Konstrukte übertrifft.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, APPEND, Modern ABAP, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und befüllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `sflights`. Dies demonstriert die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit dynamischen Typen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für den Tabellentyp und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lv_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " Dynamische Strukturdefinition
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      ls_component-name = lv_fieldname.
      CASE lv_fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID' THEN ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 3 ).
        WHEN 'CONNID' THEN ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( 4 ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE' THEN ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ).
        WHEN 'SEATSOCC' THEN ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ).
        WHEN OTHERS THEN
          " Fallback für unbekannte Felder oder Fehlerbehandlung
          CONTINUE.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Dynamische interne Tabelle erstellen
    DATA(lv_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lv_struct_descr ).
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lv_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field_value>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).

      LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
        CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

        LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO lv_fieldname.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <lv_field_value>.
          IF <lv_field_value> IS ASSIGNED.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_field>).
            IF <fs_sflight_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              <lv_field_value> = <fs_sflight_field>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte zugewiesen sein.'
                                         act = <lt_table> ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Tabelle Zeilen enthält (wenn sflight Daten hat)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamische Tabelle sollte Zeilen enthalten.'
                                        act = lines( <lt_table> ) ).

    " Prüfen der Struktur der ersten Zeile
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 INTO <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte zugewiesen sein.'
                                         act = <ls_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE sflight-carrid,
                   <lv_connid> TYPE sflight-connid.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_connid>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'Feld CARRID sollte zugewiesen sein.'
                                         act = <lv_carrid> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( msg = 'Feld CONNID sollte zugewiesen sein.'
                                         act = <lv_connid> ).

    " Beispiel für Wertprüfung (abhängig von SFLIGHT-Daten)
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( exp = 'LH' act = <lv_carrid> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen zur Laufzeit ist ein mächtiges Feature für generische Anwendungen. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`/`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` ermöglicht die flexible Definition von Datentypen. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist entscheidend für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, APPEND, ASSERT

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und sammeln Sie spezifische Felder in einer neuen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS als Quelle und sammeln Sie die Felder CARRID und CONNID.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR...IN...` Syntax in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_in_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_for_in_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                 connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR...IN...` mit `GROUP BY` und dem `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_in_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_in_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                   count  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_in_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    DATA(lv_total_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_entry IN lt_result ( s = s + ls_entry-count ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total flights should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_total_flights > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus SFLIGHTS enthält, die mindestens 5 Flüge haben. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR...IN...` und einer `WHERE` Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` und eine Hilfsvariable für die Zählung oder eine vorherige Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_in_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_in_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_carrier_counts) = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        count  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( c = c + 1 ) ) )
    ).

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_count IN lt_carrier_counts WHERE ( count >= iv_min_flights )
                             ( ls_count-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH'). Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR...IN...`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie zwei interne Tabellen (z.B. SFLIGHT und SCARR) und finden Sie alle Flüge zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FOR...IN...` Schleifen und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` für die äußere Schleife und `LINE_EXISTS` für die innere Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_in_nested_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_name) TYPE tt_flight_with_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_in_nested_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_flights_with_name = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                    LET ls_scarr = VALUE scarr( 
                                        COND #( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_scarr[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ] ) 
                                                THEN lt_scarr[ carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ]
                                                ELSE THROW cx_sy_itab_line_not_found( ) ) ) IN
                                    ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                      connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                                      carrname = ls_scarr-carrname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier Name should not be initial' act = <fs_entry>-carrname ).

Anstatt expliziter geschachtelter Schleifen wird der `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR...IN...` Schleife und dem `LET` Ausdruck verwendet, um die Fluggesellschaftsdaten zu holen. `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit `COND` und `THROW` (oder einem Default-Wert) ermöglicht einen sicheren und effizienten Zugriff auf die Zeile der zweiten Tabelle, was einem Left Outer Join ähnelt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften (CARRID, CARRNAME) aus der Tabelle SCARR und filtern Sie diese dann, um nur die Fluggesellschaften zu erhalten, deren Name mit 'L' beginnt. Verwenden Sie `SORTED TABLE` und den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine `SORTED TABLE` und wenden Sie dann `FILTER` darauf an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_data,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_data.
    TYPES tt_sorted_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_data
                                 WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_l_starting_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_carriers) TYPE tt_sorted_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_l_starting_carriers.
    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    DATA(lt_sorted_all_carriers) = VALUE tt_sorted_carriers( FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
                                                              ( carrid = ls_scarr-carrid,
                                                                carrname = ls_scarr-carrname ) ).

    rt_filtered_carriers = FILTER #( lt_sorted_all_carriers USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE carrname CS 'L*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_in_not_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

    METHODS get_carriers_without_flights

CLASS zcl_for_in_not_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr
                             WHERE ( NOT LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = ls_scarr-carrid ] ) )
                             ( ls_scarr-carrid ) ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carriers_without_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_in_not_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_without_flights( ).

    " It's possible that all carriers have flights, so we check for a specific one if we know it exists without flights
    " For demonstration, let's assume 'XX' is a carrier without flights in SFLIGHT
    " To make the test deterministic, we'd need to mock DB access or ensure test data.
    " For now, we assert that known carriers with flights are NOT in the result.
    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY table_line = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'LH should not be in the list (it has flights)' act = ( sy-subrc = 0 ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_result TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY table_line = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'AA should not be in the list (it has flights)' act = ( sy-subrc = 0 ) ).

    " If there are carriers in SCARR but not in SFLIGHT, the result should not be initial.
    " This depends on the actual data in SCARR and SFLIGHT.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result table might contain carriers without flights' act = ( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `FOR...IN...` und der `WHERE` Klausel in Kombination mit `NOT LINE_EXISTS` effizient Datensätze findet, die in einer Tabelle vorhanden sind, aber keine zugehörigen Einträge in einer anderen Tabelle haben. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Alternative zu klassischen `LOOP AT ... CHECK ...` oder `SELECT ... NOT EXISTS` Konstrukten.
keywords: FOR, LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Filtering, NOT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn ein ungültiger Parameter an eine Methode übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Exception im aufrufenden Code ab und geben Sie die Fehlermeldung aus.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_param_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_param_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_parameter=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei Methoden: eine, die eine Exception wirft, und eine aufrufende Methode, die diese Exception abfängt und verarbeitet. Demonstrieren Sie die Exception-Propagation.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_propagation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sub_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS main_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_propagation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sub_method.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD main_method.
    TRY.
        sub_method( iv_value ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` so auf, dass sie in einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` angezeigt werden können. Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit der notwendigen Struktur für den Tree.

solution:
TYPE-POOLS: icon.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
         node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
         parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
         text       TYPE lvc_value,

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_data IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS ).
    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.

    rt_tree_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                             LET lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 IN
                             ( node_key   = |{ lv_node_key }|
                               parent_key = '' " Root nodes
                               text       = |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } { ls_sflight-fldate }|
                               icon       = icon_flight
                               carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die demonstriert, wie man dynamisch Knoten zu einem `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` hinzufügt. Fokus liegt auf der Vorbereitung der Knotendaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden des `CL_GUI_COLUMN_TREE` zur Knotenverwaltung. Die Datenstruktur für Knoten ist entscheidend.
solution:
TYPE-POOLS: icon.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_data,
         node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
         parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
         text       TYPE lvc_value,
         icon       TYPE icon_d,
         level      TYPE i,
       END OF ty_tree_node_data.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_nodes_to_add
      IMPORTING
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey OPTIONAL
        iv_level      TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node_data.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nodes_to_add.
    DATA(lv_start_key) = 1000.
    IF iv_parent_key IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_start_key = iv_parent_key + 100.
    ENDIF.

    rt_nodes = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 3
                         LET lv_node_key = |{ lv_start_key + i }| IN
                         ( node_key   = lv_node_key,
                           parent_key = iv_parent_key,
                           text       = |Node { lv_node_key } (Level { iv_level })|,
                           icon       = icon_folder,
                           level      = iv_level ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,

         text TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_filter_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

CLASS zcl_filter_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_data.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data WHERE id > iv_min_id ).

    IF rt_filtered_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_table_line_not_found=>default_text.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen und werfen Sie eine Exception, wenn eine Zahl außerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs liegt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
hint: Iterieren Sie mit `FOR` über die Liste und verwenden Sie eine `IF`-Bedingung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_process_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_validate
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_min     TYPE i
        iv_max     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_validate.
    rt_processed_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number IN it_numbers
                                    ( COND #( WHEN number >= iv_min AND number <= iv_max THEN number
                                              ELSE THROW cx_sy_range_error( textid = cx_sy_range_error=>default_text ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_number FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_range_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_numbers.
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_and_validate( it_numbers = lt_test_numbers iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_number.
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 15 ) ( 10 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_numbers( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_and_validate( it_numbers = lt_test_numbers iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination des `FOR`-Operators (ab ABAP 7.40) für die Iteration über interne Tabellen mit dem `COND`- und `THROW`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.52) zur Validierung jedes Elements. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und gleichzeitig Fehlerbedingungen funktional zu behandeln.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Behandlung eines Ereignisses eines ALV Grid Controls (z.B. `DATA_CHANGED`). Verarbeiten Sie die geänderten Daten mit einer `FOR`-Expression, um nur relevante Zeilen zu extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` für das Ereignis und eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` für die Filterung der Event-Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cfw_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF cl_gui_alv_grid IMPORTING er_data_changed.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cfw_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_alv_grid = io_alv_grid.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_data_changed FOR mo_alv_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    " Extrahiere nur geänderte Zeilen mit einer FOR-Expression
    DATA(lt_changed_rows) = VALUE lvc_t_modf(
      FOR ls_modf IN er_data_changed->mt_mod_cells
      WHERE ( fieldname = 'PRICE' )
      ( ls_modf )
    ).

    IF lt_changed_rows IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Hier könnte weitere Logik folgen, z.B. Speichern der Änderungen
      MESSAGE |{ lines( lt_changed_rows ) } Zeilen mit Preisänderungen erkannt.| TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine relevanten Preisänderungen erkannt.' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDIF.

    " Bestätigen der Änderungen im ALV
    er_data_changed->set_data_changed( abap_false ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_handle_data_changed FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_data_changed.
    " Mocking des ALV Grid und des Event-Parameters ist hier notwendig
    " für einen echten Unit-Test, da UI-Controls nicht direkt instanziiert werden.
    DATA: lo_alv_grid_mock TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid,
          lo_event_data_mock TYPE REF TO cl_alv_changed_data.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_alv_grid_mock.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_event_data_mock.

    " Füllen des Mock-Event-Parameters mit Testdaten
    DATA(lt_mod_cells) = VALUE lvc_t_modf(
      ( row_id = 1 fieldname = 'PRICE' value = '150.00' )
      ( row_id = 2 fieldname = 'CARRID' value = 'DL' )
      ( row_id = 3 fieldname = 'PRICE' value = '300.00' )
    ).
    lo_event_data_mock->mt_mod_cells = lt_mod_cells.

    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_cfw_alv_event_handler( lo_alv_grid_mock ).

    " Aufruf des Event-Handlers
    lo_handler->handle_data_changed( er_data_changed = lo_event_data_mock ).

    " Hier könnte man prüfen, ob bestimmte Methoden des ALV-Grids aufgerufen wurden
    " oder ob die interne Logik korrekt ausgeführt wurde (z.B. über ein Log).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Event handler should process without dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Event-Behandlung in ABAP. Die `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE`-Klausel wird verwendet, um die Event-Daten effizient zu filtern und nur die für die Logik relevanten Änderungen zu verarbeiten. Dies ist eine kompakte und lesbare Art, Daten zu manipulieren.
keywords: Event Handling, ALV, FOR, WHERE, cl_gui_cfw, cl_gui_alv_grid

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` mit `REDUCE` und zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem Textfeld eines Custom Controls an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cfw_reduce_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_and_display.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cfw_reduce_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_display.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      container_name = 'REDUCE_DISPLAY_CONTAINER'
    ).

    DATA(lo_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
      parent = lo_container
      wordwrap_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>wordwrap_at_fixed_position
    ).

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    " Aggregation mit REDUCE
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_output) = |Gesamtpreis aller Flüge: { lv_total_price } EUR|.

    lo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_output ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element, einem Kind-Element und einem Attribut unter Verwendung von `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `create_writer`, `write_start_element`, `write_attribute`, `write_value` und `write_end_element`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_simple_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_simple_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_xml.
    DATA: lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sec_sxml_writer,
          lo_xwriter TYPE REF TO if_sxml_writer.

    " Writer erstellen
    lo_writer = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_xt_string
    ).
    lo_xwriter = lo_writer.

    " Root-Element schreiben
    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'RootElement' ).
    lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'version' value = '1.0' ).

    " Kind-Element schreiben
    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'ChildElement' ).
    lo_xwriter->write_value( 'Hello SXML!' ).
    lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende ChildElement

    lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende RootElement

    " XML-String abrufen
    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_simple_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_simple_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sxml_simple_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->create_simple_xml( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_xml msg = 'XML string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<RootElement version="1.0">' msg = 'Root element with attribute missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<ChildElement>Hello SXML!</ChildElement>' msg = 'Child element with value missing' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_sec_sxml_writer` zur Erstellung eines XML-Dokuments. Die Instanziierung des Writers erfolgt modern mit `create_writer`. Die Methoden `write_start_element`, `write_attribute`, `write_value` und `write_end_element` werden sequenziell aufgerufen, um die XML-Struktur aufzubauen.
keywords: XML, SXML, Writer, cl_sec_sxml_writer

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von XML-Elementen aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression und `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.

    DATA: lo_writer TYPE REF TO cl_sec_sxml_writer,

    FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein komplexeres XML-Dokument, das verschachtelte Elemente und Attribute aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) generiert. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Datenverarbeitung und `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Expressionen oder `REDUCE` zur Strukturierung der Daten und `write_start_element`/`write_end_element` für die XML-Hierarchie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_nested_flights_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_nested_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_xt_string
    ).
    DATA(lo_xwriter) = CAST if_sxml_writer( lo_writer ).

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen und gruppieren
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group.

    DATA(lt_flight_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS ) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_entry IN GROUP ls_flight ( flight_entry ) ) )
    ).

    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'AirlineData' ).

    FOR ls_group IN lt_flight_data.
      lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'Airline' ).
      lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'ID' value = ls_group-carrid ).

      FOR ls_flight IN ls_group-flights.
        lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'FlightDetail' ).
        lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
        lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'DepartureDate' ).
        lo_xwriter->write_value( |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).
        lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ).
        lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'BookingPrice' ).
        lo_xwriter->write_value( |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }| ).
        lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ).
        lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende FlightDetail
      ENDFOR.

      lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende Airline
    ENDFOR.

    lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende AirlineData

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` enthält. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zu inkludieren und `REDUCE` um die Anzahl der gefilterten Flüge zu zählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` für die Vorauswahl der Daten und `REDUCE` für die Zählung. Integrieren Sie dies mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_filtered_xml IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_filtered_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_xt_string
    ).
    DATA(lo_xwriter) = CAST if_sxml_writer( lo_writer ).

    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Filterung mit FILTER-Expression
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).

    " Zählung mit REDUCE-Expression
    DATA(lv_filtered_count) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).

    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'HighValueFlights' ).
    lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'MinPrice' value = |{ iv_min_price }| ).
    lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'Count' value = |{ lv_filtered_count }| ).

    FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights.
      lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'Flight' ).
      lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'Carrier' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'Connection' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'Price' ).
      lo_xwriter->write_value( |{ ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }| ).
      lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ).
      lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende Flight
    ENDFOR.

    lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende HighValueFlights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_grouped_flights_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_grouped_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_xt_string
    ).
    DATA(lo_xwriter) = CAST if_sxml_writer( lo_writer ).

    SELECT carrid connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights) UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'AirlinesSummary' ).

    " Gruppierung mit FOR GROUPS OF
    FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( GROUP ls_flight ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument, das eine Liste von Flugverbindungen aus `sflights` enthält. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften mit der höchsten Anzahl an Flügen zu ermitteln und diese in einem XML-Element darzustellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` um die Top-Fluggesellschaften zu finden und `cl_sec_sxml_writer` für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_top_airlines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_top_airlines_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_top_airlines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_top_airlines_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_xt_string
    ).
    DATA(lo_xwriter) = CAST if_sxml_writer( lo_writer ).

    SELECT carrid connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights) UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_airline_count.

    " Ermittle die Top-Fluggesellschaften mit REDUCE und FOR GROUPS OF
    DATA(lt_top_airlines) = REDUCE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_count(
      INIT airlines = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      LET current_count = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
      NEXT airlines = VALUE #( airlines
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = current_count ) )
    ).

    " Sortiere und nimm die Top 3 (Beispiel)
    SORT lt_top_airlines BY count DESCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_top_airlines COMPARING carrid.
    IF lines( lt_top_airlines ) > 3.
      DELETE lt_top_airlines FROM 4.
    ENDIF.

    lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'TopAirlines' ).

    FOR ls_airline IN lt_top_airlines.
      lo_xwriter->write_start_element( name = 'Airline' ).
      lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'ID' value = ls_airline-carrid ).
      lo_xwriter->write_attribute( name = 'FlightCount' value = |{ ls_airline-count }| ).
      lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende Airline
    ENDFOR.

    lo_xwriter->write_end_element( ). " Ende TopAirlines

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer in Sekunden zwischen zwei UTCLONG-Zeitstempeln.

CLASS zcl_utclong_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_duration_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong_from TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong_to   TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_duration_in_seconds.
    DATA(lv_difference) = cl_abap_utclong=>get_difference(
      iv_utclong1 = iv_utclong_to
      iv_utclong2 = iv_utclong_from
    ).
    " lv_difference is in 100-nanosecond units. Convert to seconds.
    rv_seconds = lv_difference / 10000000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_duration.
    DATA(lv_utclong_from) = '20251207100000.0000000'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_seconds) = lo_cut->get_duration_in_seconds(

    ).

      exp = -60

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei UTCLONG-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.
hint: UTCLONG-Werte können direkt verglichen werden, da sie als numerische Strings vorliegen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_utclongs
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_comparison_result) TYPE i. " -1 if 1 < 2, 0 if 1 = 2, 1 if 1 > 2
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_utclongs.
    IF iv_utclong1 < iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = -1.
    ELSEIF iv_utclong1 = iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = 0.
    ELSE.
      rv_comparison_result = 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comparison.
    DATA(lv_utclong_earlier) = '20251207100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_later)   = '20251207110000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_same)    = '20251207100000.0000000'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_comparator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_earlier iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_later )
      exp = -1
      msg = 'Comparison (earlier < later) incorrect'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_later iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_earlier )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Comparison (later > earlier) incorrect'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->compare_utclongs( iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_earlier iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_same )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Comparison (equal) incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da UTCLONG-Zeitstempel im ABAP-System als numerisch interpretierbare Strings gespeichert werden (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.NNNNNNN), können sie direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (<, =, >) verglichen werden. Dies ist eine einfache, effiziente und moderne Methode, um die chronologische Reihenfolge von Zeitstempeln zu bestimmen, ohne auf komplexe Konvertierungen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
keywords: UTCLONG, Compare, Comparison, Date/Time, Order

Instructions: Rufe eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen modifizierten String zurückgeben.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p_string` für den Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      call_dynamic_method
        IMPORTING
          iv_object TYPE REF TO object
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          iv_param TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string,
      _process_string
        IMPORTING
          iv_input TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters,
          ls_parameter LIKE LINE OF lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_param ).
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = iv_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = lt_parameters
          IMPORTING
            ev_result   = rv_result
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _process_string.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_dyn_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_input_string) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lv_method) = '_PROCESS_STRING'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_dyn_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      iv_object      = lo_dyn_caller
      iv_method_name = lv_method
      iv_param       = lv_input_string
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Hello World' msg = 'Dynamic method call failed' ).

    lv_method = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'.
    lv_result = lo_dyn_caller->call_dynamic_method(
      iv_object      = lo_dyn_caller
      iv_method_name = lv_method
      iv_param       = lv_input_string
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result+0(5) msg = 'Error handling for non-existent method failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode mittels `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method`. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Programme, die zur Laufzeit entscheiden müssen, welche Logik ausgeführt wird. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über eine Tabelle von `t_parameters`, was eine flexible Schnittstelle ermöglicht. Fehler werden über `cx_abap_dyn_prg_error` abgefangen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Method Call, cl_abap_dyn_prg
