      iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '100' msg = 'Get FIELD2 failed' ).

    " Test set_field_value
    lo_dyn_access->set_field_value(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_test_data
      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
                iv_new_value  = 'New Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-field1 exp = 'New Value' msg = 'Set FIELD1 failed' ).

    lo_dyn_access->set_field_value(
      CHANGING cs_data = ls_test_data
      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
                iv_new_value  = '200'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_test_data-field2 exp = 200 msg = 'Set FIELD2 failed' ).

    " Test non-existent field
    DATA(lv_error_value) = lo_dyn_access->get_field_value(
      is_data     = ls_test_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_error_value+0(5) msg = 'Error handling for non-existent field failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder einer Struktur mit `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>get_value` und `set_value`. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen, die Datenstrukturen verarbeiten, deren Felder erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, z.B. bei der Verarbeitung von Konfigurationsdaten oder Schnittstellen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_abap_dyn_prg_error` ist integriert.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Access, cl_abap_dyn_prg

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und befülle diese dynamisch. Die Struktur soll aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen generiert werden.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_structdescr=>create`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      create_and_fill_dynamic_table
        IMPORTING
          it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_components,
          ls_component LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )->get_handle( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( )->get_handle( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or handle other types
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )->get_handle( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any structure,
                       <lv_dynamic_field> TYPE any.

        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

        " Example: Fill with some data
        LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            CASE ls_field_def-name.
              WHEN 'ID'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 1.
              WHEN 'NAME'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 'Dynamic Entry 1'.
              WHEN 'VALUE'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 100.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = |Default { ls_field_def-name }|.
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        CLEAR <ls_dynamic_line>.
        LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_dynamic_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            CASE ls_field_def-name.
              WHEN 'ID'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 2.
              WHEN 'NAME'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 'Dynamic Entry 2'.
              WHEN 'VALUE'.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = 200.
              WHEN OTHERS.
                <lv_dynamic_field> = |Default { ls_field_def-name }|.
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error INTO DATA(lx_type_error).
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_abap_tabledescr_error INTO DATA(lx_table_error).
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creation( ).
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE zcl_dyn_table_creation=>tt_field_def.

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID' TYPE = 'INT' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'NAME' TYPE = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'VALUE' TYPE = 'INT' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table not created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any structure,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <ls_line> msg = 'First line not found' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect ID in first line' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 'Dynamic Entry 1' msg = 'Incorrect NAME in first line' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( <ls_line> msg = 'Second line not found' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_field> exp = 200 msg = 'Incorrect VALUE in second line' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch erzeugten Struktur erstellt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario, das oft in generischen Tools oder bei der Integration mit externen Systemen benötigt wird, deren Datenstruktur nicht fest vorgegeben ist. Es verwendet RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbolen, um die Flexibilität zu gewährleisten.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Internal Table, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel für eine SELECT-Anweisung auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einem übergebenen String.
hint: Nutze die Syntax `WHERE (lv_where_clause)` in der SELECT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      get_flights_dynamic_where
        IMPORTING
          iv_where_clause TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_where.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    lv_where_clause = iv_where_clause.

    TRY.
        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflights
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE rt_flights
          WHERE (lv_where_clause).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a new exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `CARRID = 'LH' AND CONNID = '0400'`.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_dynamic_where( lv_where ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights msg = 'No flights found for valid WHERE clause' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_empty.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `CARRID = 'XX'`.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_dynamic_where( lv_where ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Flights found for empty WHERE clause' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_where_error.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_dyn_select_where( ).
    DATA(lv_where) = `INVALID_FIELD = 'X'`.

    " Expecting an error, but unit test framework might catch MESSAGE E
    " For robust testing, one might need to catch the exception directly if the method re-raises it.
    " Here, we just check if the table is empty, assuming the error prevents data retrieval.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_dynamic_where( lv_where ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights msg = 'Flights found despite invalid WHERE clause' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung einer dynamischen WHERE-Klausel in einer SELECT-Anweisung. Dies ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Datenbankabfragen, bei denen die Filterkriterien zur Laufzeit vom Benutzer oder von einer Konfiguration bestimmt werden. Die Klausel wird als String übergeben und in Klammern gesetzt. Fehler bei der SQL-Syntax werden durch `cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error` abgefangen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SELECT, WHERE Clause, SQL, Database

Instructions: Erstelle ein ALV-Grid dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Zeige die Daten der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` an.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_table=>factory` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die Typbeschreibung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      display_sflights_alv
        IMPORTING
          it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_alv.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen " For full screen ALV
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = it_flights
        ).

        " Optional: Set ALV functions, layout, etc.
        lo_salv_table->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).
        lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( )->set_striped_pattern( abap_true ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_error).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_factory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_factory.
    DATA(lo_alv_display) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_display( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_dyn_alv_display=>tt_sflight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flights.

    " In a real unit test, displaying an ALV is not directly testable
    " as it requires GUI interaction. We can only test if the factory call
    " does not raise an exception and returns a valid object.
    TRY.
        lo_alv_display->display_sflights_alv( lt_flights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'ALV display method executed without exception' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |ALV display failed with exception: { lx_salv_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein ALV-Grid dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle erstellt und anzeigt. Die `cl_salv_table=>factory`-Methode ist hier der Schlüssel, da sie die Struktur der übergebenen Tabelle automatisch erkennt und den Feldkatalog generiert. Dies ist ideal für generische Berichte, bei denen die anzuzeigenden Daten und deren Struktur variieren können. Obwohl die eigentliche GUI-Anzeige nicht direkt im Unit-Test überprüft werden kann, wird die korrekte Instanziierung und Ausführung der Methode getestet.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, ALV, UI, cl_salv_table, Field Catalog

Instructions: Messe die Ausführungszeit eines einfachen Codeblocks, z.B. einer Schleife, mit `cl_abap_runtime`.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` vor und nach dem Codeblock.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      measure_simple_loop
        IMPORTING
          iv_iterations TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_simple_loop.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DO iv_iterations TIMES.
      " Simulate some work
      DATA(lv_dummy) = sy-index * 2.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simple_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simple_measurement.
    DATA(lo_measurer) = NEW zcl_runtime_measure( ).
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 100000.

    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_measurer->measure_simple_loop( lv_iterations ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_runtime >= 0 msg = 'Runtime should be non-negative' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_runtime < 10000000 msg = 'Runtime seems excessively high (more than 10s)' ). " Arbitrary upper limit

    " Log the runtime for analysis, not for assertion in unit test
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |Runtime for { lv_iterations } iterations: { lv_runtime } microseconds| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` zur Messung der Ausführungszeit eines Codeblocks in Mikrosekunden. Dies ist ein unverzichtbares Werkzeug für die Performance-Analyse und -Optimierung von ABAP-Programmen. Der Unit-Test überprüft, ob die gemessene Zeit gültig ist (nicht negativ) und gibt sie zur Information aus.
keywords: Runtime, Performance, cl_abap_runtime, Measurement

Instructions: Vergleiche die Ausführungszeiten von zwei verschiedenen Implementierungen zur Aggregation von Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` für beide Implementierungen und vergleiche die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_agg_result,
           tt_agg_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_result WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS: 
      compare_aggregation_methods
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _aggregate_with_loop
        IMPORTING
          it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_agg_result,
      _aggregate_with_group_by
        IMPORTING
          it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_agg_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_aggregation_methods.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_runtime_loop TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_group TYPE i.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    " Measure loop approach
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_result_loop) = _aggregate_with_loop( lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_loop = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure group by approach
    DATA(lv_start_group) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_result_group) = _aggregate_with_group_by( lt_flights ).
    DATA(lv_end_group) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_group = lv_end_group - lv_start_group.

    " Store runtimes and results for comparison
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             method TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'Loop' runtime_us = lv_runtime_loop ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'Group By' runtime_us = lv_runtime_group ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.

    " Assert results are identical (for correctness, not performance)
    IF lt_result_loop <> lt_result_group.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _aggregate_with_loop.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = ls_flight-price ) INTO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _aggregate_with_group_by.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            total_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_compare( ).

    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_aggregation_methods( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_runtimes msg = 'Runtime results not returned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_runtimes> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <lt_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_runtimes> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 runtime entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_loop_runtime).
    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_group_runtime).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_loop_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_group_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |Loop Runtime: { ls_loop_runtime-runtime_us } us, Group By Runtime: { ls_group_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance zweier gängiger Aggregationsmethoden für interne Tabellen: eine explizite Schleife mit `COLLECT` und die modernere, funktionale `FOR GROUPS OF`-Syntax. `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeiten beider Ansätze zu messen. Dies ist entscheidend, um die effizienteste Methode für bestimmte Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren und die Code-Performance zu optimieren. Der Unit-Test stellt sicher, dass die Ergebnisse korrekt sind und protokolliert die Laufzeiten.
keywords: Runtime, Performance, Comparison, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS OF, COLLECT, cl_abap_runtime

Instructions: Messe die Performance von internen Tabellenoperationen wie `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` auf einer großen Datenmenge.
hint: Erstelle eine große interne Tabelle mit Zufallsdaten und nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_table_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      measure_table_operations
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _generate_random_data
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_table_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_table_operations.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_data,
          lv_runtime_sort TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_delete TYPE i.

    lt_data = _generate_random_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure SORT
    DATA(lv_start_sort) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    SORT lt_data BY key_field ASCENDING value_field ASCENDING.
    DATA(lv_end_sort) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_sort = lv_end_sort - lv_start_sort.

    " Measure DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DATA(lv_start_delete) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_data COMPARING key_field.
    DATA(lv_end_delete) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_delete = lv_end_delete - lv_start_delete.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             operation TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( operation = 'SORT' runtime_us = lv_runtime_sort ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( operation = 'DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES' runtime_us = lv_runtime_delete ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _generate_random_data.
    DATA: lv_random_key TYPE c LENGTH 10,

      lv_random_value = sy-index MOD 1000.
      APPEND VALUE #( key_field = lv_random_key value_field = lv_random_value ) TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führe eine dynamische Methode mit variabler Anzahl von Parametern aus, wobei die Parameter zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method` mit einer dynamisch gefüllten `t_parameters` Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_dyn_var_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      execute_method_with_params
        IMPORTING
          iv_object TYPE REF TO object
          iv_method_name TYPE string
          it_input_params TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string,
      _sum_numbers
        IMPORTING
          iv_num1 TYPE i
          iv_num2 TYPE i OPTIONAL
          iv_num3 TYPE i OPTIONAL
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_var_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_method_with_params.
    DATA: lv_result_any TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = iv_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = it_input_params
          IMPORTING
            ev_result   = lv_result_any
        ).
        IF lv_result_any IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN lv_result_any->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
          IF <fs_result> IS ASSIGNED.
            rv_result = <fs_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _sum_numbers.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2 + iv_num3.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine dynamische interne Tabelle und fülle sie mit Daten aus `SFLIGHTS`, wobei nur bestimmte, dynamisch ausgewählte Felder berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit `CREATE DATA` und dynamischem `SELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      select_dynamic_fields
        IMPORTING
          iv_table_name TYPE tabname
          it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_fields.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_components,
          ls_component LIKE LINE OF lt_components,
          lv_field_list TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( iv_name = |{ iv_table_name }-{ lv_field_name }| ).
          ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
          ls_component-type = lo_elem_descr->get_handle( ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
          IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
            lv_field_list = lv_field_name.
          ELSE.
            lv_field_list = lv_field_list && ',' && lv_field_name.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
          " Field does not exist, skip it
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        DATA(lv_select_statement) = |SELECT { lv_field_list } FROM { iv_table_name } INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_dynamic_table>|.

        EXEC SQL.
          {lv_select_statement}
        ENDEXEC.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_abap_tabledescr_error.
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messe die Performance von `FOR` und `REDUCE` Ausdrücken im Vergleich zu traditionellen Schleifen für die Transformation von Daten.
hint: Erstelle eine große interne Tabelle und nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` für jeden Ansatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_input,
           tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_output,
             id TYPE i,
             processed_text TYPE string,
             doubled_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_output,
           tt_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      compare_transformation_methods
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _generate_input_data
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_input,
      _transform_with_loop
        IMPORTING
          it_input TYPE tt_input
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_output,
      _transform_with_for
        IMPORTING
          it_input TYPE tt_input
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_output) TYPE tt_output,
      _sum_with_reduce
        IMPORTING
          it_input TYPE tt_input
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_transformation_methods.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE tt_input,
          lv_runtime_loop TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_for TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_reduce TYPE i.

    lt_input = _generate_input_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure loop transformation
    DATA(lv_start_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_output_loop) = _transform_with_loop( lt_input ).
    DATA(lv_end_loop) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_loop = lv_end_loop - lv_start_loop.

    " Measure FOR transformation
    DATA(lv_start_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lt_output_for) = _transform_with_for( lt_input ).
    DATA(lv_end_for) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_for = lv_end_for - lv_start_for.

    " Measure REDUCE sum
    DATA(lv_start_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_sum_reduce) = _sum_with_reduce( lt_input ).
    DATA(lv_end_reduce) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_reduce = lv_end_reduce - lv_start_reduce.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             method TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'Loop Transformation' runtime_us = lv_runtime_loop ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'FOR Transformation' runtime_us = lv_runtime_for ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'REDUCE Sum' runtime_us = lv_runtime_reduce ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.

    " Assert results are identical for transformations
    IF lt_output_loop <> lt_output_for.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _generate_input_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index text = |Text { sy-index }| value = sy-index ) TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _transform_with_loop.
    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(ls_input).
      APPEND VALUE #( id = ls_input-id
                      processed_text = |{ ls_input-text }_processed|
                      doubled_value = ls_input-value * 2 ) TO rt_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _transform_with_for.
    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input
                           ( id = ls_input-id
                             processed_text = |{ ls_input-text }_processed|
                             doubled_value = ls_input-value * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _sum_with_reduce.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_input IN it_input NEXT s = s + ls_input-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_reduce_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_reduce_performance.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_for_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 50000.

    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_transformation_methods( lv_num_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_runtimes msg = 'Runtime results not returned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_runtimes> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <lt_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_runtimes> ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 runtime entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_loop_runtime).
    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_for_runtime).
    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_reduce_runtime).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_loop_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_for_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_reduce_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |FOR Transformation Runtime: { ls_for_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |REDUCE Sum Runtime: { ls_reduce_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messe die Performance von String-Operationen wie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` vs. `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` auf einem großen String.
hint: Erstelle einen großen String mit vielen Vorkommen eines Musters und nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_string_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      compare_string_replace
        IMPORTING
          iv_string_length TYPE i
          iv_pattern TYPE string
          iv_replacement TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _generate_long_string
        IMPORTING
          iv_length TYPE i
          iv_pattern TYPE string
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_long_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_string_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_string_replace.
    DATA: lv_long_string TYPE string,
          lv_runtime_replace_all TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_replace_regex TYPE i.

    lv_long_string = _generate_long_string( iv_string_length iv_pattern ).

    " Measure REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES
    DATA(lv_string_for_replace_all) = lv_long_string.
    DATA(lv_start_replace_all) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_pattern IN lv_string_for_replace_all WITH iv_replacement.
    DATA(lv_end_replace_all) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_replace_all = lv_end_replace_all - lv_start_replace_all.

    " Measure REPLACE with REGEX
    DATA(lv_string_for_replace_regex) = lv_long_string.
    DATA(lv_start_replace_regex) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN lv_string_for_replace_regex WITH iv_replacement.
    DATA(lv_end_replace_regex) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_replace_regex = lv_end_replace_regex - lv_start_replace_regex.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             method TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES' runtime_us = lv_runtime_replace_all ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'REPLACE REGEX' runtime_us = lv_runtime_replace_regex ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.

    " Assert results are identical
    IF lv_string_for_replace_all <> lv_string_for_replace_regex.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _generate_long_string.
    DATA: lv_temp_string TYPE string.
    DO iv_length / 10 TIMES.
      lv_temp_string = lv_temp_string && 'ABCDEFGHIJ'.
    ENDDO.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF 'E' IN lv_temp_string WITH iv_pattern.
    rv_long_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Messe die Performance des Zugriffs auf eine Hash-Tabelle im Vergleich zu einer Standardtabelle mit binärer Suche.
hint: Erstelle eine große Hash-Tabelle und eine Standardtabelle, befülle sie mit Daten und nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` für `READ TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS: 
      compare_table_access
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _generate_test_data
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_standard.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_access.
    DATA: lt_standard_data TYPE tt_standard,
          lt_hashed_data TYPE tt_hashed,
          lv_runtime_standard TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_hashed TYPE i.

    lt_standard_data = _generate_test_data( iv_num_entries ).
    lt_hashed_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_standard_data ).

    " Measure Standard Table access with BINARY SEARCH
    DATA(lv_start_standard) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    LOOP AT lt_standard_data INTO DATA(ls_read_key).
      READ TABLE lt_standard_data INTO DATA(ls_found)
        WITH KEY key_field = ls_read_key-key_field
        BINARY SEARCH.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_standard) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_standard = lv_end_standard - lv_start_standard.

    " Measure Hashed Table access
    DATA(lv_start_hashed) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    LOOP AT lt_hashed_data INTO ls_read_key.
      READ TABLE lt_hashed_data INTO ls_found
        WITH KEY key_field = ls_read_key-key_field.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_hashed) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_hashed = lv_end_hashed - lv_start_hashed.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             table_type TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( table_type = 'Standard (Binary Search)' runtime_us = lv_runtime_standard ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( table_type = 'Hashed' runtime_us = lv_runtime_hashed ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _generate_test_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( key_field = |KEY_{ sy-index }|
                      value_field = |Value for { sy-index }| ) TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_access_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_access_performance.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_table_access( ).
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 10000.

    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_table_access( lv_num_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_runtimes msg = 'Runtime results not returned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_runtimes> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <lt_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_runtimes> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 runtime entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_standard_runtime).
    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_hashed_runtime).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_standard_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_hashed_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |Standard Table (Binary Search) Runtime ({ lv_num_entries } entries): { ls_standard_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |Hashed Table Runtime: { ls_hashed_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance des Zugriffs auf eine Hash-Tabelle mit der einer Standardtabelle, die mit `BINARY SEARCH` gelesen wird. `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeiten für das Lesen aller Einträge zu messen. Hash-Tabellen bieten in der Regel eine bessere Performance für den direkten Zugriff über den Schlüssel, während Standardtabellen mit binärer Suche eine gute Alternative sein können, wenn die Daten bereits sortiert sind. Der Unit-Test generiert Testdaten, führt die Zugriffe durch und protokolliert die Laufzeiten.

Instructions: Messe die Performance der Datenübertragung zwischen internen Tabellen mit `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` vs. `CORRESPONDING #(`.
hint: Erstelle zwei interne Tabellen mit ähnlichen Strukturen und nutze `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_move_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
             unused_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
             additional_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target,
           tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: 
      compare_data_transfer
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO data.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: 
      _generate_source_data
        IMPORTING
          iv_num_entries TYPE i
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_move_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_data_transfer.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE tt_source,
          lt_target_move TYPE tt_target,
          lt_target_corr TYPE tt_target,
          lv_runtime_move TYPE i,
          lv_runtime_corr TYPE i.

    lt_source = _generate_source_data( iv_num_entries ).

    " Measure MOVE-CORRESPONDING
    DATA(lv_start_move) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    LOOP AT lt_source INTO DATA(ls_source).
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_source TO DATA(ls_target_line).
      APPEND ls_target_line TO lt_target_move.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_end_move) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_move = lv_end_move - lv_start_move.

    " Measure CORRESPONDING #(
    DATA(lv_start_corr) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lt_target_corr = CORRESPONDING #( lt_source MAPPING additional_field = unused_field ).
    DATA(lv_end_corr) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    lv_runtime_corr = lv_end_corr - lv_start_corr.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_runtime_info,
             method TYPE string,
             runtime_us TYPE i,
           END OF ty_runtime_info.
    DATA: lt_runtime_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_runtime_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'MOVE-CORRESPONDING Loop' runtime_us = lv_runtime_move ) TO lt_runtime_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( method = 'CORRESPONDING #(' runtime_us = lv_runtime_corr ) TO lt_runtime_info.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes LIKE TABLE OF lt_runtime_info.
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes> = lt_runtime_info.

    " Assert results are identical (ignoring additional_field for MOVE-CORRESPONDING)
    LOOP AT lt_target_move INTO DATA(ls_move).
      READ TABLE lt_target_corr INTO DATA(ls_corr) WITH KEY id = ls_move-id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_move-name <> ls_corr-name OR ls_move-value <> ls_corr-value.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _generate_source_data.
    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( id = sy-index
                      name = |Name { sy-index }|
                      value = sy-index * 10
                      unused_field = |Unused { sy-index }| ) TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_transfer_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_transfer_performance.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_runtime_move_corr( ).
    DATA(lv_num_entries) = 10000.

    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_comparer->compare_data_transfer( lv_num_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_runtimes msg = 'Runtime results not returned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_runtimes> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <lt_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_runtimes> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 runtime entries' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_move_runtime).
    READ TABLE <lt_runtimes> INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_corr_runtime).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_move_runtime-runtime_us >= 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |MOVE-CORRESPONDING Loop Runtime ({ lv_num_entries } entries): { ls_move_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = |CORRESPONDING #( Runtime: { ls_corr_runtime-runtime_us } us| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der Datenübertragung zwischen internen Tabellen mit der traditionellen `LOOP AT ... MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Methode und dem modernen `CORRESPONDING #(` Ausdruck. `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Ausführungszeiten zu messen. `CORRESPONDING #(` ist oft effizienter und lesbarer, insbesondere bei komplexen Mappings. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (aus 'sflights') und filtern Sie Flüge, die eine bestimmte maximale Kapazität überschreiten, unter Verwendung einer modernen Syntax. Geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'FOR' mit 'VALUE' und 'WHERE' Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_capacity TYPE s_max_cap
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights( iv_max_capacity = 200 ).

    out->write( |Gefilterte Flüge mit Kapazität > 200: { lines( lt_flights ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }, Kapazität: { ls_flight-max_seats }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                   WHERE ( max_seats > iv_max_capacity )
                                   ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_max_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_res ). " Assuming no flights with >200 seats in standard sflight

    " Add a test case where results are expected
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).
    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_first_max_seats) = lt_all_flights[ 1 ]-max_seats.
      DATA(lt_res_expected) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_max_capacity = lv_first_max_seats - 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_res_expected ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die 'WHERE'-Klausel innerhalb des 'FOR'-Ausdrucks macht den Code sehr lesbar und effizient, da keine expliziten Schleifen oder 'DELETE'-Anweisungen benötigt werden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge in 'sflights' für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung einer modernen Aggregationssyntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'REDUCE'-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_capacity( 'LH' ).
    out->write( |Gesamtkapazität für LH: { lv_total_lh }| ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_capacity( 'AA' ).
    out->write( |Gesamtkapazität für AA: { lv_total_aa }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_sflight IN sflight
                                  WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-max_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).

    " Test for LH (Lufthansa)
    DATA(lv_expected_lh) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( max_seats ) FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_actual_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_lh exp = lv_expected_lh msg = 'Total capacity for LH incorrect' ).

    " Test for a non-existent carrier
    DATA(lv_actual_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Total capacity for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'REDUCE'-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ist sehr ausdrucksstark und ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, sflight, if_oo_adt_classrun

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie basierend auf der Passagierkapazität eines Fluges, ob es sich um einen 'kleinen', 'mittleren' oder 'großen' Flug handelt. Nutzen Sie eine moderne Konditionalanweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'COND'-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_flight_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_capacity TYPE s_max_cap
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_size) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_classifier) = NEW zcl_flight_size( ).
    out->write( |Kapazität 50: { lo_classifier->get_flight_size( 50 ) }| ).
    out->write( |Kapazität 150: { lo_classifier->get_flight_size( 150 ) }| ).
    out->write( |Kapazität 300: { lo_classifier->get_flight_size( 300 ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_size.
    rv_size = COND string(
                WHEN iv_capacity < 100 THEN 'klein'
                WHEN iv_capacity < 250 THEN 'mittel'
                ELSE 'groß' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_size FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_size( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_size( 50 ) exp = 'klein' msg = 'Capacity 50 should be small' ).

CLASS zcl_flight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus 'sflights', die von einer bestimmten Stadt abfliegen und eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben. Nutzen Sie den 'FILTER'-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'FILTER'-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_advanced_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE s_city_fr
        iv_min_capacity TYPE s_max_cap
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_advanced_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_advanced_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_filter->filter_flights_by_criteria( iv_city_from = 'NEW YORK' iv_min_capacity = 150 ).

    out->write( |Gefilterte Flüge von NEW YORK mit Kapazität >= 150: { lines( lt_flights ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |Flug: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }, Abflug: { ls_flight-cityfrom }, Kapazität: { ls_flight-max_seats }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_criteria.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( ls_sflight ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from AND max_seats >= iv_min_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights_by_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights_by_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_advanced_filter( ).

    " Test with known data (assuming some flights from 'NEW YORK' with capacity >= 150 exist)
    DATA(lt_res_ny_150) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria( iv_city_from = 'NEW YORK' iv_min_capacity = 150 ).
    " Assert that the result is not initial if such flights exist, or initial if not.
    " For a robust test, one would need to know the exact content of sflight.
    " Here, we just check if the operation completes and returns a table.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_res_ny_150 ). " Assuming there are some flights

    " Test with criteria that should yield no results
    DATA(lt_res_non_existent) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria( iv_city_from = 'NONEXISTENTCITY' iv_min_capacity = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_res_non_existent ).

    DATA(lt_res_high_capacity) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_criteria( iv_city_from = 'FRANKFURT' iv_min_capacity = 10000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_res_high_capacity ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FILTER'-Operator (ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er ist besonders nützlich, um Untergruppen von Daten basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu extrahieren, ohne explizite Schleifen oder 'LOOP AT WHERE'-Konstrukte verwenden zu müssen. Die Verwendung von 'USING KEY' kann die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen hat, unter Verwendung der 'CORRESPONDING'-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'CORRESPONDING' mit 'BASE'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE decfloat16,
             status  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_transfer) = NEW zcl_data_transfer( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE ty_source_data(
      id = 1
      name = 'Test Item'
      value = '123.45'
      comment = 'This is a comment'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_transfer->transfer_data( ls_source ).

    out->write( |Target ID: { ls_target-id }| ).
    out->write( |Target Name: { ls_target-name }| ).
    out->write( |Target Amount: { ls_target-amount }| ).
    out->write( |Target Status: { ls_target-status }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transfer_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING value = amount ).
    " Set default for status as it's not in source
    rs_target-status = 'PROCESSED'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(ls_source_test) = VALUE zcl_data_transfer=>ty_source_data(
      id = 10
      name = 'Another Item'
      value = '99.99'
      comment = 'Another comment'

    DATA(ls_target_actual) = lo_cut->transfer_data( ls_source_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_actual-id exp = 10 msg = 'ID not transferred correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_actual-name exp = 'Another Item' msg = 'Name not transferred correctly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_actual-amount exp = '99.99' msg = 'Value mapped to amount incorrectly' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_actual-status exp = 'PROCESSED' msg = 'Status not set correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Mit der 'MAPPING'-Klausel können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zugeordnet werden, was den Code sauberer und wartbarer macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung und grundlegende Verwendung des 'cl_gui_timer' zur Simulation eines zeitgesteuerten Ereignisses. Erklären Sie, wie es in einem realen GUI-Szenario verwendet würde.
hint: Instanziieren Sie 'cl_gui_timer' und setzen Sie das Intervall. Beachten Sie, dass ein vollständiger Test GUI-Kontext erfordert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.

    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    " In einem echten GUI-Szenario würde der Timer in einem PBO/PAI-Zyklus
    " eines Dynpros oder in einem Web Dynpro/SAPUI5-Controller instanziiert und gestartet.
    " Hier simulieren wir nur die Instanziierung und die Event-Registrierung.
    " Die 'main'-Methode von if_oo_adt_classrun ist nicht für interaktive GUI-Elemente gedacht.
    " Daher kann der Timer hier nicht wirklich 'laufen' und Events auslösen.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.

    mo_timer->interval = 1. " 1 Sekunde
    mo_timer->runs_at_background = abap_true. " Kann im Hintergrund laufen (nicht-GUI-Kontext)

    " In einem echten GUI-Programm würde man hier mo_timer->activate( ) aufrufen.
    " Da wir keinen GUI-Kontext haben, würde activate hier einen Fehler verursachen.
    " Wir demonstrieren nur die Vorbereitung.

    out->write( |cl_gui_timer instanziiert und Event-Handler registriert.| ).
    out->write( |Intervall auf { mo_timer->interval } Sekunden gesetzt.| ).
    out->write( |Hinweis: Ein echter Timer-Lauf erfordert einen aktiven GUI-Kontext (Dynpro, Web Dynpro etc.).| ).

    " Um den Unit-Test zu ermöglichen, setzen wir den Zähler manuell
    mv_counter = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " Diese Methode würde in einem echten GUI-Szenario bei jedem Timer-Intervall aufgerufen.
    " Hier wird sie nur für den Unit-Test simuliert.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    " In einem echten Szenario könnte hier z.B. ein Bildschirm aktualisiert werden.
    " out->write( |Timer Event ausgelöst! Zähler: { mv_counter }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_instantiation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_timer_event_handler FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_instantiation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_cut->mo_timer msg = 'Timer object not instantiated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mo_timer->interval exp = 1 msg = 'Timer interval not set correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_timer_event_handler.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_demo( ).
    " Simulate event triggering for testing purposes
    lo_cut->mv_counter = 0.
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_counter exp = 1 msg = 'Timer event handler did not increment counter' ).
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_counter exp = 2 msg = 'Timer event handler did not increment counter again' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse 'cl_gui_timer' ermöglicht die Implementierung von zeitgesteuerten Ereignissen in ABAP-GUI-Anwendungen. Sie ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil für interaktive Oberflächen, die regelmäßige Aktualisierungen oder Aktionen erfordern. Die Instanziierung und Registrierung von Event-Handlern ist Standard in der ABAP-Objektorientierung. Ein vollständiger Funktionstest erfordert jedoch einen aktiven GUI-Kontext, der in einer 'if_oo_adt_classrun'-Umgebung nicht gegeben ist. Der Unit-Test konzentriert sich daher auf die Instanziierung und die Logik des Event-Handlers.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, GUI, Timer, Events, if_oo_adt_classrun

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über einen Index zu und modifizieren Sie diese, unter Verwendung einer modernen Tabellenexpression.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'TABLE_LINE' oder 'line_exists'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_line_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_status TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_line_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_table_line_access( ).
    DATA(lt_my_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_status(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'SCHEDULED' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' status = 'SCHEDULED' )
    ).

    out->write( |Vor Update:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_my_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_before).
      out->write( |{ ls_flight_before-carrid } { ls_flight_before-connid }: { ls_flight_before-status }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_accessor->update_flight_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_status = 'DEPARTED' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_my_flights ).

    out->write( |Nach Update:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_my_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_after).
      out->write( |{ ls_flight_after-carrid } { ls_flight_after-connid }: { ls_flight_after-status }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_status.
    TRY.
        ct_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-status = iv_new_status.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where line is not found
        MESSAGE e001(zmsg_flights) WITH iv_carrid iv_connid DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_line_access( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_line_access=>tt_flight_status(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'SCHEDULED' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' status = 'SCHEDULED' )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_status = 'DEPARTED' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = lt_test_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated_flight-status exp = 'DEPARTED' msg = 'Flight status not updated correctly' ).

    DATA(ls_other_flight) = lt_test_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_other_flight-status exp = 'SCHEDULED' msg = 'Other flight status should remain unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_line_access( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_line_access=>tt_flight_status(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'SCHEDULED' )
    ).

    " Expecting cx_sy_itab_line_not_found to be caught internally or handled.
    " For this test, we check if the table remains unchanged.
    DATA(lt_flights_before) = lt_test_flights.

hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR` Expression mit `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )`.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_full,
           ty_sflight_full_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           ty_flight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_full_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_flight_key_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      (
        carrid = CONV #( to_upper( ls_flight-carrid ) )
        connid = ls_flight-connid
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene interne Tabelle von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flights_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #(
      INIT sum_price = ( VALUE s_price( ) )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_expr IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz und bestimmen Sie gleichzeitig, ob der Flug "Expensive", "Moderate" oder "Cheap" ist, basierend auf seinem Preis, direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE` Expression in der `SELECT`-Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_with_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_status) TYPE ty_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, price,
      CASE
        WHEN price > 500 THEN 'Expensive'
        WHEN price > 100 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Cheap'
      END AS status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_status_expensive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_status_moderate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_status_cheap FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_status_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_with_status_expensive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case_select( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price > 500 exists for AA 0017
    " For robust testing, ensure test data or mock.
    " Let's assume AA 0017 has price 600.00
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_status( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    IF ls_status IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-connid exp = '0017' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'Expensive' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data AA 0017 not found or price not > 500' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_with_status_moderate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case_select( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price > 100 and <= 500 exists for LH 0400
    " Let's assume LH 0400 has price 250.00
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_status( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    IF ls_status IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-connid exp = '0400' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'Moderate' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data LH 0400 not found or price not moderate' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_with_status_cheap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case_select( ).
    " Assuming a flight with price <= 100 exists for UA 0001
    " Let's assume UA 0001 has price 80.00
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_status( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' ).
    IF ls_status IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-connid exp = '0001' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'Cheap' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Test data UA 0001 not found or price not cheap' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_with_status_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_case_select( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_status( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_status-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE` Expression direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik auf Datenbankebene auszuführen und ein abgeleitetes Feld zurückzugeben. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP und kann die Performance verbessern, da weniger Daten übertragen werden müssen.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CASE Expression, Conditional Logic, Data Retrieval

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen geschachtelten Strukturtyp und einen Tabellentyp. Füllen Sie die Tabelle mit Daten unter Verwendung von Konstruktorausdrücken.

CLASS zcl_nested_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_list.
    rt_passenger_list = VALUE #(
      ( name = 'Max Mustermann' age = 30 flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '123.45' ) )
      ( name = 'Erika Musterfrau' age = 25 flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251208' price = '500.00' ) )
    ).

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_passenger_list) = lo_cut->get_passenger_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_passenger_list )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten zwei Passagiere in der Liste sein.'
    ).

Die Befüllung der internen Tabelle erfolgt modern und kompakt mittels `VALUE #(...)` Konstruktorausdrücken, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert und explizite `APPEND` Anweisungen überflüssig macht.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8 kodierten String in einen UTF-16 (UCS-2) kodierten String unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_obj`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Konvertierung zwischen Codepages.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_utf16 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_utf16
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf16_string) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf8_utf16 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_utf16.
    DATA(lo_conv_in)  = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = iv_utf8_string ).
    DATA(lv_string)   = ''_string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_string ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-16BE' ). "UTF-16 Big Endian
    lo_conv_out->write( data = lv_string ).
    rv_utf16_string = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein `XSTRING` einen UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) enthält, diesen gegebenenfalls entfernt und den bereinigten `XSTRING` zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` mit der Option `ignore_bom` oder prüfen Sie die ersten Bytes manuell.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_bom_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_utf8_bom
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_no_bom) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_bom_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_utf8_bom.
    CONSTANTS: lc_utf8_bom TYPE xstring VALUE 'EFBBBF'. "UTF-8 BOM

    IF iv_xstring IS INITIAL.
      rv_xstring_no_bom = iv_xstring.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_xstring CP lc_utf8_bom && iv_xstring(3) = lc_utf8_bom.
      " BOM found, remove it
      rv_xstring_no_bom = iv_xstring+3.
    ELSE.
      " No BOM or not at the beginning
      rv_xstring_no_bom = iv_xstring.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen `XSTRING` von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage konvertiert, wobei beide Codepages dynamisch als Parameter übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und übergeben Sie die Codepages an die `create`-Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_encoding
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_source_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_dynamic_encoding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_encoding.
    DATA(lv_string) = ''_string.

    " Convert from source xstring to internal string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding
      input    = iv_source_xstring
    ).
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_string ).

    " Convert from internal string to target xstring
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding
    ).
    lo_conv_out->write( data = lv_string ).
    rv_target_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_encoding EXPECTING cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_dynamic_encoding( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hallo Welt! ÄÖÜäöüß'.

    " Original string to UTF-8 xstring
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_original_string ).

    " Convert UTF-8 to UTF-16BE
    DATA(lv_utf16_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_encoding(
      iv_source_xstring  = lv_utf8_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
    ).

    " Convert UTF-16BE back to UTF-8 for assertion
    DATA(lv_converted_back_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_encoding(
      iv_source_xstring  = lv_utf16_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-16BE'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    " Convert the final UTF-8 xstring back to string for comparison
    DATA(lo_conv_in_final) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = lv_converted_back_utf8 ).
    DATA(lv_final_string) = ''_string.
    lo_conv_in_final->read( IMPORTING data = lv_final_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_final_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Dynamische Konvertierung sollte den Originalstring wiederherstellen.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_encoding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_dynamic_encoding( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_xstring) = '48616C6C6F'X. "'Hallo' in hex

    " Attempt to convert with an invalid encoding
    lo_cut->convert_xstring_encoding(
      iv_source_xstring  = lv_dummy_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'INVALID_ENCODING'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Klassen `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` ermöglichen eine flexible Handhabung von Zeichenkodierungen, indem die Codepages zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die mit verschiedenen externen Systemen oder Dateiformaten interagieren müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `RAISING cx_abap_conv_codepage` ist ebenfalls ein wichtiger Aspekt modernen ABAP-Codes.
