Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine interne Tabelle mit einem generischen Zeilentyp und verwenden Sie diesen in einer Methode, die dynamisch auf die Felder zugreift.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES tt_generic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_generic_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_generic_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_field_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    rt_sflight = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251208' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen `XSTRING` in einen `STRING` konvertiert und dabei eine optionale BOM-Erkennung und -Entfernung durchführt.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_bom_aware IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bom_ignored FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bom_not_ignored FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_bom FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bom_ignored.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_bom_aware( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_utf8_bom TYPE xstring VALUE 'EFBBBF'.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Text mit BOM'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_original_string ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_with_bom) = lc_utf8_bom && lv_utf8_xstring.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string_bom_aware(
      iv_xstring = lv_xstring_with_bom
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      ib_ignore_bom = abap_true
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'BOM sollte ignoriert und entfernt worden sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bom_not_ignored.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_bom_aware( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_utf8_bom TYPE xstring VALUE 'EFBBBF'.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Text mit BOM'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_original_string ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_with_bom) = lc_utf8_bom && lv_utf8_xstring.

    " If BOM is not ignored, it might be part of the string or cause issues depending on the reader
    " For this test, we expect the raw bytes to be converted, which might lead to garbage characters
    " or an error if the string is then interpreted as text without BOM handling.
    " A more robust test would check for the presence of the BOM characters in the resulting string
    " or expect an exception if the encoding cannot handle it.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string_bom_aware(
          iv_xstring = lv_xstring_with_bom
          iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
          ib_ignore_bom = abap_false
        ).
        " Expecting the BOM characters to be present at the beginning of the string
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
          act = lv_converted_string
          exp = lv_original_string
          msg = 'BOM sollte nicht ignoriert worden sein, daher sollte der String anders sein.'
        ).
        " A more precise check would be to convert the BOM xstring to string and compare
        DATA(lv_bom_as_string) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' input = lc_utf8_bom )->read( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with(
          act = lv_converted_string
          exp = lv_bom_as_string
          msg = 'String sollte mit BOM-Zeichen beginnen.'
        ).

    CATCH cx_abap_conv_codepage.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unerwartete Ausnahme bei BOM-Verarbeitung.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_bom.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_bom_aware( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Text ohne BOM'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_original_string ).

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_to_string_bom_aware(
      iv_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring
      iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      ib_ignore_bom = abap_true
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'String ohne BOM sollte unverändert bleiben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Konvertierung von `XSTRING` zu `STRING` um die explizite Handhabung des Byte Order Marks (BOM). Die `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` Klasse bietet den Parameter `ignore_bom`, der es ermöglicht, ein vorhandenes BOM beim Dekodieren automatisch zu erkennen und zu entfernen. Dies ist besonders nützlich beim Verarbeiten von Textdateien, die aus verschiedenen Quellen stammen können und inkonsistent mit oder ohne BOM gespeichert wurden. Die Verwendung von `abap_bool` und `DEFAULT` für den Parameter `ib_ignore_bom` ist ein modernes Feature.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen `STRING` in einen `XSTRING` konvertiert und dabei eine optionale Byte-Reihenfolge (Big Endian/Little Endian) für UTF-16-Kodierungen berücksichtigt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und die spezifischen UTF-16-Kodierungen wie 'UTF-16BE' oder 'UTF-16LE'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_utf16_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM ty_endianness,
             big_endian,
             little_endian,
           END OF ENUM ty_endianness.

    METHODS convert_string_to_utf16_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
        iv_endianness TYPE ty_endianness DEFAULT ty_endianness=>big_endian
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_conv_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_utf16_endian IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_utf16_xstring.
    DATA(lv_encoding) = COND abap_encoding(
      WHEN iv_endianness = ty_endianness=>big_endian THEN 'UTF-16BE'
      WHEN iv_endianness = ty_endianness=>little_endian THEN 'UTF-16LE'
      ELSE THROW cx_abap_conv_codepage( textid = cx_abap_conv_codepage=>cx_abap_conv_codepage_error )
    ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = lv_encoding
    ).
    lo_conv_out->write( data = iv_string ).
    rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine interne Tabelle mit einem Schlüssel und verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` und `GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ... WITH UNIQUE KEY` und `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY`.

CLASS zcl_grouped_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_grouped,
        key      TYPE ty_sflight_key,
        flights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
        num_flights TYPE i,
      END OF ty_sflight_grouped.
    TYPES tt_sflight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_grouped.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grouped_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflights_by_key.
    rt_grouped_sflights = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        key = VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid )
      ) ASCENDING
      ( key = GROUP KEY
        flights = VALUE #(
          FOR ls_member IN GROUP
          ( ls_member )
        )
        num_flights = lines( GROUP )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie die moderne `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP SIZE` und `GROUP BY` Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                            ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = VALUE sflight-price( FOR GROUPS OF ls_member IN <fs_group> (
                                                    REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0
                                                                          FOR ls_inner_member IN GROUP <fs_group> NEXT sum = sum + ls_inner_member-price ) ) ).
      DATA(lv_average_price) = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
                                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                                      average_price = lv_average_price ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_container_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.

    METHODS handle_close FOR EVENT close OF cl_gui_docking_container.

CLASS zcl_docking_container_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_docked_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid    = sy-repid
        dynnr    = sy-dynnr
        side     = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_right
        extension = 200
        caption  = 'Schließbarer Bereich'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.

    mo_text_editor->set_text_as_stream( 'Schließen Sie diesen Container, um eine Meldung zu sehen.' ).

    SET HANDLER handle_close FOR mo_docking_container.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

  METHOD handle_close.
    MESSAGE 'Der Docking Container wurde geschlossen!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.

    lo_cut->display_docked_container( ).

    " Es gibt keine direkte Möglichkeit, die Ausführung des Event-Handlers zu simulieren.
    " Der Test bestätigt nur, dass die Methode ohne Dump durchläuft und die Objekte gebunden sind.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Docking container should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->mo_docking_container ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die ereignisgesteuerte Programmierung ist ein Kernkonzept in der GUI-Entwicklung. Mit `SET HANDLER` können Methoden als Event-Handler für spezifische Ereignisse von GUI-Controls registriert werden. Dies ermöglicht eine saubere Trennung von Logik und UI-Interaktion. Obwohl die Klasse `cl_gui_docking_container` älter ist, ist die Event-Behandlung mit `FOR EVENT` und `SET HANDLER` eine moderne und standardisierte ABAP-Praxis.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und fügen Sie dynamisch eine `cl_gui_button` und eine `cl_gui_label` hinzu. Der Button soll beim Klick eine Meldung ausgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_container=>create_container` für die Kind-Controls und `SET HANDLER` für das Button-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_docking_container_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_controls.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_button            TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mo_label             TYPE REF TO cl_gui_label.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_container_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_controls.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid    = sy-repid
        dynnr    = sy-dynnr
        side     = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 100
        caption  = 'Dynamische Controls'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_label
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container.
    mo_label->set_text( 'Klicken Sie den Button:' ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_docking_container
        text   = 'Klick mich!'.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    MESSAGE 'Button wurde geklickt!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Event-Behandlung für den Button (`click`-Ereignis) ist ebenfalls integriert. Dies ermöglicht flexible und interaktive Benutzeroberflächen, die auf Benutzeraktionen reagieren.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen. Nutzen Sie eine `LOOP` Anweisung mit `COUNT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und inkrementieren Sie einen Zähler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_berlin_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_berlin_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE cityfrom = 'BERLIN'.
      rv_count = rv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_berlin_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_berlin_flights.
    " Für einen robusten Test müssten SFLIGHT-Daten gemockt oder Testdaten eingefügt werden.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_count_flights( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (SFLIGHT). Nutzen Sie String-Templates innerhalb der Schleife.

solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flight_info
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flight_info.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }, Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }| TO rt_formatted_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_flight_info.
    " Für einen robusten Test müssten SFLIGHT-Daten gemockt oder Testdaten eingefügt werden.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_string_template( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flight_info( ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist (wenn SFLIGHT Daten enthält)

In Kombination mit einer `LOOP`-Anweisung ermöglichen sie eine elegante und lesbare Art, Daten aus internen Tabellen in formatierte Ausgaben umzuwandeln, ohne auf ältere `CONCATENATE` oder `WRITE` Anweisungen zurückgreifen zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) und füllen Sie diese mit zwei Einträgen: 'LH' (EQ) und 'AA' (BT).
hint: Nutzen Sie den VALUE Operator für die Initialisierung einer RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    METHODS get_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE tt_carrid_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
                               ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'AZ' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrid_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_create( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->get_carrid_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_range_entry) = lt_range[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-sign   exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-option exp = 'EQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-low    exp = 'LH' ).

    ls_range_entry = lt_range[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-sign   exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-option exp = 'BT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-low    exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_entry-high   exp = 'AZ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE Operator ermöglicht die kompakte und deklarative Initialisierung von internen Tabellen, einschließlich RANGE-Tabellen, in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: RANGE, VALUE, Internal Table, Initialization

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHT für Fluggesellschaften, die in einer dynamisch erstellten RANGE-Tabelle enthalten sind. Die RANGE-Tabelle soll 'LH' und 'UA' enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den IN Operator mit der RANGE-Tabelle in der SELECT-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE tt_carrid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_select( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE zcl_rng_select=>tt_carrid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'UA' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des IN Operators mit einer RANGE-Tabelle in der WHERE-Klausel einer SELECT-Anweisung ist eine effiziente und flexible Methode, um dynamische Selektionskriterien auf Datenbankebene anzuwenden. Dies vermeidet manuelle Schleifen und IF-Bedingungen und nutzt die Optimierungen des Datenbanksystems.
keywords: RANGE, SELECT, IN, Database Selection

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHT Struktur) basierend auf einer RANGE-Tabelle für Flugnummern (FLIGHTNUM). Die RANGE-Tabelle soll alle Flugnummern zwischen 100 und 200 (INC, BT) enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER Operator mit der IN Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        it_connid_range TYPE tt_connid_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_connid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE connid IN it_connid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_rng_filter=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '150' price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '250' price = 300 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '050' price = 50 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '199' price = 400 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '300' price = 500 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE zcl_rng_filter=>tt_connid_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '001' high = '200' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_connid( it_flights = lt_all_flights it_connid_range = lt_connid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-connid >= '001' AND ls_flight-connid <= '200' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER Operator (ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. In Kombination mit einer RANGE-Tabelle und der WHERE-Bedingung wird der Code sehr prägnant und ausdrucksstark, was die Wartbarkeit und Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: RANGE, FILTER, Internal Table, Table Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine RANGE-Tabelle für Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) basierend auf einer Liste von Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern. Die RANGE-Tabelle soll sowohl einzelne Werte als auch Bereiche abdecken. Verwenden Sie FOR Iterationen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie VALUE und FOR mit APPEND für die RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_criteria,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_criteria.
    TYPES: tt_flight_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
    TYPES: tt_connid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-connid.

    METHODS create_complex_range
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_flight_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_ranges) TYPE BEGIN OF ty_ranges,
                                 carrid_range TYPE tt_carrid_range,
                                 connid_range TYPE tt_connid_range,
                               END OF ty_ranges.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_range.
    rs_ranges-carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_crit IN it_criteria
                                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_crit-carrid ) ).

    rs_ranges-connid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_crit IN it_criteria
                                      WHERE ( connid IS NOT INITIAL )
                                      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = ls_crit-connid ) ).

    " Beispiel für einen Bereich hinzufügen
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '001' high = '099' ) TO rs_ranges-connid_range.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_complex_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_complex_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_for_value( ).

    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_rng_for_value=>tt_flight_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_ranges) = lo_cut->create_complex_range( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_ranges-carrid_range ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_ranges-connid_range ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ranges-carrid_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ranges-connid_range[ 1 ]-low exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ranges-connid_range[ 3 ]-option exp = 'BT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus dem VALUE Operator und FOR-Iterationen (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht die hochflexible und deklarative Konstruktion von internen Tabellen, einschließlich komplexer RANGE-Tabellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Selektionskriterien aus anderen Datenstrukturen zu generieren, was den Code kompakter und leichter verständlich macht.
keywords: RANGE, VALUE, FOR, Internal Table, Dynamic

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Flugpreis (PRICE) in einem vordefinierten RANGE von Preisen liegt. Der RANGE soll Preise zwischen 100 und 500 (INC, BT) abdecken.
hint: Verwenden Sie den IN Operator in einer IF-Bedingung mit einer RANGE-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_price_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-price.

    METHODS is_price_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_price      TYPE sflight-price
        it_price_range TYPE tt_price_range
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_price_in_range.
    IF iv_price IN it_price_range.
      rv_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_out_of_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_check( ).
    DATA(lt_price_range) = VALUE zcl_rng_check=>tt_price_range(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 100 high = 500 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_price_in_range( iv_price = 250 it_price_range = lt_price_range ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_price_in_range( iv_price = 501 it_price_range = lt_price_range ) ).

explanation: Die direkte Verwendung des IN Operators mit einer RANGE-Tabelle in einer IF-Bedingung (ABAP 7.40+) ist eine sehr lesbare und effiziente Methode, um zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in einem definierten Bereich liegt. Dies ersetzt umständliche Schleifen oder komplexe logische Ausdrücke und macht den Code klarer.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine vordefinierte Exception (CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST) mit einer Nachricht vom Typ 'E' auslöst.
hint: Verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_raise_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS raise_error_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_raise_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD raise_error_message.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
      EXPORTING
        textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default
        msgty  = 'E'
        msgid  = 'SFLIGHT'
        msgno  = '001'
        msgv1  = 'Testflug'
        msgv2  = 'nicht gefunden'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_raise_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_raise_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_raise_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->raise_error_message( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg_digest).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_msg_digest->msgty exp = 'E' ).

CLASS zcl_msg_catch_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_catch
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_message_details) TYPE BEGIN OF ty_message_details,
                                         msgty TYPE symsgty,
                                         msgid TYPE symsgid,
                                         msgno TYPE symsgno,
                                         msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
                                         full_text TYPE string,
                                       END OF ty_message_details.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _raise_test_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_catch_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_catch.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          _raise_test_exception( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg_digest).
        rs_message_details-msgty = lx_msg_digest->msgty.
        rs_message_details-msgid = lx_msg_digest->msgid.
        rs_message_details-msgno = lx_msg_digest->msgno.
        rs_message_details-msgv1 = lx_msg_digest->msgv1.
        rs_message_details-full_text = lx_msg_digest->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _raise_test_exception.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
      EXPORTING
        textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default
        msgty  = 'E'
        msgid  = 'SFLIGHT'
        msgno  = '001'
        msgv1  = 'Testflug'
        msgv2  = 'nicht gefunden'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_helper_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv2 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv3 TYPE symsgv,
             msgv4 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS collect_and_retrieve_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_helper_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_and_retrieve_messages.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    mo_message_helper->add_message( msgty = 'I' msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '002' msgv1 = 'Info 1' ).
    mo_message_helper->add_message( msgty = 'W' msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '003' msgv1 = 'Warnung 1' msgv2 = 'Detail' ).
    mo_message_helper->add_message( msgty = 'E' msgid = 'SFLIGHT' msgno = '001' msgv1 = 'Fehler 1' ).

    DATA(lt_collected_messages) = mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).

    LOOP AT lt_collected_messages INTO DATA(ls_collected_msg).
      rt_messages = VALUE #( BASE rt_messages
                             ( msgty = ls_collected_msg-msgty
                               msgid = ls_collected_msg-msgid
                               msgno = ls_collected_msg-msgno
                               msgv1 = ls_collected_msg-msgv1
                               msgv2 = ls_collected_msg-msgv2
                               msgv3 = ls_collected_msg-msgv3
                               msgv4 = ls_collected_msg-msgv4 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Exception-Klasse, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt und eine Nachricht über die MESSAGE Anweisung ausgeben kann. Lösen Sie diese Exception aus und fangen Sie sie.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Interface IF_T100_MESSAGE in Ihrer Custom Exception Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_message_exception PUBLIC.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        !textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        !previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        !msgv1 TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL
        !msgv2 TYPE symsgv OPTIONAL.

    DATA msgv1 TYPE symsgv.
    DATA msgv2 TYPE symsgv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_my_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->msgv1 = msgv1.
    me->msgv2 = msgv2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_custom_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_my_custom_exception.

    METHODS handle_custom_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_custom_exception.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_my_custom_exception
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_my_custom_exception=>if_t100_message~default
          msgv1  = 'Negativer Wert'
          msgv2  = |{ iv_value }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_custom_exception.
    TRY.
        trigger_custom_exception( iv_value ).
      CATCH zcx_my_custom_exception INTO DATA(lx_custom_ex).
        rv_message = lx_custom_ex->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

CLASS zcl_log_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    TRY.
        _perform_risky_operation( iv_input ).
        rv_log_entry = 'Operation erfolgreich'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Hier könnten Sie CL_MESSAGE_HELPER verwenden, um die Nachricht zu sammeln
        rv_log_entry = |Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|. 
        " In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine Protokollierung erfolgen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_risky_operation.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_msg_format_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             type    TYPE symsgty,
             text    TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,

CLASS zcl_msg_format_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_messages.
    rt_formatted_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_msg IN it_messages
                                     LET lv_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( )
                                     IN ( type = ls_msg-msgty
                                          text = |{ ls_msg-msgv1 } { ls_msg-msgv2 } { ls_msg-msgv3 } { ls_msg-msgv4 }|
                                          timestamp = lv_timestamp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_formatted ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_formatted_msg) = lt_formatted[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_formatted_msg-type exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_formatted_msg-text exp = 'Flug LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_formatted_msg-timestamp ).

    ls_formatted_msg = lt_formatted[ 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_formatted_msg-type exp = 'E' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von String Templates (ABAP 7.40+) in Kombination mit FOR-Iterationen und dem VALUE Operator ermöglicht die effiziente und lesbare Transformation von Datenstrukturen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Exception auslöst und dabei die neue Syntax für die Exception-Konstruktion mit Inline-Deklaration der Nachrichtentexte verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ... MESSAGE ... (ABAP 7.55+).
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_inline_raise DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_inline_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_inline_raise IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_inline_exception.
    IF iv_value < 10.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
        MESSAGE E007(SFLIGHT) WITH 'Minimalwert' iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inline_exception_raised FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_message_digest.
    METHODS test_no_inline_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_exception_raised.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_inline_raise( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->trigger_inline_exception( 5 ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg_digest).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_msg_digest->msgty exp = 'E' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_msg_digest->get_text( ) exp = 'Minimalwert' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_msg_digest->get_text( ) exp = '5' ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exception_caught ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_inline_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_inline_raise( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->trigger_inline_exception( 15 ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exception_caught ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die erweiterte RAISE EXCEPTION ... MESSAGE Syntax (ABAP 7.55+) ermöglicht die direkte Verknüpfung einer T100-Nachricht mit der Exception-Konstruktion. Dies vereinfacht den Code erheblich, da die Nachrichtendetails nicht mehr explizit über EXPORTING-Parameter übergeben werden müssen, sondern direkt in der RAISE-Anweisung definiert werden können. Dies führt zu prägnanterem und lesbarerem Code.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, MESSAGE, Inline Declaration, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Tortendiagramm, das die Verteilung der gesamten Flugpreise (PRICE) nach Währung (CURRENCY) aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Verwenden Sie die moderne ABAP-Syntax `REDUCE` für die Datenaggregation.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Summe der Flugpreise pro Währung mit `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_sflights_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_sum,
             currency TYPE s_curr_code,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_currency_sum.
    TYPES: tt_currency_sums TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    DATA mt_chart_data       TYPE tt_currency_sums.

    METHODS display_currency_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS get_currency_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_currency_sums) TYPE tt_currency_sums.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflights_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_currency_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    FENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mt_chart_data = get_currency_data( ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-currency ) ).
    DATA(lt_values)     = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-total_price ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_pie ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flugpreise nach Währung' ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).
    mo_chart_engine->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        series_name = 'Gesamtpreis'
        data_values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_currency_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_currency_sums = REDUCE tt_currency_sums(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_currency_sums( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( currency = ls_flight-currency )
      LET sum_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_currency_sums( BASE result ( currency = ls_flight-currency total_price = sum_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_currency_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_currency_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_sflights_pie( ).
    DATA(lt_currency_sums) = lo_cut->get_currency_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_currency_sums ).
    " Prüfen, ob mindestens eine Währungssumme vorhanden ist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lt_currency_sums[ 1 ]-currency ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lt_currency_sums[ 1 ]-total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Anweisung in Verbindung mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation von Daten aus `sflights` zur Erstellung eines Tortendiagramms. `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung, die besonders in ABAP 7.55+ effizient ist. Der Unit Test validiert die korrekte Aggregation der Währungsdaten.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             period TYPE string,
             sales  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_data.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    DATA mt_current_sales    TYPE tt_sales_data.

    METHODS display_sales_chart

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sales_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Initialdaten
    mt_current_sales = VALUE tt_sales_data(
      ( period = 'Jan' sales = 100 )
      ( period = 'Feb' sales = 120 )
      ( period = 'Mär' sales = 90 )
    ).

    update_sales_data( mt_current_sales ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_sales_data.
    mo_chart_engine->clear_series( ).
    mo_chart_engine->clear_category_labels( ).

    mt_current_sales = it_new_sales.

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Dynamische Verkaufsentwicklung' ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).
    mo_chart_engine->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        series_name = 'Verkäufe'
        data_values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_sales.
    rt_sales = mt_current_sales.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_stacked_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.

    mt_chart_data = get_stacked_data( ).

      DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN mt_chart_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_data-carrid ) WHERE ( flight_type = lv_flight_type )

          data_values = lt_values

    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_type = 'Business' num_flights = 20 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_type = 'Economy' num_flights = 70 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_type = 'Business' num_flights = 30 )

    CREATE OBJECT mo_dock_top
      EXPORTING
        repid                       = sy-repid

        extension                   = 500 " Höhe

        extension                   = 500 " Höhe

      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Custom containers inside docking containers
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_top
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dock_top
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_bottom
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dock_bottom
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Set initial ratio (e.g., 50% for top, 50% for bottom)
    set_split_ratio( 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_split_ratio.
    IF mo_dock_top IS BOUND.
      mo_dock_top->set_ratio( iv_ratio ).

hint: Berechnen Sie die Auslastung als `(SEATS_OCC - SEATS_FREE) / SEATS_OCC`. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation und String Templates für den Titel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             occupancy_rate TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_occupancy.
    TYPES: tt_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    DATA mt_occupancy_data   TYPE tt_occupancy.

    METHODS display_occupancy_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS get_occupancy_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_occupancy_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mt_occupancy_data = get_occupancy_data( ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_data IN mt_occupancy_data ( ls_data-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_values)     = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values( FOR ls_data IN mt_occupancy_data ( ls_data-occupancy_rate ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( |Durchschnittliche Flugauslastung ({ sy-datum DATE = USER })| ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).
    mo_chart_engine->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        series_name = 'Auslastung (%)'
        data_values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_occupancy_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsfree FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = REDUCE tt_occupancy(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_occupancy( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET total_occupied = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc - <fs_flight>-seatsfree )
          total_seats    = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
          occupancy      = COND p( WHEN total_seats > 0 THEN ( total_occupied * 100 ) / total_seats ELSE 0 ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_occupancy( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid occupancy_rate = occupancy ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flights_per_month,
             month       TYPE string,
             num_flights TYPE i,

    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

    METHODS display_flights_by_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS get_flights_by_month RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_by_month) TYPE tt_flights_per_month.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_flights_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_by_month.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mt_chart_data = get_flights_by_month( ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-month ) ).
    DATA(lt_values)     = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-num_flights ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Monat' ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).
    mo_chart_engine->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        series_name = 'Flüge'
        data_values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_month.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_by_month = REDUCE tt_flights_per_month(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flights_per_month( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( month = substring( val = ls_flight-fldate off = 4 len = 2 ) )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flights_per_month( BASE result ( month = ls_flight-month num_flights = count( GROUP ls_flight ) ) )
    ).

    " Sort by month (numeric value)
    SORT rt_flights_per_month BY month ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_dynamic_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_dock_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_add_dynamic_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid                       = sy-repid
        dynnr                       = sy-dynnr
        side                        = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension                   = 300
        no_autodef_progid_dynnr     = abap_true
      EXCEPTIONS

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_dynamic_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
        parent         = mo_docking_container
      EXCEPTIONS

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_dynamic_container.

      CALL METHOD mo_dynamic_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS

          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Top 5 Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtflugpreis aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaggregation und Filterung.
hint: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtpreise mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR GROUPS OF`, sortieren Sie und verwenden Sie `FOR ... UP TO 5` zum Filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_top5_airlines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_total_price,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_airline_total_price.
    TYPES: tt_airline_total_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_total_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.
    DATA mt_chart_data       TYPE tt_airline_total_price.

    METHODS display_top5_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.
    METHODS get_top5_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_top5_data) TYPE tt_airline_total_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_top5_airlines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_top5_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mt_chart_data = get_top5_data( ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-carrid ) ).
    DATA(lt_values)     = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values( FOR ls_data IN mt_chart_data ( ls_data-total_price ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Top 5 Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtflugpreis' ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).
    mo_chart_engine->add_series(
      EXPORTING
        series_name = 'Gesamtpreis'
        data_values = lt_values
    ).
    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_top5_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE tt_airline_total_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_airline_total_price( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET sum_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_airline_total_price( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_price = sum_price ) )
    ).

    SORT lt_aggregated_data BY total_price DESCENDING.

    rt_top5_data = VALUE tt_airline_total_price( FOR ls_data IN lt_aggregated_data UP TO 5 ROWS ( ls_data ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top5_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top5_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_top5_airlines( ).
    DATA(lt_top5_data) = lo_cut->get_top5_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_top5_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_top5_data ) exp = 5 ).
    IF lines( lt_top5_data ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_top5_data[ 1 ]-total_price >= lt_top5_data[ 2 ]-total_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Aggregation, Sortierung und Filterung von Daten aus `sflights` mit moderner ABAP-Syntax, um die Top 5 Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtflugpreis zu ermitteln und in einem Diagramm darzustellen. `REDUCE` und `FOR GROUPS OF` werden für die Aggregation verwendet, gefolgt von `SORT` und `FOR ... UP TO 5 ROWS` für die Filterung. Der Unit Test validiert die korrekte Datenverarbeitung und die Begrenzung auf die Top 5 Einträge.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, das die Verteilung der Flugklassen (z.B. 'C', 'F', 'Y') pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung und eine fiktive Flugklassenzuordnung.
hint: Erstellen Sie fiktive Flugklassendaten und aggregieren Sie diese mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR GROUPS OF`.

CLASS zcl_chart_flight_classes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_class_data,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_class TYPE string,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_class_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_class_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_class_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_chart_engine     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine.

CLASS zcl_chart_flight_classes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_class_chart.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung hier
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    mt_chart_data = get_flight_class_data( ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN mt_chart_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_data-carrid ) ( ls_data-carrid ) ).

    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_stacked_bar ). " Stacked bar for classes per airline
    mo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flugklassenverteilung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    mo_chart_engine->set_category_labels( lt_categories ).

    DATA(lt_flight_classes) = VALUE string_table( FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN mt_chart_data GROUP BY ( flight_class = ls_data-flight_class ) ( ls_data-flight_class ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_classes INTO DATA(lv_flight_class).
      DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_values(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_data IN mt_chart_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_data-carrid ) WHERE ( flight_class = lv_flight_class )
        ( REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_data> IN GROUP ls_data NEXT s = s + <fs_data>-num_flights ) )
      ).
      mo_chart_engine->add_series(
        EXPORTING
          series_name = lv_flight_class
          data_values = lt_values
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_class_data.
    " Fiktive Daten für Flugklassenverteilung
    rt_flight_class_data = VALUE tt_flight_class_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_class = 'Economy' num_flights = 40 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_class = 'Business' num_flights = 10 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' flight_class = 'First' num_flights = 5 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_class = 'Economy' num_flights = 60 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_class = 'Business' num_flights = 25 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' flight_class = 'First' num_flights = 10 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' flight_class = 'Economy' num_flights = 35 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' flight_class = 'Business' num_flights = 12 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' flight_class = 'First' num_flights = 3 )
    ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Bestellstatus (Neu, In Bearbeitung, Versandt, Abgeschlossen, Storniert) und schreiben Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Status eine Beschreibung zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `ENUM` Syntax und `CASE TYPE OF` für die Statusprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM order_status,
             new         TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
             in_process  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
             shipped     TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'S',
             completed   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
             cancelled   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',
           END OF ENUM order_status.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE order_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN order_status-new.
        rv_description = 'Neue Bestellung'.
      WHEN order_status-in_process.
        rv_description = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN order_status-shipped.
        rv_description = 'Versandt'.
      WHEN order_status-completed.
        rv_description = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN order_status-cancelled.
        rv_description = 'Storniert'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Status von Aufgaben (Offen, In Bearbeitung, Erledigt). Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Aufgaben, die ein Statusfeld vom Typ der Enumeration enthält. Filtern Sie diese Tabelle, um nur Aufgaben mit einem bestimmten Status zu erhalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `ENUM` Syntax und den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_task_filter_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM task_status,
             open        TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'O',
             in_progress TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
             done        TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'D',
           END OF ENUM task_status.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE task_status,
             desc   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES: ty_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_tasks
      IMPORTING
        it_all_tasks TYPE ty_tasks
        iv_filter_status TYPE task_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_tasks) TYPE ty_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_task_filter_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_tasks.
    rt_filtered_tasks = FILTER #( it_all_tasks WHERE status = iv_filter_status ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_open_tasks FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_done_tasks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_open_tasks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_task_filter_enum( ).
    DATA(lt_all_tasks) = VALUE zcl_task_filter_enum=>ty_tasks(
      ( id = 1 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-open desc = 'Task 1' )
      ( id = 2 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-in_progress desc = 'Task 2' )
      ( id = 3 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-open desc = 'Task 3' )
      ( id = 4 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-done desc = 'Task 4' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_tasks(
      it_all_tasks = lt_all_tasks
      iv_filter_status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-open
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_done_tasks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_task_filter_enum( ).
    DATA(lt_all_tasks) = VALUE zcl_task_filter_enum=>ty_tasks(
      ( id = 1 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-open desc = 'Task 1' )
      ( id = 2 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-in_progress desc = 'Task 2' )
      ( id = 3 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-open desc = 'Task 3' )
      ( id = 4 status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-done desc = 'Task 4' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_tasks(
      it_all_tasks = lt_all_tasks
      iv_filter_status = zcl_task_filter_enum=>task_status-done
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Enumerationen mit dem `FILTER` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare Filterung von internen Tabellen basierend auf typsicheren Statuswerten. Dies ist wesentlich moderner und effizienter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte.

CLASS zcl_weekday_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die eine lokale Textdatei (z.B. eine Log-Datei) in einem `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` anzeigt. Die Datei soll dynamisch erstellt und dann im Viewer geladen werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox` und die Methode `set_url` oder `set_data` nach dem Speichern der Datei im Dateisystem.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_file_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_local_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_content TYPE string
        iv_file_name    TYPE string DEFAULT 'temp_log.txt'.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_ecl_viewer     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_file_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_local_file.
    DATA: lv_temp_path TYPE string,
          lv_full_path TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_temp_directory(
      CHANGING
        temp_directory = lv_temp_path
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Could not get temp directory' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_full_path = lv_temp_path && `\` && iv_file_name.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename = lv_full_path
        filetype = 'ASC'
        CHANGING
          data_tab = VALUE string_table( ( iv_file_content ) )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Could not download file' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_ecl_viewer
        EXPORTING
          parent = mo_custom_container.
    ENDIF.

    mo_ecl_viewer->set_url( lv_full_path ).
    mo_ecl_viewer->do_display( ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    " Optional: Datei nach Anzeige löschen
    " cl_gui_frontend_services=>delete_file( filename = lv_full_path ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_local_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_local_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_file_display( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = `Dies ist ein Test-Log-Eintrag.`.
    DATA(lv_file_name) = `test_log_` && sy-uzeit && `.txt`.

    " Da GUI-Interaktionen (Dateidownload, Viewer-Anzeige) nicht direkt im Unit-Test
    " ausgeführt werden können, wird hier nur der Aufruf der Methode geprüft.
    " In einer realen Umgebung müsste man die Frontend-Services mocken oder
    " einen Integrationstest durchführen.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_local_file( iv_file_content = lv_content iv_file_name = lv_file_name ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Method call should not raise exception' ).
    CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception occurred during display_local_file call' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend wird der Pfad der Datei an die Methode `set_url` des Viewers übergeben. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um dynamisch generierte Dokumente oder Berichte anzuzeigen.

Instructions: Erstelle eine einfache Baumstruktur, die Fluggesellschaften und deren Verbindungen aus der Tabelle `sflights` anzeigt. Die Baumstruktur soll die Fluggesellschaften als Wurzelknoten und deren Flugverbindungen als Kindknoten darstellen.
hint: Nutze `cl_gui_simple_tree` und fülle die Knoten mit Daten aus `sflights`. Beachte, dass für einen Unit Test die GUI-Instanzierung simuliert werden muss.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree)    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS create_nodes_from_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflight_tree.
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      " For unit testing or headless scenarios, create a dummy container
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    ELSE.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    create_nodes_from_sflights( ).

    ro_tree = mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_nodes_from_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY sflight-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      DATA(lv_carrier_node_key) = |CARRIER_{ lv_carrier }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = ''
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
        i_text = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrier }|
      ).

      DATA(lt_connections) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrier ) GROUP BY sflight-connid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-connid ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(lv_connection).

Instructions: Erweitere die Baumstruktur aus dem ersten Beispiel, indem du Icons und Tooltips für die Knoten hinzufügst, um die Informationen visuell ansprechender zu gestalten.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_sflight_tree_with_icons
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree)    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS create_nodes_with_icons_from_sflights.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_icons IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflight_tree_with_icons.
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_ICONS' ).
    ELSE.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    create_nodes_with_icons_from_sflights( ).

    ro_tree = mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_nodes_with_icons_from_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY sflight-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      DATA(lv_carrier_node_key) = |CARRIER_{ lv_carrier }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = ''
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
        i_text = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrier }|
        i_exp_image = icon_airplane
        i_coll_image = icon_airplane
        i_tooltip = |Details zu { lv_carrier }|
      ).

      DATA(lt_connections) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrier ) GROUP BY sflight-connid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-connid ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(lv_connection).
        DATA(lv_connection_node_key) = |CONN_{ lv_carrier }_{ lv_connection }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_connection_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text = |Verbindung: { lv_connection }|
          i_exp_image = icon_flight
          i_coll_image = icon_flight
          i_tooltip = |Flugverbindung { lv_connection } von { lv_carrier }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die dynamisch neue Knoten zu einer bestehenden Baumstruktur hinzufügt, basierend auf einer Liste von Daten. Dies soll die Möglichkeit bieten, den Baum zur Laufzeit zu erweitern.
hint: Nutze die Methode `add_node` oder `add_nodes` von `cl_gui_simple_tree` und übergebe die Parent-Node-Key.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_initial_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree)    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    METHODS add_flight_nodes
      IMPORTING
        io_tree           TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree
        iv_carrier_node_key TYPE string
        it_flights        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_initial_tree.
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_DYNAMIC' ).
    ELSE.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    " Add a root node for all flights
    ro_tree->add_node(
      i_node_key = 'ROOT_FLIGHTS'
      i_relat_node_key = ''
      i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
      i_text = 'Alle Flüge'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_nodes.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_flight_node_key) = |FLIGHT_{ ls_flight-carrid }_{ ls_flight-connid }_{ ls_flight-fldate }|.
      io_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_flight_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = iv_carrier_node_key
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text = |Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }|
        i_tooltip = |Flug von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { ls_flight-cityto }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simuliere die Verarbeitung einer Knotenauswahl in einem Baum, indem du die ID des ausgewählten Knotens ermittelst und entsprechende Daten (z.B. Flugdetails aus `sflights`) abrufst. Der Fokus liegt auf der Logik, die nach einer Auswahl ausgeführt wird.
hint: Die Methode `get_selected_node` von `cl_gui_simple_tree` liefert den Key des ausgewählten Knotens. Nutze diesen Key, um Daten zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details_for_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details_for_node.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
          lv_connid TYPE sflight-connid,
          lv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate.

    IF iv_node_key CS 'FLIGHT_'.
      DATA(lv_temp_key) = REPLACE( val = iv_node_key old = 'FLIGHT_' new = '' ).
      SPLIT lv_temp_key AT '_' INTO lv_carrid lv_connid lv_fldate.

      READ TABLE mt_sflights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleiche zwei numerische Werte, die als Strings vorliegen, unter Berücksichtigung ihrer korrekten numerischen Interpretation und möglicher Formatierungen. Gib an, ob der erste Wert größer, kleiner oder gleich dem zweiten ist.
hint: Verwende `parse_number` von `/ui2/cl_number`, um die Strings in numerische Typen umzuwandeln, bevor du sie vergleichst.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_comparison_result,
             is_greater TYPE abap_bool,
             is_less    TYPE abap_bool,
             is_equal   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_comparison_result.

    METHODS compare_formatted_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE string
        iv_value2 TYPE string
        iv_decimal_separator TYPE c OPTIONAL
        iv_thousand_separator TYPE c OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_comparison_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_formatted_numbers.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ).

    DATA(lv_num1) = lo_parser->parse_number(
      iv_value             = iv_value1
      iv_decimal_separator = iv_decimal_separator
      iv_thousand_separator = iv_thousand_separator
    ).

    DATA(lv_num2) = lo_parser->parse_number(
      iv_value             = iv_value2
      iv_decimal_separator = iv_decimal_separator
      iv_thousand_separator = iv_thousand_separator
    ).

    IF lv_num1 > lv_num2.
      rs_result-is_greater = abap_true.
    ELSEIF lv_num1 < lv_num2.
      rs_result-is_less = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rs_result-is_equal = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
