Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die die Sichtbarkeit von Baumknoten basierend auf einem Filterkriterium steuert. Dies ist nützlich, um große Bäume zu durchsuchen oder irrelevante Informationen auszublenden.
hint: Nutze die Methode `set_node_visible` von `cl_gui_simple_tree`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_and_filter_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_filter_text    TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree)    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mt_all_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_nodes.

    METHODS create_all_sflight_nodes.
    METHODS apply_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_and_filter_tree.
    IF iv_container_name IS INITIAL.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_FILTER' ).
    ELSE.
      mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( iv_container_name ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_simple_tree(
      i_parent = mo_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
    ).

    create_all_sflight_nodes( ).

    IF iv_filter_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      apply_filter( iv_filter_text ).
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_all_sflight_nodes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY sflight-carrid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      DATA(lv_carrier_node_key) = |CARRIER_{ lv_carrier }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = ''
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
        i_text = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrier }|
      ).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_all_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      <fs_node>-node_key = lv_carrier_node_key.
      <fs_node>-text = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrier }|.

      DATA(lt_connections) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = lv_carrier ) GROUP BY sflight-connid ASCENDING AS GROUP ( sflight-connid ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(lv_connection).
        DATA(lv_connection_node_key) = |CONN_{ lv_carrier }_{ lv_connection }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_connection_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text = |Verbindung: { lv_connection }|
        ).
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO mt_all_nodes ASSIGNING <fs_node>.
        <fs_node>-node_key = lv_connection_node_key.
        <fs_node>-text = |Verbindung: { lv_connection }|.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_filter.
    LOOP AT mt_all_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      DATA(lv_is_visible) = abap_false.
      IF ls_node-text CS iv_filter_text.
        lv_is_visible = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      mo_tree->set_node_visible( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_visible = lv_is_visible ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatiere eine Zahl als Währung, aber ohne das Währungssymbol, nur mit den korrekten Dezimal- und Tausendertrennzeichen für eine bestimmte Währung.
hint: Nutze `format_currency` von `/ui2/cl_number` und manipuliere das Ergebnis oder prüfe auf einen Parameter, der das Symbol unterdrückt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui2_number_currency_no_sym DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_currency_no_symbol
      IMPORTING
        iv_value    TYPE decfloat34
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
        iv_decimals TYPE i OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui2_number_currency_no_sym IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_currency_no_symbol.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW /ui2/cl_number( ).

    DATA(lv_formatted_with_symbol) = lo_formatter->format_currency(
      iv_value     = iv_value
      iv_currency  = iv_currency
      iv_decimals  = iv_decimals
    ).

    " Remove currency symbol using string templates and regex (modern approach)
    DATA(lv_currency_symbol) = lo_formatter->get_currency_symbol( iv_currency = iv_currency ).

    rv_formatted_string = REPLACE( val = lv_formatted_with_symbol regex = lv_currency_symbol new = '' occ = 0 ).
    rv_formatted_string = COND string( WHEN rv_formatted_string CS ` ` THEN REPLACE( val = rv_formatted_string old = ` ` new = '' occ = 1 ) ELSE rv_formatted_string ).
    rv_formatted_string = COND string( WHEN rv_formatted_string CS ` ` THEN REPLACE( val = rv_formatted_string old = ` ` new = '' occ = 1 ) ELSE rv_formatted_string ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

      act = lv_in_range_count
      exp = lv_test_count
      msg = 'All generated numbers should be within the specified range'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_shuffle_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_temp_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_with_rand(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 1000000 ) " Assign a random key
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price = ls_flight-price
        currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

    SORT lt_temp_flights BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_temp_flight IN lt_temp_flights
      ( carrid = ls_temp_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_temp_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_temp_flight-fldate
        price = ls_temp_flight-price
        currency = ls_temp_flight-currency )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lt_original_flights) = lcl_test_data=>get_sflight_data( ).
    DATA(lv_original_hash) = cl_abap_hasher=>hash_table( lt_original_flights ).

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_flights ).

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.

CLASS zcl_generate_random_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY VALUE #( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' ) ( 'BA' ) ).

      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
      ( carrid   = lc_carrids[ lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( lc_carrids ) ) ]
        connid   = |{ lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 9999 ) ALPHA = OUT }|
        fldate   = |2025{ lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 12 ) ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }{ lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 28 ) ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }|
        price    = lo_random->get_next( min = 50 max = 1000 ) + lo_random->get_next_float( )
        currency = lc_currencies[ lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = lines( lc_currencies ) ) ] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) mit einer 50/50-Wahrscheinlichkeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random=>create()` und `get_next_float()` in Kombination mit einer `IF`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS flip_coin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next_float( ).

    IF lv_random_value < 0.5.
      rv_result = 'Kopf'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Zahl'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_coin_flip_distribution FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip_distribution.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_coin_flip( ).
    DATA(lv_test_count) = 10000.
    DATA(lv_heads_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_tails_count) = 0.

    DO lv_test_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = 'Kopf'.
        lv_heads_count = lv_heads_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = 'Zahl'.
        lv_tails_count = lv_tails_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_heads_count + lv_tails_count
      exp = lv_test_count
      msg = 'Total flips count mismatch'
    ).

    " Assert that the distribution is roughly 50/50 (within a tolerance)
    DATA(lv_expected_half) = lv_test_count / 2.
    DATA(lv_tolerance) = lv_test_count * 0.05. " 5% tolerance

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_heads_count GE ( lv_expected_half - lv_tolerance ) AND
              lv_heads_count LE ( lv_expected_half + lv_tolerance ) )
      msg = 'Heads count is not within expected 50% range'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_tails_count GE ( lv_expected_half - lv_tolerance ) AND
              lv_tails_count LE ( lv_expected_half + lv_tolerance ) )
      msg = 'Tails count is not within expected 50% range'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Simulation eines Münzwurfs ist ein klassisches Beispiel für die Anwendung von Zufallszahlen in der bedingten Logik. `cl_abap_random=>get_next_float()` liefert einen Wert zwischen 0 und 1, der dann einfach mit 0.5 verglichen werden kann, um die 50/50-Wahrscheinlichkeit zu realisieren.
keywords: Random, Conditional Logic, Coin Flip, Probability, cl_abap_random

Instructions: Teilen Sie eine Liste von Elementen zufällig in zwei Gruppen auf.

solution:
TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_randomly
      IMPORTING
        it_elements TYPE ty_string_table
      EXPORTING
        et_group1 TYPE ty_string_table
        et_group2 TYPE ty_string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_randomly.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_grouped_elements) = VALUE ty_string_table(
      FOR ls_element IN it_elements
      ( COND string(
          WHEN lo_random->get_next_float( ) < 0.5 THEN 'GROUP1'
          ELSE 'GROUP2' )
        && ls_element ) ). " Temporarily store group and element

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_elements INTO DATA(lv_grouped_element).
      IF lv_grouped_element CS 'GROUP1'.
        et_group1 = VALUE #(
          BASE et_group1
          ( lv_grouped_element+6 ) ). " Extract element after 'GROUP1'
      ELSE.
        et_group2 = VALUE #(
          BASE et_group2
          ( lv_grouped_element+6 ) ). " Extract element after 'GROUP2'
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_grouping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_grouping_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_elements) = VALUE ty_string_table(
      ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ( 'Date' ) ( 'Elderberry' )
      ( 'Fig' ) ( 'Grape' ) ( 'Honeydew' ) ( 'Kiwi' ) ( 'Lemon' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_group1) TYPE ty_string_table.
    DATA(lt_group2) TYPE ty_string_table.

    lo_cut->group_randomly(
      EXPORTING
        it_elements = lt_elements
      IMPORTING
        et_group1 = lt_group1
        et_group2 = lt_group2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_group1 ) + lines( lt_group2 )
      exp = lines( lt_elements )
      msg = 'All elements should be distributed into groups'
    ).

    " Check that elements are unique within their groups and not duplicated across groups
    DATA(lt_all_grouped_elements) = VALUE ty_string_table( BASE lt_group1 ( LINES OF lt_group2 ) ).
    SORT lt_all_grouped_elements ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_all_grouped_elements.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_all_grouped_elements )
      exp = lines( lt_elements )
      msg = 'All elements should be unique and present once'
    ).

    " Probabilistic check: groups should not be empty (unless input is small)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_group1 ) > 0 AND lines( lt_group2 ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Both groups should ideally not be empty for a reasonable input size'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_grouping_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_elements) TYPE ty_string_table.
    DATA(lt_group1) TYPE ty_string_table.
    DATA(lt_group2) TYPE ty_string_table.

    lo_cut->group_randomly(
      EXPORTING
        it_elements = lt_elements
      IMPORTING
        et_group1 = lt_group1
        et_group2 = lt_group2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_group1 )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Group 1 should be empty for empty input'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_group2 )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Group 2 should be empty for empty input'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt `cl_abap_random=>get_next_float()` innerhalb eines `FOR` Ausdrucks, um jedem Element zufällig eine Gruppenzugehörigkeit zuzuweisen. Obwohl `GROUP BY` hier nicht direkt für die Zuweisung verwendet wird, demonstriert es die flexible Kombination von Zufallszahlen mit modernen Schleifen- und Zuweisungsoperatoren, um Daten dynamisch zu verteilen.
keywords: Random, Grouping, cl_abap_random, FOR, VALUE, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein sicheres, zufälliges Passwort mit einer Mischung aus Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben, Zahlen und Sonderzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random` und definieren Sie verschiedene Zeichensätze für die Passwortkomponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_password_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
        iv_min_upper TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_min_lower TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_min_digit TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_min_special TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_password_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_upper   TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_lower   TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_digits  TYPE string VALUE '0123456789'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_special TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|;:,.<>/?'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_all_chars TYPE string VALUE lc_upper && lc_lower && lc_digits && lc_special.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_all_chars_len) = strlen( lc_all_chars ).

    IF iv_length < iv_min_upper + iv_min_lower + iv_min_digit + iv_min_special.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arith_errors
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Password length is too short for minimum character requirements.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_password_chars) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF c LENGTH 1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Add minimum required characters
    DO iv_min_upper TIMES.
      APPEND lc_upper+lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = strlen( lc_upper ) - 1 )(1) TO lt_password_chars.
    ENDDO.
    DO iv_min_lower TIMES.
      APPEND lc_lower+lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = strlen( lc_lower ) - 1 )(1) TO lt_password_chars.
    ENDDO.
    DO iv_min_digit TIMES.
      APPEND lc_digits+lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = strlen( lc_digits ) - 1 )(1) TO lt_password_chars.
    ENDDO.
    DO iv_min_special TIMES.
      APPEND lc_special+lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = strlen( lc_special ) - 1 )(1) TO lt_password_chars.
    ENDDO.

    " Fill remaining length with random characters from all sets
    DATA(lv_remaining_length) = iv_length - lines( lt_password_chars ).
    DO lv_remaining_length TIMES.
      APPEND lc_all_chars+lo_random->get_next( min = 0 max = lv_all_chars_len - 1 )(1) TO lt_password_chars.
    ENDDO.

    " Shuffle the characters to ensure randomness of position
    DATA(lt_shuffled_chars) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF c LENGTH 1 WITH EMPTY KEY(
      FOR ls_char IN lt_password_chars
      ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( min = 1 max = 1000000 ) " Assign a random key
        char = ls_char ) ).
    SORT lt_shuffled_chars BY random_key.

    rv_password = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR ls_char IN lt_shuffled_chars ( s && ls_char-char ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_password_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_password_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_password_min_requirements FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_generate_password_too_short FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arith_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_password_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 16.
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = lv_length ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = strlen( lv_password )
      exp = lv_length
      msg = 'Generated password has incorrect length'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_password_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 20 ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_upper   TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_lower   TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_digits  TYPE string VALUE '0123456789'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_special TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|;:,.<>/?'.

    DATA(lv_has_upper) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_lower) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_digit) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_special) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lv_password INTO DATA(lc_char).
      IF lc_upper CS lc_char.
        lv_has_upper = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_lower CS lc_char.
        lv_has_lower = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_digits CS lc_char.
        lv_has_digit = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_special CS lc_char.
        lv_has_special = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_upper msg = 'Password should contain uppercase' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_lower msg = 'Password should contain lowercase' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_digit msg = 'Password should contain digits' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_special msg = 'Password should contain special characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_password_min_requirements.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password(
      iv_length = 10
      iv_min_upper = 2
      iv_min_lower = 2
      iv_min_digit = 2
      iv_min_special = 2
    ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_upper   TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_lower   TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_digits  TYPE string VALUE '0123456789'.
    CONSTANTS: lc_special TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|;:,.<>/?'.

    DATA(lv_upper_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_lower_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_digit_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_special_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lv_password INTO DATA(lc_char).
      IF lc_upper CS lc_char.
        lv_upper_count = lv_upper_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lc_lower CS lc_char.
        lv_lower_count = lv_lower_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lc_digits CS lc_char.
        lv_digit_count = lv_digit_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lc_special CS lc_char.
        lv_special_count = lv_special_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_upper_count GE 2 ) msg = 'Not enough uppercase chars' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_lower_count GE 2 ) msg = 'Not enough lowercase chars' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_digit_count GE 2 ) msg = 'Not enough digit chars' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_special_count GE 2 ) msg = 'Not enough special chars' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_password_too_short.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_class_name = 'CX_SY_ARITH_ERRORS'
      RAISING
        lo_cut->generate_password(
          iv_length = 5
          iv_min_upper = 2
          iv_min_lower = 2
          iv_min_digit = 2
          iv_min_special = 2
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Generierung sicherer Passwörter erfordert eine Kombination aus verschiedenen Zeichentypen. `cl_abap_random` wird verwendet, um zufällige Zeichen aus vordefinierten Zeichensätzen auszuwählen und die Reihenfolge der Zeichen zu mischen, um die Vorhersagbarkeit zu minimieren. `REDUCE` wird für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet.
keywords: Random, Password, Security, String, cl_abap_random, REDUCE

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa), die noch mindestens 50 freie Plätze haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
      AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 50 ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights belong to 'LH' and have at least 50 free seats
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 50 msg = 'Not enough free seats' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that at least one flight is found (assuming test data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und prägnante Filterung interner Tabellen. Die Bedingungen werden direkt im Operator angegeben, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` in eine neue Tabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP, Functional Programming, IF

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Available', 'Full', 'Cancelled') basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Plätze (mehr als 0 = 'Available', 0 = 'Full') und einem Stornierungsflag (falls 'X' = 'Cancelled').
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator für konditionelle Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seats_free TYPE i
        iv_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_cancelled = abap_true THEN 'Cancelled'
      WHEN iv_seats_free > 0       THEN 'Available'
      WHEN iv_seats_free = 0       THEN 'Full'
      ELSE 'Unknown' " Fallback for unexpected cases
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_free = 10 iv_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Available' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_free = 0 iv_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_free = 5 iv_cancelled = abap_true ) exp = 'Cancelled' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seats_free = -1 iv_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Unknown' ). " Test fallback
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ersetzt komplexe `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Strukturen durch einen einzigen Ausdruck, der einen Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zurückgibt. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und ermöglicht die direkte Zuweisung des Ergebnisses.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, IF, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und das Flugdatum von Flügen enthält, die in der Zukunft liegen (nach dem heutigen Datum) und noch mindestens 10 freie Plätze haben.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `FILTER` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_available_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_available_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #(
        lt_all_flights
        WHERE fldate > lv_today
        AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= 10
      )
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_map_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_available_flights( ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights are in the future and have enough free seats
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary-fldate > sy-datum msg = 'Flight not in future' ).
      " Cannot directly assert free seats here as it's not in the summary structure.
      " This test assumes the filter logic is correct based on the solution.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that at least one flight is found (assuming test data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No future available flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE #( FOR ... IN FILTER #( ... ) ( ... ) )` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, dann werden die gefilterten Einträge in eine neue Struktur gemappt.
keywords: FOR, FILTER, VALUE, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP, Functional Programming, IF

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie Flüge in 'Kurzstrecke' (Flugdauer <= 120 Min), 'Mittelstrecke' (Flugdauer > 120 Min und <= 360 Min) oder 'Langstrecke' (Flugdauer > 360 Min). Nehmen Sie an, die Flugdauer ist in Minuten gegeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_flight_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_duration_min TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_range) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_flight_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_range.
    rv_range = SWITCH string( iv_flight_duration_min
      WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN 'Kurzstrecke'
      WHEN BETWEEN 121 AND 360 THEN 'Mittelstrecke'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Langstrecke'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_flight_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 60 ) exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 120 ) exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 180 ) exp = 'Mittelstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 360 ) exp = 'Mittelstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 400 ) exp = 'Langstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_range( 0 ) exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF ... ELSE IF` Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Er ist kompakter und besser lesbar.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, IF, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der `sflight`-Tabelle, die von 'AA' (American Airlines) durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum nach dem heutigen Datum liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `WHERE` und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_aa_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_aa_flights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
        AND fldate > @lv_today
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_aa_flights( ).

    " Assert that all selected flights belong to 'AA' and are in the future
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum msg = 'Flight not in future' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that at least one flight is found (assuming test data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No future AA flights found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne `SELECT` Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) und dem `@`-Zeichen für Host-Variablen macht den Datenbankzugriff wesentlich schlanker und lesbarer. Die `WHERE`-Klausel dient hier als implizite Filterung, ähnlich einer `IF`-Bedingung auf Datenbankebene.
keywords: SELECT, WHERE, Database Access, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP, IF

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, deren Flugpreis (Fahrpreis) zwischen 100 und 500 liegt (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Bereichsbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flügen basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Kriterium (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) filtert. Die Filterbedingung soll als Methode übergeben werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem Prädikat, das eine Methode referenziert. Nutzen Sie das Interface `IF_ABAP_PREDICATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    INTERFACES if_abap_predicate. " For method predicate

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        io_predicate TYPE REF TO if_abap_predicate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_simple.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier_predicate
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.

    DATA mv_dynamic_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid. " For dynamic carrier in predicate
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #(
        it_flights
        USING KEY default
        WHERE ( io_predicate->if_abap_predicate~execute( ls_flight ) = abap_true )
      )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_carrier_predicate.
    rv_result = COND abap_bool( WHEN is_flight-carrid = mv_dynamic_carrier THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  " Implementation of the interface method
  METHOD if_abap_predicate~execute.
    DATA(ls_flight) = CAST sflight( iv_value ). " Cast to actual type
    rv_result = filter_by_carrier_predicate( ls_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    " Set dynamic filter criterion
    lo_cut->mv_dynamic_carrier = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamic( it_flights = lt_test_flights io_predicate = lo_cut ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_lh ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect count for LH' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_lh INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch for LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_cut->mv_dynamic_carrier = 'AA'.
    DATA(lt_result_aa) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamic( it_flights = lt_test_flights io_predicate = lo_cut ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_aa ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect count for AA' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_aa INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch for AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht eine hochflexible und dynamische Filterung, bei der die Filterlogik zur Laufzeit übergeben werden kann. Das Interface `IF_ABAP_PREDICATE` standardisiert die Übergabe von Prädikaten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der freien Plätze nur für Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH', die noch nicht ausgebucht sind (d.h. freie Plätze > 0).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_free_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_free_seats_lh
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_free_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_free_seats_lh.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > 0
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_free_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_free_seats_lh( ).

    " Assert that the result is not negative (should be 0 or positive)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result >= 0 msg = 'Total free seats cannot be negative' ).

    " Assert a specific value if test data is controlled, otherwise check for non-zero if expected
    " For example, if you know there are LH flights with free seats:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_result > 0 msg = 'Expected more than 0 free seats for LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks fungiert als `IF`-Bedingung, die bestimmt, welche Elemente in die Aggregation einbezogen werden. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Summen oder andere Aggregationen zu berechnen.
keywords: REDUCE, IF, Grouping, Math, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug der Fluggesellschaft 'SQ' (Singapore Airlines) die Flugnummer enthält, wenn mehr als 100 freie Plätze vorhanden sind, andernfalls einen leeren Eintrag ('').
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und einer `COND`-Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_cond_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_connids_sq
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_cond_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_connids_sq.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'SQ'
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_connids = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      ( COND ty_connid(
          WHEN ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > 100 THEN ls_flight-connid
          ELSE ''
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Für jeden Eintrag der Quelltabelle wird eine `COND`-Expression ausgewertet, die basierend auf einer `IF`-ähnlichen Bedingung entweder den tatsächlichen Wert oder einen Standardwert (hier ein leerer String) zurückgibt. Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die Flüge mit mehr als 50 freien Plätzen anbieten. Die Ausgabe soll eine Tabelle von Fluggesellschafts-IDs sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` Logik, um eindeutige Werte zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_carriers_with_free_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_with_free_seats.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN FILTER #(
        lt_all_flights
        WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 50
      ) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_carriers_with_free_seats( ).

    " Assert that the result table contains unique carrier IDs
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = lt_result.
    SORT lt_unique_check BY table_line.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_unique_check ) msg = 'Result contains duplicate carriers' ).

    " Assert that at least one carrier is found (assuming test data exists)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No carriers found with free seats' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um Daten zu filtern und gleichzeitig eindeutige Werte oder Aggregationen zu erhalten. Zuerst werden die Flüge nach der Bedingung 'mehr als 50 freie Plätze' gefiltert, und dann werden die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften aus den gefilterten Ergebnissen extrahiert. Dies ersetzt komplexe `LOOP` und `COLLECT` oder `SORT` und `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` Muster.
keywords: FILTER, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Modern ABAP, Functional Programming, IF, Unique

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugnummern. Wenn ein Flug der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' (Delta Airlines) mehr als 200 freie Plätze hat, soll seine Flugnummer hinzugefügt werden. Andernfalls, wenn er weniger als 50 freie Plätze hat, soll 'OVERBOOKED' hinzugefügt werden. Für alle anderen Flüge soll nichts hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und einer `SWITCH`-Expression, um bedingt Einträge zu erzeugen oder zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_switch_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_status_connid TYPE string.
    TYPES tt_status_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_conditional_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_list) TYPE tt_status_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_switch_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_flight_status.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'DL'
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_status_list = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc IN
      ( SWITCH ty_status_connid(
          WHEN lv_free_seats > 200 THEN ls_flight-connid
          WHEN lv_free_seats < 50  THEN 'OVERBOOKED'
          ELSE THROW cx_abap_anonymous_exception( ) " Skip entry by throwing exception
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_conditional_flight_status( ).

    " Assert that the result table is not empty (assuming DL flights exist)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = abap_false msg = 'No DL flights processed' ).

    " Assert that entries are either valid connids or 'OVERBOOKED'
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(lv_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_entry IS NOT INITIAL OR lv_entry = 'OVERBOOKED' ) msg = 'Invalid entry in result table' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

( SWITCH ... ) )` mit einer `THROW` Anweisung im `ELSE`-Zweig des `SWITCH` Operators ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik, um bedingt Einträge in einer neuen internen Tabelle zu erzeugen oder zu überspringen. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr präzise Kontrolle über die Tabellenkonstruktion basierend auf komplexen `IF`-ähnlichen Bedingungen.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_cond IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_CALCULATOR` mit einer Methode `divide`, die zwei Zahlen dividiert. Behandeln Sie den Fall der Division durch Null, indem Sie eine Exception auslösen.

INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS divide
    IMPORTING
      iv_numerator   TYPE i
      iv_denominator TYPE i
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
    RAISING
      cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_calculator.

CLASS zcl_simple_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode `divide` führt eine Division durch und verwendet eine explizite Prüfung auf Division durch Null, um eine `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR` auszulösen, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Ergebnis einer sukzessiven Division einer Liste von Zahlen (z.B. `( ( (100 / 2) / 5) / 2 )`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck, um die Liste zu verarbeiten. Beachten Sie die Reihenfolge der Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_successive_division
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_successive_division.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input table cannot be empty.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_initial_value) = CONV f( it_numbers[ 1 ] ).
    DELETE it_numbers INDEX 1. " Remove first element as it's the initial value

    rv_result = REDUCE f(
      INIT result = lv_initial_value
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        result = COND f(
          WHEN number = 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Division by zero encountered.'
          ELSE
            result / number
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successive_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successive_division.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_reduce_divider( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 2 ) ( 5 ) ( 2 ) ). " 100 / 2 / 5 / 2 = 5
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_reducer->calculate_successive_division( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 20 ) ( 4 ) ). " 20 / 4 = 5
    lv_result = lo_reducer->calculate_successive_division( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält. Fügen Sie ein neues Feld `occupancy_rate` hinzu, das das Ergebnis der Division von `SEATSCC` (belegte Sitze) durch `SEATSOCC` (Gesamtsitze) darstellt. Behandeln Sie Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` und einer Inline-Bedingung für die Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
        carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate         TYPE s_date,
        seatsocc       TYPE s_seatsocc,
        seatsmax       TYPE s_seatsmax,
        occupancy_rate TYPE f,
      END OF ty_flight_occupancy,
      tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_occupancy = VALUE tt_flight_occupancy(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      (
        carrid         = ls_flight-carrid
        connid         = ls_flight-connid
        fldate         = ls_flight-fldate
        seatsocc       = ls_flight-seatsocc
        seatsmax       = ls_flight-seatsmax
        occupancy_rate = COND f(
                           WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax = 0 THEN 0 " Handle division by zero
                           ELSE CONV f( ls_flight-seatsocc ) / ls_flight-seatsmax
                         )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode `perform_operation` besitzt. Diese Methode soll dynamisch eine andere Methode (z.B. `divide_numbers`) aufrufen, die eine Division durchführt. Der Name der aufzurufenden Methode wird als String übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name)` für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param1      TYPE i
        iv_param2      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_dynamic_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error,
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lo_exception TYPE REF TO cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
    DATA: lv_result_f TYPE f.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(iv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_numerator   = iv_param1
            iv_denominator = iv_param2
          RECEIVING
            rv_result      = lv_result_f.
        rv_dynamic_result = lv_result_f.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lo_exception.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lo_exception->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Catch and re-raise for consistency
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Arithmetic error during dynamic call.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Dabei soll ein Feld in der Zielstruktur das Ergebnis einer Division zweier Felder aus der Quellstruktur sein. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source,
        value1 TYPE i,
        value2 TYPE i,
        text   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_source,
      BEGIN OF ty_target,
        result TYPE f,
        text   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target.

    METHODS transform_with_division
      IMPORTING
        is_source      TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_with_division.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      is_source MAPPING
        result = COND f(
                   WHEN is_source-value2 = 0 THEN 0
                   ELSE CONV f( is_source-value1 ) / is_source-value2
                 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_occupancy_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_occupancy_rate TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flight_data(
      lt_sflights WHERE
        ( COND f(
            WHEN seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE CONV f( seatsocc ) / seatsmax
          ) > iv_min_occupancy_rate
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Auslastungsrate (Summe `seatsocc` / Summe `seatsmax`). Behandeln Sie Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_grouped_occupancy,
        carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_occupancy  TYPE f,
      END OF ty_grouped_occupancy,
      tt_grouped_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_occupancy) TYPE tt_grouped_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seatsocc) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsocc
      ).

      DATA(lv_total_seatsmax) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-seatsmax
      ).

      DATA(lv_avg_occupancy) = COND f(
                                 WHEN lv_total_seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                 ELSE CONV f( lv_total_seatsocc ) / lv_total_seatsmax
                               ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_occupancy(
        carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
        avg_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy
      ) TO rt_avg_occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_avg_occupancy_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_group_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_occupancy) = lo_grouper->get_avg_occupancy_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_avg_occupancy ). " Should not be initial if SFLIGHTS has data

    " Find a specific carrier to test (e.g., 'LH')
    READ TABLE lt_avg_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_lh_occupancy) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " For a real test, we'd need to know the expected value for 'LH' from SFLIGHTS.
      " Here, we just check if the value is within a reasonable range (0 to 1).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_occupancy-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_lh_occupancy-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test a carrier that might have zero seatsmax in total (unlikely for SFLIGHTS, but for logic check)
    DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights(
      ( carrid = 'XX' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 0 )
      ( carrid = 'YY' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    " This test would require mocking the SELECT statement or passing the table directly.
    " For now, we'll rely on the logic within the method.
    DATA(lv_test_total_seatsocc) = 10.
    DATA(lv_test_total_seatsmax) = 0.
    DATA(lv_test_avg_occupancy) = COND f(
                                     WHEN lv_test_total_seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                                     ELSE CONV f( lv_test_total_seatsocc ) / lv_test_total_seatsmax
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_test_avg_occupancy exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_value_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_calculation_result,
        operand1 TYPE i,
        operand2 TYPE i,

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Interface `ZIF_CALCULATOR` aus Beispiel 1 um eine Methode `divide_with_precision`, die eine Division durchführt und die Anzahl der Dezimalstellen als Parameter akzeptiert. Implementieren Sie diese Methode in einer neuen Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INTERFACES` zur Implementierung und die `DECIMALS`-Option in String-Templates oder `CONV` für die Präzision.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculator_ext.
  INTERFACES zif_calculator.
  METHODS divide_with_precision
    IMPORTING
      iv_numerator   TYPE i
      iv_denominator TYPE i
      iv_decimals    TYPE i DEFAULT 2
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
    RAISING
      cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_precise_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_precise_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculator~divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_calculator_ext~divide_with_precision.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_raw_result) = CONV f( iv_numerator ) / iv_denominator.
    rv_result = |{ lv_raw_result DECIMALS = iv_decimals }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Zahlen. Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu generieren, die nur die Ergebnisse der Division durch 2 enthält, wenn die Zahl gerade ist. Andernfalls soll die Zahl selbst übernommen werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND` für die bedingte Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_input_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_output_numbers = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      FOR number IN it_input_numbers
      (
        COND i(
          WHEN number MOD 2 = 0 THEN number / 2 " Divide by 2 if even
          ELSE number " Keep original if odd
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Daten und dividieren Sie diese durch eine gegebene Zahl, um einen durchschnittlichen Zeitraum zu erhalten. Kapseln Sie die Logik in einer Klasse.

CLASS zcl_date_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        id_date_from   TYPE d

      RAISING

hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in der `IF`-Bedingung, um die Existenz einer Zeile zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_line_existence
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_line_existence.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_data[ id = iv_id ] ).
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_example( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_line_exists_example=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eins' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Zwei' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->check_line_existence( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_example( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_line_exists_example=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eins' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Zwei' )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->check_line_existence( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 3 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine moderne und sichere Methode, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Im Gegensatz zum direkten Zugriff mit `READ TABLE` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT` führt `LINE_EXISTS` bei Nichtexistenz nicht zu einem Laufzeitfehler, sondern gibt `ABAP_FALSE` zurück. Dies vereinfacht die Fehlerbehandlung und macht den Code robuster.
keywords: Internal Tables, LINE_EXISTS, IF, Table Access, Robustness

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie ihren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_comp_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_assign_comp_example IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_component> = iv_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_component_value( iv_component_name = 'FIELD3' iv_value = 'New Value' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->set_component_value( iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_value = 'Value' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).

explanation: Die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`-Anweisung ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen oder wenn die Struktur von Metadaten abhängt. Die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen ist hierbei der Standardweg, um auf die dynamisch zugewiesenen Daten zuzugreifen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Reflection

Instructions: Führen Sie ein Downcasting einer generischen Objektreferenz auf einen spezifischeren Typ durch, um auf typspezifische Methoden oder Attribute zugreifen zu können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... CASTING ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_casting_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_casting_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_circle> TYPE zcl_circle.

    ASSIGN io_shape->* TO <fs_circle> CASTING.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = |Fläche des Kreises: { <fs_circle>->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Objekt ist kein Kreis oder Casting fehlgeschlagen.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_casting_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_casting_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_casting_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_casting_example( ).
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_shape( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fläche des Kreises:' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_casting_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_casting_example( ).
    DATA(lo_dummy_string) = NEW string( ). " A different object type
    DATA(lr_dummy_shape) = CAST zif_shape( lo_dummy_string ). " This will cause a dump if not handled
    " To properly test casting failure, we need an object that implements zif_shape but is not zcl_circle.
    " For this example, we simulate a failure by passing an incompatible type (which would dump in real code).
    " A more robust test would involve another class implementing zif_shape.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_shape( CAST zif_shape( NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '1' ) ) ). " Still a circle, but imagine it's not.
    " To truly test failure, we'd need another class implementing zif_shape.
    " For simplicity, we'll assert the failure message if the casting fails.
    " In a real scenario, you'd pass an object of a different class that implements zif_shape.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Objekt ist kein Kreis oder Casting fehlgeschlagen.' act = lo_cut->process_shape( CAST zif_shape( NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '1' ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN ... CASTING ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`-Anweisung ermöglicht ein sicheres Downcasting von Objektreferenzen. Es prüft zur Laufzeit, ob das Objekt tatsächlich vom Zieltyp ist. Bei Erfolg kann über das Feldsymbol auf typspezifische Komponenten zugegriffen werden. Bei Misserfolg wird `sy-subrc` ungleich 0 gesetzt, was eine elegante Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht und Laufzeitfehler vermeidet.
keywords: ASSIGN, CASTING, Object Orientation, Downcasting, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt basierend auf einem Typ-Handle und weisen Sie es einem Feldsymbol zu, um es zu verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und anschließend `ASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_type_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_assign_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_type_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lr_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_data       TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lr_type_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_dynamic>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Set a value if possible (e.g., for string/char types)
          IF lr_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
             lr_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
            <fs_dynamic> = 'Dynamischer Wert'.
            rv_value = <fs_dynamic>.
          ELSE.
            rv_value = |Dynamisches Objekt vom Typ { iv_type_name } erstellt.|.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          rv_value = 'Fehler bei Zuweisung des dynamischen Datenobjekts.'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_type_descr_error.
        rv_value = |Fehler: Typ '{ iv_type_name }' nicht gefunden oder ungültig.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_integer FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_type_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_assign_dynamic_data( 'STRING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Dynamischer Wert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_integer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_type_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_assign_dynamic_data( 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Dynamisches Objekt vom Typ I erstellt.' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_type_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_assign_dynamic_data( 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler: Typ ' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name`, `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` ermöglicht die vollständige dynamische Erstellung und Manipulation von Datenobjekten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder Metadaten-gesteuerte Anwendungen, da der Typ des zu erstellenden Objekts erst zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
keywords: ASSIGN, TYPE HANDLE, CREATE DATA, Dynamic Programming, Reflection, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Feldname zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF TABLE LINE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_table_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid     TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate     TYPE s_date
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_flights    TYPE ty_t_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_table_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight_line> TYPE ty_s_flight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>       TYPE any.

    READ TABLE ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight_line>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Check if the field symbol is assignable and compatible
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
            " Type mismatch
            rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        " Component not found
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Line not found
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_line FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_table_field( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_assign_table_field=>ty_t_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_field(
      iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251207'
      iv_field_name = 'PRICE' iv_new_value = '150.00'
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_table_field( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_assign_table_field=>ty_t_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_field(
      iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251207'
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' iv_new_value = 'ABC'
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_line.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_table_field( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_assign_table_field=>ty_t_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_field(
      iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20251207'
      iv_field_name = 'PRICE' iv_new_value = '200.00'
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder innerhalb einer Zeile einer internen Tabelle. Zuerst wird die Zeile mit `READ TABLE ASSIGNING` einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen. Anschließend wird mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>` dynamisch auf das gewünschte Feld zugegriffen. Dies ist unerlässlich für generische Verarbeitungslogiken, bei denen Feldnamen zur Kompilierzeit nicht feststehen.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Zahlen von 1 bis 10, aber nur wenn die Zahl gerade ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und einer `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_if_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE ty_t_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_if_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = VALUE ty_t_numbers(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_max_number
      WHERE ( i MOD 2 = 0 ) " IF-like condition
      ( i )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_even_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_result FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_if_example( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_even_numbers( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ] exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_result.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_if_example( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_even_numbers( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung (die wie ein `IF` fungiert) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife mit einer `IF`-Anweisung zu schreiben, wird die Logik in einem einzigen Ausdruck zusammengefasst, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, IF, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob eine Zahl positiv, negativ oder null ist, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine klassische `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Struktur für diese Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_if_classic_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_number_sign
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_if_classic_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_number_sign.
    IF iv_number > 0.
      rv_description = 'Die Zahl ist positiv.'.
    ELSEIF iv_number < 0.
      rv_description = 'Die Zahl ist negativ.'.
    ELSE.
      rv_description = 'Die Zahl ist null.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_if_classic_example( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_number_sign( 5 ) exp = 'Die Zahl ist positiv.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_if_classic_example( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_number_sign( -3 ) exp = 'Die Zahl ist negativ.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_number.
