    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_number_sign( 0 ) exp = 'Die Zahl ist null.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl modernere Operatoren wie `COND` und `SWITCH` für Zuweisungen existieren, bleibt die klassische `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF`-Struktur für komplexere Kontrollflusslogik, die keine direkte Zuweisung ist oder mehrere Anweisungen pro Zweig erfordert, weiterhin relevant und lesbar. Sie bietet eine klare Struktur für sequentielle Bedingungsprüfungen.
keywords: IF, ELSEIF, ENDIF, Conditional Logic, Control Flow

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine globale Variable eines anderen Programms zu und lesen Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ('(program_name)variable_name') TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_global_var DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_global_variable_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_program_name TYPE program
        iv_variable_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_global_var IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_global_variable_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_global_var> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_full_name TYPE string.

    lv_full_name = |({ iv_program_name }){ iv_variable_name }|.

    ASSIGN (lv_full_name) TO <fs_global_var>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |Wert: { <fs_global_var> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = |Fehler: Variable '{ iv_variable_name }' in Programm '{ iv_program_name }' nicht gefunden oder nicht zugreifbar.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Economy-Sitze aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die von 'LH' (Lufthansa) durchgeführt werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_lh_economy_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_seat_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_lh_economy_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seats_e
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT die Flugnummer, die Fluggesellschaft und eine Statusbeschreibung, die auf der Anzahl der freien Economy-Sitze basiert: 'Viele Plätze' (> 350), 'Wenige Plätze' (100-350), 'Ausgebucht' (< 100). Verwenden Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck in der `SELECT`-Anweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE` direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste, um die Statusbeschreibung zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid,
           CASE
             WHEN seats_e - seatsocc_e > 350 THEN 'Viele Plätze'
             WHEN seats_e - seatsocc_e BETWEEN 100 AND 350 THEN 'Wenige Plätze'
             ELSE 'Ausgebucht'
           END AS status_text
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_0400-status_text exp = 'Viele Plätze' ).

    DATA(ls_flight_aa_0017) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA', connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa_0017-status_text exp = 'Wenige Plätze' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp und einer Zeilenanzahl erzeugt und mit Dummy-Daten füllt. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für RTTI und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING iv_table_type_name TYPE string
                iv_num_rows      TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_line_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        CREATE DATA ro_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_table_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

        CREATE DATA lo_line_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
        ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

        DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
          " Fill with dummy data (e.g., clear structure)
          CLEAR <fs_line>.
          " Example: if it's SFLIGHT, fill carrid and connid
          IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = |C{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT }|.
            ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = |{ sy-index ALPHA = OUT }|.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_rtti_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log or raise exception
        CLEAR ro_table_ref.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_table_ref ).

    ASSIGN lo_table_ref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_sflight_table> ) exp = 5 ).

    ASSIGN <fs_sflight_table>[ 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_first_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_first_line> ).

Dies ist mächtig für generische Frameworks oder wenn die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die `IF`-Anweisung wird hier verwendet, um spezifische Felder dynamisch zu füllen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, Field Symbols, IF

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail an einen Empfänger mit einem Betreff und einem Textkörper. Verwenden Sie die Hilfsfunktionen von `CL_BCS_UTILITIES`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_UTILITIES=>SBCS_SEND` für eine vereinfachte E-Mail-Versandlogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_email_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_simple_email
      IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                iv_subject         TYPE string
                iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rb_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_sender IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_simple_email.
    DATA: lo_send_request TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document     TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient    TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lv_sent_to_all  TYPE abap_bool.

    TRY.
        " Create send request
        lo_send_request = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        " Create document
        lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
          i_text    = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

        " Add recipient
        lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        " Set sender (optional, usually current user)
        " lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_sapuser_bcs=>create( sy-uname ) ).

        " Send email
        lv_sent_to_all = lo_send_request->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).

        IF lv_sent_to_all = abap_true.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rb_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rb_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Handle exception, e.g., log error
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rb_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_flight-seats_e - ls_flight-seatsocc_e > 100 )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seats_e = 400 seatsocc_e = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die zwei Integer-Werte addiert. Bevor die Addition durchgeführt wird, prüfen Sie, ob das Ergebnis einen Integer-Überlauf verursachen würde. Falls ja, soll eine Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>MAX_INT und eine eigene Exception-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcx_overflow_error DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_overflow_error IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_overflow_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_safely.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int.

    IF iv_val1 > 0 AND iv_val2 > 0 AND lv_max_int - iv_val1 < iv_val2.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_overflow_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_overflow_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_val1 < 0 AND iv_val2 < 0 AND lv_max_int + iv_val1 > iv_val2. " Check for underflow (negative overflow)
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_overflow_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_overflow_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_OVERFLOW_ERROR erwartet.' ).
      CATCH zcx_overflow_error.

          act = '' " Dummy assert, just to show we caught the exception
          msg = 'ZCX_OVERFLOW_ERROR wurde korrekt ausgelöst.'
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT mit dem REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_sflight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price( ).

    " Manuelle Berechnung der erwarteten Summe für den Vergleich
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_expected_price = lv_expected_price + ls_sflight-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price,
      exp = lv_expected_price,
      msg = 'Die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_count = REDUCE #( 
      INIT count TYPE i = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( <fs_sflight>-price > iv_threshold )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Eintrag in einer Quelltabelle den kumulativen Preis (laufende Summe) der Flugpreise aus SFLIGHT enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür den FOR-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Operator mit einer lokalen Variablen für die laufende Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_running_total DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_total,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_total.
    TYPES tt_sflight_with_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_running_total
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_running_total) TYPE tt_sflight_with_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_running_total IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_running_total.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate. " Order for consistent running total

    DATA(lv_current_total) = 0.
    rt_running_total = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      ( 
        carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
        fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price       = ls_sflight-price,
        total_price = ( lv_current_total = lv_current_total + ls_sflight-price ) " Zuweisung und Addition in einem
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_running_total FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_running_total.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_running_total( ).
    DATA(lt_running_total) = lo_cut->get_running_total( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_running_total,
      msg = 'Die Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_prev_total) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_running_total INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_entry-total_price >= lv_prev_total ),
        msg = 'Die laufende Summe sollte aufsteigend sein.'
      ).
      lv_prev_total = ls_entry-total_price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 0.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_expected_total = lv_expected_total + ls_sflight-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lines( lt_running_total ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_running_total[ lines( lt_running_total ) ]-total_price,
        exp = lv_expected_total,
        msg = 'Der letzte Wert der laufenden Summe sollte der Gesamtsumme entsprechen.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit der Möglichkeit, lokale Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks zu aktualisieren (hier `lv_current_total`), ermöglicht die elegante Berechnung von laufenden Summen oder anderen kumulativen Werten. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges Feature für die Transformation von internen Tabellen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, ADD, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Laufende Summe, Kumulativ

Instructions: Addieren Sie die Werte von korrespondierenden numerischen Feldern zweier Strukturen. Verwenden Sie hierfür den CORRESPONDING-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit der ADDITION-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_add_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS add_corresponding_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_data
      CHANGING
        cs_target TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_corresponding_fields.
    cs_target = CORRESPONDING #( 
      cs_target
      MAPPING
        field1 = is_source-field1
        field2 = is_source-field2
        field3 = is_source-field3
      ADDITION
        field1 = is_source-field1
        field2 = is_source-field2
        field3 = is_source-field3
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_corresponding FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_add_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_add_corresponding=>ty_data( field1 = 10 field2 = 20 field3 = 30 ).
    DATA(ls_target) = VALUE zcl_add_corresponding=>ty_data( field1 = 1   field2 = 2   field3 = 3   ).

    lo_cut->add_corresponding_fields( 
      EXPORTING
        is_source = ls_source
      CHANGING
        cs_target = ls_target
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field1,
      exp = 11,
      msg = 'Field1 sollte 11 sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field2,
      exp = 22,
      msg = 'Field2 sollte 22 sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field3,
      exp = 33,
      msg = 'Field3 sollte 33 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der CORRESPONDING-Operator mit der ADDITION-Klausel ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um numerische Felder von Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu addieren, ohne explizite Feldzuweisungen vornehmen zu müssen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, ADDITION, Strukturen, ADD, Datenhandling

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die ein bestimmtes Ziel (CITYTO) haben, und berechnen Sie dann die Summe ihrer Flugpreise (PRICE). Verwenden Sie hierfür die Operatoren FILTER und REDUCE.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den FILTER-Operator, um die Tabelle vorzufiltern, und den REDUCE-Operator, um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_of_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_of_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM lt_sflight
                                 WHERE cityto = iv_cityto.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Manuelle Berechnung für den Vergleich

    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK'.

    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price,
      exp = lv_expected_price,
      msg = 'Die Summe der gefilterten Flüge sollte korrekt sein.'

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_sum_of_filtered_flights( 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price,

      msg = 'Die Summe sollte 0 sein, wenn keine Flüge gefunden werden.'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in ein JSON-Format. Die interne Tabelle soll dabei nur ausgewählte Felder enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `/ui2/cl_abap2json` und den `VALUE` Operator, um die interne Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_json.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data( FOR ls_sflight IN 
      ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid ORDER BY fldate UP TO 2 ROWS ) 
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid, connid = ls_sflight-connid, fldate = ls_sflight-fldate, price = ls_sflight-price, currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).

    DATA(lo_json_writer) = NEW /ui2/cl_abap2json( ).
    lo_json_writer->write_data(
      EXPORTING
        data = lt_sflights
      RECEIVING
        json = rv_json
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '1000.00' currency = 'EUR' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '1200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '500.50' currency = 'USD' ) 
    ) ).

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_json_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_json_output) = lo_converter->convert_sflights_to_json( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'JSON output should not be initial' act = lv_json_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain LH' exp = 'LH' act = lv_json_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain EUR' exp = 'EUR' act = lv_json_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON should contain 1000.00' exp = '1000.00' act = lv_json_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( msg = 'JSON should not contain AA' exp = 'AA' act = lv_json_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung nutzt den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem Inline-`SELECT` Statement, um die Daten direkt in die interne Tabelle zu füllen. Anschließend wird `/ui2/cl_abap2json` verwendet, um diese Daten effizient in ein JSON-String zu konvertieren. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der Datenverarbeitung und -serialisierung.
keywords: JSON, /ui2/cl_abap2json, Internal Tables, VALUE, SELECT

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Eintrag in die Tabelle `sflights` ein, indem Sie die Daten direkt mit dem `VALUE` Operator konstruieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT` zusammen mit `VALUE #( ... )` und dem `@` Escape-Zeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_new_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price    TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_new_flight.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = iv_carrid
      connid   = iv_connid
      fldate   = iv_fldate
      price    = iv_price
      currency = iv_currency
    ) ).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_inserter->insert_new_flight(
      iv_carrid   = 'XX'
      iv_connid   = '9999'
      iv_fldate   = '20251231'
      iv_price    = '123.45'
      iv_currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Insert should be successful' ).

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = '20251231'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'Record should exist' ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = '20251231'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_insert_value( ).
    " Insert first time
    lo_inserter->insert_new_flight(
      iv_carrid   = 'YY'
      iv_connid   = '8888'
      iv_fldate   = '20251130'
      iv_price    = '500.00'
      iv_currency = 'USD'
    ).
    " Try to insert duplicate
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_inserter->insert_new_flight(
      iv_carrid   = 'YY'
      iv_connid   = '8888'
      iv_fldate   = '20251130'
      iv_price    = '500.00'
      iv_currency = 'USD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Duplicate insert should fail' ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '8888' AND fldate = '20251130'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT` Anweisung wird hier mit dem `VALUE` Operator verwendet, um eine Struktur direkt im Statement zu konstruieren. Das `@` Escape-Zeichen signalisiert, dass es sich um einen Host-Ausdruck handelt. Dies ist eine moderne, lesbare und kompakte Art, einzelne Datensätze in die Datenbank einzufügen.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, Database, Host Expression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die Währung aus `sflights` enthält, wobei die Währung in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 100.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und `CONDENSE` für die Währung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > 100 ) 
                           ( connid = ls_flight-connid, currency = CONV #( to_upper( ls_flight-currency ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 zu erhalten und geben Sie diese als neue interne Tabelle zurück.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder mit gleichen Namen von einer Struktur in eine andere, oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators. Die Zielstruktur/Tabelle soll dabei nur eine Untermenge der Felder der Quellstruktur/Tabelle enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field_new TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
    rs_target-field_new = |Mapped from source: { is_source-field3 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source MAPPING field_new = field3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 10
      field2 = 'Hello'
      field3 = 'World'
    ).
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 10 msg = 'Field1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field_new exp = 'Mapped from source: World' msg = 'Field_new mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source_data_tab(
      ( field1 = 1 field2 = 'A' field3 = 'X' )
      ( field1 = 2 field2 = 'B' field3 = 'Y' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_mapper->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table lines mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 1 msg = 'Table field1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field2 exp = 'A' msg = 'Table field2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field_new exp = 'X' msg = 'Table field_new mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht das einfache und effiziente Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen, basierend auf Feldnamen. Er ist eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Mit der `MAPPING` Klausel können Felder umbenannt oder zusätzliche Zuweisungen vorgenommen werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Internal Tables, Data Operations

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere neue Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle in die Datenbanktabelle `sflights` ein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT dbtab FROM TABLE @itab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_multiple_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_multiple_flights.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @it_new_flights.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_multiple_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_multiple_partial_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple_success.
    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE zcl_insert_table=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '1000' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '1001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_insert_table( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_inserter->insert_multiple_flights( lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Multiple insert should be successful' ).

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'ZZ'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 2 msg = 'Two records should be inserted' ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'ZZ'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_multiple_partial_fail.
    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE zcl_insert_table=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'WW' connid = '2000' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'WW' connid = '2000' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Duplicate
    ).
    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_insert_table( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_inserter->insert_multiple_flights( lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Partial insert should fail (sy-subrc <> 0)' ).

    " Verify only one record was inserted
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'WW'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-dbcnt exp = 1 msg = 'Only one record should be inserted due to duplicate' ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'WW'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT dbtab FROM TABLE @itab` Syntax ermöglicht das Einfügen mehrerer Datensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in eine Datenbanktabelle mit einer einzigen Datenbankoperation. Dies ist wesentlich performanter als das Einfügen einzelner Datensätze in einer Schleife. Das `@` Escape-Zeichen ist für Host-Variablen in Open SQL erforderlich.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Tables, Database, Host Expression

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings und numerische Werte zu einem einzigen String, wobei Sie die Formatierung der numerischen Werte steuern.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid

        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_string_format IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { iv_carrid ALPHA = OUT } { iv_connid } kostet { iv_price DECIMALS = 2 } { iv_currency ALPHA = OUT }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_output FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_output.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_string_format( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_formatter->format_flight_info(
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
      iv_connid   = '0400'
      iv_price    = '1234.50'
      iv_currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'Flug LH 0400 kostet 1234.50 EUR.' msg = 'Formatted string mismatch' ).

    lv_output = lo_formatter->format_flight_info(
      iv_carrid   = 'AA'
      iv_connid   = '0017'
      iv_price    = '500'
      iv_currency = 'USD'

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die einen bestimmten Währungscode haben und deren Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt. Geben Sie nur die Flugnummer und den Preis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `IN` und `WHEN` für die Filterung und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_when_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_currency TYPE s_currcode iv_min_price TYPE s_price RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_when_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHEN flight-currency = iv_currency AND flight-price > iv_min_price
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_when_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_currency = 'EUR' iv_min_price = 500 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ). " Prüfen, ob Ergebnisse zurückgegeben werden (kann 0 sein, wenn keine Daten passen)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und `WHEN` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s und führt zu funktionalerem Code.
keywords: FOR, WHEN, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge aus `sflights` für einen bestimmten Währungscode, aber nur für Flüge, die noch nicht ausgebucht sind (seatsocc < seatsmax).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FOR` und `WHEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_when_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_conditional_sum IMPORTING iv_currency TYPE s_currcode RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_when_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHEN flight-currency = iv_currency AND flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_conditional_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_when_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_sum( 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum >= 0 ). " Prüfen, ob die Summe nicht negativ ist.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHEN` können komplexe Aggregationen mit Filterbedingungen sehr kompakt und funktional ausgedrückt werden, was den Code effizienter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHEN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_sec_sxml_writer_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Flüge der Tabelle `sflights` und erhöhen Sie den Preis um 10% für alle Flüge, deren Währung 'USD' ist und die noch freie Plätze haben (seatsocc < seatsmax).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL ... WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_where_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_usd_flights CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_where_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_usd_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE currency = 'USD' AND seatsocc < seatsmax.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.1'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_update_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flights.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_new>).
    <fs_new>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_new>-connid = '0017'. <fs_new>-currency = 'USD'. <fs_new>-price = 100. <fs_new>-seatsocc = 10. <fs_new>-seatsmax = 20.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_new>.
    <fs_new>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_new>-connid = '0400'. <fs_new>-currency = 'EUR'. <fs_new>-price = 200. <fs_new>-seatsocc = 50. <fs_new>-seatsmax = 50.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_where_modify( ).
    lo_cut->update_usd_flights( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_new> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_new>-price exp = 110 ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_new> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_new>-price exp = 200 ). " Sollte sich nicht ändern
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Syntax ist eine klassische, aber immer noch effiziente Methode, um über interne Tabellen zu iterieren und dabei nur die Einträge zu verarbeiten, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entsprechen. In Kombination mit Field-Symbolen ermöglicht dies eine direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeilen, was performant und lesbar ist.
keywords: LOOP AT, WHERE, Internal Tables, Modify, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Währungen von Flügen aus `sflights` enthält, deren Preis über 1000 liegt und die von 'UA' oder 'DL' durchgeführt werden.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle `sflights` ein Flug existiert, der von 'AA' durchgeführt wird und die Flugnummer '0017' hat.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_flight_exists IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id RETURNING VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_where IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge, aber nur für Gruppen, in denen mindestens ein Flug einen Preis über 1000 hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP ... WHEN` mit `GROUP BY` und `GROUP WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_when_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             currency     TYPE s_currcode,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_grouped_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_when_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid currency = flight-currency )
                                GROUP WHERE ( line_exists( GROUP flight WHERE price > 1000 ) )
                                ( carrid = GROUP KEY-carrid
                                  currency = GROUP KEY-currency
                                  flight_count = lines( GROUP flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_grouped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_when_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) >= 0 ). " Prüfen, ob Ergebnisse zurückgegeben werden
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ... GROUP WHERE` Syntax ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Funktion für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die `GROUP WHERE` Klausel ermöglicht eine bedingte Auswahl ganzer Gruppen, was den Code extrem kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht und die Datenverarbeitung erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: FOR, GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, GROUP WHERE, WHEN, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Geben Sie eine Beschreibung für einen numerischen Code zurück. Wenn der Code nicht bekannt ist, soll ein Standardtext verwendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND` Expression mit `WHEN` und `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description IMPORTING iv_code TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = COND string(
      WHEN iv_code = 1 THEN 'Erster Code'
      WHEN iv_code = 2 THEN 'Zweiter Code'
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannter Code'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_when_others( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_description( 1 ) exp = 'Erster Code' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_description( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannter Code' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND` Expression mit `WHEN OTHERS` bietet eine prägnante Möglichkeit, einen Standardwert zuzuweisen, wenn keine der expliziten `WHEN`-Bedingungen erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF-ELSE IF-ELSE` Strukturen.
keywords: COND, WHEN, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, Expression

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und geben Sie für jede Zeile die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus. Nutzen Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration für die Work Area.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... INTO @DATA(...) für die Inline-Deklaration der Work Area.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_into_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_into_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    DATA(lv_temp_output) = ``.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_temp_output = lv_temp_output && |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid };|.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_output = lv_temp_output.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_loop_into_data=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_into_data( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = 'LH-400;AA-001;' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration @DATA(ls_flight) im LOOP-Statement vereinfacht die Deklaration der Work Area und macht den Code kompakter. String-Templates (|...|) werden für die Formatierung der Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: LOOP AT, INTO, DATA, Inline-Deklaration, String-Templates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' enthält, und transformieren Sie dabei die Daten, um nur Carrid, Connid und Fldate zu behalten. Nutzen Sie einen Tabellen-Konstruktor mit FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) mit einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                             WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                             ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                               connid = ls_flight-connid
                               fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No LH flights found' act = lt_lh_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight is not LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Tabellen-Konstruktor mit FOR-Ausdruck und WHERE-Klausel ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Filterung einer neuen internen Tabelle in einem einzigen Statement. Dies ist sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Tabellen-Konstruktor, Internal Tables, 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine bestehende interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten, um nur Flüge mit dem Ziel 'NEW YORK' zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie FILTER #( ... ) mit einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_flights IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250103' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_ny_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_ny_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    LOOP AT lt_ny_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine sehr prägnante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen, ohne die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, 7.50, WHERE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung eines REDUCE-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ... mit einem INIT-Wert und NEXT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
                                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '100' fldate = '20250103' seatsocc = 75 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 225 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle in einem funktionalen Stil. Er ist ideal für Summen, Zählungen oder die Erstellung komplexer Einzelwerte aus Tabellendaten.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Math, Aggregation, 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Excel-Datei (.xlsx) mit Flugdaten (Carrid, Connid, Fldate) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Die Daten sollen in ein Arbeitsblatt geschrieben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_OPENXML_HELPER=>CREATE_SPREADSHEET und ADD_TABLE_FROM_DATA. Selektieren Sie die Daten mit INTO TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_excel,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_excel.
    TYPES tt_sflight_excel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_excel WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS export_sflight_to_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS zcl_excel_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflight_to_excel.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_excel.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_excel->add_table_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_name = 'SFLIGHT_DATA'
        i_table_data = lt_flights
        i_sheet_name = 'Flüge'
    ).
    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_export( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_cut->export_sflight_to_excel( ).

Die Methode ADD_TABLE_FROM_DATA erlaubt das direkte Schreiben einer internen Tabelle in ein Arbeitsblatt, was die Datenexport-Logik erheblich vereinfacht. Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus einer simulierten Excel-Datei (als XSTRING) in eine interne Tabelle. Die Excel-Datei enthält eine Spalte 'VALUE'.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_OPENXML_HELPER=>CREATE_SPREADSHEET (mit XSTRING als Input) und GET_TABLE_FROM_SHEET. Die gelesenen Daten werden in eine interne Tabelle geschrieben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_import DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_data.
    TYPES tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS import_excel_data IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_excel_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_dummy_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_import IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD import_excel_data.
    DATA(lo_excel) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_spreadsheet( iv_xstring ).
    lo_excel->get_table_from_sheet(
      EXPORTING
        i_sheet_name = 'Sheet1'
      IMPORTING
        e_table_data = rt_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_excel.
    DATA: lt_dummy_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 'Test1' ) TO lt_dummy_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 'Test2' ) TO lt_dummy_data.

    DATA(lo_excel) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_spreadsheet( ).
    lo_excel->add_table_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_name = 'DummyData'
        i_table_data = lt_dummy_data
        i_sheet_name = 'Sheet1'
    ).
    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_import_excel_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_import_excel_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_import( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_excel_xstring) = lo_cut->create_dummy_excel( ).

    DATA(lt_imported_data) = lo_cut->import_excel_data( lv_dummy_excel_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_imported_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_imported_data[1]-value exp = 'Test1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_imported_data[2]-value exp = 'Test2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode GET_TABLE_FROM_SHEET der Klasse CL_OPENXML_HELPER ermöglicht das einfache Einlesen von Daten aus einem Excel-Arbeitsblatt direkt in eine interne Tabelle. Dies vereinfacht den Import von strukturierten Daten aus Excel-Dateien.
keywords: CL_OPENXML_HELPER, Excel, Import, INTO TABLE, File Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit zwei Arbeitsblättern. Das erste Blatt soll Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT enthalten, das zweite Blatt eine Zusammenfassung der Fluggesellschaften und der Anzahl ihrer Flüge. Formatieren Sie die Kopfzeilen des ersten Blattes fett.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_OPENXML_HELPER, ADD_SHEET, ADD_TABLE_FROM_DATA und SET_CELL_STYLE. Verwenden Sie REDUCE für die Zusammenfassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_advanced DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_excel,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_excel.
    TYPES tt_sflight_excel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_excel WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_complex_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_advanced IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_complex_excel.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_excel.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_excel) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_spreadsheet( ).

    " Sheet 1: Flight Data
    lo_excel->add_table_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_name = 'SFLIGHT_DETAILS'
        i_table_data = lt_flights
        i_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails'
    ).

    " Apply bold style to header row of Sheet 1
    DATA(lo_style) = lo_excel->create_style( ).
    lo_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_style( i_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails' i_row = 1 i_col = 1 i_style = lo_style ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_style( i_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails' i_row = 1 i_col = 2 i_style = lo_style ).
    lo_excel->set_cell_style( i_sheet_name = 'Flugdetails' i_row = 1 i_col = 3 i_style = lo_style ).

    " Calculate summary using REDUCE
    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE tt_carrier_summary( INIT r = VALUE tt_carrier_summary( )
                                                  FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                                  LET lv_index = line_index( r[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
                                                  NEXT r = COND tt_carrier_summary( WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL
                                                                                    THEN VALUE tt_carrier_summary( FOR ls_sum IN r
                                                                                                                   ( COND #( WHEN ls_sum-carrid = ls_flight-carrid THEN VALUE #( ls_sum-carrid = ls_sum-carrid flight_count = ls_sum-flight_count + 1 ) ELSE ls_sum ) ) )
                                                                                    ELSE VALUE tt_carrier_summary( BASE r ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = 1 ) ) ) ).

    " Sheet 2: Summary Data
    lo_excel->add_sheet( i_sheet_name = 'Zusammenfassung' ).
    lo_excel->add_table_from_data(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_name = 'CARRIER_SUMMARY'
        i_table_data = lt_summary
        i_sheet_name = 'Zusammenfassung'
    ).

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge mit einer Flugdauer von mehr als 100 Minuten enthält, und projizieren Sie dabei nur die Felder Carrid, Connid und Fldate. Nutzen Sie einen Tabellen-Konstruktor mit FOR-Ausdruck und einer WHERE-Bedingung, die auf einer Sub-SELECT-Abfrage basiert (für die Flugdauer aus SPFLI).
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) und eine WHERE-Klausel mit EXISTS (SELECT ... FROM SPFLI WHERE ...).
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_for_subselect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_long_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_long_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_for_subselect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_long_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_long_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 WHERE ( EXISTS( SELECT FROM spfli WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fltime > 100 ) )
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight duration not greater than 100' act = ( lv_fltime > 100 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (Carrid) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in einem FOR-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ... und REDUCE für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_stats RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_stats.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_carrier_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                   total_seats_occ = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_cut->get_carrier_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'No carrier stats found' act = lt_stats ).
    LOOP AT lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_stat).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_stat-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats occupied should be positive' act = ( ls_stat-total_seats_occ >= 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Example specific check for 'LH' if data is consistent
    READ TABLE lt_stats INTO DATA(ls_lh_stat) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH flight count should be positive' act = ( ls_lh_stat-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der GROUP BY-Ausdruck innerhalb eines FOR-Statements (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.55) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit GROUP SIZE und REDUCE können Aggregationen pro Gruppe direkt im Ausdruck durchgeführt werden, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.

                        WHEN 5 THEN 'Donnerstag'

Instructions: Ermittle den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Wenn der Flug existiert, gib 'Gefunden', sonst 'Nicht gefunden' zurück. Nutze eine `SWITCH`-Expression.

solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    rv_status = SWITCH #( cl_abap_bool=>true
                          WHEN line_exists( sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN 'Gefunden'
                          WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Nicht gefunden'
                        ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeite eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und füge eine neue Spalte mit einer Preiskategorie ('Günstig', 'Standard', 'Teuer') basierend auf dem Flugpreis hinzu. Nutze `FOR` und `CASE`.
hint: Verwende einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor und einer `CASE`-Expression für die Preiskategorie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
             category  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
                                        price    = ls_flight-price
                                        currency = ls_flight-currency
                                        category = CASE
                                                     WHEN ls_flight-price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
                                                     WHEN ls_flight-price >= 200 AND ls_flight-price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
                                                     ELSE 'Teuer'
                                                   END
                                      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf dem Flugstatus (z.B. 'A' für aktiv, 'C' für storniert). Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression innerhalb eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit einer `CASE`-Expression in der `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             status TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_status_code TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_status.
    " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir einen Status, da SFLIGHT keinen direkten Status hat.
    " In einer realen Anwendung käme der Status aus einer anderen Quelle oder Logik.
    DATA: lt_sflights_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_sflights_with_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                          connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                          status = CASE ls_flight-connid
                                                     WHEN '0017' THEN 'C' " Beispiel: Flug 0017 ist storniert
                                                     WHEN '0400' THEN 'A' " Beispiel: Flug 0400 ist aktiv
                                                     ELSE 'A'
                                                   END
                                        ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_with_status WHERE status = iv_status_code ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' price = 100 currency = 'EUR' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' price = 150 currency = 'USD' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_cancelled) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status_code = 'C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_cancelled ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl stornierter Flüge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cancelled[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Stornierter Flug LH' ).

    DATA(lt_active) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_status( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_status_code = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_active ) exp = 1 msg = 'Anzahl aktiver Flüge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_active[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Aktiver Flug LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern interner Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird eine `CASE`-Expression verwendet, um einen simulierten Status zu bestimmen, der dann als Filterkriterium dient. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität moderner ABAP-Ausdrücke zur Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Schreibe Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle in eine Excel-Datei. Die erste Zeile soll die Spaltenüberschriften enthalten, gefolgt von den Daten. Gib den Inhalt der Excel-Datei als XSTRING zurück.
hint: Verwende `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` und iteriere über die interne Tabelle, um Zeile für Zeile zu schreiben. Nutze RTTI für Spaltenüberschriften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_to_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_to_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA(lv_column) = 1.

    TRY.
        lo_excel->create_document( ).
        lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).
        lo_excel->set_active_sheet_index( 0 ).

        " Spaltenüberschriften schreiben (mittels RTTI)
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights[ 1 ] ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column ip_value = ls_component-name ).
          lv_column = lv_column + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.

        " Daten schreiben
        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          lv_column = 1.
          DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight ).
          LOOP AT lo_data_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column ip_value = <fs_value> ).
            ENDIF.
            lv_column = lv_column + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_excel_core INTO DATA(lx_excel_error).
        MESSAGE lx_excel_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        MESSAGE lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
