Instructions: Erstelle eine Excel-Datei mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Färbe die Zeilen basierend auf dem Flugstatus (z.B. 'A' für aktiv, 'C' für storniert, 'D' für verspätet), der mit einer `CASE`-Expression bestimmt wird. Gib den Inhalt der Excel-Datei als XSTRING zurück.
hint: Kombiniere `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zum Schreiben und `CASE` zum Bestimmen der Zeilenformatierung (Hintergrundfarbe).
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_conditional_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_with_cond_format
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_with_cond_format.
    DATA(lo_excel) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.

    TRY.
        lo_excel->create_document( ).
        lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flüge mit Status' ).
        lo_excel->set_active_sheet_index( 0 ).

        " Stile definieren
        DATA(lo_style_active) = lo_excel->create_style( ).
        lo_style_active->set_fill_background_color( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_light_green ).

        DATA(lo_style_cancelled) = lo_excel->create_style( ).
        lo_style_cancelled->set_fill_background_color( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_red ).

        DATA(lo_style_delayed) = lo_excel->create_style( ).
        lo_style_delayed->set_fill_background_color( cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>co_color_orange ).

        " Spaltenüberschriften schreiben
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights[ 1 ] ).
        DATA(lv_column_header) = 1.
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_header ip_value = ls_component-name ).
          lv_column_header = lv_column_header + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_header ip_value = 'STATUS' ). " Zusätzliche Status-Spalte
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.

        " Daten und Status schreiben
        LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
          DATA(lv_status) = CASE ls_sflight-connid
                               WHEN '0017' THEN 'C' " Storniert
                               WHEN '0400' THEN 'D' " Verspätet
                               ELSE 'A'            " Aktiv
                             END.

          DATA(lo_current_style) = SWITCH #( lv_status
                                             WHEN 'A' THEN lo_style_active
                                             WHEN 'C' THEN lo_style_cancelled
                                             WHEN 'D' THEN lo_style_delayed
                                             ELSE lo_excel->create_style( ) ).

          DATA(lv_column_data) = 1.
          DATA(lo_data_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight ).
          LOOP AT lo_data_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_value>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_data ip_value = <fs_value> ).
              lo_excel->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_data ip_style = lo_current_style ).
            ENDIF.
            lv_column_data = lv_column_data + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
          lo_excel->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_data ip_value = lv_status ).
          lo_excel->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column_data ip_style = lo_current_style ).
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_excel->xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_excel_core INTO DATA(lx_excel_error).
        MESSAGE lx_excel_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        MESSAGE lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimme die Jahreszeit (Frühling, Sommer, Herbst, Winter) für ein gegebenes Datum. Nutze eine `CASE`-Anweisung.
hint: Extrahiere den Monat aus dem Datum und verwende eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit `WHEN ... TO ...` für die Monatsbereiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_season_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_season
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_season) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_season_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_season.
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).

    CASE lv_month.
      WHEN '03' TO '05'.
        rv_season = 'Frühling'.
      WHEN '06' TO '08'.
        rv_season = 'Sommer'.
      WHEN '09' TO '11'.
        rv_season = 'Herbst'.
      WHEN '12' OR '01' OR '02'.
        rv_season = 'Winter'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_season = 'Ungültiger Monat'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne einen Rabattprozentsatz basierend auf dem Bestellwert. Nutze eine `COND`-Expression für gestaffelte Rabatte.
hint: Verwende eine `COND`-Expression mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen für verschiedene Bestellwertbereiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_order_value TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discount_percent) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    rv_discount_percent = COND #( WHEN iv_order_value < 100 THEN '0.00'
                                  WHEN iv_order_value >= 100 AND iv_order_value < 500 THEN '5.00'
                                  WHEN iv_order_value >= 500 AND iv_order_value < 1000 THEN '10.00'
                                  ELSE '15.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_calculate_discount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '50.00' ) exp = '0.00' msg = 'Test < 100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '150.00' ) exp = '5.00' msg = 'Test 100-499' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '750.00' ) exp = '10.00' msg = 'Test 500-999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '1200.00' ) exp = '15.00' msg = 'Test >= 1000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Sie ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Definition von gestaffelten Bedingungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expression, Discount

Instructions: Formatiere eine Telefonnummer basierend auf ihrer Länge und einem Ländercode. Nutze eine `CASE`-Expression mit String-Templates.
hint: Verwende `CASE` auf die Länge der Nummer und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_phone_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_phone_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_phone_raw TYPE string
        iv_country_code TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_phone_formatted) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_phone_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_phone_number.
    DATA(lv_phone_digits) = replace( val = iv_phone_raw regex = '[^0-9]' with = '' ).
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( lv_phone_digits ).

    rv_phone_formatted = CASE lv_length.
                           WHEN 10 THEN |({ lv_phone_digits+0(3) }) { lv_phone_digits+3(3) }-{ lv_phone_digits+6(4) }|
                           WHEN 11 THEN |{ iv_country_code } ({ lv_phone_digits+1(3) }) { lv_phone_digits+4(3) }-{ lv_phone_digits+7(4) }|
                           WHEN 7 THEN |{ lv_phone_digits+0(3) }-{ lv_phone_digits+3(4) }|
                           WHEN OTHERS THEN |Ungültige Nummer: { iv_phone_raw }|
                         END.

    IF iv_country_code IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_length = 10.
      rv_phone_formatted = |{ iv_country_code } { rv_phone_formatted }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_format_phone_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_phone_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_phone_formatter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_phone_number( iv_phone_raw = '1234567890' ) exp = '(123) 456-7890' msg = '10 Ziffern' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_phone_number( iv_phone_raw = '01234567890' iv_country_code = '+49' ) exp = '+49 (123) 456-7890' msg = '11 Ziffern mit Ländercode' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_phone_number( iv_phone_raw = '123-4567' ) exp = '123-4567' msg = '7 Ziffern' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_phone_number( iv_phone_raw = '123' ) exp = 'Ungültige Nummer: 123' msg = 'Ungültige Länge' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->format_phone_number( iv_phone_raw = '1234567890' iv_country_code = '+1' ) exp = '+1 (123) 456-7890' msg = '10 Ziffern mit Ländercode' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination einer `CASE`-Expression mit String-Templates für eine flexible und lesbare Formatierung von Telefonnummern. Die `replace`-Funktion entfernt Nicht-Ziffern, und die `CASE`-Expression wählt das passende Format basierend auf der Länge der bereinigten Nummer. String-Templates machen die Formatierung sehr intuitiv.
keywords: CASE, String Processing, String Templates, Conditional Logic, replace

solution:
CLASS zcl_container_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_container_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_data.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ls_data TYPE string.
    ASSIGN ls_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    <fs_data> = iv_value.

    DATA(lv_container) = cl_abap_container_utilities=>write_data_to_container( <fs_data> ).

    DATA: ls_read_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_read_data> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA ls_read_data TYPE string.
    ASSIGN ls_read_data->* TO <fs_read_data>.

    cl_abap_container_utilities=>read_data_from_container(
      EXPORTING
        im_container = lv_container
      IMPORTING
        ex_data    = <fs_read_data>
    ).
    rv_result = <fs_read_data>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS: timer_finished.

      start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i,
      stop_timer,

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval. " in seconds
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->cancel( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished.
    " Timer automatically cancels after one run if not set to repeat
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS: on_timer_finished FOR EVENT timer_finished OF zcl_gui_timer_basic.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_start_stop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_basic( ).
    SET HANDLER on_timer_finished FOR lo_cut.

    " Simulate timer start (cannot actually wait for GUI timer in unit test)
    lo_cut->start_timer( 1 ).
    " Simulate event firing for test purposes by directly calling the event handler.
    " Note: This does not simulate the actual GUI timer mechanism, only the event handling logic.
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = mv_event_fired msg = 'Timer event should have fired' ).

    mv_event_fired = abap_false.
    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
    " After stop, event should not fire again (if it were a real GUI timer)
    " The assert above is sufficient for basic functionality.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_timer_finished.
    mv_event_fired = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der sich wiederholt, bis er explizit gestoppt wird.
hint: Setzen Sie `cl_gui_timer->repeat` auf `ABAP_TRUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_repeat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS: timer_tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_tick_count) TYPE i.
    METHODS:
      start_repeating_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i,
      stop_repeating_timer,
      handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer. " Public for testing
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA: mv_tick_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_repeat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_repeating_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval. " in seconds
    mo_timer->repeat = abap_true.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    mv_tick_count = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_repeating_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->cancel( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_tick_count = mv_tick_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_tick_count = mv_tick_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_repeating_timer FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_actual_tick_count TYPE i.
    METHODS: on_timer_tick FOR EVENT timer_tick OF zcl_gui_timer_repeat IMPORTING iv_tick_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_repeating_timer.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_repeat( ).
    SET HANDLER on_timer_tick FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->start_repeating_timer( 1 ).
    " Simulate multiple ticks
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Simulate tick 1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_actual_tick_count exp = 1 msg = 'Tick count should be 1' ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Simulate tick 2
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_actual_tick_count exp = 2 msg = 'Tick count should be 2' ).

    lo_cut->stop_repeating_timer( ).
    " Simulate another tick after stop - should not increment if real timer
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " This call would be ignored by real timer
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_actual_tick_count exp = 3 msg = 'Tick count should be 3 (last simulated tick)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_timer_tick.
    mv_actual_tick_count = iv_tick_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die Konfiguration eines sich wiederholenden Timers, der kontinuierlich Ereignisse auslöst, bis er manuell gestoppt wird. Dies ist nützlich für periodische Aktualisierungen oder Überwachungsaufgaben im GUI. Das Ereignis wird für den Unit-Test simuliert.
keywords: Timer, GUI, Event Handling, Repeat, cl_gui_timer

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, dessen Intervall während der Laufzeit geändert werden kann.
hint: Ändern Sie das Attribut `interval` des `cl_gui_timer`-Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS: timer_tick EXPORTING VALUE(iv_current_interval) TYPE i.
    METHODS:
      start_timer IMPORTING iv_initial_interval TYPE i,
      change_interval IMPORTING iv_new_interval TYPE i,
      stop_timer,
      handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer. " Public for testing
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA: mv_current_interval TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
    ENDIF.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_initial_interval.
    mo_timer->repeat = abap_true.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    mv_current_interval = iv_initial_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD change_interval.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->interval = iv_new_interval.
      mv_current_interval = iv_new_interval.
      " To apply immediately, you might need to cancel and rerun,
      " but changing interval directly often works for next tick.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS BOUND.
      mo_timer->cancel( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    RAISE EVENT timer_tick EXPORTING iv_current_interval = mv_current_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_interval FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mv_received_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS: on_timer_tick FOR EVENT timer_tick OF zcl_gui_timer_dynamic IMPORTING iv_current_interval.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_interval.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_dynamic( ).
    SET HANDLER on_timer_tick FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->start_timer( 5 ). " Initial interval 5
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Simulate tick
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_received_interval exp = 5 msg = 'Initial interval should be 5' ).

    lo_cut->change_interval( 2 ). " Change to 2
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Simulate next tick
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_received_interval exp = 2 msg = 'Interval should be 2 after change' ).

    lo_cut->stop_timer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_timer_tick.
    mv_received_interval = iv_current_interval.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt, wie das Intervall eines Timers zur Laufzeit angepasst werden kann, was Flexibilität für Anwendungen bietet, die unterschiedliche Aktualisierungsraten benötigen. Das Ereignis wird für den Unit-Test simuliert.
keywords: Timer, GUI, Dynamic, Interval, cl_gui_timer

Instructions: Erstellen und verwalten Sie mehrere unabhängige Timer-Instanzen, die jeweils ein eigenes Ereignis auslösen.
hint: Erstellen Sie separate Instanzen von `cl_gui_timer` und registrieren Sie separate Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS: timer_instance_finished EXPORTING VALUE(iv_timer_id) TYPE string.
    METHODS:
      create_and_start_timer IMPORTING iv_timer_id TYPE string iv_interval TYPE i,
      stop_timer IMPORTING iv_timer_id TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION. " Made protected for testing purposes
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_timer_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             object TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
           END OF ty_timer_data,
           tt_timer_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_timer_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.
    DATA: mt_timers TYPE tt_timer_data.
    METHODS:
      handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer. " Protected for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_start_timer.
    DATA(ls_timer_data) = VALUE ty_timer_data( id = iv_timer_id ).
    CREATE OBJECT ls_timer_data-object.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR ls_timer_data-object.
    ls_timer_data-object->interval = iv_interval.
    ls_timer_data->object->repeat = abap_false. " One-shot timer for this example
    ls_timer_data-object->run( ).
    INSERT ls_timer_data INTO TABLE mt_timers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    READ TABLE mt_timers WITH KEY id = iv_timer_id INTO DATA(ls_timer_data).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_timer_data-object->cancel( ).
      DELETE TABLE mt_timers FROM ls_timer_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    " Find which timer instance fired the event
    LOOP AT mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_timer_data>).
      IF <fs_timer_data>-object = sender.
        RAISE EVENT timer_instance_finished EXPORTING iv_timer_id = <fs_timer_data>-id.
        DELETE TABLE mt_timers FROM <fs_timer_data>. " Remove one-shot timer
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS lcl_test_multi_timer DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_gui_timer_multi.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_timer_object IMPORTING iv_timer_id TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_timer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
      call_handle_timer_event IMPORTING io_sender TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_test_multi_timer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_timer_object.
    READ TABLE mt_timers WITH KEY id = iv_timer_id INTO DATA(ls_timer_data).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ro_timer = ls_timer_data-object.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_handle_timer_event.
    handle_timer_event( sender = io_sender ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_timers FOR TESTING.
    DATA: mt_finished_timers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS: on_timer_instance_finished FOR EVENT timer_instance_finished OF zcl_gui_timer_multi IMPORTING iv_timer_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_timers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW lcl_test_multi_timer( ). " Use test subclass
    SET HANDLER on_timer_instance_finished FOR lo_cut.

    lo_cut->create_and_start_timer( iv_timer_id = 'TimerA' iv_interval = 1 ).
    lo_cut->create_and_start_timer( iv_timer_id = 'TimerB' iv_interval = 2 ).

    " Get the internal timer objects using the test subclass helper method
    DATA(lo_timer_a_obj) = lo_cut->get_timer_object( 'TimerA' ).
    DATA(lo_timer_b_obj) = lo_cut->get_timer_object( 'TimerB' ).

    " Simulate the 'finished' event for TimerA
    " This directly calls the event handler of the CUT, passing the actual timer object as sender.
    " Note: This does not simulate the actual GUI timer mechanism, only the event handling logic.
    lo_cut->call_handle_timer_event( io_sender = lo_timer_a_obj ).
    " Simulate the 'finished' event for TimerB
    lo_cut->call_handle_timer_event( io_sender = lo_timer_b_obj ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( mt_finished_timers ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two timers should have finished' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_finished_timers[ 1 ]-table_line exp = 'TimerA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mt_finished_timers[ 2 ]-table_line exp = 'TimerB' ).

    " Verify that timers are removed from internal table after firing (one-shot)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->mt_timers ) exp = 0 msg = 'All one-shot timers should be removed' ).

    " Test stop_timer for a non-existent timer (should not cause error)
    lo_cut->stop_timer( 'NonExistentTimer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_timer_instance_finished.
    APPEND iv_timer_id TO mt_finished_timers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt, wie man mehrere `cl_gui_timer`-Instanzen unabhängig voneinander verwalten kann, was für komplexe GUI-Anwendungen mit mehreren zeitgesteuerten Prozessen nützlich ist. Für den Unit-Test wird eine Test-Unterklasse verwendet, um auf geschützte Methoden und Attribute zuzugreifen und die Ereignisauslösung zu simulieren.
keywords: Timer, GUI, Multiple Instances, Object Orientation, cl_gui_timer

Instructions: Generiere eine neue System-UUID und konkateniere sie mit einem Präfix 'LOG_'.
hint: Nutze `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32` und String-Templates oder den `CONCATENATE` Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_basic_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_prefixed_uuid RETURNING VALUE(rv_prefixed_uuid) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_basic_concat IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_prefixed_uuid = |LOG_{ lv_uuid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prefixed_uuid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prefixed_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_basic_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_prefixed_uuid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lv_result exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( msg = 'Result should start with LOG_' act = lv_result exp = 'LOG_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result length should be 36 (4 for LOG_ + 32 for UUID)' act = strlen( lv_result ) exp = 36 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Generierung einer System-UUID mit `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32` und die moderne String-Konkatenation mittels String-Templates. String-Templates sind flexibler und lesbarer als der klassische `CONCATENATE` Befehl.
keywords: UUID, String Templates, CONCATENATE, cl_system_uuid

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit 5 neuen System-UUIDs. Konkateniere jede UUID mit einem Index und speichere sie in einer neuen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze `FOR` Schleifen und den `CONCATENATE` Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_for_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_uuid_entry,
             index TYPE i,
             uuid_with_index TYPE string,
           END OF ty_uuid_entry.
    TYPES tt_uuid_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_uuid_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_indexed_uuids RETURNING VALUE(rt_indexed_uuids) TYPE tt_uuid_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_for_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_uuids.
    DATA(lt_uuids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 5
      ( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) )
    ).

    rt_indexed_uuids = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= lines( lt_uuids )
      LET lv_uuid = lt_uuids[ i ] IN
      ( index = i,
        uuid_with_index = CONCATENATE 'UUID_' i '_' lv_uuid ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_indexed_uuids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_indexed_uuids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_for_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_indexed_uuids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 5 entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( msg = 'First entry should start with UUID_1_' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-uuid_with_index exp = 'UUID_1_' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Length of first UUID string should be 39 (UUID_1_ + 32 for UUID)' act = strlen( lt_result[ 1 ]-uuid_with_index ) exp = 39 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR` Ausdruck, um eine Liste von UUIDs zu generieren und diese dann erneut mit `FOR` zu verarbeiten. Der `CONCATENATE` Befehl wird hier explizit verwendet, um die Anforderung des Keywords zu erfüllen. In modernen ABAP-Programmen werden jedoch String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Konkatenation bevorzugt, da sie flexibler und lesbarer sind.
keywords: UUID, Internal Tables, FOR, CONCATENATE, cl_system_uuid

Instructions: Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle, die eine System-UUID als Schlüssel und einen Text als Wert verwendet. Füge mehrere Einträge hinzu und rufe einen Wert über die UUID ab.
hint: Deklariere eine Hash-Tabelle mit `UNIQUE HASHED KEY` und nutze den `VALUE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY uuid.

    METHODS add_entry IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_uuid) TYPE sysuuid_c32.
    METHODS get_text_by_uuid IMPORTING iv_uuid TYPE sysuuid_c32 RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    rv_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    INSERT VALUE #( uuid = rv_uuid text = iv_text ) INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_by_uuid.
    READ TABLE mt_data WITH TABLE KEY uuid = iv_uuid INTO DATA(ls_data).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_text = ls_data-text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lv_uuid1) = lo_cut->add_entry( 'First Entry' ).
    DATA(lv_uuid2) = lo_cut->add_entry( 'Second Entry' ).

    DATA(lv_text1) = lo_cut->get_text_by_uuid( lv_uuid1 ).
    DATA(lv_text2) = lo_cut->get_text_by_uuid( lv_uuid2 ).
    DATA(lv_text_not_found) = lo_cut->get_text_by_uuid( cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should retrieve First Entry' act = lv_text1 exp = 'First Entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should retrieve Second Entry' act = lv_text2 exp = 'Second Entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should not find text for non-existent UUID' act = lv_text_not_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung einer Hash-Tabelle mit einer System-UUID als eindeutigem Schlüssel. Hash-Tabellen bieten eine sehr effiziente Zugriffszeit (konstant) und sind ideal für Szenarien, in denen schnelle Lookups basierend auf einem Schlüssel erforderlich sind. Der `VALUE` Operator wird für die Inline-Initialisierung der Tabellenzeile verwendet.
keywords: UUID, Hashed Table, Internal Tables, VALUE, cl_system_uuid

Instructions: Generiere eine UUID und extrahiere die ersten 8 Zeichen und die letzten 8 Zeichen. Konkateniere diese beiden Teile mit einem Bindestrich dazwischen.
hint: Nutze String-Operationen wie Offset/Length und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_part_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_uuid_parts RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_uuid) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_part_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_uuid_parts.
    DATA(lv_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_first_part) = lv_uuid(8).
    DATA(lv_last_part) = lv_uuid+24(8).
    rv_formatted_uuid = |{ lv_first_part }-{ lv_last_part }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_uuid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_part_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_uuid_parts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lv_result exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result length should be 17 (8 + 1 + 8)' act = strlen( lv_result ) exp = 17 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain a hyphen' act = lv_result exp = '-' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Extraktion von Teilstrings einer UUID mittels Offset- und Längenangaben (`lv_uuid(8)`, `lv_uuid+24(8)`) und deren anschließende Konkatenation mit einem String-Template. Dies ist eine moderne und prägnante Art der String-Manipulation in ABAP.
keywords: UUID, String Operations, Offset, Length, String Templates, CONCATENATE, cl_system_uuid

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights`. Für jeden Flug, der nach 'FRA' fliegt, generiere eine UUID und konkateniere sie mit der Flugnummer und dem Abflugort. Sammle diese konkatenierten Strings in einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Semikolons, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze `SELECT`, `FOR`, `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_uuids_reduced RETURNING VALUE(rv_reduced_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_uuids_reduced.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE cityto = 'FRA'.

    rv_reduced_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ) IN
      NEXT result = COND string(
        WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ lv_uuid }-{ ls_sflight-fldate }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
        ELSE |{ result };{ lv_uuid }-{ ls_sflight-fldate }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_uuid_log_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS create_log_entry IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_log_entry) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_uuid_log_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_entry.
    DATA(lv_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_timestamp).

    CONCATENATE lv_timestamp_str ' | ' lv_uuid ' | ' iv_message INTO rv_log_entry SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere eine UUID. Wenn die UUID mit 'A' beginnt, konkateniere sie mit 'Special_', ansonsten mit 'Normal_'. Nutze den `COND` Ausdruck.
hint: Nutze `COND` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_cond_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_conditional_uuid_prefix RETURNING VALUE(rv_prefixed_uuid) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_cond_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_uuid_prefix.
    DATA(lv_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lv_prefix) = COND string(
      WHEN lv_uuid CP 'A*' THEN 'Special_'
      ELSE 'Normal_'
    ).
    rv_prefixed_uuid = |{ lv_prefix }{ lv_uuid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_uuid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_cond_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_conditional_uuid_prefix( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lv_result ).
    DATA(lv_starts_with_special) = xsdbool( lv_result CP 'Special_*' ).
    DATA(lv_starts_with_normal) = xsdbool( lv_result CP 'Normal_*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should start with either Special_ or Normal_' act = lv_starts_with_special OR lv_starts_with_normal ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result length should be 32 + 8 (Special_) or 32 + 7 (Normal_)' act = strlen( lv_result ) exp = COND i( WHEN lv_starts_with_special THEN 40 ELSE 39 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights`. Gruppiere die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und erstelle für jede Gruppe einen Eintrag in einer neuen Tabelle. Jeder Eintrag soll eine generierte UUID, die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge in dieser Gruppe enthalten. Nutze den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutze `FOR ... GROUP BY` und `cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_for_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             group_id TYPE sysuuid_c32,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_for_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
      ( group_id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ),
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
        count    = GROUP SIZE ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus `sflights`. Gruppiere die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`). Für jede Gruppe, generiere eine eindeutige UUID als Gruppen-ID und konkateniere sie mit dem `CARRID`. Gib eine Tabelle mit diesen Gruppen-IDs und der Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe zurück.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_sflight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_info,
             group_uuid TYPE string,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_group_info.
    TYPES tt_group_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_uuids RETURNING VALUE(rt_group_info) TYPE tt_group_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_sflight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_uuids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_group_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
      DATA(lv_group_id) = |GROUP_{ ls_sflight-carrid }_{ lv_group_uuid }|.
      APPEND VALUE #( group_uuid = lv_group_id
                      carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_group_info.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_grouped_flight_uuids FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_uuid_sflight_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_uuids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( msg = 'Result table should have at least one entry' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( msg = 'Group UUID should start with GROUP_' act = ls_group_info-group_uuid exp = 'GROUP_' ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 0' act = ls_group_info-flight_count exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Length of group_uuid should be 42 (6 for GROUP_ + 3 for CARRID + 1 for _ + 32 for UUID)' act = strlen( ls_group_info-group_uuid ) exp = 42 ).

Instructions: Exportiere Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine XLSX-Datei. Die Daten sollen dabei modern aufbereitet und über die Klasse `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` exportiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` zur Erstellung des XLSX-Dokuments und `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` zum Speichern. Beachten Sie, dass `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` möglicherweise spezifische Abhängigkeiten hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_xlsx_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.xlsx'
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_xlsx_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_xlsx.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
          lv_xstring  TYPE xstring.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Create XLSX document
      DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
      lo_xlsx->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten' ).
      lo_xlsx->add_table(
        EXPORTING
          it_table = lt_sflights
          iv_sheet_name = 'Flugdaten'
          iv_start_row = 1
          iv_start_column = 1
      ).
      lv_xstring = lo_xlsx->get_xstring( ).

      " Download to frontend
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
        EXPORTING
          bin_filesize = xstrlen( lv_xstring )
          filename     = iv_filename
          filetype     = 'BIN'
        CHANGING
          data_xstr    = lv_xstring
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS       = 1
      ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error downloading file'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Handle no data case
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No flight data found to export'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_export_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_export_no_data FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_success.
    " Mock cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download to prevent actual download
    " and cl_ehfnd_xlsx to prevent actual XLSX creation for unit test.
    " This is a simplified test. In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles.
    " For this example, we'll just check if the method can be called without immediate error.
    " A proper test would involve mocking the external dependencies.

    " To make this test runnable without actual GUI interaction or EHFND setup,
    " we'll catch the expected exceptions.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_sflights_xlsx_export( ).
    TRY.
        lo_exporter->export_sflights_to_xlsx( iv_filename = 'test_sflights.xlsx' ).
        " If we reach here, it means the internal logic ran without crashing.
        " A real test would verify the content of lv_xstring or mock the download.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected GUI download or XLSX error to be caught' ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Expected exceptions if not running in a full environment or with mocks
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Test passed if exception is caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_export_no_data.
    " To simulate no data, we would need to mock sflights or ensure it's empty.
    " For this example, we'll assume sflights might be empty and test the exception.
    " This test is more conceptual without a proper mocking framework.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_sflights_xlsx_export( ).
    TRY.
        " Assuming sflights is empty for this test case or can be mocked.
        " For a real test, you'd ensure sflights is empty or mock the SELECT.
        lo_exporter->export_sflights_to_xlsx( iv_filename = 'empty_sflights.xlsx' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error for no data' ).
      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_ehfnd).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = lx_ehfnd->get_text( )
          exp = 'No flight data found to export'
          msg = 'Incorrect error message for no data'
        ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected cx_gui_frontend_services exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den Export von Daten in eine XLSX-Datei unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_ehfnd_xlsx`. Moderne ABAP-Features wie Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_xlsx)`) und String-Templates für Fehlermeldungen werden genutzt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die Währungscodes aus `sflights` enthält, wobei die Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator in einer Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_flight_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid   = CONV #( to_upper( ls_flight-carrid ) )
          connid   = ls_flight-connid
          currency = ls_flight-currency ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some flight data, but table is empty.'
      if_not_initial = abap_true
    ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = to_upper( ls_first_entry-carrid )
        exp = ls_first_entry-carrid
        msg = 'Carrier ID should be uppercase.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ermöglicht die Transformation und Iteration über interne Tabellen in einer deklarativen und funktionalen Weise. In diesem Beispiel wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, indem über `sflights` iteriert und die `carrid` in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird, alles innerhalb einer einzigen Expression. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Transformation, CONV, TO_UPPER

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT passengers FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lv_total
      msg = 'Total passengers should be a valid number.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_total >= 0 )
      msg = 'Total passengers should be non-negative.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Expression. Hier wird die Summe der Passagiere aller Flüge berechnet, was eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Alternative zu einer `LOOP` mit manueller Summenbildung darstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Functional

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht, die Informationen zu einem Flug (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für eine einfache und lesbare Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_message
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_message.
    rv_message = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER } hat { is_flight-passengers } Passagiere.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_message FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_message.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '400'.
    ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
    ls_flight-passengers = 150.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_templates( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_flight_message( ls_flight ).

    DATA(lv_expected_part1) = |Flug LH 400 am |.

    ).

      haystack = lv_message
      needle   = sy-datum+6(2) && '.' && sy-datum+4(2) && '.' && sy-datum+0(4)

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglichen eine intuitive und typsichere Erstellung von Strings. Variablen und Ausdrücke können direkt in den String eingebettet werden, was die Lesbarkeit gegenüber `CONCATENATE` oder `WRITE TO` erheblich verbessert. Formatierungsoptionen wie `DATE = USER` sind direkt integrierbar.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, Formatting, DATE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der Passagiere: 'Voll' bei über 100 Passagieren, 'Normal' bei 50-100 Passagieren und 'Leer' bei unter 50 Passagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_passengers TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_passengers > 100 THEN 'Voll'
      WHEN iv_passengers >= 50 THEN 'Normal'
      ELSE 'Leer'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

  METHOD test_status_normal.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 75 )

      msg = 'Status should be Normal for 50-100 passengers.'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Normal'
      msg = 'Status should be Normal for 50 passengers.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 100 )

      msg = 'Status should be Normal for 100 passengers.'

explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Fallunterscheidung, die einen Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zurückgibt. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Statements oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, besonders wenn es um die Zuweisung eines einzelnen Wertes geht.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die Flugdaten verarbeitet und eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Logger) über den Konstruktor injiziert bekommt.
hint: Nutzen Sie Constructor Injection, um Abhängigkeiten zu verwalten.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger READ-ONLY METHODS log_message.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_data.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Processing flight { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }.| ).
    " ... further processing logic ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flight_data.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_flight-connid = '001'.

    " Create a mock logger for testing
    CLASS lcl_mock_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_console_logger FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA mv_logged_message TYPE string.
        INTERFACES zif_logger.
        METHODS zif_logger~log_message REDEFINITION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
        mv_logged_message = iv_message.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_mock_logger) = NEW lcl_mock_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( io_logger = lo_mock_logger ).

    lo_processor->process_flight_data( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_mock_logger->mv_logged_message
      exp = 'Processing flight AA 001.'
      msg = 'Logger should have recorded the correct message.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Entwurfsmuster, bei dem Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitgestellt werden. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert das Testen (durch Mocking von Abhängigkeiten) und verbessert die Wartbarkeit des Codes. Die Verwendung von Interfaces (`zif_logger`) sorgt für Flexibilität.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Interface, Dependency Injection, Mocking

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Fluges in Stunden und Minuten, gegeben Start- und Endzeitstempel.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitstempel-Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             hours   TYPE i,
             minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.

    METHODS calculate_flight_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_end_tstmp   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_duration) TYPE ty_flight_duration
      RAISING
        cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_timestamp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_duration.
    DATA: lv_seconds TYPE i.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      EXPORTING
        timestamp1 = iv_end_tstmp
        timestamp2 = iv_start_tstmp
      IMPORTING
        r_seconds  = lv_seconds
    ).

    rs_duration-hours = lv_seconds DIV 3600.
    rs_duration-minutes = ( lv_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_duration FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_timestamps FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_datetime(
      iv_date = '20231026'
      iv_time = '100000'
    ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_datetime(
      iv_date = '20231026'
      iv_time = '123000'
    ).

    DATA(ls_duration) = lo_cut->calculate_flight_duration(
      iv_start_tstmp = lv_start_tstmp
      iv_end_tstmp   = lv_end_tstmp
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_duration-hours
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 hours duration.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_duration-minutes
      exp = 30
      msg = 'Expected 30 minutes duration.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_datetime(
      iv_date = '20231026'
      iv_time = '100000'
    ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_datetime(
      iv_date = '20231026'
      iv_time = '090000'
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_flight_duration(
          iv_start_tstmp = lv_start_tstmp
          iv_end_tstmp   = lv_end_tstmp
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_timestamp for end < start.' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_timestamp.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Expected exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet eine robuste und präzise Möglichkeit zur Manipulation und Berechnung mit Zeitstempeln. Die Methode `subtract` liefert die Differenz in Sekunden, die dann einfach in Stunden und Minuten umgerechnet werden kann. Dies ist die empfohlene Methode für Zeitstempel-Operationen in modernem ABAP.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, cl_abap_tstmp, Calculation

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String durch ein anderes Zeichen.

unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_all_occurrences.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_char(
      iv_input_string = 'Hello World'

    ).

  METHOD test_no_occurrence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_char(
      iv_input_string = 'Hello World'

      iv_new_char     = 'a'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hello World'
      msg = 'String should remain unchanged if old char is not found.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.

      iv_new_char     = 'b'
    ).

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die eingebaute Funktion `replace` (ab ABAP 7.50) bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, Zeichen oder Zeichenketten in einem String zu ersetzen. Der Parameter `occ = 0` stellt sicher, dass alle Vorkommen ersetzt werden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als ältere Methoden wie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, String Function, Character Replacement

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `GROUP BY` Aggregation auf der Tabelle `sflights` durch, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES tt_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, SUM( passengers ) AS total_passengers
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_passengers_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_passengers_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some aggregated data, but table is empty.'
      if_not_initial = abap_true
    ).

    " Check for a specific carrier if data is known
    DATA(ls_lh_passengers) = VALUE ty_carrier_passengers( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_passengers WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_lh_passengers-total_passengers > 0 )
        msg = 'Lufthansa should have more than 0 passengers.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne Open SQL-Statements erlauben komplexe Aggregationen direkt in der Datenbank mittels `GROUP BY`. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`INTO TABLE @rt_result`) wird der Code sehr prägnant und performant, da die Datenaggregation direkt auf der Datenbankebene stattfindet und nur das Ergebnis an das ABAP-Programm übertragen wird.
keywords: Open SQL, GROUP BY, Aggregation, SUM, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `GROUP BY` Aggregation auf der Tabelle `sflights` durch, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, aber verwenden Sie dabei eine interne Tabellenexpression anstelle von Open SQL.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Operator in einer Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_group_by_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_passengers,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_passengers.
    TYPES tt_carrier_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passengers_by_carrier_it
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passengers_by_carrier_it.
    DATA(lt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, passengers FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_result = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_passengers_by_carrier_it FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_passengers_by_carrier_it.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_group_by_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_passengers_by_carrier_it( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Expected some aggregated data, but table is empty.'
      if_not_initial = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_passengers) = VALUE ty_carrier_passengers( ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_lh_passengers WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_lh_passengers-total_passengers > 0 )
        msg = 'Lufthansa should have more than 0 passengers.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF` Operator in Tabellenexpressionen ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten innerhalb interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine rein ABAP-basierte Alternative zur `GROUP BY`-Klausel in Open SQL und bietet Flexibilität, wenn die Daten bereits im Arbeitsspeicher sind oder komplexere Gruppierungslogiken erforderlich sind.
keywords: Internal Table, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS OF, REDUCE, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der gesamten Sitzplatzkapazität aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle SFlight.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total capacity for LH should be positive' act = lv_total_capacity > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_total_capacity) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total capacity for non-existent carrier should be 0'
                                        act = lv_total_capacity
                                        exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert (z.B. eine Summe, einen Zähler oder einen komplexeren Wert) zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Hilfsvariablen zu verwenden. Dies macht den Code kompakter und funktionaler.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Summation, sflight

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFlight, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und der Anzahl der freien Sitzplätze für diese Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den FILTER-Operator mit dem FOR-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ny_flight_info,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             freesets TYPE i,
           END OF ty_ny_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_ny_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_ny_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_ny_flights_free_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_ny_flights) TYPE tt_ny_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ny_flights_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_ny_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
                             ( connid   = flight-connid
                               freesets = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der Tabelle SFlight existiert. Wenn ja, geben Sie den Zielflughafen zurück, ansonsten 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `TABLE_LINE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_destination_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cityto) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_destination_if_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrier connid = iv_connid ] ).
      rv_cityto = TABLE_LINE( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrier connid = iv_connid ] )-cityto.
    ELSE.
      rv_cityto = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine funktionale Methode, um zu prüfen, ob eine Zeile mit einem bestimmten Schlüssel in einer internen Tabelle existiert, ohne einen Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen, wenn die Zeile nicht gefunden wird. `TABLE_LINE` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die gefundene Zeile. Diese Kombination ist eine moderne und sichere Alternative zu `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und dem anschließenden Zugriff, da sie den Code kompakter und robuster macht.

    EVENTS html_button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(i_param) TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_html_event FOR EVENT html_button_clicked OF zcl_html_viewer_event
      IMPORTING i_param.

CLASS zcl_html_viewer_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_html_with_button.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_html_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_html_viewer,
          lv_html_string TYPE string.

    lv_html_string = |<html><body><button onclick="window.external.fireEvent('html_button_clicked', 'Button was clicked!');">Click Me</button></body></html>|.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_html_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    " Register for the event
    SET HANDLER me->handle_html_event FOR me.
    lo_html_viewer->register_for_event(
      EXPORTING
        eventid = 'html_button_clicked'
    ).

    lo_html_viewer->load_data(
      EXPORTING
        url          = 'about:blank'
        data_table   = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_html_string )
        size         = xstrlen( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_html_string ) )
    ).

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_html_event.
    " In a real application, you would process i_param here.
    " For demonstration, we'll just write to the console.
    WRITE: / 'HTML Button Clicked with parameter:', i_param.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_add_data IMPLEMENTATION.

          lo_worksheet      TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_xlsx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    TYPES: tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_xlsx_data IMPORTING iv_xlsx_xstring TYPE xstring
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_excel_data) TYPE tt_excel_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_xlsx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_xlsx_data.
    DATA: lo_openxml_helper TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lo_workbook       TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_workbook,
          lo_worksheet      TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_worksheet,
          lv_max_row        TYPE i,
          lv_max_col        TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_openxml_helper.
    lo_workbook = lo_openxml_helper->load_workbook_from_xstring( iv_xlsx_xstring ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_workbook->get_worksheet_by_index( iv_index = 1 ). " First sheet

    IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.
      lv_max_row = lo_worksheet->get_max_row( ).
      lv_max_col = lo_worksheet->get_max_column( ).

      LOOP AT cl_abap_range_tab=>create_for_int( iv_low = 1 iv_high = lv_max_row ) INTO DATA(lv_row).
        DATA(ls_excel_row) = VALUE ty_excel_row( ).
        ls_excel_row-col1 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 ).
        ls_excel_row-col2 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 ).
        ls_excel_row-col3 = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 ).
        APPEND ls_excel_row TO rt_excel_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_xlsx FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_xlsx.
    " Create a dummy XLSX with known content
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_openxml_create_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_xlsx) = lo_creator->create_simple_xlsx( ). " Contains 'Header 1', 'Header 2', 'Data A', '123', 'Data B', '456'

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_openxml_read_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lt_read_data) = lo_cut->read_xlsx_data( lv_initial_xlsx ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_read_data ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 rows' ).
    READ TABLE lt_read_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_row1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_row1-col1 exp = 'Header 1' msg = 'Incorrect value in row 1, col 1' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine XLSX-Datei mit mehreren Arbeitsblättern, wobei jedes Arbeitsblatt Daten aus der sflights-Tabelle basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR-Iteratoren und GROUP BY, um die sflights-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und separate Arbeitsblätter zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_xlsx RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_xlsx.
    DATA: lo_openxml_helper TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lo_workbook       TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_workbook,
          lt_sflights       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_openxml_helper.
    lo_workbook = lo_openxml_helper->create_workbook( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_workbook->create_worksheet( iv_name = lv_carrid ).

      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Connection ID' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 3 iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 4 iv_value = 'Price' ).

      DATA(lv_row) = 1.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_sflight).
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_grouped_sflight-carrid ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_grouped_sflight-connid ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 3 iv_value = ls_grouped_sflight-fldate ).
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 4 iv_value = ls_grouped_sflight-price ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_openxml_helper->save_workbook_to_xstring( lo_workbook ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_and_download_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR ls_flight IN sflights ( ls_flight ) ).

    DATA(lv_file_content) = VALUE string(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( |Flug { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }: { ls_flight-cityfrom } -> { ls_flight-cityto }| & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf )
    ).

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_file_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lv_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflights`, berechnen Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere für diese Flüge und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit `WRITE` aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator und den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR ls_flight IN sflights ( ls_flight ) ).

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER sflights_tt( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).

    WRITE: / 'Total passengers for carrier', iv_carrier, ':', rv_total_passengers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Struktur einer internen Tabelle dynamisch aus (z.B. `sflights`) und zeigen Sie die Feldnamen und deren Werte für die erste Zeile auf dem Frontend an.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff. Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` um die Informationen in einer Textdatei zu speichern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_table_structure
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_table_structure.
    DATA: lv_output_content TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      lv_output_content = 'Tabelle ist leer.'.
    ELSE.
      READ TABLE it_data INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_line> ).
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
        DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        lv_output_content = |Struktur der Tabelle:| & cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            lv_output_content = lv_output_content &&
                                |  Feld: { ls_component-name }, Wert: { <fs_field> }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_file_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lv_output_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert und eine eigene Exception wirft. Fangen Sie diese Exception modern ab und geben Sie die Fehlermeldung oder das Ergebnis mit `WRITE` aus.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.
    METHODS perform_division_and_output
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        MESSAGE e001(sy) WITH 'Division by zero attempted'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_and_output.
    DATA: lv_message TYPE string.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = divide( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
        WRITE: / 'Result:', lv_result.
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_div_zero).
        lv_message = lx_div_zero->get_text( ).
        WRITE: / 'Error:', lv_message.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
        WRITE: / 'Unexpected Error:', lv_message.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
