Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtanzahl der belegten Sitze. Geben Sie die Ergebnisse mit `WRITE` aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE` Operator innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count   TYPE i,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_summarize_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_summarize_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR ls_flight IN sflights ( ls_flight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ).
      ls_summary-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      ls_summary-total_passengers = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc
      ).
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.

      WRITE: / 'Carrier:', ls_summary-carrid,
             'Flights:', ls_summary-flight_count,
             'Passengers:', ls_summary-total_passengers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie Table Expressions mit `itab[ key = value ]` Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.
    METHODS output_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tt( FOR ls_flight IN sflights ( ls_flight ) ).

    TRY.
        rv_price = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_price = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD output_flight_price.
    DATA(lv_price) = get_flight_price( iv_carrid = iv_carrid iv_connid = iv_connid ).
    IF lv_price > 0.
      WRITE: / 'Price for flight', iv_carrid, iv_connid, ':', lv_price.
    ELSE.
      WRITE: / 'Flight', iv_carrid, iv_connid, 'not found or price is zero.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_category,
             code TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_category.
    METHODS get_status_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_rest_status_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_category.
    DATA(lv_first_digit) = iv_status_code DIV 100.

    rv_category = CASE lv_first_digit.

                    WHEN 2 THEN 'Success'
                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Redirection'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'Client Error'
                    WHEN 5 THEN 'Server Error'
                    ELSE 'Unknown'

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von HTTP-Statuscodes nach ihrer Kategorie (Informational, Success, Redirection, Client Error, Server Error) unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und einer Hilfsfunktion zur Kategorisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_entry,
             code TYPE i,
           END OF ty_status_entry,
           tt_status_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_entry WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_status,
             category TYPE string,
             codes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_status,
           tt_grouped_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_status_codes
      IMPORTING
        it_status_codes TYPE tt_status_entries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_status) TYPE tt_grouped_status.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_category_for_code
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_status_codes.
    rt_grouped_status = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF status_entry IN it_status_codes
                                  GROUP BY ( category = get_category_for_code( status_entry-code ) )
                                  ( category = status_entry-category
                                    codes = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP status_entry ( member-code ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_category_for_code.
    DATA(lv_first_digit) = iv_status_code DIV 100.
    rv_category = CASE lv_first_digit.
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'Informational'
                    WHEN 2 THEN 'Success'
                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Redirection'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'Client Error'
                    WHEN 5 THEN 'Server Error'
                    ELSE 'Unknown'
                  END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_status_group( ).
    DATA(lt_input_codes) = VALUE zcl_rest_status_group=>tt_status_entries(
      ( code = 200 ) ( code = 404 ) ( code = 500 ) ( code = 201 ) ( code = 302 ) ( code = 400 ) ( code = 101 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_status_codes( lt_input_codes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Kategorien gefunden werden' ).

    DATA(ls_success) = lt_grouped[ category = 'Success' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_success-codes ) exp = 2 msg = '2 Success Codes erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_success-codes[ 200 ] ). " Check if 200 exists
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_success-codes[ 201 ] ). " Check if 201 exists

    DATA(ls_client_error) = lt_grouped[ category = 'Client Error' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( ls_client_error-codes ) exp = 2 msg = '2 Client Error Codes erwartet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_client_error-codes[ 404 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_client_error-codes[ 400 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Syntax, die ab ABAP 7.50 verfügbar ist. Sie ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, hier basierend auf der HTTP-Statuscode-Kategorie, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: REST, HTTP, Status Code, Grouping, FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_i18n_get_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_translated_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message_class TYPE sy-msgid
        iv_message_number TYPE sy-msgno
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_translated_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_get_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_translated_message.
    " In a real scenario, ZMSG_TEST 001 would exist with translations.
    " For demonstration, we simulate the translation.
    IF iv_message_class = 'ZMSG_TEST' AND iv_message_number = '001'.
      IF iv_language = 'DE'.
        rv_translated_text = 'Hallo Welt!'.
      ELSEIF iv_language = 'EN'.
        rv_translated_text = 'Hello World!'.
      ELSE.
        rv_translated_text = 'Hello World!'. " Default
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_translated_text = 'Nachricht nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.

    " The actual call would look like this if the message existed:
    " rv_translated_text = cl_i18n_utils=>get_text_in_language(
    "   iv_msgid = iv_message_class
    "   iv_msgno = iv_message_number
    "   iv_language = iv_language
    " ).

Instructions: Übersetzen Sie einen dynamischen Text mit Platzhaltern in eine Zielsprache, wobei die Platzhalterwerte beibehalten werden. Nehmen Sie an, der übersetzte Text wird von einer externen Quelle oder einem Nachrichtenpool bezogen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_i18n_utils` zur Textbeschaffung (simuliert) und String Templates zur Ersetzung der Platzhalter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_placeholder_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS translate_with_placeholders
      IMPORTING
        iv_template_key TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
        it_placeholders TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_translated_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_translated_template
      IMPORTING
        iv_template_key TYPE string
        iv_language TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_template) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_placeholder_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD translate_with_placeholders.
    DATA(lv_template) = get_translated_template( iv_template_key = iv_template_key iv_language = iv_language ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lv_template.

    LOOP AT it_placeholders INTO DATA(lv_placeholder_value) FROM 1.
      DATA(lv_placeholder_marker) = |\{{ sy-tabix - 1 }\}|. " e.g., {0}, {1}
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_placeholder_marker IN lv_result WITH lv_placeholder_value.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_translated_string = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_translated_template.
    " Simulate fetching a translated template. In a real scenario, this would come from a message class or text repository.
    CASE iv_template_key.
      WHEN 'GREETING_TEMPLATE'.
        IF iv_language = 'DE'.
          rv_template = 'Hallo {0}, heute ist der {1}.'.
        ELSEIF iv_language = 'EN'.
          rv_template = 'Hello {0}, today is {1}.'.
        ELSE.
          rv_template = 'Hello {0}, today is {1}.'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_template = 'Template not found: {0}'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_placeholder_translation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_placeholder_text( ).
    DATA(lt_placeholders) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Max Mustermann' ) ( '07.12.2023' ) ).

    DATA(lv_translated_de) = lo_cut->translate_with_placeholders(
      iv_template_key = 'GREETING_TEMPLATE'
      iv_language = 'DE'
      it_placeholders = lt_placeholders
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_translated_de exp = 'Hallo Max Mustermann, heute ist der 07.12.2023.' ).

    DATA(lv_translated_en) = lo_cut->translate_with_placeholders(

      iv_language = 'EN'
      it_placeholders = lt_placeholders

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt für Flugpreise basierend auf dem Preisbereich. Wenn der Preis über 1000 liegt, 10% Rabatt; über 500, 5% Rabatt; sonst kein Rabatt. Messen Sie die Laufzeit dieser Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `COND` Expression mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Logik und `cl_abap_runtime` für die Performance-Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_discount,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             discount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_discount.
    TYPES tt_flight_discount TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_discount WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_discount
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_discounts) TYPE tt_flight_discount.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rt_flight_discounts = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                     price    = ls_sflight-price
                                     discount = COND decfloat16(
                                                  WHEN ls_sflight-price > 1000 THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.10'
                                                  WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500  THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.05'
                                                  ELSE '0'
                                                )
                                   ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man lv_duration loggen oder weiterverarbeiten.
    " Für diesen Beispielcode wird es hier nicht direkt in den Rückgabewert integriert.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discount.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-price = 1200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-price = 750.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_sflight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_discount( ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_res1).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_res2).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_res3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Discount for 300' act = ls_res3-discount exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf dem Carrier-ID (z.B. 'LH' -> 'Lufthansa', 'UA' -> 'United', 'AA' -> 'American', sonst 'Other'). Nutzen Sie die `SWITCH` Expression und messen Sie die Laufzeit der Kategorisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SWITCH` Expression mit `WHEN` für die Fallunterscheidung und `cl_abap_runtime` zur Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrier_name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_categories
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_categories) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_categories.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rt_flight_categories = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                    ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                      fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                      carrier_name = SWITCH string(
                                                       ls_sflight-carrid
                                                       WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                                       WHEN 'UA' THEN 'United Airlines'
                                                       WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                                       ELSE 'Other Carrier'
                                                     )
                                    ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge, die einen bestimmten Carrier und eine bestimmte Connection ID haben. Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `WHEN` für die Filterung. Messen Sie die Laufzeit.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung (impliziert `WHEN` für die Filterung) und `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                  ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                    connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                    fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                    status   = COND string(
                                                 WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum AND ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN 'Delayed'
                                                 WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum AND ls_sflight-price <= 500 THEN 'On Time (Past)'
                                                 WHEN ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Today'
                                                 ELSE 'On Time'
                                               )
                                  ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

                                                                    ELSE 0
                                                                  ) ).

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_subgroup,
             category TYPE string,
             flights  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_subgroup.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             subgroups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_subgroup WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_category
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_category.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                  GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    subgroups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_subflight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                         GROUP BY COND string(
                                                                    WHEN ls_subflight-distance > 500 THEN 'Long Haul'
                                                                    ELSE 'Short Haul'
                                                                  )
                                                         ( category = GROUP KEY
                                                           flights  = VALUE #( FOR ls_final_flight IN GROUP ls_subflight ( ls_final_flight ) ) )
                                                       )
                                  ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_message
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_message.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rv_message = |Flug { is_sflight-carrid } { is_sflight-connid } am {
                   COND string(
                     WHEN is_sflight-fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Heute'
                     WHEN is_sflight-fldate = sy-datum - 1 THEN 'Gestern'
                     WHEN is_sflight-fldate = sy-datum + 1 THEN 'Morgen'
                     ELSE |{ is_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                   )
                 } mit Preis { is_sflight-price CURRENCY = is_sflight-currency }|.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bonus DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_bonus,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             bonus    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_bonus.
    TYPES tt_flight_bonus TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_bonus WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_flight_bonus
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bonuses) TYPE tt_flight_bonus.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bonus IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_bonus.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rt_flight_bonuses = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                 LET lv_occupancy = COND decfloat16(
                                                      WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_sflight-seatsocc / ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                                      ELSE '0'
                                                    ) IN
                                 ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                   price    = ls_sflight-price
                                   bonus    = COND decfloat16(
                                                WHEN lv_occupancy > '0.9' THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.20'
                                                WHEN lv_occupancy > '0.7' THEN ls_sflight-price * '0.10'
                                                ELSE '0'
                                              )
                                 ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = 1000. <fs_sflight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 95.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-price = 1000. <fs_sflight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 80.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0001'. <fs_sflight>-price = 1000. <fs_sflight>-seatsmax = 100. <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = 60.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bonus( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_flight_bonus( lt_sflights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_res1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Bonus for >90%' act = ls_res1-bonus exp = '200.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_res2).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen und Werten filtert. Die Filterbedingungen sollen mit `WHEN` in einer `COND` Expression dynamisch aufgebaut werden. Messen Sie die Laufzeit.
hint: Nutzen Sie dynamische Tabellenzugriffe und `COND` mit `WHEN` für die Filterlogik. `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter_param,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_filter_param.
    TYPES tt_filter_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filter_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        it_filter_params TYPE tt_filter_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    " Dies ist eine vereinfachte dynamische Filterung. Eine echte dynamische Filterung
    " würde FIELD-SYMBOLS und dynamische WHERE-Klauseln erfordern, die nicht direkt
    " in COND/WHEN integrierbar sind. Hier wird eine Iteration mit COND/WHEN simuliert.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lv_match) = abap_true.
      LOOP AT it_filter_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
        " Hier müsste man dynamisch auf ls_sflight zugreifen, z.B. mit ASSIGN COMPONENT
        " Für dieses Beispiel simulieren wir eine feste Bedingung für 'CARRID'
        IF ls_param-field_name = 'CARRID'.
          lv_match = COND abap_bool(
                       WHEN ls_sflight-carrid = ls_param-field_value THEN abap_true
                       ELSE abap_false
                     ).
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_match = abap_false. EXIT. ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_match = abap_true.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_filtered_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'.

    DATA: lt_filter_params TYPE zcl_dynamic_filter=>tt_filter_params.
    APPEND VALUE #( field_name = 'CARRID' field_value = 'LH' ) TO lt_filter_params.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_sflights = lt_sflights it_filter_params = lt_filter_params ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered count for LH' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_res1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered CARRIER' act = ls_res1-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl eine vollständig dynamische Filterung mit `COND`/`WHEN` in ABAP komplex ist (oft erfordert sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und dynamische `WHERE`-Klauseln, die nicht direkt in Ausdrücke integriert sind), zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie `COND` mit `WHEN` in einer Schleife verwendet werden kann, um bedingte Logik für dynamische Kriterien zu implementieren. Es demonstriert die Flexibilität von `COND` auch in Szenarien, die eine gewisse Dynamik erfordern. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Performance dieser iterativen, bedingten Verarbeitung zu messen.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit und führen Sie basierend darauf eine spezifische Aktion aus. Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` mit `WHEN` und messen Sie die Laufzeit der Typenprüfung.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA: mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi( ) * mv_radius ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA: mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side ** 2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_shape
      IMPORTING
        io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_shape.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle.
        rv_description = |Dies ist ein Kreis mit Radius { io_shape->mv_radius } und Fläche { io_shape->get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square.
        rv_description = |Dies ist ein Quadrat mit Seitenlänge { io_shape->mv_side } und Fläche { io_shape->get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannte Form'.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Filterung, Transformation und Aggregation von Flugdaten in einer funktionalen Kette. Filtern Sie Flüge eines Carriers, transformieren Sie den Preis (z.B. verdoppeln) und summieren Sie dann die transformierten Preise. Nutzen Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` und `REDUCE` mit `WHEN` und messen Sie die Laufzeit.
hint: Ketten Sie `FILTER`, `FOR` und `REDUCE` Ausdrücke. Verwenden Sie `COND` mit `WHEN` für bedingte Logik und `cl_abap_runtime`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_transformed_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    rv_total_transformed_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                           FOR ls_filtered_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                                                               WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
                                           NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND sflight-price(
                                                                           WHEN ls_filtered_flight-price > 0 THEN ls_filtered_flight-price * 2
                                                                           ELSE 0
                                                                         ) ).

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_functional_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_functional_chain.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_sflight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_sflight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_sflight>-price = 500.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    " (100 * 2) + (200 * 2) = 200 + 400 = 600
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total transformed price for LH' act = lv_total exp = 600 ).

    lv_total = lo_cut->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'UA' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).
    " (500 * 2) = 1000
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total transformed price for UA' act = lv_total exp = 1000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der funktionalen Programmierung in modernem ABAP durch das Verketten von Ausdrücken wie `FILTER`, `FOR` und `REDUCE`. Die `COND` Expression mit `WHEN` wird hier verwendet, um eine bedingte Transformation (Preisverdopplung) direkt in der Aggregation durchzuführen. Dies führt zu einem sehr kompakten, lesbaren und effizienten Code, der komplexe Datenverarbeitungsschritte in einer einzigen Anweisung ausdrückt. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Performance dieser funktionalen Kette zu messen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, REDUCE, COND, WHEN, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, Performance, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch aus, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen und `WHEN` in einer `CASE` Anweisung zur Validierung. Messen Sie die Laufzeit des dynamischen Aufrufs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen und `CASE` mit `WHEN` zur Validierung. `cl_abap_runtime` für die Messung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS _method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DATA(lv_method_name_upper) = to_upper( iv_method_name ).

    CASE lv_method_name_upper.
      WHEN '_METHOD_A'.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name_upper) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      WHEN '_METHOD_B'.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name_upper) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 'Methode nicht gefunden oder nicht erlaubt'.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    DATA(lv_duration) = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_text = 'Ergebnis von Methode A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_text = 'Ergebnis von Methode B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).

    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( '_method_a' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Call Method A' act = lv_result_a exp = 'Ergebnis von Methode A' ).

    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( '_method_b' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Call Method B' act = lv_result_b exp = 'Ergebnis von Methode B' ).

    DATA(lv_result_invalid) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'invalid_method' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Call Invalid Method' act = lv_result_invalid exp = 'Methode nicht gefunden oder nicht erlaubt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible Architekturen. Die `CASE`-Anweisung mit `WHEN` ist hier entscheidend, um die Sicherheit zu gewährleisten, indem nur erlaubte Methoden dynamisch aufgerufen werden können. Dies verhindert unerwünschte Zugriffe und macht den dynamischen Code robuster. `cl_abap_runtime` wird verwendet, um die Performance des dynamischen Aufrufs und der Validierung zu messen.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, CASE, WHEN, Performance

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer Struktur zur Laufzeit aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_struct_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_components.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type->get_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` in Kombination mit RTTI, um den Feldnamen zu validieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).

    " Check if field exists using RTTI first
    DATA(lv_field_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
        lv_field_exists = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_exists = abap_true.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_value = <fs_value>.
      ELSE.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_component_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_read_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing_field RAISING cx_sy_assign_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_read( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_field_name = 'CONNID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing_field.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_read( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_field_value( is_structure = ls_sflight iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTING_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_assign_error was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von RTTI und Field-Symbols ermöglicht hochdynamische Programmierung. Bevor `ASSIGN COMPONENT` verwendet wird, kann RTTI genutzt werden, um die Existenz des Feldes zu prüfen und so Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden. Dies ist typisch für generische Frameworks oder Tools, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field-Symbols, dynamisch, cx_sy_assign_error

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in einen XSTRING (binäre Daten) und umgekehrt, unter Angabe der Codepage.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_codepage`.

CLASS zcl_binary_string_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.

    METHODS xstring_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage TYPE abap_codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_string_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD string_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_by_encoding(
      encoding = iv_codepage
      endian = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_string
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD xstring_to_string.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_by_encoding(
      encoding = iv_codepage
      endian = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little
    ).
    lo_conv->convert(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = rv_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den SHA256-Hash eines Strings oder XSTRINGs.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_hash_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256_hash
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hash_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_hash_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256_hash.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create(
      algorithm = cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256
    ).

    IF iv_data IS INSTANCE OF string.
      DATA(lv_string) = CAST string( iv_data ).
      lo_digest->update_string( lv_string ).
    ELSEIF iv_data IS INSTANCE OF xstring.
      DATA(lv_xstring) = CAST xstring( iv_data ).
      lo_digest->update_xstring( lv_xstring ).
    ELSE.
      " Handle other types if necessary, or raise exception
      " For simplicity, convert to string and then hash
      DATA(lv_temp_string) TYPE string.
      MOVE iv_data TO lv_temp_string.
      lo_digest->update_string( lv_temp_string ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_hash_xstring = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und RTTI zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ) ).

    " Check if method exists using RTTI
    DATA(lv_method_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method_descr).
      IF ls_method_descr-name = iv_method_name.
        lv_method_exists = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_method_exists = abap_true.
      TRY.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
            EXPORTING
              iv_input = iv_param " Assuming method has an IV_INPUT parameter
            RECEIVING
              rv_output = rv_result.
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call).
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_dyn_call.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>cx_sy_dyn_call_method_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
      io_object = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING'
      iv_param = 'World'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello, World!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_no_param.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
      io_object = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'GET_SIMPLE_GREETING'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Simple Hello!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_not_found.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->call_method_dynamically(
          io_object = lo_target
          iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_dyn_call_error was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` ist ein mächtiges Feature. In Kombination mit RTTI (`cl_abap_classdescr->get_methods`) kann zur Laufzeit geprüft werden, ob eine Methode existiert, bevor sie aufgerufen wird. Dies erhöht die Robustheit von dynamischen Anwendungen, die z.B. auf Konfigurationen basieren.
keywords: RTTI, CALL METHOD, dynamisch, Methode, cx_sy_dyn_call_error

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( lo_descr ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      DATA(lv_visibility) TYPE string.
      CASE ls_attribute-visibility.
        WHEN cl_abap_classdescr=>visibility_public THEN lv_visibility = 'PUBLIC'.
        WHEN cl_abap_classdescr=>visibility_protected THEN lv_visibility = 'PROTECTED'.
        WHEN cl_abap_classdescr=>visibility_private THEN lv_visibility = 'PRIVATE'.
        WHEN OTHERS THEN lv_visibility = 'UNKNOWN'.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_attribute-name type = ls_attribute-type->get_name( ) visibility = lv_visibility ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.

CLASS zcl_htb_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA(lt_sflights_hashed) = VALUE ty_sflights_hashed( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights_raw ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_hashed INTO rs_flight
      WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                     connid = iv_connid
                     fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_src_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer Hashed Table.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit einer Hashed Table als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_count.
    TYPES: ty_passenger_counts_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_passenger_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_passenger_counts) TYPE ty_passenger_counts_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_passenger_counts = REDUCE ty_passenger_counts_hashed(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_passenger_counts_hashed( )
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid IN
      NEXT result = COND #(
        WHEN line_exists( result[ carrid = lv_carrid ] )
          THEN VALUE ty_passenger_counts_hashed(
                 FOR <fs_entry> IN result
                 ( COND #( WHEN <fs_entry>-carrid = lv_carrid
                           THEN VALUE ty_passenger_count( <fs_entry> total_passengers = <fs_entry>-total_passengers + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
                           ELSE <fs_entry> ) ) ) 
        ELSE VALUE ty_passenger_counts_hashed( BASE result ( carrid = lv_carrid total_passengers = <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_dynamic_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_htb_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table von Fluggesellschaften (z.B. `scarr`) mit dem Schlüssel `CARRID`. Erweitern Sie die `sflights`-Daten um den Namen der Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie die Hashed Table verwenden.
hint: Laden Sie `scarr` in eine Hashed Table und verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `CORRESPONDING` oder direkten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_enrich DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES: ty_scarr_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_enriched,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS enrich_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_enrich IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA lt_scarr_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_scarr_raw.

    DATA(lt_scarr_hashed) = VALUE ty_scarr_hashed( FOR <fs_scarr> IN lt_scarr_raw ( <fs_scarr> ) ).

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                                   LET ls_scarr = lt_scarr_hashed[ KEY carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid ] IN
                                   ( carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                                     carrname = ls_scarr-carrname,
                                     connid   = <fs_flight>-connid,
                                     fldate   = <fs_flight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_enriched_flights) = lo_cut->enrich_flights_with_carrier_name( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_enriched_flights ).

    " Assuming 'LH' (Lufthansa) is present in sflights and scarr
    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_enriched_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_flight-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR ... IN ...` und dem direkten Zugriff auf eine Hashed Table (`lt_scarr_hashed[ KEY carrid = ... ]`) innerhalb eines `LET`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Datenanreicherung. Die Hashed Table bietet einen schnellen Lookup für den Fluggesellschaftsnamen, ohne dass explizite Schleifen oder `READ TABLE` Anweisungen erforderlich sind.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, Internal Table, Data Enrichment, LET, Functional Programming

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance des Zugriffs auf eine Standardtabelle vs. eine Hashed Table für 1000 zufällige Zugriffe.
hint: Messen Sie die Zeit mit `GET RUN TIME FIELD` und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit Index für Standardtabelle und `WITH TABLE KEY` für Hashed Table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_htb_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS measure_read_performance
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_performance_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_htb_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_read_performance.
    CONSTANTS: lc_num_accesses TYPE i VALUE 1000.
    DATA: lt_sflights_std TYPE ty_sflights_standard,
          lt_sflights_hsh TYPE ty_sflights_hashed,
          lv_start_time   TYPE i,
          lv_end_time     TYPE i,
          lv_duration_std TYPE i,
          lv_duration_hsh TYPE i,
          ls_sflight      TYPE sflight,
          lt_keys         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Prepare data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_std.
    lt_sflights_hsh = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights_std ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    " Generate random keys for testing
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights_std ).
    IF lv_max_index = 0. " Handle empty table case
      rs_performance_data = 'No data in sflight table to measure performance.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DO lc_num_accesses TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = sy-uzeit min = 1 max = lv_max_index )->get_next( ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = lt_sflights_std[ lv_random_index ]-carrid
                                   connid = lt_sflights_std[ lv_random_index ]-connid
                                   fldate = lt_sflights_std[ lv_random_index ]-fldate ) TO lt_keys.
    ENDDO.

    " Measure Standard Table performance
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_std INTO ls_sflight WITH KEY carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid fldate = ls_key-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
    lv_duration_std = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure Hashed Table performance
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO ls_key.
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_hsh INTO ls_sflight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_key-carrid connid = ls_key-connid fldate = ls_key-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
    lv_duration_hsh = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    rs_performance_data = |Standard Table: { lv_duration_std } µs, Hashed Table: { lv_duration_hsh } µs. (Accesses: { lc_num_accesses })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_measure_read_performance FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_measure_read_performance.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_htb_performance( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->measure_read_performance( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = count( val = lv_result regex = 'µs' ) = 2 ).
    " Further assertions could parse the string and compare values, but this is sufficient for a basic test.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Performance-Vorteil von Hashed Tables bei schlüsselbasierten Zugriffen im Vergleich zu Standardtabellen. Während Standardtabellen bei sequenziellen Zugriffen effizient sind, bieten Hashed Tables bei direkten Zugriffen über den Schlüssel eine deutlich bessere Performance, da sie einen Hash-Algorithmus verwenden, um den Eintrag direkt zu finden. Die Laufzeitmessung mit `GET RUN TIME FIELD` macht diesen Unterschied sichtbar.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, Standard Table, Performance, READ TABLE, GET RUN TIME FIELD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, aber mit einer zusätzlichen Spalte für die 'Auslastung' in Prozent.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) additional_field = ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_add_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_extended,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             occupancy_percent TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_extended.
    TYPES: ty_sflights_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflights_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_add_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                           LET lv_occupancy = COND decfloat34(
                                                WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0
                                                THEN ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc / <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) * 100
                                                ELSE 0 ) IN
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( <fs_flight> )
                             occupancy_percent = lv_occupancy ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_add_field( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-occupancy_percent >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-occupancy_percent <= 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING #()` und der Zuweisung zusätzlicher Felder ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die auf einer bestehenden basiert, aber um berechnete Felder erweitert wird. `LET` wird verwendet, um Zwischenberechnungen lesbar zu halten, und `COND` für die bedingte Berechnung der Auslastung.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, LET, COND, Internal Table, Data Manipulation

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_data,
             object_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             x_coord   TYPE i,
             y_coord   TYPE i,
             z_coord   TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_3d_object_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_3d_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights

      ( object_id = ls_sflight-carrid,
        x_coord   = lv_index * 10,
        y_coord   = ls_sflight-connid MOD 100,

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_data_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_data,
             object_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             x_coord   TYPE i,
             y_coord   TYPE i,
             z_coord   TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_data_agg IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_summary_string = REDUCE string(

      NEXT s = s && |
- Object { ls_obj-object_id }: X={ ls_obj-x_coord }, Y={ ls_obj-y_coord }, Z={ ls_obj-z_coord }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_cond_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_property,
             color TYPE string,
             visible TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_3d_object_property.

    METHODS get_object_properties

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_cond_assign IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_sflights_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_viewer_method.
    DATA: lo_viewer_mock TYPE REF TO zcl_3dviewer_dynamic_call.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_viewer_mock.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_viewer_mock->(iv_method_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_set_property.
    " Simulate setting a property of the 3D viewer
    " In a real scenario, this would call a method of mo_3d_viewer
  ENDMETHOD.

    " Simulate refreshing the 3D viewer
    " In a real scenario, this would call a method of mo_3d_viewer

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kopie einer internen Tabelle mit 3D-Objektdaten und ändern Sie dabei die X-Koordinate aller Objekte um einen bestimmten Wert. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_copy_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object_data,
             object_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             x_coord   TYPE i,
             y_coord   TYPE i,
             z_coord   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_3d_object_data.
    TYPES tt_3d_object_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_and_offset_x
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_3d_object_data
        iv_offset      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_data) TYPE tt_3d_object_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3dviewer_copy_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_and_offset_x.
    rt_modified_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_obj IN it_source_data
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_obj ) WITH x_coord = ls_obj-x_coord + iv_offset ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit eines Codeblocks, der eine interne Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen füllt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME=>GET_RUNTIME_IN_MICROSECONDS` vor und nach dem Codeblock.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_table_fill RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_table_fill.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE TABLE OF i, 
          lv_start_time TYPE i, 
          lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 100000 TIMES.
      APPEND sy-index TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_table_fill( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Runtime should be positive' act = ( lv_runtime > 0 ) ).

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance einer klassischen LOOP-Anweisung mit einer funktionalen FOR-Iteration beim Verarbeiten einer großen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` für beide Messungen und die `FOR`-Expression für die moderne Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_performance DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS: compare_loops RETURNING VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO DATA.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: get_test_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight,
             measure_classic_loop IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i,
             measure_for_loop IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_performance IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_test_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_data UP TO 100000 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_classic_loop.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i,
          ls_sflight LIKE LINE OF it_data.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO ls_sflight.
      " Simulate some work
      ls_sflight-carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_for_loop.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lt_result TYPE tt_sflight.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    lt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_data ( ls_sflight ) ). " Simulate some work

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_loops.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_sflight,
          lv_classic_runtime TYPE i,
          lv_for_runtime TYPE i,
          ls_runtimes TYPE STRUCTURE.

    lt_data = get_test_data( ).

    lv_classic_runtime = measure_classic_loop( it_data = lt_data ).
    lv_for_runtime = measure_for_loop( it_data = lt_data ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE HASHED TABLE OF STRUCTURE WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_runtimes INTO rs_runtimes.
    " This part needs adjustment to return a structured result, e.g., a map or a structure.
    " For simplicity, let's return a simple structure with two fields.
    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE REF TO STRUCTURE OF (classic_loop_us TYPE i, for_loop_us TYPE i).
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes>-classic_loop_us = lv_classic_runtime.
    <fs_runtimes>-for_loop_us = lv_for_runtime.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compare_loops FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_loops.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_performance( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_loops( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_runtimes> TYPE zcl_loop_performance=>compare_loops~rs_runtimes->*.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Classic loop runtime should not be initial' act = <fs_runtimes>-classic_loop_us exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'FOR loop runtime should not be initial' act = <fs_runtimes>-for_loop_us exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Classic loop runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-classic_loop_us > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FOR loop runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-for_loop_us > 0 ) ).

    " Assert that FOR loop is generally faster or comparable
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FOR loop should be faster or similar to classic loop' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-for_loop_us <= <fs_runtimes>-classic_loop_us ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der klassischen `LOOP AT` Anweisung mit der modernen `FOR`-Expression für interne Tabellen. `FOR`-Expressions sind oft kompakter und können in vielen Fällen auch performanter sein, da sie für funktionale Operationen optimiert sind. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` wird verwendet, um die Zeiten präzise zu messen und den Unterschied zu quantifizieren.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, LOOP, FOR, INTERNAL TABLES, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Messen Sie den Overhead eines Methodenaufrufs im Vergleich zu direkt ausgeführtem Code.
hint: Führen Sie eine leere Methode und den entsprechenden Code direkt aus und messen Sie die Zeiten mit `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_overhead DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_overhead RETURNING VALUE(rs_overhead_data) TYPE REF TO DATA.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: dummy_method,
             measure_direct_code RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i,
             measure_method_call RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_overhead IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dummy_method.
    " Empty method to simulate a method call with minimal logic
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_direct_code.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    " Direct code execution (minimal operation)
    DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 + 1.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_method_call.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    " Method call
    dummy_method( ).
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_overhead.
    DATA: lv_direct_runtime TYPE i,
          lv_method_runtime TYPE i,
          ls_overhead_data TYPE STRUCTURE.

    lv_direct_runtime = measure_direct_code( ).
    lv_method_runtime = measure_method_call( ).

    CREATE DATA rs_overhead_data TYPE REF TO STRUCTURE OF (direct_us TYPE i, method_us TYPE i, overhead_us TYPE i).
    ASSIGN rs_overhead_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_overhead_data>).
    <fs_overhead_data>-direct_us = lv_direct_runtime.
    <fs_overhead_data>-method_us = lv_method_runtime.
    <fs_overhead_data>-overhead_us = lv_method_runtime - lv_direct_runtime.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_measure_overhead FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_measure_overhead.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_overhead( ).
    DATA(lr_overhead_data) = lo_cut->measure_overhead( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_overhead_data> TYPE zcl_method_overhead=>measure_overhead~rs_overhead_data->*.
    ASSIGN lr_overhead_data->* TO <fs_overhead_data>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Direct code runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_overhead_data>-direct_us >= 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_overhead_data>-method_us >= 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Overhead should be non-negative' act = ( <fs_overhead_data>-overhead_us >= 0 ) ).
    " The overhead is typically very small, but should be measurable.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Method call should take at least as long as direct code' act = ( <fs_overhead_data>-method_us >= <fs_overhead_data>-direct_us ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel misst den geringen Performance-Overhead, der durch einen Methodenaufruf im Vergleich zur direkten Ausführung von Code entsteht. Obwohl dieser Overhead in den meisten Fällen vernachlässigbar ist, ist es wichtig, ihn bei sehr performanzkritischen Schleifen oder Algorithmen zu berücksichtigen. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` ermöglicht diese feingranulare Messung.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Performance der String-Verkettung mit String-Templates (`&&`) gegenüber der klassischen `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung bei einer großen Anzahl von Operationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` für beide Messungen und String-Templates für die moderne Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concat_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_string_concatenation RETURNING VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO DATA.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: measure_concatenate RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i,
             measure_string_template RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concat_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_concatenate.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          lv_result TYPE string,
          lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 100000 TIMES.
      CONCATENATE lv_result lv_string INTO lv_result.
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_string_template.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          lv_result TYPE string,
          lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 100000 TIMES.
      lv_result = |{ lv_result }{ lv_string }|.
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_string_concatenation.
    DATA: lv_concat_runtime TYPE i,
          lv_template_runtime TYPE i,
          ls_runtimes TYPE STRUCTURE.

    lv_concat_runtime = measure_concatenate( ).
    lv_template_runtime = measure_string_template( ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE REF TO STRUCTURE OF (concatenate_us TYPE i, string_template_us TYPE i).
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes>-concatenate_us = lv_concat_runtime.
    <fs_runtimes>-string_template_us = lv_template_runtime.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compare_string_concatenation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_string_concatenation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_concat_perf( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_string_concatenation( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_runtimes> TYPE zcl_string_concat_perf=>compare_string_concatenation~rs_runtimes->*.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Concatenate runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-concatenate_us > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'String template runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-string_template_us > 0 ) ).
    " String templates are generally more efficient for concatenation.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'String templates should be faster or similar to CONCATENATE' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-string_template_us <= <fs_runtimes>-concatenate_us ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance der String-Verkettung mit der klassischen `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung und den modernen String-Templates (`|...|`). String-Templates sind in der Regel performanter und lesbarer, insbesondere bei komplexeren Verkettungen. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` wird verwendet, um diese Performance-Unterschiede zu demonstrieren.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, STRING, CONCATENATE, STRING TEMPLATES, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME

CLASS zcl_frontend_clipboard DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RAISING
        cx_frontend_services_exception.
