CLASS zcl_frontend_clipboard IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_clipboard_content.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>clipboard_import(
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_frontend_services_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Importieren aus der Zwischenablage'.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(lv_line).
      rv_content = rv_content && lv_line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF rv_content IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Remove last CR_LF
      rv_content = rv_content( sy-fdpos - 2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Performance des Zugriffs auf eine interne Tabelle mittels `LINE_EXISTS` und `READ TABLE` mit `KEY` im Vergleich zu `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine große Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` und die modernen Tabellenoperationen `LINE_EXISTS`, `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_access_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS compare_table_access RETURNING VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE REF TO DATA.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS: get_test_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_key,
             measure_line_exists IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflight_key RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i,
             measure_filter_reduce IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflight_key RETURNING VALUE(rv_runtime_us) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_access_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_test_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_data UP TO 100000 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_line_exists.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lv_found TYPE abap_bool.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 1000 TIMES. " Repeat access for better measurement
      lv_found = line_exists( it_data[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ] ).
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_filter_reduce.
    DATA: lv_start_time TYPE i, lv_end_time TYPE i,
          lv_count TYPE i.

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    DO 1000 TIMES. " Repeat access for better measurement
      lv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_entry IN FILTER #( it_data WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    ENDDO.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rv_runtime_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD compare_table_access.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_sflight_key,
          lv_line_exists_runtime TYPE i,
          lv_filter_reduce_runtime TYPE i,
          ls_runtimes TYPE STRUCTURE.

    lt_data = get_test_data( ).

    lv_line_exists_runtime = measure_line_exists( it_data = lt_data ).
    lv_filter_reduce_runtime = measure_filter_reduce( it_data = lt_data ).

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes TYPE REF TO STRUCTURE OF (line_exists_us TYPE i, filter_reduce_us TYPE i).
    ASSIGN rs_runtimes->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_runtimes>).
    <fs_runtimes>-line_exists_us = lv_line_exists_runtime.
    <fs_runtimes>-filter_reduce_us = lv_filter_reduce_runtime.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compare_table_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_table_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_access_perf( ).
    DATA(lr_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_table_access( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_runtimes> TYPE zcl_itab_access_perf=>compare_table_access~rs_runtimes->*.
    ASSIGN lr_runtimes->* TO <fs_runtimes>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LINE_EXISTS runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-line_exists_us > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FILTER/REDUCE runtime should be positive' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-filter_reduce_us > 0 ) ).
    " Assert that modern functional approaches are efficient.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Functional access should be efficient' act = ( <fs_runtimes>-filter_reduce_us <= <fs_runtimes>-line_exists_us * 2 ) ). " Allow some variance
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance verschiedener moderner Zugriffsarten auf interne Tabellen. `LINE_EXISTS` ist für die schnelle Prüfung der Existenz eines Eintrags optimiert. `FILTER` und `REDUCE` bieten eine funktionale und oft sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten zu filtern und zu aggregieren. `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` hilft, die Effizienz dieser Ansätze zu quantifizieren und die Vorteile moderner ABAP-Syntaxen hervorzuheben.
keywords: RUNTIME, PERFORMANCE, INTERNAL TABLES, LINE_EXISTS, FILTER, REDUCE, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, SFLIGHT

      FROM sflight

    " Filter flights for Lufthansa (LH) with available seats

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA') aus der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflights.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für AA und LH in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Gesamtsitze für AA sollten nicht 0 sein' act = lv_total_seats_aa exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Gesamtsitze für LH sollten nicht 0 sein' act = lv_total_seats_lh exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Gesamtsitze sollten positiv sein' act = ( lv_total_seats_aa > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflight

Instructions: Sammeln Sie verschiedene Fehlermeldungen und geben Sie diese in einem strukturierten Format aus. Simulieren Sie die Verwendung eines Nachrichtensammlers (ähnlich `cf_reca_message_list`).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die Nachrichten sammelt und ausgibt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Iteration und Formatierung.
solution:
" Simulation der cf_reca_message_list Funktionalität
INTERFACE zif_message_collector.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
           type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " S=Success, E=Error, W=Warning, I=Info, A=Abort
           id   TYPE symsgid,
           no   TYPE symsgno,
           text TYPE string,
         END OF ty_message.
  TYPES tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS add_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_type TYPE c LENGTH 1
      iv_id   TYPE symsgid
      iv_no   TYPE symsgno
      iv_text TYPE string OPTIONAL.

  METHODS get_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
  METHODS has_errors RETURNING VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_messages TYPE zif_message_collector~tt_messages.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_message FOR IMPLEMENTATION zif_message_collector~add_message.
    METHODS get_messages FOR IMPLEMENTATION zif_message_collector~get_messages.
    METHODS has_errors FOR IMPLEMENTATION zif_message_collector~has_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_collector~add_message.
    APPEND VALUE #( type = iv_type id = iv_id no = iv_no text = iv_text ) TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_collector~get_messages.
    rt_messages = mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message_collector~has_errors.
    rv_has_errors = xsdbool( line_exists( mt_messages[ type = 'E' ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_message_collector TYPE REF TO zif_message_collector
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_messages.
    DATA(lt_messages) = io_message_collector->get_messages( ).
    rv_output = REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                               FOR ls_msg IN lt_messages
                               NEXT s = |{ s }{ COND string( WHEN s IS NOT INITIAL THEN |\n| ELSE '' ) }Nachricht ({ ls_msg-type }): { ls_msg-text }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_message_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_handling.
    DATA(lo_collector) = NEW zcl_message_collector( ).
    lo_collector->zif_message_collector~add_message( iv_type = 'S' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '001' iv_text = 'Erfolgreich verarbeitet.' ).
    lo_collector->zif_message_collector~add_message( iv_type = 'E' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '002' iv_text = 'Fehler aufgetreten.' ).
    lo_collector->zif_message_collector~add_message( iv_type = 'W' iv_id = 'ZMSG' iv_no = '003' iv_text = 'Warnung: Daten unvollständig.' ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_message_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_processor->process_messages( lo_collector ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Output sollte Fehlermeldung enthalten' substring = 'Fehler aufgetreten.' act = lv_output ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Collector sollte Fehler haben' act = lo_collector->has_errors( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Nachrichten sollte 3 sein' act = lines( lo_collector->get_messages( ) ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert einen Nachrichtensammler und dessen Verarbeitung. Es zeigt die Verwendung von Interfaces, Inline-Deklarationen, `VALUE` für die Initialisierung von Strukturen, `REDUCE` für die String-Aggregation und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Prüfung auf Fehler.
keywords: Interface, Object Orientation, Error Handling, REDUCE, String Templates, LINE_EXISTS, OPTIONAL, cf_reca_message_list

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Gebucht', 'Voll', 'Überbucht') basierend auf der Auslastung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = COND decfloat34( WHEN iv_seatsmax > 0 THEN ( iv_seatsocc * 100 ) / iv_seatsmax ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = SWITCH string( lv_occupancy_percent
      WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 70 THEN 'Gebucht'
      WHEN BETWEEN 71 AND 99 THEN 'Gut gebucht'
      WHEN 100 THEN 'Voll'
      ELSE 'Überbucht'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status sollte Gebucht sein' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 50 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Gebucht' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status sollte Gut gebucht sein' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 90 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Gut gebucht' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status sollte Voll sein' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 100 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Voll' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status sollte Überbucht sein' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 101 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Überbucht' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status sollte Gebucht sein (0 Sitze)' act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_seatsocc = 0 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Gebucht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung von Mehrfachverzweigungen, ähnlich einem `CASE`-Statement, aber als Ausdruck, der direkt einen Wert zurückgibt. Hier kombiniert mit `COND` für die Berechnung des Prozentsatzes.
keywords: SWITCH, COND, Conditional Logic, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists     TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index      TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_flight_index.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_sflights.

    " Populate with some dummy data or read from DB
    lt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20251207' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '017' fldate = '20251208' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '249' fldate = '20251209' )
    ).

    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                                                  connid = is_flight_key-connid
                                                  fldate = is_flight_key-fldate ] ) ).

    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( lt_flights[ carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                                          connid = is_flight_key-connid
                                          fldate = is_flight_key-fldate ] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_existence FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_existence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_line_ops( ).
    DATA(ls_search_key) = VALUE zcl_sflights_line_ops=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '017' fldate = '20251208' ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_flight_index(
      EXPORTING
        is_flight_key = ls_search_key
      IMPORTING
        ev_exists     = lv_exists
        ev_index      = lv_index
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flug sollte existieren' act = lv_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Index sollte 2 sein' act = lv_index exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_line_ops( ).
    DATA(ls_search_key) = VALUE zcl_sflights_line_ops=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'XX' connid = '999' fldate = '20250101' ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_flight_index(
      EXPORTING
        is_flight_key = ls_search_key
      IMPORTING
        ev_exists     = lv_exists
        ev_index      = lv_index
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Flug sollte nicht existieren' act = lv_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Index sollte 0 sein' act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken ermöglichen eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Prüfung auf die Existenz einer Zeile und das Ermitteln ihres Index in einer internen Tabelle, ohne explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Table Expressions, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um einen Flug zu konfigurieren, wobei optionale Parameter verwendet werden, um Flexibilität zu bieten.
hint: Nutzen Sie Method Chaining und `OPTIONAL` Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_config,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_config.

    METHODS set_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS set_connection
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS set_date
      IMPORTING iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS set_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc OPTIONAL
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_builder.

    METHODS build_flight_config RETURNING VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_flight_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_config TYPE ty_flight_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_carrier.
    ms_config-carrid = iv_carrid.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_connection.
    ms_config-connid = iv_connid.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_date.
    ms_config-fldate = iv_fldate.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_seats.
    IF iv_seatsocc IS SUPPLIED.
      ms_config-seatsocc = iv_seatsocc.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_seatsmax IS SUPPLIED.
      ms_config-seatsmax = iv_seatsmax.
    ENDIF.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build_flight_config.
    " Simple status logic for demo
    IF ms_config-seatsocc > ms_config-seatsmax.
      ms_config-status = 'OVERBOOKED'.
    ELSEIF ms_config-seatsocc = ms_config-seatsmax.
      ms_config-status = 'FULL'.
    ELSE.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zur Laufzeit eine interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch definierten Struktur und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_field1_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'FIELD_A'
        iv_field2_name TYPE string DEFAULT 'FIELD_B'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  LIKE LINE OF lt_components.

    " Define components dynamically
    ls_component-name = iv_field1_name.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_name( 'CHAR10' ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    ls_component-name = iv_field2_name.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_datadescr=>describe_by_name( 'INT4' ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    " Create structure descriptor
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Create table descriptor
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                             p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                             p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " Assign to field symbol and fill
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO <fs_line>.

      " Fill first row
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field1_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
      IF <fs_field1> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_field1> = 'Value 1A'.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field2_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
      IF <fs_field2> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_field2> = 100.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      " Fill second row
      <fs_field1> = 'Value 2A'.
      <fs_field2> = 200.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <fs_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Table should have 2 entries'
    ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_a>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_b>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'Value 1A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_b> exp = 100 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_a>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_b>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'Value 2A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_b> exp = 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die vollständige dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Mittels `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` wird die Struktur und der Tabellentyp definiert, gefolgt von `CREATE DATA` und der Zuweisung zu Feldsymbolen für die Datenbefüllung.
keywords: RTTI, RTTC, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr, CREATE DATA, dynamic programming, internal table

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit `SORT` und einem temporären Zufallsfeld.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ANY TABLE
      EXPORTING
        et_shuffled_data TYPE ANY TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a temporary table with random sort key
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_temp,
            random_key TYPE i,
            line_data  TYPE REF TO data,
          END OF ls_temp.
    DATA: lt_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_temp WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_random_generator) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                                  seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                  min  = 1
                                  max  = lines( <fs_table> ) * 10 ). " Max key to ensure good distribution

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ls_temp-random_key = lo_random_generator->get_next( ).
      CREATE DATA ls_temp-line_data LIKE <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line> TO ls_temp-line_data->*.
      APPEND ls_temp TO lt_temp.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_temp BY random_key.

    " Fill the shuffled table
    CREATE DATA et_shuffled_data LIKE <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN et_shuffled_data TO <fs_table>.
    LOOP AT lt_temp INTO ls_temp.
      ASSIGN ls_temp-line_data->* TO <fs_line>.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lt_original = VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_shuffle( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_data        = lt_original
      IMPORTING
        et_shuffled_data = lt_shuffled
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled )
      exp = lines( lt_original )
      msg = 'Shuffled table should have same number of entries'
    ).

    " Check if all original elements are present (sum check)
    DATA(lv_sum_original) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR x IN lt_original NEXT s = s + x ).
    DATA(lv_sum_shuffled) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR x IN lt_shuffled NEXT s = s + x ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_sum_shuffled
      exp = lv_sum_original
      msg = 'Sum of elements should be the same'
    ).

    " It's hard to assert randomness, but we can check if it's *not* sorted
    " (though a small table might coincidentally be sorted)
    DATA(lv_is_sorted) = abap_true.
    IF lines( lt_shuffled ) > 1.
      LOOP AT lt_shuffled INTO DATA(lv_current).
        IF sy-tabix > 1.
          IF lv_current < lt_shuffled[ sy-tabix - 1 ].
            lv_is_sorted = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    " This assertion might fail rarely if the random sort happens to sort it.
    " For a robust test, one would run it many times or use statistical tests.
    " For this example, we'll just assert it's not the *original* order.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lt_shuffled
      exp = lt_original
      msg = 'Shuffled table should ideally not be in original order'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine interne Tabelle zufällig zu mischen, wird jeder Zeile ein temporärer Zufallsschlüssel zugewiesen. Anschließend wird die Tabelle nach diesem Schlüssel sortiert. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um eine zufällige Reihenfolge zu erzielen.
keywords: Random, cl_abap_random, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Tables, Shuffle, SORT

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen, zufälligen alphanumerischen IDs.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random_int` mit String-Templates und einer Schleife, die auf Eindeutigkeit prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_ids
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_ids.
    DATA: lv_char_pool TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789',
          lv_pool_len  TYPE i.
    lv_pool_len = strlen( lv_char_pool ).

    DATA(lo_random_generator) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
                                  seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( )
                                  min  = 0
                                  max  = lv_pool_len - 1 ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_id) = ``.
      DO iv_length TIMES.
        DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_generator->get_next( ).
        lv_new_id = lv_new_id && lv_char_pool+lv_random_index(1).
      ENDDO.

      " Check for uniqueness and regenerate if necessary
      IF line_exists( rt_unique_ids[ table_line = lv_new_id ] ).
        " Decrement loop counter to retry this ID
        sy-index = sy-index - 1.
      ELSE.
        APPEND lv_new_id TO rt_unique_ids.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) mit einer 50/50-Chance.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und vergleichen Sie den Wert mit 0.5.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_coin_flip_result,
             flip_number TYPE i,
             result      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_coin_flip_result.
    TYPES: tt_coin_flip_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_coin_flip_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flip_coin
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_flips TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_coin_flip_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_coin_flip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random_generator) = cl_abap_random_float=>create(
                                  seed = cl_abap_random=>seed( ) ).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_num_flips
                          LET lv_random_value = lo_random_generator->get_next( ) IN
                          ( flip_number = i,
                            result      = COND string( WHEN lv_random_value < 0.5 THEN 'Kopf' ELSE 'Zahl' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_coin_flip FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_coin_flip.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_coin_flip( ).
    DATA(lt_flips) = lo_cut->flip_coin( iv_num_flips = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flips )
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Should perform 100 flips'
    ).

    DATA(lv_heads_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flip IN lt_flips WHERE ( result = 'Kopf' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_tails_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flip IN lt_flips WHERE ( result = 'Zahl' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_heads_count + lv_tails_count = 100 )
      msg = 'Total flips should match'
    ).

    " Assert that both outcomes occurred (highly probable for 100 flips)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_heads_count > 0 AND lv_tails_count > 0 )
      msg = 'Both heads and tails should occur in 100 flips'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_abap_random_float` zur Simulation eines Münzwurfs. Eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0.0 und 1.0 wird generiert und mit 0.5 verglichen, um 'Kopf' oder 'Zahl' zu bestimmen. Die `FOR`-Iteration mit `VALUE` und `COND` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und moderne Implementierung.
keywords: Random, cl_abap_random, cl_abap_random_float, Math, Simulation, Conditional Logic, FOR, VALUE, COND

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT existiert, unter Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS`.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_flight_exists_line IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse, die einen geschachtelten strukturierten Typ für interne Daten verwendet, um die Kapselung zu demonstrieren. Die Klasse soll eine Methode haben, die diese Daten befüllt und zurückgibt.
hint: Definieren Sie `TYPES` innerhalb des `PRIVATE SECTION` der Klasse, um die Kapselung zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_types_encap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_public_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_public_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_public_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_public_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_encapsulated_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_public_flight_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_private_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_private_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_private_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_private_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_private_flights TYPE tt_private_flight_detail.

    METHODS load_private_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_types_encap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_encapsulated_flights.
    load_private_data( ).
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_private IN mt_private_flights
                          ( carrid = ls_private-carrid,
                            connid = ls_private-connid,
                            fldate = ls_private-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_private_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_private_flights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 rows' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-connid ).

Nur eine Teilmenge der Daten wird über einen öffentlichen Typ (`ty_public_flight_info`) und eine Methode (`get_encapsulated_flights`) nach außen gegeben. Dies demonstriert das Prinzip der Datenkapselung und der Trennung von Belangen, was zu robusterem und wartbarerem Code führt. keywords: TYPES, CLASS, ENCAPSULATION, PRIVATE SECTION, NESTED TYPES, OBJECT ORIENTATION

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen rabattierten Preis, wenn ein bestimmter Schwellenwert überschritten wird. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `LET` Expression innerhalb einer `IF` Anweisung.
hint: Die `LET` Expression erlaubt die Deklaration lokaler Variablen innerhalb eines Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_let_if DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_threshold      TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_rate  TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_let_if IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    IF iv_original_price > iv_threshold
      LET lv_discount_amount = iv_original_price * iv_discount_rate / 100 IN
      rv_final_price = iv_original_price - lv_discount_amount.
    ELSE.
      rv_final_price = iv_original_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discounted_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_discount_let_if( ).

    " Testfall 1: Preis über Schwellenwert, Rabatt sollte angewendet werden
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Discount applied' act = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_original_price = 1000 iv_threshold = 500 iv_discount_rate = 10 ) exp = 900 ).

    " Testfall 2: Preis unter Schwellenwert, kein Rabatt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'No discount' act = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_original_price = 400 iv_threshold = 500 iv_discount_rate = 10 ) exp = 400 ).

    " Testfall 3: Preis genau auf Schwellenwert, kein Rabatt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'No discount at threshold' act = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_original_price = 500 iv_threshold = 500 iv_discount_rate = 10 ) exp = 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LET` Expression (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht die Deklaration und Initialisierung lokaler Hilfsvariablen direkt innerhalb eines Ausdrucks oder einer Anweisung, wie hier in einer `IF`-Anweisung. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, da temporäre Berechnungen direkt dort definiert werden, wo sie benötigt werden, ohne den umgebenden Codeblock mit zusätzlichen `DATA`-Deklarationen zu belasten. Es fördert einen funktionaleren Programmierstil.
keywords: IF, LET, EXPRESSION, LOCAL VARIABLE, CONDITIONAL LOGIC

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten. Fügen Sie dabei ein zusätzliches Feld 'is_long_haul' hinzu, das `abap_true` ist, wenn die Flugdauer über 5 Stunden liegt, ansonsten `abap_false`. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `COND`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cond_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_extended,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime     TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime     TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             is_long_haul TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_extended.
    TYPES tt_flight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_extended_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_extended_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                          LET lv_dep_time = ls_flight-deptime
                              lv_arr_time = ls_flight-arrtime
                              lv_duration = COND i(
                                WHEN lv_arr_time >= lv_dep_time THEN lv_arr_time - lv_dep_time
                                ELSE lv_arr_time - lv_dep_time + 2400 " Über Mitternacht
                              ) IN
                          ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid,
                            connid      = ls_flight-connid,
                            fldate      = ls_flight-fldate,
                            deptime     = ls_flight-deptime,
                            arrtime     = ls_flight-arrtime,
                            is_long_haul = COND abap_bool(
                                             WHEN lv_duration > 500 THEN abap_true " 500 = 5 Stunden (HHMM Format)
                                             ELSE abap_false
                                           )
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extended_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extended_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_cond_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_extended_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 10 rows' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-connid ).
      " Beispielprüfung für is_long_haul (kann je nach SFLIGHT-Daten variieren)
      IF ls_flight-is_long_haul = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Long haul flag should be true' act = ls_flight-is_long_haul ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Long haul flag should be false' act = ls_flight-is_long_haul ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE` Operatoren mit `FOR` Ausdrücken und geschachtelten `COND` Operatoren. Es ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Anreicherung von Daten beim Füllen einer internen Tabelle. Die `LET` Expression wird hier verwendet, um Zwischenberechnungen (Flugdauer) lokal und lesbar zu halten. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster, das traditionelle `LOOP AT ... APPEND` Schleifen mit `IF` Anweisungen ersetzt und den Code erheblich vereinfacht.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Datum initial ist und geben Sie einen entsprechenden Text zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür die moderne `IF ... IS INITIAL` Syntax.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) aus SFLIGHT enthält, die mit 'A' beginnen. Nutzen Sie `TYPES` und füllen Sie die Tabelle mit `FOR` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `TYPES`, `VALUE #( FOR ... IN FILTER ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_carrids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_filtered_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carriers_starting_with_a
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE tt_filtered_carrids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_carrids IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_starting_with_a.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE carrid CP 'A*' )
                          ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_carrids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'AA should be in the list' act = line_exists( lt_carrids[ table_line = 'AA' ] ) ).

    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`), deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Filtern Sie die Tabelle nach einem dynamisch übergebenen Feld und Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM_NAME)TABLE_NAME') TO <field_symbol>`. Für das Filtern können Sie `LOOP AT <field_symbol> WHERE (dynamic_condition)` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_field_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_component> TYPE any.

    " Dynamically assign the internal table
    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <lt_any_table>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN. " Table not found
    ENDIF.

    " Construct dynamic WHERE clause (simple equality for demo)
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_field_value }'|.

    LOOP AT <lt_any_table> ASSIGNING <ls_any_line> WHERE (lv_where_clause).
      " Dynamically read components to build the return table
      DATA(ls_sflight_line) = VALUE ty_s_sflight( ).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <lv_any_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_sflight_line-carrid = <lv_any_component>. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <lv_any_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_sflight_line-connid = <lv_any_component>. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <lv_any_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_sflight_line-fldate = <lv_any_component>. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <lv_any_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. ls_sflight_line-price = <lv_any_component>. ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_line TO rt_filtered_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_field_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(gv_sflights_test) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    gv_sflights_test = lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic_table(
                           iv_table_name  = '(LTCL_TEST)GV_SFLIGHTS_TEST'
                           iv_field_name  = 'CARRID'
                           iv_field_value = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should return filtered data' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Filtered CARRID should be AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic_table(
                           iv_table_name  = '(LTCL_TEST)NON_EXISTENT_TABLE'
                           iv_field_name  = 'CARRID'
                           iv_field_value = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should return empty table if table not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_field_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.
    DATA(gv_sflights_test) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    gv_sflights_test = lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic_table(
                           iv_table_name  = '(LTCL_TEST)GV_SFLIGHTS_TEST'
                           iv_field_name  = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                           iv_field_value = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should return empty table if field not found in WHERE clause' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf eine interne Tabelle und deren Filterung. Der Tabellenname wird zur Laufzeit übergeben und einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `LOOP` wird ebenfalls dynamisch konstruiert. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, erfordert aber Vorsicht bei der Sicherheit und Performance.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, Dynamic WHERE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template-Method-Pattern. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_report_template`, die eine Methode `run_report` mit einer festen Ablauflogik (z.B. `prepare_data`, `process_data`, `display_results`) definiert. `prepare_data` und `display_results` sollen abstrakt sein, `process_data` eine Standardimplementierung haben.
hint: Die `run_report` Methode ist nicht-final und ruft die abstrakten Methoden auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_template DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: run_report FINAL,
             prepare_data ABSTRACT,
             display_results ABSTRACT.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_report.
    prepare_data( ).
    process_data( ).
    display_results( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    " Default implementation: convert to uppercase
    LOOP AT mt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
      <fs_line> = to_upper( <fs_line> ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: prepare_data REDEFINITION,
             display_results REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_processed_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_data.
    " Simulate data fetching
    APPEND 'sales item 1' TO mt_data.
    APPEND 'sales item 2' TO mt_data.
    APPEND 'sales item 3' TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_results.
    " Simulate displaying results (e.g., to ALV, etc.)
    " For testing, we'll just ensure it runs.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_data.
    rt_data = mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sales_report_template FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sales_report_template.
    DATA(lo_sales_report) = NEW zcl_sales_report( ).
    lo_sales_report->run_report( ).

    DATA(lt_processed_data) = lo_sales_report->get_processed_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed_data ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 processed items' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed_data[ 1 ] exp = 'SALES ITEM 1' msg = 'First item should be uppercase' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed_data[ 2 ] exp = 'SALES ITEM 2' msg = 'Second item should be uppercase' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template-Method-Pattern definiert das Skelett eines Algorithmus in einer Basisklasse, überlässt aber die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte den Unterklassen. Abstrakte Methoden erzwingen die Implementierung dieser Schritte, während konkrete Methoden (wie `process_data`) eine Standardfunktionalität bieten oder die Gesamtlogik steuern.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Template Method, Inheritance

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD <field_symbol>->(method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lo_object> TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_result> TYPE any.

    " Assign the object to a field symbol (optional, but good practice for dynamic calls)
    <lo_object> = io_object.

    TRY.
        " Dynamically call the method
        CALL METHOD <lo_object>->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = <lv_result>.
        rv_result = <lv_result>.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Method call failed or method not found'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for demonstration
CLASS zcl_test_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string,
             get_number RETURNING VALUE(rv_num) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_text = 'Hello from dynamic call!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_number.
    rv_num = 42.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW zcl_test_object( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
                           io_object = lo_test_obj
                           iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic call!' msg = 'Should call GET_GREETING' ).

    lv_result = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
                           io_object = lo_test_obj
                           iv_method_name = 'GET_NUMBER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '42' msg = 'Should call GET_NUMBER and return 42' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_fail.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_test_obj) = NEW zcl_test_object( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method(
                           io_object = lo_test_obj
                           iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method call failed or method not found' msg = 'Should handle non-existent method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD <field_symbol>->(method_name)` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das Flexibilität in der Programmgestaltung bietet. Es ist nützlich für Frameworks, generische Handler oder wenn die aufzurufende Methode erst zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei unerlässlich.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Object Orientation, Dynamic Method Call

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_document_abstract` mit einer abstrakten Methode `get_content`. Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode `create_document` in dieser abstrakten Klasse, die basierend auf einem Typ-Parameter (z.B. 'PDF', 'TXT') konkrete Instanzen von Unterklassen (z.B. `zcl_pdf_document`, `zcl_text_document`) erzeugt und zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-METHODS factory FOR INSTANCE` und `CREATE OBJECT TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PROTECTED.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_content ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_document_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zcl_document_abstract.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_document_type.
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_pdf_document( ).
      WHEN 'TXT'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_text_document( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return initial
        " For simplicity, returning initial here.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_content.
    rv_content = 'This is a PDF document content.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_content REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_text_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_content.
    rv_content = 'This is a plain text document content.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_document_factory FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_document_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_document_factory.
    DATA(lo_pdf_doc) = zcl_document_abstract=>create_document( 'PDF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_pdf_doc msg = 'PDF document should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_pdf_doc->get_content( ) exp = 'This is a PDF document content.' msg = 'PDF content mismatch' ).

    DATA(lo_txt_doc) = zcl_document_abstract=>create_document( 'TXT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_txt_doc msg = 'Text document should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_txt_doc->get_content( ) exp = 'This is a plain text document content.' msg = 'Text content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_document_type.
    DATA(lo_unknown_doc) = zcl_document_abstract=>create_document( 'XML' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_unknown_doc msg = 'Unknown document type should return initial object' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Method-Pattern ermöglicht es einer Klasse, die Instanziierung von Objekten an Unterklassen zu delegieren. Hier wird eine statische Factory-Methode in der abstrakten Basisklasse verwendet, um konkrete Implementierungen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zu erzeugen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Factory Method

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Datenreferenz für eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflight` und weisen Sie diese einem Feldsymbol zu. Füllen Sie die Tabelle mit Daten und lesen Sie sie aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_ref_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight,
           ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_dynamic_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_ref_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA lr_sflight_table TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE ty_s_sflight.

    " Dynamically create a data reference for an internal table of type sflight
    CREATE DATA lr_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Assign the content of the data reference to a field symbol
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Fill the dynamic table with some data
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_sflight>
        UP TO 3 ROWS.

      " Read data from the dynamic table and return it
      LOOP AT <lt_sflight> ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
        APPEND <ls_sflight> TO rt_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_ref_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_sflight_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Result table should contain 3 rows' ).
    " Further assertions could check content if specific test data was inserted
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erzeugung von Datenreferenzen mit `CREATE DATA` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <field_symbol>` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datentypen zur Laufzeit arbeiten müssen. Dies ermöglicht es, Speicherplatz für Datenstrukturen oder interne Tabellen zu allozieren und diese dann über Feldsymbole zu manipulieren.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Data Reference, CREATE DATA, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Verwendung von `PROTECTED` Attributen und Methoden in einer abstrakten Klasse, die von Unterklassen genutzt werden. Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_logger_abstract` mit einer geschützten Methode `_log_message` und einem geschützten Attribut `mv_log_prefix`. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Unterklasse `zcl_console_logger`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PROTECTED SECTION` für Attribute und Methoden, die nur innerhalb der Klassenhierarchie sichtbar sein sollen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_logger_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_info ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_log_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'LOG: '.
    METHODS _log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD _log_message.
    " Generic logging logic, e.g., add timestamp, prefix
    " WRITE: / |{ mv_log_prefix }{ sy-uzeit } { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_logger_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_prefix TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    METHODS log_info REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF iv_prefix IS SUPPLIED.
      mv_log_prefix = iv_prefix.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_info.
    " Use the protected method and attribute from the superclass
    _log_message( |INFO: { iv_message }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_console_logger_with_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " Since _log_message doesn't return a value, we assert on internal state if possible
    " or simply ensure the call doesn't dump.
    lo_logger->log_info( 'Test message' ).
    " A more advanced test would use a test double for _log_message to capture its call.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_logger->mv_log_prefix ). " This would fail, as mv_log_prefix is protected and not directly accessible for assertion.
    " For demonstration, we'll rely on successful execution.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_console_logger_with_prefix.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( iv_prefix = 'APP_LOG: ' ).
    lo_logger->log_info( 'Another test' ).
    " Similar to above, direct assertion on protected members is not possible.
    " The test ensures the constructor and log_info method execute correctly.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `PROTECTED` Bereich einer Klasse macht Attribute und Methoden für die Klasse selbst und alle ihre Unterklassen sichtbar. Dies ist ideal, um Implementierungsdetails zu kapseln, die für die interne Logik der Klassenhierarchie relevant sind, aber nicht Teil der öffentlichen Schnittstelle sein sollen. Abstrakte Klassen können diese geschützten Elemente definieren, die dann von konkreten Unterklassen genutzt werden.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Protected, Inheritance

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine globale Variable zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Ändern Sie ihren Wert und lesen Sie ihn wieder aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM_NAME)VARIABLE_NAME') TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
REPORT z_dyn_global_var_access.

DATA gv_global_string TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value'.
DATA gv_global_int TYPE i VALUE 100.

CLASS zcl_dyn_global_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_and_set_global_variable
      IMPORTING
        iv_variable_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_old_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_global_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_set_global_variable.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_global_var> TYPE any.

    " Dynamically assign the global variable
    ASSIGN ('(Z_DYN_GLOBAL_VAR_ACCESS)' && iv_variable_name) TO <lv_global_var>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_old_value = <lv_global_var>.
      <lv_global_var> = iv_new_value.
    ELSE.
      rv_old_value = 'Variable not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_global_string_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_global_int_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_variable_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_global_string_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_global_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_old_value) = lo_cut->get_and_set_global_variable(
                               iv_variable_name = 'GV_GLOBAL_STRING'
                               iv_new_value     = 'New String Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_old_value exp = 'Initial Value' msg = 'Old string value should be Initial Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = gv_global_string exp = 'New String Value' msg = 'Global string should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_global_int_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_global_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_old_value) = lo_cut->get_and_set_global_variable(
                               iv_variable_name = 'GV_GLOBAL_INT'
                               iv_new_value     = '200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_old_value exp = '100' msg = 'Old int value should be 100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = gv_global_int exp = 200 msg = 'Global int should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_variable_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_global_accessor( ).
    DATA(lv_old_value) = lo_cut->get_and_set_global_variable(
                               iv_variable_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_VAR'
                               iv_new_value     = 'Some Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_old_value exp = 'Variable not found' msg = 'Should indicate variable not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf globale Variablen eines Programms mittels `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM_NAME)VARIABLE_NAME') TO <field_symbol>` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das in speziellen Szenarien wie generischen Tools oder Debugging-Hilfen nützlich sein kann. Es ist jedoch mit Vorsicht zu genießen, da es die Kapselung durchbricht und die Wartbarkeit beeinträchtigen kann. Der Programmname muss hierbei explizit angegeben werden.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Global Variable

Instructions: Eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_data_processor_abstract` soll sicherstellen, dass alle Unterklassen eine bestimmte Schnittstelle `zif_data_source` implementieren, die eine Methode `get_raw_data` definiert. Die abstrakte Klasse soll eine Methode `process_and_get_data` bereitstellen, die `get_raw_data` aufruft und die Daten verarbeitet.
hint: Die abstrakte Klasse kann eine Schnittstelle implementieren und die Implementierung der Schnittstellenmethoden an die Unterklassen delegieren oder selbst implementieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_source PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_raw_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
    METHODS process_and_get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_get_data.
    DATA(lv_raw_data) = zif_data_source~get_raw_data( ).
    " Simulate processing: reverse the string
    rv_processed_data = reverse( lv_raw_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_processor_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_data_source~get_raw_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_raw_data.
    rv_data = 'Data from file'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_data_processor_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_data_source~get_raw_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_raw_data.
    rv_data = 'Data from database'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_data_processor FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_db_data_processor FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_data_processor.
    DATA(lo_file_processor) = NEW zcl_file_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_file_processor->process_and_get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 'elif morf ataD' msg = 'File data should be reversed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_db_data_processor.
    DATA(lo_db_processor) = NEW zcl_db_data_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_db_processor->process_and_get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 'esabatad morf ataD' msg = 'DB data should be reversed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann eine Schnittstelle implementieren und die Implementierung der Schnittstellenmethoden an ihre Unterklassen delegieren. Dies stellt sicher, dass alle konkreten Unterklassen die erforderliche Funktionalität bereitstellen, während die abstrakte Klasse gemeinsame Logik (wie `process_and_get_data`) implementieren kann, die auf diesen Schnittstellenmethoden basiert.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Object Orientation, Interface, Inheritance, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) als Datenreferenz entgegennimmt und dynamisch die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <field_symbol>` und `LINES(<field_symbol>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_lines
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_lines) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_lines.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_lines = lines( <lt_any_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_lines = 0. " Not a table or assignment failed
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_with_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_string_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_scalar_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_initial_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_lines( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lr_sflights) = REF #( lt_sflights ).

CLASS zcl_error_demonstrator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_validation_error RAISING zcx_validation_error.
    METHODS trigger_runtime_error RAISING zcx_runtime_error.
    METHODS handle_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_demonstrator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_validation_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_validation_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_validation_error=>default.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_runtime_error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_runtime_error EXPORTING textid = zcx_runtime_error=>default.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_errors.
    TRY.
        trigger_validation_error( ).
      CATCH zcx_validation_error INTO DATA(lx_validation).
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Validation Error:', lx_validation->get_text( ).
      CATCH zcx_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_runtime).
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Runtime Error:', lx_runtime->get_text( ).
      CATCH zcx_abstract_error INTO DATA(lx_abstract).
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Generic Abstract Error:', lx_abstract->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        trigger_runtime_error( ).
      CATCH zcx_validation_error INTO lx_validation.
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Validation Error (2):', lx_validation->get_text( ).
      CATCH zcx_runtime_error INTO lx_runtime.
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Runtime Error (2):', lx_runtime->get_text( ).
      CATCH zcx_abstract_error INTO lx_abstract.
        " WRITE: / 'Caught Generic Abstract Error (2):', lx_abstract->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Nutzen Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) in Kombination mit `ASSIGN`, um dynamisch die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur zu iterieren und deren Werte auszulesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für RTTI. Iterieren Sie über die Komponenten und nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_output,
             component_name TYPE string,
             component_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_output,
           ty_t_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS iterate_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_t_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD iterate_structure_components.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure->* TO <ls_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                                cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <ls_structure> ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_structure> TO <lv_component_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_output(
          component_name = ls_component-name
          component_value = |{ <lv_component_value> }|
        ) TO rt_components.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (als Datenreferenz) und einen Feldnamen (als String) entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll dynamisch den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes in jeder Zeile der Tabelle auf einen neuen Wert setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <field_symbol_table>`, `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol_component>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_any_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN abap_false. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_any_table> ASSIGNING <ls_any_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_any_line> TO <lv_any_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Assign new value, handling potential type conversion issues implicitly
        " For robust solution, consider RTTI for type checks/conversions
        <lv_any_component> = iv_new_value.
      ELSE.
        " Component not found in this line's structure (should not happen if table is uniform)
        " Or component is not changeable
        RETURN abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_utclong_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong) = '20231027103000.0000000'. " UTC: 27.10.2023 10:30:00
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.

    lo_converter->convert_to_local(
      EXPORTING
        iv_utclong = lv_utclong
      IMPORTING
        ev_date    = lv_date
        ev_time    = lv_time
    ).

    " Annahme: Lokale Zeitzone ist CET/CEST, d.h. UTC+1 oder UTC+2
    " Für 27.10.2023 10:30 UTC ist es in CET 12:30 (CEST wäre 12:30, aber am 27.10. ist es schon CET)

    " Hier wird ein Beispiel für eine erwartete lokale Zeit (z.B. UTC+2) verwendet.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time exp = '123000' msg = 'Uhrzeitkonvertierung fehlerhaft (Annahme UTC+2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
