explanation: Konstruktor-Ausdrücke mit dem `NEW`-Operator ermöglichen die Instanziierung von Objekten und die Zuweisung von Werten in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Objekte zu erstellen, insbesondere wenn sie direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Expressions, NEW, Class

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zugreift (z.B. `CARRID` in `SFLIGHT`) und dessen Wert als String zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Komponente nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_access( ).
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.

    " Test existierende Komponente
    DATA(lv_carrid_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value(
                               is_structure = ls_sflight
                               iv_component = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_value exp = 'LH' ).

    " Test nicht existierende Komponente
    DATA(lv_invalid_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value(
                                iv_structure = ls_sflight
                                iv_component = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid_value exp = 'Komponente nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Komponenten von Strukturen mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in der dynamischen Programmierung. Es ermöglicht flexible Lösungen, bei denen Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, und ist ein Kernbestandteil vieler Frameworks.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Reflection

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'UA') und ein Flugdatum, das in der Zukunft liegt. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_future_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE fldate > sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( lv_carrid ).

    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_future_flights ) <= lines( lt_all_flights ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... ENDLOOP` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Declarative Programming, Data Selection

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer in Stunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln (`TIMESTAMPL`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>SUBTRACT` um die Differenz in Sekunden zu erhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dtm_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_duration_in_hours
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp_from TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp_to   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hours)   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dtm_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_duration_in_hours.
    DATA lv_seconds TYPE i.
    cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      EXPORTING
        timestamp1 = iv_timestamp_to
        timestamp2 = iv_timestamp_from
      IMPORTING
        r_secs     = lv_seconds
    ).
    rv_hours = lv_seconds / 3600.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_duration_in_hours FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duration_in_hours.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dtm_duration( ).

    " Testfall 1: 1 Stunde Differenz
    DATA(lv_tstmp_from_1) = '20251207100000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_to_1)   = '20251207110000'.
    DATA(lv_hours_1) = lo_cut->get_duration_in_hours(
                           iv_timestamp_from = lv_tstmp_from_1
                           iv_timestamp_to   = lv_tstmp_to_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hours_1 exp = 1 ).

    " Testfall 2: 2.5 Stunden Differenz (wird auf 2 gekürzt bei Integer)
    DATA(lv_tstmp_from_2) = '20251207100000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_to_2)   = '20251207123000'.
    DATA(lv_hours_2) = lo_cut->get_duration_in_hours(
                           iv_timestamp_from = lv_tstmp_from_2
                           iv_timestamp_to   = lv_tstmp_to_2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hours_2 exp = 2 ).

    " Testfall 3: Null Differenz
    DATA(lv_tstmp_from_3) = '20251207100000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_to_3)   = '20251207100000'.
    DATA(lv_hours_3) = lo_cut->get_duration_in_hours(
                           iv_timestamp_from = lv_tstmp_from_3
                           iv_timestamp_to   = lv_tstmp_to_3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hours_3 exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet eine robuste und objektorientierte Möglichkeit zur Manipulation und Berechnung mit Zeitstempeln. Die Methode `SUBTRACT` ist ideal, um die Differenz zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden zu erhalten, was eine präzise Dauerberechnung ermöglicht.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, CL_ABAP_TSTMP, Duration

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines einzelnen Fluges aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungs-ID und Flugdatum. Verwenden Sie `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` und eine Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` und `INTO @DATA(...)` ist die moderne und bevorzugte Art, einen einzelnen Datensatz aus der Datenbank zu lesen. Sie ist effizienter als `SELECT SINGLE` bei der Verwendung von `WHERE`-Klauseln, die nicht den Primärschlüssel abdecken, und die Inline-Deklaration reduziert den Code.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert und diese Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` abfängt. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    DATA lv_result TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    TRY.
        lv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler bei Division: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_handling( ).

    " Test gültige Division
    DATA(lv_result_valid) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_valid exp = 'Ergebnis: 5.00' ).

    " Test Division durch Null
    DATA(lv_result_error) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result_error exp = 'Division durch Null' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist der Standard in ABAP, um robuste und fehlerresistente Anwendungen zu entwickeln. Sie ermöglicht die saubere Trennung von Fehlerbehandlungslogik vom normalen Programmfluss und die Reaktion auf spezifische Fehlertypen.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY CATCH, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils eine Instanz der Klasse zurückgeben, um Methodenaufrufe zu verketten (Method Chaining). Demonstrieren Sie dies, indem Sie eine Fluggesellschafts-ID und eine Verbindungs-ID setzen und dann einen formatierten String abrufen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Rückgabewerte der Methoden als `TYPE REF TO SELF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.

    METHODS set_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.

    METHODS set_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.

    METHODS get_formatted_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_carrid.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_connid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_id.
    rv_id = |{ mv_carrid }-{ mv_connid }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kuchendiagramm, das die Verteilung der Flugpreise aus `sflights` in drei Kategorien (günstig, mittel, teuer) darstellt. Nutzen Sie moderne interne Tabellenoperationen zur Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` zur Kategorisierung und Aggregation der Flugpreise.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_price_distrib DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_category,
             category TYPE string,
             count    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_price_category.
    TYPES tt_price_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_distribution RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_price_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_price_distrib IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_price_distribution( ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( i_parent = iv_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_pie ).
    lo_chart->set_title( 'Flugpreisverteilung' ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data (
        VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_data_line(
          label = ls_data-category
          value = ls_data-count
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_price_distribution.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    rt_data = REDUCE tt_price_category(
      INIT lv_cheap  = 0
           lv_medium = 0
           lv_expensive = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT
        lv_cheap = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price < 300 THEN lv_cheap + 1 ELSE lv_cheap ),
        lv_medium = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price >= 300 AND ls_flight-price < 700 THEN lv_medium + 1 ELSE lv_medium ),
        lv_expensive = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price >= 700 THEN lv_expensive + 1 ELSE lv_expensive )
      FINALLY
        APPEND VALUE ty_price_category( category = 'Günstig' count = lv_cheap ) TO rt_data;
        APPEND VALUE ty_price_category( category = 'Mittel' count = lv_medium ) TO rt_data;
        APPEND VALUE ty_price_category( category = 'Teuer' count = lv_expensive ) TO rt_data
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_price_distrib( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Liniendiagramm, das die Entwicklung der durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Monat für ein bestimmtes Jahr (z.B. 2025) anzeigt. Die Datenaufbereitung soll mit modernen ABAP-Features erfolgen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` auf Monat und Jahr und den `AVG`-Aggregatfunktion. Verwenden Sie `FOR` zur Transformation der Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
                                  iv_year      TYPE s_date DEFAULT '2025'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_month,
             month     TYPE i,
             avg_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_price_month.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_month TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_month WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_monthly_avg_price IMPORTING iv_year TYPE s_date
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_avg_price_month.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_avg_price_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_monthly_avg_price( iv_year ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( i_parent = iv_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_line ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Durchschnittlicher Flugpreis pro Monat ({ iv_year })| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Durchschnittspreis' ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data (
        VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_data_line(
          label = |{ ls_data-month ALPHA = OUT }|
          value = ls_data-avg_price
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_monthly_avg_price.
    SELECT FROM sflights
      FIELDS SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 ) AS month_str, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      WHERE SUBSTRING( fldate, 1, 4 ) = @iv_year
      GROUP BY SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 )
      ORDER BY month_str ASC
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_data).

    rt_data = VALUE tt_avg_price_month(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_data (
        month = CONV i( ls_raw-month_str ),
        avg_price = ls_raw-avg_price
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_avg_price_month( ).
    DATA(lt_monthly_data) = lo_cut->get_monthly_avg_price( '2025' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_monthly_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_monthly_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_monthly_data ) exp = 12 ). " Assuming data for all 12 months in 2025

    LOOP AT lt_monthly_data INTO DATA(ls_month_data).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm und implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass die Diagrammerstellung fehlschlägt (z.B. aufgrund eines fehlenden GUI-Containers).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen der GUI-Klassen, insbesondere `cx_gui_exception`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simple_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simple_data.
    TYPES tt_simple_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simple_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sample_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_simple_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_sample_data( ).

    TRY.
        IF iv_container IS NOT BOUND.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception EXPORTING textid = cx_gui_exception=>cn_error_message.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( i_parent = iv_container ).

        lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
        lo_chart->set_title( 'Beispiel Diagramm' ).

        DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_data_table(
          FOR ls_data IN lt_data (
            VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_data_line(
              label = ls_data-label
              value = ls_data-value
            )
          )
        ).

        lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
        lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Log error or handle gracefully
        WRITE: / 'Fehler bei Diagrammerstellung:', lx_gui->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        WRITE: / 'Allgemeiner Fehler:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sample_data.
    rt_data = VALUE tt_simple_data(
      ( label = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( label = 'B' value = 20 )
      ( label = 'C' value = 15 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen einfachen HTTP-Handler, der auf eine GET-Anfrage mit dem Text "Hello from ABAP HTTP Server!" antwortet. Die Klasse muss das Interface `IF_HTTP_EXTENSION` implementieren.
hint: Implementieren Sie die Methode `IF_HTTP_EXTENSION~HANDLE_REQUEST` und setzen Sie den Antworttext mit `server->response->set_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_hello_world DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_hello_world IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'text/plain' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( 'Hello from ABAP HTTP Server!' ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_handle_request FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_request.
    DATA: lo_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server,
          lo_request TYPE REF TO if_http_request,
          lo_response TYPE REF TO if_http_response.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_server TYPE cl_http_server.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_request TYPE cl_http_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_response TYPE cl_http_response.

    lo_server->request = lo_request.
    lo_server->response = lo_response.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_hello_world( ).
    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( lo_server ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_cdata( ) exp = 'Hello from ABAP HTTP Server!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_status( ) exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_response->get_header_field( '~content_type' ) exp = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung implementiert das `IF_HTTP_EXTENSION`-Interface, das für HTTP-Handler-Klassen erforderlich ist. In der Methode `HANDLE_REQUEST` wird der Content-Type auf `text/plain` gesetzt und der Antworttext mit `set_cdata` festgelegt. Dies ist der grundlegende Aufbau eines ABAP HTTP-Handlers.
keywords: cl_http_server, IF_HTTP_EXTENSION, HTTP, Web Services, set_cdata

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen URL-Parameter (z.B. `/greet?name=World`) ausliest und eine personalisierte Begrüßung zurückgibt (z.B. "Hello, World!").

CLASS zcl_http_greet_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_name) = server->request->get_form_field( 'name' ).

    IF lv_name IS INITIAL.
      lv_name = 'Guest'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_response_text) = |Hello, { lv_name } from ABAP!|.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'text/plain' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_response_text ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_handle_request_with_param.
    DATA: lo_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server,

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-POST-Handler, der einen JSON-Payload empfängt, diesen parst und die empfangenen Daten in der HTTP-Antwort bestätigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `server->request->get_cdata( )` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_json_parser` zum Parsen des JSON-Payloads.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_body) = server->request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lv_response_json) = ''.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_abap_json_parser( iv_json = lv_request_body ).
        DATA(ls_received_data) = VALUE ty_data( ).
        lo_parser->parse( EXPORTING json = lv_request_body RECEIVING data = ls_received_data ).

        lv_response_json = |{ '"status": "success", "received_id": "' }{ ls_received_data-id }{ '", "received_name": "' }{ ls_received_data-name }{ '"' }|.
        lv_response_json = |{ '{' }{ lv_response_json }{ '}' }|.

        server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_abap_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        lv_response_json = |{ '"status": "error", "message": "JSON Parse Error: ' }{ lx_json_error->get_text( ) }{ '"' }|.
        lv_response_json = |{ '{' }{ lv_response_json }{ '}' }|.
        server->response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        lv_response_json = |{ '"status": "error", "message": "General Error: ' }{ lx_root->get_text( ) }{ '"' }|.
        lv_response_json = |{ '{' }{ lv_response_json }{ '}' }|.
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_response_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der bei einem ungültigen HTTP-Methode (z.B. PUT) einen HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed Fehler zurückgibt.
hint: Überprüfen Sie `server->request->get_method()` und setzen Sie den Status entsprechend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_method_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_method_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_method) = server->request->get_method( ).

    IF lv_method = if_http_request=>co_method_get OR lv_method = if_http_request=>co_method_post.
      server->response->set_cdata( |Method { lv_method } allowed.| ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ELSE.
      server->response->set_cdata( |Method { lv_method } not allowed.| ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
      server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Allow' value = 'GET, POST' ).
    ENDIF.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine Best Practice für die Implementierung von RESTful APIs.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Balkendiagramm, das die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt, aber nur für Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator zur Datenreduktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` auf die `sflights`-Daten, bevor Sie sie aggregieren und dem Diagramm übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
                                  iv_min_price TYPE s_price DEFAULT 500.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_cnt TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_data IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE s_price
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_filtered_flight_data( iv_min_price ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( i_parent = iv_container ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flüge > { iv_min_price } pro Fluggesellschaft| ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data (
        VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_data_line(
          label = ls_data-carrid
          value = ls_data-flight_cnt
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR <fs_flight> IN sflights ( <fs_flight> ) ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab(
      lt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price
    ).

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_cnt
      FROM @lt_filtered_flights AS flights_alias
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_carr_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_carr_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lt_carriers) = get_carriers( ).

    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id

    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'application/xml' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_xml_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen HTTP-Header 'X-API-Key' auf Gültigkeit prüft. Bei einem ungültigen oder fehlenden Schlüssel soll ein HTTP 401 Unauthorized Fehler zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `server->request->get_header_field` und `COND` für die Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_api_key_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_valid_api_key TYPE string VALUE 'MY_SECRET_API_KEY'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_api_key_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_api_key) = server->request->get_header_field( 'X-API-Key' ).

    IF lv_api_key = gc_valid_api_key.
      server->response->set_cdata( 'Access Granted!' ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ELSE.
      server->response->set_cdata( 'Unauthorized: Invalid or missing API Key.' ).
      server->response->set_status( code = 401 reason = 'Unauthorized' ).
      server->response->set_header_field( name = 'WWW-Authenticate' value = 'Bearer realm="ABAP API"' ).
    ENDIF.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = '~content_type' value = 'text/plain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Diagramm, dessen Typ dynamisch basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'BAR' oder 'PIE') gewählt wird. Zeigen Sie die Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` oder `COND` um den Diagrammtyp dynamisch zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart IMPORTING iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
                                  iv_chart_type TYPE string DEFAULT 'BAR'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_cnt TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA(lt_data) = get_flight_data( ).

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( i_parent = iv_container ).

    DATA(lv_chart_type) = COND i(
      WHEN iv_chart_type = 'BAR' THEN cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar
      WHEN iv_chart_type = 'PIE' THEN cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_pie
      ELSE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_type_bar " Default
    ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_type( lv_chart_type ).
    lo_chart->set_title( |Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft ({ iv_chart_type } Chart)| ).

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>tt_data_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data (
        VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>ty_data_line(
          label = ls_data-carrid
          value = ls_data-flight_cnt
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_cnt
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, und extrahieren Sie eine Liste von Werten aus einem spezifischen Feld ('value') innerhalb jedes Objekts.
hint: Nach dem Parsen des JSON-Strings, greifen Sie auf das JSON-Array zu und iterieren Sie über dessen Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_array_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_array_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_parse_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_array_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_array_values.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_json_root) = lo_json_parser->parse( ).
    DATA(lo_json_array) = lo_json_root->get_array( 'items' ).

    LOOP AT lo_json_array->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      APPEND lo_element->get_string( 'value' ) TO rt_values.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_array_values( lv_json ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge in einer gegebenen `sflights`-Tabelle für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                               FOR flight IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_mock_sflights) = VALUE zcl_itab_reduce_sum=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' price = '1000' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' price = '1200' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'LONDON' cityto = 'PARIS' price = '500' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' cityto = 'NEW YORK' price = '1100' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_mock_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '1500' ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_mock_sflights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '1200' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_mock_sflights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = '0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code für Summierungen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionsoperationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Gruppierung von Flügen aus der `sflights`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung durch und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `GROUP SIZE` Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_connection
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_connection.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                    connid = group_key-connid
                                    flight_count = group_key->* ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_mock_sflights) = VALUE zcl_itab_group_by=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum + 2 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_connection( lt_mock_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu aggregieren und dabei auf die Gruppenschlüssel und die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe zuzugreifen. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Aggregationslogiken erheblich.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten (Felder) einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen, insbesondere `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_elemdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_structure.
    DATA(lo_descr_ref) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr_ref ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name
                                      type = lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_type_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_analyze_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_analyzer( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN ls_sflight TO <fs_sflight>.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->analyze_structure( REF #( <fs_sflight> ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 16 ). "SFLIGHT has 16 components
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ name = 'CARRID' ]-type exp = 'S_CARR_ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_components[ name = 'CONNID' ]-type exp = 'S_CONN_ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen zur Laufzeit dynamisch abzufragen. Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und `cl_abap_structdescr` sowie `cl_abap_elemdescr`, um die Komponenten einer Struktur und deren Datentypen zu ermitteln. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, z.B. bei der Implementierung von dynamischen UI-Generatoren oder Datenkonvertern.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_elemdescr, Type Information

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein Flug 'Premium' ist, basierend auf seinem Preis und der Fluggesellschaft, unter Verwendung eines `COND`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator für konditionale Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS is_premium_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_premium) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_premium_flight.
    rv_is_premium = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN is_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND is_flight-price > 1500 THEN abap_true
      WHEN is_flight-carrid = 'AA' AND is_flight-price > 1200 THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_premium_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_premium_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    "LH Premium
    DATA(ls_flight_lh_premium) = VALUE zcl_cond_expression=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' price = '1600' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_premium_flight( ls_flight_lh_premium ) exp = abap_true ).

    "LH Not Premium
    DATA(ls_flight_lh_standard) = VALUE zcl_cond_expression=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'LH' price = '1400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_premium_flight( ls_flight_lh_standard ) exp = abap_false ).

    "AA Premium
    DATA(ls_flight_aa_premium) = VALUE zcl_cond_expression=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'AA' price = '1300' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_premium_flight( ls_flight_aa_premium ) exp = abap_true ).

    "Other Carrier
    DATA(ls_flight_ua) = VALUE zcl_cond_expression=>ty_flight_data( carrid = 'UA' price = '2000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_premium_flight( ls_flight_ua ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Reihe von Bedingungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und führt zu deutlich kürzerem und lesbarerem Code, insbesondere bei komplexeren Bedingungsprüfungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Expression, Readability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine resumable Ausnahme auslöst, und eine aufrufende Methode, die versucht, den Fehler zu beheben und die Ausführung fortzusetzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE` und `RESUME`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA error_value TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
                                  previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
                                  i_error_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor( previous = previous ).
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->error_value = i_error_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_resumable_error.

    METHODS caller_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_value < 0.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error
        EXPORTING
          error_value = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD caller_method.
    DATA lv_current_value TYPE i VALUE iv_initial_value.
    DATA lv_attempts TYPE i VALUE 0.
    WHILE lv_attempts < 3. " Try to fix 3 times
      TRY.
          rv_final_result = process_data( lv_current_value ).
          RETURN. " Success
        CATCH zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable).
          lv_attempts = lv_attempts + 1.
          IF lv_attempts < 3.
            lv_current_value = ABS( lx_resumable->error_value ). " Attempt to fix
            RESUME.
          ELSE.
            " Cannot fix, re-raise or handle as non-resumable
            RAISE EXCEPTION lx_resumable.
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.
    " If loop finishes without return, it means it failed after attempts
    rv_final_result = -1. " Indicate failure
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_resumable_fix FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_resumable_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_success.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resumable_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_demo->caller_method( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_resumable_fix.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resumable_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_demo->caller_method( -5 ). " Should be fixed to 5, then result 10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_resumable_fail.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_resumable_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_demo->caller_method( -1 ). " Will try to fix, but -1 will always be negative.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_resumable_error not re-raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_resumable_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_resumable_error correctly re-raised after attempts.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Resumable Ausnahmen (`RESUMABLE` Keyword) ermöglichen es, nach dem Abfangen einer Ausnahme die Ausführung an der Stelle fortzusetzen, an der die Ausnahme ausgelöst wurde, nachdem der Fehler im `CATCH` Block behoben wurde. Dies ist nützlich für Fehler, die programmatisch korrigiert werden können.

    " If assertion fails, a runtime error (ASSERTION_FAILED) occurs

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Teil eines Byte-Strings, beginnend an einem bestimmten Offset und mit einer bestimmten Länge, in einen String.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Parameter `offset` und `n` in der Methode `read` von `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_partial_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_partial_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_encoding TYPE abap_encoding
        iv_offset TYPE i
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_partial_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_partial_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
    lo_conv->read( EXPORTING input = iv_xstring
                             offset = iv_offset
                             n = iv_length
                    IMPORTING data = rv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_partial_read FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    METHODS test_partial_read_full FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_partial_read.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_partial_read( ).
    DATA(lv_full_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = 'ABCDEFG' codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    " Convert 'CDE' (offset 2, length 3 for UTF-8, which is 3 bytes per char for simple ASCII)
    " For ASCII, 1 char = 1 byte. So offset 2, length 3 means 3 bytes from 3rd byte.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_partial_xstring(
                           iv_xstring = lv_full_xstring
                           iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                           iv_offset = 2
                           iv_length = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'CDE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_read_full.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_partial_read( ).
    DATA(lv_full_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = 'ABCDEFG' codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_converter->convert_partial_xstring(
                           iv_xstring = lv_full_xstring
                           iv_encoding = 'UTF-8'
                           iv_offset = 0
                           iv_length = xstrlen( lv_full_xstring ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABCDEFG' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Parameter `OFFSET` und `N` in der `READ`-Methode von `CL_ABAP_CONV_IN_CE` ermöglichen die selektive Konvertierung von Teilbereichen eines Byte-Strings. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn große Binärdaten verarbeitet werden und nur bestimmte Abschnitte relevant sind oder wenn Daten in Blöcken gelesen werden müssen.

  METHOD test_calculate_logarithms.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_logarithm( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_cut->calculate_logarithms( iv_value = 10 ).
    " Assertions for floating point numbers need tolerance
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_delta( act = ls_results-natural_log exp = '2.3025850929940456840179914546844' delta = '0.0000000000000000000000000000001' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für Flüge, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen (z.B. 'LH' als Carrier ID), unter Verwendung einer modernen Reduktionssyntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHEN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights_data TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_data
        UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_data = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights_data
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Elemente einer Quelltabelle enthält, wobei ein Feld der neuen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung im Quell-Element gesetzt wird. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `WHEN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` zum Filtern und `COND` mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             value  TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES tt_source_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             processed_value TYPE i,
             is_high_value   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_source_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    rt_target_items = VALUE #( 
      FOR item IN it_source_items
      WHERE ( status = 'A' ) "Filter for active items
      ( id = item-id
        processed_value = item-value * 2
        is_high_value = COND abap_bool( WHEN item-value > 100 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_active_items FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD test_process_items.
      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_table( ).
      DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_cond_table=>tt_source_items(
        ( id = 1 value = 50 status = 'A' )
        ( id = 2 value = 120 status = 'A' )
        ( id = 3 value = 30 status = 'I' ) "Inactive, should be filtered out
        ( id = 4 value = 200 status = 'A' )
      ).
      DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_source ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-processed_value exp = 100 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-is_high_value exp = abap_false ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-processed_value exp = 240 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-is_high_value exp = abap_true ).
    ENDMETHOD.

    METHOD test_no_active_items.
      DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_table( ).
      DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_cond_table=>tt_source_items(
        ( id = 1 value = 50 status = 'I' )
      ).
      DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_source ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 0 ).
    ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR` Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. `WHERE` filtert die Zeilen, und `COND` mit `WHEN` erlaubt die bedingte Berechnung von Feldern für die neue Tabelle.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, WHERE, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Transformation

      " Handle error
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_viewer

      " mo_viewer->set_property( 'ZOOM' = '1.0' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_viewer->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_viewer.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ecl_viewer_events IMPLEMENTATION.

    SET HANDLER handle_click FOR mo_viewer.

  METHOD handle_click.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach mehreren Kriterien und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Ergebnissen. Nutzen Sie `FILTER` mit `WHEN`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer `WHERE` Klausel, die mehrere Bedingungen enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_data TYPE tt_sflight.

    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_data
        UP TO 100 ROWS. "Limit for example
    ELSE.
      lt_sflights_data = it_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_data
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
                                    AND price >= iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )

      ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode dynamisch aus, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und übergeben Sie dabei Parameter. Nutzen Sie moderne Syntax für die dynamische Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS _method_a
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS _method_b
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_importing.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    ls_parameter-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
    ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_returning.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF LOCAL INSTANCE me
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD test_dynamic_method_a.

    ENDMETHOD.

Es erlaubt die Bestimmung der aufzurufenden Methode und ihrer Parameter zur Laufzeit, was in Szenarien wie Plugin-Architekturen oder generischen Frameworks nützlich ist. Die Verwendung von `GET REFERENCE OF` für Parameter ist hierbei entscheidend.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Query-Parameter aus einer gegebenen URL in eine interne Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>PARSE_URL` um den Query-String zu erhalten, und dann String-Operationen mit `SPLIT` und `UNESCAPE_URL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_parse_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_param.
    TYPES ty_t_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_query_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE ty_t_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_parse_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_query_params.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = cl_http_utility=>parse_url( iv_url = iv_url ).
    IF lv_query_string IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SPLIT lv_query_string AT '&' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_pairs).

    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      DATA(lv_name)  = '' .
      DATA(lv_value) = '' .
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO lv_name lv_value.
      INSERT VALUE #( name = cl_http_utility=>unescape_url( lv_name ) value = cl_http_utility=>unescape_url( lv_value ) ) INTO TABLE rt_params.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_params ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'param1' INTO DATA(ls_param1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param1-value exp = 'value1' ).
    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'param2' INTO DATA(ls_param2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param2-value exp = 'value2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_params_special_chars.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_params ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'name' INTO DATA(ls_param_name).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param_name-value exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).
    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'city' INTO DATA(ls_param_city).

INTO` verwendet, um die einzelnen Parameter zu zerlegen und mit `UNESCAPE_URL` zu dekodieren. Dies ermöglicht eine effiziente und lesbare Verarbeitung von URL-Parametern.

CLASS zcl_http_build_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR param IN it_params
      NEXT s = COND string(
                 WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ``
                 ELSE s && `&`
               )
               && cl_http_utility=>escape_url( param-name )
               && `=`
               && cl_http_utility=>escape_url( param-value )
    ).

    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_url = iv_base_url.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strukturen beliebigen Typs dynamisch Feld für Feld auf Gleichheit.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Komponenten beider Strukturen und vergleichen Sie die Werte dynamisch mit Feld-Symbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structures
      IMPORTING
        ir_struct1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_struct2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_structs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structures.
    DATA(lo_descr1) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_struct1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr2) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_struct2 ).

    IF lo_descr1->get_relative_name( ) <> lo_descr2->get_relative_name( ).
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lo_descr1->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_value1> TYPE any,
                     <lv_value2> TYPE any.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE ir_struct1->* TO <lv_value1>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen if types are identical
        rv_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp-name OF STRUCTURE ir_struct2->* TO <lv_value2>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Should not happen if types are identical
        rv_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      IF <lv_value1> <> <lv_value2>.
        rv_are_equal = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_are_equal = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_str_replace_in_itab IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie führende und abschließende Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` für doppelte Leerzeichen und `CONDENSE` oder `STRIP` für führende/abschließende Leerzeichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_dirty_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_clean_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_clean_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string_spaces.
    rv_clean_string = iv_dirty_string.
    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    rv_clean_string = |{ rv_clean_string ALPHA = OUT }|.
    " Replace multiple spaces with single space
    rv_clean_string = REPLACE( val = rv_clean_string regex = '\s+' new = ' ' occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_spaces FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_clean_spaces( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( '  Hello   World   ABAP  ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World ABAP' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( 'SingleWord' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'SingleWord' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->clean_string_spaces( '   ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert moderne String-Templates (`ALPHA = OUT` für führende/abschließende Leerzeichen) mit `REPLACE` und regulären Ausdrücken (`\s+` für ein oder mehrere Leerzeichen), um Strings effizient zu bereinigen. Dies ist wesentlich flexibler und kürzer als ältere `CONDENSE` oder `SHIFT` Anweisungen.
keywords: REPLACE, REGEX, String, String Templates, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie den ersten Buchstaben jedes Wortes in einem Satz durch seinen Großbuchstaben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE` mit `REGEX` und Backreferences oder eine Schleife mit `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_capitalize_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS capitalize_first_letter
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_capitalized_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_capitalize_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD capitalize_first_letter.
    DATA(lv_temp_sentence) = iv_sentence.
    " Capitalize first letter of the whole sentence
    lv_temp_sentence = REPLACE( val = lv_temp_sentence regex = '^(\w)' new = '$1' ).
    lv_temp_sentence = to_upper( substring( val = lv_temp_sentence off = 0 len = 1 ) ) && substring( val = lv_temp_sentence off = 1 ).

    " Capitalize first letter after a space
    rv_capitalized_sentence = REPLACE( val = lv_temp_sentence regex = '(\s)(\w)' new = |$1{ to_upper( '$2' ) }| occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_capitalize_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_capitalize_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_capitalize_words( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->capitalize_first_letter( 'hello world abap' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World Abap' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->capitalize_first_letter( 'another test sentence' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Another Test Sentence' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->capitalize_first_letter( 'singleword' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Singleword' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REPLACE` mit regulären Ausdrücken und String-Funktionen wie `TO_UPPER` und `SUBSTRING` in String-Templates. Der Regex `(\s)(\w)` fängt ein Leerzeichen und den darauf folgenden Buchstaben ein, wobei der Buchstabe dann in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird. Dies ist eine elegante Lösung für die Wortkapitalisierung.
keywords: REPLACE, REGEX, String, TO_UPPER, ABAP 7.40

hint: Die Klasse `SABP_CONVERT` kann zur Codepage-Erkennung verwendet werden, obwohl `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` die primäre Klasse für Konvertierungen ist. Für die Erkennung ist oft eine Heuristik oder Vorabinformation nötig. Hier wird eine Annahme getroffen oder eine bekannte Codepage verwendet.

CLASS zcl_codepage_detect_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_and_convert
      IMPORTING
        ix_input_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_fallback_cp   TYPE cpactab-codepage DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_detect_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_and_convert.
    " In real scenarios, codepage detection is complex and often requires external libraries or heuristics.
    " SABP_CONVERT is typically used for specific conversions, not general detection.
    " For this example, we assume a known fallback or a simple case.
    " If SABP_CONVERT was meant for detection, its API would be different.
    " We will use CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE with a fallback.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter( iv_fallback_cp ).
        rv_output_string = lo_codepage->convert_from( ix_input_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Fallback or error handling if conversion fails
        rv_output_string = 'Conversion failed or unknown codepage'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `SABP_CONVERT` um einen String von einer Codepage in eine andere zu konvertieren, ohne die `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` Klasse direkt zu instanziieren.
hint: Die Funktion `SABP_CONVERT` ist eine ältere, aber immer noch nutzbare Funktion für Codepage-Konvertierungen. Sie erfordert die Angabe von Quell- und Ziel-Codepage-IDs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_s_abp_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_sabp
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string  TYPE string
        iv_source_cp     TYPE cpactab-codepage
        iv_target_cp     TYPE cpactab-codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_s_abp_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_sabp.
    DATA: lv_xstring_temp TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring using source codepage
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = iv_input_string
        encoding = iv_source_cp
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring_temp
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    ENDIF.

    " Convert xstring to string using target codepage
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_STRING'
      EXPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xstring_temp
        encoding = iv_target_cp
      IMPORTING
        text     = rv_output_string
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage, wobei die Konvertierung in einer `FOR` Expression gekapselt ist.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` Expressions mit der `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` Klasse für eine funktionale Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_itab_transcode DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transcode_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_source_cp     TYPE cpactab-codepage
        iv_target_cp     TYPE cpactab-codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_itab_transcode IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transcode_string_table.
    DATA(lo_source_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter( iv_source_cp ).
    DATA(lo_target_converter) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_codepage_converter( iv_target_cp ).

    rt_output_strings = VALUE #( FOR lv_string IN it_input_strings
                                 LET lx_intermediate = lo_source_converter->convert_to( lv_string )
                                 IN
                                 ( lo_target_converter->convert_from( lx_intermediate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transcode_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transcode_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_itab_transcode( ).
    DATA(lt_test_strings) = VALUE zcl_codepage_itab_transcode=>tt_strings( ( 'Hallo' ) ( 'Grüße' ) ( 'Welt' ) ).
    DATA(lv_source_cp) = '1100'. " Latin-1
    DATA(lv_target_cp) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transcode_string_table( it_input_strings = lt_test_strings
                                                      iv_source_cp = lv_source_cp
                                                      iv_target_cp = lv_target_cp ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_codepage_itab_transcode=>tt_strings( ( 'Hallo' ) ( 'Grüße' ) ( 'Welt' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    " Test with different codepages, ensuring content integrity
    DATA(lt_test_strings_utf8) = VALUE zcl_codepage_itab_transcode=>tt_strings( ( 'Äpfel' ) ( 'Birnen' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result_utf8) = lo_cut->transcode_string_table( it_input_strings = lt_test_strings_utf8
                                                           iv_source_cp = 'UTF-8'
                                                           iv_target_cp = '1100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_utf8 exp = lt_test_strings_utf8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `FOR` Expressions für interne Tabellen mit der `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` Klasse. Durch die Verwendung von `LET` für die Zwischen-XSTRING-Konvertierung bleibt der Code innerhalb der `FOR` Expression kompakt und lesbar, was eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt.

Instructions: Erstellen und füllen Sie eine Hashed Table mit Flugdaten aus 'sflights' unter Verwendung des 'VALUE' Operators und einer 'FOR' Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )' für die Initialisierung und Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_create_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_sflights_hashed
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_create_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_hashed.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                             connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                             fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                             seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Hashed table should contain entries' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität ('seatsocc') für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer Hashed Table unter Verwendung des 'REDUCE' Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'REDUCE' Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_hashed
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer Hashed Table existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden, unter Verwendung von 'LINE_EXISTS()' und 'LINE_INDEX()'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die funktionalen Ausdrücke 'LINE_EXISTS()' und 'LINE_INDEX()' mit dem Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_hashed
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    ev_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = LINE_INDEX( it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
