    DATA mt_flights TYPE zcl_ht_line_ops=>tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 150 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_exists_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_line_ops( ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool, lv_index TYPE i.
    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' it_flights = mt_flights
                                 IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_exists_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_line_ops( ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool, lv_index TYPE i.
    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' it_flights = mt_flights
                                 IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die funktionalen Ausdrücke 'LINE_EXISTS()' und 'LINE_INDEX()' bieten eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, die Existenz eines Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen und dessen Index zu ermitteln. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Hashed Tables, da der Zugriff über den Schlüssel optimiert ist. Die Verwendung von 'COND' für die bedingte Zuweisung ist ebenfalls ein modernes ABAP-Feature.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table mit einer dynamischen Schlüsseldefinition zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI ('cl_abap_tabledescr') und 'CREATE DATA' mit 'TYPE HANDLE'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_dynamic_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_hashed_table
      IMPORTING
        it_key_fields TYPE string_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_dynamic_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_hashed_table.
    DATA: lt_key_components TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>t_key_components,
          ls_key_component  TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>s_key_component.

    LOOP AT it_key_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_key_component-name = lv_field_name.
      APPEND ls_key_component TO lt_key_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_key_components IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Key fields cannot be empty'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_name( 'ZCL_HT_DYNAMIC_KEY=>TY_DATA' ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                  p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
                                  p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
                                  p_unique = abap_true
                                  p_key_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>keykind_user
                                  p_key_components = lt_key_components ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_key_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_key_fields RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_key_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_dynamic_key( ).
    DATA lt_key_fields TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'FIELD1' TO lt_key_fields.
    APPEND 'FIELD2' TO lt_key_fields.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_hashed_table( lt_key_fields ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_dynamic_table ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_table_descr->table_kind exp = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_table_descr->key_components ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_key_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_dynamic_key( ).
    DATA lt_key_fields TYPE string_table.
    lo_cut->create_dynamic_hashed_table( lt_key_fields ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer Hashed Table mit einem zur Laufzeit definierten Schlüssel. Dies wird durch RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und die Klassen 'cl_abap_tabledescr' und 'cl_abap_structdescr' erreicht. Der 'CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE' Befehl ermöglicht die Instanziierung eines Datentyps, der dynamisch beschrieben wurde. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Anwendungen, bei denen die Tabellenstruktur oder der Schlüssel nicht zur Kompilierzeit feststeht.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV mit einer benutzerdefinierten Statusleiste, die die Anzahl der angezeigten Zeilen anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'get_functions()' und 'set_status_function()' sowie 'set_status_text()'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_status_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_salv_events_functions.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_status.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_status_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        mo_alv = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                          t_table   = lt_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_functions) = mo_alv->get_functions( ).
        lo_functions->set_all( abap_true ).
        lo_functions->set_status_function( abap_true ).

        DATA(lo_events_functions) = mo_alv->get_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER me->if_salv_events_functions~added_function FOR lo_events_functions.

        mo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_salv_events_functions~added_function.
    IF r_salv_function->get_function( ) = if_salv_c_function=>status_function.
      DATA(lv_lines) = lines( mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* ).
      r_salv_function->set_status_text( |Anzahl Zeilen: { lv_lines }| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies bietet eine verbesserte Benutzererfahrung und ist ein Beispiel für die erweiterte Interaktivität des modernen ALV-Objektmodells. Die 'cl_salv_controller_metadata' ist hierbei für die Verwaltung der Funktions- und Statusleisten zuständig.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'LEFT OUTER JOIN' Operation zwischen zwei Hashed Tables durch, um Flugdaten mit zusätzlichen Informationen zu verknüpfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den 'FOR ... IN ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ...' Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_base,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_base.
    TYPES tt_flight_base_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_base WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_info,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_info.
    TYPES tt_carrier_info_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_info WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES tt_joined_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS perform_left_join
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_base_hashed
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_info_hashed
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_joined_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_left_join.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               LEFT OUTER JOIN it_carriers AS ls_carrier
                                 ON ls_flight~carrid = ls_carrier~carrid
                               ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                 fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 carrname = ls_carrier-carrname ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_left_join FOR TESTING.

    DATA mt_flights TYPE zcl_ht_left_join=>tt_flight_base_hashed.
    DATA mt_carriers TYPE zcl_ht_left_join=>tt_carrier_info_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
                          ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' ) ).
    mt_carriers = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
                           ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_left_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->perform_left_join( it_flights = mt_flights it_carriers = mt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_joined INTO DATA(ls_joined_lh) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_joined_lh-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).

    READ TABLE lt_joined INTO DATA(ls_joined_xx) INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_joined_xx-carrname ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FOR ... IN ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ...' Ausdruck ermöglicht es, 'JOIN'-Operationen direkt auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen, ähnlich wie bei Datenbanktabellen. Dies ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature, das die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit des Codes verbessert. Es ist besonders effizient, wenn die beteiligten Tabellen Hashed Tables sind, da der Schlüsselzugriff optimiert ist.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, LEFT OUTER JOIN, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Data Joins

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table und verwenden Sie den 'GROUP BY' Ausdruck in einer 'LOOP' Schleife, um Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu zählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key)'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ht_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights_hashed TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_hashed
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ht_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.

    DATA mt_flights TYPE zcl_ht_group_by=>tt_flights_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
                          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' )
                          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250103' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ht_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( mt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_lh-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_aa-flight_count exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'GROUP BY' Ausdruck in einer 'LOOP' Schleife ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature, um Einträge in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Er ermöglicht es, über Gruppen von Zeilen zu iterieren und gruppenspezifische Berechnungen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu traditionellen 'AT NEW' oder manuellen Gruppierungslogiken und funktioniert hervorragend mit Hashed Tables.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, GROUP BY, LOOP, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Füge einen einzelnen neuen Flugdatensatz in die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ein.
hint: Nutze `INSERT sflights FROM @wa` mit `VALUE #(...)` für die Arbeitsbereichsinitialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_new_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_new_flight.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
      price = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'A320'
      seatsmax = 150
      seatsocc = 50
      paymentsum = '5000.00'
      seatsocc_b = 10
      seatsocc_f = 5
    ).

    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen des Flugdatensatzes'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_new_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_new_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '9999'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->insert_new_flight(
          iv_carrid = lv_carrid
          iv_connid = lv_connid
          iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

        DATA(ls_check) = VALUE sflights( ).
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_check
          WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'SQL Exception caught during insert' ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT dbtab FROM @wa` Syntax ist die moderne Art, einen einzelnen Datensatz in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Die `VALUE`-Syntax wird hier verwendet, um den Arbeitsbereich `ls_flight` direkt zu initialisieren, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `sy-subrc` und `cx_sy_sql_exception` ist ebenfalls Best Practice.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS, VALUE, SQL, Exception Handling

Instructions: Füge mehrere Flugdatensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ein.
hint: Nutze `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @itab` für den Massen-Insert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_from_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.

    METHODS delete_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_from_table.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @it_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-subrc <> 4. " 0: OK, 4: Duplicate keys accepted
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Massen-Einfügen von Flugdatensätzen'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flights.
    DELETE sflights FROM TABLE @it_flight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_from_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_table( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9990' fldate = lv_date price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 paymentsum = '5000.00' seatsocc_b = 10 seatsocc_f = 5 )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '9991' fldate = lv_date price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 paymentsum = '20000.00' seatsocc_b = 20 seatsocc_f = 10 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_table=>tt_flight_keys(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9990' fldate = lv_date )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '9991' fldate = lv_date )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->insert_flights_from_table( lt_new_flights ).

        DATA(lv_count) = 0.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_count
          WHERE carrid IN ('XX', 'YY') AND fldate = @lv_date.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'SQL Exception caught during bulk insert' ).
      FINALLY.
        lo_cut->delete_flights( lt_flight_keys ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INSERT dbtab FROM TABLE @itab` Befehl ist die bevorzugte Methode für Massen-Inserts in Datenbanktabellen. Er ist performanter als das Einfügen einzelner Zeilen in einer Schleife. `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` verhindert einen Dump bei doppelten Schlüsseln und setzt `sy-subrc` auf 4, was eine saubere Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS, TABLE, Bulk Insert, Performance

Instructions: Füge neue Flugdatensätze in die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ein, die aus einer `SELECT`-Anweisung stammen, wobei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Währung berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Nutze `INSERT sflights FROM ( SELECT ... )` um Daten direkt aus einer Abfrage einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flights_from_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE s_curr_code
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_rows) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.

    METHODS delete_inserted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_from_select.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 1.
    INSERT sflights FROM (
      SELECT carrid, connid, @lv_fldate AS fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc, paymentsum, seatsocc_b, seatsocc_f
        FROM sflights
        WHERE currency = @iv_currency
    ).
    rv_inserted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen von Flugdatensätzen aus SELECT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_inserted_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_new_carrid AND fldate = @( sy-datum + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_from_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_select( ).
    DATA(lv_currency) = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_new_carrid) = 'ZZ'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Prepare test data (ensure some EUR flights exist)
    DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 paymentsum = '5000.00' seatsocc_b = 10 seatsocc_f = 5 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_test_flight ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_initial_count) = 0.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_initial_count WHERE fldate = @lv_fldate.

        DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flights_from_select(
          iv_currency = lv_currency
          iv_new_carrid = lv_new_carrid ).

        DATA(lv_final_count) = 0.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_final_count WHERE fldate = @lv_fldate.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_inserted ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_count exp = lv_initial_count + lv_inserted ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'SQL Exception caught during INSERT FROM SELECT' ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
        lo_cut->delete_inserted_flights( lv_new_carrid ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT dbtab FROM ( SELECT ... )` Syntax ermöglicht das direkte Einfügen von Daten, die durch eine `SELECT`-Anweisung ermittelt wurden, in eine Datenbanktabelle. Dies ist äußerst effizient, da die Datenverarbeitung vollständig auf der Datenbankebene stattfindet und keine Daten zwischen Applikationsserver und Datenbank transportiert werden müssen. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen (`@lv_fldate`) innerhalb der `SELECT`-Anweisung ist ein Merkmal von Open SQL mit ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, Open SQL, Performance

Instructions: Definiere eine abstrakte Klasse für die Verarbeitung von Flugdaten mit einer abstrakten Methode, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden muss.
hint: Verwende `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` um die Vererbungshierarchie zu gestalten.
solution:
ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_abstract_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
             cityto TYPE s_cityname,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.

    ABSTRACT METHODS process_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA ms_flight_info TYPE ty_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_flight_info = is_flight_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_abstract_class_concept FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_abstract_class_concept.
    " Eine abstrakte Klasse kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden.
    " Der Test konzentriert sich darauf, dass eine konkrete Unterklasse
    " die abstrakte Methode implementieren muss.
    " Hier wird nur die Existenz der abstrakten Klasse und Methode geprüft.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_abstract_flight_processor=>ty_flight_info(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' ).

    " Versuch, eine abstrakte Klasse zu instanziieren, würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen.
    " DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_abstract_flight_processor( ls_flight ). " -> Syntaxfehler

    " Der eigentliche Test erfolgt in der konkreten Implementierung.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true " Dummy-Assertion, da abstrakte Klasse nicht direkt testbar ist
      msg = 'Abstract class definition successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine `ABSTRACT CLASS` kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden und dient als Blaupause für Unterklassen. `ABSTRACT METHODS` müssen in jeder konkreten Unterklasse implementiert werden. Dies erzwingt eine bestimmte Schnittstelle und Verhaltensweise in der Vererbungshierarchie und ist ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung für Polymorphie.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Method, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Inheritance

Instructions: Implementiere eine konkrete Klasse, die von der abstrakten Flugdatenverarbeitungsklasse erbt und deren abstrakte Methode implementiert, um Flugdetails zu protokollieren.
hint: Erbe von der abstrakten Klasse und implementiere die abstrakte Methode `process_flight_data`.

CLASS zcl_concrete_flight_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_flight_processor CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_flight_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    rv_result = |Flight { ms_flight_info-carrid } { ms_flight_info-connid } from { ms_flight_info-cityfrom } to { ms_flight_info-cityto } on { ms_flight_info-fldate } processed.|
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concrete_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concrete_logger.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_abstract_flight_processor=>ty_flight_info(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' cityfrom = 'FRA' cityto = 'JFK' ).

    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_concrete_flight_logger( ls_flight ).

Dies zeigt, wie konkrete Implementierungen das durch die abstrakte Klasse vorgegebene Verhalten bereitstellen. Instructions: Erstelle eine abstrakte Fabrikmethode, die verschiedene konkrete Implementierungen einer abstrakten Datenverarbeitungsklasse zurückgibt, welche dann Daten in eine interne Tabelle einfügen.
hint: Kombiniere abstrakte Klassen/Methoden mit dem Fabrik-Muster und `INSERT` in interne Tabellen. Nutze `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_data_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
           carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           fldate TYPE s_date,
         END OF ty_flight_data.
  TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS insert_data
    IMPORTING
      is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
    CHANGING
      ct_target_table TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_single_flight_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_inserter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_single_flight_inserter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_data_inserter~insert_data.
    INSERT is_flight_data INTO TABLE ct_target_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_inserter_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_inserter
      IMPORTING
        iv_inserter_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_inserter) TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_inserter
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_inserter_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_inserter.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_{ iv_inserter_type }_FLIGHT_INSERTER|.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_inserter TYPE (lv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Erstellen des Inserters: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_factory_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_insert.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zif_flight_data_inserter=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = zif_flight_data_inserter=>tt_flight_data( ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_inserter) = zcl_abstract_inserter_factory=>create_inserter( 'SINGLE' ).
        lo_inserter->zif_flight_data_inserter~insert_data(
          is_flight_data = ls_flight
          CHANGING
            ct_target_table = lt_flights ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Fabrik-Muster mit einer abstrakten Fabrikklasse und dynamischer Objekterzeugung. Die abstrakte Fabrikmethode `create_inserter` erzeugt Instanzen von Klassen, die das Interface `zif_flight_data_inserter` implementieren. Die konkrete Klasse `zcl_single_flight_inserter` implementiert die `insert_data`-Methode, die `INSERT` für interne Tabellen verwendet. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und erweiterbare Architektur, bei der die Art des Inserters zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden kann.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Factory Pattern, Dynamic Programming, INSERT, Interface, Polymorphism

Instructions: Implementiere eine Strategie, bei der verschiedene konkrete Klassen (die von einer abstrakten Klasse erben) unterschiedliche `INSERT`-Operationen auf die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ausführen.
hint: Nutze das Strategie-Muster mit abstrakten Klassen und `INSERT` in Datenbanktabellen. Jede Strategie implementiert eine andere Art des Einfügens.
solution:
ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_flight_save_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights.

    ABSTRACT METHODS save_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA ms_flight TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_save_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_flight = is_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_single_insert_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_save_strategy CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_flight REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_single_insert_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_flight.
    INSERT sflights FROM @me->ms_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen eines einzelnen Fluges'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_saver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_save_strategy.

    METHODS execute_save
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_save_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_saver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_save.
    mo_strategy->save_flight( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_strategy_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_insert.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'ST'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 paymentsum = '5000.00' seatsocc_b = 10 seatsocc_f = 5 ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_strategy) = NEW zcl_single_insert_strategy( ls_flight ).
        DATA(lo_saver) = NEW zcl_flight_saver( lo_strategy ).
        lo_saver->execute_save( ).

        DATA(ls_check) = VALUE sflights( ).
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_check
          WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Strategie-Muster. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_flight_save_strategy` definiert die Schnittstelle für das Speichern von Flügen. Konkrete Strategien wie `zcl_single_insert_strategy` implementieren die `save_flight`-Methode, die hier einen `INSERT` in die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ausführt. Die Klasse `zcl_flight_saver` verwendet eine dieser Strategien zur Laufzeit. Dies ermöglicht es, den Algorithmus (die Art des Speicherns) unabhängig vom Client zu variieren.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Versuche, einen doppelten Datensatz in `SFLIGHTS` einzufügen und behandle den Fehler mit `CATCH CX_SY_SQL_DUPLICATE_KEY`.
hint: Nutze `INSERT` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks, um die spezifische Ausnahme `CX_SY_SQL_DUPLICATE_KEY` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_with_duplicate_check
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_with_duplicate_check.
    TRY.
        INSERT sflights FROM @is_flight.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_duplicate_key.
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Optional: Log the error or send a message
        " MESSAGE 'Duplicate key error for flight' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Handle other SQL errors
        " MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
                          AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
                          AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_duplicate_key_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duplicate_key_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'DP'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 paymentsum = '5000.00' seatsocc_b = 10 seatsocc_f = 5 ).

    " Sicherstellen, dass der Datensatz nicht existiert
    lo_cut->delete_flight( ls_flight ).

    " Erster Insert sollte erfolgreich sein
    DATA(lv_success1) = lo_cut->insert_flight_with_duplicate_check( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success1 ).

    " Zweiter Insert mit denselben Schlüsseln sollte fehlschlagen und die Ausnahme abfangen
    DATA(lv_success2) = lo_cut->insert_flight_with_duplicate_check( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success2 ).

    FINALLY.
      lo_cut->delete_flight( ls_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Behandlung von Ausnahmen bei Datenbankoperationen ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen. `TRY...CATCH` ermöglicht das Abfangen spezifischer SQL-Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_SQL_DUPLICATE_KEY`, die ausgelöst wird, wenn versucht wird, einen Datensatz mit einem bereits existierenden Primärschlüssel einzufügen. Dies verhindert einen Programmabbruch und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion auf den Fehler.
keywords: INSERT, Database, Error Handling, Exception, CX_SY_SQL_DUPLICATE_KEY, TRY CATCH

Instructions: Definiere eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer konkreten Methode und einer abstrakten Methode, um die Kombination von implementiertem und abstraktem Verhalten zu zeigen.
hint: Eine abstrakte Klasse kann sowohl konkrete als auch abstrakte Methoden enthalten.
solution:
ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_mixed_abstract_class DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

    ABSTRACT METHODS perform_specific_action
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_action_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mixed_abstract_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_name.
    rv_name = 'zcl_mixed_abstract_class'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mixed_abstract_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mixed_abstract_class.
    " Eine abstrakte Klasse kann nicht direkt instanziiert werden.
    " Wir testen eine konkrete Unterklasse, um die Funktionalität zu demonstrieren.
    CLASS lcl_concrete_impl DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_mixed_abstract_class.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS perform_specific_action REDEFINITION.
    ENDDEFINITION.

    CLASS lcl_concrete_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD perform_specific_action.
        rv_action_result = 'Specific action performed by concrete class'.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDIMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW lcl_concrete_impl( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance->get_class_name( ) exp = 'zcl_mixed_abstract_class' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_instance->perform_specific_action( ) exp = 'Specific action performed by concrete class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, dass eine `ABSTRACT CLASS` sowohl vollständig implementierte Methoden (`get_class_name`) als auch `ABSTRACT METHODS` (`perform_specific_action`) enthalten kann. Dies ermöglicht es, gemeinsames Verhalten in der abstrakten Klasse zu kapseln, während spezifisches Verhalten den Unterklassen überlassen wird. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code und die Einhaltung des Prinzips der Vererbung.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Class, Method, Object Orientation, Inheritance, Mixed Behavior

Instructions: Füge neue Flugdatensätze in die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ein, basierend auf einer `SELECT`-Anweisung, die Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` und `SCARR` kombiniert.
hint: Nutze `INSERT dbtab FROM ( SELECT ... FROM ... JOIN ... )` für komplexe Datenintegration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flights_from_join
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_rows) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_sql_exception.

    METHODS delete_inserted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_from_join.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 2.
    INSERT sflights FROM (
      SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, @lv_fldate AS fldate, s~price, s~currency, s~planetype, s~seatsmax, s~seatsocc, s~paymentsum, s~seatsocc_b, s~seatsocc_f
        FROM sflights AS s
        INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
        WHERE s~price > @iv_min_price
          AND c~currcode = s~currency " Beispielhafte zusätzliche Bedingung
    ).
    rv_inserted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_sql_exception
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Einfügen von Flugdatensätzen aus JOIN-SELECT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_inserted_flights.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE fldate = @( sy-datum + 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_from_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_join( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '50.00'.
    DATA(lv_new_carrid) = 'JN'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum + 2.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten existieren
    DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 paymentsum = '5000.00' seatsocc_b = 10 seatsocc_f = 5 ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_test_flight ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_initial_count) = 0.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_initial_count WHERE fldate = @lv_fldate.

        DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_flights_from_join(
          iv_min_price = lv_min_price
          iv_new_carrid = lv_new_carrid ).

        DATA(lv_final_count) = 0.
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_final_count WHERE fldate = @lv_fldate.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_inserted ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_count exp = lv_initial_count + lv_inserted ).

      CATCH cx_sy_sql_exception INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
      FINALLY.
        DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
        lo_cut->delete_inserted_flights( lv_new_carrid ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die `INSERT FROM SELECT`-Funktionalität, indem es eine `INNER JOIN`-Operation in der `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet. Dies ermöglicht das Einfügen von Datensätzen, die aus der Verknüpfung mehrerer Datenbanktabellen resultieren. Es ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Datenintegration direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen erheblich verbessert.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, JOIN, Open SQL, Data Integration

Instructions: Implementiere eine abstrakte Klasse, die eine Vorlagenmethode (Template Method Pattern) für die Flugdatenverarbeitung bereitstellt, wobei bestimmte Schritte abstrakt sind und von Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen.
hint: Nutze das Template Method Pattern mit einer konkreten Methode, die abstrakte Methoden aufruft.
solution:
ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_flight_template_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_lifecycle
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA ms_current_flight TYPE sflights.

    ABSTRACT METHODS prepare_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_preparation_log) TYPE string.

    ABSTRACT METHODS execute_processing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_execution_log) TYPE string.

    ABSTRACT METHODS finalize_processing
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_finalization_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_template_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_lifecycle.
    ms_current_flight = is_flight.
    rv_log = |Starting processing for flight { ms_current_flight-carrid } { ms_current_flight-connid } { ms_current_flight-fldate }\n|.
    rv_log = rv_log && prepare_data( ) && |\n|.
    rv_log = rv_log && execute_processing( ) && |\n|.
    rv_log = rv_log && finalize_processing( ) && |\n|.
    rv_log = rv_log && 'Processing finished.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_template_concrete_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_flight_template_processor CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS execute_processing REDEFINITION.
    METHODS finalize_processing REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_template_concrete_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_data.
    rv_preparation_log = |Data prepared for flight { ms_current_flight-carrid }.|
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_processing.
    rv_execution_log = |Processing flight { ms_current_flight-connid } now.|
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD finalize_processing.
    rv_finalization_log = |Finalizing processing for flight { ms_current_flight-fldate }.|
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_template_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_template_method.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_template_concrete_impl( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_processor->process_flight_lifecycle( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Starting processing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Data prepared' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Processing flight' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Finalizing processing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_log exp = 'Processing finished' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Template Method Pattern. Die abstrakte Klasse `zcl_flight_template_processor` definiert eine Skelettmethode (`process_flight_lifecycle`), die den Algorithmus festlegt. Bestimmte Schritte dieses Algorithmus sind jedoch `ABSTRACT METHODS` (`prepare_data`, `execute_processing`, `finalize_processing`), die von den konkreten Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen. Dies ermöglicht es, den Gesamtalgorithmus beizubehalten, während einzelne Schritte angepasst werden können.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Template Method Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Inheritance

Instructions: Füge Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die durch eine `FOR`-Iteration über eine andere Tabelle generiert werden, wobei nur bestimmte Elemente berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Nutze `INSERT` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid
                             total_price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_for.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_for( ).
    DATA(lt_source_flights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251207' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251207' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' fldate = '20251208' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights( it_flights = lt_source_flights iv_min_price = '90.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'DL' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Iteration in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes ABAP-Feature. Es ermöglicht die deklarative Erzeugung und Befüllung interner Tabellen, indem es über eine Quelltabelle iteriert, optional filtert und die Ergebnisse in eine neue Struktur transformiert. Dies ersetzt oft komplexe Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen und macht den Code wesentlich lesbarer und wartbarer.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Table Comprehension, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definiere eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer abstrakten Methode, die einen Parameter vom Typ einer internen Tabelle akzeptiert, und implementiere eine konkrete Klasse, die diese Methode nutzt, um Daten in eine andere interne Tabelle einzufügen.
hint: Kombiniere abstrakte Methoden mit Tabellenparametern und `INSERT LINES OF`.
solution:
ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_abstract_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_line.
    TYPES tt_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    ABSTRACT METHODS process_data_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data_table
      CHANGING
        ct_target_data TYPE tt_data_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_table_inserter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_table_processor CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_table REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_table_inserter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_table.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_data INTO TABLE ct_target_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_abstract_table_insert FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_abstract_table_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_concrete_table_inserter( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_abstract_table_processor=>tt_data_table(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Alpha' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Beta' ) ).
    DATA(lt_target) = zcl_abstract_table_processor=>tt_data_table(
      ( id = 0 value = 'Initial' ) ).

    lo_cut->process_data_table(
      it_source_data = lt_source
      CHANGING
        ct_target_data = lt_target ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 3 ]-value exp = 'Beta' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `ABSTRACT METHODS` mit Tabellenparametern. Die abstrakte Methode `process_data_table` definiert eine generische Schnittstelle für die Verarbeitung von internen Tabellen. Die konkrete Implementierung `zcl_concrete_table_inserter` nutzt `INSERT LINES OF`, um die Daten aus der Quelltabelle in die Zieltabelle einzufügen. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen verschiedene Verarbeitungslogiken auf denselben Datentyp angewendet werden müssen, aber die genaue Implementierung variiert.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Method, Internal Table, INSERT, LINES OF, Polymorphism, Object Orientation

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für HTTP-Statuscodes (z.B. OK, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR) mit expliziten numerischen Werten.
hint: Verwende `VALUE` in der Enumerationsdefinition, um explizite Werte zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_http_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM http_status_code,
             ok                  VALUE 200,
             not_found           VALUE 404,
             internal_server_error VALUE 500,
           END OF ENUM http_status_code.

    METHODS get_status_description IMPORTING iv_code TYPE http_status_code RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_http_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_code.
      WHEN http_status_code=>ok.
        rv_description = 'OK'.
      WHEN http_status_code=>not_found.
        rv_description = 'Not Found'.
      WHEN http_status_code=>internal_server_error.
        rv_description = 'Internal Server Error'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unknown Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_description.
    DATA(lo_http_status) = NEW zcl_enum_http_status( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_http_status->get_status_description( zcl_enum_http_status=>http_status_code=>ok ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'OK' ).

    lv_description = lo_http_status->get_status_description( zcl_enum_http_status=>http_status_code=>not_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'Not Found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Explizite Werte in Enumerationen ermöglichen die direkte Zuordnung zu externen Standards (wie HTTP-Codes) und verbessern die Lesbarkeit, da der Wert direkt ersichtlich ist, ohne dass eine separate Mapping-Logik erforderlich ist.
keywords: ENUMERATION, VALUE, HTTP Status

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Enumerationswert eine Beschreibung zurückgibt, unter Verwendung des modernen `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck kann direkt mit Enumerationswerten verwendet werden, um kompakten Code zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_switch_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM color_code,
             red,
             blue,
             green,
           END OF ENUM color_code.

    METHODS get_color_name IMPORTING iv_color TYPE color_code RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_switch_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_color_name.
    rv_name = SWITCH #( iv_color
                        WHEN color_code=>red   THEN 'Rot'
                        WHEN color_code=>blue  THEN 'Blau'
                        WHEN color_code=>green THEN 'Grün'
                        ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_color_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_color_name.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_enum_switch_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_demo->get_color_name( zcl_enum_switch_demo=>color_code=>red ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Rot' ).

    lv_name = lo_demo->get_color_name( zcl_enum_switch_demo=>color_code=>green ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Grün' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu `CASE`-Anweisungen. In Kombination mit Enumerationen ermöglicht er eine sehr elegante und typsichere Abbildung von Werten auf Ergebnisse.
keywords: ENUMERATION, SWITCH, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die alle Werte einer Enumeration als interne Tabelle von Strings zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `CL_ABAP_ENUMDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM month_name,
             jan, feb, mar, apr, may, jun,
             jul, aug, sep, oct, nov, dec,
           END OF ENUM month_name.

    METHODS get_all_month_names RETURNING VALUE(rt_month_names) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_month_names.
    DATA(lo_enum_descr) = CAST cl_abap_enumdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_ENUM_ITERATOR=>MONTH_NAME' ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_enum_descr->get_values( ) INTO DATA(ls_enum_value).
      APPEND ls_enum_value-name TO rt_month_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_all_month_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_all_month_names.
    DATA(lo_iterator) = NEW zcl_enum_iterator( ).
    DATA(lt_months) = lo_iterator->get_all_month_names( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_months ) exp = 12 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_months[ 1 ] exp = 'JAN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_months[ 12 ] exp = 'DEC' ).

explanation: Durch die Verwendung von RTTI kann man dynamisch Informationen über Typen, einschließlich Enumerationen, zur Laufzeit abrufen. Dies ermöglicht flexible Implementierungen, wie das Iterieren über alle definierten Enumerationswerte, ohne diese manuell auflisten zu müssen.

Instructions: Definiere eine Enumeration für verschiedene Arten von Log-Nachrichten (Info, Warning, Error) und verwende diese in einer Methode, die eine Nachricht basierend auf dem Typ formatiert.
hint: Kombiniere Enumerationen mit String-Templates für formatierte Ausgaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_enum_log_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM log_type,
             info,
             warning,
             error,
           END OF ENUM log_type.

    METHODS format_log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_type    TYPE log_type
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_enum_log_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_log_message.
    DATA(lv_prefix) = SWITCH #( iv_type
                                WHEN log_type=>info    THEN 'INFO: '
                                WHEN log_type=>warning THEN 'WARNING: '
                                WHEN log_type=>error   THEN 'ERROR: '
                                ELSE '' ).
    rv_formatted_message = |{ lv_prefix }{ iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lv_message = lo_log->format_log_message( iv_type = zcl_enum_log_message=>log_type=>error iv_message = 'Critical error occurred.' ).

CLASS zcl_int4_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen `int8`-Wert in einen `int4`-Wert und prüfen Sie dabei auf einen möglichen Überlauf.
hint: Vergleichen Sie den `int8`-Wert mit den Max/Min-Werten von `int4` vor der Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_int8_to_int4
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE int8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_int8_to_int4.
    DATA(lv_min_int4) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_min_value( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int4 ).
    DATA(lv_max_int4) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int4 ).

    IF iv_value < lv_min_int4 OR iv_value > lv_max_int4.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow
        EXPORTING
          text = |Value { iv_value } is outside the valid range for INT4 ({ lv_min_int4 } to { lv_max_int4 })|.
    ENDIF.

    rv_converted_value = iv_value. " Implicit conversion after check
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Maximalwert eines beliebigen numerischen ABAP-Typs zur Laufzeit, der als `cl_abap_typedescr` Objekt übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_EXCEPTIONAL_VALUES=>GET_MAX_VALUE` in Kombination mit RTTI, um den Typ-Code dynamisch zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_max_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        io_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE string " Return as string for generic display
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_type_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_max_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_type_kind) = io_type_descr->type_kind.
    DATA(lv_type_length) = io_type_descr->length.

    DATA(lv_type_code) = SWITCH string( lv_type_kind
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int1
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int2
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int4 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int4
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_int8
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_p THEN
        CASE lv_type_length.
          WHEN 1 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed1
          WHEN 2 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed2
          WHEN 3 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed3
          WHEN 4 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed4
          WHEN 5 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed5
          WHEN 6 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed6
          WHEN 7 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed7
          WHEN 8 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed8
          WHEN 9 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed9
          WHEN 10 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed10
          WHEN 11 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed11
          WHEN 12 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed12
          WHEN 13 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed13
          WHEN 14 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed14
          WHEN 15 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed15
          WHEN 16 THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>c_type_packed16
          ELSE THROW cx_sy_dyn_type_error( text = |Unsupported packed length { lv_type_length }| )
        ENDCASE.
      ELSE THROW cx_sy_dyn_type_error( text = |Unsupported type kind { lv_type_kind }| )
    ).

    rv_max_value = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_max_value( lv_type_code ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Excel-Datei (XLSX) mit zwei Spalten ('Produkt', 'Menge') und einigen Zeilen Daten. Die resultierende Datei soll als XSTRING zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_openxml_helper` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und `cl_openxml_helper_worksheet` für das Tabellenblatt und die Zellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_xlsx DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             product TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_simple_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xlsx_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_xlsx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_excel.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_document->create_worksheet( 'Produkte' ).

    " Header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'A' ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Produkt' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'B' ip_row = 1 ip_value = 'Menge' ).

    " Data rows
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_products INTO DATA(ls_product).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'A' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_product-product ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_column = 'B' ip_row = lv_row ip_value = ls_product-quantity ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xlsx_xstring = lo_document->get_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_create_xlsx=>tt_products(
      ( product = 'Apfel' quantity = 10 )
      ( product = 'Birne' quantity = 5 )
    ).

    DATA(lx_xlsx_content) = lo_creator->create_simple_excel( lt_products ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lx_xlsx_content
      msg = 'XLSX content should not be initial'
    ).
    " Further assertions would require parsing the XLSX, which is complex for a unit test.
    " We assume if it's not initial, the creation process was successful.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_openxml_helper` zum Laden der Datei und dann die Methoden zum Zugriff auf das Tabellenblatt und die Zelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_cell DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_cell_value
      IMPORTING
        ix_xlsx_content TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name   TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_column       TYPE string
        iv_row          TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cell_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_xlsx_cell IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_cell_value.
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_openxml_helper=>load_document( ix_xlsx_content ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_document->get_worksheet(
      ip_sheet_name = COND #( WHEN iv_sheet_name IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_sheet_name ELSE 'Sheet1' ) " Default sheet name
    ).

    IF lo_worksheet IS BOUND.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` filtern (z.B. nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft) und die verbleibenden Zeilen in ein neues Format transformieren (z.B. nur Flugnummer und Abflugort).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                     cityfrom = ls_flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_itab_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'. " Example carrier

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty for carrier LH'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_info-carrid
        exp = lv_carrier
        msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch after filtering'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks filtert die Quelltabelle, und die nachfolgende Klammerdefinition `( ... )` definiert die Struktur und die Werte der neuen Zeilen in der Zieltabelle. Dies führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code im Vergleich zu klassischen `LOOP` und `APPEND` Konstrukten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Functional Programming, Transformation, sflights
