Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Dateisystemstruktur (Verzeichnisse und Dateien) und bereiten Sie die Daten für eine Baumdarstellung vor. Die Struktur soll rekursiv aufgebaut werden. Demonstrieren Sie dabei die Verwendung des `NEW` Operators für die Instanziierung von Objekten und `OPTIONAL` für optionale Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine rekursive Methode, um die Hierarchie zu durchlaufen. Der `NEW` Operator ist für die Objekterzeugung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_system_entry,
             name       TYPE string,
             path       TYPE string,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
             sub_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_system_entry WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_file_system_entry,
           tt_file_system_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_system_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
             expanded   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node,
           tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_simulated_file_system
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fs_root) TYPE ty_file_system_entry.

    METHODS convert_fs_to_tree_nodes
      IMPORTING
        is_fs_entry TYPE ty_file_system_entry
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey OPTIONAL " Modern ABAP: OPTIONAL Parameter
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS add_entry_to_tree
      IMPORTING
        is_fs_entry TYPE ty_file_system_entry
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      CHANGING
        ct_tree_nodes TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_simulated_file_system.
    rt_fs_root = VALUE #( name = 'Root' path = '/' is_folder = abap_true
      sub_entries = VALUE #( 
        ( name = 'Folder1' path = '/Folder1' is_folder = abap_true
          sub_entries = VALUE #( 
            ( name = 'FileA.txt' path = '/Folder1/FileA.txt' is_folder = abap_false )
            ( name = 'FileB.log' path = '/Folder1/FileB.log' is_folder = abap_false )
          ) )
        ( name = 'Folder2' path = '/Folder2' is_folder = abap_true
          sub_entries = VALUE #( 
            ( name = 'SubFolder' path = '/Folder2/SubFolder' is_folder = abap_true )
          ) )
        ( name = 'FileC.doc' path = '/FileC.doc' is_folder = abap_false )
      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_fs_to_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = is_fs_entry-path.
    DATA(lv_parent_key) = iv_parent_key.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( ( node_key = lv_node_key
                                parent_key = lv_parent_key
                                text = is_fs_entry-name
                                is_folder = is_fs_entry-is_folder
                                expanded = is_fs_entry-is_folder ) ).

    LOOP AT is_fs_entry-sub_entries INTO DATA(ls_sub_entry).
      " Rekursiver Aufruf mit NEW für die Objekterzeugung
      DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_tree_dynamic_builder( ).
      APPEND LINES OF lo_builder->convert_fs_to_tree_nodes( is_fs_entry = ls_sub_entry iv_parent_key = lv_node_key ) TO rt_tree_nodes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_entry_to_tree.
    " Diese Methode wäre Teil einer rekursiven Logik, die die Knoten zu einem echten Baum hinzufügt.
    " Hier nur als Platzhalter für die Demonstration der Datenkonvertierung.
    DATA(lv_node_key) = is_fs_entry-path.
    APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_node_key
                    parent_key = iv_parent_key
                    text = is_fs_entry-name
                    is_folder = is_fs_entry-is_folder
                    expanded = is_fs_entry-is_folder ) TO ct_tree_nodes.

    LOOP AT is_fs_entry-sub_entries INTO DATA(ls_sub_entry).
      add_entry_to_tree( is_fs_entry = ls_sub_entry iv_parent_key = lv_node_key CHANGING ct_tree_nodes = ct_tree_nodes ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,

CLASS zcl_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_tree_nodes.
    DATA(lv_search_pattern) = '*' && iv_search_term && '*'.

    rt_filtered_nodes = FILTER #( it_all_nodes USING KEY primary_key WHERE text CP lv_search_pattern ). " Modern ABAP: FILTER Operator

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_menu_item,
             function TYPE string,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_menu_item,
           tt_menu_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_menu_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_menu_assignment,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             menu_items TYPE tt_menu_items,
           END OF ty_node_menu_assignment,
           tt_node_menu_assignments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_menu_assignment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: tt_node_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF lvc_nkey WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_context_menu_data
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes_with_menu TYPE tt_node_keys
        it_available_menus TYPE tt_menu_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_assignments) TYPE tt_node_menu_assignments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_context_menu_data.
    rt_assignments = REDUCE tt_node_menu_assignments(
      INIT assignments = VALUE tt_node_menu_assignments( )
      FOR  node_key IN it_nodes_with_menu
      NEXT assignments = VALUE #( BASE assignments
        ( node_key = node_key
          menu_items = it_available_menus ) ) " Fügt alle verfügbaren Menüs zu jedem Knoten hinzu
    ).

Obwohl `cl_gui_simple_tree` selbst keine direkten Interface-Konstanten für D&D-Modi bereitstellt, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man solche Konstanten in einer modernen ABAP-Klasse kapseln und für die Konfiguration verwenden würde, um die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit zu verbessern.
keywords: cl_gui_simple_tree, Drag & Drop, CONSTANTS, GUI, Configuration

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine einzelne Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle 'sflights_tab' basierend auf 'carrid' und 'connid' mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck 'itab[ key = value ]'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_read_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_read_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    rs_flight = it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_read_single( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-connid exp = '0017' ).

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_read_single=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_read_single( ).

explanation: Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen mit einer kompakten und lesbaren Syntax, die die Notwendigkeit expliziter READ TABLE-Anweisungen reduziert. Bei Nicht-Finden wird eine Ausnahme ausgelöst.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'AA' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_not_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'UA' it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: TABLES, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Selection

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur 'carrid' und 'connid' aus einer bestehenden 'sflights'-Tabelle enthält und dabei 'connid' als String formatiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator in Verbindung mit VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_map_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_map_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                             ( carrier = ls_flight-carrid
                               connection = |{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_map_transform=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_map_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrier exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connection exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connection exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Verbindung mit VALUE ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation von Tabellen, indem er eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erstellt. String-Templates (|...|) werden für die einfache Formatierung verwendet.
keywords: TABLES, FOR, VALUE, Table Comprehension, String Templates, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer 'sflights'-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                               NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 200.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 350 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen.
keywords: TABLES, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp ('planetype') für einen spezifischen Flug in einer internen Tabelle 'sflights_tab' mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck auf der linken Seite einer Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_modify_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_modify_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype.
    ct_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-planetype = iv_new_planetype.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_modify_single=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'BOEING' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_modify_single( ).
    lo_cut->update_planetype( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_new_planetype = 'CONCORDE' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ]-planetype exp = 'CONCORDE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ]-planetype exp = 'AIRBUS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_not_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_modify_single=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_modify_single( ).
    lo_cut->update_planetype( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_planetype = 'JET' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die direkte Zuweisung zu einem Feld einer Zeile, die über einen Tabellenausdruck identifiziert wird, ist die modernste und effizienteste Methode, um einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu ändern. Dies erfordert eine Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel.
keywords: TABLES, MODIFY, Table Expression, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze ('seatsocc') für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle um einen gegebenen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und eine WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_modify_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase_by TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_modify_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_occupied_seats.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-seatsocc = <fs_flight>-seatsocc + iv_increase_by.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_increase_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_modify_multi=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 100 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' seatsocc = 150 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_modify_multi( ).
    lo_cut->increase_occupied_seats( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_increase_by = 10 CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 2 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 ). "LH should be unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 3 ]-seatsocc exp = 160 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_increase_none.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_modify_multi=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 50 ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_modify_multi( ).
    lo_cut->increase_occupied_seats( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_increase_by = 10 CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-seatsocc exp = 50 ). "Should be unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von FIELD-SYMBOLS in LOOP AT-Schleifen ist die effizienteste Methode, um Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu modifizieren, da sie eine direkte Bearbeitung der Tabellenzeile ohne implizites MODIFY ermöglicht.
keywords: TABLES, MODIFY, LOOP AT, Field Symbols, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die eine Teilmenge von Flügen aus 'sflights' enthält, aber mit einem zusätzlichen Feld 'is_long_haul' basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit FOR und einer bedingten Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_extended,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             is_long_haul TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_extended.
    TYPES tt_flight_extended TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_extended_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extended_flights) TYPE tt_flight_extended.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_extended_flights.
    rt_extended_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' OR carrid = 'LH' ) " Example filter
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight )
                                     is_long_haul = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_extended FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_extended.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_insert_value=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'BOEING' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'AIRBUS' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'JET' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_extended_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_long_haul exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_long_haul exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_insert_value=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_extended_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator mit FOR ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit CORRESPONDING und COND können komplexe Transformationen und bedingte Zuweisungen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung durchgeführt werden.
keywords: TABLES, INSERT, VALUE, FOR, CORRESPONDING, COND, Internal Tables

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle 'sflights_tab'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die DELETE-Anweisung mit einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrier.
    DELETE ct_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_none FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_found.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_delete=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete( ).
    lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrier( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_none.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_tab_delete=>tt_sflight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete( ).
    lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrier( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die DELETE-Anweisung mit WHERE-Klausel ist die standardmäßige und effiziente Methode, um mehrere Zeilen aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen, die bestimmten Kriterien entsprechen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der 'sflights'-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft ('carrid') und ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator mit GROUPS OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                             ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                               flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie nur den Flugzeugtyp ('planetype') für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die MODIFY-Anweisung mit TRANSPORTING und einer WHERE-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_tab_modify_trans DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_tab_modify_trans IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_for_carrier.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp für einen bestehenden Flug in der Datenbanktabelle 'sflights'. Wenn der Flug nicht existiert, soll er eingefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die MODIFY-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen mit einer Workarea.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_or_insert_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_or_insert_flight.
    DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid    = iv_carrid
      connid    = iv_connid
      fldate    = iv_fldate
      planetype = iv_planetype
    ).

    MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_insert FOR TESTING.
    METHODS cleanup_sflight FOR GLOBAL CLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_update.
    " Setup: Insert a flight first
    DATA(ls_initial_flight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid    = 'XX'
      connid    = '1234'
      fldate    = '20250101'
      planetype = 'OLDPLANE'
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_initial_flight.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_or_insert_flight(
      iv_carrid    = 'XX'
      iv_connid    = '1234'
      iv_fldate    = '20250101'
      iv_planetype = 'NEWPLANE'
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify update
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_planetype)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '1234' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype exp = 'NEWPLANE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_modify( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_or_insert_flight(
      iv_carrid    = 'YY'
      iv_connid    = '5678'
      iv_fldate    = '20250102'
      iv_planetype = 'INSERTED'
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify insert
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_planetype)
      WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '5678' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype exp = 'INSERTED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_sflight.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' OR carrid = 'YY'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die MODIFY-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen versucht, eine Zeile zu aktualisieren, wenn sie existiert, oder einzufügen, wenn sie nicht existiert. Die Verwendung von VALUE-Operatoren für die Workarea-Initialisierung und Inline-Deklarationen macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer.
keywords: MODIFY, Database, sflights, Open SQL

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch alle öffentlichen Instanzattribute einer gegebenen Klasse aus und geben Sie deren Namen zurück. Verwenden Sie hierfür RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und die Methode `get_attributes` des zurückgegebenen Deskriptors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_instance_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attribute_names) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_instance_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).

    rt_attribute_names = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <attribute> IN lo_class_descr->get_attributes(
        p_visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public
        p_is_static  = abap_false
      )
      ( <attribute>-name )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr` und die Methode `get_interfaces` des zurückgegebenen Deskriptors. Filtern Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name     TYPE clike
        iv_interface_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).

    DATA(lt_interfaces) = lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ).

    IF line_exists( lt_interfaces[ name = iv_interface_name ] ).
      rv_implements = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_implements = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Strukturdefinition (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_descr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` gefolgt von `create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_descr( iv_struct_name ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Dynamisches Füllen eines Feldes (Beispiel für SFLIGHT)
        TRY.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
            IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AA'. ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
            IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0017'. ENDIF.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
            IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
            " Component not found, ignore for this example
        ENDTRY.

        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_sflight> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 1 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN <lt_sflight>[ 1 ] TO <ls_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_sflight> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ls_sflight>-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse anhand ihres Namens und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf. Dies erfordert fortgeschrittene RTTI-Kenntnisse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr`, `create_object` und dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE clike
        iv_method_name TYPE clike
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
    DATA lo_instance     TYPE REF TO object.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_instance TYPE (iv_class_name).

    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      INSERT VALUE abap_parmbind(
        name  = 'IV_INPUT'
        kind  = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input
        value = NEW cl_abap_datadescr=>('STRING')
      ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
      ASSIGN iv_param_value TO lt_parameters[ name = 'IV_INPUT' ]-value->*.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_result TYPE string.
    DATA lr_result TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_result TYPE string.
    ASSIGN lr_result->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).

    CALL METHOD lo_instance->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING RESULTS
        <fs_result>.

    rv_result = <fs_result>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING

    TRY.

Es zeigt, wie man eine Klasse zur Laufzeit instanziiert (`CREATE OBJECT TYPE (iv_class_name)`) und eine Methode dynamisch aufruft (`CALL METHOD lo_instance->(iv_method_name)`). Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Anzahl von Spalten vom Typ STRING und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create_empty_struct`, `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_string_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_string_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_columns TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_rtti_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_string_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_string_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    DO iv_num_columns TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = |COLUMN_{ sy-index }|
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      p_components = lt_components
    ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      IF <ls_dynamic_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        DO iv_num_columns TIMES.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT |COLUMN_{ sy-index }| OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
          IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_component> = |Value { sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.
        INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_string_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_string_table( 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_table> ).

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_product_names.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lv_array_size) = lo_json_parser->get_array_size( ).

    LOOP AT sy-tab_lines INTO DATA(lv_index) FROM 1 TO lv_array_size.
      DATA(lo_product_obj) = lo_json_parser->get_array_element_as_object( lv_index - 1 ). "0-based index

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe funktional zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' ) " Beispiel: Nur EUR-Flüge addieren
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_reduce( ).
    " Annahme: Fluggesellschaft 'LH' hat Flüge in SFLIGHTS mit Preisen
    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.00.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND currency = 'EUR'.
    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price ).

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis jedes Fluges in einer internen Tabelle um einen bestimmten Prozentsatz und sammeln Sie die neuen Preise in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer Inline-Berechnung, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_prices
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_updated_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   connid = flight-connid
                                   price  = flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_increase_prices_zero_percent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_for( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_compute_for=>tt_flight_prices.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100.00 ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 200.00 ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_updated_prices) = lo_cut->increase_prices( it_flights = lt_flights iv_percentage = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated_prices ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated_prices[ 1 ]-price exp = 110.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_updated_prices[ 2 ]-price exp = 220.00 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur, die den Gesamtpreis und den durchschnittlichen Preis einer Liste von Flugsegmenten enthält. Nutzen Sie die `sflights` Tabelle als Datenquelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator zur Initialisierung der Struktur mit berechneten Werten, die aus einer `REDUCE`-Operation stammen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_compute_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             total_price   TYPE s_price,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
             number_of_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_compute_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0.00
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_number_of_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    rs_summary = VALUE #( total_price = lv_total_price
                          average_price = COND s_price( WHEN lv_number_of_flights > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_number_of_flights ELSE 0 )
                          number_of_flights = lv_number_of_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summary_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_summary_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_value( ).
    " Annahme: 'LH' hat Flüge mit Preisen in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(ls_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( 'LH' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_total) = 0.00.
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_total WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND currency = 'EUR'.
    SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sflights INTO lv_expected_count WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND currency = 'EUR'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_price exp = lv_expected_total ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-number_of_flights exp = lv_expected_count ).
    IF lv_expected_count > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-average_price exp = lv_expected_total / lv_expected_count ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-average_price exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_summary_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_compute_value( ).
    DATA(ls_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( 'ZZ' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-total_price exp = 0.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-average_price exp = 0.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-number_of_flights exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die direkte Initialisierung von Strukturen mit Werten, die aus komplexeren Ausdrücken oder anderen Operatoren wie `REDUCE` stammen können. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von numerischen Werten in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Zähler und einer Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE i
                                      count = 0 TYPE i
                                FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
                                NEXT sum = sum + lv_number,
                                     count = count + 1 ).

    rv_average = CONV decfloat34( ls_result-sum ) / ls_result-count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_average( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE zcl_reduce_average=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '20.0' ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE zcl_reduce_average=>tt_numbers( ( 5 ) ( 10 ) ( 15 ) ( 20 ) ).
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_average( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '12.5' ).

    lt_numbers = VALUE zcl_reduce_average=>tt_numbers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression kann nicht nur zur Summation, sondern auch zur Berechnung komplexerer Aggregationen wie dem Durchschnitt verwendet werden, indem mehrere Initialwerte (Summe und Zähler) verwaltet werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, Durchschnitt, Zahlen, Aggregation, Interne Tabelle

CLASS zcl_loop_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Anzahl zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_components
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type->get_name() ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur auf einen neuen Wert setzt, wobei sowohl der Feldname als auch der neue Wert dynamisch übergeben werden. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Typ des neuen Wertes mit dem Feldtyp kompatibel ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder direkte Zuweisung mit Typprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_structure  TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_set_field_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lo_field_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_string_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_structure TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_field_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_field> ).
    lo_string_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_new_value ).

    IF lo_field_descr->type_kind = lo_string_descr->type_kind OR
       lo_field_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
       lo_field_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_numc OR
       lo_field_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date OR
       lo_field_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_conv_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " More sophisticated type conversion logic would be needed here
      " For simplicity, we'll allow direct assignment for basic types
      " and raise error for complex mismatches.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` heraus, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und geben Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit diesen Flügen zurück. Verwenden Sie hierfür die `FILTER`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Beschreiben Sie, wie man die Laufzeit-Typinformationen (RTTI) einer internen Tabelle abruft, insbesondere den Tabellentyp und den Zeilentyp. Ermitteln Sie auch die Anzahl der Komponenten, falls der Zeilentyp eine Struktur ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data()` und `get_table_line_type()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_info
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      EXPORTING
        ev_table_kind TYPE string
        ev_line_kind  TYPE string
        ev_num_components TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_info.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
    ev_table_kind = lo_table_descr->table_kind.

    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    ev_line_kind = lo_line_descr->type_kind.

    IF lo_line_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_descr ).
      ev_num_components = lines( lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ).
    ELSE.
      ev_num_components = 1. "For elementary types, it's just one component
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_sflight_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                              p_line_type = lo_sflight_descr
                              p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                              p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_sflight_descr.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Fill some data dynamically
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_carrid> = 'LH'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_connid> = '0400'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_fldate> = sy-datum.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_carrid> = 'AA'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_connid>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_connid> = '0017'.
    ENDIF.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_fldate>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_fldate> = sy-datum.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Komponenten einer Struktur zur Laufzeit, einschließlich deren Namen, Typen und Längen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data()` und die Methode `get_components()`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type_kind TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: ty_component_info_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_any_struct TYPE ANY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_component_info_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_descr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_any_struct ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component-type ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name      = ls_component-name
        type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
        length    = lo_elem_descr->length
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen Methodenaufruf durch, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string,
      get_farewell RETURNING VALUE(rv_farewell) TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_farewell = 'Goodbye from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_me) = me. " Reference to self for dynamic call

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_me->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_greeting exp = 'Hello from dynamic method!' ).

    DATA(lv_result_farewell) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'GET_FAREWELL' ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Funktion, die eine Spalte einer beliebigen internen Tabelle summiert, deren Name dynamisch übergeben wird. Die Spalte muss numerisch sein.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr`, Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sum_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_numeric_column
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sum_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numeric_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_value> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid table reference'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF lo_line_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Table line type is not a structure'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_descr ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_column_name INTO DATA(ls_component_info).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' not found|. 
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( ls_component_info-type ).
    IF lo_elem_descr->is_numeric( ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Column '{ iv_column_name }' is not numeric|. 
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_sum = rv_sum + <fs_value>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_numeric_column FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_numeric_column_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_numeric_column.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_sum_column( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_numeric_column( it_any_table = lt_sflight iv_column_name = 'SEATSMAX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 800 ). " Assuming SFLIGHT has 2 rows with SEATSMAX 400
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_numeric_column_error.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_sum_column( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->sum_numeric_column( it_any_table = lt_sflight iv_column_name = 'CARRID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-numeric column' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for non-numeric column' ).
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->sum_numeric_column( it_any_table = lt_sflight iv_column_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-existent column' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for non-existent column' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine leistungsstarke generische Funktion, die eine Spalte einer beliebigen internen Tabelle dynamisch summiert. Es nutzt RTTI (`cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_elemdescr`) zur Überprüfung des Tabellen- und Spaltentyps und Feld-Symbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT`) für den dynamischen Zugriff auf den Spaltenwert. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` stellt sicher, dass nur numerische Spalten summiert werden und existierende Spaltennamen verwendet werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, generic, internal table, sum, ASSIGN COMPONENT, cx_sy_dyn_call_error

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine gegebene Struktur alle erwarteten Felder (Komponenten) enthält.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Komponentenlisten von `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_validate_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_any_struct TYPE ANY
        it_expected_components TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_validate_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_any_struct ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
    DATA(lt_actual_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    LOOP AT it_expected_components INTO DATA(lv_expected_component).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_components WITH KEY name = lv_expected_component TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validate_structure_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_validate_structure_invalid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_validate_structure_not_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_structure_valid.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lt_expected_components TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_expected_components.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_expected_components.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_expected_components.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_validate_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->validate_structure_components(
      is_any_struct        = ls_sflight
      it_expected_components = lt_expected_components
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validate_structure_invalid.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lt_expected_components TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_expected_components.
    APPEND 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' TO lt_expected_components.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_validate_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->validate_structure_components(
      is_any_struct        = ls_sflight
      it_expected_components = lt_expected_components
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_validate_structure_not_struct.
    DATA: lv_char TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    DATA: lt_expected_components TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_expected_components.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_validate_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->validate_structure_components(
      is_any_struct        = lv_char
      it_expected_components = lt_expected_components
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie RTTI zur Validierung von Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit verwendet werden kann. Die Methode `validate_structure_components` prüft, ob eine übergebene Struktur alle in einer Liste definierten Komponenten enthält. Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Wert aus einer dynamisch übergebenen Strukturkomponente und konvertieren Sie ihn in einen String. Die Komponente kann beliebigen elementaren Typ haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole und String-Templates für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_read_and_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_as_string
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ANY
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_and_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Component '{ iv_component }' not found in structure|. 
    ENDIF.

    " Modern ABAP: Use string templates for flexible type conversion to string
    rv_string_value = |{ <fs_component> }|.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur eine Untermenge der Spalten einer Quelltabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) enthält, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` für den Zeilentyp und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` für den Tabellentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_projected_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE ANY TABLE
        it_columns_to_keep TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_projected_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_projected_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_source_line> TYPE ANY,
                   <lt_target> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_target_line> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_source_comp> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_target_comp> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <lt_source>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid source table reference'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_source_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source> ).
    DATA(lo_source_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_source_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_source_components) = lo_source_line_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA: lt_target_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT it_columns_to_keep INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      READ TABLE lt_source_components WITH KEY name = lv_column_name INTO DATA(ls_source_comp_info).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Column '{ lv_column_name }' not found in source table|. 
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_source_comp_info TO lt_target_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_target_line_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    DATA(lo_target_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                      p_line_type = lo_target_line_descr
                                      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                      p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rt_projected_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_projected_table->* TO <lt_target>.
    CREATE DATA <ls_target_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_target_line_descr.
    ASSIGN <ls_target_line>->* TO <ls_target_line>.

    LOOP AT <lt_source> ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
      LOOP AT it_columns_to_keep INTO lv_column_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO <fs_source_comp>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_target_line> TO <fs_target_comp>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_source_comp> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_comp> = <fs_source_comp>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <ls_target_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target>.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_projected_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_projected_table_error FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_projected_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA: lt_columns_to_keep TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_columns_to_keep.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_columns_to_keep.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_projection( ).
    DATA(lo_projected_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_projected_table(
      it_source_table      = lt_sflight
      it_columns_to_keep = lt_columns_to_keep
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_projected> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_projected_line> TYPE ANY.
    ASSIGN lo_projected_table_ref->* TO <lt_projected>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_projected> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_projected> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_projected_line>.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_carrid> TYPE any, <fs_connid> TYPE any, <fs_fldate> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_projected_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_projected_line> TO <fs_connid>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <ls_projected_line> TO <fs_fldate>. " Should not exist

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_carrid> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_connid> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_fldate> ). " FLDATE should not be in projected table
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_projected_table_error.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_columns_to_keep TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_columns_to_keep.
    APPEND 'NON_EXISTENT_COLUMN' TO lt_columns_to_keep.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_projection( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_projected_table(
          it_source_table      = lt_sflight
          it_columns_to_keep = lt_columns_to_keep
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-existent column' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle erstellt, die nur eine spezifische Untermenge von Spalten einer Quelltabelle enthält. Es verwendet `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` zur Definition des neuen Zeilen- und Tabellentyps basierend auf den ausgewählten Spalten. Anschließend werden Daten zeilenweise von der Quelltabelle in die neue, projizierte Tabelle kopiert, wobei Feld-Symbole für den dynamischen Zugriff auf die Komponenten verwendet werden. Dies ermöglicht flexible Datenprojektionen zur Laufzeit.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ einer beliebigen Datenreferenz zur Laufzeit und geben Sie den Typnamen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_data_ref_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_name_from_ref
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_data_ref_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_name_from_ref.
    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      rv_type_name = 'UNBOUND'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    rv_type_name = lo_typedescr->get_absolute_name( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einem elementaren Zeilentyp (z.B. `string`) und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name()` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_elem_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_elem_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_string_table.
    DATA(lo_string_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ).
    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                p_line_type = lo_string_descr
                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_string_descr.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      <ls_line> = lv_value.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_first_row>).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit einem elementaren Zeilentyp (hier `string`).
