Instructions: Ermitteln Sie, ob ein gegebener Typ ein Tabellentyp ist und, falls ja, ob es sich um eine Standardtabelle, sortierte Tabelle oder Hash-Tabelle handelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data()` und die Eigenschaft `table_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_kind_info
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE
      EXPORTING
        ev_is_table TYPE abap_bool
        ev_table_kind TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_kind_info.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).

    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
      ev_is_table = abap_true.
      DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
      ev_table_kind = lo_table_descr->table_kind.
    ELSE.
      ev_is_table = abap_false.
      ev_table_kind = 'NOT_A_TABLE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur mit einer Liste von Komponenten, die zur Laufzeit definiert werden, und füllen Sie diese mit Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create()` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type_name TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_def.
    TYPES: ty_component_def_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct
      IMPORTING
        it_component_defs TYPE ty_component_def_tt
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_struct) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO DATA(ls_comp_def).
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( ls_comp_def-type_name ).
      IF ls_comp_def-length > 0.
        lo_elem_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_kind(
                            p_type_kind = lo_elem_descr->type_kind
                            p_length = ls_comp_def-length ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr(
        name = ls_comp_def-name
        type = lo_elem_descr
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_struct TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_struct> TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_struct->* TO <ls_dynamic_struct>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Failed to assign dynamic structure'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_index = 0.
    LOOP AT it_component_defs INTO ls_comp_def.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      READ TABLE it_values INDEX lv_index INTO DATA(lv_value).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_comp_def-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_struct> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          TRY.
              <fs_component> = lv_value.
            CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = |Type conversion error for component '{ ls_comp_def-name }'|. 
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `STANDARD TABLE` mit einem generischen Zeilentyp `ANY` und füllen Sie diese mit elementaren Werten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p_any()` für den Zeilentyp und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_any_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_any_table
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_any_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_any_table.
    DATA(lo_any_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p_any( ). " Get descriptor for generic type ANY
    DATA(lo_table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                p_line_type = lo_any_descr
                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rt_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_type.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_any_descr.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      <ls_line> = lv_value.
      INSERT <ls_line> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should have 3 entries' act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_first_row>).

Anschließend wird `CREATE DATA` verwendet, um die Tabelle zu instanziieren und Feld-Symbole, um Werte in die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle einzufügen. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Ganzzahlen, um nur die geraden Zahlen zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer Modulo-Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_even_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_even_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_even_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE ( table_line MOD 2 ) = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_even_numbers FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_even_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_even_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 6 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_even_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ), msg = 'Anzahl der geraden Zahlen stimmt nicht überein.' ).

Die Bedingung `( table_line MOD 2 ) = 0` prüft direkt, ob die aktuelle Zeile (implizit `table_line` genannt) eine gerade Zahl ist. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Konstrukten.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_city IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_frankfurt.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " In einem realen Szenario würden Sie hier Daten aus der DB lesen.
    " Für das Beispiel füllen wir die Tabelle mit Testdaten.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Economy-Sitzplätze (`SEATSOCC`) für alle Flüge von 'TOKYO'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` in Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_economy_seats_tokyo
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_economy_seats_tokyo.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'JL' connid = '701' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'TOKYO' cityto = 'OSAKA' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'NH' connid = '802' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'TOKYO' cityto = 'SAPPORO' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'KE' connid = '903' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'SEOUL' cityto = 'TOKYO' seatsocc = 180 ) TO lt_sflight.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'TOKYO' )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle aller Flüge, die nicht von 'BERLIN' abfliegen.

solution:

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AF' connid = '0200' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'PARIS' cityto = 'ROME' ) TO lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight EXCEPT WHERE cityfrom = 'BERLIN' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flights_not_from_berlin FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_not_from_berlin.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_except( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_not_from_berlin( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Es sollten 3 Flüge gefunden werden, die nicht von BERLIN abfliegen.' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

explanation: Die `EXCEPT` Klausel im `FILTER` Operator ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, Zeilen auszuschließen, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist oft lesbarer und effizienter als die Negation der Bedingung im `WHERE`-Teil, insbesondere bei komplexeren Ausschlusskriterien.
keywords: FILTER, EXCEPT, SFLIGHT, Ausschluss, CITYFROM, VALUE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Dateiobjekten (mit Name und MIME-Typ), um nur solche zu erhalten, die dem MIME-Typ 'application/pdf' entsprechen. Verwenden Sie eine Konstante für den MIME-Typ.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem übergebenen Feldnamen und Wert filtert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck, z.B. `(field_name) = field_value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_field    TYPE fieldname
        iv_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    " Dynamischer WHERE-Ausdruck
    DATA(lv_dynamic_condition) = |{ iv_field } = '{ iv_value }'|.

    TRY.
        rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data WHERE (lv_dynamic_condition) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die dynamische Bedingung ungültig ist oder keine Daten gefunden wurden.
        " Für dieses Beispiel geben wir eine leere Tabelle zurück.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_dynamic FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_dynamic_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic( ).
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_data = lt_sflight iv_field = 'CITYFROM' iv_value = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2, msg = 'Anzahl der dynamisch gefilterten Flüge stimmt nicht überein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT', msg = 'Erster Abflugort stimmt nicht überein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT', msg = 'Zweiter Abflugort stimmt nicht überein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_dynamic_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic( ).
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) TO lt_sflight.

    " Ungültiger Feldname sollte zu leerer Tabelle führen
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic( it_data = lt_sflight iv_field = 'INVALID_FIELD' iv_value = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result, msg = 'Ergebnis sollte leer sein bei ungültigem Feldnamen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `FILTER` mit dynamischen `WHERE`-Bedingungen. Der Bedingungsausdruck wird zur Laufzeit als String konstruiert und dann in Klammern an die `WHERE`-Klausel übergeben. Dies ist nützlich für generische Filterfunktionen, bei denen die Filterkriterien erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die einfache Erstellung des dynamischen Strings verwendet.
keywords: FILTER, Dynamisch, WHERE, String-Templates, fieldname, SFLIGHT, VALUE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Objektreferenzen einer benutzerdefinierten Klasse, um nur Objekte zu erhalten, deren Attribut `status` den Wert 'ACTIVE' hat.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

Die `WHERE`-Klausel kann direkt auf öffentliche Attribute der referenzierten Objekte zugreifen, was eine sehr intuitive und objektorientierte Filterung ermöglicht. Die Inline-Instanziierung von Objekten (`NEW zcl_my_object(...)`) ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE string_table(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge eines bestimmten Flugdatums aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_flight_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE p(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE flDate = iv_flight_date
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    " Annahme: sflight enthält Daten. Für einen robusten Test müssten Daten gemockt werden.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Beispiel: Füge Testdaten ein (nicht Teil der Lösung, nur für den Test)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flDate = lv_test_date price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' flDate = lv_test_date price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' flDate = lv_test_date price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flDate = sy-datum price = '1000.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_date( lv_test_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '350.00' msg = 'Test 1: Summe der Flugpreise für ein Datum' ).

    " Aufräumen (nicht Teil der Lösung, nur für den Test)

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur. Der Feldname wird als String übergeben. Wenn das Feld nicht existiert, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `ELSE` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL ...` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flDate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'LH' msg = 'Test 1: Gültiges Feld' ).

explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und Feldsymbolen ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme. Die `IF sy-subrc = 0 ELSE` Struktur ist hier die moderne Art der Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, ELSE, sflight

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit einer Fluent Interface, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer Kette auszuführen. Die Methoden sollen `ME` zurückgeben.
hint: Jede Methode, die Teil der Fluent Interface ist, muss `RETURNING VALUE(me) LIKE sy-repid` oder `RETURNING VALUE(result) LIKE REF TO SELF` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(me) LIKE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.
    METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(me) LIKE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.
    METHODS build RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_result.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_result,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_result.

    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rs_result = VALUE #( value1 = mv_value1 value2 = mv_value2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-value1 exp = 10 msg = 'Test 1: Value1 gesetzt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-value2 exp = 'Test' msg = 'Test 2: Value2 gesetzt' ).

explanation: Fluent Interfaces verbessern die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem sie das Verketten von Methodenaufrufen ermöglichen. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster in modernen Programmiersprachen und wird in ABAP durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`me`) erreicht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, Method Chaining

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in der Tabelle `sflights`, der von 'NEW YORK' abfliegt und dessen Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardflug zurück. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `COND` mit `ELSE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` und `COND` für den Fall, dass kein Eintrag gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_first_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_first_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rs_flight = VALUE sflight(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND carrid = 'AA'
      THEN flight
      ELSE VALUE sflight( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0000' cityfrom = 'DEFAULT' cityto = 'DEFAULT' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_find_first_flight( ).

    " Füge Testdaten ein, um einen Treffer zu garantieren
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' flDate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' price = '500.00' currency = 'USD' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' flDate = sy-datum cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' price = '600.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_first_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Test 1: Erster Flug gefunden (CARRID)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'Test 2: Erster Flug gefunden (CITYFROM)' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'.

    " Testfall: Kein Flug gefunden
    DATA(ls_no_flight_result) = lo_cut->get_first_flight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_no_flight_result-carrid exp = 'XX' msg = 'Test 3: Standardflug, wenn kein Treffer' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und der `THEN ... ELSE` Klausel ermöglicht das Finden des ersten passenden Eintrags in einer internen Tabelle und das Bereitstellen eines Fallback-Wertes, falls nichts gefunden wird. Dies ist sehr ausdrucksstark und vermeidet explizite Schleifen und `IF`-Abfragen.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, COND, ELSE, sflight

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein Feiertag ist. Da es keine direkte Standardfunktion gibt, simulieren Sie dies mit einer Liste von Feiertagen und nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit `ELSE`.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Konstante mit Feiertagen und verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_is_holiday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_a_holiday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_holiday) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_holidays,
                 holiday1 TYPE d VALUE '20230101',
                 holiday2 TYPE d VALUE '20231225',
                 holiday3 TYPE d VALUE '20231226',
               END OF gc_holidays.

    TYPES: tt_holidays TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-DATA gct_holidays TYPE tt_holidays.

    CLASS-METHODS class_constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_is_holiday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_constructor.
    gct_holidays = VALUE #( ( gc_holidays-holiday1 )
                            ( gc_holidays-holiday2 )
                            ( gc_holidays-holiday3 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_date_a_holiday.
    rv_is_holiday = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( gct_holidays[ table_line = iv_date ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_is_holiday( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_date_a_holiday( '20230101' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 1: Neujahr ist Feiertag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_date_a_holiday( '20231225' ) exp = abap_true msg = 'Test 2: Weihnachten ist Feiertag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_date_a_holiday( '20230615' ) exp = abap_false msg = 'Test 3: Normaler Tag ist kein Feiertag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: Date, Time, LINE_EXISTS, COND, ELSE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Rabatt auf einen Preis. Wenn der Preis über 1000 liegt, beträgt der Rabatt 10%, andernfalls 5%. Nutzen Sie den `COND` Ausdruck mit `ELSE` für die Rabattberechnung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` für den Rabattfaktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_factor) = COND p(
      WHEN iv_original_price > 1000 THEN '0.90'
      ELSE '0.95'
    ).
    rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * lv_discount_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_discount_calculator( ).

    DATA(lv_price1) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '1200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price1 exp = '1080.00' msg = 'Test 1: Preis > 1000 (10% Rabatt)' ).

    DATA(lv_price2) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price2 exp = '475.00' msg = 'Test 2: Preis <= 1000 (5% Rabatt)' ).

    DATA(lv_price3) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( '1000.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price3 exp = '950.00' msg = 'Test 3: Preis = 1000 (5% Rabatt)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: Math, COND, ELSE, Discount, Calculation

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request auf eine externe URL durch und lesen Sie die Antwort. Die URL ist 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und `send`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_url         TYPE string VALUE 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1',
          lv_response    TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = lv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXPORTING
            timeout = 30
        ).

        lo_http_client->receive(
          IMPORTING
            e_message = lv_response
        ).

        out->write( |HTTP GET Response: { lv_response }| ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        out->write( |Error during HTTP request: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_request FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_request.
    " This test primarily checks if the code compiles and runs without immediate errors.
    " A real unit test would mock cl_http_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_get_request( ).
    " Since if_oo_adt_classrun~main writes to 'out', we can't directly assert output.
    " For demonstration, we'll just call it and ensure no dump.
    lo_cut->if_oo_adt_classrun~main( out = NEW cl_abap_unit_test_out( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No direct assertion for external call, check console output.' ).

Instructions: Suchen Sie Termine basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (z.B. Datum und Betreff-Teilstring) und geben Sie die Ergebnisse zurück. Verwenden Sie `sflights` als Referenz für mögliche Termin-Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_appointments` und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit `FILTER` oder `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_search_appointments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_search_appointments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment,
          lt_all_appointments TYPE cl_appointment=>tt_appointment_guid_tab,
          lt_filtered_appointments TYPE cl_appointment=>tt_appointment_guid_tab.

    DATA(lv_search_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_search_subject) = 'Demo'.

    TRY.
        lo_appointment = NEW cl_appointment( ).

        " Zuerst alle Termine im Zeitraum holen (oder alle, wenn Zeitraum offen)
        lo_appointment->get_appointments(
          EXPORTING
            i_start_date = lv_search_date
            i_end_date   = lv_search_date
          IMPORTING
            e_appointment_guid_tab = lt_all_appointments
        ).

        " Filtern mit moderner Syntax
        lt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( lt_all_appointments USING KEY default
                                             WHERE ( appointment_guid IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
        " Da cl_appointment keine direkte Filterung nach Betreff in get_appointments bietet,
        " müssen wir die Details jedes Termins lesen und dann filtern.
        " Dies ist ein Beispiel für die Kombination von älteren APIs mit modernen ABAP-Mustern.

        DATA(lt_results) = VALUE cl_appointment=>tt_appointment_guid_tab(
          FOR <fs_guid> IN lt_filtered_appointments
            LET lo_single_app = NEW cl_appointment( i_appointment_guid = <fs_guid>-appointment_guid )
            IN
              COND #( WHEN lo_single_app->read_appointment( ) IS INITIAL AND\                           lo_single_app->get_subject( ) CP '*' && lv_search_subject && '*' THEN <fs_guid> )
        ).

        IF lt_results IS NOT INITIAL.
          out->write( |Gefundene Termine für '{ lv_search_subject }' am { lv_search_date }:| ).
          LOOP AT lt_results ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result_guid>).
            DATA(lo_found_app) = NEW cl_appointment( i_appointment_guid = <fs_result_guid>-appointment_guid ).
            lo_found_app->read_appointment( ).
            out->write( |  - ID: { <fs_result_guid>-appointment_guid }, Betreff: { lo_found_app->get_subject( ) }| ).
          ENDLOOP.
        ELSE.
          out->write( |Keine Termine für '{ lv_search_subject }' am { lv_search_date } gefunden.| ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        out->write( |Fehler beim Suchen der Termine: { lx_app_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP PATCH-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1' und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client`, `request->set_method(if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch)` und `cl_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_patch_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_patch_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_url         TYPE string VALUE 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1',
          lv_request_body TYPE string,
          lv_response    TYPE string.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_data,
             title TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_data.

    DATA(ls_patch_data) = VALUE ty_patch_data( title = 'Updated Title' ).

    lv_request_body = cl_json=>serialize( data = ls_patch_data pretty_name = if_abap_bool=>true ).

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url    = lv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_request_body ).

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXPORTING
            timeout = 30
        ).

        lo_http_client->receive(
          IMPORTING
            e_message = lv_response
        ).

        out->write( |HTTP PATCH Request Body: { lv_request_body }| ).
        out->write( |HTTP PATCH Response: { lv_response }| ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_not_found cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        out->write( |Error during HTTP request: { lx_http_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Termin und lesen Sie ihn anschließend sofort wieder aus, um die Konsistenz zu prüfen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `create_appointment` und `read_appointment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_read_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_read_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment,
          lv_appointment_id TYPE szatk_guid,
          lv_subject_created TYPE string VALUE 'Test Termin für Konsistenzprüfung'.

    DATA(lv_start_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = '110000'.
    DATA(lv_end_time)   = '120000'.

    TRY.
        " Termin erstellen
        lo_appointment = NEW cl_appointment( i_appointment_guid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c( ) ).
        lo_appointment->create_appointment(
          EXPORTING
            i_start_date = lv_start_date
            i_start_time = lv_start_time
            i_end_date   = lv_end_date
            i_end_time   = lv_end_time
            i_subject    = lv_subject_created
            i_location   = 'Office'
          IMPORTING
            e_appointment_guid = lv_appointment_id
        ).
        out->write( |Termin { lv_appointment_id } erstellt.| ).

        " Termin auslesen
        DATA(lo_read_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( i_appointment_guid = lv_appointment_id ).
        lo_read_appointment->read_appointment( ).
        DATA(lv_subject_read) = lo_read_appointment->get_subject( ).

        IF lv_subject_read = lv_subject_created.
          out->write( |Konsistenzprüfung erfolgreich: Betreff '{ lv_subject_read }' stimmt überein.| ).
        ELSE.
          out->write( |Konsistenzprüfung fehlgeschlagen: Erstellt '{ lv_subject_created }', gelesen '{ lv_subject_read }'.| ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        out->write( |Fehler: { lx_app_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie die Fehlermeldung der Ausnahme in einem Anwendungsprotokoll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die Methode `add_message` des Log-Handlers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_with_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
        io_log_handler TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_exception.
    DATA lv_result TYPE i.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.
        lv_result = 100 / iv_value.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        io_log_handler->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          iv_msgno = '007'
          iv_msgv1 = 'Ausnahme aufgetreten'
          iv_msgv2 = lx_error->get_text( )
        ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error. " Re-raise the exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_logging FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_no_exception_logging FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_logging.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_exception_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log_creator) = NEW zcl_bal_basic_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log_handler) = lo_log_creator->create_and_add_info_msg(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'SUB5'
      iv_msg_text  = 'Start'
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data_with_exception(
          iv_value       = 0
          io_log_handler = lo_log_handler
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log_handler->get_messages( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgv2 exp = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception_logging.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_exception_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log_creator) = NEW zcl_bal_basic_log( ).
    DATA(lo_log_handler) = lo_log_creator->create_and_add_info_msg(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'SUB5'
      iv_msg_text  = 'Start'
    ).

    lo_cut->process_data_with_exception(
      iv_value       = 10
      io_log_handler = lo_log_handler
    ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log_handler->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke sind der moderne Weg zur Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Durch das Protokollieren der Ausnahmeinformationen im BAL wird eine detaillierte Fehleranalyse ermöglicht. Die `REF TO`-Syntax ist hier entscheidend für die Übergabe des Log-Handlers.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Fehlermeldungen in einem Anwendungsprotokoll mithilfe einer `REDUCE`-Expression.

CLASS zcl_bal_reduce_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        io_log_handler TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_reduce_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_error_messages.
    IF io_log_handler IS BOUND.
      DATA(lt_all_messages) = io_log_handler->get_messages( ).
      rv_error_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                 FOR message IN lt_all_messages
                                 WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
                                 NEXT count = count + 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Protokollieren Sie eine Warnmeldung nur dann, wenn ein bestimmter Schwellenwert überschritten wird, unter Verwendung einer `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um den Nachrichtentext oder die Nachricht selbst bedingt zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_cond_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_threshold_warning
      IMPORTING
        iv_value       TYPE i
        iv_threshold   TYPE i
        io_log_handler TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_cond_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_threshold_warning.
    IF io_log_handler IS BOUND.
      DATA(lv_message_text) = COND string(
        WHEN iv_value > iv_threshold THEN |Wert { iv_value } überschreitet Schwellenwert { iv_threshold }|
        ELSE ''
      ).

      IF lv_message_text IS NOT INITIAL.
        io_log_handler->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'W'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
          iv_msgno = '018'
          iv_msgv1 = lv_message_text
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE für Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) und fügen Sie drei Datensätze in unsortierter Reihenfolge ein. Überprüfen Sie, ob die Tabelle automatisch nach dem Schlüssel sortiert ist.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS insert_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE rt_sorted_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_and_sort.
    DATA: lt_input_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight        TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20241231'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check if sorted correctly (AA, LH 2024, LH 2025)
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO ls_flight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO ls_flight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = '20241231' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO ls_flight.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer `SORTED TABLE` mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel (`UNIQUE KEY`) stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle immer nach diesem Schlüssel sortiert bleibt. Beim Einfügen von Datensätzen (`INSERT`) wird die korrekte Position automatisch gefunden und Duplikate (falls `UNIQUE KEY` verwendet wird) werden verhindert oder führen zu einem Fehler. Dies ist effizient für Lesezugriffe.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INTERNAL TABLES, INSERT, UNIQUE KEY, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flugdatensatz (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) effizient aus einer SORTED TABLE. Demonstrieren Sie den Performance-Vorteil.
hint: Bei `SORTED TABLE` ist `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ...` bereits optimiert (impliziter binärer Suchalgorithmus).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS read_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_flights = it_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD read_flight.
    READ TABLE mt_flights INTO rs_flight
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing EXPECTING CX_SY_READ_ERROR FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_read=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-connid = '0400'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-fldate = '20250101'. INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( lt_flights ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->read_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_sorted_table_read=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( lt_flights ).
    lo_cut->read_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `READ TABLE` Befehl auf einer `SORTED TABLE` nutzt automatisch einen binären Suchalgorithmus, was zu einer logarithmischen Laufzeit (O(log n)) führt und somit deutlich effizienter ist als eine sequentielle Suche (O(n)) auf einer Standardtabelle, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Die Schlüsselkomponenten müssen dabei in der `WITH KEY` Klausel angegeben werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, BINARY SEARCH, PERFORMANCE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer SORTED TABLE. Nutzen Sie `COLLECT`.
hint: `COLLECT` fasst Zeilen mit identischen Schlüsselkomponenten zusammen und addiert numerische Felder. Funktioniert am besten mit SORTED TABLES.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_agg TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS aggregate_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_prices.
    DATA: ls_agg TYPE ty_sflight_agg.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_agg-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_agg-price  = ls_flight-price.
      COLLECT ls_agg INTO rt_aggregated_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_collect_prices FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_collect_prices.
    DATA: lt_input_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_flight        TYPE sflight.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = '100.00'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-price = '200.00'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_flight-price = '150.00'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-price = '50.00'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_collect( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_prices( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_result-price exp = '250.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_agg_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_result-price exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COLLECT` ist eine spezielle Anweisung für interne Tabellen, die Zeilen mit identischen Schlüsselkomponenten zusammenfasst und die Werte aller anderen numerischen Felder addiert. Bei `SORTED TABLE`s ist dies besonders effizient, da die Tabelle bereits nach dem Schlüssel sortiert ist und `COLLECT` die Sortierung nutzen kann, um schnell die zu aggregierenden Zeilen zu finden. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, COLLECT, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL TABLES, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdatensätze nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` auf einer SORTED TABLE.
hint: Der `GROUP BY` Zusatz in `LOOP AT` ist ideal für Aggregationen. Eine vorsortierte Tabelle kann die Performance verbessern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_group_res,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occup   TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_group_res.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_group_res TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_group_res WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_average
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_group_res.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_average.
    DATA: lt_sorted_flights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    " Sort the input table to optimize GROUP BY
    lt_sorted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights ( ls_flight ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_sorted_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ls_flight_entry-carrid ASCENDING
                                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_occup) = 0.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_total_occup = lv_total_occup + ls_member-seatsocc.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      avg_occup = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_occup / lv_count ELSE 0 ) )
             TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue SORTED TABLE, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer bestehenden Flugdatentabelle enthält. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen und Transformationen in einem Schritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE tt_carrier_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_count( )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      LET lv_index = result[ KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid ]-count IN
      NEXT result = COND tt_carrier_count(
        WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
          THEN VALUE tt_carrier_count( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = 1 ) )
        ELSE VALUE tt_carrier_count( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_index + 1 ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'BA'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_input_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_res_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_lh-count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_res_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_aa-count exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_res_ba) WITH KEY carrid = 'BA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res_ba-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung, das es erlaubt, eine interne Tabelle zu einer einzelnen Wert oder einer neuen Tabelle zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In diesem Beispiel wird eine `SORTED TABLE` als Akkumulator verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu zählen. Die `COND` und `LET` Ausdrücke ermöglichen eine prägnante Logik für das Hinzufügen oder Aktualisieren von Einträgen in der Ergebnistabelle. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, SORTED TABLE, AGGREGATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, ABAP 7.50

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Flugdetails: { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate }|.
    ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_events) = lo_alv->get_event( ).
        " We can't simulate a double click in a unit test, but we can check if the event object is bound.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_events ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'ALV event registration failed' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das ALV Object Model unterstützt ein robustes Event-Handling, das es ermöglicht, auf Benutzerinteraktionen wie Doppelklicks zu reagieren. Über `get_event` erhält man Zugriff auf das Event-Objekt (`cl_salv_events_list`), für das dann ein lokaler Event-Handler mit `SET HANDLER` registriert werden kann. Dies ist der moderne und objektorientierte Weg, interaktive ALV-Berichte zu erstellen. Die Event-Parameter `row` und `column` liefern die notwendigen Informationen zur Identifizierung des angeklickten Datensatzes.
keywords: ALV, EVENT HANDLING, DOUBLE CLICK, cl_salv_events_list, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Spaltenüberschriften eines ALV basierend auf den Data Dictionary-Texten der zugrunde liegenden Struktur dynamisch zu setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_ddic_field_list` und `set_long_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_rtti_headers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_rtti_headers.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_r_data  = it_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_sflights )->get_table_line_type( )->get_struct_type( ).
        DATA(lt_ddic_fields) = lo_struct_descr->get_ddic_field_list( ).

        LOOP AT lt_ddic_fields INTO DATA(ls_ddic_field).
          TRY.
              DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( ls_ddic_field-fieldname ).
              IF ls_ddic_field-fieldtext IS NOT INITIAL.
                lo_column->set_long_text( ls_ddic_field-fieldtext ).
              ENDIF.
            CATCH cx_salv_not_found.
              " Column not found in ALV, ignore
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        MESSAGE 'ALV- oder RTTI-Fehler aufgetreten' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_column_headers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_column_headers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_r_data = lt_sflights ).
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights )->get_table_line_type( )->get_struct_type( ).
        DATA(lt_ddic_fields) = lo_struct_descr->get_ddic_field_list( ).

        READ TABLE lt_ddic_fields INTO DATA(ls_ddic_field) WITH KEY fieldname = 'CARRID'.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
          lo_column->set_long_text( ls_ddic_field-fieldtext ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_column->get_long_text( ) exp = ls_ddic_field-fieldtext ).
        ELSE.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CARRID field not found in DDIC metadata' ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'ALV or RTTI operation failed' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und dem ALV Object Model. Mit RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` kann man zur Laufzeit Metadaten über Datentypen abrufen, einschließlich der Feldtexte aus dem Data Dictionary. Diese Informationen können dann verwendet werden, um ALV-Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch und sprachunabhängig zu setzen, was die Wartbarkeit und Flexibilität des Codes erheblich verbessert. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittener und sehr moderner Ansatz.
keywords: ALV, RTTI, DYNAMIC, COLUMN HEADERS, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische ALV-Anzeigeklasse, die jede interne Tabelle anzeigen kann und dabei grundlegende Einstellungen wie gestreifte Zeilen und Spaltenoptimierung vornimmt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` mit `t_r_data` und generische Methoden für Einstellungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE ANY TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Ungültige Datenreferenz' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_r_data  = <lt_data> ).

        " Basic settings
        DATA(lo_display_settings) = lo_alv->get_display_settings( ).
        lo_display_settings->set_striped_pattern( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_optimize( if_salv_c_bool_sap=>true ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'ALV-Fehler aufgetreten' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Übergabe einer Datenreferenz (`TYPE REF TO data`) kann die Methode `display_table` jede beliebige interne Tabelle anzeigen. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE ANY TABLE`) ermöglicht den Zugriff auf die dynamisch übergebene Tabelle. Standardeinstellungen wie gestreifte Zeilen (`set_striped_pattern`) und Spaltenoptimierung (`set_optimize`) können generisch angewendet werden, was zu wiederverwendbarem und wartungsfreundlichem Code führt.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Spalte zu einem ALV hinzu, die den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'On Time', 'Delayed') basierend auf einem Kriterium anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_column_list=>add_column` und `set_cell_type` oder `set_value_column`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights_ext TYPE tt_sflight_ext,
          ls_sflight_ext  TYPE ty_sflight_ext.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      ls_sflight_ext = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ).
      IF ls_sflight-planetype IS INITIAL.
        ls_sflight_ext-status = 'Delayed'.
      ELSE.
        ls_sflight_ext-status = 'On Time'.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_ext TO lt_sflights_ext.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_r_data  = lt_sflights_ext ).

        " Set header for custom column
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_status) = lo_columns->get_column( 'STATUS' ).
        lo_column_status->set_long_text( 'Flugstatus' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        MESSAGE 'ALV-Fehler aufgetreten' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_custom_column_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_custom_column_status.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-planetype = 'A320'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-planetype = ''. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_custom_column( ).
    lo_cut->display_sflights_with_status( lt_sflights ).

    " We cannot directly assert the ALV display, but we can check the logic for the custom column.
    DATA: lt_sflights_ext TYPE zcl_alv_custom_column=>tt_sflight_ext,
          ls_sflight_ext  TYPE zcl_alv_custom_column=>ty_sflight_ext.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      ls_sflight_ext = CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ).
      IF ls_sflight-planetype IS INITIAL.
        ls_sflight_ext-status = 'Delayed'.
      ELSE.
        ls_sflight_ext-status = 'On Time'.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_ext TO lt_sflights_ext.
    ENDLOOP.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_ext INTO ls_sflight_ext INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_ext-status exp = 'On Time' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_ext INTO ls_sflight_ext INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_ext-status exp = 'Delayed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Hinzufügen von benutzerdefinierten Spalten zu einem ALV ist ein häufiges Szenario. Hier wird eine neue interne Tabelle (`ty_sflight_ext`) definiert, die die ursprünglichen Flugdaten erweitert und eine zusätzliche Statusspalte enthält. Diese erweiterte Tabelle wird dann mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) befüllt und an das ALV Object Model übergeben. Das ALV erkennt die neue Spalte automatisch, und ihre Eigenschaften können wie bei jeder anderen Spalte angepasst werden. Dies ist ein flexibler Weg, um zusätzliche Informationen im ALV darzustellen.
keywords: ALV, CUSTOM COLUMN, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHT, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(lv_carrid_entry).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_carrid_entry TO rt_flight_carriers.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und wenden Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel an, um Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu filtern.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flights_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic_where.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    lv_dynamic_where_clause = |carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'|.

      WHERE (lv_dynamic_where_clause).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, um alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` zu lesen. Aggregieren Sie dann die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft mithilfe von `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` zum Lesen und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_passenger_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_passenger_count.
    TYPES: tt_passenger_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_passenger_count_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_passenger_counts) TYPE tt_passenger_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_count_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight_entry TO lt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_passenger_counts = REDUCE tt_passenger_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_passenger_count( )
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET existing_entry = result[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid DEFAULT INITIAL ] IN
      result = COND #( 
        WHEN existing_entry IS INITIAL
          THEN VALUE tt_passenger_count( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_passengers = flight-seatsocc ) )
        ELSE VALUE tt_passenger_count( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_passengers = existing_entry-total_passengers + flight-seatsocc ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_cursor_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_passenger_counts) = lo_cut->get_passenger_count_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_passenger_counts )
      msg = 'Should have aggregated data for at least one carrier'
      exp = 0
      operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die effiziente Datenbeschaffung mittels `OPEN CURSOR` mit der modernen ABAP-Funktion `REDUCE` (ab 7.40) zur Aggregation von Daten. `REDUCE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Art der Datenverarbeitung, die traditionelle Schleifen und manuelle Aggregationen ersetzt.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Data Aggregation, Database Access

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Namen des aktuellen SAP GUI Themes mithilfe von `cl_gui_props_consumer`.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gui_properties,
             gui_mode TYPE string,
             gui_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_gui_properties.

    METHODS get_multiple_gui_properties
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_gui_properties) TYPE ty_gui_properties.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multiple_gui_properties.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lt_property_names) = VALUE cl_gui_props_consumer=>tt_property_name(
      ( cl_gui_props_consumer=>co_property_gui_mode )
      ( cl_gui_props_consumer=>co_property_gui_type )
    ).
    DATA(lt_properties) = lo_props_consumer->get_properties( lt_property_names ).

    READ TABLE lt_properties WITH KEY property_name = cl_gui_props_consumer=>co_property_gui_mode
      INTO DATA(ls_mode_prop).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_gui_properties-gui_mode = ls_mode_prop-property_value.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_properties WITH KEY property_name = cl_gui_props_consumer=>co_property_gui_type
      INTO DATA(ls_type_prop).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_gui_properties-gui_type = ls_type_prop-property_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, um Flüge aus `SFLIGHT` zu lesen. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt, und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei eine moderne `COND` Expression.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR` mit einer `COND` Expression nach dem `FETCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE sy-datum VALUE sy-datum.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_entry).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_sflight_entry-fldate > lv_current_date THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
        APPEND ls_sflight_entry TO rt_future_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_cursor_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Assert that all retrieved flights are indeed in the future
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    LOOP AT lt_future_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_flight-fldate > lv_current_date
        msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate } is not in the future|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR` in Kombination mit einer `COND` Expression (ab 7.40) zur Filterung von Daten nach dem Abruf. Obwohl eine `WHERE`-Klausel im `SELECT` effizienter wäre, zeigt dies die Anwendung von `COND` für komplexe Logik nach dem `FETCH`.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, COND, Conditional Logic, Database Access, Date/Time

Instructions: Lesen Sie mit `OPEN CURSOR` alle Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHT` und konvertieren Sie deren Namen in Großbuchstaben. Speichern Sie die eindeutigen, großgeschriebenen Namen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und nach dem `FETCH` die String-Funktion `to_upper` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_upper_carriers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_upper_carriers) TYPE SORTED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_upper_carriers.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_all_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid FROM sflight.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @DATA(lv_carrid_entry).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_carrid_entry TO lt_all_carriers.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_upper_carriers = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN lt_all_carriers ( to_upper( carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_upper_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_upper_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_cursor_string( ).
    DATA(lt_upper_carriers) = lo_cut->get_unique_upper_carriers( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_upper_carriers )
      msg = 'Should retrieve at least some unique upper case carriers'
      exp = 0
      operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal
    ).

    " Check if all entries are upper case and unique
    DATA(lv_previous_carrier) TYPE string.
    LOOP AT lt_upper_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_carrier
        exp = to_upper( lv_carrier )
        msg = |Carrier '{ lv_carrier }' is not upper case|
      ).
      IF lv_previous_carrier IS NOT INITIAL.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = lv_carrier > lv_previous_carrier
          msg = |Carriers '{ lv_previous_carrier }' and '{ lv_carrier }' are not unique or sorted correctly|
        ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_previous_carrier = lv_carrier.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `OPEN CURSOR` für die Datenbeschaffung mit modernen ABAP-Funktionen zur String-Verarbeitung und Tabellenmanipulation. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `DISTINCT` und der String-Funktion `to_upper` (ab 7.40) ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Erstellung einer internen Tabelle mit eindeutigen, großgeschriebenen Werten.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, String Processing, to_upper, FOR, DISTINCT, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise (FIELD `PRICE`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Währung (FIELD `CURRENCYCODE`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currencycode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( currencycode = iv_currency )
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
