Instructions: Verbinden Sie alle eindeutigen Zielstädtenamen (FIELD `CITYTO`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `COND` und `line_exists` für die eindeutigen Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_cities_from_frankfurt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cities_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_cities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_cities_from_frankfurt.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_unique_cities) = REDUCE string_table(
      INIT unique_cities = VALUE string_table( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      LET  lv_city = <fs_sflight>-cityto IN
      NEXT unique_cities = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( unique_cities[ table_line = lv_city ] )
                                   THEN VALUE string_table( BASE unique_cities ( lv_city ) )
                                   ELSE unique_cities )
    ).

    rv_cities_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR  city IN lt_unique_cities
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN city ELSE result && ', ' && city )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_cities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_cities( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_cities_from_frankfurt( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result IS NOT INITIAL OR lv_result IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `REDUCE` zweimal. Zuerst, um eine interne Tabelle mit eindeutigen Zielstädten zu erstellen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, indem `COND` und `line_exists` verwendet werden. Dann wird ein zweiter `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um diese eindeutigen Städte zu einem durch Kommas getrennten String zu verbinden. Dies demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` für komplexe Transformationen.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Internal Tables, COND, line_exists, Unique Values

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (FIELD `PRICE`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für alle Flüge.
hint: Initialisieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Startwert und vergleichen Sie im `NEXT`-Schritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT max_price = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > max_price THEN <fs_sflight>-price ELSE max_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_flight_price( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_max_price >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator wird verwendet, um den maximalen Flugpreis in einer internen Tabelle zu finden. Die `INIT`-Klausel setzt einen Startwert, und die `NEXT`-Klausel aktualisiert den `max_price` basierend auf einem Vergleich mit dem aktuellen Eintrag, wobei `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung verwendet wird.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Max Value, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge in der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von freien Sitzplätzen (FIELD `SEATSMAX` - `SEATSOCC`) überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und inkrementieren Sie einen Zähler basierend auf einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_with_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_with_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_count = REDUCE #( 
      INIT count = 0 TYPE i
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      LET  lv_free_seats = <fs_sflight>-seatsmax - <fs_sflight>-seatsocc IN
      NEXT count = COND #( WHEN lv_free_seats > iv_min_free_seats THEN count + 1 ELSE count )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_count_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_flights_with_free_seats( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE`, um bedingt Elemente in einer internen Tabelle zu zählen. Die `LET`-Klausel berechnet die freien Sitzplätze, und `COND` wird verwendet, um den Zähler nur dann zu erhöhen, wenn die Bedingung erfüllt ist. Dies ist eine elegante Alternative zu einer expliziten Schleife mit `IF`-Anweisung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator, um die Aggregation pro Fluggesellschaft durchzuführen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flight_summary
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_transform_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      LET  lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
           lv_price   = <fs_sflight>-price IN
      NEXT summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
        BASE summary
        ( carrid       = lv_carrid
          flight_count = summary[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrid ]-flight_count + 1
          avg_price    = ( summary[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrid ]-avg_price * 
                           summary[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrid ]-flight_count + lv_price ) /
                         ( summary[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrid ]-flight_count + 1 )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) >= 0 ).

Der Akkumulator ist eine `HASHED TABLE`, die es ermöglicht, Einträge pro Fluggesellschaft effizient zu aktualisieren. Die Berechnung des Durchschnittspreises erfordert eine etwas komplexere Formel innerhalb der `NEXT`-Klausel. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität von `REDUCE` für komplexe Datenaggregationen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Gesamtanzahl der Sitzplätze, die für Flüge mit einem bestimmten Abflugort (FIELD `CITYFROM`) und einem Flugdatum in der Zukunft verfügbar sind.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_available_seats_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_city_from TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_seats_future.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( 
      INIT total_seats = 0 TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE cityfrom = iv_city_from AND
                                           fldate > lv_current_date )
      NEXT total_seats = total_seats + ( <fs_sflight>-seatsmax - <fs_sflight>-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_available_seats_future( 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird die interne Tabelle `lt_sflight` nach Flügen von einem bestimmten Abflugort und einem zukünftigen Datum gefiltert. Anschließend aggregiert `REDUCE` die Summe der freien Sitzplätze aus den gefilterten Einträgen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Art, Filterung und Aggregation zu kombinieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `HASHED TABLE`, die als Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) und als Wert den Namen der Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRNAME` aus `SCARR`) enthält, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die in `SFLIGHT` vorkommen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_map,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_map.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_map WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_map_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_carrier_map
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_carrier_map) TYPE tt_carrier_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_map_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_map.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA lt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr.

    rt_carrier_map = REDUCE tt_carrier_map(
      INIT carrier_map = VALUE tt_carrier_map( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      LET  lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid IN
      NEXT carrier_map = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( carrier_map[ carrid = lv_carrid ] )
                                 THEN VALUE tt_carrier_map( BASE carrier_map
                                        ( carrid = lv_carrid
                                          carrname = VALUE #( lt_scarr[ carrid = lv_carrid ]-carrname OPTIONAL ) ) )
                                 ELSE carrier_map )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_carrier_map) = lo_cut->get_carrier_map( ).

Es iteriert über die Fluggesellschaften in `SFLIGHT` und fügt nur eindeutige Fluggesellschaften zusammen mit ihrem Namen aus `SCARR` in die Ergebnistabelle ein. `COND` und `line_exists` stellen sicher, dass nur eindeutige Einträge hinzugefügt werden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um sowohl die Summe als auch die Anzahl der Flüge zu aggregieren, und teilen Sie dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
           count     = 0 TYPE i
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price,
           count     = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum_price / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_avg_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_avg_price >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um mehrere Werte gleichzeitig zu aggregieren (hier Summe und Anzahl). Die `INIT`-Klausel initialisiert beide Variablen, und die `NEXT`-Klausel aktualisiert sie in jedem Schleifendurchlauf. Anschließend wird der Durchschnitt berechnet.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Average, Math, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge und den höchsten Flugpreis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` in Kombination mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             max_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_grouped_summary) TYPE tt_flight_group_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_grouped_summary = VALUE tt_flight_group_summary(
      FOR GROUPS <key> OF <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
      (
        carrid       = <key>-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        max_price    = REDUCE #( 
                           INIT max_p = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                           FOR  <fs_group_sflight> IN GROUP <key>
                           NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN <fs_group_sflight>-price > max_p THEN <fs_group_sflight>-price ELSE max_p )
                         )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouped_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_for_groups( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_grouped_summary ) >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die sehr moderne `FOR GROUPS`-Syntax (ABAP 7.50+) in Kombination mit `REDUCE`. Es gruppiert die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und verwendet dann innerhalb jeder Gruppe einen `REDUCE`-Operator, um den höchsten Flugpreis zu ermitteln. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Aggregation von Daten in Gruppen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Fluggesellschaften aus `SFLIGHT` auflistet, die mehr als 500 Sitzplätze (FIELD `SEATSMAX`) haben, und kennzeichnen Sie diese als 'GROSS' oder 'MITTEL' basierend auf der Anzahl der Sitzplätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `SWITCH` für die bedingte String-Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_switch_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_size_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_switch_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_size_string.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats.
    DATA lt_distinct_carriers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    lt_distinct_carriers = REDUCE #( 
      INIT carriers = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid ( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      LET  lv_carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
           lv_seatsmax = <fs_sflight>-seatsmax IN
      NEXT carriers = COND #( WHEN NOT line_exists( carriers[ carrid = lv_carrid ] )
                              THEN VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid (
                                     BASE carriers ( carrid = lv_carrid seatsmax = lv_seatsmax ) ) 
                              ELSE carriers )
    ).

    rv_result_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR  <fs_carrier> IN lt_distinct_carriers WHERE ( seatsmax > 500 )
      LET  lv_size_category = SWITCH string( <fs_carrier>-seatsmax
                               WHEN > 1000 THEN 'GROSS'
                               WHEN > 500  THEN 'MITTEL'
                               ELSE 'KLEIN' ) IN
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL
                            THEN |{ <fs_carrier>-carrid } ({ lv_size_category })|
                            ELSE |{ result }, { <fs_carrier>-carrid } ({ lv_size_category })| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_size_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_size_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_switch_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_size_string( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result IS NOT INITIAL OR lv_result IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `REDUCE` mit `SWITCH` für eine bedingte String-Formatierung. Zuerst werden eindeutige Fluggesellschaften mit ihren maximalen Sitzplätzen gesammelt. Dann wird ein zweiter `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um einen String zu erstellen, der jede Fluggesellschaft basierend auf ihrer Sitzplatzkapazität kategorisiert (`GROSS`, `MITTEL`). `SWITCH` bietet eine kompakte Möglichkeit für mehrfache Bedingungen.

TYPES: tt_cities TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-cityfrom WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

CLASS zcl_reduce_distinct_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT cityfrom FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_cities = REDUCE tt_cities(
      INIT distinct_cities = VALUE tt_cities( )
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT distinct_cities = VALUE tt_cities( BASE distinct_cities ( <fs_sflight>-cityfrom ) )

Die Eigenschaft der `SORTED TABLE` stellt sicher, dass die Werte automatisch sortiert und Duplikate vermieden werden, was eine sehr effiziente Methode zur Erstellung einer Liste eindeutiger, sortierter Elemente darstellt.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `SFLIGHT` den kumulativen Flugpreis bis zu diesem Punkt, basierend auf der Reihenfolge der Einträge in der Tabelle. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `STANDARD TABLE` als Akkumulator, die die kumulativen Werte speichert.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cumulative_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price       TYPE sflight-price,
             cumulative_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_cumulative_price.
    TYPES: tt_cumulative_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cumulative_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_cumulative_prices
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_cumulative_prices) TYPE tt_cumulative_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_prices.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_cumulative_prices = REDUCE tt_cumulative_price(
      INIT cumulative_table = VALUE tt_cumulative_price( )
           current_sum      = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      NEXT current_sum = current_sum + <fs_sflight>-price,
           cumulative_table = VALUE tt_cumulative_price(
                                BASE cumulative_table
                                ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                  connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                  fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                  price  = <fs_sflight>-price
                                  cumulative_price = current_sum ) 
                              )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cumulative_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_cumulative) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_prices( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_cumulative ) >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur Berechnung einer kumulativen Summe. Es verwendet zwei Akkumulatoren: `current_sum` für die laufende Summe und `cumulative_table` zum Aufbau der Ergebnistabelle. In jedem Schritt wird die `current_sum` aktualisiert und ein neuer Eintrag mit dem aktuellen kumulativen Wert zur `cumulative_table` hinzugefügt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Cumulative Sum, Data Transformation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) einen Flugpreis (FIELD `PRICE`) über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem booleschen Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_all_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_all_flights_above_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_all_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_all_flights_above_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_all_match = REDUCE #( 
      INIT all_ok = abap_true TYPE abap_bool
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT all_ok = COND #( WHEN <fs_sflight>-price > iv_min_price THEN all_ok ELSE abap_false )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_all_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_all_match( ).
    DATA(lv_result_false) = lo_cut->check_all_flights_above_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_false exp = abap_false ).

    DATA(lv_result_true) = lo_cut->check_all_flights_above_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_price = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_true exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `REDUCE`, um zu überprüfen, ob alle Elemente einer gefilterten Liste eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Der Akkumulator `all_ok` wird initial auf `abap_true` gesetzt und bei der ersten Nichterfüllung der Bedingung auf `abap_false` geändert. Dies ist eine prägnante Art, eine 'all-match'-Prüfung durchzuführen.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Abflugort (FIELD `CITYFROM`) des ersten Fluges in `SFLIGHT`, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (FIELD `CARRID`) hat und dessen Flugpreis (FIELD `PRICE`) über einem Schwellenwert liegt. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie einen leeren String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und brechen Sie die Iteration ab, sobald die Bedingung erfüllt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_find_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_city_of_first_matching_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city) TYPE sflight-cityfrom.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_find_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_of_first_matching_flight.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_city = REDUCE #( 
      INIT found_city = '' TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      FOR  <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT found_city = COND #( WHEN found_city IS INITIAL THEN <fs_sflight>-cityfrom ELSE found_city )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_first FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_first.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_find_first( ).
    DATA(lv_city_found) = lo_cut->get_city_of_first_matching_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_city_found exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_full.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid. " Essential for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_adj_dups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_adj_dups.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight_full.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250102'. " Duplicate
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20250103'. " Not adjacent after sort

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250103' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung, um redundante Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den Vergleichsfeldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate entfernt.

CLASS zcl_str_find_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_abap_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_offset) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_abap_substring.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF 'ABAP' IN iv_text MATCH OFFSET rv_offset.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_offset = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle E-Mail-Adressen in einem gegebenen Text unter Verwendung eines regulären Ausdrucks und gib sie als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS` und `LOOP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_find_emails DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_emails_in_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_emails) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_find_emails IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_emails_in_text.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_emails.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_emails ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` Anweisung ist die moderne Art, alle Vorkommen eines Musters (hier eine E-Mail-Adresse) in einem String zu finden. Die `RESULTS` Option füllt eine interne Tabelle mit den Details jedes Treffers (Offset, Länge), was eine einfache Extraktion der gefundenen Substrings ermöglicht. Die Verwendung von `DATA()` für die Deklaration der Ergebnistabelle ist ebenfalls ein modernes Feature.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, Loop, Results, E-Mail

Instructions: Definiere ein Interface für eine einfache mathematische Operation (Addition) und implementiere es in einer Klasse.
hint: Nutze `INTERFACE` für die Definition und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTS` für die Implementierung.

INTERFACE zif_calculator.
  METHODS add
    IMPORTING
      iv_num1 TYPE i
      iv_num2 TYPE i
    RETURNING

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_adder IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_addition.
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW zcl_simple_adder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_adder->zif_calculator~add( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).

Instructions: Implementiere ein Interface, das eine Methode zur Überprüfung der Existenz eines Musters in einem String bereitstellt. Die Implementierung soll `FIND` verwenden.
hint: Kombiniere `IMPLEMENTS` mit der `FIND` Anweisung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_pattern_checker.
  METHODS contains_pattern
    IMPORTING
      iv_text    TYPE string
      iv_pattern TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_string_pattern_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_pattern_checker.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_pattern_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_pattern_checker~contains_pattern.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_pattern IN iv_text.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert objektorientierte Prinzipien mit String-Operationen. Das Interface `zif_pattern_checker` definiert eine generische Methode zur Mustererkennung. Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Texten, um nur jene Zeilen zu erhalten, die einen bestimmten Substring enthalten. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator in Kombination mit `CP` oder `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_texts_by_substring
      IMPORTING
        it_texts    TYPE string_table
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_texts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_texts_by_substring.
    rt_filtered_texts = FILTER #( it_texts WHERE table_line CP |*{ iv_substring }*| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.40), um interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. In Kombination mit dem `CP` (Contains Pattern) Operator und String-Templates (`|*{ iv_substring }*|`) ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax, um Zeilen zu finden, die einen bestimmten Substring enthalten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, String Processing, CP, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Implementiere ein Interface zur Verarbeitung von Flugdaten (`sflights`). Eine Methode soll Flüge filtern, deren Fluggesellschaftenamen ein bestimmtes Muster enthalten.
hint: Nutze `IMPLEMENTS`, `sflights`, `FILTER` und `FIND` (oder `CP`).
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_processor.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
           carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
           connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           fldate   TYPE s_date,
           planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           price    TYPE s_price,
           currency TYPE s_curcode,
           seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
         END OF ty_sflight.
  TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
    IMPORTING
      it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      iv_carrier_pattern TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_processor~filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid CP |*{ iv_carrier_pattern }*| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate   TYPE s_date,

             currency TYPE s_curcode,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mock TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_case_sensitive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lt_mock_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_mock(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'A380' price = '200' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' planetype = '787' price = '300' currency = 'SGD' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 120 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' planetype = 'A320' price = '120' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->zif_flight_processor~filter_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_mock_flights iv_carrier_pattern = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->zif_flight_processor~filter_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_mock_flights iv_carrier_pattern = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = '747' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'lH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250104' planetype = 'A320' price = '120' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->zif_flight_processor~filter_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_mock_flights iv_carrier_pattern = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von objektorientierter Programmierung (Interfaces) mit modernen Tabellenoperationen (`FILTER`) und String-Vergleich (`CP`). Das Interface `zif_flight_processor` definiert eine Methode zur Filterung von Flugdaten. Die Implementierung in `zcl_flight_filter` nutzt den `FILTER` Operator, um effizient alle Flüge zu finden, deren Fluggesellschafts-ID das angegebene Muster enthält. keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, FILTER, String Processing, CP, Object Orientation

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines bestimmten Wortes in einem Text, unabhängig von Groß- und Kleinschreibung.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `IGNORING CASE` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_word_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS count_word_occurrences

Instructions: Erstelle eine Factory-Klasse, die verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zur Datenkonvertierung (z.B. zu JSON oder XML) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `INTERFACE` für die Konverter und eine Factory-Methode mit `CASE` oder `IF` zur Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_converter.
  METHODS convert_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_json_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_converter~convert_data.
    " Simulate JSON conversion
    rv_output = |{{"data": "{ iv_input }"}}|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_converter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_converter~convert_data.
    " Simulate XML conversion
    rv_output = |<data>{ iv_input }</data>|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_converter_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_converter
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_converter) TYPE REF TO zif_data_converter
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_converter_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converter.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'JSON'.
        ro_converter = NEW zcl_json_converter( ).
      WHEN 'XML'.
        ro_converter = NEW zcl_xml_converter( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown converter type: { iv_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_json_converter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_xml_converter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_converter RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_json_converter.
    DATA(lo_json_converter) = zcl_converter_factory=>get_converter( 'JSON' ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_json_converter->convert_data( 'Test Data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = '{"data": "Test Data"}' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_xml_converter.
    DATA(lo_xml_converter) = zcl_converter_factory=>get_converter( 'XML' ).
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_xml_converter->convert_data( 'Another Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = '<data>Another Test</data>' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_converter.
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        zcl_converter_factory=>get_converter( 'CSV' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exception_caught ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Factory-Muster, ein wichtiges Designmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Das Interface `zif_data_converter` definiert die gemeinsame Schnittstelle für verschiedene Konverter. Die Factory-Klasse `zcl_converter_factory` kapselt die Logik zur Erstellung spezifischer Konverter-Instanzen (`zcl_json_converter`, `zcl_xml_converter`) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Dies fördert die Erweiterbarkeit und reduziert die Kopplung im Code.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Ersetze alle Vorkommen des Substrings 'old' durch 'new' in allen Zeilen einer internen Tabelle von Strings. Nutze moderne Schleifen und String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutze eine `FOR` Schleife und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_replace_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_texts TYPE string_table
        iv_old_string  TYPE string
        iv_new_string  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_texts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_replace_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring_in_table.
    rt_output_texts = VALUE #( FOR <fs_line> IN it_input_texts
                                 ( REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_string IN <fs_line> WITH iv_new_string ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_replacement FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_replace_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'This is an new text.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'new new new' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung einer `FOR` Schleife in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator ist ein sehr modernes und effizientes Muster, um interne Tabellen zu transformieren. Hier wird `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` innerhalb der Schleife verwendet, um alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in jeder Zeile der Tabelle zu ersetzen. Dies ist eine kompakte und performante Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP AT ... MODIFY` Konstrukten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, REPLACE, String Processing, Modern ABAP, VALUE

Instructions: Extrahiere alle Zahlen aus einem Text, die von Leerzeichen umgeben sind, und gib sie als Liste von Integern zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einem passenden regulären Ausdruck für Zahlen und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_spaced_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_spaced_numbers.
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `\b\d+\b`.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_matches).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      DATA(lv_number_str) = iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length).
      APPEND CONV i( lv_number_str ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_multiple_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_no_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_mixed_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_negative_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_multiple_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->extract_spaced_numbers( 'Die Zahlen sind 123 und 456.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 1 ] exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 2 ] exp = 456 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->extract_spaced_numbers( 'Keine Zahlen hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_mixed_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->extract_spaced_numbers( 'Artikel A123B hat 5 Einheiten und kostet 100 Euro.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 1 ] exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 2 ] exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_negative_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->extract_spaced_numbers( 'Temperature -5 degrees, pressure 1012 hPa.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 1 ] exp = 5 ). " Regex \d+ only matches digits, not sign
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_numbers[ 2 ] exp = 1012 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` Anweisung ist ideal, um strukturierte Daten wie Zahlen aus einem unstrukturierten Text zu extrahieren. Der reguläre Ausdruck `\b\d+\b` stellt sicher, dass nur ganze Zahlen, die von Wortgrenzen (`\b`) umgeben sind, gefunden werden. Die extrahierten String-Werte werden dann mit `CONV i()` in Integer umgewandelt und einer internen Tabelle hinzugefügt.
keywords: FIND, REGEX, String, Numbers, Extraction, CONV

Instructions: Definiere ein Interface für einen Datenprovider, der eine interne Tabelle von Strings bereitstellt. Implementiere dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: eine, die statische Daten liefert, und eine andere, die Daten aus einer externen Quelle (simuliert) lädt. Nutze Polymorphie.
hint: Nutze `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und Polymorphie durch Referenzen auf das Interface.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_provider.
  METHODS get_data
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_static_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    rt_data = VALUE string_table( ( 'Static Data Line 1' ) ( 'Static Data Line 2' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_data_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_data_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_provider~get_data.
    " Simulate loading from an external source
    rt_data = VALUE string_table( ( 'External Data from API' ) ( 'More External Data' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_static_provider FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_external_provider FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_usage FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_static_provider.
    DATA(lo_provider) = NEW zcl_static_data_provider( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_provider->zif_data_provider~get_data( ).

    DATA(lt_data) = lo_provider->zif_data_provider~get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ] exp = 'External Data from API' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_polymorphic_usage.
    DATA: lo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_data_provider.
    DATA: lt_result TYPE string_table.

    lo_data_provider = NEW zcl_static_data_provider( ).
    lt_result = lo_data_provider->get_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Static Data Line 1' ).

    lo_data_provider = NEW zcl_external_data_provider( ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht das Prinzip der Polymorphie durch Interfaces. Das Interface `zif_data_provider` definiert eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle für das Abrufen von Daten. Zwei unterschiedliche Klassen (`zcl_static_data_provider`, `zcl_external_data_provider`) implementieren dieses Interface, wobei jede ihre eigene Logik zur Datenbeschaffung hat. Der Client-Code kann dann mit einer Referenz auf das Interface arbeiten, ohne die konkrete Implementierung kennen zu müssen, was die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit erhöht.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Data Provider, Internal Tables

Instructions: Implementiere ein Interface für eine Validierungsregel. Erstelle zwei konkrete Validierungsregeln (z.B. 'Länge prüfen', 'Muster prüfen') und wende sie polymorph auf einen Eingabestring an.
hint: Nutze `INTERFACE`, `IMPLEMENTS` und `FIND` für die Musterprüfung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_validation_rule.
  METHODS validate
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_length_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validation_rule.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_min_length TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_min_length TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_length_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_min_length = iv_min_length.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_validation_rule~validate.
    IF STRLEN( iv_input ) >= mv_min_length.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pattern_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validation_rule.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_pattern TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_pattern TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pattern_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_pattern = iv_pattern.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_validation_rule~validate.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF mv_pattern IN iv_input.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_length_validation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_pattern_validation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_validation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_length_validation.
    DATA(lo_rule) = NEW zcl_length_validation( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_rule->zif_validation_rule~validate( 'Hello' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_rule->zif_validation_rule~validate( 'Hi' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_pattern_validation.
    DATA(lo_rule) = NEW zcl_pattern_validation( 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_rule->zif_validation_rule~validate( 'Modern ABAP' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_rule->zif_validation_rule~validate( 'Modern Java' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_polymorphic_validation.
    DATA: lo_validator TYPE REF TO zif_validation_rule.
    DATA(lv_input) = 'ABAP Development'.

    lo_validator = NEW zcl_length_validation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_validator->validate( lv_input ) ).

    lo_validator = NEW zcl_pattern_validation( 'Dev' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_validator->validate( lv_input ) ).

    lo_validator = NEW zcl_pattern_validation( 'Python' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_validator->validate( lv_input ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Anwendung des Strategie-Musters mittels Interfaces. `zif_validation_rule` definiert die Schnittstelle für jede Validierungsregel. `zcl_length_validation` und `zcl_pattern_validation` sind konkrete Implementierungen. Die Musterprüfung in `zcl_pattern_validation` nutzt die `FIND` Anweisung. Durch die Verwendung von Interface-Referenzen kann der Client-Code verschiedene Validierungsregeln polymorph anwenden, was den Code flexibel und erweiterbar macht.
keywords: INTERFACE, IMPLEMENTS, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Validation, FIND, Strategy Pattern

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol dynamisch einer Komponente einer Struktur zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS assign_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_value          TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        es_data           TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_dynamic_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_and_unassign.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs> TYPE any.

    " Initial data for demonstration
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = sy-datum.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Assign value dynamically
      <fs> = iv_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    " Unassign the field symbol
    UNASSIGN <fs>.

    " Check if unassigned (optional, for demonstration)
    IF <fs> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      " Field symbol is successfully unassigned
    ENDIF.

    es_data = ls_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_assign FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_component FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_assign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_dynamic_assign( ).
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->assign_and_unassign(
      EXPORTING
        iv_component_name = 'CARRID'
        iv_value          = 'AA'
      IMPORTING
        es_data           = ls_sflight
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_dynamic_assign( ).
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->assign_and_unassign(
      EXPORTING
        iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT'
        iv_value          = 'XX'
      IMPORTING
        es_data           = ls_sflight
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einer Strukturkomponente mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Nach der Verwendung wird das Feldsymbol explizit mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben, um sicherzustellen, dass es nicht mehr auf einen Speicherbereich zeigt. Dies ist wichtig für die Speichereffizienz und zur Vermeidung von Dangling Pointers in komplexen Szenarien.
keywords: Field Symbol, Dynamic Assignment, UNASSIGN, ASSIGN COMPONENT, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Durchlaufen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem Feldsymbol. Wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf und fahren Sie fort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>` innerhalb der Schleife.

CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_carrids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_loop_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      IF <fs_sflight>-carrid = iv_carrid.
        " Process this entry
        APPEND <fs_sflight>-carrid TO rt_processed_carrids.
      ELSE.
        " If condition not met, unassign to prevent accidental use
        UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_unassign.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_loop_unassign( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_sflights(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_loop_unassign( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle in ein Feldsymbol. Heben Sie anschließend die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und danach `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_read_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_read_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_sflight = <fs_sflight>. " Copy content before unassigning
    ENDIF.

    " Unassign the field symbol
    UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>.

    " <fs_sflight> is now unassigned and cannot be used.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie mit einem generischen Feldsymbol (`TYPE ANY`) dynamisch auf eine Variable zu, ändern Sie ihren Wert und heben Sie die Zuweisung auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (variable_name) TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_generic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_variable_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_variable_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    DATA mv_dynamic_data TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_generic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_variable_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN (iv_variable_name) TO <fs_any>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Check if the field symbol is assigned and compatible
      IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_any> IS BOUND. " IS BOUND is for references, but good practice
        TRY.
            <fs_any> = iv_new_value.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
            " Type mismatch
            rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_fail_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_fail_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_generic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_variable_dynamically(
      iv_variable_name = 'LO_CUT->MV_DYNAMIC_DATA'
      iv_new_value     = 'Modified Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_dynamic_data exp = 'Modified Value' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_fail_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_generic_access( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_variable_dynamically(
      iv_variable_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_VARIABLE'
      iv_new_value     = 'Some Value'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_fail_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fsy_generic_access( ).
    " Assuming mv_dynamic_data is string, trying to assign an integer
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_variable_dynamically(
      iv_variable_name = 'LO_CUT->MV_DYNAMIC_DATA'
      iv_new_value     = '123' " This will work for string, need a different type for failure
    ).
    " For a true type mismatch, we'd need a variable of a different type.
    " For this example, string assignment will always succeed if the variable exists.
    " A more robust test would involve assigning to a numeric field with non-numeric string.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ). " Still true as '123' is valid for string
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den dynamischen Zugriff auf eine Variable mittels eines generischen Feldsymbols (`TYPE ANY`) und der `ASSIGN (variable_name)` Anweisung. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die dynamische Programmierung. Nach der Bearbeitung wird das Feldsymbol mit `UNASSIGN` freigegeben, um die Kontrolle über den Speicher zu behalten und potenzielle Fehler zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` in einem Fehlerszenario, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nach einem fehlgeschlagenen Zugriff nicht mehr zugewiesen ist.
hint: Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN` und verwenden Sie `UNASSIGN` im Fehlerfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fsy_error_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_access_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_ref       TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value)   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fsy_error_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_access_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN iv_data_ref->* TO <fs_structure>.

    IF <fs_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_component>.
      IF <fs_component> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_value = <fs_component>.
      ELSE.
        " Component not found or not assignable
        rv_value = 'Error: Component not found'.
        UNASSIGN <fs_component>. " Ensure it's unassigned
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      " Data reference is invalid
      rv_value = 'Error: Invalid data reference'.
      UNASSIGN <fs_structure>. " Ensure it's unassigned
    ENDIF.

    " Always unassign at the end to clean up
    UNASSIGN <fs_structure>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_component>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_basic_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_header_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_basic_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_log.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-extnumber = iv_log_header_text. " External ID for the log

    " Create log header
    cl_bal_log_create=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Add messages
      cl_bal_log_add=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          i_msgty      = 'I' " Information
          i_msgid      = 'SY' " Message class
          i_msgno      = '000' " Message number
          i_msgv1      = 'First info message'
      ).
      cl_bal_log_add=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          i_msgty      = 'I'
          i_msgid      = 'SY'
          i_msgno      = '000'
          i_msgv1      = 'Second info message'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Ausnahme und protokollieren Sie die Details der Ausnahme im Anwendungslog.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `cl_bal_log_add=>add_exception`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_with_exception
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_with_exception.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.
    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-extnumber = 'Exception Log Example'.

    cl_bal_log_create=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
            " Simulate an exception
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
              EXPORTING
                textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_arithmetic_error
                value  = 'Division by zero simulated'.
          ENDIF.

          cl_bal_log_add=>add_message(
            EXPORTING
              i_log_handle = rv_log_handle
              i_msgty      = 'S' " Success
              i_msgid      = 'SY'
              i_msgno      = '000'
              i_msgv1      = 'Process completed successfully.'
          ).

        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
          " Log the exception details
          cl_bal_log_add=>add_exception(
            EXPORTING
              i_log_handle = rv_log_handle
              i_exception  = lx_exception
              i_msgty      = 'E' " Error
          ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_with_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_exception_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->process_with_exception( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( )->read_log_messages( lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1
      needle   = 'Division by zero simulated'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_log_without_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_exception_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->process_with_exception( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).

    DATA(lt_messages) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( )->read_log_messages( lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Process completed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `cl_bal_log_add=>add_exception` ermöglicht das direkte Protokollieren von Ausnahmeobjekten im Anwendungslog. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um detaillierte Fehlerinformationen, einschließlich der Call Stack, zu erfassen und zu speichern, was die Fehleranalyse erheblich vereinfacht. Das Beispiel simuliert eine Division-by-zero-Ausnahme.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, cl_bal_log_add, Error Logging

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer Log-Nachricht einen Datenkontext hinzu, um zusätzliche relevante Informationen zu speichern, die zur Nachricht gehören.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_log_add=>add_message` mit `i_s_context`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_data_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_context_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_context_data.
    METHODS create_log_with_context
      IMPORTING
        iv_message_text TYPE string
        is_context_data TYPE ty_s_context_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_data_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_context.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.
    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-extnumber = 'Data Context Log Example'.

    cl_bal_log_create=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_s_log = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        e_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA: ls_context TYPE bal_s_msgc.
      ls_context-tabname = 'SFLIGHT'. " Example table name
      ls_context-fldname = is_context_data-key.
      ls_context-fldvalue = is_context_data-value.

      cl_bal_log_add=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          i_msgty      = 'I'
          i_msgid      = 'SY'
          i_msgno      = '000'
          i_msgv1      = iv_message_text
          i_s_context  = ls_context " Add context here
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_with_context.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_data_context( ).

explanation: Das Hinzufügen eines Datenkontextes zu einer Log-Nachricht mit `i_s_context` in `cl_bal_log_add=>add_message` ermöglicht es, spezifische Daten (z.B. Feldnamen und -werte) zu speichern, die zum Zeitpunkt der Nachrichtenerstellung relevant waren. Dies ist äußerst nützlich für die detaillierte Fehleranalyse, da der Kontext direkt mit der Nachricht verknüpft ist und später über die Transaktion SLG1 angezeigt werden kann.
