Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung eines modernen ABAP-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_seatsmax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seatsmax RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_seatsmax IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seatsmax.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_seatsmax FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_seatsmax.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_seatsmax( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seatsmax( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT. Ein einfacher Test prüft, ob der Wert > 0 ist.
    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHT einfügen oder mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summe sollte nicht 0 sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind' act = lv_result exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen, indem er eine Schleife und eine Akkumulatorvariable in einer einzigen Anweisung zusammenfasst. Dies ist effizienter und moderner als klassische LOOP-Anweisungen.
keywords: NUMBER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob eine gegebene Zahl gerade oder ungerade ist, unter Verwendung eines modernen ABAP-Konditionaloperators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator für eine inline-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_even_odd_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_even_or_odd IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_even_odd_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_even_or_odd.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_number MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'Gerade'
      ELSE 'Ungerade'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_even FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_odd FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_even.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_even_odd_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_even_or_odd( 4 ) exp = 'Gerade' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_even_or_odd( 100 ) exp = 'Gerade' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_odd.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_even_odd_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_even_or_odd( 3 ) exp = 'Ungerade' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_even_or_odd( 99 ) exp = 'Ungerade' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_even_odd_checker( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->is_even_or_odd( 0 ) exp = 'Gerade' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Bedingung in einer einzigen Zeile. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert den Codeumfang im Vergleich zu klassischen IF-ELSE-Strukturen.
keywords: NUMBER, COND, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie einen Custom Container (cl_gui_custom_container) und ein Textfeld (cl_gui_textedit) innerhalb einer ABAP-Klasse. Die Klasse soll die Erstellung und Zerstörung der UI-Elemente kapseln. (Hinweis: Für die tatsächliche Anzeige ist ein Dynpro erforderlich, hier wird nur die Backend-Logik demonstriert).
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE OBJECT für cl_gui_custom_container und cl_gui_textedit. Denken Sie an die Freigabe der Ressourcen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_text_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_ui_elements.
    METHODS set_text IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
    METHODS get_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS destroy_ui_elements.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_textedit  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_text_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_ui_elements.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = mv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dynpro_dynpro_link = 5
        OTHERS         = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        error_cntl_create = 1
        error_cntl_init   = 2
        error_cntl_link   = 3
        error_dp_create   = 4
        OTHERS            = 5.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( text = iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = rv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_ui_elements.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_textedit->free.
      CLEAR mo_textedit.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_ui_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_get_text FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_ui_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_text_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    lo_cut->create_ui_elements( ).
    " In einem echten Dynpro-Kontext würde hier die Anzeige erfolgen.
    " Hier prüfen wir nur, ob die Objekte erfolgreich instanziiert wurden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_textedit ).
    lo_cut->destroy_ui_elements( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_textedit ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_get_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_text_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER_2' ).
    lo_cut->create_ui_elements( ).
    DATA(lv_test_text) = 'Hello, ABAP GUI!'.
    lo_cut->set_text( lv_test_text ).
    DATA(lv_retrieved_text) = lo_cut->get_text( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_retrieved_text exp = lv_test_text ).
    lo_cut->destroy_ui_elements( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kapselung der GUI-Elemente in einer Klasse fördert die Objektorientierung und Wiederverwendbarkeit. Die explizite Freigabe der Ressourcen mit `FREE` ist entscheidend, um Speicherlecks zu vermeiden. Die Verwendung von `CREATE OBJECT` mit Fehlerbehandlung ist Standard für GUI-Programmierung.
keywords: cl_gui_custom_container, UI, Object Orientation, cl_gui_textedit

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle numerischen Werte (ganze Zahlen) aus einem gegebenen String und geben Sie diese als Liste von Zahlen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie reguläre Ausdrücke mit `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und dem Muster `\d+`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_all_numbers IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_all_numbers.
    DATA lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_input_string RESULTS lt_matches.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches
                          LET lv_number_str = iv_input_string+<match>-offset(<match>-length)
                          IN ( CONV i( lv_number_str ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_numbers_simple FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_numbers_mixed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_numbers_none FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_numbers_simple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_numbers( 'abc123def45ghi' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 45 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_numbers_mixed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_numbers( 'Preis: 10.50 EUR, Menge: 20 Stk.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_numbers_none.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_extract_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_all_numbers( 'Keine Zahlen hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit dem `RESULTS` Zusatz und einem `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und moderne Extraktion und Transformation von Daten aus Strings. Reguläre Ausdrücke sind mächtig für komplexe Mustererkennung, und `FOR` mit `VALUE` bietet eine funktionale Art der Listenverarbeitung.
keywords: NUMBER, REGEX, String Processing, FOR, VALUE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Registrierung eines Event-Handlers für ein generisches GUI-Control (z.B. cl_gui_button) innerhalb eines Custom Containers. Die Klasse soll den Event-Handler implementieren und das Event verarbeiten. (Hinweis: Die tatsächliche Auslösung des Events erfordert Benutzerinteraktion auf einem Dynpro).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` und definieren Sie eine Methode mit `FOR EVENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_button.
    METHODS destroy_ui_elements.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_button    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    DATA mv_button_clicked TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_button.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = mv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
        text   = 'Klick mich!'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    " Event wurde ausgelöst
    mv_button_clicked = abap_true.
    " In einem echten Szenario würde hier eine Aktion ausgeführt, z.B. Meldung anzeigen
    " cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box( 'Button wurde geklickt!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_ui_elements.
    IF mo_button IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_button->free.
      CLEAR mo_button.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_event_handler( 'TEST_EVENT_CONTAINER' ).
    lo_cut->create_button( ).

    " Prüfen, ob der Button und Container instanziiert wurden
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_button ).

    " Da Events in Unit-Tests nicht direkt ausgelöst werden können,
    " prüfen wir hier nur die erfolgreiche Registrierung und die Existenz der Objekte.
    " Eine tatsächliche Event-Simulation wäre komplex und außerhalb des Rahmens eines Unit-Tests.
    " Man könnte eine Test-Methode im CUT aufrufen, die das Event simuliert, wenn das CUT dafür vorbereitet ist.

    lo_cut->destroy_ui_elements( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Event-Behandlung in ABAP basiert auf dem Observer-Muster. `SET HANDLER` registriert eine Methode als Event-Handler für ein bestimmtes Event eines Objekts. Die `FOR EVENT` Syntax in der Methodendefinition macht den Code klar und explizit. Dies ist der Standardweg für die Interaktion mit GUI-Controls.
keywords: cl_gui_custom_container, Event Handling, UI, cl_gui_button, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um nur Flüge mit einer maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität (SEATSMAX) größer als 200 zurückzugeben, und speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_large_capacity_flights( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit SEATSMAX > 200 in SFLIGHT.
    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHT einfügen oder mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_error ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle gefilterten Flüge das Kriterium erfüllen
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'SEATSMAX sollte > 200 sein' act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist deutlich lesbarer und performanter als eine manuelle Schleife mit IF-Bedingungen und APPEND-Anweisungen.
keywords: NUMBER, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz von `cl_gui_custom_container` zur Laufzeit, wobei der Name des Containers und der Typ des Controls (z.B. `cl_gui_textedit`) als Parameter übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dem Zusatz `TYPE (lv_class_name)`.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_textedit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_button FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_class_name EXPECTING CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_textedit.

    DATA(lo_textedit_obj) = lo_creator->create_dynamic_container_control( iv_container_name = 'DYN_TEXT_CONT' iv_control_class = 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der maximalen Sitzplätze (SEATSMAX) aller Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS unter Verwendung eines modernen ABAP-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um sowohl die Summe als auch die Anzahl der Einträge zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_seatsmax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_seatsmax RETURNING VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_seatsmax IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_seatsmax.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE sflight_agg(
      INIT sum   = 0
           count = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum   = sum + flight-seatsmax
           count = count + 1
    ).

    rv_average_seats = ls_aggregation-sum / ls_aggregation-count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsstruktur für REDUCE
TYPES: BEGIN OF sflight_agg,
         sum   TYPE i,
         count TYPE i,
       END OF sflight_agg.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seatsmax( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_average_seatsmax( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT. Ein einfacher Test prüft, ob der Wert > 0 ist.
    " Für einen präziseren Test müsste man Testdaten in SFLIGHT einfügen oder mocken.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Durchschnitt sollte nicht 0 sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind' act = lv_result exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    " Dies erfordert das Mocken der SFLIGHT-Tabelle oder eine leere Testtabelle.
    " Für diesen Beispiel-Unit-Test wird angenommen, dass SFLIGHT leer sein könnte.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man Testdaten einfügen oder die DB-Zugriffe mocken.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_seatsmax( ).
    " Temporär die SFLIGHT-Tabelle leeren oder eine Mock-Implementierung verwenden
    " (nicht direkt im Unit-Test-Framework möglich ohne erweiterte Techniken).
    " Hier simulieren wir nur den Fall, dass die Tabelle leer ist.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 msg = 'Durchschnitt sollte 0 sein für leere Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist vielseitig für komplexe Aggregationen. Hier wird er verwendet, um gleichzeitig die Summe und die Anzahl der Elemente zu berechnen, was die Ermittlung des Durchschnitts in einem einzigen, modernen Ausdruck ermöglicht. Dies ist effizienter und lesbarer als separate Schleifen oder Aggregatfunktionen.
keywords: NUMBER, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten maximalen Sitzplatzkapazität (SEATSMAX) in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und geben Sie dessen Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um den Maximalwert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_seats_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_num) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_seats_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE sflight(
      INIT max_seats_flight = VALUE sflight( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE flight-seatsmax > max_seats_flight-seatsmax OR max_seats_flight-seatsmax = 0
      NEXT max_seats_flight = flight
    ).

    rv_flight_num = ls_max_flight-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_seats_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflight FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_seats_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_seats_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_seats( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT. Ein einfacher Test prüft, ob der Wert nicht initial ist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flugnummer sollte nicht initial sein, wenn Daten vorhanden sind' act = lv_result exp = '' level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_level_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_max_seats_flight( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Flugnummer sollte initial sein für leere Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator kann nicht nur für Summen, sondern auch für die Suche nach Maximal- oder Minimalwerten verwendet werden. Durch die Initialisierung mit einem leeren Struktur und einer WHERE-Bedingung, die den aktuellen Eintrag mit dem bisherigen Maximum vergleicht, wird der Flug mit den meisten Sitzplätzen effizient gefunden. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu einer LOOP-Schleife mit einer Hilfsvariable.
keywords: NUMBER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Max Value

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_custom_container` instanziiert und eine Methode bereitstellt, um dessen Größe anzupassen. (Hinweis: Die Größenanpassung wird erst auf dem Dynpro sichtbar).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `set_size` des Containers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resizable_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_container.
    METHODS set_container_size IMPORTING iv_width TYPE i iv_height TYPE i.
    METHODS destroy_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resizable_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = mv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_container_size.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container->set_size( width = iv_width height = iv_height ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_container.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    lo_cut->create_container( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).

    " Die set_size Methode ändert interne Attribute des GUI-Objekts.
    " Eine direkte Überprüfung der Größe ist im Unit-Test ohne Dynpro-Kontext schwierig.
    " Wir prüfen hier nur, dass die Methode ohne Fehler aufgerufen werden kann.
    lo_cut->set_container_size( iv_width = 500 iv_height = 300 ).

    lo_cut->destroy_container( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_cut->mo_container ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer gegebenen nicht-negativen Ganzzahl unter Verwendung einer rekursiven Methode und modernen ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine rekursive Methode und den COND-Operator für die Basisfallprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING text = 'Fakultät ist nur für nicht-negative Zahlen definiert.'.
    ENDIF.

    rv_factorial = COND i(
      WHEN iv_number = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE iv_number * calculate_factorial( iv_number - 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factorial_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_one FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factorial_negative EXPECTING CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factorial_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 0 ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_one.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_factorial( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 1 ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factorial_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_factorial( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_factorial( 7 ) exp = 5040 ).

Die Verwendung des `COND`-Operators für die Basisfallprüfung (iv_number = 0) macht die Methode sehr kompakt und lesbar. Dies demonstriert die Fähigkeit von modernem ABAP, rekursive Algorithmen elegant auszudrücken.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse, die dynamisch verschiedene Typen von GUI-Controls (z.B. `cl_gui_textedit`, `cl_gui_button`) innerhalb eines `cl_gui_custom_container` erzeugen kann, basierend auf einem übergebenen Typ-Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischem Typ und eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle oder Basisklasse für die Controls.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_gui_control.
  METHODS get_control_object RETURNING VALUE(ro_control) TYPE REF TO object.
  METHODS free_control.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_gui_control_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_control
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        iv_control_type   TYPE string " z.B. 'TEXTEDIT', 'BUTTON'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_control_wrapper) TYPE REF TO zif_gui_control
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-METHODS get_control_class_name IMPORTING iv_control_type TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_class_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_control_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_control.
    DATA lv_class_name TYPE string.
    lv_class_name = get_control_class_name( iv_control_type ).

    DATA lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error. ENDIF.

    DATA lo_control TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_control TYPE (lv_class_name)
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error. ENDIF.

    " Wrapper-Klasse, die zif_gui_control implementiert
    CLASS lcl_control_wrapper DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_gui_control.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_control TYPE REF TO object.
      PRIVATE SECTION:
        DATA mo_control TYPE REF TO object.
    ENDDEFINITION.

    CLASS lcl_control_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mo_control = io_control.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD zif_gui_control~get_control_object.
        ro_control = mo_control.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD zif_gui_control~free_control.
        IF mo_control IS BOUND.
          CALL METHOD mo_control->('FREE'). " Dynamischer Aufruf der FREE-Methode
          CLEAR mo_control.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDIMPLEMENTATION.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_control_wrapper TYPE lcl_control_wrapper EXPORTING io_control = lo_control.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_control_class_name.
    CASE iv_control_type.
      WHEN 'TEXTEDIT'.
        rv_class_name = 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT'.
      WHEN 'BUTTON'.
        rv_class_name = 'CL_GUI_BUTTON'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error EXPORTING text = 'Unbekannter Control-Typ'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_textedit FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_button FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_control_type EXPECTING CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_textedit.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_gui_control_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_wrapper) = lo_factory->create_control( iv_container_name = 'FACTORY_TEXT_CONT' iv_control_type = 'TEXTEDIT' ).
    DATA(lo_control) = lo_wrapper->get_control_object( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_control ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_control IS INSTANCE OF cl_gui_textedit ).
    lo_wrapper->free_control( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_control ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_button.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_gui_control_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_wrapper) = lo_factory->create_control( iv_container_name = 'FACTORY_BUTTON_CONT' iv_control_type = 'BUTTON' ).
    DATA(lo_control) = lo_wrapper->get_control_object( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_control ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_control IS INSTANCE OF cl_gui_button ).
    lo_wrapper->free_control( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_bound( lo_control ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_control_type.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_gui_control_factory( ).
    lo_factory->create_control( iv_container_name = 'FACTORY_INVALID_CONT' iv_control_type = 'UNKNOWN_TYPE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Muster in ABAP, kombiniert mit dynamischer Objekterzeugung und einer lokalen Wrapper-Klasse, die eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementiert. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und erweiterbare Erzeugung von GUI-Controls, ohne dass der Client-Code die konkreten Control-Klassen kennen muss. Die dynamische Methode `CALL METHOD mo_control->('FREE')` ist notwendig, da die `FREE`-Methode nicht in `REF TO object` definiert ist.
keywords: cl_gui_custom_container, Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Dynamic Programming, UI, Interface

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen CSV-String mit Komma als Trennzeichen in eine interne Tabelle. Die erste Zeile enthält die Kopfzeilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `parse_csv_string`. Achten Sie auf die Parameter für Trennzeichen und Kopfzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_simple_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_simple_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_delimiter  = ','
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lt_string_table) = lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).

    LOOP AT lt_string_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
      IF sy-tabix = 1 AND lo_csv_parser->i_has_header = abap_true. " Skip header row if present
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data(
        col1 = <fs_row>[ 1 ]
        col2 = <fs_row>[ 2 ]

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit numerischen Werten und berechnen Sie die Summe einer Spalte mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Parsen Sie zuerst die Daten in eine interne Tabelle, konvertieren Sie die numerische Spalte und verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             item TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum_from_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_from_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_delimiter  = ','
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lt_string_table) = lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).

    DATA(lt_parsed_values) = VALUE tt_values(
      FOR row IN lt_string_table WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL AND sy-tabix > 1 ) " Skip header
      ( item   = row[ 1 ]
        amount = CONV decfloat16( row[ 2 ] ) )
    ).

    rv_total_amount = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR wa IN lt_parsed_values
      NEXT sum = sum + wa-amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 iv_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 iv_value = 'Price' ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lv_row) = sy-tabix + 1.
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 iv_value = <fs_flight>-carrid ).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 iv_value = <fs_flight>-connid ).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 iv_value = <fs_flight>-fldate ).
      lo_sheet_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 iv_value = <fs_flight>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: Summary
    DATA(lo_sheet_summary) = lo_spreadsheet->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Summary' ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR wa IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + wa-price
    ).

    lo_sheet_summary->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 iv_value = 'Total Flights' ).
    lo_sheet_summary->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 iv_value = lv_total_flights ).
    lo_sheet_summary->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 iv_value = 'Total Price' ).
    lo_sheet_summary->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 iv_value = lv_total_price ).

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_spreadsheet_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(

        " Log or handle the exception
        cl_demo_output=>display( |CSV parsing failed: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei, deren Spaltenüberschriften und Daten dynamisch aus einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit generiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) um die Feldnamen und -werte der internen Tabelle dynamisch zu ermitteln und in das Excel zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_exporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_table_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_dynamic_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_table_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Dynamic Data' ).

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_excel_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_spreadsheet_xstring( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_data_ref) = REF #( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_data_ref ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Write header row dynamically
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx iv_value = <fs_component>-name ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data rows dynamically
    DATA(lv_row_idx) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_component>.
        DATA(lv_value) = |{ <fs_row>-(<fs_component>-name) }|.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = lv_col_idx iv_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_spreadsheet_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_test_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Entry One' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_excel_dynamic_exporter( ).
    DATA(lv_excel_xstring) = lo_cut->export_dynamic_table_to_excel( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_excel_xstring IS NOT INITIAL ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Generierung einer Excel-Datei aus einer beliebigen internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Mithilfe von RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) werden die Strukturkomponenten (Feldnamen) der Tabelle ermittelt, um dynamisch Kopfzeilen zu erstellen. Anschließend werden die Daten zeilen- und spaltenweise in das Excel geschrieben. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario, das die Flexibilität von ABAP und `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` zeigt.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine geparste CSV-Tabelle nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. alle Zeilen, bei denen eine Spalte einen bestimmten Wert hat) unter Verwendung der `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Parsen Sie die CSV-Daten und wenden Sie dann die `FILTER`-Expression auf die resultierende interne Tabelle an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_csv_by_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_csv_by_value.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      i_delimiter  = ','
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lt_string_table) = lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string( iv_csv_string ).

    DATA(lt_all_items) = VALUE tt_items(
      FOR row IN lt_string_table WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL AND sy-tabix > 1 ) " Skip header
      ( id    = row[ 1 ]
        name  = row[ 2 ]
        value = row[ 3 ] )
    ).

    rt_filtered_items = FILTER tt_items FROM lt_all_items
      WHERE value = iv_filter_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_csv_by_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_csv_by_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_input) = `ID,Name,Value\n1,Item A,X\n2,Item B,Y\n3,Item C,X`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_csv_by_value( iv_csv_string = lv_csv_input iv_filter_value = 'X' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Item C' ).

    DATA(lt_result_y) = lo_cut->filter_csv_by_value( iv_csv_string = lv_csv_input iv_filter_value = 'Y' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_y ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_y[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung der `FILTER`-Expression, um Daten aus einer mit `cl_icf_csv` geparsten internen Tabelle zu selektieren. Nach dem Parsen und der Initialisierung einer typisierten Tabelle wird `FILTER` verwendet, um deklarativ alle Zeilen zu extrahieren, die einem bestimmten Kriterium entsprechen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und performante Art, interne Tabellen zu manipulieren.
keywords: CSV, cl_icf_csv, FILTER, Internal Tables, Data Selection, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei, die Daten aus einer Liste von Objekten (z.B. Instanzen einer Klasse) exportiert, wobei die Eigenschaften der Objekte dynamisch als Spalten in Excel abgebildet werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_objectdescr`) mit `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`, um die Attribute der Objekte zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und zu exportieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_object_exporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_objects_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_object_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_objects_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_spreadsheet) = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_spreadsheet->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = 'Object Data' ).

    IF it_objects IS INITIAL.
      rv_excel_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_spreadsheet_xstring( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_first_object_ref) = REF #( it_objects[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_first_object_ref ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_object_descr->get_relative_type_descr( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Write header row dynamically from object attributes
    DATA(lv_col_idx) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>).
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = lv_col_idx iv_value = <fs_component>-name ).
      lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Write data rows dynamically from object attributes
    DATA(lv_row_idx) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_objects ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_object>).
      lv_col_idx = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_component>.
        DATA(lv_value) = |{ <fs_object>-(<fs_component>-name) }|.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = lv_col_idx iv_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col_idx = lv_col_idx + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row_idx = lv_row_idx + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_excel_xstring = lo_spreadsheet->get_spreadsheet_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine interne Tabelle mit Vor- und Nachnamen. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die zusätzlich eine Spalte für den vollständigen Namen enthält, der aus Vor- und Nachnamen gebildet wird. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator und String-Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `VALUE #(...)` Operator mit String-Templates für die Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_value_str_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person_in,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_person_in,
           tt_person_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person_out,
             first_name  TYPE string,
             last_name   TYPE string,
             full_name   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_person_out,
           tt_person_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_full_name_table
      IMPORTING
        it_persons_in TYPE tt_person_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_persons_out) TYPE tt_person_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_value_str_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_full_name_table.
    rt_persons_out = VALUE #( FOR ls_person IN it_persons_in
                               ( first_name = ls_person-first_name,
                                 last_name  = ls_person-last_name,
                                 full_name  = |{ ls_person-first_name } { ls_person-last_name }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_full_name_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_value_str_temp( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_value_str_temp=>tt_person_in(
      ( first_name = 'Anna' last_name = 'Schmidt' )
      ( first_name = 'Peter' last_name = 'Meier' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_full_name_table( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-full_name exp = 'Peter Meier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` Schleifen und String-Templates ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen mit `CONCATENATE`.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE operator, FOR, String Templates, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Liste von Wörtern. Verbinden Sie diese Wörter zu einem einzigen Satz, getrennt durch Leerzeichen, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Liste der Wörter iterativ zu einem String zu reduzieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine Liste von `cl_appointment`-Objekten. Gruppieren Sie diese Termine nach ihrem Startdatum und geben Sie für jedes Datum die Anzahl der Termine aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_group,
             appointment_date TYPE d,
             count            TYPE i,
           END OF ty_date_group,
           tt_date_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_date_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_date_groups) TYPE tt_date_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_group_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_by_date.
    LOOP AT it_appointments INTO DATA(lo_appointment) GROUP BY lo_appointment->get_date() INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(lo_grouped_appointment).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE ty_date_group( appointment_date = ls_group_key-appointment_date
                                  count            = lv_count ) TO rt_date_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_group_by_date( ).

    DATA(lo_app2) = NEW cl_appointment( i_date = '20251201' i_description = 'App 2' ).
    DATA(lo_app3) = NEW cl_appointment( i_date = '20251205' i_description = 'App 3' ).

    DATA(lt_all_apps) = VALUE zcl_app_group_by_date=>tt_appointments(
      ( lo_app1 ) ( lo_app2 ) ( lo_app3 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped_apps) = lo_cut->group_appointments_by_date( lt_all_apps ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped_apps ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_apps[ 1 ]-appointment_date exp = '20251201' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_apps[ 1 ]-count exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_grouped_apps[ 2 ]-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die prüft, ob ein gegebenes `cl_appointment`-Objekt in der Zukunft liegt. Nutzen Sie moderne Datum/Zeit-Vergleiche.
hint: Vergleichen Sie das Termindatum und die Uhrzeit mit `sy-datum` und `sy-uzeit`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_is_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_appointment_in_future
      IMPORTING
        io_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_is_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_appointment_in_future.
    IF io_appointment IS NOT BOUND.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_app_date) = io_appointment->get_date( ).
    DATA(lv_app_time) = io_appointment->get_time( ).

    IF lv_app_date > sy-datum.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSEIF lv_app_date = sy-datum AND lv_app_time > sy-uzeit.
      rv_is_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_group_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO cl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_date_to_appointments_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_appointments WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line->get_date() AS date_key.

    METHODS group_appointments_to_map
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_map) TYPE ty_date_to_appointments_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_group_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_appointments_to_map.
    rt_map = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_appointments GROUP BY ( date_key = ls_group->get_date() ) ASCENDING
                      ( date_key = ls_group-date_key
                        VALUE #( FOR ls_app IN GROUP ls_group ( ls_app ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der eine Liste von Elementen enthält, die durch Kommas getrennt sind. Die Liste soll dynamisch aus einer internen Tabelle generiert werden, wobei leere Elemente übersprungen werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_skip_empty DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_comma_separated_list
      IMPORTING
        it_elements TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_skip_empty IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_comma_separated_list.
    rv_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR element IN it_elements
      WHERE element IS NOT INITIAL
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN element ELSE |{ s }, { element }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_comma_separated_list( lt_elements ).

Dies ist ideal, um leere Strings zu überspringen und eine saubere, kommagetrennte Liste zu erstellen, ohne zusätzliche `IF`-Anweisungen oder manuelle Schleifen. CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE s_price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE lt_scarr ORDER BY carrid. " Order for consistent test results

    rv_carrier_list = REDUCE string( 
      INIT result = VALUE string( )
      FOR carrier IN lt_scarr

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Geben Sie die Flugnummer (CONNID) zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(ls_max_flight) = REDUCE sflight( 
      INIT max_flight TYPE sflight
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_flight-price THEN flight ELSE max_flight )
    ).
    rv_connid = ls_max_flight-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_price( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_connid) = ''.

    SELECT connid FROM sflight INTO lv_expected_connid
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
    ENDSELECT.

    DATA(lv_actual_connid) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_price( lv_carrid ).

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Hash-Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Hash-Tabelle als initialem Wert und aktualisieren Sie die Zähler in der Schleife mit `SWITCH` und `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_flight_count_h_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_h_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_flight_count_h_tab( 
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_flight_count_h_tab( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT
        counts = SWITCH ty_flight_count_h_tab(
          counts
          WHEN counts[ carrid = flight-carrid ] THEN
            VALUE #( BASE counts ( carrid = flight-carrid count = counts[ carrid = flight-carrid ]-count + 1 ) )
          ELSE
            VALUE #( BASE counts ( carrid = flight-carrid count = 1 ) )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    DATA: lt_expected_counts TYPE zcl_reduce_group_count=>ty_flight_count_h_tab.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sflight GROUP BY carrid INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_counts).
    LOOP AT lt_db_counts INTO DATA(ls_db_count).
      INSERT VALUE #( carrid = ls_db_count-carrid count = ls_db_count-count ) INTO TABLE lt_expected_counts.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_counts ) exp = lines( lt_expected_counts ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_counts INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      DATA(ls_actual) = lt_actual_counts[ carrid = ls_expected-carrid ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-count exp = ls_expected-count ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` mit `SWITCH` und `BASE`, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu aggregieren. Es zählt die Vorkommen jedes `carrid` und aktualisiert die Hash-Tabelle effizient.
keywords: REDUCE, SWITCH, BASE, Internal Tables, Grouping, Hash Table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft den `carrid` und die Anzahl der Flüge enthält, die teurer als 500 sind (aus SFLIGHT).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle als initialem Wert und `FOR GROUPS OF` in der Schleife, um zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_expensive_flights,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             expensive_flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_expensive_flights.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_expensive_flights_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_expensive_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_carrier_expensive_flights_t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_result = REDUCE ty_carrier_expensive_flights_t( 
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrier_expensive_flights_t( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY flight-carrid
      (
        APPEND VALUE #( 
          carrid = flight-carrid
          expensive_flight_count = REDUCE i(
            INIT count = 0
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            WHERE ( price > 500 )
            NEXT count = count + 1
          )
        ) TO result
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_complex_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flight_counts( ).

    DATA: lt_expected_result TYPE zcl_reduce_complex_transform=>ty_carrier_expensive_flights_t.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    SORT lt_sflight BY carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_group_member) WHERE price > 500.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid expensive_flight_count = lv_count ) TO lt_expected_result.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_actual_result BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected_result BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected_result ) ).
    DO lines( lt_actual_result ) TIMES.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_result[ sy-index ]-carrid exp = lt_expected_result[ sy-index ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_result[ sy-index ]-expensive_flight_count exp = lt_expected_result[ sy-index ]-expensive_flight_count ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Verwendung von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF`, um Daten zu gruppieren und innerhalb jeder Gruppe weitere Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist sehr mächtig für komplexe Datentransformationen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Aggregation

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) um 10%.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` um die Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_modify_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS increase_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      CHANGING
        ct_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_modify_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.1'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_modify_table( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_sflight_before) = lt_sflight. " Copy for comparison

    lo_cut->increase_flight_prices(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_sflight = lt_sflight
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_before INTO DATA(ls_flight_before).
      DATA(ls_flight_after) = lt_sflight[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight_before-carrid connid = ls_flight_before-connid fldate = ls_flight_before-fldate ].
      IF ls_flight_before-carrid = lv_carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight_after-price
          exp = ls_flight_before-price * '1.1'
          msg = |Price for { ls_flight_before-carrid } { ls_flight_before-connid } not increased correctly.|
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight_after-price
          exp = ls_flight_before-price
          msg = |Price for { ls_flight_before-carrid } { ls_flight_before-connid } should not have changed.|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` (`<fs_flight>`) in einer `LOOP AT`-Anweisung ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung der Zeilen einer internen Tabelle, ohne dass eine explizite `MODIFY`-Anweisung erforderlich ist. Dies ist sehr effizient.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation, LOOP AT

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine spezifische Flugverbindung aus einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) und geben Sie den Preis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effizienten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate  TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE it_sflight ASSIGNING <fs_flight>
      WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
               connid = iv_connid
               fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = <fs_flight>-price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_read_table( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS. " Get some test data

    IF lines( lt_sflight ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_test_flight) = lt_sflight[ 1 ].
      DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price(
                                 it_sflight = lt_sflight
                                 iv_carrid  = ls_test_flight-carrid
                                 iv_connid  = ls_test_flight-connid
                                 iv_fldate  = ls_test_flight-fldate
                               ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = ls_test_flight-price ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No test data available in sflight.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test for non-existent flight
    DATA(lv_non_existent_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price(
                                     it_sflight = lt_sflight
                                     iv_carrid  = 'XX'
                                     iv_connid  = '0000'
                                     iv_fldate  = sy-datum
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_non_existent_price exp = 0 ). " Default initial value
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist die performanteste Methode, um eine einzelne Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle zu lesen, da keine Daten kopiert werden. Das Feldsymbol zeigt direkt auf die Zeile im Speicher.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und geben Sie dessen Wert als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE sflight
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_dynamic_access( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_actual_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic(
                                 is_data    = ls_sflight
                                 iv_fieldname = 'CARRID'
                               ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_value exp = ls_sflight-carrid ).

      DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic(
                                 is_data    = ls_sflight
                                 iv_fieldname = 'PRICE'
                               ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = |{ ls_sflight-price }| ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'No test data available in sflight.' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Test for non-existent field
    DATA(lv_non_existent_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic(
                                     is_data    = ls_sflight
                                     iv_fieldname = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_non_existent_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine geschachtelte Struktur, z.B. eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die jeweils eine interne Tabelle von Flügen enthalten. Erhöhen Sie den Preis jedes Fluges um 5%.
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_nested_loops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_flights_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flights TYPE ty_flights_t,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_flights_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_nested_flight_prices
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_flights TYPE ty_carrier_flights_t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_nested_loops IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_nested_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_carrier_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier>).
      LOOP AT <fs_carrier>-flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.05'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nested_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_nested_loops( ).
    DATA: lt_carrier_flights TYPE zcl_fs_nested_loops=>ty_carrier_flights_t.

    " Populate test data
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflight BY carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_carrier_entry) = VALUE zcl_fs_nested_loops=>ty_carrier_flights( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        APPEND VALUE #( connid = ls_group_flight-connid fldate = ls_group_flight-fldate price = ls_group_flight-price ) TO ls_carrier_entry-flights.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_carrier_entry TO lt_carrier_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_carrier_flights_before) = lt_carrier_flights. " Copy for comparison

    lo_cut->increase_nested_flight_prices(
      CHANGING
        ct_carrier_flights = lt_carrier_flights
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrier_flights_before ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier_before>).
      DATA(ls_carrier_after) = lt_carrier_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = <fs_carrier_before>-carrid ].
      LOOP AT <fs_carrier_before>-flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_before>).
        DATA(ls_flight_after) = ls_carrier_after-flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS connid = <fs_flight_before>-connid fldate = <fs_flight_before>-fldate ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight_after-price
          exp = <fs_flight_before>-price * '1.05'
          msg = |Price for { <fs_carrier_before>-carrid } { <fs_flight_before>-connid } not increased correctly.|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Geschachtelte `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Anweisungen sind die effizienteste Methode, um geschachtelte interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Inhalte direkt zu modifizieren, ohne unnötige Datenkopien.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Nested Loops, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' aus SFLIGHT enthält und nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `price` hat.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES: ty_filtered_flights_t TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_filtered_flights_t.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_lh_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE ty_filtered_flights_t( 
      INIT result = VALUE ty_filtered_flights_t( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid price = flight-price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_lh_flights( ).

    DATA: lt_expected_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_filter_transform=>ty_filtered_flights_t.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid price = ls_sflight-price ) TO lt_expected_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT lt_actual_flights BY carrid connid.
    SORT lt_expected_flights BY carrid connid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_flights ) exp = lines( lt_expected_flights ) ).
    DO lines( lt_actual_flights ) TIMES.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_flights[ sy-index ]-carrid exp = lt_expected_flights[ sy-index ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_flights[ sy-index ]-connid exp = lt_expected_flights[ sy-index ]-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual_flights[ sy-index ]-price exp = lt_expected_flights[ sy-index ]-price ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Filterung und Transformation in einem einzigen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck. Es filtert die Flüge nach `carrid` und erstellt gleichzeitig eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer reduzierten Menge an Feldern.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs akzeptiert und den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes in jeder Zeile um einen Faktor erhöht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` vom Typ `ANY TABLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff. Prüfen Sie auf numerische Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_table_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS multiply_field_in_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_fieldname TYPE fieldname
        iv_factor    TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE. " Generic table type
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_table_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_field_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: ct_any_table is not a table
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Check if field is numeric before multiplication
        IF <fs_field> IS SUPPLIED AND <fs_field> IS NUMERIC.
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> * iv_factor.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_multiply FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_multiply.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_generic_table_proc( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_sflight_before) = lt_sflight. " Copy for comparison

    lo_cut->multiply_field_in_table(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fieldname = 'PRICE'
        iv_factor    = '1.2'
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table = lt_sflight
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_before INTO DATA(ls_flight_before).
      DATA(ls_flight_after) = lt_sflight[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight_before-carrid connid = ls_flight_before-connid fldate = ls_flight_before-fldate ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_after-price
        exp = ls_flight_before-price * '1.2'
        msg = |Price for { ls_flight_before-carrid } { ls_flight_before-connid } not multiplied correctly.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a different field (e.g., SEATSMAX)
    DATA(lt_sflight_seats) = lt_sflight_before. " Reset for new test
    lo_cut->multiply_field_in_table(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fieldname = 'SEATSMAX'
        iv_factor    = '0.9'
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table = lt_sflight_seats
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_before INTO DATA(ls_flight_before_seats).
      DATA(ls_flight_after_seats) = lt_sflight_seats[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight_before_seats-carrid connid = ls_flight_before_seats-connid fldate = ls_flight_before_seats-fldate ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_after_seats-seatsmax
        exp = ls_flight_before_seats-seatsmax * '0.9'
        msg = |Seatsmax for { ls_flight_before_seats-carrid } { ls_flight_before_seats-connid } not multiplied correctly.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with non-numeric field (should not change)
    DATA(lt_sflight_carrid) = lt_sflight_before.
    lo_cut->multiply_field_in_table(
      EXPORTING
        iv_fieldname = 'CARRID'
        iv_factor    = '1.5'
      CHANGING
        ct_any_table = lt_sflight_carrid
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_before INTO DATA(ls_flight_before_carrid).
      DATA(ls_flight_after_carrid) = lt_sflight_carrid[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight_before_carrid-carrid connid = ls_flight_before_carrid-connid fldate = ls_flight_before_carrid-fldate ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_after_carrid-carrid
        exp = ls_flight_before_carrid-carrid
        msg = |Carrid for { ls_flight_before_carrid-carrid } { ls_flight_before_carrid-connid } should not have changed.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit von `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in Kombination mit `TYPE ANY TABLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Entwicklung generischer Routinen, die mit beliebigen Tabellentypen und Feldern arbeiten können. Die Prüfung `IS NUMERIC` stellt sicher, dass nur numerische Felder multipliziert werden.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Generic, ANY TABLE, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen und schließen Sie den Cursor anschließend. Geben Sie die gelesenen Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
