  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_n_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_n_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5
      msg = 'Should return exactly 5 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Returned flights should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die explizite Cursor-Verarbeitung mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` ermöglicht eine feingranulare Kontrolle über die Datenbeschaffung, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor über einen Commit/Rollback hinweg offen, was hier aber durch das explizite `CLOSE CURSOR` überschrieben wird. Die moderne Syntax mit `DATA(...)` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` vereinfacht die Deklaration und Zuweisung.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHTS, Database Operations

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Cursor für `SFLIGHTS` öffnet, Daten in Paketen von 100 Zeilen liest und den Cursor nach Abschluss oder bei einem Fehler schließt. Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY` für die robuste Fehlerbehandlung und Ressourcenfreigabe.
hint: `FETCH NEXT CURSOR PACKAGE SIZE` und `FINALLY` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_package_robust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_package_robust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
            FROM sflights.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
          CLEAR lt_package.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING previous = lx_sql_error.
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_in_packages FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_package_robust( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_packages( 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Should return flights' ).
    " Verify that the number of flights is reasonable (e.g., more than 0)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Should have read more than 0 flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FETCH NEXT CURSOR PACKAGE SIZE` für die paketweise Verarbeitung und einem `TRY...CATCH...FINALLY`-Block ist entscheidend für robuste Datenbankoperationen. Der `FINALLY`-Block garantiert, dass der Cursor auch im Fehlerfall geschlossen wird, was Ressourcenlecks verhindert. Die Verwendung von `RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_error` signalisiert mögliche Datenbankfehler.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Cursor öffnet, einige Daten liest und dann sicherstellt, dass der Cursor geschlossen wird, selbst wenn die Methode vorzeitig beendet wird (z.B. durch eine Exception).
hint: Der `FINALLY`-Block ist der Schlüssel zur sicheren Ressourcenfreigabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_safe_close DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_close_cursor
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_safe_close IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_close_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflights.

        DO iv_max_entries TIMES.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
        ENDDO.

        " Simulate an error after some processing
        IF iv_max_entries > 1 AND lines( rt_flights ) > 1.
          " This will cause a dump if not handled, but FINALLY will still execute
          " RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_message.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_root.
        " Handle any exception, but FINALLY is guaranteed to run
      FINALLY.
        IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
          CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_safe_close_normal FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_safe_close_with_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_close_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_safe_close( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_and_close_cursor( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2
      msg = 'Should return 2 flights normally' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_safe_close_with_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_safe_close( ).
    " To test the FINALLY block, we would need to simulate an exception
    " that occurs *after* the cursor is opened but *before* it's closed.
    " For simplicity in unit tests, we just ensure the method runs without dump.
    " The FINALLY block ensures CLOSE CURSOR is called.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->process_and_close_cursor( 1000000 ). " Large number to potentially trigger issues
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 )
          msg = 'Should return some flights even with potential issues' ).
    CATCH cx_root.
        " Expected if an exception is uncommented in the solution
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true
          msg = 'Exception caught, FINALLY block should still execute' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung des `FINALLY`-Blocks in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Konstrukt ist die empfohlene moderne ABAP-Praxis, um sicherzustellen, dass Ressourcen wie Datenbank-Cursor immer freigegeben werden, unabhängig davon, ob die Verarbeitung erfolgreich war oder eine Ausnahme aufgetreten ist. Dies verhindert Ressourcenlecks und erhöht die Stabilität der Anwendung.
keywords: CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, FINALLY, TRY CATCH, Resource Management, Exception Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen Cursor für `SFLIGHTS` öffnet und eine Methode `get_next_flight` bereitstellt, die jeweils eine Zeile zurückgibt. Der Cursor soll automatisch geschlossen werden, wenn alle Zeilen gelesen wurden oder das Objekt zerstört wird (Destruktor).
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` im Konstruktor, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Methode und `CLOSE CURSOR` im Destruktor (`FINAL METHODS FREE`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_oo_managed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_next_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    FINAL METHODS free.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_cursor TYPE cursor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_oo_managed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    OPEN CURSOR mv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_flight.
    IF mv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR mv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF rs_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CLEAR rs_flight.
        CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
        CLEAR mv_cursor.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free.
    IF mv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL.
      CLOSE CURSOR mv_cursor.
      CLEAR mv_cursor.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_oo_cursor_management FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_oo_cursor_management.
    DATA(lo_flight_reader) = NEW zcl_cursor_oo_managed( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_flight_reader->get_next_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid
      msg = 'First flight should be read' ).

    " Read a few more to ensure cursor is still open
    DO 3 TIMES.
      ls_flight = lo_flight_reader->get_next_flight( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid
        msg = 'Subsequent flights should be read' ).
    ENDDO.

    " Let the object go out of scope to trigger destructor (and CLOSE CURSOR)
    CLEAR lo_flight_reader.
    " No direct way to assert cursor is closed, but destructor ensures it.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = abap_true
      msg = 'Destructor (and CLOSE CURSOR) should be called when object is cleared' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert objektorientiertes Ressourcenmanagement. Der Cursor wird im Konstruktor geöffnet und im Destruktor (`FINAL METHODS FREE`) geschlossen. Dies stellt sicher, dass der Cursor freigegeben wird, sobald das Objekt nicht mehr referenziert wird, was eine saubere Kapselung und automatische Ressourcenbereinigung ermöglicht. Die Methode `get_next_flight` bietet eine iterator-ähnliche Funktionalität.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, Destructor, Object Orientation, SFLIGHTS, Resource Management

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Arten von Exceptions abfängt, einschließlich einer generischen `OTHERS`-Klausel.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_param1 TYPE i
        iv_param2 TYPE i
        iv_operation TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_multi_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        CASE iv_operation.
          WHEN 'DIVIDE'.
            rv_result = iv_param1 / iv_param2.
          WHEN 'ADD'.
            rv_result = iv_param1 + iv_param2.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_meth_not_exist. " Simulate another exception
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        MESSAGE lx_zero->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_result = -1. " Indicate error
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        MESSAGE lx_arith->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_result = -2.
      CATCH OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_other).
        MESSAGE lx_other->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_result = -99.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks, um Ressourcen freizugeben, auch wenn eine Exception auftritt.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Exception im `TRY`-Block auftritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_resource_open) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        " Simulate an error based on input
        IF iv_input = 'ERROR'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error.
        ENDIF.
        " Simulate successful processing
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CLEANUP.
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          " e.g., CLOSE DATASET, FREE OBJECT, etc.
          cl_demo_output=>display( 'Resource was cleaned up.' ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_write_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS write_sflight_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_filepath) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_write_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_sflight_to_excel.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_xlsx_document( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx->create_worksheet( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    " Write header
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 4 ip_value = 'Price' ).

    " Write data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 1 ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 2 ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 3 ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = 4 ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_temp_dir) = cl_abap_tmp_dir=>get_instance( )->get_path( ).
    rv_filepath = lv_temp_dir && '/' && iv_filename.
    lo_xlsx->save_document( rv_filepath ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_get_text IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Generieren Sie die ersten N Zahlen der Fibonacci-Sequenz (bis zu einem Maximalwert von 1000) und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife, die abbricht, sobald der Maximalwert überschritten wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_sequence IMPORTING iv_max_value TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_fibonacci) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_sequence.
    DATA: lv_a TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_b TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_next TYPE i.

    APPEND lv_a TO rt_fibonacci.
    APPEND lv_b TO rt_fibonacci.

    WHILE lv_next <= iv_max_value.
      lv_next = lv_a + lv_b.
      IF lv_next > iv_max_value.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_fibonacci.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Warteschlange (Queue) für Strings. Fügen Sie Elemente hinzu und verarbeiten Sie diese der Reihe nach, bis die Warteschlange leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und `DELETE TABLE itab INDEX 1` zum Entfernen des ersten Elements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_queue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_item IMPORTING iv_item TYPE string.
    METHODS process_queue RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_queue TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_queue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_item.
    APPEND iv_item TO mt_queue.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA: lv_item TYPE string.

    WHILE mt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE mt_queue INDEX 1 INTO lv_item.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_items.
        DELETE TABLE mt_queue INDEX 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if mt_queue is not initial
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                            RETURNING VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_string_tokenizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD tokenize_string.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_found_pos TYPE i,
          lv_length TYPE i.

    lv_length = strlen( iv_input ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_length.
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_delimiter IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF iv_input MATCH OFFSET lv_found_pos.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND iv_input+lv_offset(lv_found_pos - lv_offset) TO rt_tokens.
        lv_offset = lv_found_pos + strlen( iv_delimiter ).
      ELSE.
        APPEND iv_input+lv_offset TO rt_tokens.
        lv_offset = lv_length. " End of string
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    " Handle empty string case or trailing delimiter
    IF lv_length = 0 OR ( lv_offset > 0 AND iv_input+lv_length-1(1) = iv_delimiter ).
      APPEND '' TO rt_tokens.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_error_hndl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_data_safe RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                 RAISING   cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_error_hndl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data_safe.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error opening cursor for SFLIGHT'.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE sy-subrc = 0.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
      ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 4. " sy-subrc = 4 means no more data, which is not an error
        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Error fetching data from SFLIGHT'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung einer einfach verketteten Liste, die in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert ist, bis ein bestimmtes Endelement erreicht ist oder kein Nachfolger gefunden wird.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_list_item,
         id      TYPE i,
         next_id TYPE i,
         value   TYPE string,
       END OF ty_list_item.
TYPES: tt_list_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_list_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_linked_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list IMPORTING it_list_data TYPE tt_list_items
                         IMPORTING iv_start_id TYPE i
                         IMPORTING iv_end_id TYPE i OPTIONAL
                         RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_linked_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_list.
    DATA: lv_current_id TYPE i VALUE iv_start_id,
          ls_current_item TYPE ty_list_item.

    WHILE lv_current_id IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE it_list_data INTO ls_current_item WITH KEY id = lv_current_id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_current_item-value TO rt_processed_values.
        IF ls_current_item-id = iv_end_id.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_id = ls_current_item-next_id.
      ELSE.
        " No next item found, break loop
        CLEAR lv_current_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Aufgaben in einer internen Tabelle. Brechen Sie die Verarbeitung ab, sobald eine Aufgabe mit dem Status 'ERROR' gefunden wird.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
         id     TYPE i,
         status TYPE string,
         description TYPE string,
       END OF ty_task.
TYPES: tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_task_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_tasks IMPORTING it_tasks TYPE tt_tasks
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_task_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_tasks.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i VALUE 1,
          ls_task TYPE ty_task.

    WHILE lv_index <= lines( it_tasks ).
      READ TABLE it_tasks INDEX lv_index INTO ls_task.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF ls_task-status = 'ERROR'.
          " Stop processing if an error task is found
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND ls_task TO rt_processed_tasks.
        lv_index = lv_index + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if lv_index is within bounds
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen und addieren Sie diese, bis die Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Geben Sie die erreichte Summe und die Anzahl der addierten Elemente zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE` Schleife und `LINE_EXISTS` oder `TABLE_LINE` um auf Elemente zuzugreifen und die Schleife zu steuern.
solution:
TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sum_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_until_threshold IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
                                        IMPORTING iv_threshold TYPE i
                                        EXPORTING ev_sum TYPE i
                                        EXPORTING ev_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_until_threshold.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_current_number TYPE i.

    ev_sum = 0.
    ev_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_sum <= iv_threshold AND lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      lv_current_number = it_numbers[ lv_index ]. " Modern table expression
      ev_sum = ev_sum + lv_current_number.
      ev_count = ev_count + 1.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " If the loop exited because sum exceeded threshold, subtract the last added number
    IF ev_sum > iv_threshold AND ev_count > 0.
      ev_sum = ev_sum - it_numbers[ lv_index - 1 ].
      ev_count = ev_count - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS aggregate_flight_seats IMPORTING iv_max_flights TYPE i
                                   EXPORTING ev_total_seats TYPE i
                                   EXPORTING ev_flights_processed TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ev_total_seats = 0.
    ev_flights_processed = 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT * FROM sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      WHILE sy-subrc = 0 AND ev_flights_processed < iv_max_flights.
        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_total_seats = ev_total_seats + ls_sflight-seatsocc.
          ev_flights_processed = ev_flights_processed + 1.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Feldnamen und Typen einer klassischen ABAP-Struktur, die mit `BEGIN OF` definiert wurde.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_inspect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_classic,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_classic.

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_names) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_inspect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_struct_field_info.
    DATA: ls_sflight_dummy TYPE ty_sflight_classic.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflight_dummy ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND ls_component-name TO rt_field_names.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_hash_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_hash_table.
    DATA: lo_sflight_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lt_sflight_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lo_sflight_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflight_dummy ).

    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_sflight_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
      p_unique     = abap_true
      p_key        = VALUE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_table( ( name = 'CARRID' ) ( name = 'CONNID' ) )
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Anwendungen, die dynamisch mit Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen, ohne diese zur Designzeit zu kennen. `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` ermöglicht die flexible Definition der Tabelleneigenschaften.

CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid > '0000' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`AA`) mit der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'AA'
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Expected total seats to be greater than 0 for AA'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Sie ersetzt Schleifen, die manuell eine Summe oder einen anderen aggregierten Wert berechnen würden, und ist dabei oft effizienter und leichter zu lesen.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Unbekannt') basierend auf dem `deptime` und `actdeptime` Feld, unter Verwendung der `COND`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND`-Expression für kompakte bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_sflight-deptime IS INITIAL OR is_sflight-actdeptime IS INITIAL THEN 'Unbekannt'
      WHEN is_sflight-deptime = is_sflight-actdeptime THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN is_sflight-actdeptime > is_sflight-deptime THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    " Test Case 1: Pünktlich
    ls_sflight-deptime = '100000'.
    ls_sflight-actdeptime = '100000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight )
      exp = 'Pünktlich'
      msg = 'Expected Pünktlich'
    ).

    " Test Case 2: Verspätet
    ls_sflight-deptime = '100000'.
    ls_sflight-actdeptime = '103000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight )
      exp = 'Verspätet'
      msg = 'Expected Verspätet'
    ).

    " Test Case 3: Unbekannt (initial)
    CLEAR: ls_sflight-deptime, ls_sflight-actdeptime.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( ls_sflight )
      exp = 'Unbekannt'
      msg = 'Expected Unbekannt for initial times'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen in einer einzigen, kompakten Zeile. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich, insbesondere bei einfachen bedingten Zuweisungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, sflight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die jeweils `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen und eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` als `RETURNING VALUE` zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_mult TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 5 )->multiply( 2 )->add( 3 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 13 
      msg = 'Method chaining calculation failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein modernes Programmierparadigma, das die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss von Operationen auf einem Objekt verbessert. Indem Methoden das Objekt selbst (`ME`) zurückgeben, können mehrere Operationen in einer einzigen Anweisung verkettet werden, was den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker macht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, ME, RETURNING VALUE

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_corr( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Expected flights to be populated'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        msg = 'CARRID should not be initial'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_flight-cityfrom
        msg = 'CITYFROM should not be initial'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax in Open SQL ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten aus der Datenbank in eine intern deklarierte Tabelle zu lesen. Sie erspart das manuelle Mapping von Feldern und ist besonders nützlich, wenn die interne Struktur eine Untermenge der Datenbanktabelle ist. Die `CORRESPONDING` Expression wird hier verwendet, um die Felder von `lt_sflight_full` auf die Struktur von `rt_flights` zu mappen.
keywords: Open SQL, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, inline declaration, sflight, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer Zeilenstruktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen und Typen (z.B. `CARRID` als `SFLIGHT-CARRID`, `CONNID` als `SFLIGHT-CONNID`) zusammengestellt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table_from_fields
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_from_fields.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component( name = 'CARRID' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CARR_ID' ) ) TO lt_components.
    APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component( name = 'CONNID' type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'S_CONN_ID' ) ) TO lt_components.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
      p_unique     = abap_false
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_struct_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_struct_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_struct_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table_from_fields( ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA(lo_line_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_dynamic_table ).
    lo_line_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_line_type( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lo_line_descr->get_components( ) )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 components in dynamic structure'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_line_descr->get_components( )[ 1 ]-name
      exp = 'CARRID'
      msg = 'Expected CARRID as first component'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer vollständig dynamischen internen Tabelle, deren Zeilenstruktur zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Komponenten definiert wird. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes RTTI-Szenario, das für hochflexible Anwendungen und Frameworks unerlässlich ist, die Datenstrukturen basierend auf Konfigurationen oder Metadaten generieren müssen. `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` sind hier die Schlüsselkomponenten.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, cl_abap_tabledescr, dynamic structure, dynamic table, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der `sflight`-Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft, unter Verwendung der `GROUP BY` Expression.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = GROUP ls_flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Sie ersetzt komplexe Schleifenkonstrukte mit `AT NEW` oder manuellen Hash-Tabellen und bietet eine deklarative, lesbare und performante Lösung für Gruppierungsaufgaben.

Instructions: Verketten Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, unter Verwendung der `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Templates für die Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_carriers
      IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_carriers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR carrid IN it_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ carrid }|
                           ELSE |{ s }, { carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenate_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_reduce_concat( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ( 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'LH, AA, UA'
      msg = 'Concatenated string does not match expected value'
    ).

    CLEAR lt_carriers.
    lv_result = lo_cut->concatenate_carriers( lt_carriers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Expected empty string for empty table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die elegante Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression zur Verkettung von String-Elementen einer internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `COND` und String-Templates wird eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Lösung für eine häufige Aufgabe geboten, die traditionell eine explizite Schleife und bedingte Logik erfordert hätte.
keywords: String Processing, REDUCE, String Templates, COND, concatenation

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in eine interne Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder mit passenden Namen enthält.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Die Zielstruktur soll nur Felder mit passenden Namen aus der Quellstruktur erhalten.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field_b TYPE i,

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten und kopieren Sie nur die passenden Felder in eine Arbeitsstruktur für die weitere Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_short,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_short.
    TYPES tt_sflight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING it_flights_full TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_short) TYPE tt_sflight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights_full INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF DATA(ls_flight_short).
      APPEND ls_flight_short TO rt_flights_short.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights_short ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_short[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_short[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights_short[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights_short[ 1 ]-connid ). " connid should be initial as it's not in target
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ...` Syntax ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, über eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und gleichzeitig nur die namensgleichen Felder in eine Zielstruktur zu kopieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn man nur einen Teil der Daten einer Zeile benötigt.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quell- in eine Zielstruktur oder -tabelle unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators, um nur namensgleiche Felder zu übertragen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für eine moderne und kompakte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             value   TYPE decfloat16,
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             amount  TYPE decfloat16, " Different name
             status  TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             created_by TYPE sy-uname,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_single_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_table_data
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_single_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table_data.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_single_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_single_data.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_operator=>ty_source_data( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '123.45' status = 'A' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_operator( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_single_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-amount ). " 'value' not mapped to 'amount'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-status exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-created_by ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table_data.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_operator=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.00' status = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.00' status = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Syntax, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren, basierend auf namensgleichen Feldern. Er ersetzt die ältere `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Anweisung und kann auch mit `BASE` und `EXCEPT` für komplexere Szenarien erweitert werden.
keywords: CORRESPONDING operator, Structures, Internal Tables, Data Transfer, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. CSV-Daten) in ein binäres Format (`SOLIX_TAB`), um es als E-Mail-Anhang zu verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `string_to_solix` der Klasse `CL_BCS_CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_itab_to_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_csv_line TYPE string.
    TYPES tt_csv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_csv_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_csv_to_solix
      IMPORTING it_csv_data TYPE tt_csv_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_solix_tab) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_itab_to_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_csv_to_solix.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR line IN it_csv_data NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN line ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && line ) ).

    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string = lv_csv_string
        iv_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
        iv_add_bom = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        et_solix = rt_solix_tab
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_csv_to_solix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_csv_to_solix.
    DATA(lt_csv) = VALUE zcl_bcs_convert_itab_to_solix=>tt_csv_data(
      ( 'Header1,Header2' )
      ( 'Value1,Value2' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_convert_itab_to_solix( ).
    DATA(lt_solix) = lo_cut->convert_csv_to_solix( lt_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_solix ).
    DATA(lv_string_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string( lt_solix ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_string_back exp = 'Header1,Header2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_string_back exp = 'Value1,Value2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_BCS_CONVERT` bietet statische Methoden zur Konvertierung von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Formaten, die für den Business Communication Service (BCS) benötigt werden. `string_to_solix` ist ideal, um Textdaten (z.B. CSV) in ein binäres Format für E-Mail-Anhänge zu überführen, wobei die Codepage und BOM berücksichtigt werden können. Die `REDUCE` Expression wird hier verwendet, um die interne Tabelle effizient zu einem String zu verbinden.
keywords: CL_BCS_CONVERT, SOLIX_TAB, CSV, Email Attachment, Data Conversion, REDUCE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine E-Mail mit Flugdaten. Wählen Sie relevante Felder aus `SFLIGHT` mit `CORRESPONDING` aus, formatieren Sie diese als Text und konvertieren Sie den Text dann in HTML für den E-Mail-Body.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS`, String-Templates und `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>text_to_html`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_email_body
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_html_body) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_email_body.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_info.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_html_body = cl_bcs_convert=>text_to_html( 'Keine Flugdaten für ' && iv_carrid && ' gefunden.' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_text_body) = |Flugdetails für Airline { iv_carrid }:{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_text_body = lv_text_body &&
                     |  Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - Preis: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_html_body = cl_bcs_convert=>text_to_html( lv_text_body ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden, indem Sie den `FOR` Operator verwenden und die Zeilen mit `CORRESPONDING` in ein neues Format mappen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corr_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             id      TYPE i,
             name    TYPE string,
             quantity TYPE i,
             price   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES tt_source_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             item_id TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             total_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_items
      IMPORTING it_source_items TYPE tt_source_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corr_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_items.
    rt_target_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source_items
                                ( CORRESPONDING ty_target_item( ls_source MAPPING item_id = id item_name = name total_value = ( ls_source-quantity * ls_source-price ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_items FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_items.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_for_corr_itab=>tt_source_items(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' quantity = 2 price = '1.50' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' quantity = 3 price = '0.75' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corr_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_items( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-total_value exp = '3.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-total_value exp = '2.25' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des `FOR` Operators mit `CORRESPONDING` innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktors ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. Sie ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, indem man über eine bestehende iteriert und jede Zeile in ein neues Format mappt, inklusive Berechnungen und explizitem Feld-Mapping.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen in eine `XSTRING` im JSON-Format, um sie als Anhang zu versenden. Nutzen Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS` für die Datenvorbereitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für JSON-Serialisierung und `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>xstring_to_solix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_json_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_as_json_xstring
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_json_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_as_json_xstring.
    DATA lt_flights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_flights_filtered TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights_filtered
      UP TO 3 ROWS.

    IF lt_flights_filtered IS NOT INITIAL.
      CALL TRANSFORMATION id
        SOURCE flights = lt_flights_filtered
        RESULT XML rv_json_xstring.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine E-Mail mit einem PDF-Anhang. Das PDF liegt als `XSTRING` vor. Konvertieren Sie es in `SOLIX_TAB` und fügen Sie es der E-Mail hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>xstring_to_solix` und die BCS-Klassen `CL_BCS` und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_pdf
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_pdf_xstring     TYPE xstring
        iv_pdf_filename    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_pdf.
    DATA: lo_bcs         TYPE REF TO cl_bcs,
          lo_document    TYPE REF TO cl_document_bcs,
          lo_recipient   TYPE REF TO if_recipient_bcs,
          lt_solix_pdf   TYPE solix_tab,
          lv_size_kb     TYPE i.

    " Create BCS object
    lo_bcs = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    " Convert XSTRING PDF to SOLIX_TAB
    cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_xstring = iv_pdf_xstring
      IMPORTING
        et_solix = lt_solix_pdf
    ).

    " Calculate size for attachment
    lv_size_kb = xstrlen( iv_pdf_xstring ) / 1024.

    " Create document with attachment
    lo_document = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( line = 'Please find the attached PDF document.' ) )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'PDF'
      i_attachment_subject = iv_pdf_filename
      i_attachment_size    = lv_size_kb
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix_pdf
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add recipient
    lo_recipient = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address(
      iv_address_string = iv_recipient_email
    ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Send email
    lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_with_pdf FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_with_pdf.
    " This test only verifies the call sequence and does not actually send an email.
    " A real test would involve mocking CL_BCS and its methods.
    DATA(lv_dummy_pdf) = ''X.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_pdf_attachment( ).

    " Mocking CL_BCS and CL_DOCUMENT_BCS for unit testing is complex.
    " For this example, we'll just assert that the method can be called without immediate errors.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use test doubles (mocks/stubs) for CL_BCS and its dependencies.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_email_with_pdf(
          iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
          iv_subject         = 'Test PDF Attachment'
          iv_pdf_xstring     = lv_dummy_pdf
          iv_pdf_filename    = 'test.pdf'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Assert that no exception occurred
      CATCH cx_bcs_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'BCS error occurred during test' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es demonstriert die Integration der Konvertierung mit den BCS-Klassen `CL_BCS` und `CL_DOCUMENT_BCS` zur Erstellung und zum Versand einer E-Mail mit Anhang.

CLASS zcl_corr_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine präzise Kontrolle darüber, welche namensgleichen Felder *nicht* von der Quell- in die Zielstruktur kopiert werden sollen. Dies ist nützlich, wenn man fast alle Felder übernehmen möchte, aber bestimmte Ausnahmen definieren muss, ohne eine explizite `MAPPING` Klausel für alle anderen Felder zu schreiben.
keywords: CORRESPONDING operator, EXCEPT, Structures, Data Transfer, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_LOGGABLE` mit einer Methode `LOG_MESSAGE`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse `ZCL_APP_LOGGER`, die die Nachricht in einer internen Tabelle speichert, um sie testbar zu machen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` und `IMPLEMENTS`. Für den Test speichern Sie die Nachrichten in einer `CLASS-DATA` Tabelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_loggable PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_app_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_loggable.
    CLASS-DATA gt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY. " Für Testzwecke
    METHODS get_logged_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_loggable~log_message.
    APPEND iv_message TO gt_log_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_logged_messages.
    rt_messages = gt_log_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_log_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    CLEAR zcl_app_logger=>gt_log_messages. " Log vor jedem Test leeren
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_log_message.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_app_logger( ).
    lo_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( 'Erste Testnachricht' ).
    lo_logger->zif_loggable~log_message( 'Zweite Testnachricht' ).

    DATA(lt_logged) = lo_logger->get_logged_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_logged ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logged[ 1 ] exp = 'Erste Testnachricht' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logged[ 2 ] exp = 'Zweite Testnachricht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Interfaces (`INTERFACE`) und deren Implementierung in einer Klasse (`IMPLEMENTS`). Das Interface `ZIF_LOGGABLE` definiert einen Vertrag für die Protokollierung. Die Klasse `ZCL_APP_LOGGER` erfüllt diesen Vertrag. Für die Testbarkeit werden die Nachrichten in einer statischen internen Tabelle gespeichert, die im Unit-Test geleert und überprüft werden kann. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster, um Seiteneffekte (wie das Schreiben in ein echtes Log) in Tests zu isolieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine externe Funktion aufruft, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab und werfen Sie eine eigene, spezifischere Ausnahme, die die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und den `PREVIOUS`-Parameter beim Erzeugen der neuen Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_external_service_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_details TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_details TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_external_service_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_error_details = iv_error_details.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_service
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING cx_static_check. " Simuliert einen externen Dienst, der eine generische Ausnahme auslösen könnte
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_service.
    IF iv_input = 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_static_check=>cx_static_check. " Generischer Fehler
    ELSE.
      rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_external_service_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_service_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_external_service) = NEW zcl_external_service( ).
    TRY.
        rv_result = lo_external_service->call_service( iv_input = iv_data ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_original).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_external_service_error
          EXPORTING
            iv_error_details = 'Fehler beim Aufruf des externen Dienstes.'
            previous         = lx_original.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_data_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_external_service_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data_success.
    DATA(lo_wrapper) = NEW zcl_service_wrapper( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_wrapper->process_data( 'Some data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Some data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_data_error.
    DATA(lo_wrapper) = NEW zcl_service_wrapper( ).
    TRY.
        lo_wrapper->process_data( 'ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_external_service_error expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_external_service_error INTO DATA(lx_wrapper_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_wrapper_error->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_wrapper_error->mv_error_details exp = 'Fehler beim Aufruf des externen Dienstes.' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lx_wrapper_error->previous IS INSTANCE OF cx_static_check ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Abfangen einer generischen Ausnahme (`cx_static_check`) und das erneute Werfen einer spezifischeren, benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_external_service_error`). Die ursprüngliche Ausnahme wird dabei als 'previous' in die neue Ausnahme eingebettet. Dies ist ein wichtiges Muster für die Fehlerbehandlung, um den Kontext des ursprünglichen Fehlers beizubehalten, während eine anwendungsspezifischere Fehlermeldung bereitgestellt wird. Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block ermöglicht diese Kapselung der Fehlerlogik.
keywords: RAISE, EXCEPTION, TRY, CATCH, PREVIOUS, ERROR HANDLING

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_DATA_PROCESSOR` mit einer Methode `PROCESS_DATA` und einer Standardimplementierung für eine Hilfsmethode `GET_DEFAULT_SETTING`. Implementieren Sie das Interface in einer Klasse und überschreiben Sie optional die Standardimplementierung.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `THROW`-Ausdruck in einem funktionalen Kontext (z.B. `REDUCE` oder `FOR`), um eine Ausnahme zu werfen, wenn eine Bedingung nicht erfüllt ist.
hint: Der `THROW`-Ausdruck ist ab ABAP 7.52 verfügbar und kann direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_value DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum_length) TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_list.
    rv_sum_length = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR value IN it_values
      NEXT s = s + COND #( WHEN value IS NOT INITIAL THEN strlen( value )
                           ELSE THROW zcx_invalid_value( iv_value = 'Empty string found' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_list_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_list_error FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_list_success.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->process_list( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 14 ). " 5 + 5 + 4
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_list_error.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( '' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_list( lt_values ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_invalid_value expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_invalid->mv_value exp = 'Empty string found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `THROW`-Ausdruck (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.52) ermöglicht das Werfen von Ausnahmen direkt innerhalb von Ausdrücken, wie z.B. in `COND` oder `SWITCH`. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die funktionale Programmierung, da es die Fehlerbehandlung nahtlos in die Ausdruckslogik integriert, ohne separate `IF`-Blöcke oder `RAISE`-Anweisungen zu benötigen. Im Beispiel wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die Längen von Strings zu summieren, und `THROW` wird ausgelöst, wenn ein leerer String gefunden wird, was zu kompakterem und lesbarerem Code führt.
keywords: THROW, EXCEPTION, REDUCE, FOR, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, ABAP 7.52

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für die Datenvalidierung (`ZIF_VALIDATOR`) und implementieren Sie es in einer Klasse, die eine einfache Validierungsregel anwendet und bei Verletzung eine Ausnahme wirft.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Designmuster mithilfe von Interfaces. Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_SORT_STRATEGY` und mehrere Klassen, die dieses Interface implementieren, um verschiedene Sortieralgorithmen darzustellen.
hint: Das Interface definiert die `SORT`-Methode. Jede Strategie-Klasse implementiert diese Methode mit einem anderen Sortieransatz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_sort_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS sort_data
    CHANGING
      ct_data TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_bubble_sort_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bubble_sort_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_sort_strategy~sort_data.
    " Einfacher Bubble Sort für Demonstrationszwecke
    DATA lv_swapped TYPE abap_bool.
    DO.
      lv_swapped = abap_false.
      LOOP AT ct_data INTO DATA(lv_current) FROM 1 TO lines( ct_data ) - 1.
        DATA(lv_next) = ct_data[ sy-tabix + 1 ].
        IF lv_current > lv_next.
          ct_data[ sy-tabix ] = lv_next.
          ct_data[ sy-tabix + 1 ] = lv_current.
          lv_swapped = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_swapped = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quick_sort_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_quick_sort_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_sort_strategy~sort_data.
    " ABAP's interne Sortierung ist oft Quick Sort-basiert oder optimiert
    SORT ct_data ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_sort_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_sort_strategy.
    METHODS perform_sort
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_sort_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_sort_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_sorter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_sort_strategy = io_sort_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD perform_sort.
    mo_sort_strategy->sort_data( CHANGING ct_data = ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE string_table( ( 'C' ) ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lo_bubble_sorter) = NEW zcl_data_sorter( NEW zcl_bubble_sort_strategy( ) ).
    lo_bubble_sorter->perform_sort( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

explanation: Das Strategie-Designmuster ermöglicht es, Algorithmen zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. In ABAP wird dies elegant mit Interfaces (`ZIF_SORT_STRATEGY`) realisiert. Jede konkrete Strategie (z.B. `ZCL_BUBBLE_SORT_STRATEGY`, `ZCL_QUICK_SORT_STRATEGY`) implementiert das Interface und bietet eine eigene Implementierung der `SORT_DATA`-Methode. Die Kontextklasse (`ZCL_DATA_SORTER`) hält eine Referenz auf das Interface und delegiert die Ausführung an die aktuell zugewiesene Strategie. Dies fördert die Flexibilität, Wartbarkeit und die Einhaltung des Open/Closed-Prinzips.

             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Flugdaten (aus `SFLIGHTS`) verarbeitet. Wenn ein Flugpreis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme mit Details zum Flug ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` und `LOOP AT` mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcx_flight_price_too_low DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_price TYPE s_price READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date OPTIONAL
        iv_price TYPE s_price OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_price_too_low IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
    mv_fldate = iv_fldate.
    mv_price = iv_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RAISING zcx_flight_price_too_low.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Für Testzwecke begrenzen

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < iv_min_price.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_price_too_low
          EXPORTING
            iv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid
            iv_connid = ls_flight-connid
            iv_fldate = ls_flight-fldate
            iv_price  = ls_flight-price.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_flights_success.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit Preisen über 1000
    lo_analyzer->analyze_flights( 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Kein Fehler erwartet
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_analyze_flights_low_price.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge mit Preisen unter 1000000, aber über 100
    " Wir setzen einen hohen Schwellenwert, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Fehler auftritt
    TRY.
        lo_analyzer->analyze_flights( 1000000 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_flight_price_too_low expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_flight_price_too_low INTO DATA(lx_low_price).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_low_price->mv_carrid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_low_price->mv_connid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lx_low_price->mv_price < 1000000 ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Wenn eine Geschäftsregel (Flugpreis unter Schwellenwert) verletzt wird, wird eine Ausnahme ausgelöst, die detaillierte Informationen zum betroffenen Datensatz enthält. Dies ist entscheidend für die präzise Fehlerbehandlung in datenintensiven Anwendungen. Die Ausnahme wird mit den relevanten Flugdaten gefüllt, was die Diagnose des Problems erheblich vereinfacht.

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface `ZIF_DATA_SOURCE` für den Zugriff auf Daten. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in zwei Klassen: eine, die Daten aus einer internen Tabelle liefert, und eine andere, die Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` liest.

INTERFACE zif_data_source PUBLIC.

           id   TYPE i,
           value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_data_record.

    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data_records.

                       ( id = 2 value = 'Internal Data 2' ) ).

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS. " Für Demonstrationszwecke begrenzen

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         ( id = sy-tabix value = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_operation_status,
             op_id TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_operation_status.

    DATA mt_status TYPE tt_operation_status READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_failed_op_id TYPE i READ-ONLY.

      IMPORTING

        iv_failed_op_id TYPE i OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    mt_status = it_status.
    mv_failed_op_id = iv_failed_op_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_operations
      IMPORTING
        it_operations TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING zcx_operation_failed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_operations.
    DATA: lt_op_status TYPE zcx_operation_failed=>tt_operation_status.

    LOOP AT it_operations INTO DATA(lv_op_id).
      DATA(ls_status) = VALUE zcx_operation_failed=>ty_operation_status(
        op_id = lv_op_id ).

      IF lv_op_id MOD 2 = 0. " Simuliere Fehler für gerade IDs
        ls_status-status = 'FAILED'.
        ls_status-message = |Operation { lv_op_id } fehlgeschlagen.|.
        APPEND ls_status TO lt_op_status.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed
          EXPORTING
            it_status       = lt_op_status
            iv_failed_op_id = lv_op_id.
      ELSE.
        ls_status-status = 'SUCCESS'.
        ls_status-message = |Operation { lv_op_id } erfolgreich.|.
        APPEND ls_status TO lt_op_status.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
