hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `PARSE_CSV_STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flight_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error. " Example exception for parsing issues
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flight_csv.
    DATA:
      lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
      lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
        ).

        " Skip header row if present, or handle based on content
        IF lines( lt_csv_table ) > 0 AND lt_csv_table[1][1] = 'Carrid'. " Simple header check
          DELETE lt_csv_table INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid   = <fs_row>[1]
            connid   = <fs_row>[2]
            cityfrom = <fs_row>[3]
            cityto   = <fs_row>[4]
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        " Handle specific ICF CSV errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
        " Handle cases where a row might not have enough columns
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_bounds->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD parse_custom_csv.
    DATA:
      lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
      lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
            iv_delimiter  = ';' " Custom delimiter
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table

        " Check header
        IF lines( lt_csv_table ) > 0.
          DATA(ls_header) = lt_csv_table[1].
          IF ls_header[1] <> 'Carrier' OR ls_header[2] <> 'FlightNo'. " Simplified check

              EXPORTING
                textid = zcx_csv_header_error=>default_text. " Assuming default_text is defined in exception
          ENDIF.
          DELETE lt_csv_table INDEX 1. " Remove header after check
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid   = <fs_row>[1]
            connid   = <fs_row>[2]
            cityfrom = <fs_row>[3]
            cityto   = <fs_row>[4]
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_bounds->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights), die für den Download über eine ICF-Schnittstelle vorbereitet ist.

solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flight_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_csv.
    DATA:
      lo_csv_generator TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
      lt_csv_table     TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_generator.

    " Add header row
    APPEND VALUE string_table( ( 'Carrid' ) ( 'Connid' ) ( 'CityFrom' ) ( 'CityTo' ) ) TO lt_csv_table.

    " Convert internal table to cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table format
    LOOP AT it_flight_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      APPEND VALUE string_table(
        ( <fs_flight>-carrid )
        ( <fs_flight>-connid )
        ( <fs_flight>-cityfrom )
        ( <fs_flight>-cityto )
      ) TO lt_csv_table.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_generator->create_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            it_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
          RECEIVING
            rv_csv_string = rv_csv_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_csv_mandatory_field DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    INTERFACES if_t100_message.

CLASS zcl_csv_mandatory_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_and_validate_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string

      RAISING
        zcx_csv_mandatory_field
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

CLASS zcl_csv_mandatory_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_validate_csv.
    DATA:
      lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
      lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
        ).

        " Skip header
        IF lines( lt_csv_table ) > 0 AND lt_csv_table[1][1] = 'Carrid'.
          DELETE lt_csv_table INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(lv_current_row) = sy-tabix + 1. " Adjust for 1-based indexing and potential header

          IF <fs_row>[1] IS INITIAL. " Check Carrid
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_csv_mandatory_field
              EXPORTING
                textid = zcx_csv_mandatory_field=>default_text " Assuming default_text
                i_row_number = lv_current_row
                i_field_name = 'Carrid'.
          ENDIF.

          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid   = <fs_row>[1]
            connid   = <fs_row>[2]
            cityfrom = <fs_row>[3]
            cityto   = <fs_row>[4]
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_bounds->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle und generieren Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette, die nur Flüge von 'LH' und 'AA' enthält, wobei die Spaltenreihenfolge geändert wird und ein benutzerdefiniertes Trennzeichen verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `FOR`, `FILTER` und `cl_icf_csv` mit `iv_delimiter`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_output,
        flight_id TYPE s_conn_id,
        airline   TYPE s_carr_id,
        origin    TYPE s_cityname,
        dest      TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_flight_output.
    TYPES tt_flight_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_transformed) =
      FILTER tt_flight_output FROM
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA' )
        ( VALUE ty_flight_output(
            flight_id = ls_sflight-connid
            airline   = ls_sflight-carrid
            origin    = ls_sflight-cityfrom
            dest      = ls_sflight-cityto
          ) ).

    DATA(lo_csv_generator) = NEW cl_icf_csv( ).
    DATA(lt_csv_table)     = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table(
      ( VALUE string_table( ( 'Flight ID' ) ( 'Airline' ) ( 'Origin' ) ( 'Destination' ) ) )
      FOR ls_output IN lt_filtered_transformed
      ( VALUE string_table(
          ( ls_output-flight_id )
          ( ls_output-airline )
          ( ls_output-origin )
          ( ls_output-dest )
        ) )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_csv_generator->create_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            it_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
            iv_delimiter  = '|' " Pipe as delimiter
          RECEIVING
            rv_csv_string = rv_csv_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung einer eingehenden HTTP-Anfrage mit CSV-Daten. Die Methode soll die CSV-Daten parsen und eine Bestätigungsnachricht zurückgeben. Fehler beim Parsen sollen als Exception behandelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Parsen und `RAISE EXCEPTION` für Fehler. Die Methode simuliert den `HANDLE_REQUEST` einer ICF-Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_icf_csv_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_csv_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_request_body TYPE string " Simulates HTTP request body
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_icf_csv_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_csv_request.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table,
          lt_flight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_request_body
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
        ).

        IF lines( lt_csv_table ) > 0 AND lt_csv_table[1][1] = 'Carrid'.
          DELETE lt_csv_table INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid   = <fs_row>[1]
            connid   = <fs_row>[2]
            cityfrom = <fs_row>[3]
            cityto   = <fs_row>[4]
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_response_message = |{ lines( lt_flight_data ) } Flugdaten erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler beim Parsen der CSV-Daten: { lx_icf_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Fehler: Ungültiges CSV-Format (Zeile { sy-tabix }): { lx_bounds->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine CSV-Zeichenkette parst und dabei leere Zeilen ignoriert. Wenn eine Zeile nicht die erwartete Anzahl von Spalten hat, soll eine `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` Exception ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` spezifisch ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_robust_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
        col1 TYPE string,
        col2 TYPE string,
        col3 TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data_row.
    TYPES tt_data_row TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_robustly
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_data_row
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_robust_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_robustly.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          " Ignore empty rows (e.g., if all columns are initial)
          IF <fs_row> IS INITIAL.
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          TRY.
              DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_data_row(
                col1 = <fs_row>[1]
                col2 = <fs_row>[2]
                col3 = <fs_row>[3]
              ).
              APPEND ls_data TO rt_parsed_data.
            CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
              " Re-raise with more context if needed, or handle specifically
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds
                EXPORTING
                  text = |Zeile { sy-tabix } hat nicht genügend Spalten: { lx_bounds->get_text( ) }|.
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Validieren Sie eine CSV-Zeichenkette, um sicherzustellen, dass alle numerischen Felder (z.B. `Connid`) tatsächlich Zahlen sind. Lösen Sie eine Exception aus, wenn ein Feld nicht numerisch ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Parsen und `COND` oder `TRY...CATCH` für die Typkonvertierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_csv_numeric_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA row_number TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    DATA field_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA field_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_row_number TYPE i OPTIONAL
        i_field_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        i_field_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_csv_numeric_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->row_number = i_row_number.
    me->field_name = i_field_name.
    me->field_value = i_field_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_numeric_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_cityname,
        cityto   TYPE s_cityname,
      END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_numeric_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        zcx_csv_numeric_error
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_numeric_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_numeric_fields.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_csv_parser.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser->parse_csv_string(
          EXPORTING
            iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
          RECEIVING
            rt_csv_table  = lt_csv_table
        ).

        IF lines( lt_csv_table ) > 0 AND lt_csv_table[1][1] = 'Carrid'.
          DELETE lt_csv_table INDEX 1.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          DATA(lv_current_row) = sy-tabix + 1. " Adjust for 1-based indexing and potential header
          DATA: lv_connid_num TYPE s_conn_id.

          TRY.
              lv_connid_num = <fs_row>[2]. " Attempt conversion
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_csv_numeric_error
                EXPORTING
                  textid = zcx_csv_numeric_error=>default_text " Assuming default_text
                  i_row_number = lv_current_row
                  i_field_name = 'Connid'
                  i_field_value = <fs_row>[2].
          ENDTRY.

          DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid   = <fs_row>[1]
            connid   = lv_connid_num
            cityfrom = <fs_row>[3]
            cityto   = <fs_row>[4]
          ).
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_icf_error INTO DATA(lx_icf_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_icf_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_bounds).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_bounds->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_numeric_validation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_numeric_validation_fail RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_numeric_validation_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_numeric_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = 'Carrid,Connid,CityFrom,CityTo' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   'LH,0400,Frankfurt,New York'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->validate_numeric_fields( lv_csv ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_numeric_validation_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_numeric_validator( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = 'Carrid,Connid,CityFrom,CityTo' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                   'LH,ABC,Frankfurt,New York'. " Non-numeric Connid

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      EXPORTING
        class = 'ZCX_CSV_NUMERIC_ERROR'
      ACT = #( lo_cut->validate_numeric_fields( lv_csv ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Validierung von CSV-Daten, um sicherzustellen, dass Felder, die numerisch sein sollen, auch tatsächlich Zahlen enthalten. Eine benutzerdefinierte Exception (`ZCX_CSV_NUMERIC_ERROR`) wird ausgelöst, wenn die Konvertierung eines Feldes in einen numerischen Typ fehlschlägt. Instructions: Geben Sie dem ABAP-Laufzeitsystem einen Hinweis zur sofortigen Speicherfreigabe für nicht mehr referenzierte Objekte.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_free DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_memory_free.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_free IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_memory_free.
    DATA: lv_large_string TYPE string VALUE 'A'.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      lv_large_string = lv_large_string && 'A'.
    ENDDO.

    " Referenz aufheben
    CLEAR lv_large_string.

    " Hinweis zur Speicherfreigabe geben
    cl_abap_memory_utilities=>free_memory( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_free_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_free( ).
    " Vor dem Aufruf kann man optional den Speicher messen
    " DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_allocated_memory_size( ).

    lo_cut->trigger_memory_free( ).

    " Nach dem Aufruf kann man optional den Speicher erneut messen und vergleichen
    " DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_allocated_memory_size( ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_mem_after < lv_mem_before ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie einen String nach links und füllen Sie die entstandenen Lücken am Ende mit einem bestimmten Füllzeichen, unter Verwendung moderner String-Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SHIFT` mit einem String-Template und der Funktion `fill`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_and_fill
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_places       TYPE i
        iv_fill_char    TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_and_fill.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY iv_places PLACES.

    " Füllen der entstandenen Leerzeichen mit dem Füllzeichen
    rv_result_string = |{ lv_temp_string WIDTH = strlen( iv_input_string ) PAD LEFT = iv_fill_char }|.
    " PAD LEFT ist hier nicht ganz korrekt, da es links auffüllt. Besser wäre es, die Länge zu kennen und dann zu füllen.
    " Eine direktere Methode wäre:
    DATA(lv_shifted_part) = lv_temp_string( strlen( iv_input_string ) - iv_places ).
    DATA(lv_fill_part) = repeat( val = iv_fill_char occ = iv_places ).
    rv_result_string = |{ lv_shifted_part }{ lv_fill_part }|.

    " Korrektur für den Fall, dass der String kürzer wird als ursprünglich
    IF strlen( rv_result_string ) > strlen( iv_input_string ).
      rv_result_string = rv_result_string( strlen( iv_input_string ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Einfachere und korrektere Lösung für feste Länge:
    DATA(lv_fixed_length_string) TYPE string.
    lv_fixed_length_string = iv_input_string.
    SHIFT lv_fixed_length_string LEFT BY iv_places PLACES.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN SECTION OFFSET strlen( iv_input_string ) - iv_places OF lv_fixed_length_string WITH iv_fill_char.
    rv_result_string = lv_fixed_length_string.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_shift_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_shift
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_shift_type   TYPE string " 'LEFT', 'RIGHT', 'TRIM_LEFT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_shifted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shift_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_shift.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    rv_shifted_string = SWITCH string(
      iv_shift_type
      WHEN 'LEFT' THEN
        SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT BY 2 PLACES.
        lv_temp_string
      WHEN 'RIGHT' THEN
        SHIFT lv_temp_string RIGHT BY 2 PLACES.
        lv_temp_string
      WHEN 'TRIM_LEFT' THEN
        SHIFT lv_temp_string LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
        lv_temp_string
      ELSE
        iv_input_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, aber nur für Flüge, deren Währung 'EUR' ist und deren Flugnummer mit '0' beginnt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `IF`-Bedingung innerhalb der Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_eur_flight_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_eur_flight_sum.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( currency = 'EUR' )
                               NEXT
                                 sum = sum + COND #( WHEN flight-connid CP '0*' THEN flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( ( cityfrom = 'FRA' AND cityto = 'JFK' ) OR
                                            ( cityfrom = 'MUC' AND cityto = 'LAX' ) ) AND
                                          ( fldate CP lv_current_year && '*' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_action.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_action
      IMPORTING
        io_action TYPE REF TO zif_flight_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_action.
    IF io_action IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_cancel.
      DATA(lo_cancel_action) = CAST zcl_flight_cancel( io_action ).
      lo_cancel_action->zif_flight_action~execute_action( ).
    ELSE IF io_action IS INSTANCE OF zcl_flight_reschedule.
      DATA(lo_reschedule_action) = CAST zcl_flight_reschedule( io_action ).
      lo_reschedule_action->zif_flight_action~execute_action( ).
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Unknown flight action type.' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, bei der ein nachfolgender Aufruf nur erfolgt, wenn eine vorherige Bedingung erfüllt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen, und integrieren Sie `IF`-Bedingungen in den Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chain_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_step1
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_processor.
    METHODS process_step2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chain_processor.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_processed TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i VALUE 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chain_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_step1.
    IF iv_condition = abap_true.
      mv_processed = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      mv_processed = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_step2.
    IF mv_processed = abap_true. " Only process if step1 was successful
      mv_value = iv_value * 2.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    IF mv_processed = abap_true.
      rv_result = |Processed with value: { mv_value }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Not processed.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_chain_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_step1( abap_true )->process_step2( 10 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed with value: 20' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_failure.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Not processed.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer Zeile verkettet werden. Die Integration von `IF`-Bedingungen innerhalb der Methoden ermöglicht eine flexible Steuerung des Ausführungsflusses in der Kette.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Method, IF

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge zurück, aber nur wenn die Anzahl der Flüge größer als 1 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer `IF`-Bedingung nach der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_counts.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      IF lv_count > 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_city.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    TRY.
        lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( iv_xml_string ) ).
        DATA(lo_city_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( '/Travel/Destination/City' ).
        IF lo_city_node IS BOUND.
          rv_city = lo_city_node->get_value( ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_xml_parse_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        rv_city = 'Error parsing XML'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_city FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_city.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = '<Travel><Destination><City>Frankfurt</City></Destination></Travel>'.
    DATA(lv_city) = lo_cut->parse_and_get_city( lv_xml ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode demonstriert das Parsen eines XML-Strings mit `cl_xml_document` und das Extrahieren eines Knotens über seinen Pfad. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_xml_document)`) und die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen einfachen XML-String aus ABAP-Daten (z.B. Flugdaten).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` und Methoden wie `create_node` und `create_element`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    METHODS generate_flight_xml
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = 'Flight' ).
    lo_xml_document->set_root( lo_root ).

    lo_root->create_element( name = 'CarrierID' )->set_value( is_flight-carrid ).
    lo_root->create_element( name = 'ConnectionID' )->set_value( is_flight-connid ).
    lo_root->create_element( name = 'CityFrom' )->set_value( is_flight-cityfrom ).
    lo_root->create_element( name = 'CityTo' )->set_value( is_flight-cityto ).

    rv_xml_string = cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp( lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generate_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_xml.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_xml_generator=>ty_flight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '400'.
    ls_flight-cityfrom = 'Frankfurt'.
    ls_flight-cityto = 'New York'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->generate_flight_xml( ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<Flight>' msg = 'XML root tag missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<CityFrom>Frankfurt</CityFrom>' msg = 'CityFrom tag missing or incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = '<CityTo>New York</CityTo>' msg = 'CityTo tag missing or incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_xml_document` und seinen Methoden (`create_element`, `set_value`, `set_root`, `render_xstring`) dynamisch XML-Strukturen aufbaut. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_ce=>uccp` ist für die Konvertierung von String zu XString notwendig.
keywords: XML, cl_xml_document, generation, create_element, render_xstring

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie Variablen inline in verschiedenen Kontexten (z.B. `LOOP`, `SELECT`, `METHOD` Parameter).
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(...)` oder `FINAL(...)` direkt an der Verwendungsstelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS get_single_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(lv_line).
      APPEND |Processed: { lv_line }| TO rt_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_single_value.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      UP TO 1 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } gefunden.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Kein Flug gefunden.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_single_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Item1' ) ( 'Item2' ) ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two lines expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_output[1] exp = 'Processed: Item1' msg = 'First line incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_single_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_single_value( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_value msg = 'Value should not be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_line)`, `DATA(ls_sflight)`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit, da die Variable direkt dort deklariert wird, wo sie verwendet wird. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code und macht den Datenfluss transparenter. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden ebenfalls verwendet.
keywords: DATA, inline declaration, LOOP, SELECT, string templates

Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer Schleife unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators, basierend auf einer anderen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` für die Iteration und Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_processed,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_processed.
    TYPES tt_flight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                                    ( flight_key  = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid }|
                                      flight_date = ls_raw-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_for_operator=>tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '123' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two processed flights expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[1]-flight_key exp = 'LH-400' msg = 'First flight key incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[2]-flight_date exp = '20250102' msg = 'Second flight date incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarker Konstruktorausdruck, der es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen basierend auf der Iteration über andere Datenquellen zu füllen. Er unterstützt auch Filterbedingungen und Transformationen innerhalb der Schleife, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt.
keywords: FOR, internal table, constructor expression, iteration, transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             product_id TYPE string,
             quantity   TYPE i,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_sales
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_items TYPE tt_sales_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sales) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_sales.
    rv_total_sales = REDUCE #( INIT total TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 VALUE 0
                                FOR ls_item IN it_sales_items
                                NEXT total = total + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_sales FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_sales.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_sales) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator=>tt_sales_items(
      ( product_id = 'P1' quantity = 2 price = '10.50' )
      ( product_id = 'P2' quantity = 1 price = '20.00' )
      ( product_id = 'P3' quantity = 3 price = '5.25' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_sales( lt_sales ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '56.75' msg = 'Total sales incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_sales) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator=>tt_sales_items( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_sales( lt_sales ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '0.00' msg = 'Total sales for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionaler Konstruktorausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Er ist ideal für Summierungen, Zählungen oder die Erstellung komplexer Einzelwerte aus Tabellendaten, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.
keywords: REDUCE, internal table, aggregation, constructor expression, functional programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung mit dem `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit gefilterten Einträgen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE tt_products
        iv_min_price    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_expensive_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_products.
    rt_expensive_products = FILTER #( it_all_products USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_products FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_products.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_filter_operator=>tt_products(
      ( id = 'A1' name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
      ( id = 'A2' name = 'Mouse' price = '25.00' )
      ( id = 'A3' name = 'Keyboard' price = '150.00' )
      ( id = 'A4' name = 'Monitor' price = '300.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expensive) = lo_cut->get_expensive_products( it_all_products = lt_products iv_min_price = '100.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expensive ) exp = 3 msg = 'Three expensive products expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expensive[1]-name exp = 'Laptop' msg = 'First expensive product incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expensive[3]-name exp = 'Monitor' msg = 'Third expensive product incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_filter_operator=>tt_products(
      ( id = 'A1' name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expensive) = lo_cut->get_expensive_products( it_all_products = lt_products iv_min_price = '2000.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_expensive ) msg = 'No products expected above 2000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein Konstruktorausdruck, der eine neue interne Tabelle erzeugt, die nur die Zeilen der Quelltabelle enthält, die einer bestimmten Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE` Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, internal table, constructor expression, filtering

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) in einer Klasse, um eine 'Fluent Interface' zu erstellen.
hint: Methoden, die verkettet werden sollen, müssen eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.
    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_builder.
    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = |{ mv_value1 } - { mv_value2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_builder->set_value1( 'Hello' )->set_value2( 'World' )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello - World' msg = 'Chained method call result incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu kombinieren. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME`) zurückgibt. Dies führt zu einem 'Fluent Interface', das die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes verbessert.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface, ME

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` mit der neuen Open SQL Syntax, einschließlich Inline-Deklaration und Host-Variablen-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `WHERE` mit Host-Variablen.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_new_syntax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

CLASS zcl_open_sql_new_syntax IMPLEMENTATION.

      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_new_syntax( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should find flights for LH' ).

  METHOD test_no_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'Should find no flights for XX' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem expliziten Schlüssel und greifen Sie über diesen Schlüssel auf Einträge zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WITH UNIQUE KEY` oder `WITH NON-UNIQUE KEY` und `TABLE LINE` oder `KEY` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_material,
             matnr TYPE matnr,
             maktx TYPE maktx,
           END OF ty_material.
    TYPES tt_materials TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_material
                         WITH UNIQUE KEY matnr.

    METHODS add_material
      IMPORTING
        is_material TYPE ty_material
      CHANGING
        ct_materials TYPE tt_materials.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den bedingten Operator `COND` oder `SWITCH` für eine kompakte Zuweisung basierend auf Bedingungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )` oder `SWITCH type( operand WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_operators DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_status_text_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_operators IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text_cond.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Erfolgreich'
      WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_text_switch.
    rv_status_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_status_code
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Erfolgreich'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text_cond( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' msg = 'COND: Status 2 incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text_cond( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' msg = 'COND: Unknown status incorrect' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text_switch( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' msg = 'SWITCH: Status 2 incorrect' ).

explanation: Die bedingten Operatoren `COND` und `SWITCH` sind Konstruktorausdrücke, die eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` oder `CASE...WHEN...ENDCASE` für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen bieten. `COND` ist flexibler für beliebige Bedingungen, während `SWITCH` ideal für die Prüfung eines einzelnen Operanden auf verschiedene Werte ist.
keywords: COND, SWITCH, conditional logic, constructor expression, compact syntax

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer dynamisch übergebenen Bedingung (z.B. 'CITYTO = 'NEW YORK'').
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen Prädikat, das durch eine Methode einer lokalen Klasse bereitgestellt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS lcl_dynamic_predicate DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS-METHODS is_match
          IMPORTING
            is_flight     TYPE ty_sflight
            iv_field_name TYPE string
            iv_value      TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_match) TYPE abap_bool.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_dynamic_predicate IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD is_match.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          rv_match = COND abap_bool( WHEN <fs_field> = iv_value THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamically.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_all
                                   WHERE ( lcl_dynamic_predicate=>is_match( is_flight = flight, iv_field_name = iv_field_name, iv_value = iv_value ) = abap_true )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_ny) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamically( iv_field_name = 'CITYTO' iv_value = 'NEW YORK' ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamically( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'NY-Flüge sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_filtered_ny ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_ny INTO DATA(ls_flight_ny).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alle Flüge sollten nach New York gehen' act = ls_flight_ny-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH-Flüge sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_lh INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Alle Flüge sollten von LH sein' act = ls_flight_lh-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `FILTER`-Operator mit einem dynamischen Prädikat verwendet werden kann, das in einer separaten Methode implementiert ist. Dies ermöglicht flexible Filterbedingungen zur Laufzeit, indem Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) verwendet werden, um auf Komponenten der Struktur zuzugreifen. Dies ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Technik für dynamische Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, Predicate, FIELD-SYMBOLS, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Lesen Sie den aktuellen Inhalt der Zwischenablage des Frontend-Rechners aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `cl_gui_frontend_services=>clipboard_get`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frontend_clipboard_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_clipboard_content
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_clipboard_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_clipboard_content.
    DATA lv_content TYPE string.
    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>clipboard_get
      IMPORTING
        data = lv_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1
        error_no_gui = 2
        OTHERS = 3.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. leeren String zurückgeben oder Exception werfen
      rv_content = 'ERROR: Could not read clipboard content'.
    ELSE.
      rv_content = lv_content.
    END IF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_clipboard FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_clipboard.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_clipboard_get( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Testinhalt für Zwischenablage'.

    " Versuch, die Zwischenablage zu setzen, um sie dann zu lesen
    " In einem echten Unit-Test ohne GUI ist dies schwierig zu simulieren.
    " Hier wird nur der Aufruf und die Fehlerbehandlung getestet.
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>clipboard_set( data = lv_test_string ).
        DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->get_clipboard_content( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Zwischenablage sollte den Testinhalt enthalten' act = lv_content exp = lv_test_string ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Wenn keine GUI verfügbar ist, wird eine Exception geworfen.
        " Dann testen wir, ob die Fehlermeldung korrekt zurückgegeben wird.
        DATA(lv_error_content) = lo_cut->get_clipboard_content( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet, wenn keine GUI' act = lv_error_content exp = 'ERROR: Could not read clipboard content' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_gui_frontend_services` bietet eine Schnittstelle zu verschiedenen Funktionen des Frontend-Rechners. `clipboard_get` ist eine einfache Methode, um Text aus der Zwischenablage zu lesen. CLASS zcl_frontend_file_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_selected_file_path
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_file_path) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_file_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_selected_file_path.
    DATA: lt_file_table TYPE filetable,
          lv_rc         TYPE i,
          lv_path       TYPE string.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog
      EXPORTING
        window_title            = 'Datei auswählen'
        default_extension       = '*.txt'
        default_filename        = 'test.txt'
        multiselection          = abap_false
      CHANGING
        file_table              = lt_file_table
        rc                      = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_dialog_failed = 1
        cntl_error              = 2
        error_no_gui            = 3
        OTHERS                  = 4.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_rc = 1.
      READ TABLE lt_file_table INDEX 1 INTO lv_path.
      rv_file_path = lv_path.
    ELSE.
      rv_file_path = 'ERROR: No file selected or GUI error'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_file_dialog( ).

        " In einem echten Unit-Test kann der Benutzer keine Datei auswählen.
        " Wir können hier nur prüfen, ob der Aufruf keine harte Exception wirft
        " und ob ein erwarteter Fehlerstring zurückkommt, wenn der Dialog abgebrochen wird.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dateipfad sollte nicht initial sein, wenn GUI verfügbar und Datei ausgewählt' act = lv_file_path ).
        " Oder, wenn der Dialog abgebrochen wird:
        " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet, wenn Dialog abgebrochen' act = lv_file_path exp = 'ERROR: No file selected or GUI error' ).

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Wenn keine GUI verfügbar ist, sollte eine Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden.
        lv_file_path = lo_cut->get_selected_file_path( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Fehlermeldung erwartet, wenn keine GUI' act = lv_file_path exp = 'ERROR: No file selected or GUI error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `file_open_dialog` bietet eine Standard-GUI-Funktionalität zum Auswählen von Dateien. Sie ist flexibel konfigurierbar (Titel, Standarderweiterung, Mehrfachauswahl) und gibt den oder die ausgewählten Pfade zurück. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist entscheidend, da der Benutzer den Dialog abbrechen oder keine GUI verfügbar sein könnte.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, File Dialog, Frontend, GUI, file_open_dialog

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, und zählen Sie die Anzahl der gefundenen Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` und `lines()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_and_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_and_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_from_city.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    rv_count = lines( VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_all WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ) ( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_and_count( ).
    DATA(lv_count_ny) = lo_cut->count_flights_from_city( 'NEW YORK' ).
    DATA(lv_count_fra) = lo_cut->count_flights_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).
    DATA(lv_count_nonexistent) = lo_cut->count_flights_from_city( 'NONEXISTENT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Anzahl NY-Flüge sollte > 0 sein' act = lv_count_ny exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Anzahl FRA-Flüge sollte > 0 sein' act = lv_count_fra exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl nicht existierender Flüge sollte 0 sein' act = lv_count_nonexistent exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine temporäre gefilterte Tabelle zu erstellen, mit der Funktion `lines()`, um die Anzahl der Einträge in dieser gefilterten Tabelle zu ermitteln. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Art, Filterung und Zählung in einem Schritt durchzuführen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, REDUCE, lines, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Counting

Instructions: Führen Sie eine externe Anwendung (z.B. Notepad) auf dem Frontend-Rechner aus und übergeben Sie optional einen Dateipfad als Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frontend_execute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_application
      IMPORTING
        iv_application_path TYPE string
        iv_parameters       TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_frontend_execute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_application.
    DATA lv_rc TYPE i.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute
      EXPORTING
        application        = iv_application_path
        parameter          = iv_parameters
        get_program_name   = abap_false
        get_program_path   = abap_false
        get_program_param  = abap_false
        maximized          = abap_false
        minimized          = abap_false

      IMPORTING
        return_code        = lv_rc
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error         = 1
        error_no_gui       = 2
        bad_parameter      = 3
        file_not_found     = 4
        OTHERS             = 5.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_rc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_execute_notepad.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_execute( ).
    DATA(lv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    " Pfad zu Notepad.exe kann je nach System variieren.
    " Für Linux/macOS wäre es ein anderer Befehl (z.B. 'gedit' oder 'open -a TextEdit').
    DATA(lv_notepad_path) TYPE string VALUE 'notepad.exe'.
    DATA(lv_test_file) TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\test.txt'. " Beispielpfad

    TRY.
        " Test ohne Parameter
        lv_success = lo_cut->execute_application( iv_application_path = lv_notepad_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Notepad sollte erfolgreich gestartet werden (ohne Parameter)' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

        " Test mit Parameter (Dateipfad)
        lv_success = lo_cut->execute_application( iv_application_path = lv_notepad_path iv_parameters = lv_test_file ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Notepad sollte erfolgreich mit Dateipfad gestartet werden' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Wenn keine GUI verfügbar ist, sollte die Ausführung fehlschlagen.
        lv_success = lo_cut->execute_application( iv_application_path = lv_notepad_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Ausführung sollte fehlschlagen, wenn keine GUI' act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
