explanation: Die Methode `execute` der Klasse `cl_gui_frontend_services` ermöglicht das Starten beliebiger externer Programme auf dem Frontend-Rechner. Dies ist eine mächtige Funktion für die Integration mit lokalen Anwendungen. Die Parameter `application` und `parameter` sind entscheidend für die Steuerung des externen Programms. Eine umfassende Fehlerbehandlung ist hier besonders wichtig, da viele externe Faktoren (Programm nicht gefunden, Berechtigungen) eine Rolle spielen können.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, Execute, Frontend, GUI, execute, External Application

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren Fluggesellschaft ('CARRID') in einer Liste von bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften enthalten ist, und geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einer `IN`-Bedingung, die auf einer internen Tabelle basiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_in_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_in_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrids.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_all
                                   WHERE ( carrid IN it_preferred_carrids ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_carrid_in_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_carrid_in_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_in_list( ).
    DATA lt_preferred_carrids TYPE zcl_filter_in_list=>tt_carrid.
    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_preferred_carrids.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_preferred_carrids.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrids( lt_preferred_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Gefilterte Flüge sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte in der Liste sein' act = xsdbool( ls_flight-carrid IN lt_preferred_carrids ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_preferred_carrids.
    APPEND 'XX' TO lt_preferred_carrids.
    DATA(lt_filtered_none) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrids( lt_preferred_carrids ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Keine Flüge erwartet für nicht existierende Carrids' act = lines( lt_filtered_none ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 kann der `IN`-Operator direkt im `WHERE`-Teil eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks verwendet werden, um zu prüfen, ob ein Wert in einer internen Tabelle enthalten ist. Dies vereinfacht die Syntax erheblich im Vergleich zu früheren Versionen, die eine explizite Schleife oder eine Hash-Tabelle erfordert hätten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, IN Operator, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, List Comparison

Instructions: Laden Sie eine Datei vom Frontend-Rechner auf den Applikationsserver hoch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frontend_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_file_to_app_server
      IMPORTING
        iv_frontend_path TYPE string
        iv_app_server_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_file_to_app_server.
    DATA: lv_file_length TYPE i,
          lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_frontend_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_false
      IMPORTING
        filelength              = lv_file_length
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error         = 1
        file_read_error         = 2
        no_batch                = 3
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 4
        invalid_type            = 5
        no_authority            = 6
        unknown_error           = 7
        bad_data_format         = 8
        cntl_error              = 9
        error_no_gui            = 10
        OTHERS                  = 11.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Inhalt auf Applikationsserver schreiben
    OPEN DATASET iv_app_server_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
        TRANSFER lv_line TO iv_app_server_path.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_app_server_path.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_upload_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_upload_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_upload( ).
    DATA(lv_frontend_path) TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\upload_test.txt'. " Beispielpfad
    DATA(lv_app_server_path) TYPE string VALUE '/tmp/upload_test_app.txt'. " Beispielpfad auf Applikationsserver
    DATA(lv_test_content) TYPE string VALUE 'Dies ist ein Testinhalt für den Upload.'.
    DATA(lv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    " Temporäre Datei auf Frontend erstellen (manuell oder durch ein anderes Tool)
    " Für diesen Unit-Test simulieren wir den Erfolg des GUI-Uploads.
    " In einer echten Testumgebung müsste die Datei existieren.

    " Erstellen einer Dummy-Datei auf dem Applikationsserver für den Test
    OPEN DATASET lv_app_server_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRANSFER 'Dummy content' TO lv_app_server_path.
      CLOSE DATASET lv_app_server_path.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " Hier wird angenommen, dass der GUI-Upload erfolgreich wäre.
        " Der eigentliche Upload kann im Unit-Test nicht simuliert werden.
        " Wir testen die Logik nach dem GUI-Aufruf.
        " Um den Test zu ermöglichen, müsste gui_upload gemockt werden.
        " Da dies nicht direkt möglich ist, wird hier nur der Aufruf getestet.
        lv_success = lo_cut->upload_file_to_app_server( iv_frontend_path = lv_frontend_path iv_app_server_path = lv_app_server_path ).
        " Erwartung: Wenn GUI verfügbar, sollte der Upload-Teil erfolgreich sein.
        " Wenn keine GUI, dann sollte es fehlschlagen.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Upload sollte erfolgreich sein, wenn GUI verfügbar' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

        " Überprüfen, ob die Datei auf dem Applikationsserver existiert (und Inhalt, falls simuliert)
        DATA lv_read_line TYPE string.
        OPEN DATASET lv_app_server_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          READ DATASET lv_app_server_path INTO lv_read_line.
          CLOSE DATASET lv_app_server_path.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Datei auf Applikationsserver sollte Inhalt haben' act = lv_read_line ).
        ELSE.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Datei auf Applikationsserver konnte nicht gelesen werden' ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        lv_success = lo_cut->upload_file_to_app_server( iv_frontend_path = lv_frontend_path iv_app_server_path = lv_app_server_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Upload sollte fehlschlagen, wenn keine GUI' act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Aufräumen: Datei auf Applikationsserver löschen
    DELETE DATASET lv_app_server_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `gui_upload` ist der Standardweg, um Dateien vom Frontend auf den Applikationsserver zu übertragen. Sie liest den Inhalt der Frontend-Datei in eine interne Tabelle, die dann auf dem Applikationsserver gespeichert werden kann. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist hier besonders wichtig, da viele externe Faktoren (Dateizugriff, GUI-Verbindung) den Prozess beeinflussen können. Das Schreiben auf den Applikationsserver erfolgt mit `OPEN DATASET` und `TRANSFER`.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, Upload, Frontend, Applikationsserver, GUI, gui_upload, OPEN DATASET, TRANSFER

Instructions: Laden Sie eine Datei vom Applikationsserver auf den Frontend-Rechner herunter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frontend_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_file_from_app_server
      IMPORTING
        iv_app_server_path TYPE string
        iv_frontend_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_file_from_app_server.
    DATA: lt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string,
          lv_file_length TYPE i.

    " Inhalt vom Applikationsserver lesen
    OPEN DATASET iv_app_server_path FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      READ DATASET iv_app_server_path INTO DATA(lv_line).
      DO.
        APPEND lv_line TO lt_file_content.
        READ DATASET iv_app_server_path INTO lv_line.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_app_server_path.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_frontend_path
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_false
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_write_error        = 1
        no_batch                = 2
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
        invalid_type            = 4
        no_authority            = 5
        unknown_error           = 6
        bad_data_format         = 7
        cntl_error              = 8
        error_no_gui            = 9
        OTHERS                  = 10.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_download_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_download( ).
    DATA(lv_app_server_path) TYPE string VALUE '/tmp/download_test_app.txt'. " Beispielpfad auf Applikationsserver
    DATA(lv_frontend_path) TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\download_test.txt'. " Beispielpfad auf Frontend
    DATA(lv_test_content) TYPE string VALUE 'Dies ist ein Testinhalt für den Download.'.
    DATA(lv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    " Erstellen einer Dummy-Datei auf dem Applikationsserver
    OPEN DATASET lv_app_server_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRANSFER lv_test_content TO lv_app_server_path.
      CLOSE DATASET lv_app_server_path.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lv_success = lo_cut->download_file_from_app_server( iv_app_server_path = lv_app_server_path iv_frontend_path = lv_frontend_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Download sollte erfolgreich sein, wenn GUI verfügbar' act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

        " In einem echten Test müsste hier geprüft werden, ob die Datei auf dem Frontend existiert und den korrekten Inhalt hat.
        " Dies ist im Unit-Test ohne GUI nicht direkt möglich.

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        lv_success = lo_cut->download_file_from_app_server( iv_app_server_path = lv_app_server_path iv_frontend_path = lv_frontend_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Download sollte fehlschlagen, wenn keine GUI' act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Aufräumen: Datei auf Applikationsserver löschen
    DELETE DATASET lv_app_server_path.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `gui_download` ist das Gegenstück zu `gui_upload` und dient dazu, Dateien vom Applikationsserver auf den Frontend-Rechner zu übertragen. Zuerst wird der Inhalt der Datei vom Applikationsserver in eine interne Tabelle gelesen (`OPEN DATASET`, `READ DATASET`), und dann wird diese Tabelle mittels `gui_download` an das Frontend gesendet. Auch hier ist eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung unerlässlich.
keywords: cl_gui_frontend_services, Download, Frontend, Applikationsserver, GUI, gui_download, OPEN DATASET, READ DATASET

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften dieser Flüge enthält, aber ohne Duplikate.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE #` und nutzen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle oder `DISTINCT` für die Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid_distinct TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_distinct_carrids_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_distinct_carrids) TYPE tt_carrid_distinct.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_distinct_carrids_from_city.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.

    rt_distinct_carrids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights_all
                                   WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ) ( flight-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_distinct_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_distinct_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_distinct_carrids) = lo_cut->get_distinct_carrids_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Distinct Carrids sollten nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_distinct_carrids ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-gt ).

    " Überprüfen, ob alle Einträge eindeutig sind (durch HASHED TABLE sichergestellt)
    " und ob sie tatsächlich von Frankfurt sind (indirekt durch den Filter).
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_ua) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_distinct_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      IF lv_carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_carrid = 'UA'.
        lv_count_ua = lv_count_ua + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH sollte einmal vorkommen' act = lv_count_lh exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'UA sollte einmal vorkommen' act = lv_count_ua exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FILTER` mit `VALUE #` und der Zuweisung an eine `HASHED TABLE` zur automatischen Entfernung von Duplikaten. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck iteriert über die gefilterten Flüge und extrahiert nur die `carrid`, die dann in die Hash-Tabelle eingefügt werden. Die Hash-Tabelle stellt durch ihren eindeutigen Schlüssel sicher, dass nur distinct Werte gespeichert werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um eindeutige Werte aus einer gefilterten Menge zu erhalten.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, HASHED TABLE, DISTINCT, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Duplicates

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache Informationsmeldung auf dem Frontend-Rechner an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box`.

CLASS zcl_frontend_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS show_info_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_title   TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD show_info_message.
    DATA lv_title TYPE string.
    IF iv_title IS INITIAL.
      lv_title = 'Information'.
    ELSE.
      lv_title = iv_title.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_box
      EXPORTING
        text          = iv_message
        title         = lv_title
        type          = cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_type_information
        buttons       = cl_gui_frontend_services=>message_button_ok
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error    = 1
        error_no_gui  = 2
        OTHERS        = 3.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. in System-Log schreiben
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Anzeigen der Nachricht' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_show_info_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_show_info_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_frontend_message( ).
    DATA(lv_test_message) = 'Dies ist eine Testnachricht.'.
    DATA(lv_test_title) = 'Testtitel'.

    TRY.
        " Der Aufruf sollte keine Exception werfen, wenn eine GUI verfügbar ist.
        " Die tatsächliche Anzeige der Message Box kann im Unit-Test nicht verifiziert werden.
        lo_cut->show_info_message( iv_message = lv_test_message iv_title = lv_test_title ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ). " Prüfen, ob kein Fehlercode zurückgegeben wurde

        lo_cut->show_info_message( iv_message = lv_test_message ). " Ohne Titel
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Wenn keine GUI verfügbar ist, sollte der Aufruf einen Fehler erzeugen.
        lo_cut->show_info_message( iv_message = lv_test_message ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc ). " Prüfen, ob ein Fehlercode zurückgegeben wurde
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `message_box` der Klasse `cl_gui_frontend_services` ist der Standardweg, um Dialogfenster mit Nachrichten auf dem Frontend anzuzeigen. Sie ist flexibel in Bezug auf Nachrichtentyp (Information, Warnung, Fehler), Titel und Schaltflächen. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Element für die Benutzerinteraktion in GUI-basierten ABAP-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS update_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_updated_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_field.
    rs_updated_data = is_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE rs_updated_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_update_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_update.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_struct_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Old Value 1'.
    ls_data-field2 = 'Old Value 2'.

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).
    DATA(ls_updated) = lo_accessor->update_field(
      is_data       = ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
      iv_new_value  = 'New Value'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-field1 exp = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-field2 exp = 'Old Value 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_update_invalid.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_dynamic_struct_access=>ty_data.
    ls_data-field1 = 'Old Value 1'.

    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).
    DATA(ls_updated) = lo_accessor->update_field(
      is_data       = ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
      iv_new_value  = 'Should Not Change'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_updated-field1 exp = 'Old Value 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die dynamische Programmierung, das es ermöglicht, auf Strukturkomponenten zuzugreifen, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine generische interne Tabelle (Typ `ANY TABLE`) akzeptiert und den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte in jeder Zeile dynamisch auf einen neuen Wert setzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS <FS_TABLE> TYPE ANY TABLE` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb des Loops.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_column
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table  TYPE any table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_table) TYPE any table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_wa> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rt_updated_table LIKE it_any_table.
    ASSIGN rt_updated_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    <fs_table> = it_any_table. " Copy content

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_wa>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generic_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_update.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    <fs_line>-id = 1.
    <fs_line>-text = 'Original Text 1'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    <fs_line>-id = 2.
    <fs_line>-text = 'Original Text 2'.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_generic_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_processor->update_table_column(
      it_any_table   = lt_data
      iv_column_name = 'TEXT'
      iv_new_value   = 'Updated Text'
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_updated_line> TYPE ty_test_data.
    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_updated_line> INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated_line>-text exp = 'Updated Text' ).
    READ TABLE lt_updated ASSIGNING <fs_updated_line> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated_line>-text exp = 'Updated Text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von `ANY TABLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` kann diese Methode mit jeder Art von interner Tabelle arbeiten, was eine hohe Flexibilität und Wiederverwendbarkeit ermöglicht.
keywords: FIELD-SYMBOLS, ANY TABLE, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle akzeptiert und deren Inhalt über ein `FIELD-SYMBOL` dereferenziert und verarbeitet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_data_ref_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_ref_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_wa> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_wa>.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
        " Further processing of <fs_wa> could happen here
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_process_table_ref.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_structure,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_structure.

    METHODS create_and_populate_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE any table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_wa> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_id> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_name> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF ty_structure.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_wa>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_id>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_id> = sy-index.
        ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_name>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_name> = |Item { sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table_ref) = lo_creator->create_and_populate_table( 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_generic> TYPE any table.
    ASSIGN lr_table_ref->* TO <fs_table_generic>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table_generic> ) exp = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_wa> TYPE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>ty_structure.
    READ TABLE <fs_table_generic> ASSIGNING <fs_wa> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_wa>-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_wa>-name exp = 'Item 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertiere einen String von der Codepage UTF-8 in die Codepage ISO-8859-1. Beachte, dass die Konvertierung von `string` zu `xstring` und zurück erforderlich ist.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_to`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cp_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso88591
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cp_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso88591.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_xstring_iso) TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string (UTF-8 internal) to xstring (UTF-8 external)
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_utf8_string
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8' "System's internal codepage is usually UTF-8 on modern systems
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_xstring_utf8
    ).

    " Convert xstring (UTF-8 external) to xstring (ISO-8859-1 external)
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_to(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_xstring_utf8
        source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        target_buffer   = lv_xstring_iso
    ).

    " Convert xstring (ISO-8859-1 external) back to string (UTF-8 internal)
    " Note: This assumes the resulting ISO-8859-1 content can be represented in UTF-8 without loss.
    " For actual binary data, you might return xstring directly.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_xstring_iso
        source_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        target          = rv_iso_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_codepage_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_codepage_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cp_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello World! ÄÖÜäöüß'. "Contains special characters"
    DATA(lv_converted_string) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_back_to_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_back_to_utf8_string) TYPE string.

    " Convert original string (UTF-8) to ISO-8859-1 representation
    lv_converted_string = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso88591( lv_original_string ).

    " To properly test, we need to convert the ISO-8859-1 string back to UTF-8
    " and compare with the original.
    " First, convert the original string to its UTF-8 xstring representation
    DATA(lv_original_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_original_string
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_original_utf8_xstring
    ).

    " Now, convert the 'ISO-8859-1' string (which is actually UTF-8 internally)
    " to its ISO-8859-1 xstring representation.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring_from_converted) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_converted_string
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1' "This is the crucial part: treat the string as if it's ISO-8859-1
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_iso_xstring_from_converted
    ).

    " Now, convert the ISO-8859-1 xstring back to UTF-8 xstring
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_to(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_iso_xstring_from_converted
        source_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        target_buffer   = lv_back_to_utf8_xstring
    ).

    " Finally, convert the UTF-8 xstring back to ABAP string
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_back_to_utf8_xstring
        source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        target          = lv_back_to_utf8_string
    ).

    " Assert that the round-trip conversion yields the original string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_back_to_utf8_string
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Round-trip conversion should match original string'
    ).

    " Test with a string that might lose information in ISO-8859-1 (e.g., Japanese characters)
    DATA(lv_japanese_string) = 'こんにちは'. "Japanese for "Hello"
    DATA(lv_converted_japanese) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_back_japanese_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_back_japanese_string) TYPE string.

    lv_converted_japanese = lo_cut->convert_utf8_to_iso88591( lv_japanese_string ).

    " Convert original Japanese string to UTF-8 xstring
    DATA(lv_original_japanese_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_japanese_string
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_original_japanese_utf8_xstring
    ).

    " Convert the 'ISO-8859-1' string (which is actually UTF-8 internally)
    " to its ISO-8859-1 xstring representation.
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring_from_converted_jp) TYPE xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = lv_converted_japanese
        target_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = lv_iso_xstring_from_converted_jp
    ).

    " Convert the ISO-8859-1 xstring back to UTF-8 xstring
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from_to(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_iso_xstring_from_converted_jp
        source_codepage = 'ISO-8859-1'
        target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        target_buffer   = lv_back_japanese_xstring
    ).

    " Convert the UTF-8 xstring back to ABAP string
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_back_japanese_xstring
        source_codepage = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        target          = lv_back_japanese_string
    ).

    " Assert that the Japanese string is NOT equal after conversion to ISO-8859-1 and back,
    " as ISO-8859-1 cannot represent these characters.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_back_japanese_string
      exp = lv_japanese_string
      msg = 'Japanese string should not match after ISO-8859-1 round-trip'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` ist essenziell für die korrekte Handhabung von Zeichenkodierungen, insbesondere beim Austausch von Daten mit externen Systemen. Die Konvertierung zwischen `string` (intern UTF-8) und `xstring` (externe Codepage) ist ein häufiges Szenario.
keywords: CODEPAGE, KONVERTIERUNG, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, STRING, XSTRING

Instructions: Konvertiere einen ABAP-String (`string`) in einen Binärstring (`xstring`) unter Verwendung einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. UTF-8).
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_to_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_string   TYPE string
        iv_codepage TYPE cpcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_to_xstr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_xstring.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source      = iv_string
        target_codepage = iv_codepage
      IMPORTING
        buffer      = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_str_to_xstr FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_str_to_xstr.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_to_xstr( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Test String mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_codepage_utf8) = 4103. "UTF-8"
    DATA(lv_codepage_iso) = 1100. "ISO-8859-1"

    " Convert to UTF-8 xstring
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
      iv_string   = lv_original_string
      iv_codepage = lv_codepage_utf8
    ).

    " Convert back to string to verify
    DATA(lv_back_string_utf8) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_xstring_utf8
        source_codepage = lv_codepage_utf8
      IMPORTING
        target          = lv_back_string_utf8
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_string_utf8 exp = lv_original_string ).

    " Convert to ISO-8859-1 xstring (might lose some characters if not representable)
    DATA(lv_xstring_iso) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
      iv_string   = lv_original_string
      iv_codepage = lv_codepage_iso
    ).

    " Convert back to string to verify (expect potential loss for some chars if not in ISO-8859-1)
    DATA(lv_back_string_iso) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_xstring_iso
        source_codepage = lv_codepage_iso
      IMPORTING
        target          = lv_back_string_iso
    ).
    " For 'ÄÖÜ', ISO-8859-1 can represent them, so it should be equal.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_back_string_iso exp = lv_original_string ).

    " Test with a character not representable in ISO-8859-1 (e.g., Euro sign €)
    DATA(lv_euro_string) = 'Preis: 100 €'.
    DATA(lv_xstring_euro_iso) = lo_cut->convert_string_to_xstring(
      iv_string   = lv_euro_string
      iv_codepage = lv_codepage_iso
    ).
    DATA(lv_back_string_euro_iso) TYPE string.
    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = lv_xstring_euro_iso
        source_codepage = lv_codepage_iso
      IMPORTING
        target          = lv_back_string_euro_iso
    ).
    " The Euro sign is often replaced by '?' or similar in ISO-8859-1 if not explicitly handled.
    " We expect it to be different.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_back_string_euro_iso exp = lv_euro_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `convert_to` von `cl_abap_codepage` ist der Standardweg, um ABAP-Strings in eine binäre Darstellung (`xstring`) unter Verwendung einer spezifischen Codepage zu überführen. Dies ist entscheidend für die Datenübertragung in verschiedenen Formaten.
keywords: CODEPAGE, KONVERTIERUNG, STRING, XSTRING, CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE

Instructions: Laden Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle und speichern Sie diese als CSV-Datei auf dem lokalen Desktop des Benutzers. Der Dateiname soll 'sflights_data.csv' sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` und String-Templates für den Dateipfad.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_desktop_path) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory( ).
      DATA(lv_file_path) = |{ lv_desktop_path }\sflights_data.csv|.

      cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
        EXPORTING
          filename                = lv_file_path
          filetype                = 'ASC'
          has_field_separator     = abap_true
        CHANGING
          data_tab                = lt_sflights
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS                  = 1
      ).

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei.' TYPE 'E'.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE |Datei '{ lv_file_path }' erfolgreich heruntergeladen.| TYPE 'S'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine hierarchische Ansicht von Fluggesellschaften und deren Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in einem `cl_gui_list_tree` an. Die Fluggesellschaften sollen die Wurzelknoten sein, und die einzelnen Flüge die Kindknoten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_list_tree`, `add_node` und `add_item` in einem `cl_gui_custom_container`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lst_sflights_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lst_sflights_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY sflight-carrid ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = |NODE_{ lv_node_key }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = ' '
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_node_text      = lv_carrid
        i_node_key       = lv_parent_key
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        DATA(lv_child_key) = |NODE_{ lv_node_key }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
          i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_node_text      = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto }|
          i_node_key       = lv_child_key
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'NODE_1' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'NODE_1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_cut->mo_tree msg = 'List Tree Objekt sollte gebunden sein' ).

CLASS zcl_lst_sflights_tree_ext DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_lst_sflights_tree_ext IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE string_table( FOR sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY sflight-carrid ( sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_parent_key) = |NODE_{ lv_node_key }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = ' '
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_node_text      = lv_carrid
        i_node_key       = lv_parent_key
      ).

      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        DATA(lv_child_key) = |NODE_{ lv_node_key }|.
        mo_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_key
          i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_node_text      = |Flug { ls_sflight-connid }|
          i_node_key       = lv_child_key
        ).

        DATA(ls_flight_data) = VALUE ty_flight_data(
          carrid  = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid  = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate  = ls_sflight-fldate
          deptime = ls_sflight-deptime
          arrtime = ls_sflight-arrtime
        ).
        mo_tree->set_item_data(
          i_node_key = lv_child_key

        mo_tree->set_item_tooltip(
          i_node_key = lv_child_key
          i_item_name = 'FLIGHT_DETAILS'
          i_tooltip = |Flug: { ls_sflight-connid }, Datum: { ls_sflight-fldate }, Abflug: { ls_sflight-deptime }, Ankunft: { ls_sflight-arrtime }|
        ).
      ENDLOOP.

    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'NODE_1' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'NODE_1' ).

Instructions: Öffnen Sie eine vorgegebene URL ('https://www.sap.com') im Standard-Webbrowser des Frontend-PCs.

CLASS zcl_fes_open_url IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://www.sap.com'.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute(
      EXPORTING
        application = lv_url
        operation   = 'OPEN'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS      = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `cl_gui_list_tree`, das es dem Benutzer ermöglicht, über eine Eingabeaufforderung neue Knoten hinzuzufügen. Der neue Knoten soll immer als Kind des 'Root Node' hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gui_list_tree` mit `cl_gui_frontend_services=>input_dialog` in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lst_dynamic_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS add_nodes_interactively.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lst_dynamic_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = ' '
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Root Node'
      i_node_key       = 'ROOT'
    ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_nodes_interactively.
    DATA(lv_input) = ''.
    DATA(lv_title) = 'Neuen Knoten hinzufügen'.
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Geben Sie den Text für den neuen Knoten ein (oder leer zum Beenden):'.

    DO.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>input_dialog(
        EXPORTING
          title         = lv_title
          text          = lv_text
        CHANGING
          result        = lv_input
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS        = 1
      ).

      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_input IS INITIAL.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      mv_node_counter = mv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_new_node_key) = |CHILD_{ mv_node_counter }|.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT'
        i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_node_text      = lv_input
        i_node_key       = lv_new_node_key
      ).
      mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
      MESSAGE |Knoten '{ lv_input }' hinzugefügt.| TYPE 'S'.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `cl_gui_list_tree` und implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die alle Knoten des Baumes expandiert und anschließend wieder kollabiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `expand_node` und `collapse_node` in einer Schleife über alle Knoten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_lst_expand_collapse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS toggle_expansion.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mt_node_keys TYPE cl_gui_list_tree=>t_node_key_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lst_expand_collapse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " Beispielknoten hinzufügen
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = ' '
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Root Node 1'
      i_node_key       = 'ROOT1'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT1'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Child 1.1'
      i_node_key       = 'CHILD1_1'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'CHILD1_1'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Grandchild 1.1.1'
      i_node_key       = 'GCHILD1_1_1'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = ' '
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Root Node 2'
      i_node_key       = 'ROOT2'
    ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT1' ).

    " Alle Knoten-Keys sammeln
    mo_tree->get_all_node_keys( IMPORTING et_node_key_table = mt_node_keys ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD toggle_expansion.
    " Alle Knoten expandieren
    LOOP AT mt_node_keys INTO DATA(lv_node_key).
      mo_tree->expand_node( lv_node_key ).
    ENDLOOP.
    MESSAGE 'Alle Knoten expandiert.' TYPE 'S'.

    WAIT UP TO 2 SECONDS.

    " Alle Knoten kollabieren
    LOOP AT mt_node_keys INTO lv_node_key.
      mo_tree->collapse_node( lv_node_key ).
    ENDLOOP.
    MESSAGE 'Alle Knoten kollabiert.' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_expansion_collapse FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expansion_collapse.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'TEST_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_lst_expand_collapse( lo_container ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_cut->mo_tree msg = 'List Tree Objekt sollte gebunden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_cut->mt_node_keys msg = 'Knoten-Keys sollten gesammelt sein' ).

    " Direkter Test von expand/collapse ist im Unit-Test schwierig.
    " Hier wird die korrekte Initialisierung und das Sammeln der Knoten-Keys geprüft.
    " Die Methode toggle_expansion() würde eine GUI-Interaktion auslösen.

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es verwendet die Methoden `expand_node` und `collapse_node` in einer Schleife über alle gesammelten Knoten-Keys. Die `WAIT`-Anweisung dient der Visualisierung.     mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'VEHICLES'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Auto: BMW'
      i_node_key       = 'CAR_BMW'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'VEHICLES'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Motorrad: Harley'
      i_node_key       = 'MOTOR_HARLEY'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'VEHICLES'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Fahrrad: Mountainbike'
      i_node_key       = 'BIKE_MTB'
    ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'VEHICLES' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'VEHICLES' ).

    mo_tree->get_all_node_keys( IMPORTING et_node_key_table = mt_node_keys ).

    gs_text_style-color = cl_gui_list_tree=>style_color_yellow.
    gs_text_style-style = cl_gui_list_tree=>style_bold.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD search_nodes.
    " Zuerst alle Hervorhebungen entfernen
    LOOP AT mt_node_keys INTO DATA(lv_node_key).
      mo_tree->set_node_text_style(
        i_node_key = lv_node_key
        i_item_name = ' '
        i_text_style = VALUE #( color = cl_gui_list_tree=>style_color_default style = cl_gui_list_tree=>style_normal )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF iv_search_term IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Suchbegriff ist leer. Hervorhebungen entfernt.' TYPE 'I'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_found_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT mt_node_keys INTO lv_node_key.
      DATA(lv_node_text) = mo_tree->get_node_text( lv_node_key ).
      IF lv_node_text CP |*{ iv_search_term }*|.
        mo_tree->set_node_text_style(
          i_node_key = lv_node_key
          i_item_name = ' '
          i_text_style = gs_text_style
        ).
        lv_found_count = lv_found_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found_count > 0.
      MESSAGE |{ lv_found_count } Knoten gefunden und hervorgehoben.| TYPE 'S'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE |Keine Knoten für '{ iv_search_term }' gefunden.| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge aus der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden, in eine interne Zieltabelle ein. Verwenden Sie dabei den `FOR`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `INSERT` in einer Schleife oder direkt mit `VALUE` für die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_s,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_flight_s.
    TYPES tt_flights_s TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_s WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_flights_from_db
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_s.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_from_db.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      WHERE fldate >= iv_min_fldate.

    " Iteration über die gefilterten Flüge und Einfügen in die Zieltabelle
    LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      INSERT VALUE #( " Erstellt eine neue Zeile und fügt sie ein
        carrid    = <fs_sflight>-carrid
        connid    = <fs_sflight>-connid
        fldate    = <fs_sflight>-fldate
        planetype = <fs_sflight>-planetype
      ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_for FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_for.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten vorhanden sind
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_today price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = lv_today + 1 price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = lv_today - 1 price = '200.00' currency = 'GBP' planetype = 'C130' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->insert_flights_from_db( iv_min_fldate = lv_today ).

    " Erwartet 2 Flüge (heute und morgen)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' INTO DATA(ls_flight3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( sy-subrc ). " Sollte nicht gefunden werden

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'. " Aufräumen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl der `FOR`-Operator selbst keine `INSERT`-Funktionalität bietet, kann er hervorragend genutzt werden, um die Datenquelle zu filtern und vorzubereiten. Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` Syntax in Kombination mit `INSERT VALUE #(...)` innerhalb der Schleife ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, gefilterte Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle zu übertragen.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, FOR, LOOP, Field Symbol, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein. Die Zieltabelle soll dabei Duplikate (basierend auf dem Primärschlüssel) ignorieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS insert_unique_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_lines_of IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_items.
    " Initialisierung der Zieltabelle
    rt_target_items = VALUE #( 
      ( id = 1 text = 'Initial Item 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Initial Item 2' )
    ).

    " Einfügen von Zeilen aus der Quelltabelle, Duplikate werden ignoriert
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_items INTO TABLE rt_target_items ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_unique FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_unique.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_lines_of( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_lines_of=>tt_items(
      ( id = 2 text = 'Duplicate Item 2' ) " Duplikat-ID
      ( id = 3 text = 'New Item 3' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'New Item 4' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->insert_unique_items( lt_source_items = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 ). " 2 initial + 2 neue
    READ TABLE lt_target WITH KEY id = 2 INTO DATA(ls_item2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-text exp = 'Initial Item 2' ). " Original sollte erhalten bleiben
    READ TABLE lt_target WITH KEY id = 3 INTO DATA(ls_item3).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist die effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einzufügen, insbesondere wenn die Zieltabelle einen eindeutigen Schlüssel hat und Duplikate ignoriert werden sollen. Dies ist performanter als eine Schleife mit Einzel-`INSERT`s.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, Duplicates, Unique Key, Sorted Table

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... FROM ...` mit einer Workarea.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flight_record
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_price    TYPE s_price
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
        iv_planetype TYPE s_planety
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight_record.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( " Workarea mit Daten füllen
      carrid    = iv_carrid
      connid    = iv_connid
      fldate    = iv_fldate
      price     = iv_price
      currency  = iv_currency
      planetype = iv_planetype
    ).

    " Einfügen des Datensatzes in die Datenbanktabelle
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_db_single FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_db_single.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Vorherige Datensätze aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_record(
      iv_carrid   = lv_carrid
      iv_connid   = lv_connid
      iv_fldate   = lv_fldate
      iv_price    = '100.00'
      iv_currency = 'EUR'
      iv_planetype = 'TEST'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    " Einfügung überprüfen
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-planetype exp = 'TEST' ).

    " Testen einer doppelten Einfügung (sollte fehlschlagen)
    lv_success = lo_cut->insert_flight_record(
      iv_carrid   = lv_carrid
      iv_connid   = lv_connid
      iv_fldate   = lv_fldate
      iv_price    = '200.00'
      iv_currency = 'USD'
      iv_planetype = 'TEST2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT` Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen ist der Standardweg, um einzelne Zeilen hinzuzufügen. Die Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators zur Initialisierung der Workarea macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer. Die Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` ist entscheidend, um den Erfolg der Datenbankoperation zu bestätigen.
keywords: INSERT, Database, SFLIGHT, Workarea, sy-subrc

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit in einer Variablen gespeichert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamischer Zugriff auf eine Komponente der Struktur
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_component( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE zcl_assign_component=>ty_data(
      field1 = 'Wert 1'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = '20231207'
    ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Wert 1' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value_not_found) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value_not_found exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`-Anweisung ist essenziell für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Komponenten einer Struktur, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was für generische Verarbeitungsroutinen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field Symbol, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Component

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über die Spalten einer internen Tabelle und lesen Sie deren Werte aus. Die Spaltennamen sind zur Laufzeit bekannt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_itab_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
             col3 TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE tt_data
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_itab_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_column_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_col_name>).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_col_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND |{ <fs_col_name> }: { <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
        ELSE.
          APPEND |{ <fs_col_name> }: Feld nicht gefunden| TO rt_values.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Ändern Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch über ein Feldsymbol, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO <fs>` und weisen Sie dann dem Feldsymbol einen neuen Wert zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS modify_dynamic_field
      CHANGING
        cs_data     TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamischer Zugriff auf das zu ändernde Feld
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Wert des Feldsymbols ändern
      <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine Zeile in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge automatisch beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...`. Bei sortierten Tabellen wird die Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position eingefügt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_into_sorted_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_key_field TYPE i
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_into_sorted_table.
    " Initialisierung einer sortierten Tabelle
    rt_data = VALUE #( 
      ( key_field = 10 value = 'Zehn' )
      ( key_field = 30 value = 'Dreißig' )
      ( key_field = 20 value = 'Zwanzig' ) " Wird beim Einfügen sortiert
    ).

    " Einfügen einer neuen Zeile. Die Tabelle bleibt sortiert.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = iv_key_field value = iv_value )
      INTO TABLE rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sorted FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_sorted_itab( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->insert_into_sorted_table(
      iv_key_field = 25
      iv_value     = 'Fünfundzwanzig'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-key_field exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-key_field exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-key_field exp = 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[4]-key_field exp = 30 ).

    " Testen des Einfügens eines Duplikats (sollte Fehler verursachen, da UNIQUE KEY)
    TRY.
        lo_cut->insert_into_sorted_table(
          iv_key_field = 20
          iv_value     = 'Duplikat'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception für Duplikat erwartet' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_duplicate_key.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception für Duplikat korrekt abgefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei sortierten internen Tabellen (SORTED TABLE) fügt die `INSERT`-Anweisung eine neue Zeile automatisch an der korrekten Position ein, um die Sortierreihenfolge beizubehalten. Dies ist effizienter und weniger fehleranfällig, als eine Standardtabelle zu füllen und anschließend zu sortieren. Bei UNIQUE KEY wird eine Exception ausgelöst, wenn ein Duplikat eingefügt werden soll.
keywords: INSERT, Internal Table, Sorted Table, Unique Key, Automatic Sorting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei die Struktur der Tabelle zur Laufzeit definiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_itab
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " Dynamische Definition der Struktur
    LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_name>).
      ls_component-name = <fs_name>.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Alle Felder als STRING
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Dynamische Erstellung der internen Tabelle
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lr_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    " Dynamisches Füllen der Tabelle
    DO 3 TIMES. " Beispiel: 3 Zeilen
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>).

      LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING <fs_name>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = |{ <fs_name> }_Wert_{ sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_wa> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_itab_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_itab_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab_create( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD_A' ) ( 'FIELD_B' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_itab( it_field_names = lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_dynamic_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_dynamic_field> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_dynamic_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_dynamic_field> exp = 'FIELD_A_Wert_1' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO <fs_dynamic_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_dynamic_field> exp = 'FIELD_B_Wert_1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Mit `cl_abap_structdescr` wird die Struktur einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit definiert. `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` erzeugt dann die Tabelle und die Workarea. `ASSIGN` ist hierbei unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erzeugten Datenobjekte zuzugreifen und sie zu füllen. Dies ist ein Kernkonzept für generische Frameworks und Tools.
keywords: ASSIGN, CREATE DATA, Dynamic Programming, Internal Table, RTTI, Field Symbol

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile an einer bestimmten Position (Index) in eine Standardtabelle ein.

CLASS zcl_insert_at_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.

    METHODS insert_item_at_index
      IMPORTING

        iv_text  TYPE string
        iv_index TYPE i

      ( id = 10 text = 'Erster Eintrag' )
      ( id = 30 text = 'Dritter Eintrag' )
    ).

    INSERT VALUE #( id = iv_id text = iv_text )
      INTO TABLE rt_items INDEX iv_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Methode eines Objekts zu und rufen Sie diese auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für die Objektreferenz und dann `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS method_b
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE i.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string " Für Einfachheit: alle Parameter als String übergeben
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = iv_input * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr,
          lt_parameters   TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter    TYPE abap_parmbind.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result> TYPE any.

    " Dynamische Methodenbeschreibung abrufen
    lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
    lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

    IF lo_method_descr IS BOUND.
      " Parameter binden
      LOOP AT lo_method_descr->parameters INTO DATA(ls_meth_param) WHERE parameter_kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>param_kind_importing.
        ls_parameter-name = ls_meth_param-name.
        ls_parameter-kind = abap_parmbind_kind=>importing.
        IF ls_meth_param-type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        ELSEIF ls_meth_param-type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
          DATA(lv_int_value) TYPE i VALUE 0.
          TRY.
              lv_int_value = iv_param_value.
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
              " Fehlerbehandlung
          ENDTRY.
          GET REFERENCE OF lv_int_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
      ENDLOOP.

      " Methode dynamisch aufrufen
      CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
        PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
        RECEIVING PARAMETER INTO <fs_result>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_result = <fs_result>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    " Test method_a
    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A'
      iv_param_value = 'Hello'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_a exp = 'Method A called with: Hello' ).

    " Test method_b
    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'METHOD_B'
      iv_param_value = '5'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_b exp = '10' ).

    " Test non-existent method
    DATA(lv_result_c) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method(
      io_object      = lo_cut
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
      iv_param_value = ''
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result_c ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object PARAMETER-TABLE ...` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Architekturen. In Kombination mit RTTI (`cl_abap_classdescr`, `cl_abap_methdescr`) können Methoden und deren Parameter zur Laufzeit inspiziert und aufgerufen werden. `ASSIGN` wird hier implizit für die Parameterübergabe und das Empfangen des Rückgabewerts verwendet.
keywords: ASSIGN, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Object Orientation, Method Call

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die nur die Felder einer anderen Tabelle enthält, die in einer Feldliste angegeben sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... CORRESPONDING #( ... )` mit einer Feldliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_with_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_data) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_with_corresponding.
    LOOP AT it_source_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
      " Einfügen mit CORRESPONDING, um nur passende Felder zu übertragen
      INSERT CORRESPONDING #( <fs_source> ) INTO TABLE rt_target_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_corresponding=>tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' status = 'X' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' status = ' ' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->insert_with_corresponding( it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[1]-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[1]-status ). " Status-Feld existiert in Ziel nicht

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[2]-name exp = 'Item B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT CORRESPONDING #( ... )`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Methode, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen, aber teilweise übereinstimmenden Strukturen zu übertragen. Sie kopiert automatisch Felder mit identischen Namen und ignoriert nicht übereinstimmende Felder, was den Code kompakter und wartungsfreundlicher macht als manuelle Zuweisungen.
