Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` mit einer Flugdauer (FLTIME) über 180 Minuten und berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis dieser gefilterten Flüge. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und den `DIVIDE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` für die Selektion und anschließend `REDUCE` oder manuelle Aggregation mit `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_price_long_flights RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_long_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_long_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( fltime > 180 AND price > 0 )
      ( flight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_long_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_long_flights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price DIVIDE lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf `sflights`, die für jeden Flug den Preis pro Sitzplatz (`PRICE / SEATSMAX`) enthält. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und dem `DIVIDE` Operator. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass `SEATSMAX` 0 ist, indem Sie dann 0 als Preis pro Sitzplatz setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und dem `DIVIDE` Operator. Denken Sie an die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_per_seat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_per_seat,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price_per_seat TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_price_per_seat.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_per_seat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_per_seat WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_prices_per_seat RETURNING VALUE(rt_prices) TYPE tt_flight_price_per_seat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_per_seat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_prices_per_seat.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             fldate = flight-fldate,
                             price_per_seat = COND decfloat16(
                                                WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN flight-price DIVIDE flight-seatsmax
                                                ELSE 0
                                              )
                           ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_prices_per_seat FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_prices_per_seat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_price_per_seat( ).
    DATA(lt_prices) = lo_cut->get_prices_per_seat( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_prices ) exp = 0 msg = 'Table should not be empty' ).

    LOOP AT lt_prices INTO DATA(ls_price).
      IF ls_price-price_per_seat > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_price-price_per_seat > 0 ) msg = 'Price per seat should be positive for valid flights' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative und sehr kompakte Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb des `VALUE`-Ausdrucks behandelt elegant die Division durch Null, was den Code robust und lesbar macht. Der `DIVIDE`-Operator wird für die Berechnung verwendet.
keywords: VALUE, Internal Tables, FOR, DIVIDE, COND, Table Construction, sflights

    METHODS get_mime_type_by_extension
      IMPORTING iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_by_extension.
    rv_mime_type = SWITCH string(
      iv_extension
      WHEN 'pdf'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_pdf
      WHEN 'txt'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_text_plain
      WHEN 'jpg'  THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_image_jpeg
      WHEN 'xslfo' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_xslfo_supplementary
      ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>s_application_octet_stream
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Preis pro Sitzplatz für einen Flug. Falls die Anzahl der Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) 0 ist, soll der Wert 0 zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten der Preis (`PRICE`) geteilt durch die Sitze. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden und den `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_per_seat
      IMPORTING iv_price    TYPE s_price
                iv_seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price_per_seat) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_per_seat.
    rv_price_per_seat = COND decfloat16(
      WHEN iv_seatsmax > 0 THEN iv_price DIVIDE iv_seatsmax
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_per_seat FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_per_seat.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_divide( ).

    " Testfall: Normale Division
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->calculate_price_per_seat( iv_price = 100 iv_seatsmax = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 10 msg = 'Normal division failed' ).

    " Testfall: Division durch Null
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->calculate_price_per_seat( iv_price = 100 iv_seatsmax = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 0 msg = 'Division by zero should return 0' ).

    " Testfall: Negative Sitze (sollte auch 0 zurückgeben, da > 0 Bedingung)
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->calculate_price_per_seat( iv_price = 100 iv_seatsmax = -5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 0 msg = 'Negative seats should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf einer Bedingung in einer einzigen Zeile. Dies ist ideal für die kompakte Implementierung von bedingten Logiken, wie hier die Vermeidung einer Division durch Null, und verbessert die Lesbarkeit im Vergleich zu einer klassischen `IF`-Anweisung.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, DIVIDE, Error Handling, Inline Expression

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein spezifischer Flug (z.B. Lufthansa, Flug 0400 am 28.02.1995) in `sflights` existiert. Falls vorhanden, geben Sie den Preis pro Sitzplatz (`PRICE / SEATSMAX`) zurück. Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und den `DIVIDE` Operator. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass `SEATSMAX` 0 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` oder `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_per_seat_for_flight
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price_per_seat) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_per_seat_for_flight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = iv_carrid
      connid = iv_connid
      fldate = iv_fldate
    ).

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] ).
      DATA(ls_flight) = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ].
      rv_price_per_seat = COND decfloat16(
        WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_flight-price DIVIDE ls_flight-seatsmax
        ELSE 0
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_price_per_seat = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_with_zero_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_price_per_seat_for_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '19950228' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_price > 0 ) msg = 'Price per seat should be positive for existing flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_price_per_seat_for_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 0 msg = 'Price per seat should be 0 for non-existing flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_with_zero_seats.
    " Annahme: Es gibt einen Flug mit 0 Sitzen oder wir simulieren ihn
    " Für diesen Test fügen wir einen Dummy-Flug ein, falls keiner existiert
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AZ'.
    ls_sflight-connid = '0001'.
    ls_sflight-fldate = '20250101'.
    ls_sflight-price = 100.
    ls_sflight-seatsmax = 0.
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_price_per_seat_for_flight( iv_carrid = 'AZ' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 0 msg = 'Price per seat should be 0 for flight with zero seats' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = '20250101'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ausdrücke `LINE_EXISTS` und der Tabellen-Ausdruck `itab[ ... ]` sind moderne Wege, um das Vorhandensein von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und direkt auf diese zuzugreifen. In Kombination mit `COND` und dem `DIVIDE`-Operator wird eine robuste und lesbare Lösung für die Berechnung des Preises pro Sitzplatz bereitgestellt, die auch die Division durch Null sicher handhabt.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, DIVIDE, COND, sflights, Table Expressions

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Flugstruktur (`sflights`) in eine benutzerdefinierte Zielstruktur. Dabei soll das Feld `PRICE` durch `SEATSMAX` geteilt werden, um `PRICE_PER_SEAT` zu erhalten. Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und dem `DIVIDE` Operator. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass `SEATSMAX` 0 ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` und dem `DIVIDE` Operator. Denken Sie an die Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             price_per_seat TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_target.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING
                                   carrier_id = carrid
                                   connection_id = connid
                                   flight_date = fldate
                                   price_per_seat = COND decfloat16(
                                                      WHEN is_source-seatsmax > 0 THEN is_source-price DIVIDE is_source-seatsmax
                                                      ELSE 0
                                                    )
                               ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mapping_normal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mapping_zero_seats FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_divide( ).
    DATA ls_source TYPE sflights.
    ls_source-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_source-connid = '0400'.
    ls_source-fldate = '19950228'.
    ls_source-price = 1000.
    ls_source-seatsmax = 100.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_flight_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-carrier_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-connection_id exp = '0400' msg = 'Connection ID mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-flight_date exp = '19950228' msg = 'Flight Date mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-price_per_seat exp = 10 msg = 'Price per seat calculation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mapping_zero_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_divide( ).
    DATA ls_source TYPE sflights.
    ls_source-carrid = 'UA'.
    ls_source-connid = '0001'.
    ls_source-fldate = '20250101'.
    ls_source-price = 500.
    ls_source-seatsmax = 0.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_flight_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-price_per_seat exp = 0 msg = 'Price per seat should be 0 for zero seats' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Gruppieren Sie die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Sitzplatz (`PRICE / SEATSMAX`). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `DIVIDE` Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und innerhalb der Gruppe `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price_per_seat TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_price_per_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_per_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR flight IN GROUP <fs_group> WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 0 )
        NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-price DIVIDE flight-seatsmax )
      ).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
        INIT count = 0
        FOR flight IN GROUP <fs_group> WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 0 )
        NEXT count = count + 1
      ).

      DATA ls_result TYPE ty_carrier_avg_price.
      ls_result-carrid = <fs_group>-carrid.
      IF lv_flight_count > 0.
        ls_result-avg_price_per_seat = lv_total_price DIVIDE lv_flight_count.
      ELSE.
        ls_result-avg_price_per_seat = 0.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_result TO rt_result.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             price TYPE s_price,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_per_seat
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_per_seat.
    DATA(lv_total_price_per_seat) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 0 )
      NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-price DIVIDE flight-seatsmax )
    ).

    DATA(lv_valid_flight_count) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights WHERE ( flight-seatsmax > 0 )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).

    IF lv_valid_flight_count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price_per_seat DIVIDE lv_valid_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den Durchschnitt eines numerischen Feldes aus einer internen Tabelle berechnet. Der Feldname und die interne Tabelle werden als Parameter übergeben. Verwenden Sie RTTI und den `DIVIDE` Operator. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass das Feld nicht numerisch ist oder die Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_elemdescr`) um auf Feldwerte zuzugreifen und `REDUCE` mit `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_dynamic_average
      IMPORTING it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING   cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_average.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE decfloat16 VALUE 0,
          lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data )->get_table_line_type( )->get_structure_type( ).
    DATA(lo_comp_descr) = lo_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).

    IF lo_comp_descr->is_numeric( ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' ist nicht numerisch.|.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      DATA(lv_value) = <fs_line>-(iv_field_name).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_value.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum DIVIDE lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_codepage_converter_error` ab.

CLASS zcl_cpg_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_with_error_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string    TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result)   TYPE REF TO data. " xstring on success, string with error message on failure
    METHODS get_error_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_with_error_check.
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    CLEAR mv_error_message.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
          EXPORTING
            source          = iv_input_string
            target_codepage = iv_target_codepage
          IMPORTING
            buffer          = lv_xstring
        ).
        GET REFERENCE OF lv_xstring INTO rs_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        mv_error_message = lx_error->get_text( ).
        GET REFERENCE OF mv_error_message INTO rs_result.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = mv_error_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_detect_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_encoding
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_codepage) TYPE abap_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_detect_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_encoding.
    TRY.
        rv_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage(
          EXPORTING
            buffer = iv_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        " Fallback or default if detection fails
        rv_codepage = '4103'. " Default to UTF-8 if detection fails
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine `xstring` im UTF-8-Format, um sie als CSV-Datei herunterzuladen. Jede Zeile der Tabelle soll dabei in eine Zeile der `xstring` konvertiert werden, getrennt durch Zeilenumbrüche.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` in einer Schleife und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_table_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_lines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_table_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_to_utf8.
    DATA(lv_string_buffer) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_crlf) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_tab) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab. " Using tab for CSV-like output

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_string_buffer = lv_string_buffer &&
                         |{ ls_sflight-carrid }{ lv_tab }| &&
                         |{ ls_sflight-connid }{ lv_tab }| &&
                         |{ ls_sflight-fldate }{ lv_tab }| &&
                         |{ ls_sflight-price }{ lv_tab }| &&
                         |{ ls_sflight-currency }{ lv_crlf }|.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      EXPORTING
        source          = lv_string_buffer
        target_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = rv_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

category: File Handling, Internal Tables, Character Encoding
Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer hochgeladenen CSV-Datei (als `xstring` im UTF-8-Format) zurück in eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` und dann `SPLIT` oder `READ TABLE` für die Zeilenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_utf8_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_utf8_to_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_lines.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_utf8_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_sflights.
    DATA(lv_string_buffer) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_crlf) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_tab) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = iv_xstring
        source_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = lv_string_buffer
    ).

    DATA(lt_lines) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_string_buffer AT lv_crlf INTO TABLE lt_lines.

    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight_line.
      SPLIT lv_line AT lv_tab INTO
        ls_sflight-carrid
        ls_sflight-connid
        ls_sflight-fldate
        ls_sflight-price
        ls_sflight-currency.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine `xstring` (UTF-8) mit Windows-Zeilenumbrüchen (CRLF) in einen ABAP-String und ersetzen Sie dabei die CRLF-Sequenzen durch Unix-Zeilenumbrüche (LF).
hint: Konvertieren Sie zuerst die `xstring` in einen ABAP-String und verwenden Sie dann `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` für die Zeilenumbrüche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_line_endings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_crlf_to_lf
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring_crlf TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_lf) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_line_endings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_crlf_to_lf.
    DATA(lv_string_crlf) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_crlf) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_lf) TYPE string VALUE cl_abap_char_utilities=>lf.

    cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      EXPORTING
        source_buffer   = iv_xstring_crlf
        source_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      IMPORTING
        buffer          = lv_string_crlf
    ).

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_crlf IN lv_string_crlf WITH lv_lf.
    rv_string_lf = lv_string_crlf.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP-String in eine `xstring` mit einem bestimmten Zeichensatz und anschließend wieder zurück in einen ABAP-String. Überprüfen Sie, ob der ursprüngliche und der zurückkonvertierte String identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_integrity_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_conversion_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_codepage     TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_integrity_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_conversion_integrity.
    DATA(lv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_converted_back_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
          EXPORTING
            source          = iv_input_string
            target_codepage = iv_codepage
          IMPORTING
            buffer          = lv_xstring
        ).

        cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
          EXPORTING
            source_buffer   = lv_xstring
            source_codepage = iv_codepage
          IMPORTING
            buffer          = lv_converted_back_string
        ).

        IF iv_input_string = lv_converted_back_string.
          rv_is_identical = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_identical = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
        rv_is_identical = abap_false. " Conversion error means not identical
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFlight) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität in der Economy Class haben und geben Sie nur die Flugnummern zurück. Protokollieren Sie, wenn keine Flüge gefunden wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `FILTER` und `VALUE` für die Transformation. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG` für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_type    TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE seatsmax >= @iv_min_capacity.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      log_message( iv_message = |Keine Flüge mit Mindestkapazität { iv_min_capacity } gefunden.| iv_type = 'W' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_connids = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity )
                             ( flight-connid ) ).

    IF rt_connids IS INITIAL.
      log_message( iv_message = |Nach Filterung keine Flüge mit Mindestkapazität { iv_min_capacity } gefunden.| iv_type = 'W' ).
    ELSE.
      log_message( iv_message = |{ lines( rt_connids ) } Flüge mit Mindestkapazität { iv_min_capacity } gefunden.| iv_type = 'S' ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG' " Example message class
      i_msgno = '001'  " Example message number
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Begrüßungsnachricht basierend auf der Tageszeit (Morgen, Mittag, Abend) und einem optionalen Benutzernamen. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und den `COND`-Operator. Protokollieren Sie die generierte Nachricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Formatierung und `COND` für die bedingte Logik. `SY-UZEIT` kann für die Tageszeit verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_greeting_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_username TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_time_ranges,
        morning_start TYPE sy-uzeit VALUE '060000',
        noon_start    TYPE sy-uzeit VALUE '120000',
        evening_start TYPE sy-uzeit VALUE '180000',
        night_start   TYPE sy-uzeit VALUE '220000',
      END OF gc_time_ranges.

    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_type    TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_time_of_day) = COND string(
      WHEN lv_current_time >= gc_time_ranges-morning_start AND lv_current_time < gc_time_ranges-noon_start    THEN 'Guten Morgen'
      WHEN lv_current_time >= gc_time_ranges-noon_start    AND lv_current_time < gc_time_ranges-evening_start THEN 'Guten Tag'
      WHEN lv_current_time >= gc_time_ranges-evening_start AND lv_current_time < gc_time_ranges-night_start   THEN 'Guten Abend'
      ELSE 'Gute Nacht'
    ).

    rv_greeting = |{ lv_time_of_day }{ COND string( WHEN iv_username IS NOT INITIAL THEN | { iv_username }| ELSE '' ) }!|.

    log_message( iv_message = |Generierte Begrüßung: '{ rv_greeting }'| iv_type = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '002'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` für einen bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und ein bestimmtes Datum. Mappen Sie die gelesenen Daten auf eine interne Tabelle mit einer reduzierten Struktur, die nur `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthält. Protokollieren Sie die Anzahl der gefundenen Einträge.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für die Strukturzuordnung. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_type    TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF lt_sflight_raw IS INITIAL.
      log_message( iv_message = |Keine Flüge für { iv_carrid } am { iv_fldate } gefunden.| iv_type = 'W' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_summaries = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight_raw MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate ).

    log_message( iv_message = |{ lines( rt_flight_summaries ) } Flüge für { iv_carrid } am { iv_fldate } gelesen.| iv_type = 'S' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '003'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator. Protokollieren Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_type    TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflight IS INITIAL.
      log_message( iv_message = |Keine Flüge für Fluggesellschaft { iv_carrid } gefunden.| iv_type = 'W' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).

    log_message( iv_message = |Gesamtzahl belegter Sitze für { iv_carrid }: { rv_total_seats }| iv_type = 'S' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '004'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_prefix  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_type    TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_prefix.
    IF it_strings IS INITIAL.
      log_message( iv_message = |Eingabetabelle ist leer, keine Filterung möglich.| iv_type = 'I' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings WHERE ( table_line CS iv_prefix ) ).

    log_message( iv_message = |{ lines( rt_filtered_strings ) } Einträge mit Präfix '{ iv_prefix }' gefunden.| iv_type = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '005'
      i_msgv1 = iv_message
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt und eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`) abfängt. Protokollieren Sie die Ausnahmeinformationen.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_exception
      IMPORTING
        io_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        log_exception( lx_zerodivide ).
        " Optionally re-raise or set a default value
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_exception.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '006'
      i_msgv1 = io_exception->get_text( )
      i_msgv2 = io_exception->get_source_position( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Operationen auf einem numerischen Wert unter Verwendung von Method Chaining. Jede Operation soll den Wert modifizieren und das Objekt für die nächste Operation zurückgeben. Protokollieren Sie jede Operation.
hint: Designen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i.

    METHODS add
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calculator.

    METHODS multiply
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_calculator.

    METHODS get_result
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.

    METHODS log_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
    log_operation( iv_operation = 'Initialisierung' iv_value = iv_initial_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    log_operation( iv_operation = 'Addition' iv_value = iv_value ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    log_operation( iv_operation = 'Multiplikation' iv_value = iv_value ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
    log_operation( iv_operation = 'Ergebnisabfrage' iv_value = rv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_operation.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '007'
      i_msgv1 = |Operation: { iv_operation }, Wert: { iv_value }, Aktueller Stand: { mv_current_value }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining_operations.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chained_calculator( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Zeile zu verketten, was die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes erheblich verbessert. Die private Instanzvariable `mv_current_value` speichert den Zustand des Rechners, und die private Methode `log_operation` protokolliert jeden Schritt, was die Nachvollziehbarkeit der Kette erleichtert. Die Verwendung von `PRIVATE SECTION` schützt den internen Zustand und die Hilfsfunktionen.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu und lesen Sie dessen Wert. Der Feldname wird zur Laufzeit übergeben. Protokollieren Sie den dynamisch gelesenen Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_access
      IMPORTING
        iv_fieldname TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
        iv_type      TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
      log_access( iv_fieldname = iv_fieldname iv_value = rv_value iv_type = 'I' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
      log_access( iv_fieldname = iv_fieldname iv_value = rv_value iv_type = 'E' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_access.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = iv_type
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '008'
      i_msgv1 = |Dynamischer Zugriff auf Feld '{ iv_fieldname }': Wert '{ iv_value }'|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_access_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_accessor( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_accessor=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test String' field2 = 123 field3 = '20251207' ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Test String' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_access_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_accessor( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_accessor=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_fieldname = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit mittels Feld-Symbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und der Anweisung `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme oder Frameworks, bei denen Feldnamen nicht fest codiert sind. Die private Methode `log_access` protokolliert die Ergebnisse des dynamischen Zugriffs, was bei der Fehlersuche in dynamischen Szenarien unerlässlich ist. Die Kapselung der Logging-Logik in einer privaten Methode ist eine gute Praxis.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, CL_BAL_LOG, PRIVATE SECTION

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.

    METHODS log_result
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weekday_resolver IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).

    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
      lv_weekday
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Sonntag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Samstag'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).

    log_result( iv_date = iv_date iv_name = rv_weekday_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_result.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '009'
      i_msgv1 = |Datum: { iv_date }, Wochentag: { iv_name }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert und geben Sie dessen Index zurück, falls vorhanden. Protokollieren Sie das Ergebnis der Suche.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` für die effiziente Suche in internen Tabellen. Verwenden Sie `CL_BAL_LOG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_searcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_string_in_table
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_search  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_search_result
      IMPORTING
        iv_search TYPE string
        iv_index  TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_searcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_string_in_table.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( it_strings[ table_line = iv_search ] ).
      rv_index = LINE_INDEX( it_strings[ table_line = iv_search ] ).
      log_search_result( iv_search = iv_search iv_index = rv_index ).
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0. " 0 indicates not found
      log_search_result( iv_search = iv_search iv_index = rv_index ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_search_result.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    IF iv_index > 0.
      lo_log_handle->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '010'
        i_msgv1 = |String '{ iv_search }' gefunden an Index { iv_index }|
      ).
    ELSE.
      lo_log_handle->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '010'
        i_msgv1 = |String '{ iv_search }' nicht gefunden|
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen String durch einen anderen Teilstring. Protokollieren Sie den ursprünglichen und den modifizierten String.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring   TYPE string
        iv_new_substring   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_replacement
      IMPORTING
        iv_original TYPE string
        iv_modified TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring.
    rv_modified_string = iv_original_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN rv_modified_string WITH iv_new_substring.
    log_replacement( iv_original = iv_original_string iv_modified = rv_modified_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_replacement.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '012'
      i_msgv1 = |Original: '{ iv_original }'|
      i_msgv2 = |Modifiziert: '{ iv_modified }'|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_object_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_object TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING

    METHODS log_type_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_object_type.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_object ).
        rv_type_name = lo_typedescr->get_name( ).
        log_type_info( rv_type_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_type_name = 'Unbekannt oder Initial'.
        log_type_info( rv_type_name ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_type_info.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '014'
      i_msgv1 = |Ermittelter Typ des Datenobjekts: '{ iv_type_name }'|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name REDEFINITION.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_product_base FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS log_product_creation
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
        iv_class_name   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zif_product IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = get_name( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
        log_product_creation( iv_product_type = iv_product_type iv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_A' ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
        log_product_creation( iv_product_type = iv_product_type iv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_B' ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return initial
        log_product_creation( iv_product_type = iv_product_type iv_class_name = 'UNKNOWN' ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_product_creation.
    DATA(lo_log_handle) = cl_bal_log=>get_instance( ).
    lo_log_handle->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '015'
      i_msgv1 = |Factory: Produkt '{ iv_product_type }' als Klasse '{ iv_class_name }' erstellt.|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

hint: Verwenden Sie `get_container` des Splitters, um die Unter-Container zu erhalten, und instanziieren Sie die Controls mit diesen Containern als `parent`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_with_controls DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_splitter TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_with_controls IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_splitter_demo) = NEW zcl_splitter_with_controls( 'CONTROLS_CONTAINER' ).
    out->write( |Splitter with TextEdit and ALV Grid created for container '{ lo_splitter_demo->mv_container_name }'.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent            = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        container_name    = mv_container_name
        orientation       = cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_horizontal
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error        = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        OTHERS            = 3.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating splitter container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " TextEdit im linken Panel
    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating TextEdit control' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " ALV Grid im rechten Panel
    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 2 )
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV Grid control' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Beispiel: Daten für ALV Grid (sflights)
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      ).
    ENDIF.

    " Beispiel: Text für TextEdit
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( text = 'Dies ist ein Beispieltext im TextEdit-Feld.' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Instanzmethode `get_timestamp()` des `cl_abap_utclong`-Objekts und anschließend `CONVERT TIME STAMP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_to_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utclong_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
      EXPORTING
        ev_date    TYPE sy-datum
        ev_time    TYPE sy-uzeit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_to_local IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utclong_to_local.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = iv_utclong->get_timestamp( ).
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_timestamp
      TIME ZONE sy-zonlo
      INTO DATE ev_date
      TIME ev_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_to_local( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_fixed) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_from_string( '20231027103000.0000000' ). " UTC 27.10.2023 10:30:00

    " Annahme: Zeitzone CET/CEST, d.h. +1h oder +2h im Oktober
    " Für 27.10.2023 10:30 UTC ist es in CET/CEST 12:30 (CEST)
    lo_cut->convert_utclong_to_local(
      EXPORTING iv_utclong = lv_utclong_fixed
      IMPORTING ev_date    = DATA(lv_local_date)
                ev_time    = DATA(lv_local_time)
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_date exp = '20231027' msg = 'Datum sollte 27.10.2023 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_local_time exp = '123000' msg = 'Uhrzeit sollte 12:30:00 sein (CEST)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Konvertierung eines `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempels in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit erfolgt in zwei Schritten: Zuerst wird der `UTCLONG` in einen Standard-ABAP-Zeitstempel (`TIMESTAMP`) umgewandelt, dann wird dieser mit `CONVERT TIME STAMP` unter Berücksichtigung der Systemzeitzone in Datum und Uhrzeit aufgeteilt. Inline-Deklarationen verbessern die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: UTCLONG, Conversion, Date, Time, TIMESTAMP, DATA, Time Zone

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und die Flugnummer (CONNID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und Inline-Deklaration.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

  METHOD get_flight_keys.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight_data
                               ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid,
                                 connid = <fs_flight>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks und einer Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit `DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR <fs_price> IN lt_prices
                                  NEXT sum = sum + <fs_price>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis, unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in einem `LOOP AT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(...)` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_grouped_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_group_member-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_aa_result-total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte positiv sein' ).

Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA`) werden sowohl für die Gruppenschlüssel als auch für die Gruppenmitglieder verwendet.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen und Dezimalzahlen) aus einem gegebenen Text und geben Sie sie als Liste von Strings zurück.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+(\.\d+)?`. " Matches integers or decimals
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    ENDWHILE.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einem String, der eine URL enthält, das Protokoll, den Host und den Pfad.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit Capturing Groups und `GET_SUBMATCH`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_parts,
             protocol TYPE string,
             host     TYPE string,
             path     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url_parts.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_url_parts) TYPE ty_url_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_url.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\w+)://([^/]+)(/.*)?$`. " (1)protocol, (2)host, (3)path
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_url ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_url_parts-protocol = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_url_parts-host = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_url_parts-path = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_url FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_url FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_url.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_regex_url_parser( ).
    DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE ty_url_parts( protocol = 'https' host = 'www.example.com' path = '/path/to/resource' ).
    DATA(ls_actual) = lo_parser->parse_url( 'https://www.example.com/path/to/resource' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-protocol exp = ls_expected-protocol ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-host exp = ls_expected-host ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-path exp = ls_expected-path ).

    ls_expected = VALUE ty_url_parts( protocol = 'http' host = 'localhost:8080' path = '' ).
    ls_actual = lo_parser->parse_url( 'http://localhost:8080' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-protocol exp = ls_expected-protocol ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-host exp = ls_expected-host ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-path exp = ls_expected-path ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_url.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_regex_url_parser( ).
    DATA(ls_expected) = VALUE ty_url_parts( ).
    DATA(ls_actual) = lo_parser->parse_url( 'not-a-url' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual exp = ls_expected
                                      msg = 'Invalid URL should return initial structure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Capturing Groups in Regex-Mustern (definiert durch Klammern `()`) ermöglichen das Extrahieren spezifischer Teile eines Strings. Nach einem erfolgreichen `MATCH` können diese Teile mit `GET_SUBMATCH(index)` abgerufen werden.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String das Wort "ABAP" enthält, unabhängig von Groß- und Kleinschreibung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Regex-Modifikator `(?i)` für Case-Insensitive Matching.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_case_insensitive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_abap_ci
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_case_insensitive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_abap_ci.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `(?i)ABAP`. " (?i) makes the pattern case-insensitive
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_contains = lo_matcher->match( ). " Match anywhere in string
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_contains_abap_ci.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_regex_case_insensitive( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->contains_abap_ci( 'Hello ABAP World' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_checker->contains_abap_ci( 'hello abap world' ) ).

keywords: REGEX, Case-Insensitive, String Search, CL_ABAP_REGEX, (?i)

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen Satz in einzelne Wörter auf, wobei Leerzeichen und Satzzeichen als Trennzeichen dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `FIND_NEXT` und einem Muster, das Wörter findet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_word_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_into_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_word_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_into_words.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\b\w+\b`. " Matches whole words
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_sentence ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_found_string( ) TO rt_words.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_words FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_words.
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW zcl_regex_word_splitter( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = `Hello, world! This is a test.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'world' ) ( 'This' ) ( 'is' ) ( 'a' ) ( 'test' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_splitter->split_into_words( lv_sentence ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Should split sentence into words' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_splitter) = NEW zcl_regex_word_splitter( ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_splitter->split_into_words( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Empty string should return empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl es keine direkte "Regex-Split"-Funktion gibt, kann man durch das Finden aller "Wörter" (definiert durch `\b\w+\b` - Wortgrenzen und alphanumerische Zeichen) den Effekt eines Splits erzielen. `FIND_NEXT` und `GET_FOUND_STRING` sind hier die Schlüsselmethoden.
keywords: REGEX, Split, Words, String Processing, CL_ABAP_REGEX, FIND_NEXT

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String dem Datumsformat "DD.MM.YYYY" entspricht.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein Regex-Muster, das die Struktur des Datums validiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_date_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date_format.
    " Pattern for DD.MM.YYYY (basic validation, not checking for valid days in month)
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])\.(0[1-9]|1[0-2])\.(19|20)\d{2}$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_date_string ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_valid_date.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_regex_date_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '01.01.2023' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_date_format( '31.12.1999' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_date.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_regex_date_validator( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ein spezifisches Regex-Muster wird erstellt, um das Format DD.MM.YYYY zu überprüfen. Die Capturing Groups und Quantifizierer (`{2}`) stellen sicher, dass die Zahlen für Tag, Monat und Jahr korrekt formatiert sind. Die `MATCH`-Methode prüft, ob der gesamte String dem Muster entspricht.
keywords: REGEX, Validation, Date Format, CL_ABAP_REGEX, MATCH

Hello

This is bold text.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Zeilen in einem mehrzeiligen Text, die mit dem Wort "Error" beginnen (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren).
hint: Verwenden Sie den Multiline-Modifikator `(?m)` und den Zeilenanfang-Anker `^`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find_line_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_error_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_line_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_error_lines.
    " (?m) for multiline mode, (?i) for case-insensitive
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `(?mi)^Error.*`. " Matches lines starting with 'Error'
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_multiline_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_found_string( ) TO rt_error_lines.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_error_lines FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_error_lines FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_error_lines.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_regex_find_line_start( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Log entry 1: Info message.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                     `Error: Something went wrong.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                     `Another line.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                     `error in processing.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( `Error: Something went wrong.` ) ( `error in processing.` ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_finder->find_error_lines( lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Should find all lines starting with error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_error_lines.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_regex_find_line_start( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = `Log entry 1: Info message.` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                     `Warning: Minor issue.`.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_finder->find_error_lines( lv_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual exp = lt_expected
                                      msg = 'Should return empty table if no error lines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Modifikator `(?m)` aktiviert den Multiline-Modus, sodass `^` den Anfang jeder Zeile (nicht nur des gesamten Strings) matcht. `(?i)` sorgt für Case-Insensitive Matching. `FIND_NEXT` iteriert durch die Treffer.
keywords: REGEX, Multiline, String Search, CL_ABAP_REGEX, (?m), (^)

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges IPv4-Adressformat hat.

CLASS zcl_regex_ipv4_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    " Regex for IPv4 validation (simplified, not checking for 0-255 range per octet strictly)
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_ip_address ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_regex_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255.255' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( 'abc.def.ghi.jkl' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein komplexes Regex-Muster wird verwendet, um die Struktur einer IPv4-Adresse zu validieren. Jedes Oktett wird auf den Bereich 0-255 geprüft. Die `MATCH`-Methode stellt sicher, dass der gesamte String dem Muster entspricht.

Instructions: Suchen Sie alle Vorkommen des Musters 'ABAP' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren) in einem gegebenen String und geben Sie die Anzahl der Treffer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` und `CL_ABAP_MATCHER` mit der Option `IGNORE CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_count_abap DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_abap_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_count_abap IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_abap_occurrences.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = 'ABAP' ignore_case = abap_true ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    lo_matcher->find_all( ).
    rv_count = lo_matcher->get_number_of_matches( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_count_abap FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_abap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_count_abap( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_abap_occurrences( 'Das ist ein ABAP-Programm mit abap-Code.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 Treffer finden' ).
    lv_count = lo_cut->count_abap_occurrences( 'Kein Treffer hier.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Sollte 0 Treffer finden' ).

CLASS zcl_regex_filter_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_alphanum_strings
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_filter_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_alphanum_strings.
    DATA(lo_regex_digit) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\d' ).
    DATA(lo_regex_upper) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '[A-Z]' ).

    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings USING 
      WHERE ( 
        ( lo_regex_digit->create_matcher( text = table_line )->match( ) = abap_true ) AND
        ( lo_regex_upper->create_matcher( text = table_line )->match( ) = abap_true )
      ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_filter_strings( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Abc1' ) ( 'abc' ) ( '123' ) ( 'XYZ9' ) ( 'aBcD2' ) ( 'no match' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Abc1' ) ( 'XYZ9' ) ( 'aBcD2' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_alphanum_strings( lt_input ).

Instructions: Zählen Sie in einer Liste von Texten, wie viele Texte das Wort 'Error' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren) enthalten und wie viele das Wort 'Success' (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren) enthalten. Geben Sie die Zähler in einer Struktur zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression mit `CL_ABAP_MATCHER`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_counts,
         errors   TYPE i,
         successes TYPE i,
       END OF ty_counts.

CLASS zcl_regex_reduce_counts DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_keywords
      IMPORTING
        it_texts TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_counts) TYPE ty_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_reduce_counts IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_keywords.
    DATA(lo_regex_error) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = 'Error' ignore_case = abap_true ).
    DATA(lo_regex_success) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = 'Success' ignore_case = abap_true ).

    rs_counts = REDUCE ty_counts(
      INIT l_errors = 0 l_successes = 0
      FOR lv_text IN it_texts
      NEXT
        l_errors = COND #( WHEN lo_regex_error->create_matcher( text = lv_text )->match( ) = abap_true THEN l_errors + 1 ELSE l_errors )
        l_successes = COND #( WHEN lo_regex_success->create_matcher( text = lv_text )->match( ) = abap_true THEN l_successes + 1 ELSE l_successes )
      RESULT
        VALUE ty_counts( errors = l_errors successes = l_successes )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_keywords.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_reduce_counts( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'An error occurred.' ) ( 'Operation successful.' ) ( 'Another error.' ) ( 'Success again!' ) ( 'No match.' ) ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->count_keywords( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-errors exp = 2 msg = 'Fehleranzahl falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-successes exp = 2 msg = 'Erfolgsanzahl falsch' ).

    lt_input = VALUE string_table( ( 'Only one error' ) ).
    ls_result = lo_cut->count_keywords( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-errors exp = 1 msg = 'Fehleranzahl bei einem Treffer falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-successes exp = 0 msg = 'Erfolgsanzahl bei einem Treffer falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String und eine Liste von Wörtern entgegennimmt. Die Methode soll überprüfen, ob der String *mindestens eines* der Wörter enthält, wobei die Suche dynamisch mit Regex und Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignoriert werden soll.
hint: Konstruieren Sie das Regex-Muster dynamisch aus der Liste der Wörter (z.B. `(Wort1|Wort2|Wort3)`) und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_any_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        it_words TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_contains) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_regex_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_any_word.
    IF it_words IS INITIAL.
      rv_contains = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_pattern_parts) = VALUE string_table( FOR word IN it_words ( escape( val = word format = cl_abap_regex=>e_abap_format ) ) ).
    DATA(lv_pattern) = |({ cl_abap_string_utilities=>concatenate_string_table( table = lv_pattern_parts separator = '|' ) })|.

    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ignore_case = abap_true ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_contains = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
