CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_contains_any_word FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_contains_any_word.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_regex_match( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'apple' ) ( 'banana' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_any_word( iv_text = 'I like apples and oranges.' it_words = lt_words ) msg = 'Sollte Apple finden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_any_word( iv_text = 'Do you have Bananas?' it_words = lt_words ) msg = 'Sollte Bananas finden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_any_word( iv_text = 'Only cherries here.' it_words = lt_words ) msg = 'Sollte nichts finden' ).

    lt_words = VALUE string_table( ( 'error' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->contains_any_word( iv_text = 'An ERROR occurred.' it_words = lt_words ) msg = 'Sollte Error finden (ignore case)' ).

    lt_words = VALUE string_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->contains_any_word( iv_text = 'Any text' it_words = lt_words ) msg = 'Leere Wortliste sollte false sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung dynamischer Regex-Muster aus einer Liste von Wörtern. Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Wert für eine bestimmte Domäne gültig ist, indem Sie die Festwerte der Domäne abrufen und den Wert dagegen prüfen. Verwenden Sie die Domäne 'SPRAS' (Sprachschlüssel) und prüfen Sie den Wert 'D'.
hint: Rufen Sie die Festwerte mit `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` ab und verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_value_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_domain_value_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain TYPE domname
        iv_value  TYPE ddtext
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_value_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_domain_value_valid.
    DATA(lt_fixed_values) = cl_reca_ddic_doma=>get_fixed_values_for_domain( iv_domain ).

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_fixed_values[ low = iv_value ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_is_domain_value_valid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_domain_value_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ddic_domain_value_check( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_domain_value_valid( iv_domain = 'SPRAS' iv_value = 'D' ) msg = 'D sollte gültig sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_domain_value_valid( iv_domain = 'SPRAS' iv_value = 'E' ) msg = 'E sollte gültig sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_domain_value_valid( iv_domain = 'SPRAS' iv_value = 'X' ) msg = 'X sollte ungültig sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_domain_value_valid( iv_domain = 'BOOLE_D' iv_value = 'Y' ) msg = 'Y sollte für BOOLE_D ungültig sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_domain_value_valid( iv_domain = 'BOOLE_D' iv_value = 'X' ) msg = 'X sollte für BOOLE_D gültig sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Abfrage von DDIC-Festwerten mittels `CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA` mit der modernen `LINE_EXISTS`-Expression. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Überprüfung, ob ein Wert in den definierten Festwerten einer Domäne enthalten ist, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC`.
keywords: DDIC, CL_RECA_DDIC_DOMA, Domäne, Festwerte, LINE_EXISTS, COND, Validierung

CLASS zcl_regex_remove_html IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Fluginformationen aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`), wobei nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID`, `FLDATE` und `PRICE` übernommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` und `sflights`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            connid = flight-connid
                            fldate = flight-fldate
                            price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab( ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE s_price = 0

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) mit den Werten 'LH' und 'AA' und verwenden Sie diese, um Flüge aus `sflights` zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` zur Range-Erstellung und `IN` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddbool_d,
             option TYPE ddbool_d,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_range_line.
    TYPES tt_range TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_range
      IMPORTING it_carrid_range TYPE tt_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.

    METHODS create_carrier_range
      IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_range) TYPE tt_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_range.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflights( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_carrier_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN it_carriers
                        ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = carrier ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_with_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_carrier_range( lt_carriers ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier_range( lt_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id( ( 'SQ' ) ( 'BA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_carrier_range( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_range INTO DATA(ls_range_line) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_line-low exp = 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_line-sign exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_range_line-option exp = 'EQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Erstellung von Ranges mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist eine moderne und kompakte Methode. Die Verwendung von Ranges in `FILTER`-Operationen oder `WHERE`-Klauseln ist ein Standardmuster, das hier mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten umgesetzt wird. Dies simuliert die Nutzung von Konstanten für Ranges, wie sie `if_fsbp_const_range` bereitstellen könnte.
keywords: Ranges, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, FILTER, sflights, DATA

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary_by_carrier,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary_by_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary_by_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary_by_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflights( ).
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_grouped_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count  = lv_flight_count
                      average_price = COND #( WHEN lv_flight_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_flight_count ELSE 0 ) )
             TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_summary ) ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_lh-flight_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_lh-average_price > 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_aa-flight_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary_aa-average_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen und dem `COND`-Operator für die Durchschnittsberechnung entsteht ein sehr moderner und lesbarer Code für Aggregationen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, sflights, DATA, COND

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben. Die Ergebnisse sollen in eine neue Tabelle kopiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` und `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für effizienten Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_criteria.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
      <fs_result>-carrid   = <fs_flight>-carrid.
      <fs_result>-connid   = <fs_flight>-connid.
      <fs_result>-fldate   = <fs_flight>-fldate.
      <fs_result>-seatsocc = <fs_flight>-seatsocc.
      <fs_result>-seatsmax = <fs_flight>-seatsmax.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_where( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_criteria( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( <fs_flight>-seatsmax - <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) >= 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine direkte Filterung der zu verarbeitenden Zeilen, ohne dass eine separate `IF`-Bedingung innerhalb der Schleife erforderlich ist. Die Verwendung von `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ist effizient, da keine Daten kopiert werden.
keywords: LOOP AT, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und das Flugdatum von Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus `sflights` enthält, wobei das Datum im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' vorliegen soll.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE string, " Date as string YYYY-MM-DD
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( connid = ls_flight-connid
                                 fldate = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches_regex( act = <fs_flight>-fldate exp = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT`-Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die einfache Formatierung des Datums verwendet.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, String Templates, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_seats_aa >= 0 msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative' ).

    DATA lv_expected_sum TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO lv_expected_sum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats_aa exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Sum should match direct SELECT SUM' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer prägnanten, funktionalen Weise. Sie initialisiert eine Variable (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, um den Wert in jedem Schritt zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP AT`-Schleifen mit manueller Summenbildung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die mehr als 100 belegte Sitze haben und deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist. Die gefilterten Daten sollen in einer neuen Tabelle vom Typ `ty_sflight_filtered` gespeichert werden.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

      FROM sflight

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > iv_min_occ ).

Sie erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die die `WHERE`-Bedingung erfüllen, und ersetzt somit explizite `LOOP AT`-Schleifen mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` nach `IF`-Bedingungen.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) 
                                                  ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_grouped_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
      <fs_result>-carrid = <fs_group>-carrid.
      <fs_result>-connid = <fs_group>-connid.
      <fs_result>-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 msg = 'Should find some groups' ).

    DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' INTO lv_expected_count.
    READ TABLE lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_group>-flight_count exp = lv_expected_count ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem ABAP, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren. Dies vereinfacht Aggregationen und Gruppierungslogik erheblich, die zuvor oft manuelle Sortierungen und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukte erforderten. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die ein `cl_gui_calendar`-Objekt instanziiert und es auf einem Custom Control anzeigt. Setzen Sie das aktuelle Datum auf den 15. des nächsten Monats.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_container=>screen0` für das Parent und `set_date`. Beachten Sie, dass GUI-Controls in Unit-Tests nicht visuell dargestellt werden können.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calendar.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_calendar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_calendar.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calendar.
    " Create a custom container on screen 0 (main screen)
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CALENDAR_CONTAINER'
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error     = 1
        cntl_system_error = 2
        create_error   = 3
        lifetime_error = 4
        lifetime_dyn_error = 5
        OTHERS         = 6.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create calendar control
    CREATE OBJECT mo_calendar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error creating calendar control' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Calculate next month's 15th
    DATA lv_next_month_date TYPE d.
    DATA(lv_year) = sy-datum+0(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    lv_month = lv_month + 1.
    IF lv_month > 12.
      lv_month = 1.
      lv_year = lv_year + 1.
    ENDIF.
    lv_next_month_date = |{ lv_year ALPHA = OUT }{ lv_month ALPHA = OUT PAD = '0' }{ '15' }|.

    " Set the date
    CALL METHOD mo_calendar->set_date
      EXPORTING
        date = lv_next_month_date
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Error setting calendar date' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " In a real report, you would now call a screen, e.g., CALL SCREEN 100.
    " For unit testing, we only check object creation and method calls.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calendar_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calendar_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_display( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_calendar( ).
        " If no exception, assume creation was successful.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Placeholder for successful execution
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_exception->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_gui_calendar` ist ein Wrapper für das Calendar Control, das in ABAP-Dynpros verwendet wird. Die Instanziierung erfolgt über einen `cl_gui_custom_container` als Parent. Die Methode `set_date` erlaubt das programmatische Setzen eines Datums. Im Unit-Test kann nur die fehlerfreie Instanziierung geprüft werden, da die visuelle Darstellung einen aktiven GUI-Kontext erfordert.
keywords: cl_gui_calendar, GUI Controls, Object Orientation, Custom Control, Date/Time

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und aktualisieren Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze für Flüge, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen, indem Sie 5 Sitze hinzufügen. Verwenden Sie `REFERENCE INTO` für effizienten Zugriff.
hint: `REFERENCE INTO` ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_ref_into DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_ref_into IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_occupancy.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_flights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight)
      WHERE fldate < iv_date.
      lr_flight->seatsocc = lr_flight->seatsocc + 5.
      " Ensure seatsocc does not exceed seatsmax
      IF lr_flight->seatsocc > lr_flight->seatsmax.
        lr_flight->seatsocc = lr_flight->seatsmax.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_ref_into( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365. " Flights older than 1 year

    DATA lt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->update_flight_occupancy( iv_date = lv_test_date ).

    LOOP AT lt_updated_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_updated>).
      READ TABLE lt_original_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_original>)
        WITH KEY carrid = <fs_updated>-carrid
                 connid = <fs_updated>-connid
                 fldate = <fs_updated>-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_updated>-fldate < lv_test_date.
          " Check if seatsocc increased by 5 or capped at seatsmax
          DATA(lv_expected_seats) = <fs_original>-seatsocc + 5.
          IF lv_expected_seats > <fs_original>-seatsmax.
            lv_expected_seats = <fs_original>-seatsmax.
          ENDIF.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated>-seatsocc exp = lv_expected_seats ).
        ELSE.
          " For newer flights, seatsocc should be unchanged
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_updated>-seatsocc exp = <fs_original>-seatsocc ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `REFERENCE INTO` in einer `LOOP AT`-Schleife ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf die Zeilen der internen Tabelle über eine Datenreferenz. Dies ist effizienter als `INTO` (da keine Kopie erstellt wird) und sicherer als `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` in bestimmten Kontexten, da die Referenz explizit ist. Änderungen an `lr_flight->seatsocc` wirken sich direkt auf die entsprechende Zeile in `rt_updated_flights` aus.
keywords: LOOP AT, REFERENCE INTO, Internal Tables, Data References, In-place Modification

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit String-Verkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_flight_numbers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                                            FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-connid
                                                                 ELSE s && ',' && ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concatenation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_numbers( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    DATA lv_expected TYPE string.
    SELECT STRING_AGG( connid, ',' ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO lv_expected.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected msg = 'Concatenated string should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen, einschließlich der Verkettung von Strings. Durch die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb der `NEXT`-Klausel kann elegant gehandhabt werden, ob ein Komma als Trennzeichen vorangestellt werden muss oder nicht. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Alternative zu einer expliziten `LOOP AT`-Schleife mit `CONCATENATE`.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, Concatenation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Wähle einen zufälligen Flug aus der Demotabelle `sflights` aus und gib dessen Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Lese alle Flüge in eine interne Tabelle, bestimme die Anzahl der Zeilen und nutze `cl_abap_random_int` für einen zufälligen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).
    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = lv_num_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    " Überprüfe, ob ein Flug zurückgegeben wurde (wenn sflights nicht leer ist)
    IF lines( VALUE zcl_random_sflight=>tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight ) ) ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = '' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '' msg = 'Flugnummer sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte initial sein, wenn sflights leer ist' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `cl_abap_random_int` in Kombination mit internen Tabellen. Die `FOR`-Iteration und `VALUE`-Konstruktor sind moderne Syntaxelemente, um Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle zu lesen. Die Zufallszahl wird dann verwendet, um einen gültigen Index für den Zugriff auf die interne Tabelle zu generieren.

Instructions: Erzeuge eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20 (inklusive).
hint: Nutze eine `HASHED TABLE` oder `SET` zur Überprüfung der Einzigartigkeit und `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 20
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA: lt_temp_numbers TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).

    DO iv_count * 10 TIMES. " Max 10 tries per number to avoid infinite loop on small ranges
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = iv_min ip_max = iv_max ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
          APPEND lv_random_num TO rt_unique_numbers.
          IF lines( rt_unique_numbers ) = iv_count.
            SORT rt_unique_numbers.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          " Number already exists, try again
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.

    " Fallback if not enough unique numbers could be generated
    IF lines( rt_unique_numbers ) < iv_count.
      " Handle error or return what was generated
      " For this example, we just return what we have
      SORT rt_unique_numbers.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_random_full_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random( ).

    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_unique COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_unique ) exp = 5 msg = 'Alle Zahlen sollten eindeutig sein' ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 20 ) msg = 'Zahl außerhalb des Bereichs' ).

  METHOD test_unique_random_full_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random( ).

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Zufallszahlengenerierung mit `cl_abap_random_int` und der effizienten Überprüfung auf Einzigartigkeit mittels einer `HASHED TABLE`. Die `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur fängt den Fehler `cx_sy_table_line_exists` ab, wenn eine doppelte Zahl eingefügt werden soll, und ermöglicht so eine erneute Generierung. Instructions: Weise einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Wert zu, der von einem String-Parameter abhängt.
hint: Nutze `ASSIGN COMPONENT` um das Feldsymbol zu referenzieren und dann `MOVE` um den Wert zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_field_symbol DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS assign_value_to_field
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_data       TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_field_symbol IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_value_to_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " MOVE wird hier verwendet, um den Wert zuzuweisen, was auch Typkonvertierungen ermöglicht.
      MOVE iv_value TO <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      " Fehlerbehandlung: Feld nicht gefunden
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Feld '{ iv_field_name }' nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_field_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_assign_field_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_assign_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_field_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_field_symbol( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_move_field_symbol=>ty_data( field_a = 'Initial' field_b = 0 ).

    lo_cut->assign_value_to_field( iv_field_name = 'FIELD_A' iv_value = 'New Value' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_a exp = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_b exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_assign_field_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_field_symbol( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_move_field_symbol=>ty_data( field_a = 'Initial' field_b = 0 ).

    lo_cut->assign_value_to_field( iv_field_name = 'FIELD_B' iv_value = '456' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_a exp = 'Initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field_b exp = 456 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_assign_invalid_field RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_field_symbol( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_move_field_symbol=>ty_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_assign_error ).
    lo_cut->assign_value_to_field( iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' iv_value = 'Test' CHANGING cs_data = ls_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Arbeit mit Feldsymbolen ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Hier wird `ASSIGN COMPONENT` verwendet, um ein Feldsymbol dynamisch einem Feld einer Struktur zuzuweisen, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Anschließend wird `MOVE` verwendet, um den Wert in das referenzierte Feld zu schreiben. Dies ist ein klassisches und weiterhin relevantes Szenario für die `MOVE`-Anweisung.
keywords: MOVE, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Extrahiere einen Teilstring aus einem Quellstring und weise ihn einem Zielstring zu, indem du `MOVE` mit Offset und Länge verwendest.
hint: Die `MOVE`-Anweisung erlaubt die Angabe von Offset und Länge für die Quell- und Zielfelder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_substring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_source TYPE string
        iv_offset TYPE i
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_target) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_substring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_substring.
    " In modern ABAP würde man hier eher String-Templates oder substring() verwenden.
    " Aber für die Demonstration von MOVE mit Offset/Length:
    DATA(lv_temp_source) = iv_source.
    DATA(lv_temp_target) TYPE string.

    " MOVE lv_temp_source+iv_offset(iv_length) TO lv_temp_target.
    " Die Syntax mit Offset/Length ist bei STRING-Typen nicht direkt mit MOVE möglich.
    " Stattdessen muss man auf CHAR-Typen ausweichen oder substring() verwenden.
    " Da die Anweisung explizit 'MOVE' mit Offset/Length verlangt, simulieren wir dies mit einem CHAR-Feld.

    DATA(lv_char_source) TYPE c LENGTH 255.
    DATA(lv_char_target) TYPE c LENGTH 255.

    lv_char_source = iv_source.

    IF iv_offset >= 0 AND iv_length > 0.
      MOVE lv_char_source+iv_offset(iv_length) TO lv_char_target.
    ENDIF.

    rv_target = lv_char_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_out_of_bounds FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_zero_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_substring( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->extract_substring( iv_source = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' iv_offset = 5 iv_length = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'FGH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_out_of_bounds.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_substring( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->extract_substring( iv_source = 'ABC' iv_offset = 10 iv_length = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result ). " Erwartet initial, da Offset außerhalb liegt
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_zero_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_substring( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->extract_substring( iv_source = 'ABC' iv_offset = 1 iv_length = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_result ). " Erwartet initial, da Länge 0 ist
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MOVE`-Anweisung mit Offset- und Längenangaben (`+offset(length)`) ist ein klassisches Feature in ABAP zur Manipulation von Zeichenketten. Obwohl für `STRING`-Typen modernere Funktionen wie `substring()` oder String-Templates bevorzugt werden, ist diese Syntax bei `CHAR`-Typen weiterhin direkt anwendbar und zeigt die präzise Kontrolle, die `MOVE` über die Datenübertragung bietet. Das Beispiel demonstriert diese Funktionalität durch die Verwendung von `CHAR`-Hilfsfeldern.
keywords: MOVE, String Processing, Offset, Length, Substring

Instructions: Wähle 3 zufällige, eindeutige Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Lese alle Fluggesellschaften, nutze `cl_abap_random_int` für zufällige Indizes und stelle die Einzigartigkeit sicher.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_carriers.
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight-carrid ).

    IF lt_all_carriers IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_num_unique_carriers) = lines( lt_all_carriers ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ).

    DATA(lt_temp_result) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count * 10 TIMES. " Max 10 tries per carrier
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = lv_num_unique_carriers ).
      DATA(lv_random_carrier) = lt_all_carriers[ lv_random_index ].

      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_carrier INTO TABLE lt_temp_result.
          APPEND lv_random_carrier TO rt_carriers.
          IF lines( rt_carriers ) = iv_count.
            SORT rt_carriers.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          " Carrier already exists, try again
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.

    SORT rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_unique_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_unique_carriers_less_than_requested FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_unique_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_random_carriers( iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Fluggesellschaften generiert werden' ).

    DATA(lt_check_unique) = lt_carriers.
    SORT lt_check_unique BY table_line ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_unique COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_unique ) exp = 3 msg = 'Alle Fluggesellschaften sollten eindeutig sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_unique_carriers_less_than_requested.
    " Annahme: Es gibt weniger als 10 eindeutige Fluggesellschaften in sflights
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_carriers( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = lo_cut->get_random_carriers( iv_count = 10 ).

    DATA(lt_all_unique_sflight_carriers) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( ls_sflight-carrid ).
    DATA(lv_max_possible) = lines( lt_all_unique_sflight_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_carriers ) exp = lv_max_possible msg = 'Anzahl der generierten sollte maximal mögliche sein' ).

    DATA(lt_check_unique) = lt_carriers.
    SORT lt_check_unique BY table_line ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_check_unique COMPARING ALL FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_check_unique ) exp = lines( lt_carriers ) msg = 'Alle generierten sollten eindeutig sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Auswahl einer bestimmten Anzahl von eindeutigen Elementen aus einer Datenmenge (`sflights`). Es verwendet eine `HASHED TABLE` mit `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften effizient zu sammeln. Anschließend wird `cl_abap_random_int` verwendet, um zufällige Indizes zu generieren, und eine `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur stellt die Einzigartigkeit der ausgewählten Fluggesellschaften sicher. Dies ist eine moderne und robuste Methode für zufällige Stichproben.
keywords: cl_abap_random_int, sflights, Hashed Table, Unique, Random Selection, VALUE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Flugnummer (CONNID) mit '0' beginnt. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( ... ) WHERE ...` und den `GROUP` Schlüsselwort, um auf die Gruppendaten zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count,
      tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
         INTO DATA(group_key)
         WHERE ( ls_flight-connid CP '0*' ).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_member>).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'No flights grouped' exp = abap_false ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = ls_result-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH should have flights' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax, insbesondere mit der `WHERE`-Klausel, ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die zu gruppierenden Einträge vorab, was die Performance verbessert. Der Zugriff auf die Gruppenelemente erfolgt über `LOOP AT GROUP`.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, WHERE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für alle Flüge, die von der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' durchgeführt werden. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `WHEN`-Bedingung.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Nutzen Sie `WHEN` innerhalb des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_lh_flight_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_lh_flight_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflights-price
                               FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum_price = sum_price + COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_lh_flight_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 msg = 'Total price should be non-negative' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `COND WHEN` ermöglicht er die bedingte Einbeziehung von Werten in die Aggregation, was den Code sehr prägnant und funktional macht.

Instructions: Füllen Sie ein Excel-Arbeitsblatt mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet`.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und schreiben Sie jede Zeile in das Excel-Blatt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_flights_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel_workbook TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_excel_sheet  TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_workbook = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_excel_sheet = lo_excel_workbook->add_sheet( 'FlightData' ).

        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 1 value = 'Carrier ID' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 2 value = 'Connection ID' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 3 value = 'Flight Date' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 4 value = 'Price' ).

        DATA(lv_row) = 2.

        lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 2 value = 'Carrier Name' ).
        DATA(lv_row_carriers) = 2.
        LOOP AT lt_scarr INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
          lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( row = lv_row_carriers col = 1 value = ls_carrier-carrid ).
          lo_sheet_carriers->set_cell_value( row = lv_row_carriers col = 2 value = ls_carrier-carrname ).
          lv_row_carriers = lv_row_carriers + 1.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Excel-Bericht mit Flugdaten aus `sflights`. Fügen Sie eine Spalte 'Status' hinzu, die 'Delayed' anzeigt, wenn der Flugpreis über 1000 liegt, und 'On-Time' sonst. Erklären Sie, wie `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` (im Kontext von FDT) für bedingte Formatierung genutzt werden könnte.
hint: Fügen Sie die Status-Spalte mit `COND` hinzu. Für echte bedingte Formatierung in Excel über `cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet` müsste man FDT-Regeln definieren, die Formatierungen anwenden. Hier wird der Status im Code bestimmt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_cond_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_cond_format_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_cond_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_cond_format_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel_workbook TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet,
          lo_excel_sheet  TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_workbook = NEW cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet( ).
        lo_excel_sheet = lo_excel_workbook->add_sheet( 'FlightStatus' ).

        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 1 value = 'Carrier ID' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 2 value = 'Connection ID' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 3 value = 'Price' ).
        lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = 1 col = 4 value = 'Status' ).

        DATA(lv_row) = 2.
        LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
          DATA(lv_status) = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > 1000 THEN 'Delayed' ELSE 'On-Time' ).

          lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = lv_row col = 1 value = ls_flight-carrid ).
          lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = lv_row col = 2 value = ls_flight-connid ).
          lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = lv_row col = 3 value = ls_flight-price ).
          lo_excel_sheet->set_cell_value( row = lv_row col = 4 value = lv_status ).
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_excel_workbook->get_xstring( ).

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet INTO DATA(lx_fdt_xl).
        MESSAGE lx_fdt_xl->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_to_dt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             date TYPE d,
             time TYPE t,
             tzone TYPE tzone,
           END OF ty_datetime_components.

        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_components) TYPE ty_datetime_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_to_dt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_timestamp_to_components.

      INTO DATE rs_components-date
      TIME rs_components-time
      TIME ZONE rs_components-tzone.

    DATA(ls_expected_components) = VALUE zcl_tst_to_dt=>ty_datetime_components(
      date  = '20231207'
      time  = '103045'
      tzone = sy-zonlo " Assuming local system time zone for simplicity
    ).

    DATA(ls_actual_components) = lo_cut->convert_timestamp_to_components( iv_tstmp ).

    ).

CLASS zcl_tst_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tst_format IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,

      TIME lv_time

CLASS zcl_wrt_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Vergleiche zwei Zeitstempel und gib zurück, welcher der beiden früher ist oder ob sie gleich sind.
hint: Zeitstempel können direkt mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`) verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tst_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " 'TSTMP1_EARLIER', 'TSTMP2_EARLIER', 'EQUAL'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_timestamps.
    IF iv_tstmp1 < iv_tstmp2.
      rv_result = 'TSTMP1_EARLIER'.
    ELSE IF iv_tstmp1 > iv_tstmp2.
      rv_result = 'TSTMP2_EARLIER'.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'EQUAL'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tst_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp_earlier) = '20231207100000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_later)   = '20231207100001'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_equal)   = '20231207100000'.

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_earlier
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_later
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result1
      exp = 'TSTMP1_EARLIER'
      msg = 'TSTMP1 should be earlier'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_later
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_earlier
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'TSTMP2_EARLIER'
      msg = 'TSTMP2 should be earlier'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->compare_timestamps(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_earlier
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_equal
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result3
      exp = 'EQUAL'
      msg = 'Timestamps should be equal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeitstempel vom Typ `TIMESTAMPL` können in ABAP direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren verglichen werden, was eine intuitive und effiziente Methode für die zeitliche Reihenfolgeprüfung bietet.

CLASS zcl_tst_tz_conv IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_utc_tstmp TYPE timestampl.

      EXPORTING
        tstmp    = lv_utc_tstmp
        tzone    = iv_target_tzone

Instructions: Berechne den Zeitstempel, der 30 Minuten vor einem gegebenen Zeitstempel liegt.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` mit der entsprechenden Sekundenanzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tst_sub_min DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_minutes_from_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp  TYPE timestampl
        iv_minutes TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_sub_min IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_minutes_from_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_seconds) = iv_minutes * 60.
    rv_new_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
      tstmp1 = iv_tstmp
      seconds = lv_seconds
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = '20231207103000'.
    DATA(lv_minutes_to_sub) = 30.
    DATA(lv_expected_tstmp) = '20231207100000'.

    DATA(lv_actual_tstmp) = lo_cut->subtract_minutes_from_timestamp(

Instructions: Erstelle einen String, der eine Liste von Elementen (z.B. Farben) durch Kommas getrennt darstellt, unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_wrt_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_comma_separated_list
      IMPORTING
        it_elements TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_list_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_wrt_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_comma_separated_list.
    rv_list_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = `` FOR wa IN it_elements NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN wa ELSE |{ s }, { wa }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Extrahieren Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `FILTER` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_from_fra
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_from_fra.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid AND
                                  fldate > lv_current_date AND
                                  cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) " Assuming cityfrom for 'FRA'
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                            connid = flight-connid,
                            fldate = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    " Setup test data (if sflights is empty or not suitable)
    " For simplicity, assuming sflights has some data.
    " In a real scenario, you might mock sflights or insert test data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_from_fra( ).

    " Assertions
    " Check if all flights are from 'FRANKFURT' and in the future
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CityFrom should be FRANKFURT' act = 'FRANKFURT' exp = 'FRANKFURT' ). " This check is implicit in the WHERE clause, but good to show intent
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be in the future' act = ( ls_flight-fldate > cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check if at least one flight is found (if test data guarantees it)
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should find some flights' act = lines( lt_flights ) ). " Use assert_initial or assert_not_initial based on expected outcome
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. `VALUE #(...)` wird zur direkten Initialisierung der Zieltabelle verwendet.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, FILTER, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights` mit dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.

    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_mock_provider) = NEW zcl_data_provider_mock( ).
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_service_consumer( io_data_provider = lo_mock_provider ).
    out->write( lo_consumer->process_data( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Konstruktor-Injektion ist ein Design-Pattern, das die Testbarkeit und Flexibilität von Klassen verbessert, indem Abhängigkeiten über den Konstruktor übergeben werden, anstatt sie intern zu erzeugen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_result = 'Method A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_result = 'Method B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF me RECEIVING RESULTS rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or callable dynamically.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    out->write( lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'METHOD_A' ) ).
    out->write( lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'METHOD_B' ) ).
    out->write( lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result_a) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic call to Method A' act = lv_result_a exp = 'Method A executed' ).

    DATA(lv_result_b) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic call to Method B' act = lv_result_b exp = 'Method B executed' ).

    DATA(lv_result_invalid) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_call( 'INVALID_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Dynamic call to invalid method' substring = 'Error' in = lv_result_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe ermöglichen es, den Namen einer aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks oder generische Verarbeitungslogiken. Die `TRY...CATCH` Block ist entscheidend für die Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, RTTI

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( )` und die Methoden der Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper`.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    " Test for 30 days in future
    DATA(lv_future_date_30) = lo_cut->get_date_in_future( 30 ).
    DATA(lv_expected_date_30) TYPE d.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse (`IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN`), die die ersten 5 Einträge der Tabelle `sflights` liest und formatiert auf der Konsole ausgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT UP TO 5 ROWS` und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_classrun_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_display,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             curr   TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight_display.
    TYPES tt_sflight_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_output) = get_formatted_flights( ).
    out->write( |--- First 5 SFLIGHTS Entries ---| ).
    LOOP AT lt_output INTO DATA(lv_line).
      out->write( lv_line ).
    ENDLOOP.
    out->write( |----------------------------------| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_display.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND |{ ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-curr }| TO rt_formatted_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_formatted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_classrun_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_formatted_lines) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( ).

    " Assert that at least some lines are returned (assuming sflights is not empty)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return formatted flight lines' act = lt_formatted_lines ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should return at most 5 lines' act = ( lines( lt_formatted_lines ) <= 5 ) ).

    " Check content of a line (e.g., contains 'LH' if LH is in sflights)
    " This is a basic check, more robust tests would involve mocking sflights.
    READ TABLE lt_formatted_lines INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_first_line).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'First line should contain carrid' substring = 'LH' in = lv_first_line ). " Assuming LH is a common carrid
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN` für die Ausführbarkeit und `SELECT` mit `UP TO N ROWS` für effizientes Datenlesen, zusammen mit String-Templates für die Formatierung, zeigt eine moderne Art der Datenanzeige.
keywords: IF_OO_ADT_CLASSRUN, SELECT, sflights, String Templates, Data Display

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die konzeptionell die Logik eines Behavior Handlers im ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) demonstriert. Die Klasse soll von `CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER` erben und eine Methode zur Validierung von Flugdaten enthalten.
hint: Erben Sie von `CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER` und implementieren Sie eine Validierungsmethode. Beachten Sie, dass dies ein konzeptionelles Beispiel ist, da ein vollständiger RAP-Kontext fehlt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bh_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_in,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data_in.
    TYPES tt_flight_data_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_failed_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_failed_key.
    TYPES tt_failed_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_failed_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_to_validate TYPE tt_flight_data_in
      EXPORTING
        et_failed_keys         TYPE tt_failed_keys
        et_messages            TYPE cl_abap_behavior_handler=>ty_message_table. " Use RAP message type

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    " In a real RAP scenario, these methods would be overridden
    " METHODS get_instance_authorizations FOR BEHAVIOR ...
    " METHODS validate FOR VALIDATE ...
    " METHODS save_modified FOR SAVE ...
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bh_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    LOOP AT it_flights_to_validate INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < lv_current_date.
        APPEND VALUE ty_failed_key( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                                    fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) TO et_failed_keys.
        APPEND VALUE cl_abap_behavior_handler=>ty_message(
          message_text = |Flugdatum { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } liegt in der Vergangenheit.|
          message_severity = cl_abap_behavior_handler=>co_severity_error
          message_class = 'ZMSG_FLIGHT' " Placeholder message class
          message_number = '001' " Placeholder message number
          message_v1 = ls_flight-fldate
          message_v2 = ls_flight-carrid
          message_v3 = ls_flight-connid
          message_v4 = ''
        ) TO et_messages.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_validate_flight_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_validate_flight_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bh_validator( ).
    DATA lt_flights_to_validate TYPE zcl_flight_bh_validator=>tt_flight_data_in.
    DATA lt_failed_keys TYPE zcl_flight_bh_validator=>tt_failed_keys.
    DATA lt_messages TYPE cl_abap_behavior_handler=>ty_message_table.

    " Test Case 1: Valid flight date
    APPEND VALUE zcl_flight_bh_validator=>ty_flight_data_in(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) + 1
    ) TO lt_flights_to_validate.

    " Test Case 2: Invalid flight date (in the past)
    APPEND VALUE zcl_flight_bh_validator=>ty_flight_data_in(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ) - 1
    ) TO lt_flights_to_validate.

    lo_cut->validate_flight_date(
      EXPORTING
        it_flights_to_validate = lt_flights_to_validate
      IMPORTING
        et_failed_keys         = lt_failed_keys
        et_messages            = lt_messages
    ).

    " Assertions
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'One flight should fail validation'
      act = lines( lt_failed_keys )
      exp = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      msg = 'One error message should be generated'
      act = lines( lt_messages )
      exp = 1
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_failed_keys INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_failed_key).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Failed key carrid' act = ls_failed_key-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Failed key connid' act = ls_failed_key-connid exp = '0010' ).

    READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_message).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Message severity' act = ls_message-message_severity exp = cl_abap_behavior_handler=>co_severity_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Message text' substring = 'Vergangenheit' in = ls_message-message_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Klasse erbt von `CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER` und demonstriert, wie Validierungslogik in einem RAP-Kontext aussehen könnte. Sie nutzt die von RAP bereitgestellten Typen für Nachrichten und Fehlerbehandlung, auch wenn sie außerhalb eines vollständigen RAP-Stacks ausgeführt wird.
keywords: CL_ABAP_BEHAVIOR_HANDLER, RAP, Validation, Object Orientation, ABAP Cloud
