Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, und speichern Sie sie in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_itab( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'. " Assuming 'LH' exists in sflights

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_test_carrid ).

    " Assert that all filtered flights belong to the specified carrier
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should match' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_test_carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the count is reasonable (e.g., not empty if LH exists)
    DATA(lv_expected_count) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid INTO lv_expected_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of filtered flights should match' act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere oder von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden sollen. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder `CORRESPONDING #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             other_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_table
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source( field1 = 'Test' field2 = 100 field3 = '20250101' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 should match' act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should match' act = ls_target-field2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Other_field should be initial' act = ls_target-other_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_table.
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_corresponding_op=>tt_source.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source( field1 = 'Entry1' field2 = 1 field3 = '20250101' ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_corresponding_op=>ty_source( field1 = 'Entry2' field2 = 2 field3 = '20250102' ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_op( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table lines should match' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry Field1' act = ls_target_entry-field1 exp = 'Entry1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator (als Ausdruck `CORRESPONDING #(...)`) bietet eine moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit übereinstimmenden Feldnamen zu kopieren.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Operations, Structures, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wochentagstext basierend auf einer numerischen Eingabe (1=Montag, 2=Dienstag, etc.) zu. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH type( expression WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string( iv_day_number
                                    WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                                    WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                                    WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                                    WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                                    WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                                    WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                                    WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                                    ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weekday_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Day 1' act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 1 ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Day 7' act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 7 ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Invalid Day' act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 0 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Invalid Day 8' act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 8 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Möglichkeit, einen Wert basierend auf dem Ergebnis eines Ausdrucks oder einer Variablen zuzuweisen, ähnlich einem `CASE`-Statement, aber als Ausdruck.
keywords: SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen XML-String und extrahieren Sie den Wert eines spezifischen Knotens mittels XPath.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_with_string` zum Laden des XML und `get_node_by_path` zur Navigation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_get_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_get_node.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.
      rv_node_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XML-Dokument aus Daten der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von String-Templates und `cl_xml_document`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xml_document=>create_empty`, `create_element` und `create_element_and_set_value` in einer Schleife über die Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_sflight_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_empty( ).
    DATA(lo_root) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'SFlights' ).
    lo_xml_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(lo_flight_node) = lo_xml_document->create_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_root->append_child( lo_flight_node ).

      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_set_value( iv_name = 'Carrid' iv_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_set_value( iv_name = 'Connid' iv_value = |{ ls_sflight-connid }| ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_set_value( iv_name = 'Fldate' iv_value = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = ISO }| ).
      lo_flight_node->create_element_and_set_value( iv_name = 'Price' iv_value = |{ ls_sflight-price }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xml_string = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_xml.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_xml_creator=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE zcl_xml_creator=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_xml_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_creator->create_sflight_xml( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = `<Carrid>LH</Carrid>` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_xml exp = `<Price>100.00</Price>` ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch XML-Dokumente aus ABAP-Daten erstellt. Die Verwendung von `cl_xml_document` in Kombination mit String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Wertkonvertierung ist ein moderner und effizienter Ansatz. Die Methode `create_element_and_set_value` vereinfacht das Hinzufügen von Elementen erheblich.
keywords: XML, Generation, sflights, String Templates, cl_xml_document

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Werte eines bestimmten Knotennamens aus einem XML-Dokument in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_elements_by_tag_name` und eine Schleife über die resultierende Knotenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_multi_node_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_nodes_by_tag
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_tag_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_node_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_multi_node_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_nodes_by_tag.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_xml_document->get_elements_by_tag_name( iv_tag_name ).

    LOOP AT lo_node_list ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_node>).
      APPEND <fs_node>->get_value( ) TO rt_node_values.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_extract_multiple_nodes.
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<root><item>A</item><item>B</item><other>C</other></root>`.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_xml_multi_node_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = lo_extractor->extract_nodes_by_tag( iv_xml_string = lv_xml iv_tag_name = 'item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_values ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man effizient mehrere Knoten mit demselben Tag-Namen aus einem XML-Dokument extrahiert. Die Methode `get_elements_by_tag_name` liefert eine Liste von Knoten, die dann einfach durchlaufen werden kann, um die Werte zu sammeln. Dies ist eine gängige Aufgabe beim Parsen von XML-Daten.
keywords: XML, Multiple Nodes, Internal Table, cl_xml_document

Instructions: Parsen Sie ein XML-Dokument mit Namespaces und extrahieren Sie einen Wert unter Berücksichtigung des Namespace.
hint: Registrieren Sie Namespaces mit `set_namespace` an Ihrem `cl_xml_document`-Objekt, bevor Sie XPath-Ausdrücke verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_namespace_xml
      IMPORTING

        iv_uri        TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_node_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_namespace_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_namespace_xml.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    lo_xml_document->set_namespace( iv_prefix = iv_prefix iv_uri = iv_uri ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.
      rv_node_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_xml) = `<root xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns"><ns:data>NamespaceValue</ns:data></root>`.

keywords: XML, Namespaces, XPath, cl_xml_document

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das explizite Freigeben von Speicher für eine interne Tabelle und überprüfen Sie den Effekt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_release_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_report,
             size_before TYPE i,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_memory_info) TYPE ty_memory_report.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_release_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_memory_release.
    DATA: lt_large_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    LOOP AT sy-tab_carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid) UP TO 1000. " Fill with some data
      APPEND |Long string data for { lv_carrid } and { sy-tabix }| TO lt_large_table.
    ENDLOOP.

    rs_memory_info-size_before = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_total_size_of_object( lt_large_table ).

    FREE lt_large_table. " Explicitly free memory

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_report) = lo_demo->demonstrate_memory_release( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_report-size_before > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_report-size_after exp = 0 ). " Nach FREE sollte die Größe 0 sein
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht das explizite Freigeben von Speicher für eine interne Tabelle mit dem `FREE`-Statement. Obwohl ABAP eine automatische Speicherverwaltung hat, kann das explizite Freigeben bei sehr großen Datenmengen oder in kritischen Performance-Szenarien sinnvoll sein.
keywords: Memory, Free, Clear, Performance, cl_abap_memory_utilities

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Speicher-Snapshot, führen Sie Operationen durch und vergleichen Sie den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach den Operationen, um Speicherwachstum zu analysieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption_snapshot` und `get_memory_consumption_diff`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_snapshot_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_diff,
             initial_size TYPE i,
             final_size   TYPE i,
             diff_size    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_diff.

    METHODS analyze_memory_growth
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_diff) TYPE ty_memory_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_snapshot_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_memory_growth.
    DATA(lo_snapshot_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption_snapshot( ).

    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    LOOP AT sy-tab_carrid INTO DATA(lv_carrid) UP TO 500.
      APPEND |Some more data for { lv_carrid } and { sy-tabix }| TO lt_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_snapshot_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption_snapshot( ).

    DATA(ls_diff_raw) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption_diff(
      iv_snapshot_before = lo_snapshot_before
      iv_snapshot_after  = lo_snapshot_after
    ).

    rs_diff-initial_size = lo_snapshot_before->get_total_size( ).
    rs_diff-final_size   = lo_snapshot_after->get_total_size( ).
    rs_diff-diff_size    = ls_diff_raw-total_size.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_growth FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_growth.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_mem_snapshot_analyzer( ).
    DATA(ls_diff) = lo_analyzer->analyze_memory_growth( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_diff-initial_size >= 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_diff-final_size > ls_diff-initial_size ). " Sollte gewachsen sein
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_diff-diff_size > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Speicheranalyse durch die Erstellung von Snapshots und den Vergleich des Speicherverbrauchs. `get_memory_consumption_snapshot` erstellt einen Momentaufnahme des Speichers, und `get_memory_consumption_diff` berechnet die Differenz. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Identifizierung von Speicherlecks oder unerwartetem Speicherwachstum in komplexen Anwendungen.
keywords: Memory, Snapshot, Diff, Leak, Performance, cl_abap_memory_utilities

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Wert eines spezifischen Knotens in einem XML-Dokument und geben Sie das aktualisierte XML zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_node_by_path` und `set_value` auf dem gefundenen Knoten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_xml_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_xml) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xml_updater IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node IS BOUND.

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS add_attribute_to_node
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_xml_attr_adder IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_xml_document) = cl_xml_document=>create_with_string( iv_xml_string ).

    rv_updated_xml = lo_xml_document->render_2_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur mit Standardwerten und überschreiben Sie dann spezifische Felder mithilfe des `VALUE`-Operators. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art der Strukturinitialisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_s_data( field1 = 'A' field2 = 'B' )` und den `COND`-Operator für bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_product,
             id     TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             name   TYPE string,
             price  TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_product.

    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE c LENGTH 10
        iv_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_product) TYPE ty_s_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    " Initialize with default values and then set specific ones
    rs_product = VALUE #( " Target structure is inferred
      id     = iv_id
      name   = COND string( WHEN iv_name IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_name ELSE 'Default Product' )
      price  = '0.00'
      active = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product.

    " Test case 1: With name supplied

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_product2-name   exp = 'Default Product' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_product2-price  exp = '0.00' ).

Die Verwendung von `COND` innerhalb von `VALUE` zeigt eine weitere moderne Ausdrucksform für bedingte Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Daten aus einer bestehenden internen Tabelle transformieren und filtern, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenmanipulation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lt_new) = VALUE ty_t_new( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item_raw,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_item_raw,
           ty_t_item_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item_processed,
             item_id   TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             double_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_item_processed,
           ty_t_item_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_items TYPE ty_t_item_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE ty_t_item_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    " Create a new table by iterating, filtering, and transforming
    rt_processed_items = VALUE #( " Target table type is inferred
      FOR ls_item IN it_raw_items WHERE ( ls_item-active = abap_true AND ls_item-value > 10 )
        ( item_id      = ls_item-id
          item_name    = ls_item-name && ' (Processed)'
          double_value = ls_item-value * 2 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_raw) = VALUE zcl_for_expression=>ty_t_item_raw(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = 5  active = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = 15 active = abap_true )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item C' value = 20 active = abap_false )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Item D' value = 12 active = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 2, msg = 'Incorrect number of processed items' ).

    DATA(ls_expected1) = VALUE zcl_for_expression=>ty_s_item_processed( item_id = 2 item_name = 'Item B (Processed)' double_value = 30 ).
    DATA(ls_expected2) = VALUE zcl_for_expression=>ty_s_item_processed( item_id = 4 item_name = 'Item D (Processed)' double_value = 24 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-item_id      exp = ls_expected1-item_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-item_name    exp = ls_expected1-item_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 1 ]-double_value exp = ls_expected1-double_value ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-item_id      exp = ls_expected2-item_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-item_name    exp = ls_expected2-item_name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[ 2 ]-double_value exp = ls_expected2-double_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen zu verwenden, wird die Logik in einer einzigen Zeile ausgedrückt, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: FOR EXPRESSION, INTERNAL TABLES, TRANSFORMATION, FILTERING, VALUE OPERATOR, MODERN ABAP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Werten aus einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Dies ist eine funktionale Art der Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ... IN ... NEXT s = s + ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_value,
             category TYPE string,
             amount   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_value,
           ty_t_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_amount
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE ty_t_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_amount) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_amount.
    rv_total_amount = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_value IN it_values
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_value-amount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_amount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_amount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator=>ty_t_values(
      ( category = 'A' amount = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' amount = 20 )
      ( category = 'A' amount = 5 )
      ( category = 'C' amount = 15 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_amount( lt_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 50, msg = 'Incorrect total amount' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_values) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator=>ty_t_values( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_amount( lt_empty_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_empty exp = 0, msg = 'Total amount for empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariable in einer einzigen, funktionalen Expression auszudrücken. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert die Fehleranfälligkeit im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Konstrukten.
keywords: REDUCE OPERATOR, AGGREGATION, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, MODERN ABAP

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung unter Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Selektion von Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_product,
             id     TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             name   TYPE string,
             price  TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_product,
           ty_t_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_products
      IMPORTING
        it_all_products TYPE ty_t_products

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Klasse mit einer Fluent Interface (Method Chaining), um eine Konfiguration schrittweise aufzubauen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes.
hint: Geben Sie `ME` von den Methoden zurück, um das Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_settings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_param1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_config.

    METHODS set_param2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_config.

    METHODS add_setting
      IMPORTING
        iv_setting TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_config.

    METHODS get_config_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_param1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_param2 TYPE string.
    DATA mt_settings TYPE ty_t_settings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_param1.
    mv_param1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_param2.
    mv_param2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_setting.
    APPEND iv_setting TO mt_settings.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config_summary.
    DATA(lv_settings_str) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR setting IN mt_settings
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN setting ELSE s && ', ' && setting )
    ).
    rv_summary = |Param1: { mv_param1 }, Param2: { mv_param2 }, Settings: { lv_settings_str }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_interface FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_interface.
    DATA(lo_config) = NEW zcl_fluent_config( ).

    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_config->set_param1( 'ValueA' )
                                 ->set_param2( 'ValueB' )
                                 ->add_setting( 'Setting1' )
                                 ->add_setting( 'Setting2' )
                                 ->get_config_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_summary,
      exp = 'Param1: ValueA, Param2: ValueB, Settings: Setting1, Setting2',
      msg = 'Fluent interface did not produce expected summary'
    ).

    DATA(lv_summary_empty) = NEW zcl_fluent_config( )->get_config_summary( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_summary_empty,
      exp = 'Param1: , Param2: , Settings: ',
      msg = 'Empty config summary incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Fluent Interface, auch bekannt als Method Chaining, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinanderzureihen. Jede Methode, die Teil des Fluent Interface ist, gibt eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurück. Dies ist ein gängiges Designmuster in modernen objektorientierten Sprachen und wird hier mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator für die String-Aggregation kombiniert.
keywords: FLUENT INTERFACE, METHOD CHAINING, OBJECT ORIENTATION, REDUCE OPERATOR, MODERN ABAP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Zahlen unter Verwendung von modernen ABAP-Ausdrücken. Dies demonstriert die Verwendung von In-Line-Deklarationen und arithmetischen Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und In-Line-Deklarationen für die Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + number
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    ).

Dies führt zu einem sehr kompakten und gut lesbaren Code, der die Absicht klar ausdrückt. Die Behandlung des leeren Listenfalls ist ebenfalls enthalten.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Alter einer Person in Jahren basierend auf einem Geburtsdatum und dem aktuellen Datum. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne Datumsfunktionen und -ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` und Datumsarithmetik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age_in_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    IF iv_birth_date IS INITIAL OR iv_birth_date > lv_current_date.
      rv_age = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_years_diff) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    " Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4) ).
      rv_age = lv_years_diff - 1.
    ELSE.
      rv_age = lv_years_diff.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_age FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_dates FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculation( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    " Test case: Birthday already passed this year
    DATA(lv_birth_date_passed) = lv_current_date - 10000. " Approx 27 years ago
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( lv_birth_date_passed ) exp = 27 ).

    " Test case: Birthday not yet passed this year
    DATA(lv_birth_date_future) = lv_current_date - 9000. " Approx 24 years ago, but birthday in future
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( lv_birth_date_future ) exp = 24 ).

    " Test case: Exact birthday today
    DATA(lv_birth_date_today) = lv_current_date - 3652. " Approx 10 years ago
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( lv_birth_date_today ) exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calculation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( '00000000' ) exp = 0, msg = 'Invalid birth date should return 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->calculate_age_in_years( '99991231' ) exp = 0, msg = 'Future birth date should return 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Alters erfordert eine sorgfältige Datumsarithmetik, insbesondere die Berücksichtigung, ob der Geburtstag im aktuellen Jahr bereits stattgefunden hat. Dieses Beispiel verwendet `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date()` für das aktuelle Datum und moderne String-Offsets für den Vergleich von Monat und Tag. Die In-Line-Deklaration macht den Code kompakter.
keywords: DATE, TIME, AGE CALCULATION, CL_ABAP_CONTEXT_INFO, MODERN ABAP

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary,
           ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( " Target table type is inferred
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights_raw GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid       = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) " GROUP SIZE counts elements in the current group
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_for( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary, 'Summary table should not be empty' ).

    " Example: Check if LH has at least one flight
    DATA(ls_lh_summary) = VALUE zcl_group_by_for=>ty_s_flight_summary( ).
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_lh_summary WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0, 'LH should have flights' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'LH carrier not found in summary' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Check for unique carriers
    DATA(lv_unique_carriers) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_summary
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = lv_unique_carriers, msg = 'Each entry should represent a unique carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`-Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Er ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... AT NEW ... ENDAT`-Konstrukte durch eine deklarative Syntax. `GROUP SIZE` ist eine spezielle Variable, die innerhalb des Gruppenkontextes die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe liefert.
keywords: GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, SFLIGHTS, MODERN ABAP

CLASS zcl_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_date_by_country IMPORTING iv_date    TYPE sy-datum
                                           iv_country TYPE sy-langu
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_by_country.
    rv_formatted_date = COND string(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Werte einer internen Tabelle, aber nur für Einträge, die einen bestimmten Status haben. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen `REDUCE` Ausdruck mit `COND WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_conditional_sum IMPORTING it_items TYPE ty_t_item
                                              iv_filter_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + COND i( WHEN item-status = iv_filter_status THEN item-value ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_dynamic_criteria IMPORTING it_data TYPE ty_t_data
                                                 iv_filter_type TYPE string
                                       RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_dynamic_criteria.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE (
      COND #( WHEN iv_filter_type = 'EVEN_ID' THEN ( id MOD 2 = 0 )
              WHEN iv_filter_type = 'ODD_ID'  THEN ( id MOD 2 = 1 )
              ELSE abap_true ) = abap_true
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_shape.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.

  METHOD zif_shape~get_description. rv_description = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|. ENDMETHOD.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor. mv_side = iv_side. ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description. rv_description = |Quadrat mit Seitenlänge { mv_side }|. ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape IMPORTING io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_info = |Verarbeite { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_description() } (spezifischer Radius: { lo_circle->mv_radius })|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_info = |Verarbeite { lo_square->zif_shape~get_description() } (spezifische Seitenlänge: { lo_square->mv_side })|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_info = |Unbekannte Form: { io_shape->get_description() }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_conditional_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_source_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             id          TYPE i,
             status      TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_target_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_items IMPORTING it_source_items TYPE ty_t_source_item
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_items) TYPE ty_t_target_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_conditional_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_items.
    rt_target_items = VALUE #( FOR item IN it_source_items
      ( id = item-id
        status = item-status
        description = COND string( WHEN item-status = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
                                  WHEN item-status = 'P' THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                                  WHEN item-status = 'C' THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                                  ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein Flug 'pünktlich', 'verspätet' oder 'unbekannt' ist, basierend auf der Differenz zwischen geplanter und tatsächlicher Ankunftszeit. Nutzen Sie einen `COND` Ausdruck mit `WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

                                          iv_actual_time  TYPE sy-uzeit
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_time_diff) = iv_actual_time - iv_planned_time.

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN lv_time_diff <= 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN lv_time_diff > 0 AND lv_time_diff <= 300 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
      WHEN lv_time_diff > 300 THEN 'Stark verspätet'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach ihrem Status (pünktlich, verspätet, unbekannt) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Status. Nutzen Sie hierfür `GROUP BY` mit `COND WHEN` zur Statusbestimmung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `GROUP BY` und definieren Sie den Gruppierungsschlüssel dynamisch mit `COND WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_group_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             plan_dep_time TYPE sflight-deptime,
             act_dep_time  TYPE sflight-deptime,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status_count,
             status TYPE string,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_status_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_status_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_status IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_data
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_status_counts) TYPE ty_t_flight_status_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_status.
    rt_status_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights
      GROUP BY ( flight_status = COND string(
                                  WHEN flight-act_dep_time <= flight-plan_dep_time THEN 'Pünktlich'
                                  WHEN flight-act_dep_time > flight-plan_dep_time AND flight-act_dep_time - flight-plan_dep_time <= 300 THEN 'Leicht verspätet'
                                  WHEN flight-act_dep_time > flight-plan_dep_time THEN 'Stark verspätet'
                                  ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) )
      ( status = flight_status
        count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_column_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        it_data        TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_column_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row>   TYPE ty_s_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND <fs_field> TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_row_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_row_text.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE ty_s_data.

    ASSIGN TABLE FIELD (ct_data)[ iv_index ] TO <fs_row>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_row>-text = iv_new_text.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen generischen Eingabeparameter (`TYPE ANY`) akzeptiert und versucht, dessen Wert in einen String zu konvertieren, unabhängig vom ursprünglichen Typ.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_type_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_type_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).

    CASE lo_type_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        rv_string = iv_data.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
           cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data }|. " String Template for conversion
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data DATE = USER }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_string = |{ iv_data TIME = USER }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback for other types, might not be meaningful
        TRY.
            ASSIGN iv_data TO <fs_data> CASTING TYPE string. " Attempt direct cast
            rv_string = <fs_data>.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
            rv_string = 'Unsupported Type'.
        ENDTRY.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHODS process_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_process.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_processable> TYPE REF TO zif_processable.

    ASSIGN io_object TO <fs_processable> CASTING.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_result = <fs_processable>->process_data( ).

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine CSV-ähnliche Datei mit `cl_cts_language_file_io` und verarbeiten Sie dynamisch eine bestimmte Spalte, deren Name zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_cts_language_file_io` zum Lesen mit `SPLIT` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die dynamische Spaltenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_csv_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_csv_column
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path   TYPE string
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_delimiter   TYPE c DEFAULT ','
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_column_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_csv_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_csv_column.
    DATA lt_file_content TYPE string_table.
    DATA ls_header_line  TYPE string.
    DATA lt_header_fields TYPE string_table.
    DATA lv_column_index TYPE i.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file_into_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_file_name = iv_file_path
      IMPORTING
        e_file_content = lt_file_content
    ).

    IF lines( lt_file_content ) > 0.
      ls_header_line = lt_file_content[ 1 ].
      SPLIT ls_header_line AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_header_fields.

      LOOP AT lt_header_fields INTO DATA(lv_header_field).
        IF to_upper( lv_header_field ) = to_upper( iv_column_name ).
          lv_column_index = sy-tabix.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_column_index IS INITIAL.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_cts_language_file_io
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_cts_language_file_io=>cx_file_not_found. " Re-use for 'column not found'
      ENDIF.

      DELETE lt_file_content INDEX 1. " Remove header

      LOOP AT lt_file_content INTO DATA(lv_line).
        DATA lt_line_fields TYPE string_table.
        SPLIT lv_line AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_line_fields.

        IF lv_column_index <= lines( lt_line_fields ).
          APPEND lt_line_fields[ lv_column_index ] TO rt_column_values.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_sort_field TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_sflight_data TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflight_table.
    " Check if the field exists in the structure (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ct_sflight_data[ 1 ] ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_field_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      IF to_upper( ls_component-name ) = to_upper( iv_sort_field ).
        lv_field_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_field_found = abap_true.
      SORT ct_sflight_data BY (iv_sort_field).
    ELSE.
      " Handle error or log warning if field not found
      " For this example, we'll just skip sorting if field is invalid
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_clear_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clear_column_in_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_generic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any table line
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_clear_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clear_column_in_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row>   TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_field_found TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    IF lines( ct_generic_table ) IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT ct_generic_table ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CLEAR <fs_field>.
        lv_field_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_success = lv_field_found.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_field TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
        it_sflight_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_sflight.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row>   TYPE ty_s_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_filter_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_field> = iv_filter_value.
          APPEND <fs_row> TO rt_filtered_data.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feld gruppiert und die Anzahl der Einträge pro Gruppe zurückgibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_group_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_group_result.
    TYPES: ty_t_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_group_field TYPE string
        it_sflight_data TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_counts) TYPE ty_t_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflight_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row>   TYPE ty_s_sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA lt_temp_grouped TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_s_group_result WITH UNIQUE KEY group_key.
    DATA ls_temp_group   TYPE ty_s_group_result.

    LOOP AT it_sflight_data ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_group_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_temp_group-group_key = <fs_field>.
        READ TABLE lt_temp_grouped INTO DATA(ls_existing_group) WITH TABLE KEY group_key = ls_temp_group-group_key.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ls_existing_group-count = ls_existing_group-count + 1.
          MODIFY TABLE lt_temp_grouped FROM ls_existing_group.
        ELSE.
          ls_temp_group-count = 1.
          INSERT ls_temp_group INTO TABLE lt_temp_grouped.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_group_counts = VALUE #( FOR group_entry IN lt_temp_grouped ( group_entry ) ).
    SORT rt_group_counts BY group_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_field_value,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_field_value.
    TYPES: ty_t_field_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component,
          lo_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    " 1. Build dynamic structure definition
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-field_name.
      lo_data_descr = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " Assume all fields are strings for simplicity
      ls_component-type = lo_data_descr.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any table line.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Populate dynamic table (example with one row)
    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_new_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <fs_new_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

      IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_val>).
          IF <fs_field_val> IS ASSIGNED.
            <fs_field_val> = ls_field_def-field_value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discount_percentage
      IMPORTING
        iv_loyalty_points TYPE i
        iv_purchase_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discount_percent) TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount_percentage.
    rv_discount_percent = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_loyalty_points >= 1000 AND iv_purchase_amount >= 500 THEN 15
      WHEN iv_loyalty_points >= 500 AND iv_purchase_amount >= 200 THEN 10
      WHEN iv_loyalty_points >= 100 OR iv_purchase_amount >= 100 THEN 5
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, die nur Flüge zu einem bestimmten Zielort enthält. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `CASE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einem `CASE`-Ausdruck, um die Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_destination
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_destination.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( cityto = iv_destination )
                                   ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                     connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                     fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                                     cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom,
                                     cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie die Daten für eine hierarchische Darstellung von Flugverbindungen (Carrier -> Connection Number) vor, die in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree` angezeigt werden soll. Die Methode soll die Knotendaten zurückgeben.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `LVC_T_GNOD` und füllen Sie diese mit den hierarchischen Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_text,
             isfolder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_node.

    " Helper method to display the tree (for demonstration, not unit testable directly)
    METHODS display_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes TYPE tt_flight_node
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_nodes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0,
          lv_relat_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                            ( ls_sflight-carrid ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      lv_relat_key = lv_node_key.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_relat_key
                                   relatkey = ''
                                   text = |Carrier: { lv_carrier }|
                                   isfolder = abap_true ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrier.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_node_key
                                     relatkey = lv_relat_key
                                     text = |Connection: { ls_flight-connid } ({ ls_flight-cityfrom } - { ls_flight-cityto })|
                                     isfolder = abap_false ) TO rt_nodes.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          ls_node TYPE ty_flight_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    LOOP AT it_nodes INTO ls_node.
      lo_tree->add_node(
        node_key = ls_node-node_key
        relat_node_key = ls_node-relatkey
        text = ls_node-text
        isfolder = ls_node-isfolder
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->expand_subtree( '1' ). " Expand first node for better visibility
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_node_structure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_node_count FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_node_structure.
    DATA(lo_prep) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_prep->prepare_flight_tree_nodes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nodes msg = 'Node table should not be empty' ).

    " Check a carrier node
    READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_carrier_node) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrier_node-relatkey exp = '' msg = 'First node should be root' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_carrier_node-isfolder msg = 'Carrier node should be a folder' ).

    " Check a connection node (assuming at least one connection exists)
    READ TABLE lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_conn_node) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_conn_node-relatkey msg = 'Connection node should have a parent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = ls_conn_node-isfolder msg = 'Connection node should not be a folder' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_node_count.
    DATA(lo_prep) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_prep->prepare_flight_tree_nodes( ).

    " The exact count depends on SFLIGHT data, but we can check for a reasonable minimum
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_nodes ) > 0 msg = 'Should have more than 0 nodes' ).

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_items_prep IMPLEMENTATION.

    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie Methoden zum dynamischen Hinzufügen und Entfernen von Knoten aus einer internen Datenstruktur, die einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` repräsentiert. Die Methoden sollen die aktualisierte Datenstruktur zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie interne Tabellenoperationen, um die Knotendaten zu manipulieren, und simulieren Sie die GUI-Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_text,
             isfolder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH UNIQUE KEY node_key.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS add_flight_connection
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_current_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_node.

    METHODS remove_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_current_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_node.

    " Helper method to display the tree (for demonstration)
    METHODS display_dynamic_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes TYPE tt_flight_node
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE tt_flight_node.
    DATA mv_next_node_key TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS get_next_node_key RETURNING VALUE(rv_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialize with some base nodes if needed, or keep empty.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_node_key.
    mv_next_node_key = mv_next_node_key + 1.
    rv_key = |{ mv_next_node_key }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_connection.
    DATA(lv_carrier_node_key) = get_next_node_key( ).
    DATA(lv_conn_node_key) = get_next_node_key( ).

    " Check if carrier node already exists
    READ TABLE mt_nodes WITH KEY text = |Carrier: { iv_carrier }| INTO DATA(ls_existing_carrier).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Add carrier node
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_carrier_node_key
                                   relatkey = ''
                                   text = |Carrier: { iv_carrier }|
                                   isfolder = abap_true ) TO mt_nodes.
    ELSE.
      lv_carrier_node_key = ls_existing_carrier-node_key.
    ENDIF.

    " Add connection node
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_conn_node_key
                                 relatkey = lv_carrier_node_key
                                 text = |Connection: { iv_connid } ({ iv_cityfrom } - { iv_cityto })|
                                 isfolder = abap_false ) TO mt_nodes.

    rt_current_nodes = mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_node.
    DELETE mt_nodes WHERE node_key = iv_node_key.
    " Also remove any children if it was a folder (simplified for this example)
    DELETE mt_nodes WHERE relatkey = iv_node_key.
    rt_current_nodes = mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_dynamic_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          ls_node TYPE ty_flight_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    " Clear existing tree before rebuilding
    lo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).

    LOOP AT it_nodes INTO ls_node.
      lo_tree->add_node(
        node_key = ls_node-node_key
        relat_node_key = ls_node-relatkey
        text = ls_node-text
        isfolder = ls_node-isfolder
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->expand_subtree( '1' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_node.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_tree) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes_after_add1) = lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'LH' '400' 'FRANKFURT' 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes_after_add1 ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 nodes (carrier + connection)' ).

    DATA(lt_nodes_after_add2) = lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'UA' '900' 'CHICAGO' 'LONDON' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes_after_add2 ) exp = 4 msg = 'Should have 4 nodes (2 carriers + 2 connections)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_remove_node.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_tree) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_dynamic( ).
    lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'LH' '400' 'FRANKFURT' 'NEW YORK' ).
    lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'UA' '900' 'CHICAGO' 'LONDON' ).

    " Find a node key to remove (e.g., the first connection node)
    DATA(lt_current_nodes) = lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'BA' '100' 'LONDON' 'PARIS' ).
    READ TABLE lt_current_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node_to_remove) WITH KEY text = 'Connection: 400 (FRANKFURT - NEW YORK)'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_node_to_remove-node_key msg = 'Node to remove should exist' ).

    DATA(lt_nodes_after_remove) = lo_dynamic_tree->remove_node( ls_node_to_remove-node_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes_after_remove ) exp = 5 msg = 'Should have 5 nodes after removing one connection' ).
    " Check if the specific node is gone
    READ TABLE lt_nodes_after_remove TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY node_key = ls_node_to_remove-node_key.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Removed node should not be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_tree) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_dynamic( ).
    lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'LH' '400' 'FRANKFURT' 'NEW YORK' ).
    DATA(lt_nodes_after_add) = lo_dynamic_tree->add_flight_connection( 'LH' '401' 'FRANKFURT' 'LONDON' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_nodes_after_add ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 nodes (1 carrier + 2 connections)' ).
    " Verify only one carrier node for LH
    DATA(lv_lh_carrier_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_nodes_after_add INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE text = 'Carrier: LH'.
      lv_lh_carrier_count = lv_lh_carrier_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lh_carrier_count exp = 1 msg = 'Should only have one carrier node for LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Kontextmenü für die Knoten eines `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Die Methode soll die Menüpunkte zurückgeben, die für einen bestimmten Knotentyp generiert würden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ctmenu` und registrieren Sie sich für das `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST`-Event. Die Event-Handler-Methode soll das Menü dynamisch aufbauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_menu_item,
             function TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_menu_item.
    TYPES tt_menu_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_menu_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_display_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    " Method to simulate context menu request for testing
    METHODS simulate_context_menu_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey
        iv_is_folder TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_menu_items) TYPE tt_menu_items.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL FOR EVENTS context_menu_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_context_menu_request
          FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree
          IMPORTING
            node_key
            menu.
        DATA mo_parent TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_tree_context_menu. " Reference to the main class
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_context_menu_request.
        DATA(lv_is_folder) = abap_false.
        IF mo_parent IS BOUND AND mo_parent->mo_tree IS BOUND.
          TRY.
              mo_parent->mo_tree->get_node_data(
                EXPORTING
                  node_key = node_key
                IMPORTING
                  isfolder = lv_is_folder
              ).
            CATCH cx_gui_error.
              " Handle error, e.g., node not found
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lt_menu_items) = mo_parent->simulate_context_menu_request( iv_node_key = node_key iv_is_folder = lv_is_folder ).

        DATA(lo_menu) = CAST cl_ctmenu( menu ).
        LOOP AT lt_menu_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
          lo_menu->add_function( fcode = ls_item-function text = ls_item-text ).
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_tree.
    DATA(lo_node_prep) = NEW zcl_flight_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_node_prep->prepare_flight_tree_nodes( ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        node_key = ls_node-node_key
        relat_node_key = ls_node-relatkey
        text = ls_node-text
        isfolder = ls_node-isfolder
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_event_handler) = NEW lcl_event_handler( ).
    lo_event_handler->mo_parent = me.

    SET HANDLER lo_event_handler->on_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.

    mo_tree->expand_subtree( '1' ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_context_menu_request.
    IF iv_is_folder = abap_true.
      APPEND VALUE ty_menu_item( function = 'EXPAND' text = 'Expand/Collapse' ) TO rt_menu_items.
      APPEND VALUE ty_menu_item( function = 'ADD_CONN' text = 'Add Connection' ) TO rt_menu_items.
    ELSE.
      APPEND VALUE ty_menu_item( function = 'SHOW_DET' text = 'Show Details' ) TO rt_menu_items.
      APPEND VALUE ty_menu_item( function = 'DEL_CONN' text = 'Delete Connection' ) TO rt_menu_items.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND VALUE ty_menu_item( function = 'REFRESH' text = 'Refresh Tree' ) TO rt_menu_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Daten für einen `cl_gui_simple_tree` vorbereitet und dabei die `sflights`-Tabelle verwendet, um eine hierarchische Struktur von Ländern, Städten und Flügen zu erstellen. Die Methode soll die Knotendaten zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` und `VALUE` um die hierarchischen Daten effizient zu strukturieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_geo_tree_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             relatkey TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_text,
             isfolder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_node TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH UNIQUE KEY node_key.

    METHODS prepare_geo_flight_tree_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node.

    " Helper method to display the tree (for demonstration)
    METHODS display_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes TYPE tt_tree_node
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_geo_tree_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_geo_flight_tree_nodes.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_node_key TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, countryfr, cityfrom, countryto, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY countryfr cityfrom countryto cityto carrid connid.

    rt_nodes = VALUE tt_tree_node(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_countryfr IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( country = ls_flight_countryfr-countryfr ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_country_key = |C_{ lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 }|
      IN
      ( node_key = lv_country_key
        relatkey = ''
        text = |Country: { ls_flight_countryfr-country }|
        isfolder = abap_true )

      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight_cityfrom IN GROUP ls_flight_countryfr GROUP BY ( city = ls_flight_cityfrom-cityfrom ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_city_key = |CT_{ lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 }|
      IN
      ( node_key = lv_city_key
        relatkey = lv_country_key
        text = |City: { ls_flight_cityfrom-city }|
        isfolder = abap_true )

      FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_flight_cityfrom
      LET lv_flight_key = |F_{ lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1 }|
      IN
      ( node_key = lv_flight_key
        relatkey = lv_city_key
        text = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid } to { ls_flight-cityto }|
        isfolder = abap_false )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          ls_node TYPE ty_tree_node.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_sel_mode_single.

    LOOP AT it_nodes INTO ls_node.
      lo_tree->add_node(
        node_key = ls_node-node_key
        relat_node_key = ls_node-relatkey
        text = ls_node-text
        isfolder = ls_node-isfolder
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->expand_subtree( 'C_1' ). " Expand first country node
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_node_keys_unique FOR TESTING.
