Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Liste von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`), bei der die angezeigten Spalten zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen ausgewählt werden. Verwenden Sie RTTI, um den Feldkatalog zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_list_layout=>factory` zusammen mit `FOR` für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_sflights_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table " List of field names to display
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight. " Return data for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights[ 1 ] )->as_structdescr( ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      DATA(lt_field_catalog) = VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>tt_field_catalog(
        FOR ls_field_name IN it_field_names
          LET ls_component = lt_components[ name = ls_field_name ] IN
          ( fieldname = ls_field_name
            coltext   = ls_component-as_ddic_type-fieldtext )
      ).

      DATA(lo_list_layout) = cl_abap_list_layout=>factory(
        i_data = REF #( lt_sflights )
        i_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
    rt_sflights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Delimiter (z.B. Komma, Semikolon, Pipe) getrennt ist, und extrahieren Sie die einzelnen Tokens. Die Delimiter können auch mehrfach hintereinander auftreten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit `FIND` und `SUBSTRING` und `REPLACE` um Delimiter zu normalisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_parser_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiters   TYPE string " e.g., ',;|'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tokens) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_parser_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_string.
    DATA(lv_processed_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_current_pos) = 0.
    DATA(lv_next_delimiter_pos) = 0.
    DATA(lv_token) = ''.

    " Normalize multiple delimiters to a single one (e.g., space)
    LOOP AT iv_delimiters INTO DATA(lv_delimiter).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_delimiter IN lv_processed_string WITH ' '.
    ENDLOOP.
    " Replace multiple spaces with a single space
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_processed_string WITH ' '.
    " Trim leading/trailing spaces
    CONDENSE lv_processed_string.

    " Use WHILE loop to split by single space
    WHILE lv_current_pos < STRLEN( lv_processed_string ).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF ' ' IN SECTION OFFSET lv_current_pos OF lv_processed_string MATCH OFFSET lv_next_delimiter_pos.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_token = lv_processed_string+lv_current_pos(lv_next_delimiter_pos - lv_current_pos).
        IF lv_token IS NOT INITIAL.
          INSERT lv_token INTO TABLE rt_tokens.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_pos = lv_next_delimiter_pos + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Last token
        lv_token = lv_processed_string+lv_current_pos.
        IF lv_token IS NOT INITIAL.
          INSERT lv_token INTO TABLE rt_tokens.
        ENDIF.
        lv_current_pos = STRLEN( lv_processed_string ). " Exit loop
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`), die nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungsnummer sortiert und nach einem bestimmten Preis gefiltert ist, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_list_layout`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT` und den funktionalen `FILTER`-Operator, bevor Sie die Daten an `cl_abap_list_layout` übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_sflights_sorted_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sorted_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_sorted_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sorted_filtered_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    " Sort the table
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid ASCENDING connid ASCENDING.

    " Filter the table using functional filter operator
    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER zcl_list_sflights_sorted_filtered=>tt_sflight(
      lt_sflights WHERE price >= iv_min_price
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout(
        i_data = REF #( lt_filtered_sflights )
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
    rt_sflights = lt_filtered_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sorting_and_filtering FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_initial_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorting_and_filtering.
    DATA(lo_sflights_list) = NEW zcl_list_sflights_sorted_filtered( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_sflights_list->display_sorted_filtered_sflights( iv_min_price = 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'No flights found in SFLIGHTS table. Please ensure data exists.'
      reverse = abap_true
    ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      " Check sorting (first two elements)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid LE lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid ).
      IF lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-connid LE lt_result[ 2 ]-connid ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
    " Check filtering
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price >= 500 ).
    ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine 'verkettete Liste' (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle mit Zeiger auf den nächsten Eintrag) durchläuft und alle Elemente sammelt. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die Iteration.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einem Feld für den 'next_index' und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die abbricht, wenn der 'next_index' ungültig ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_linked_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_list_node,
             id        TYPE i,
             value     TYPE string,
             next_index TYPE i, " Index of the next node in the table
           END OF ty_list_node,
           tt_linked_list TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_list_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS traverse_list
      IMPORTING
        it_list_data TYPE tt_linked_list
        iv_start_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_collected_values) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_linked_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD traverse_list.
    DATA(lv_current_index) = iv_start_index.
    DATA(ls_current_node) = VALUE ty_list_node( ).

    IF NOT line_exists( it_list_data[ lv_current_index ] ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Start index not found in list data.'.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_current_index > 0 AND lv_current_index <= lines( it_list_data ).
      ls_current_node = it_list_data[ lv_current_index ].
      INSERT ls_current_node-value INTO TABLE rt_collected_values.
      lv_current_index = ls_current_node-next_index.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine aggregierte Liste von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`), die die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft anzeigt. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation und `cl_abap_list_layout` zur Anzeige.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_sflights_aggregated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_flight,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             avg_price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_flight,
           tt_aggregated_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_aggregated_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_aggregated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE tt_aggregated_flight(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      ( carrid        = ls_flight-carrid
        total_flights = lv_count
        avg_price     = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0.0
                                   FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price ) / lv_count
      )
    ).

    IF lt_aggregated_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout(
        i_data = REF #( lt_aggregated_data )
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
    rt_aggregated_data = lt_aggregated_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Zustandsmaschine, die den Status eines Prozesses basierend auf einer Sequenz von Ereignissen ändert. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Ereignisse zu verarbeiten.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und eine `CASE`-Anweisung, um den aktuellen Zustand zu verwalten und auf Ereignisse zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_state_machine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event,
           tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_state TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_states,
                 initial TYPE ty_state VALUE 'INITIAL',
                 processing TYPE ty_state VALUE 'PROCESSING',
                 completed TYPE ty_state VALUE 'COMPLETED',
                 error TYPE ty_state VALUE 'ERROR',
               END OF gc_states.

    METHODS process_events
      IMPORTING
        it_events TYPE tt_events
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_state) TYPE ty_state.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_machine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_events.
    DATA(lv_current_state) = gc_states-initial.
    DATA(lv_event_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_current_state <> gc_states-completed AND lv_current_state <> gc_states-error
          AND lv_event_index <= lines( it_events ).

      DATA(ls_current_event) = it_events[ lv_event_index ].

      CASE lv_current_state.
        WHEN gc_states-initial.
          IF ls_current_event-name = 'START'.
            lv_current_state = gc_states-processing.
          ELSE.
            lv_current_state = gc_states-error.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN gc_states-processing.
          IF ls_current_event-name = 'PROCESS_STEP'.
            " Simulate some processing
            " Stay in PROCESSING state
          ELSEIF ls_current_event-name = 'FINISH'.
            lv_current_state = gc_states-completed.
          ELSEIF ls_current_event-name = 'FAIL'.
            lv_current_state = gc_states-error.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Should not happen if states are handled correctly
          lv_current_state = gc_states-error.
      ENDCASE.

      lv_event_index = lv_event_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_final_state = lv_current_state.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_styled DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_styled,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             cell_style TYPE cl_abap_list_layout=>ty_cell_style_tab, " For cell-specific styling

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_styled IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_styled_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Prepare data with styling information using VALUE operator
    rt_styled_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight_styled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price

                             THEN VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>ty_cell_style_tab(

                                  )
                             ELSE VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>ty_cell_style_tab( ) )
      )
    ).

    IF rt_styled_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout(
        i_data = REF #( rt_styled_sflights )
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings aus einem gegebenen String. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um den String iterativ zu bereinigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` in Kombination mit `FIND` und `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_substring    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_substring.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    IF iv_substring IS INITIAL.
      rv_cleaned_string = iv_input_string.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    WHILE lv_offset IS NOT INITIAL OR lv_offset = 0. " Loop until FIND returns sy-subrc <> 0
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_substring IN lv_temp_string MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        REPLACE SECTION OFFSET lv_offset LENGTH STRLEN( iv_substring ) OF lv_temp_string WITH ''.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR lv_offset. " Exit loop
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_calculated DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_calculated IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calculated_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency

    rt_sflights_ext = VALUE tt_sflight_ext(

        connid   = ls_sflight-connid

    IF rt_sflights_ext IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_list_layout) = NEW cl_abap_list_layout(
        i_data = REF #( rt_sflights_ext )
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum, indem Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen zu einem Startdatum hinzufügen. Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag) sollen übersprungen werden. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Arbeitstage zu zählen, und `cl_abap_date_helper` oder einfache Datumsarithmetik, um das Datum zu inkrementieren und den Wochentag zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_workdays   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_workdays.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_days_added) = 0.

    WHILE lv_days_added < iv_workdays.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1. " Increment date by one day

      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).

      " Check if it's a weekday (Monday=1 to Friday=5)
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5.
        lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_end_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen durchläuft und die Summe der Zahlen berechnet, bis die Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Die Schleife soll dann abbrechen und die bisherige Summe zurückgeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit einer Abbruchbedingung, die die Summe prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_until_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_until_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_index) = 1.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_threshold AND lv_index <= lines( it_numbers ).
      lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + it_numbers[ lv_index ].
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_sum = lv_current_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        i_data = REF #( lt_sflights )
        i_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die die ersten N Primzahlen findet. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Kandidaten zu prüfen und eine innere Schleife zur Primzahlprüfung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Anzahl der gefundenen Primzahlen zu verfolgen, und eine innere `WHILE`-Schleife oder `DO` für die Teilbarkeitsprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prime_number_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_first_n_primes
      IMPORTING
        iv_n_primes TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_primes) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prime_number_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_first_n_primes.
    IF iv_n_primes <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Number of primes must be positive.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_number) = 2.
    DATA(lv_primes_found) = 0.

    WHILE lv_primes_found < iv_n_primes.
      DATA(lb_is_prime) = abap_true.
      IF lv_current_number <= 1.
        lb_is_prime = abap_false.
      ELSEIF lv_current_number > 2 AND lv_current_number MOD 2 = 0.
        lb_is_prime = abap_false.
      ELSE.
        DATA(lv_divisor) = 3.
        " Inner WHILE loop for primality test
        WHILE ( lv_divisor * lv_divisor ) <= lv_current_number.
          IF lv_current_number MOD lv_divisor = 0.
            lb_is_prime = abap_false.
            EXIT. " Exit inner loop
          ENDIF.
          lv_divisor = lv_divisor + 2.
        ENDWHILE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lb_is_prime = abap_true.
        INSERT lv_current_number INTO TABLE rt_primes.
        lv_primes_found = lv_primes_found + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_number = lv_current_number + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) an, wobei die Spaltenreihenfolge dynamisch zur Laufzeit festgelegt wird. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_list_layout` und eine sortierte Liste von Feldnamen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Liste der gewünschten Feldnamen und nutzen Sie diese, um den Feldkatalog für `cl_abap_list_layout` zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_list_sflights_reordered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_reordered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_ordered_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_sflights_reordered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_reordered_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights[ 1 ] )->as_structdescr( ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      DATA(lt_field_catalog) = VALUE cl_abap_list_layout=>tt_field_catalog(
        FOR ls_field_name IN it_ordered_field_names
          LET ls_component = lt_components[ name = ls_field_name ] IN
          ( fieldname = ls_field_name
            coltext   = ls_component-as_ddic_type-fieldtext )
      ).

      DATA(lo_list_layout) = cl_abap_list_layout=>factory(
        i_data = REF #( lt_sflights )
        i_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog
      ).
      " lo_list_layout->display( ).
    ENDIF.
    rt_sflights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, konvertieren Sie das Feld `PLANETYPE` von der System-Codepage nach UTF-8 und speichern Sie es in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `FOR` und `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` in Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_converted,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE string, " Changed to string for converted value
           END OF ty_sflight_converted.
    TYPES tt_sflight_converted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_converted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflights_planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_converted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_converted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflights_planetype.
    DATA(lv_system_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_converted_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights_raw
        LET lv_xstring_raw = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                               text      = ls_sflight-planetype
                               codepage  = lv_system_codepage
                               endian    = 'B' )
            lv_planetype_utf8 = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                  xtext     = lv_xstring_raw
                                  codepage  = 'UTF-8'
                                  endian    = 'B' )
        IN ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
             connid    = ls_sflight-connid
             fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
             planetype = lv_planetype_utf8 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von UTF-8 nach ISO-8859-1, ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens im konvertierten String und fügen Sie das Ergebnis in einen String-Template ein.

CLASS zcl_codepage_string_tmpl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_template
      IMPORTING
        iv_input          TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_char_to_replace TYPE c LENGTH 1
        iv_replacement_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_template) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_string_tmpl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_template.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                              text      = iv_input
                              codepage  = 'UTF-8'
                              endian    = 'B' ).

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                  xtext     = lv_xstring_utf8
                                  codepage  = iv_target_codepage
                                  endian    = 'B' ).

    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_char_to_replace IN lv_converted_string WITH iv_replacement_char.

    rv_output_template = |Das Ergebnis der Konvertierung ist: '{ lv_converted_string }'.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie zwei Strings in eine gemeinsame Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) und vergleichen Sie sie anschließend. Überprüfen Sie, ob die Strings nach der Konvertierung gleich sind.
hint: Konvertieren Sie beide Strings in eine neutrale Codepage, bevor Sie sie vergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_strings_after_conversion
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1         TYPE string
        iv_string2         TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_strings_after_conversion.
    DATA(lv_xstring1_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                               text      = iv_string1
                               codepage  = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage()
                               endian    = 'B' ).
    DATA(lv_converted_string1) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                   xtext     = lv_xstring1_utf8
                                   codepage  = iv_target_codepage
                                   endian    = 'B' ).

    DATA(lv_xstring2_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                               text      = iv_string2
                               codepage  = cl_abap_codepage=>get_system_codepage()
                               endian    = 'B' ).
    DATA(lv_converted_string2) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                   xtext     = lv_xstring2_utf8
                                   codepage  = iv_target_codepage
                                   endian    = 'B' ).

    IF lv_converted_string1 = lv_converted_string2.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen und zeigen Sie einen einfachen Baum mit statischen Knoten unter Verwendung von `cl_gui_simple_tree` an. Das Beispiel soll die grundlegende Struktur eines Baums mit einem Wurzelknoten und zwei Kindknoten demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` als Parent und die Methode `add_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tre_simple_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tre_simple_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_simple_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    " In einem echten Programm müsste ein Custom Container auf einem Dynpro existieren.
    " Für dieses Beispiel wird nur die Instanziierung gezeigt.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_root
      i_node_text      = 'Root Node'
      e_new_node_key   = DATA(lv_root_key)
    ).

    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Child 1'
      e_new_node_key   = DATA(lv_child1_key)
    ).

    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
      i_node_text      = 'Child 2'
    ).

    lo_tree->set_top_node( lv_root_key ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( lv_root_key ).

    " Um den Baum tatsächlich anzuzeigen, müsste diese Methode
    " im PBO eines Dynpros aufgerufen werden.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie einen Baum mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights`, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und String-Templates für die Knotentexte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tre_sflights_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tre_sflights_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container.

    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT'
      i_relationship   = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_root
      i_node_text      = 'Flight Data'
      e_new_node_key   = DATA(lv_root_key)
    ).

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

CLASS zcl_tre_dynamic_nodes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,

                         ( id = 'ITEM2' text = 'Item A2' ) ) )
      ( id = 'CAT2' name = 'Category B'

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer Sprachdatei und filtern Sie alle Zeilen, die ein bestimmtes Schlüsselwort enthalten. Geben Sie die gefilterten Zeilen als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `read_file_content` mit `SPLIT` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fil_filter_lang_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_lang_file_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_language  TYPE sy_langu
        iv_keyword   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fil_filter_lang_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_lang_file_lines.
    DATA(lo_file_io) = NEW cl_cts_language_file_io( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = ``.

    TRY.
        lv_content = lo_file_io->read_file_content(
          i_file_path = iv_file_path
          i_language  = iv_language
        ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Leere Tabelle zurückgeben
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_content IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lt_all_lines) = VALUE string_table( FOR <line> IN  cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_content sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) WHERE ( <line> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <line> ) ).

      rt_filtered_lines = FILTER #( lt_all_lines USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( contains( text = table_line regex = iv_keyword ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lines_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fil_filter_lang_file( ).
    " Mocking file content for test
    DATA(lv_mock_content) = 'Line 1 with keyword.
Line 2 without.
Another line with keyword.'.
    " In a real scenario, you'd write lv_mock_content to a temp file first.
    " For this test, we simulate the read_file_content result.
    " This test is conceptual, as cl_cts_language_file_io cannot be easily mocked.
    " We assume read_file_content returns lv_mock_content.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_lang_file_lines( iv_file_path = '/mock/path/file.txt' iv_language = 'E' iv_keyword = 'keyword' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'Line 1 with keyword.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'Another line with keyword.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_lines_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fil_filter_lang_file( ).
    DATA(lv_mock_content) = 'Line 1.
Line 2.
Line 3.'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_lang_file_lines( iv_file_path = '/mock/path/file.txt' iv_language = 'E' iv_keyword = 'nonexistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lade den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) als CSV-Datei auf das Frontend des Benutzers herunter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download`. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine Frontend-Interaktion ist und nicht direkt in einem reinen Unit-Test getestet werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_download_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_sflights_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights.csv'
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_download_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_csv.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    " Get desktop directory as a suggestion, or use a fixed path
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory(
      CHANGING
        desktop_directory = lv_filepath
    ).
    lv_filepath = lv_filepath && '\' && iv_filename.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC' " ASCII for CSV
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = it_sflights
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error during GUI download'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_download_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_download_csv( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_gui_download_csv=>tt_sflight.

    " Populate some dummy data for the internal table
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231208' price = '123.45' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231209' price = '678.90' ) TO lt_sflights.

    " In a real unit test, GUI interactions are usually mocked or skipped.
    " Here, we just ensure the method can be called without syntax errors.
    " The actual file download cannot be asserted in a standard ABAP Unit test.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->download_sflights_csv( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_filename = 'test_sflights.csv' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'GUI download method called (actual download not testable)' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` ist die Standardmethode, um Daten von einem ABAP-System auf das Frontend des Benutzers herunterzuladen. Die Verwendung von `has_field_separator = abap_true` ist entscheidend für die Erstellung einer korrekten CSV-Datei. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `cx_gui_frontend_services` ist ebenfalls eine moderne Praxis.
keywords: GUI, Download, CSV, Frontend, cl_gui_frontend_services, Internal Table

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_file_not_exist FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_exist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_file_exist( ).
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory(
      CHANGING
        desktop_directory = lv_filepath
    ).
    " This test assumes a file named 'dummy_test_file.txt' might exist on the desktop.
    " For a robust test, one would create and delete the file in setup/teardown.
    lv_filepath = lv_filepath && '\dummy_test_file.txt'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_file_existence( lv_filepath ).
        " Assert that the method was called successfully. Actual existence depends on environment.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'File existence check method called' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_not_exist.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_file_exist( ).
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory(
      CHANGING
        desktop_directory = lv_filepath
    ).
    " This file should definitely not exist.
    lv_filepath = lv_filepath && '\non_existent_file_123456789.tmp'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_file_existence( lv_filepath ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false msg = 'File should not exist' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_execute_notepad.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_execute_program( ).
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_desktop_directory(
      CHANGING
        desktop_directory = lv_filepath
    ).
    lv_filepath = lv_filepath && '\test_document.txt'.

    " Create a dummy file for Notepad to open (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(lt_content) = VALUE string_table( ( 'This is a test document.' ) ).
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename = lv_filepath
            filetype = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab = lt_content
        ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Ignore if file creation fails for test, focus on execute.
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_notepad_with_file( lv_filepath ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Program execution method called (actual execution not testable)' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Clean up the dummy file (optional)
    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_delete( filename = lv_filepath ).
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        " Ignore if file deletion fails.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_to_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_date) = '20231208'.

    DATA(lv_expected_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.

Instructions: Öffne eine URL im Standard-Webbrowser des Benutzers.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute` mit der URL als Parameter und 'explorer.exe' (Windows) oder dem Standard-Browser-Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_open_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS open_url_in_browser
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_open_url IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD open_url_in_browser.
    DATA: lv_application TYPE string.

    IF sy-opsys = 'WINDOWS'.
      lv_application = 'explorer.exe'. " On Windows, explorer.exe can open URLs
    ELSE.
      " For other OS, a more generic approach might be needed or specific browser commands.
      " For simplicity, we assume Windows or a system where direct URL execution works.
      lv_application = iv_url.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>execute(
      EXPORTING
        application = lv_application
        parameter   = COND string( WHEN sy-opsys = 'WINDOWS' THEN iv_url ELSE '' ) " Parameter only for Windows explorer
        get_program_name = abap_true
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS      = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Error opening URL in browser'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timestamp_to_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_from_timestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = '20231208100000.0000000'. " Example UTC timestamp
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d, lv_time TYPE t.

    " The expected date/time depends on the system's timezone relative to UTC.
    " For this example, we assume a system where 20231208100000 UTC converts to 20231208 110000 (e.g., CET/CEST +1 hour).
    " A robust test would involve setting a specific timezone for the test or mocking the datfm instance.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_from_utc_timestamp( EXPORTING iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp IMPORTING ev_date = lv_date ev_time = lv_time ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_date exp = '20231208' msg = 'Date should be 20231208' ).
        " This assertion might fail depending on the actual system timezone.
        " For a system in CET (UTC+1), 10:00:00 UTC is 11:00:00 local time.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time exp = '110000' msg = 'Time should be 11:00:00 (assuming CET)' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_datfm_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Sie konvertiert einen UTC-Zeitstempel zurück in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit, basierend auf den Zeitzoneneinstellungen des Systems oder Benutzers. CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type.
    rv_mime_type = COND string(

      WHEN iv_file_extension = 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_text_xml

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

      WHEN iv_extension = 'xml' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_text_xml
      WHEN iv_extension = 'css' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_text_css

solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_custom_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mime_mapping,
             extension TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mime_mapping,
           tt_mime_mappings TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_mime_mapping
                                WITH UNIQUE KEY extension.

    METHODS get_custom_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_mime_mappings TYPE tt_mime_mappings READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_custom_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_mime_mappings = VALUE #( " Initialisierung der HASHED TABLE
      ( extension = 'csv' mime_type = 'text/csv' )
      ( extension = 'json' mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_json )
      ( extension = 'xlsx' mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' )
      ( extension = 'docx' mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_custom_mime_type.
    READ TABLE mt_mime_mappings INTO DATA(ls_mapping) WITH TABLE KEY extension = iv_file_extension.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_mime_type = ls_mapping-mime_type.
    ELSE.
      rv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_octet_stream.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_multi_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_data,
             type TYPE bal_msgty,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message_data,
           tt_message_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_app_log_multi_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_multiple_messages.
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object    = 'SZAL'
      subobject = 'MULTIMSG'
      extnumber = 'MULTI_LOG_001'
    ).

    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( is_log_header = ls_log_header ).

    LOOP AT it_messages INTO DATA(ls_msg_data).
      DATA(ls_message) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
        msgty = ls_msg_data-type
        msgid = 'SY'
        msgno = '000'
        msgv1 = ls_msg_data-text
      ).
      lo_log->add_message( is_message = ls_message ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                             msgno = ls_bal_msg-msgno

                             msgv2 = ls_bal_msg-msgv2
                             msgv3 = ls_bal_msg-msgv3

Instructions: Integrieren Sie die Anwendungsprotokollierung in eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null abfängt und einen Fehler im Log protokolliert. Die Methode soll das Ergebnis der Division zurückgeben oder 0, wenn ein Fehler auftritt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung und `ADD_MESSAGE` für die Protokollierung des Fehlers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log TYPE REF TO cl_bal_logobj.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object    = 'SZAL'
      subobject = 'ERROR'
      extnumber = 'ERROR_LOG_001'
    ).
    mo_log = NEW cl_bal_logobj( is_log_header = ls_log_header ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide_and_log.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        DATA(ls_message) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
          msgty = 'E'
          msgid = 'SY'
          msgno = '000'
          msgv1 = |Division durch Null versucht: { iv_numerator } / { iv_denominator }|
        ).
        mo_log->add_message( is_message = ls_message ).
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_log_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_and_log( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_log_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_and_log( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).

    " Überprüfen, ob eine Fehlermeldung im Log ist
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->mo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = cl_bal_db_load=>get_messages( lv_log_handle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Division durch Null' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration der Anwendungsprotokollierung in die Fehlerbehandlung. Mit `TRY...CATCH` wird die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` abgefangen, die bei einer Division durch Null auftritt. Im `CATCH`-Block wird dann eine Fehlermeldung mit `ADD_MESSAGE` in das Anwendungsprotokoll geschrieben. Dies ist eine Best Practice für robuste Anwendungen, um Fehler zu protokollieren, ohne den Programmablauf abrupt zu beenden.
keywords: Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, Application Log, Error Logging, CL_BAL_LOGOBJ

    ).

  METHOD filter_allowed_files.
    rt_filtered_filenames = FILTER #( it_filenames WHERE is_mime_type_allowed( table_line ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_mime_type_allowed.
    DATA(lv_extension) = cl_abap_file_utilities=>get_extension( iv_filename ).
    DATA(lv_mime_type) = get_mime_type_from_extension( lv_extension ).
    rv_is_allowed = xsdbool( line_exists( mt_allowed_mimes[ mime_type = lv_mime_type ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_type_from_extension.
    rv_mime_type = COND string(
      WHEN iv_extension = 'txt' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_text_plain
      WHEN iv_extension = 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_pdf
      WHEN iv_extension = 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_image_jpeg
      WHEN iv_extension = 'png' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_image_png
      ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_octet_stream
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Nachrichten sammelt und diese bei Bedarf in einem Anwendungsprotokoll speichert. Die Klasse soll eine Methode zum Hinzufügen von Nachrichten und eine zum Speichern des Logs bereitstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie ein privates Attribut vom Typ `CL_BAL_LOGOBJ` und Methoden zum Hinzufügen und Speichern.

CLASS zcl_app_log_collector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE bal_msgty
        iv_text TYPE string.

    METHODS save_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_loghndl.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log TYPE REF TO cl_bal_logobj.

    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_collector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object    = 'SZAL'
      subobject = 'COLLECT'
      extnumber = 'COLLECT_LOG_001'
    ).
    mo_log = NEW cl_bal_logobj( is_log_header = ls_log_header ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_message.
    DATA(ls_message) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = iv_type
      msgid = 'SY'
      msgno = '000'
      msgv1 = iv_text
    ).
    mo_log->add_message( is_message = ls_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD save_log.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    cl_bal_db_save=>save_log( rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Nachrichten aus einem Anwendungsprotokoll nach ihrem Nachrichtentyp (z.B. 'I', 'W', 'E') und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Nachrichten pro Typ. Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Operator.
hint: Lesen Sie die Nachrichten mit `CL_BAL_DB_LOAD` und verwenden Sie dann `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_count,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_message_count,
           tt_message_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_messages_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE bal_loghndl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_message_counts) TYPE tt_message_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_messages_by_type.
    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = cl_bal_db_load=>get_messages( iv_log_handle ).

    LOOP AT lt_bal_messages INTO DATA(ls_message) GROUP BY ls_message-msgty.
      APPEND VALUE ty_message_count(
        msgty = ls_message-msgty
        count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_message_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Dateierweiterungen in eine kommaseparierte Zeichenkette von MIME-Typen umwandelt. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Liste der Erweiterungen zu iterieren und die MIME-Typen zu einer Zeichenkette zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_reduce_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_extensions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mime_types_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_extensions TYPE tt_extensions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type_from_extension
      IMPORTING
        iv_extension TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_reduce_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_types_as_string.
    rv_mime_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR extension IN it_extensions
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN get_mime_type_from_extension( extension )
        ELSE s && `, ` && get_mime_type_from_extension( extension )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_mime_type_from_extension.
    rv_mime_type = COND string(
      WHEN iv_extension = 'txt' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_text_plain
      WHEN iv_extension = 'pdf' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_pdf
      WHEN iv_extension = 'jpg' THEN cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_image_jpeg
      ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>gc_mime_application_octet_stream
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um einen zufälligen Index zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR sflight IN sflights ( CORRESPONDING #( sflight ) ) ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_flight.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 0
      high = lv_max_index
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights INDEX ( lv_random_index + 1 ) INTO rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_gen,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_gen.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_gen TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_gen WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count        TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_gen.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 999 ).
    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( low = 1.0 high = 1000.0 ).
    DATA(lo_random_date) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = 365 ). " Days offset

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 TO iv_count ( 
      carrid    = |LH{ lo_random_int->get_next( ) ALPHA = IN }| " Example carrier ID
      connid    = lo_random_int->get_next( )
      fldate    = lv_current_date + lo_random_date->get_next( )
      planetype = |A3{ lo_random_int->get_next( ) MOD 100 }| " Example plane type
      seatsmax  = 200
      seatsocc  = lo_random_int->get_next( ) MOD 200
      price     = lo_random_float->get_next( )
      currency  = 'EUR'
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes aus jeder Zeile einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHTS) dynamisch aus und geben Sie ihn zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).`
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_field_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_field_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
      ELSE.
        " Handle case where field is not found for a specific row (e.g., append empty string or error)
        APPEND 'Field not found in row' TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus SFLIGHTS. Wählen Sie dann zufällig ein numerisches Feld (z.B. SEATSMAX, SEATSOCC) dieses Fluges aus und ändern Sie dessen Wert zufällig innerhalb eines Bereichs.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Auswahl des Fluges und des Feldes mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur dynamischen Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_dynamic_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mod,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_mod.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_mod TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mod WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_random_flight_field
      IMPORTING
        io_flights_ref  TYPE REF TO tt_sflight_mod " Pass by reference to modify
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_modified_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_mod
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_dynamic_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_random_flight_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flights> TYPE tt_sflight_mod.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight>  TYPE ty_sflight_mod.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>   TYPE any.

    ASSIGN io_flights_ref->* TO <fs_flights>.
    IF <fs_flights> IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_modified_flight.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 1. Select a random flight
    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( <fs_flights> ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random_flight_idx) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_flight_idx) = lo_random_flight_idx->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE <fs_flights> INDEX ( lv_random_flight_idx + 1 ) ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_modified_flight.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Select a random numeric field to modify
    DATA(lt_numeric_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'SEATSOCC' ) ( 'SEATSMAX' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_field_idx) = lines( lt_numeric_fields ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random_field_idx) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_max_field_idx ).
    DATA(lv_random_field_idx) = lo_random_field_idx->get_next( ).
    DATA(lv_field_name) = lt_numeric_fields[ ( lv_random_field_idx + 1 ) ].

    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " 3. Modify the field with a random value
      DATA(lo_random_value) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 250 ). " Example range
      <fs_field> = lo_random_value->get_next( ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_modified_flight = <fs_flight>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Übergabe der internen Tabelle als Referenz (`TYPE REF TO`) ermöglicht die direkte Änderung der Originaldaten. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für dynamische Datenmanipulation.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und tauschen Sie Elemente basierend auf zufälligen Indizes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffle,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffle.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_shuffle TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffle WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE tt_sflight_shuffle
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_sflight_shuffle
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_original_table.

    IF rt_shuffled_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_table_size - 1 ).

    LOOP AT rt_shuffled_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_current_row>).
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-tabix - 1.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap current row with a randomly selected row
      DATA(ls_temp_row) = rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index + 1 ].
      rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index + 1 ] = <fs_current_row>.
      <fs_current_row> = ls_temp_row.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_shuffle_single_entry_table FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_itab_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_itab_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffle(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250104' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    " Assert that content is the same, but order is likely different
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY carrid connid.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY carrid connid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted ).

    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be in the exact same order as original (unless size is 0 or 1)
    IF lines( lt_original ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original msg = 'Table should be shuffled' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_itab_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_itab_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_shuffled ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_single_entry_table.
    DATA(lo_shuffler) = NEW zcl_itab_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_single) = VALUE zcl_itab_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffle(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_shuffler->shuffle_table( lt_single ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_single ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode implementiert das Mischen einer internen Tabelle mithilfe des Fisher-Yates-Algorithmus. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` liefert die notwendigen Zufallsindizes. Die Verwendung von Field-Symbols (`<fs_current_row>`) innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht eine effiziente In-Place-Modifikation der Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Table, Shuffle, Field-Symbol

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Strukturtyp (z.B. SFLIGHT) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dyn,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_dyn.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_itab_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Populate with some example data (assuming iv_type_name is SFLIGHT or similar)
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>) CASTING TYPE ty_sflight_dyn.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_sflight_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
        <fs_sflight_line>-connid = '0400'.
        <fs_sflight_line>-fldate = '20250101'.
        INSERT <fs_sflight_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

        <fs_sflight_line>-carrid = 'UA'.
        <fs_sflight_line>-connid = '0010'.
        <fs_sflight_line>-fldate = '20250102'.
        INSERT <fs_sflight_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_sflight.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE zcl_dynamic_itab_creator=>ty_sflight_dyn.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line> CASTING TYPE zcl_dynamic_itab_creator=>ty_sflight_dyn.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dynamic_itab_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( 'INVALID_TYPE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über alle Komponenten einer SFLIGHT-Struktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie deren Namen und Werte aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_iterator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_iter,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_iter.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_fields
      IMPORTING
        is_structure    TYPE ty_sflight_iter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fields) TYPE tt_field_info.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_iterator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_fields.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure )
    ).

    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_field_info(
          name  = ls_component-name
          value = |{ <fs_field> }|
        ) TO rt_fields.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Für jeden Flug in einer internen SFLIGHT-Tabelle: Entscheiden Sie zufällig, ob das Feld 'PLANETYPE' auf einen neuen, zufälligen Wert aus einer vordefinierten Liste geändert werden soll. Modifizieren Sie das Feld dynamisch.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Zufallsentscheidung und die Auswahl des neuen Wertes mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur dynamischen Feldmodifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_random_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_cond,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_cond.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_cond TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_cond WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        io_flights_ref  TYPE REF TO tt_sflight_cond " Pass by reference to modify
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_random_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_conditionally.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flights> TYPE tt_sflight_cond.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight>  TYPE ty_sflight_cond.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_planetype> TYPE sflight-planetype.

    ASSIGN io_flights_ref->* TO <fs_flights>.
    IF <fs_flights> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_new_planetypes) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A380' ) ( 'B787' ) ( 'CRJ9' ) ( 'E190' ) ).
    DATA(lv_max_planetype_idx) = lines( lt_new_planetypes ) - 1.

    DATA(lo_random_decision) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = 1 ). " 0 or 1
    DATA(lo_random_planetype_idx) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_max_planetype_idx ).

    LOOP AT <fs_flights> ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      IF lo_random_decision->get_next( ) = 1. " 50% chance to modify
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PLANETYPE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_planetype>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          DATA(lv_new_planetype) = lt_new_planetypes[ lo_random_planetype_idx->get_next( ) + 1 ].
          <fs_planetype> = lv_new_planetype.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_process_empty_flights FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_conditionally.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conditional_random_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_conditional_random_assign=>tt_sflight_cond(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' planetype = 'A330' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0030' fldate = '20250104' planetype = 'B737' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_flights) = REF TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_original_planetypes) = VALUE string_table( FOR flight IN lt_flights ( flight-planetype ) ).

    lo_processor->process_flights_conditionally( io_flights_ref = lr_flights ).

    DATA(lv_changes_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_original_planetype) = lt_original_planetypes[ sy-tabix ].
      IF ls_flight-planetype <> lv_original_planetype.
        lv_changes_count = lv_changes_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Due to randomness, we can't assert an exact number of changes, but we can assert that some changes are possible.
    " For a robust test, one might run this multiple times or mock the random generator.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_changes_count >= 0 AND lv_changes_count <= lines( lt_flights ) )
      msg = 'Number of changes should be between 0 and total flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_empty_flights.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_conditional_random_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_conditional_random_assign=>tt_sflight_cond( ).
    DATA(lr_empty_flights) = REF TO lt_empty_flights.

    lo_processor->process_flights_conditionally( io_flights_ref = lr_empty_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_empty_flights
      msg = 'Empty table should remain empty'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie dynamisch eine neue Spalte zu einer internen Tabelle hinzu und füllen Sie diese mit einem Standardwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_base,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_base.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_base TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_base WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref    TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
        iv_column_type  TYPE string " e.g., 'STRING', 'I', 'D'
        iv_default_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_new_table_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_column_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_old_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_old_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_column> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_old_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <fs_old_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_old_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr(
      cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_old_table> )
    ).
    DATA(lo_old_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_old_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_old_line_descr->get_components( ).

    " Add new component
    DATA(ls_new_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr(
      name = iv_column_name
      type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_column_type )
    ).
    APPEND ls_new_component TO lt_components.

    " Create new structure type
    DATA(lo_new_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Create new table type based on new structure
    DATA(lo_new_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_new_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = lo_old_table_descr->table_kind
      p_unique = lo_old_table_descr->is_unique
      p_key = lo_old_table_descr->get_keys( )
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_new_table_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_new_table_ref->* TO <fs_new_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_old_table> ASSIGNING <fs_old_line>.
        CREATE DATA <fs_new_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_new_table>.
        " Move data from old line to new line
        <fs_new_line> = CORRESPONDING #( <fs_old_line> ).

        " Assign and fill new column
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO <fs_new_column>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_new_column> = iv_default_value.
        ENDIF.
        INSERT <fs_new_line> INTO TABLE <fs_new_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
