Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Münzwurf (Kopf oder Zahl) mit einer 50/50-Chance.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit einem Bereich von 0 bis 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_coin_flipper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_coin_side TYPE c LENGTH 4.
    CONSTANTS: gc_head TYPE ty_coin_side VALUE 'Kopf'.
    CONSTANTS: gc_tail TYPE ty_coin_side VALUE 'Zahl'.

    METHODS flip_coin
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE ty_coin_side
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_coin_flipper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_num = 0.
      rv_result = gc_head.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = gc_tail.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flip_coin FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flip_coin.
    DATA(lo_flipper) = NEW zcl_coin_flipper( ).
    DATA(lv_head_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_tail_count) = 0.

    " Perform many flips to statistically verify 50/50 chance
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_flipper->flip_coin( ).
      IF lv_result = zcl_coin_flipper=>gc_head.
        lv_head_count = lv_head_count + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = zcl_coin_flipper=>gc_tail.
        lv_tail_count = lv_tail_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_head_count + lv_tail_count exp = 1000 ).
    " Assert that counts are roughly equal (within a reasonable margin)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_head_count > 400 AND lv_head_count < 600 )
      msg = 'Head count should be around 500'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = ( lv_tail_count > 400 AND lv_tail_count < 600 )
      msg = 'Tail count should be around 500'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein Münzwurf wird durch die Generierung einer Zufallszahl (0 oder 1) mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` simuliert. Dies ist eine einfache Anwendung von Zufallszahlen zur Modellierung binärer Ereignisse. Die Verwendung von Konstanten für 'Kopf' und 'Zahl' verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Math, Simulation, Constants

Instructions: Setzen Sie den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch auf einen neuen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` und weisen Sie den neuen Wert zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_structure_ref TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any structure
        iv_field_name    TYPE string
        iv_new_value     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_structure> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_structure_ref->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Attempt to assign the new value. Type conversion might be implicit or require explicit handling.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          " Handle conversion error if new_value cannot be assigned to field type
          " For simplicity, we ignore it here, but in real code, log or raise exception.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_setter->set_field_value_dynamic(
      ir_structure_ref = lr_data
      iv_field_name    = 'FIELD2'

    ).

  METHOD test_set_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_setter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_setter( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE ty_test_struct( field1 = 'Initial' field2 = 10 ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO ls_data.

    lo_setter->set_field_value_dynamic(
      ir_structure_ref = lr_data

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'Initial' ).

    ).

explanation: Diese Methode ermöglicht das dynamische Setzen von Feldwerten in einer beliebigen Struktur. Durch die Übergabe einer Referenz auf die Struktur (`TYPE REF TO data`) und die Verwendung von `ASSIGN COMPONENT` kann zur Laufzeit auf das gewünschte Feld zugegriffen und dessen Wert geändert werden. Die `TRY-CATCH` Block ist wichtig, um mögliche Konvertierungsfehler abzufangen, wenn der neue Wert nicht zum Feldtyp passt.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort bestehend aus 8 Großbuchstaben und Ziffern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates, um Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Satz auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_password_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 8
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_password_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_chars_length) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_chars_length - 1 ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_password = rv_password && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_password_chars_valid.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_random_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_generator->generate_password( iv_length = 20 ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_valid_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_password ) TIMES.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Vergleichswert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE (field_name) = value` mit Field-Symbols oder `FILTER` mit dynamischem Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_filter.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight_filter
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_compare_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE tt_sflight_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_sflight_filter.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Perform comparison dynamically
        IF <fs_field> = iv_compare_value.
          APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered_table.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie 3 zufällige, eindeutige Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und stellen Sie sicher, dass die ausgewählten Indizes eindeutig sind.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_unique,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_unique.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_unique TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_unique WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count        TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_unique
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_unique_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_unique( FOR sflight IN sflights ( CORRESPONDING #( sflight ) ) ).

    IF lines( lt_all_sflights ) < iv_count.
      " Not enough flights to pick unique ones
      rt_flights = lt_all_sflights.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_all_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Ensure uniqueness of indices
      WHILE line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_random_index ] ).
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ).
      ENDWHILE.
      INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.

      READ TABLE lt_all_sflights INDEX ( lv_random_index + 1 ) INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_unique_flights FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

  METHOD test_get_random_unique_flights.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_random_unique_flights( iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check for uniqueness of selected flights (e.g., by primary key)
    DATA(lt_unique_flights) = lt_flights.
    SORT lt_unique_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_unique_flights )
      exp = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'All selected flights should be unique'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_more_than_available.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_unique_flights( ).
    " Simulate a small SFLIGHTS table
    DATA(lv_original_sflights_count) = lines( sflights ).
    DELETE FROM sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' ) 
    ) ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_random_unique_flights( iv_count = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).

    " Restore SFLIGHTS data if it was not empty initially
    IF lv_original_sflights_count > 0.
      DELETE FROM sflights.
      INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_unique_flights_from_small_set.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_unique_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_original_sflights_count) = lines( sflights ).
    DELETE FROM sflights.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) 
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250103' ) 
    ) ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_random_unique_flights( iv_count = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).

    IF lv_original_sflights_count > 0.
      DELETE FROM sflights.
      INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, wobei die Spaltennamen und -typen zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>CREATE` für die Strukturdefinition und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` für die Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'STRING', 'I', 'D'
           END OF ty_column_def.
    TYPES: tt_column_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_column_definitions TYPE tt_column_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_components) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table(
      FOR ls_col_def IN it_column_definitions (
        name = ls_col_def-name
        type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_col_def-type )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Add some example data dynamically
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.

      " Row 1
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_a>) TYPE string.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field_a> = 'Value A1'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_b>) TYPE i.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field_b> = 100. ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

      " Row 2
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field_a>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field_a> = 'Value A2'. ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field_b>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field_b> = 200. ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_build_and_fill_table.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_column_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_builder=>tt_column_defs(
      ( name = 'FIELD_A' type = 'STRING' )
      ( name = 'FIELD_B' type = 'I' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_builder->build_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_column_defs ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_a> TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field_b> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_A' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field_a>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD_B' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field_b>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_a> exp = 'Value A1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field_b> exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_build_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_column_defs) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_builder=>tt_column_defs(
      ( name = 'FIELD_C' type = 'STRING' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_dynamic_table ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ). " Still adds example data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung einer internen Tabelle, deren Struktur (Spaltennamen und -typen) vollständig zur Laufzeit definiert wird. Es verwendet RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`) und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE`, um die dynamische Tabelle zu instanziieren. Das Füllen der Tabelle erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für jede Spalte.

      IMPORTING
        iv_string TYPE string

Instructions: Angenommen, Sie erhalten eine Liste von Mitarbeiterdaten (Name, Gehalt, Abteilung) von einem OData-Service. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Namen und Gehälter der Mitarbeiter enthält, deren Gehalt über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und erhöhen Sie deren Gehalt um einen Bonus.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit dem VALUE-Operator und einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id        TYPE string,
             name      TYPE string,
             salary    TYPE decfloat16,
             department TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_employee,
             name      TYPE string,
             bonus_salary TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_processed_employee.
    TYPES: tt_processed_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_emp_process_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS process_employee_data
          IMPORTING
            it_employees TYPE tt_employees
            iv_salary_threshold TYPE decfloat16
            iv_bonus_percentage TYPE decfloat16
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_processed_employees) TYPE tt_processed_employees.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_emp_process_data IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD process_employee_data.
        rt_processed_employees = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_employee IN it_employees WHERE ( salary > iv_salary_threshold )
          ( name = ls_employee-name
            bonus_salary = ls_employee-salary * ( 1 + iv_bonus_percentage / 100 ) )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_emp_process_data( ).
    DATA lt_employees TYPE tt_employees.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_employees ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_emp>).
    <fs_emp>-id = '001'. <fs_emp>-name = 'Alice'. <fs_emp>-salary = '50000'. <fs_emp>-department = 'IT'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_employees ASSIGNING <fs_emp>.
    <fs_emp>-id = '002'. <fs_emp>-name = 'Bob'. <fs_emp>-salary = '75000'. <fs_emp>-department = 'HR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_employees ASSIGNING <fs_emp>.
    <fs_emp>-id = '003'. <fs_emp>-name = 'Charlie'. <fs_emp>-salary = '40000'. <fs_emp>-department = 'Sales'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_employee_data(
                            it_employees        = lt_employees
                            iv_salary_threshold = '45000'
                            iv_bonus_percentage = '10'
                          ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of processed employees'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-name
      exp = 'Alice'
      msg = 'First employee name incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 1 ]-bonus_salary
      exp = '55000.00'
      msg = 'First employee bonus salary incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-name
      exp = 'Bob'
      msg = 'Second employee name incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[ 2 ]-bonus_salary
      exp = '82500.00'
      msg = 'Second employee bonus salary incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter aller Mitarbeiter in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id        TYPE string,
             name      TYPE string,
             salary    TYPE decfloat16,
             department TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee.
    TYPES: tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_emp_reduce_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS calculate_total_salary
          IMPORTING
            it_employees TYPE tt_employees
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_total_salary) TYPE decfloat16.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_emp_reduce_data IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD calculate_total_salary.
        rv_total_salary = REDUCE #( 
          INIT sum_salary = CONV decfloat16( '0' )
          FOR ls_employee IN it_employees
          NEXT sum_salary = sum_salary + ls_employee-salary
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch aus, basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Methodennamen. Simulieren Sie dies für eine 'Employee Service'-Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Syntax `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zif_employee_service DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_employee_data.
    METHODS update_employee_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zif_employee_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zif_employee_service( ).
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.

    lv_method_name = 'GET_EMPLOYEE_DATA'.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_service.
        out->write( |Methode '{ lv_method_name }' erfolgreich aufgerufen.| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        out->write( |Fehler beim Aufruf von Methode '{ lv_method_name }'.| ).
    ENDTRY.

    lv_method_name = 'UPDATE_EMPLOYEE_DATA'.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_service.
        out->write( |Methode '{ lv_method_name }' erfolgreich aufgerufen.| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        out->write( |Fehler beim Aufruf von Methode '{ lv_method_name }'.| ).
    ENDTRY.

    lv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_service.
        out->write( |Methode '{ lv_method_name }' erfolgreich aufgerufen.| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        out->write( |Fehler beim Aufruf von Methode '{ lv_method_name }'.| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_employee_data.
    " Simulierte Logik zum Abrufen von Mitarbeiterdaten
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_employee_data.
    " Simulierte Logik zum Aktualisieren von Mitarbeiterdaten
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zif_employee_service( ).
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.

    lv_method_name = 'GET_EMPLOYEE_DATA'.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_service.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic call to existing method should not raise error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dynamic call to existing method raised an unexpected error' ).
    ENDTRY.

    lv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_service.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dynamic call to non-existent method did not raise expected error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic call to non-existent method raised expected error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT) und verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um Daten von einer Struktur in eine andere zu übertragen, wobei nur übereinstimmende Felder kopiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder den moderneren `CORRESPONDING` Operator für die Zuweisung von Strukturen oder Tabellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_reduced_sflight_data
          IMPORTING
            iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_reduced_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_reduced_sflight_data.
        DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

        SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
          FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

        rt_reduced_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid fldate = fldate price = price ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_corresponding( ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ist die moderne und typsichere Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Er ermöglicht das einfache Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit (teilweise) identischen Feldnamen. Mit der `MAPPING`-Klausel können explizite Feldzuordnungen vorgenommen werden, was die Flexibilität erhöht und den Code klarer macht.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR GROUPS` Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE` und Aggregatfunktionen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_grouped_flight_stats
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_grouped_stats) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_grouped_flight_stats.
        DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight_data.

        SELECT carrid, connid, price
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

        rt_grouped_stats = VALUE #( 
          FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
          ( carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
            flight_count = GROUP SIZE
            avg_price   = AVG( ls_flight-price ) )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouping( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_stats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
    ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_group) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_first_group-carrid
        msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_first_group-flight_count > 0 )
        msg = 'Flight count should be greater than 0'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_first_group-avg_price > 0 )
        msg = 'Average price should be greater than 0'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR GROUPS` Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator und Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` und `AVG` können komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogiken kompakt und lesbar implementiert werden, ohne explizite Schleifen und manuelle Akkumulation.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) in einer Klasse, um mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt sequenziell und flüssig auszuführen.
hint: Jede Methode in der Kette muss eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME->`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_employee DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: name TYPE string READ-ONLY,
          salary TYPE decfloat16 READ-ONLY,
          department TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_salary TYPE decfloat16
        iv_department TYPE string.

    METHODS set_salary
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_salary TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_employee.

    METHODS set_department
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_department TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_employee.

    METHODS get_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_employee IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->name = iv_name.
    me->salary = iv_salary.
    me->department = iv_department.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_salary.
    me->salary = iv_new_salary.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_department.
    me->department = iv_new_department.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_info.
    rv_info = |Name: { me->name }, Salary: { me->salary }, Department: { me->department }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_employee) = NEW zcl_chainable_employee(
      iv_name = 'Anna'
      iv_salary = '50000'
      iv_department = 'Sales'
    ).

    DATA(lv_info) = lo_employee->set_salary( '55000' )->set_department( 'Marketing' )->get_info( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_info) = 'Name: Anna, Salary: 55000.00, Department: Marketing'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_info
      exp = lv_expected_info
      msg = 'Method chaining result incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ist ein Entwurfsmuster, das die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes verbessert, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME->`) zurückgibt. Dies ist ein Merkmal moderner, objektorientierter Programmierung und fördert einen flüssigeren, deklarativeren Stil.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Functional Programming, Employee

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahmebehandlung für eine Methode, die einen Fehler bei der Verarbeitung von Mitarbeiterdaten simulieren kann.

CLASS zcl_employee_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_employee_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_employee.
    IF iv_employee_id IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_employee_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_employee_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulierte Verarbeitung
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_handling.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_employee_processor( ).

    " Testfall: Gültige ID (keine Ausnahme erwartet)
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_employee( 'EMP001' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected for valid ID' ).
      CATCH zcx_employee_error.

    TRY.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for empty ID was not raised' ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Expected exception for empty ID was raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme-Klassen, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` oder `CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK` erben, ist der Standardweg für die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht eine klare Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung, verbessert die Robustheit des Codes und bietet detaillierte Informationen über aufgetretene Probleme. Die Integration mit `IF_T100_MESSAGE` erlaubt die Verwendung von Nachrichtenklassen für mehrsprachige Fehlermeldungen.
keywords: Exception Handling, Custom Exception, CX_STATIC_CHECK, RAISE EXCEPTION, Employee

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator, um eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (aus SFLIGHT) bedingt zu füllen, basierend auf einer externen Bedingung. Wenn die Bedingung wahr ist, füllen Sie die Tabelle mit allen Flügen, andernfalls mit einer leeren Tabelle.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ist ideal für bedingte Zuweisungen, auch für interne Tabellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flights_conditionally
          IMPORTING
            ib_fill_table TYPE abap_bool
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_sflight_cond_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flights_conditionally.
        rt_flights = COND #( 
          WHEN ib_fill_table = abap_true
          THEN VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN sflight ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid connid = ls_sflight-connid ) )
          ELSE VALUE #( ) 
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cond_true FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cond_false FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cond_true.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_cond_fill( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_conditionally( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Table should be filled when condition is true'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Table should contain entries'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cond_false.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_cond_fill( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_conditionally( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Table should contain no entries'
    ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht bedingte Zuweisungen in einer kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Syntax, ähnlich einem ternären Operator. Er kann nicht nur für skalare Werte, sondern auch für die bedingte Initialisierung oder Füllung von internen Tabellen verwendet werden, was den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, VALUE

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REPLACE` Operator, um alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen String zu ersetzen.
hint: Der `REPLACE` Operator ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, String-Ersetzungen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_substring
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_substring.
    rv_result_string = REPLACE( val = iv_original_string sub = iv_old_substring with = iv_new_substring occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_old) = 'Hello'.
    DATA(lv_new) = 'Hi'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_substring(
                         iv_original_string = lv_original
                         iv_old_substring   = lv_old
                         iv_new_substring   = lv_new
                       ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP'
      msg = 'String replacement failed'
    ).

    DATA(lv_original2) = 'NoMatch'.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->replace_substring(
                          iv_original_string = lv_original2
                          iv_old_substring   = 'xyz'
                          iv_new_substring   = 'abc'
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'NoMatch'
      msg = 'String replacement with no match failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REPLACE` Operator ist eine funktionale Methode zur String-Manipulation, die ab ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist. Er bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Syntax für das Ersetzen von Teilstrings. Die Option `occ = 0` ist besonders nützlich, um alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings zu ersetzen, ohne explizite Schleifen oder ältere `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` Anweisungen verwenden zu müssen.
keywords: REPLACE, String Processing, String Operator

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info
      RAISING
        cx_gos_error.

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_attachments.
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS1001'. " Example: Flight object type
    DATA(lv_object_key) = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
      ip_objtype = lv_object_type
      ip_objkey  = lv_object_key
    ).

CLASS zcl_gos_start_workflow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_start_workflow IMPLEMENTATION.

      ip_objtype = lv_object_type

solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_service_history DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_service_entry,
             service_type TYPE gos_service_type,
             service_name TYPE gos_service_name,
             creation_date TYPE sy-datum,
             creation_time TYPE sy-uzeit,
             created_by   TYPE sy-uname,
           END OF ty_service_entry.
    TYPES tt_service_history TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_service_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_service_history
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_history) TYPE tt_service_history
      RAISING
        cx_gos_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_service_history IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_service_history.
    DATA(lv_object_type) = 'BUS1001'. " Example: Flight object type
    DATA(lv_object_key) = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid ALPHA = IN }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

    DATA(lo_gos_manager) = NEW cl_gos_manager(
      ip_objtype = lv_object_type
      ip_objkey  = lv_object_key
    ).

    DATA: lt_service_history TYPE gos_service_history_t.
    lo_gos_manager->get_service_history(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE borident( objtype = lv_object_type objkey = lv_object_key )
      IMPORTING
        et_service_history = lt_service_history
    ).

    rt_history = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_service_history (
      service_type = ls_entry-service_type
      service_name = ls_entry-service_name
      creation_date = ls_entry-creation_date
      creation_time = ls_entry-creation_time
      created_by   = ls_entry-created_by
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` Ausdruck, um die Tabelle zu filtern und zu mappen.

CLASS zcl_it_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_future_flights

CLASS zcl_it_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > lv_current_date )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_future_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_future_flights ). " Sollte leer sein, da SFLIGHTS keine zukünftigen Daten hat
  ENDMETHOD.

keywords: FOR IN WHERE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Filtering, Mapping

CLASS zcl_it_sum_by_planetype DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, aber mit einem zusätzlichen Feld für den Status ('Active' oder 'Cancelled'), basierend auf dem Flugdatum (Flüge vor heute sind 'Cancelled', andere 'Active').
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einem `COND` Ausdruck für das neue Feld.

CLASS zcl_it_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.

CLASS zcl_it_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN sflights
                            ( flight-carrid,
                              flight-connid,
                              flight-fldate,
                              flight-price,
                              flight-currency,
                              flight-planetype,
                              status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate < lv_current_date THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE 'Active' ) ) ).

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Preis zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_max_price_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_max_price_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_max_price_flight.
    TYPES tt_max_price_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_max_price_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_flight_per_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_max_flights) TYPE tt_max_price_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_max_price_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_flight_per_carrier.
    rt_max_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights
                                 GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                 ( REDUCE ty_max_price_flight(
                                     INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_max_price_flight( carrid = flight-carrid price = 0 )
                                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                     NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN member-price > max_flight-price
                                                               THEN VALUE ty_max_price_flight( carrid = member-carrid
                                                                                                connid = member-connid
                                                                                                price  = member-price )
                                                               ELSE max_flight ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_max_price_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_price_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_max_price_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_max_flights) = lo_cut->get_max_price_flight_per_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_max_flights ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen des höchsten Preises für eine Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH')
    DATA(ls_max_lh) = lt_max_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT `carrid = 'LH'` ].
    IF ls_max_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_max_lh-price exp = 1000 ). " Beispielwert, anpassen falls SFLIGHTS anders ist
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. `REDUCE` iteriert über die Mitglieder jeder Gruppe und findet den Eintrag mit dem höchsten Preis, was eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Lösung darstellt.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Aggregation, MAX

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, aber nur die ersten 5 Flüge jeder Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `FOR ... IN GROUP` mit `UP TO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_top_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_entry,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_entry.
    TYPES tt_flight_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_flights_per_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_top_n TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_flight_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_top_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    rt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights
                                 GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                 ( FOR member IN GROUP flight UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                                     ( carrid = member-carrid,
                                       connid = member-connid,
                                       fldate = member-fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights_per_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_top_n_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_top_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_flights_per_carrier( iv_top_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_top_flights ).

    " Überprüfen, ob für jede Fluggesellschaft maximal 2 Flüge vorhanden sind
    DATA(lt_grouped_by_carrier) = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_top_flights
                                            GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                            ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                              count = COUNT( flight-carrid ) ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_by_carrier INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_group-count <= 2 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit einem weiteren `FOR ... IN GROUP` Ausdruck, um eine Untermenge von Elementen pro Gruppe zu extrahieren. `UP TO iv_top_n ROWS` begrenzt die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe, was eine effiziente Möglichkeit ist, Top-N-Listen zu erstellen.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, FOR IN GROUP, UP TO, Internal Tables, Grouping, Subsetting

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` in einem ALV mit IDA an und fügen Sie eine Aggregation für den Gesamtpreis pro Fluggesellschaft hinzu.

CLASS zcl_alv_ida_custom_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` mit `WHERE` und `AVG`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_agg_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_agg_result.
    TYPES tt_agg_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_aggregations
      IMPORTING iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_aggregations) TYPE tt_agg_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_agg_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_aggregations.
    rt_aggregations = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights
                                 WHERE ( fldate >= iv_min_fldate )
                                 GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid       = flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = COUNT( * ),
                                   avg_price    = AVG( flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_aggregations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_agg_filtered( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365. " Flüge des letzten Jahres
    DATA(lt_aggregations) = lo_cut->get_filtered_aggregations( iv_min_fldate = lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_aggregations ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob die Anzahl der Flüge für 'LH' größer als 0 ist
    DATA(ls_agg_lh) = lt_aggregations[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT `carrid = 'LH'` ].
    IF ls_agg_lh IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_agg_lh-flight_count > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von Filterung (`WHERE`) und Gruppierung (`FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`) innerhalb eines einzigen `VALUE #(...)` Ausdrucks. Die Aggregationsfunktionen `COUNT(*)` und `AVG()` werden verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Gruppe zu berechnen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft und jedes Flugdatum die Flugnummern als kommaseparierten String enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` mit `STRING_CONCAT_LINES` oder String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_concat_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connids,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connids TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_connids.
    TYPES tt_grouped_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_concatenated_connids
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_connids) TYPE tt_grouped_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_concat_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_concatenated_connids.
    rt_grouped_connids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN sflights
                                   GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid, fldate = flight-fldate
                                   ( carrid  = flight-carrid,
                                     fldate  = flight-fldate,
                                     connids = REDUCE string(
                                                 INIT s = ''
                                                 FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                 NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN member-connid ELSE s && ',' && member-connid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_concatenated_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_concat_connid( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped_connids) = lo_cut->get_concatenated_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_grouped_connids ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob für einen Eintrag die Connids korrekt verkettet sind
    DATA(ls_entry) = lt_grouped_connids[ 1 ].
    IF ls_entry IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-connids ).
      " Weitere spezifische Überprüfung, z.B. ob Kommas enthalten sind, wenn mehrere Flüge existieren

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( count( val = ls_entry-connids sep = ',' ) > 0 ) ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` für eine mehrstufige Gruppierung und `REDUCE` zum Verketten von Strings. Der `REDUCE` Operator ist hier ideal, um iterativ die Flugnummern einer Gruppe zu einem kommaseparierten String zusammenzufügen, was eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke String-Manipulation ermöglicht.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` in einem ALV mit IDA an, wobei die Spalte 'PRICE' als Währung formatiert und die Spalte 'FLDATE' als Datum im Format 'DD.MM.YYYY' angezeigt wird.

  METHOD display_sflights_formatted.

        DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create( r_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_ida->get_columns( ).

        " Preis als Währung formatieren

        lo_column_price->set_output_length( 15 ). " Beispiel: Ausgabelänge anpassen

        " Explizite Formatierung ist oft nicht nötig, da ALV IDA Benutzer-Settings berücksichtigt.
        " Für spezifische Edit-Masken müsste man ggf. auf CL_SALV_TABLE zurückgreifen oder
        " eine View mit CAST/CONVERT verwenden.
        " Hier nur ein Beispiel für die Beeinflussung der Spalte.
        DATA(lo_column_fldate) = lo_columns->get_column( 'FLDATE' ).
        lo_column_fldate->set_output_length( 10 ). " DD.MM.YYYY hat 10 Zeichen

        lo_alv_ida->display( ).

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadrate einer Liste von Zahlen. Wenn die Liste leer ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Berechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und prüfen Sie die Tabellengröße vor der Operation, um eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_list DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_list IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_list_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_list
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_empty_list=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + ( n * n ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares_empty FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_empty_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares_success.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_list_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_processor->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 14 ). " 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_of_squares_empty.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_list_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->calculate_sum_of_squares( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_empty_list was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_empty_list.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_empty_list caught successfully.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die moderne `REDUCE`-Anweisung für kompakte Aggregationen mit einer robusten Fehlerbehandlung mittels `RAISE EXCEPTION` bei leeren Eingabedaten.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, RAISE EXCEPTION, Internal Tables

CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        zcx_no_flights_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_all.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_all USING KEY primary_key

      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_no_flights_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_no_flights_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse aufruft. Wenn die aufgerufene Methode eine Ausnahme auslöst, fangen Sie diese ab und geben Sie eine generische Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Namen. Fangen Sie `cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error` oder die spezifische Ausnahme ab.

CLASS zcx_dynamic_call_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_class_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid         LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL

        iv_class_name  TYPE string OPTIONAL

  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_class_name = iv_class_name.
    mv_method_name = iv_method_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_dynamic_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lr_data   TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULTS rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_call_error
          EXPORTING
            iv_class_name  = iv_class_name
            iv_method_name = iv_method_name
            previous       = lx_dyn_error.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other exception from the called method
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_dynamic_call_error
          EXPORTING
            iv_class_name  = iv_class_name
            iv_method_name = iv_method_name
            previous       = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_id DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_id.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_id.
    DATA(lv_connid_str) = CONV string( iv_connid ).

    IF lv_connid_str IS INITIAL OR NOT lv_connid_str CO '0123456789'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_id
        EXPORTING
          iv_flight_id = lv_connid_str
          iv_reason    = 'Flugnummer ist nicht numerisch oder leer.'.
    ENDIF.

    IF strlen( lv_connid_str ) <> 4. " Assuming 4 digits for flight ID
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_id
        EXPORTING
          iv_flight_id = lv_connid_str
          iv_reason    = 'Flugnummer hat ungültige Länge (erwartet 4 Ziffern).'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcx_unexpected_type DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_expected_type TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_actual_type TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid           LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous         LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_expected_type TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_actual_type   TYPE string OPTIONAL.

CLASS zcx_unexpected_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_expected_type = iv_expected_type.
    mv_actual_type = iv_actual_type.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_object_type
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_expected_type TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_unexpected_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_object_type.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( io_object ).
    DATA(lv_actual_type) = lo_class_descr->get_name( ).

    IF NOT io_object->is_a( iv_expected_type ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_unexpected_type
        EXPORTING
          iv_expected_type = iv_expected_type
          iv_actual_type   = lv_actual_type.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_check_object_type_failure FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_unexpected_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_object_type_success.
    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_test_class1( ).
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_rtti_checker( ).
    lo_checker->check_object_type( io_object = lo_object iv_expected_type = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Object type check successful.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_object_type_failure.
    DATA(lo_object) = NEW zcl_test_class1( ).
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_rtti_checker( ).
    TRY.
        lo_checker->check_object_type( io_object = lo_object iv_expected_type = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS2' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception zcx_unexpected_type was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_unexpected_type INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->mv_expected_type exp = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS2' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_exception->mv_actual_type exp = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_unexpected_type caught successfully.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) zur dynamischen Typüberprüfung von Objekten. Durch das Auslösen einer Ausnahme bei einem unerwarteten Typ wird die Typsicherheit zur Laufzeit gewährleistet und die Robustheit von generischem Code erhöht.
keywords: RTTI, RAISE EXCEPTION, cl_abap_classdescr, is_a, Type Checking

CLASS zcx_authorization_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

CLASS zcl_authorization_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_authority
      IMPORTING
        iv_auth_object TYPE string
        iv_activity    TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_authorization_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_authorization_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_authority.
    " Simulate authority check. In a real system, this would be a real AUTHORITY-CHECK.
    " For testing purposes, we'll assume 'Z_TEST_AUTH' with activity '01' is required.
    IF iv_auth_object = 'Z_TEST_AUTH' AND iv_activity = '01'.
      " Simulate success for this specific case
      RETURN.
    ELSEIF iv_auth_object = 'Z_TEST_AUTH' AND iv_activity = '02'.
      " Simulate failure for activity '02'
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_authorization_error
        EXPORTING
          iv_auth_object = iv_auth_object
          iv_activity    = iv_activity.
    ELSE.
      " For any other case, simulate success or failure based on a more complex logic
      " For simplicity, we'll raise an error for unknown objects/activities
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_authorization_error
        EXPORTING
          iv_auth_object = iv_auth_object
          iv_activity    = iv_activity.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,

CLASS zcl_sflight_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft und der Flugnummer und deklarieren Sie die Zielstruktur inline.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA(ls_flight)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_read_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_read_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
    rs_flight = ls_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in der Tabelle `sflights` existiert, ohne die Daten tatsächlich zu lesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `FROM` ohne `INTO` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_exists( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um die Existenz eines Datensatzes zu prüfen, ist es effizienter, `SELECT SINGLE FROM ... WHERE ...` ohne `INTO` zu verwenden. Das System liest dann nur so viele Daten wie nötig, um die Existenz zu bestätigen, und setzt `sy-subrc` entsprechend. Dies ist performanter als das Lesen aller Daten.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, sy-subrc, Database Access, Existence Check

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für einen bestimmten Flug aus `sflights`. Falls der Flug nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert von 0 zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA()` und den `COND`-Operator für den Standardwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seats) TYPE s_seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupied_seats.
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(lv_seats)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_seats = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN lv_seats ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_seats) = lo_cut->get_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_seats exp = 0 ).

  METHOD test_get_seats_not_found.
