Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flugdatensatz aus `sflights` für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft, sortiert nach Flugdatum absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` mit `ORDER BY` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_latest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS get_latest_flight_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_latest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight_key
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_latest_flight FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_latest_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_latest( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_key) = lo_cut->get_latest_flight_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_key-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_key-fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `SELECT SINGLE` implizit nur eine Zeile liest, ist `SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS` mit `ORDER BY` nützlich, wenn man die "erste" oder "letzte" Zeile nach einer bestimmten Sortierung benötigt. Dies ist eine explizite und performante Methode, um dies zu erreichen.
keywords: SELECT UP TO 1 ROWS, ORDER BY, Database Access, Sorting

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die Konstanten für verschiedene Statuscodes eines Auftrags enthält und eine Methode, die diese Konstanten verwendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` im `PUBLIC SECTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      BEGIN OF gc_status,
        new      TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
        in_process TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
        completed  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C',
        cancelled  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',
      END OF gc_status.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status-new.
        rv_description = 'New Order'.
      WHEN gc_status-in_process.
        rv_description = 'Order in Process'.
      WHEN gc_status-completed.
        rv_description = 'Order Completed'.
      WHEN gc_status-cancelled.
        rv_description = 'Order Cancelled'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unknown Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_status_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_description.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_order_status( ).
    DATA(lv_desc_new) = lo_cut->get_status_description( zcl_order_status=>gc_status-new ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_new exp = 'New Order' ).

    DATA(lv_desc_comp) = lo_cut->get_status_description( zcl_order_status=>gc_status-completed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_comp exp = 'Order Completed' ).

    DATA(lv_desc_unknown) = lo_cut->get_status_description( 'Z' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_unknown exp = 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CLASS-CONSTANTS` sind statische, unveränderliche Werte, die direkt über den Klassennamen zugänglich sind. Sie verbessern die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes, indem sie "Magic Numbers" oder String-Literale durch aussagekräftige Namen ersetzen.
keywords: CLASS-CONSTANTS, Object Orientation, Readability, Maintainability

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Methode, die lokale Konstanten für Berechnungen verwendet, um die Lesbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONSTANTS` innerhalb der Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_circle_area
      IMPORTING
        iv_radius TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_circle_area.
    CONSTANTS: lc_pi TYPE decfloat16 VALUE '3.141592653589793'.
    rv_area = lc_pi * iv_radius * iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_circle_area FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_circle_area.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_constants( ).
    DATA(lv_area) = lo_cut->calculate_circle_area( iv_radius = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_area exp = '314.1592653589793' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Lokale Konstanten, deklariert mit `CONSTANTS` innerhalb einer Methode, sind nur in dieser Methode sichtbar. Sie dienen dazu, unveränderliche Werte zu definieren, die spezifisch für die Logik dieser Methode sind, was die Lesbarkeit und das Verständnis des Codes verbessert.
keywords: CONSTANTS, Local Scope, Readability, Math

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit Konstanten für Systemmeldungen und implementieren Sie dieses Interface in einer Klasse, um auf die Meldungen zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONSTANTS` im `INTERFACE`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_messages.
  CONSTANTS:
    BEGIN OF gc_msg,
      success TYPE string VALUE 'Operation successful.',
      error   TYPE string VALUE 'An error occurred.',
      warning TYPE string VALUE 'Warning: Check input.',
    END OF gc_msg.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_messages.
    METHODS get_success_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_error_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_success_message.
    rv_message = zif_messages~gc_msg-success.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = zif_messages~gc_msg-error.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_messages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_success_msg) = lo_cut->get_success_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success_msg exp = 'Operation successful.' ).

    DATA(lv_error_msg) = lo_cut->get_error_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_error_msg exp = 'An error occurred.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interface-Konstanten bieten eine Möglichkeit, globale, unveränderliche Werte zu definieren, die von allen Klassen verwendet werden können, die das Interface implementieren. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Konsistenz von Werten über verschiedene Klassen hinweg.
keywords: CONSTANTS, INTERFACE, Object Orientation, Reusability

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, deren ID als Konstante definiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` und den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_line,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-CONSTANTS: gc_target_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH'.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = gc_target_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_flights=>ty_sflight_table.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CLASS-CONSTANTS` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) für interne Tabellen ist ein Beispiel für modernen, funktionalen ABAP-Code. Es macht den Filterkriterium explizit und leicht änderbar.
keywords: CONSTANTS, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine Struktur mit Standardwerten, wobei einige Werte aus Konstanten stammen.

solution:

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und die Flugnummer (`connid`) für einen bestimmten Flug aus `sflights` und geben Sie diese als String-Template zurück. Falls der Flug nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie 'Flug nicht gefunden' zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO @DATA()` und ein String-Template mit `sy-subrc` Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_info_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_info_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight_key)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_summary = |Flug { ls_flight_key-carrid } { ls_flight_key-connid } gefunden.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_summary = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_info_template( ).
    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_summary exp = 'Flug AA 0017 gefunden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_info_template( ).
    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE` in Kombination mit String-Templates (ABAP 7.40+) für eine moderne und lesbare Formatierung von Ausgaben. Die Inline-Deklaration und die `sy-subrc`-Prüfung sind ebenfalls Best Practices.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, String Templates, sy-subrc, Database Access

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Typ eines Dokuments basierend auf einem Code, der als Konstante definiert ist, und verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` und den `SWITCH`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_doc_type_invoice TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'I',
      gc_doc_type_order   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'O',
      gc_doc_type_delivery TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'D'.

    METHODS get_document_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_document_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_doc_code
      WHEN gc_doc_type_invoice THEN 'Rechnung'
      WHEN gc_doc_type_order   THEN 'Bestellung'
      WHEN gc_doc_type_delivery THEN 'Lieferung'
      ELSE 'Unbekannter Dokumenttyp'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_document_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_document_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_document_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_document_type( ).
    DATA(lv_desc_invoice) = lo_cut->get_document_description( zcl_document_type=>gc_doc_type_invoice ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_invoice exp = 'Rechnung' ).

    DATA(lv_desc_order) = lo_cut->get_document_description( zcl_document_type=>gc_doc_type_order ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_order exp = 'Bestellung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_document_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_document_type( ).
    DATA(lv_desc_unknown) = lo_cut->get_document_description( 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_desc_unknown exp = 'Unbekannter Dokumenttyp' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) bietet eine kompakte und funktionale Alternative zur `CASE`-Anweisung. In Kombination mit `CLASS-CONSTANTS` wird die Logik zur Bestimmung des Dokumenttyps sehr lesbar und wartbar.
keywords: CONSTANTS, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Typ und die Länge einer beliebigen elementaren Variablen zur Laufzeit mit RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_data()` und greifen Sie auf die Attribute `type_kind` und `length` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_type_info,
             type_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             length    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_type_info.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Initialwert eines beliebigen elementaren Datentyps zur Laufzeit mit RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_data()` und die Methode `get_initial_value()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_initial_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_initial_value_of_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_data       TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_initial_value) TYPE string. "Return as string for generic display
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_initial_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_value_of_type.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_data( iv_data ).
    DATA(lv_initial_value_raw) TYPE xstring.
    lo_descr->get_initial_value( EXPORTING p_value = lv_initial_value_raw ).

    " Convert raw initial value to string representation
    CASE lo_descr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_string.
        rv_initial_value = ''.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_char.
        rv_initial_value = |{ '' PAD LEFT TO lo_descr->length }|.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int4 OR
           cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int1 OR
           cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_int2.
        rv_initial_value = '0'.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_packed.
        rv_initial_value = '0.00'. "Example for packed, depends on decimals
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_date.
        rv_initial_value = '00000000'.
      WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>typekind_time.
        rv_initial_value = '000000'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback for other types, might need more specific handling
        rv_initial_value = 'UNKNOWN_INITIAL_VALUE'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sys_param_bool DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_sapstar_login_disabled
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_disabled) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_sys_param_bool IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_sapstar_login_disabled.
    DATA(lv_param_value) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_param_value = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( 'login/no_automatic_user_sapstar' ).
        " Profile parameters often return '1' for true, '0' for false.
        " Use modern string comparison.
        IF lv_param_value = '1' OR to_upper( lv_param_value ) = 'TRUE' OR to_upper( lv_param_value ) = 'YES'.
          rv_is_disabled = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_disabled = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_not_found.
        " Default to false if parameter not found (or handle as per business logic)
        rv_is_disabled = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_spfl_error.
        " Handle other errors, e.g., log and default to false
        rv_is_disabled = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sys_param_robust_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_param_value_robust
      IMPORTING
        iv_param_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_spfl_error. "Re-raise generic error for caller to handle
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sys_param_robust_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_param_value_robust.
    TRY.
        rv_value = cl_spfl_profile_parameter=>get_parameter_value( iv_param_name ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_parameter_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_spfl_error(
          textid = cx_spfl_error=>parameter_error
          previous = lx_not_found
          text = |Parameter '{ iv_param_name }' wurde nicht gefunden.|
        ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_spfl_error(
          textid = cx_spfl_error=>parameter_error
          previous = lx_error
          text = |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Parameter '{ iv_param_name }'.|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_param_robust FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_param_robust RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_param_robust.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sys_param_robust_read( ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_param_value_robust( 'rdisp/max_wprun_time' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_value ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_value IS NUMERIC ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_param_robust.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sys_param_robust_read( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_param_value_robust( 'non_existent_param_xyz' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_spfl_error for non-existent parameter' ).
      CATCH cx_spfl_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'nicht gefunden' act = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_spfl_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Fehlerbehandlung beim Lesen von Systemprofilparametern. Anstatt nur Standardwerte zurückzugeben, werden spezifische Ausnahmen abgefangen und eine generische `cx_spfl_error` erneut ausgelöst, die die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' enthält. String-Templates werden direkt in der Ausnahmebehandlung verwendet, um aussagekräftige und dynamische Fehlermeldungen zu generieren, was die Wartbarkeit und Fehleranalyse verbessert.
keywords: Systemparameter, cl_spfl_profile_parameter, Fehlerbehandlung, Ausnahmen, TRY-CATCH, String-Templates, cx_spfl_error

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und fügen Sie einen Eintrag hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_name ).

    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                       p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
                       p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                       p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_wa>).

      IF iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
        IF <fs_carrid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_carrid> = 'AZ'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
        IF <fs_connid> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_connid> = '0001'. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
        IF <fs_fldate> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_wa> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_price>).
        IF <fs_price> IS ASSIGNED. <fs_price> = '500.00'. ENDIF.

        APPEND <fs_wa> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Namen und Typen aller Komponenten einer Zeile einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components IMPORTING it_table TYPE any TABLE RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
    lo_line_descr  ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine bestimmte Komponente (Feld) in einer Struktur existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_component_type`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_field_exists
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_exists.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ).
        lo_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).
        rv_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component_error.
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,

    DATA(ls_test_struct) = VALUE ty_test_struct( field_a = 'X' field_b = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_exists( ).

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string. " Return as string for generic access
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie die entsprechende Exception ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_json_parser_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE ty_data.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string CHANGING data = ls_data ).
        rv_error_message = 'Deserialization successful (unexpected)'.
      CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_json_error INTO DATA(lx_general_json_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_general_json_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Methoden und Attribute einer Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_methods` und `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             is_public TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_methods.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
      APPEND VALUE ty_method_info(
        name = ls_method-name
        is_public = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_method-visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      ) TO rt_methods.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name = ls_attribute-name
        type = ls_attribute-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Wert eines Feldes dynamisch in einen anderen Typ (z.B. von `string` zu `i`), wenn der Zieltyp zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datadescr=>get_data_kind` und `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit Field-Symbols oder `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_source_value TYPE string
        iv_target_type  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_field_value.
    DATA: lo_target_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_target_type_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).

        CASE lo_target_type_descr->get_data_kind( ).
          WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>data_kind_int.
            DATA(lv_int_value) TYPE i.
            lv_int_value = iv_source_value.
            rv_converted_value = |{ lv_int_value }|.
          WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>data_kind_float.
            DATA(lv_float_value) TYPE f.
            lv_float_value = iv_source_value.
            rv_converted_value = |{ lv_float_value }|.
          WHEN cl_abap_elemdescr=>data_kind_decfloat.
            DATA(lv_decfloat_value) TYPE decfloat16.
            lv_decfloat_value = iv_source_value.
            rv_converted_value = |{ lv_decfloat_value }|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_converted_value = iv_source_value. " No specific conversion, return as is
        ENDCASE.

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        rv_converted_value = 'Unknown target type'.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_converted_value = 'Conversion error'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_field_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_convert( ).

    DATA(lv_int_converted) = lo_cut->convert_field_value( iv_source_value = '123' iv_target_type = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_int_converted exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_float_converted) = lo_cut->convert_field_value( iv_source_value = '123.45' iv_target_type = 'F' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_float_converted exp = '1.2345000000000000E+02' ). " ABAP F type representation

    DATA(lv_decfloat_converted) = lo_cut->convert_field_value( iv_source_value = '123.45' iv_target_type = 'DECFLOAT16' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decfloat_converted exp = '123.45' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid_conversion) = lo_cut->convert_field_value( iv_source_value = 'ABC' iv_target_type = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid_conversion exp = 'Conversion error' ).

    DATA(lv_unknown_type) = lo_cut->convert_field_value( iv_source_value = '1' iv_target_type = 'UNKNOWN_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unknown_type exp = 'Unknown target type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI kann verwendet werden, um den Datentyp eines Feldes zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen (`get_data_kind`). Basierend darauf kann eine dynamische Typkonvertierung durchgeführt werden. Fehler bei der Konvertierung sollten mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen werden.
keywords: RTTI, Data Conversion, Dynamic Programming, cl_abap_elemdescr, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Fügen Sie dynamisch ein neues Schlüssel-Wert-Paar zu einem bestehenden JSON-String hinzu, ohne den String komplett neu zu parsen und zu serialisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_json_parser` oder manipulieren Sie den String direkt (mit Vorsicht). Für einfache Fälle ist String-Manipulation möglich, für komplexe Fälle ist ein Parser besser.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_add_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_field_to_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_key         TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_add_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_field_to_json.
    DATA(lv_escaped_value) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>json_escape( iv_value ).
    DATA(lv_field_to_add) = |,"{ iv_key }":"{ lv_escaped_value }"|.

    " Find the last closing brace and insert before it
    DATA(lv_last_brace_pos) = find( val = iv_json_string sub = '}' occ = -1 ).

    IF lv_last_brace_pos IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_last_brace_pos > 0.
      rv_new_json = iv_json_string(1, lv_last_brace_pos - 1 ) && lv_field_to_add && iv_json_string+lv_last_brace_pos.
    ELSE.
      " Handle cases where it's not a valid JSON object or empty
      rv_new_json = |{{"{ iv_key }":"{ lv_escaped_value }"}}|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_field_to_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_field_to_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_add_field( ).

    DATA(lv_initial_json) = `{"name":"Alice"}`.
    DATA(lv_new_json) = lo_cut->add_field_to_json( iv_json_string = lv_initial_json iv_key = 'age' iv_value = '30' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_json exp = '{"name":"Alice","age":"30"}' ).

    DATA(lv_empty_json) = `{}`.
    DATA(lv_new_json_empty) = lo_cut->add_field_to_json( iv_json_string = lv_empty_json iv_key = 'city' iv_value = 'Berlin' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_json_empty exp = '{"city":"Berlin"}' ).

    DATA(lv_json_with_special_chars) = `{"item":"Book"}`.
    DATA(lv_new_json_special) = lo_cut->add_field_to_json( iv_json_string = lv_json_with_special_chars iv_key = 'desc' iv_value = 'A great "read"!' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_json_special exp = '{"item":"Book","desc":"A great \"read\"!"}' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das direkte Hinzufügen eines Feldes zu einem JSON-String ist mit String-Operationen möglich, erfordert aber sorgfältige Handhabung von Kommas und Klammern. `cl_abap_string_utilities=>json_escape` ist hierbei unerlässlich, um die JSON-Gültigkeit zu gewährleisten. Für komplexere Szenarien wäre ein vollständiges Parsen und erneutes Serialisieren mit `/ui2/cl_json` robuster.
keywords: JSON, String Manipulation, Data Manipulation, String Templates, json_escape

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit den entsprechenden Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_from_city.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom
           AND fldate > lv_current_date.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_for_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge einer Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für Flüge, die in der Zukunft liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression mit `WHEN` für die bedingte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_capacity_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights  TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_capacity_sum.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate > lv_current_date )
                                      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_exp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_timer_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_tick_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_timer_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_timer_tick.
    CASE iv_tick_count.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_status_message = 'Initialisierung läuft...'.
      WHEN 5.
        rv_status_message = 'Daten werden geladen...'.
      WHEN 10.
        rv_status_message = 'Verarbeitung abgeschlossen.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_message = 'Warten auf Ereignis...'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt, basierend auf einem übergebenen Typ-Code. Nutzen Sie `SWITCH` mit `WHEN` für die Objekterzeugung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SWITCH` Expression, um bedingt Instanzen verschiedener Klassen zu erzeugen, die ein gemeinsames Interface implementieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_action DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_action_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_action~execute.
    rv_result = 'Action B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_action) TYPE REF TO zif_action.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_action_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_action.
    ro_action = SWITCH #( iv_type
                          WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_action_a( )
                          WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_action_b( )
                          ELSE THROW cx_sy_create_error( textid = cx_sy_create_error=>cx_sy_create_error ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die Flugnummern und deren ursprünglichen Index aus der Tabelle sflight enthält. Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Expression mit INDEX und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit cl_demo_output aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... INDEX ... ) und String Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_index,
             index   TYPE i,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid  TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_with_index.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_index RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_index.
    METHODS display_flights_with_index.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights INDEX idx
                              ( index = idx
                                carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                connid = ls_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_flights_with_index.
    DATA(lt_flights_indexed) = get_flights_with_index( ).
    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'Flugdaten mit Index (FOR-Expression)' ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_indexed INTO DATA(ls_flight_indexed).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Index: { ls_flight_indexed-index }, Flug: { ls_flight_indexed-carrid }-{ ls_flight_indexed-connid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_index.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_for_index( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->get_flights_with_index( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result MSG 'Result table should not be empty.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index exp = 1 MSG 'First index should be 1.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-index exp = 2 MSG 'Second index should be 2.' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aus der sflight-Tabelle, aber nur für die ersten drei Zeilen. Nutzen Sie eine REDUCE-Expression und geben Sie das Ergebnis mit cl_demo_output aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit FOR ... IN ... INDEX ... und einer Bedingung für den Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_first_n_flights
          IMPORTING iv_n_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 3
          RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
    METHODS display_sum_first_n_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_tabix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_first_n_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price
                                   FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights INDEX idx
                                   WHERE ( idx <= iv_n_rows )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sum_first_n_flights.
    DATA(lv_sum) = calculate_sum_first_n_flights( 3 ).
    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'Summe der ersten 3 Flugpreise (REDUCE)' ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Gesamtsumme: { lv_sum }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_tabix( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_first_n_flights( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_sum MSG 'Sum for 1 row should not be initial.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum > 0 MSG 'Sum for 1 row should be positive.' ).

    DATA(lv_sum_3) = lo_calculator->calculate_sum_first_n_flights( 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_sum_3 >= lv_sum MSG 'Sum for 3 rows should be greater or equal to sum for 1 row.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_sum.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_tabix( ).
    lo_calculator->display_sum_first_n_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' 
      MSG 'Display method should execute without dump.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung, um einen einzelnen Wert aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. Die Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ... INDEX idx` und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung auf `idx` ermöglicht eine präzise Steuerung, welche Elemente in die Aggregation einfließen. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Endergebnis.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, INDEX, WHERE, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, cl_demo_output, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig (Shuffle).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle und fügen Sie die Elemente in zufälliger Reihenfolge ein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_temp_table) = it_original_table.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_temp_table ).

    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_lines
    ).

    DO lv_lines TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      READ TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(lv_entry).
      APPEND lv_entry TO rt_shuffled_table.
      DELETE TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_random_index.
      lo_random->set_max( lines( lt_temp_table ) ). " Adjust max for remaining elements
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und String-Templates, um Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_charset_len) = strlen( lc_charset ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_charset_len - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_charset+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Zählen Sie die Einträge in `SFLIGHTS` und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für einen Offset.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO lv_count.

    IF lv_count = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_count - 1
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF rs_random_flight
      UP TO 1 ROWS
      OFFSET lv_random_offset.
    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) in einen CSV-String und bereiten Sie diesen als E-Mail-Anhang vor.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix` und `cl_abap_conv_ce=>create_by_encoding` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_csv_solix
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_solix_table) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_attachment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_csv_solix.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = 'Airline;Flugnr.;Datum;Preis' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_csv_rows) = VALUE string( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( |{ ls_flight-carrid };{ ls_flight-connid };{ ls_flight-fldate };{ ls_flight-price }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) ).
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = lv_csv_header && lv_csv_rows.

    TRY.
        cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          EXPORTING
            iv_string = lv_csv_string
            iv_codepage = '1100' " UTF-8
            iv_add_bom = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            et_solix  = rt_solix_table
        ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_text.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_bcs_csv_attachment=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_csv_attachment( ).

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string( it_solix = lt_solix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_converted_string sub = 'LH;0400;20250101;100.00' ).

Instructions: Traversieren Sie eine hierarchische Struktur (z.B. eine Stückliste oder Organisationsstruktur), die in einer internen Tabelle gespeichert ist, um alle Nachfolger eines gegebenen Knotens zu finden. Nutzen Sie dabei eine WHILE-Schleife für die iterative Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen Stack (interne Tabelle) und eine WHILE-Schleife, die läuft, solange der Stack nicht leer ist. Neue Nachfolger werden auf den Stack gelegt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hierarchy_traversal DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node,
             id       TYPE i,
             parent_id TYPE i,
             name     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node,
           tt_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_descendants
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_node_id TYPE i
        it_hierarchy     TYPE tt_nodes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descendants) TYPE tt_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hierarchy_traversal IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_descendants.
    DATA: lt_stack TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_current_node_id TYPE i.

    APPEND iv_start_node_id TO lt_stack.

    WHILE lt_stack IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1 INTO lv_current_node_id.
      DELETE TABLE lt_stack INDEX 1.

      " Add current node to result if it's not the start node itself (optional, depending on requirement)
      IF lv_current_node_id <> iv_start_node_id.
        READ TABLE it_hierarchy WITH KEY id = lv_current_node_id INTO DATA(ls_node).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND ls_node TO rt_descendants.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      " Find direct children and add them to the stack
      LOOP AT it_hierarchy INTO ls_node WHERE parent_id = lv_current_node_id.
        APPEND ls_node-id TO lt_stack.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_descendants.
    DATA: lt_hierarchy TYPE zcl_hierarchy_traversal=>tt_nodes.

    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 parent_id = 0 name = 'Root' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 parent_id = 1 name = 'Child A' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 3 parent_id = 1 name = 'Child B' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 4 parent_id = 2 name = 'Grandchild A1' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 5 parent_id = 2 name = 'Grandchild A2' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 6 parent_id = 3 name = 'Grandchild B1' ) INTO TABLE lt_hierarchy.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hierarchy_traversal( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_descendants( iv_start_node_id = 1 it_hierarchy = lt_hierarchy ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ id = 1 ] OPTIONAL ). " Start node itself should not be in result
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result[ id = 4 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Durch die Verwendung eines Stacks (interne Tabelle) kann die Schleife dynamisch fortgesetzt werden, solange noch unerforschte Knoten vorhanden sind. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #()` und Inline-Deklarationen machen den Code kompakt und lesbar.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine iterative numerische Methode (z.B. Newtons Verfahren zur Berechnung der Quadratwurzel), die so lange fortgesetzt wird, bis das Ergebnis innerhalb einer vorgegebenen Toleranz konvergiert. Protokollieren Sie dabei die Anzahl der Iterationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife, die abbricht, wenn die absolute Differenz zwischen zwei aufeinanderfolgenden Approximationen kleiner als die Toleranz ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_newton_sqrt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_number   TYPE f
        iv_tolerance TYPE f DEFAULT '0.00001'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sqrt) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    DATA mv_iterations TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_newton_sqrt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sqrt.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lv_guess TYPE f VALUE '1.0',
          lv_prev_guess TYPE f,
          lv_diff TYPE f.

    mv_iterations = 0.

    WHILE abap_true.
      mv_iterations = mv_iterations + 1.
      lv_prev_guess = lv_guess.
      lv_guess = ( lv_prev_guess + ( iv_number / lv_prev_guess ) ) / 2.
      lv_diff = ABS( lv_guess - lv_prev_guess ).

      IF lv_diff < iv_tolerance.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      IF mv_iterations > 1000. " Safety break for non-converging cases
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_sqrt = lv_guess.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sqrt_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sqrt_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sqrt_negative RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sqrt_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_newton_sqrt( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sqrt( iv_number = '25' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '5.0' delta = '0.0001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_cut->mv_iterations ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sqrt_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_newton_sqrt( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sqrt( iv_number = '0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0.0' delta = '0.0001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sqrt_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_newton_sqrt( ).

explanation: Newtons Verfahren ist ein klassisches Beispiel für einen Algorithmus, der eine iterative Annäherung an eine Lösung erfordert. Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Reihe von Zufallszahlen, bis deren Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet oder eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zahlen generiert wurde. Speichern Sie die generierten Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife mit einer Bedingung, die sowohl die Summe als auch die Anzahl der Zahlen berücksichtigt. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Zufallszahlengenerierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sum_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE i
        iv_max_numbers TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.

    DATA mv_sum TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sum_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( ip_min = 1 ip_max = 100 ).
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= iv_threshold AND lv_count < iv_max_numbers.
      DATA(lv_random_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      APPEND lv_random_number TO rt_numbers.
      lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lv_random_number.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    mv_sum = lv_current_sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sflights_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sflights_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_fieldcat     TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Build field catalog dynamically
    LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_fieldname ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Select data from SFLIGHTS and fill dynamic table
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO lv_fieldname.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_field> = <fs_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Display ALV
    DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_salv_table( ).
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_calc_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calculated_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_calc_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calculated_sflights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Build field catalog for SFLIGHTS fields
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).
    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data in SFLIGHTS' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr_sflights) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights_all[1] ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr_sflights->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = ls_component-name ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Add calculated fields to field catalog
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' datatype = 'CURR' decimals = 2 currency = 'CURRENCY' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'OCCUPANCY_RATE' datatype = 'P' decimals = 2 ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    " 3. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 4. Fill dynamic table with SFLIGHTS data and calculated values
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_fieldcat INTO DATA(ls_fcat_entry).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_entry-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CASE ls_fcat_entry-fieldname.
            WHEN 'TOTAL_PRICE'.
              <fs_field> = <fs_sflight>-price * <fs_sflight>-seatsocc.
            WHEN 'OCCUPANCY_RATE'.
              IF <fs_sflight>-seatsmax > 0.
                <fs_field> = ( <fs_sflight>-seatsocc / <fs_sflight>-seatsmax ) * 100.
              ELSE.
                <fs_field> = 0.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_entry-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <fs_field> = <fs_field>.
              ENDIF.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 5. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_key_value_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
             group_id TYPE i, " To simulate grouping for multiple rows
           END OF ty_key_value,
           tt_key_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_key_value_data
      IMPORTING
        it_key_value_data TYPE tt_key_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_key_value_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_key_value_data.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Determine all unique keys to form column headers
    DATA(lt_unique_keys) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_kv IN it_key_value_data
      GROUP BY ls_kv-key
      ( ls_kv-key )
    ).

    " Add a grouping ID field if multiple rows share the same keys
    APPEND 'GROUP_ID' TO lt_unique_keys.

    " 2. Build field catalog dynamically
    LOOP AT lt_unique_keys INTO DATA(lv_key).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_key coltext = lv_key ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 3. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 4. Fill dynamic table
    DATA(lv_current_group_id) = 0.
    LOOP AT it_key_value_data INTO DATA(ls_kv_entry) GROUP BY ls_kv_entry-group_id.
      lv_current_group_id = lv_current_group_id + 1.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'GROUP_ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_current_group_id. ENDIF.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_kv_entry INTO DATA(ls_grouped_kv).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_grouped_kv-key OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = ls_grouped_kv-value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 5. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_entry-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.

        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

    " 5. Display ALV

      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Elemente aus einer Warteschlange (repräsentiert durch eine interne Tabelle) nacheinander, bis die Warteschlange leer ist oder eine maximale Anzahl von Elementen verarbeitet wurde. Protokollieren Sie die verarbeiteten Elemente.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife, die läuft, solange die Warteschlange nicht leer ist und das Verarbeitungslimit nicht erreicht ist. Entfernen Sie Elemente nach der Verarbeitung aus der Warteschlange.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_queue_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_queue TYPE tt_queue_item
        iv_max_items     TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE tt_queue_item.

    DATA mv_items_processed TYPE i READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_current_queue) = it_initial_queue.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.

    WHILE lt_current_queue IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_processed_count < iv_max_items.
      READ TABLE lt_current_queue INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_items.
        DELETE TABLE lt_current_queue INDEX 1.
        lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        " Should not happen if lt_current_queue is not initial
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    mv_items_processed = lv_processed_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Countdown von einer Startzahl bis Null. Brechen Sie den Countdown ab, wenn eine bestimmte 'Notfall'-Zahl erreicht wird, und geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung aus. Andernfalls geben Sie jede Zahl des Countdowns aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife, die die Zählvariable dekrementiert. Nutzen Sie eine IF-Bedingung innerhalb der Schleife, um den Notfall zu prüfen und die Schleife mit `EXIT` zu verlassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_countdown_emergency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS start_countdown
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_number TYPE i
        iv_emergency_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_countdown_emergency IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_countdown.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_start_number.

    WHILE lv_current_number >= 0.
      IF lv_current_number = iv_emergency_number.
        APPEND |Emergency reached at { lv_current_number }! Aborting countdown.| TO rt_log.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND |Countdown: { lv_current_number }| TO rt_log.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_current_number < 0 AND NOT line_exists( rt_log[ 1 ] WHERE contains( val = table_line sub = 'Emergency' ) ).
      APPEND 'Countdown finished successfully.' TO rt_log.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV-Grid, das eine Teilmenge der Felder aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Die Auswahl der Felder soll über eine vordefinierte Liste von Feldnamen erfolgen. Das ALV soll dabei nur die ersten N Zeilen der Daten anzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die dynamische Tabelle und `SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS` für die Datenbeschränkung. Die Feldnamen können direkt im Feldkatalog verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_subset_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_subset
      IMPORTING
        it_selected_fields TYPE string_table
        iv_max_rows        TYPE i DEFAULT 10.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_subset_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_subset.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Build field catalog from selected field names
    LOOP AT it_selected_fields INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_fieldname ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Select data from SFLIGHTS (up to max_rows) and fill dynamic table
    DATA: lt_sflights_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT (it_selected_fields) FROM sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_subset.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_subset ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT it_selected_fields INTO lv_fieldname.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_field> = <fs_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen iterativen Prozess mit einer WHILE-Schleife. Protokollieren Sie den Zustand jedes Schritts (z.B. Iterationsnummer, aktueller Wert, Status) in einer dynamischen internen Tabelle. Zeigen Sie dieses Prozessprotokoll anschließend in einem ALV-Grid an.
hint: Definieren Sie eine einfache Struktur für die Protokolleinträge. Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` zur Erstellung der dynamischen Tabelle und füllen Sie diese innerhalb der WHILE-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_iterative_process_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_and_display_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        iv_target_value TYPE i
        iv_step_size    TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log_entries) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_iterative_process_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_and_display_log.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Define structure for log entries dynamically
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'ITERATION' datatype = 'INT4' coltext = 'Iteration' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CURRENT_VALUE' datatype = 'INT4' coltext = 'Current Value' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'STATUS' datatype = 'STRING' coltext = 'Status' ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    " 2. Create dynamic table type for the log
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Simulate iterative process and fill dynamic log table
    DATA(lv_current_value) = iv_start_value.
    DATA(lv_iteration) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_value < iv_target_value AND lv_iteration < 100. " Safety break
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.

      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ITERATION' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_iteration. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CURRENT_VALUE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_current_value. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STATUS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = |Processing step { lv_iteration }|. ENDIF.

      APPEND |Iteration { lv_iteration }: Value = { lv_current_value }| TO rt_log_entries.
      lv_current_value = lv_current_value + iv_step_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_current_value >= iv_target_value.
      APPEND |Process completed. Final value: { lv_current_value }| TO rt_log_entries.
    ELSE.
      APPEND |Process aborted after { lv_iteration } iterations. Current value: { lv_current_value }| TO rt_log_entries.
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine 'Was-wäre-wenn'-Analyse durch, bei der eine WHILE-Schleife einen Parameter iterativ anpasst, bis ein Zielwert erreicht ist. Für jede Iteration sollen wichtige Metriken (Eingabeparameter, Ergebnis, Differenz zum Ziel) in einer dynamischen ALV-Tabelle erfasst und angezeigt werden.
hint: Bauen Sie den Feldkatalog für das ALV dynamisch auf, basierend auf den zu protokollierenden Metriken. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für Berechnungen und `SWITCH` für bedingte Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_what_if_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_what_if_analysis
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_param TYPE f
        iv_target_result TYPE f
        iv_step_size     TYPE f DEFAULT '0.1'
        iv_tolerance     TYPE f DEFAULT '0.01'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_what_if_alv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_what_if_analysis.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Define structure for analysis log entries dynamically
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'ITERATION' datatype = 'INT4' coltext = 'Iteration' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'INPUT_PARAM' datatype = 'FLTP' decimals = 4 coltext = 'Input Parameter' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CALC_RESULT' datatype = 'FLTP' decimals = 4 coltext = 'Calculated Result' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'DIFFERENCE' datatype = 'FLTP' decimals = 4 coltext = 'Difference to Target' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'STATUS' datatype = 'STRING' coltext = 'Status' ) TO lt_fieldcat.

    " 2. Create dynamic table type for the analysis log
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Perform 'What-If' analysis with WHILE loop and fill dynamic log table
    DATA(lv_current_param) = iv_initial_param.
    DATA(lv_iteration) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_result) = 0.0.
    DATA(lv_difference) = 0.0.

    WHILE ABS( lv_difference ) > iv_tolerance OR lv_iteration = 0.
      lv_iteration = lv_iteration + 1.

      " Simulate a calculation (e.g., a simple function)
      lv_current_result = lv_current_param * lv_current_param / 10.
      lv_difference = lv_current_result - iv_target_result.

      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ITERATION' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_iteration. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'INPUT_PARAM' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_current_param. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CALC_RESULT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_current_result. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'DIFFERENCE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = lv_difference. ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STATUS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = SWITCH string(
          WHEN ABS( lv_difference ) <= iv_tolerance THEN 'Converged'
          WHEN lv_iteration >= 100 THEN 'Max iterations reached'
          ELSE 'Iterating'
        ).
      ENDIF.

      IF ABS( lv_difference ) <= iv_tolerance OR lv_iteration >= 100.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_param = lv_current_param + iv_step_size.
    ENDWHILE.

    " 4. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
