Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV-Grid, das die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Die Besonderheit ist, dass die Spalten für 'PRICE' und 'CURRENCY' nur dann angezeigt werden, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung (z.B. ein Schalter in der Konfiguration) aktiv ist. Andernfalls werden diese Spalten weggelassen.
hint: Bauen Sie den Feldkatalog bedingt auf. Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` mit dem angepassten Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_alv_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_show_price_currency TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_true.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_alv_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_conditionally.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Get base field catalog from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).
    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data in SFLIGHTS' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr_sflights) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights_all[1] ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr_sflights->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      " Conditionally add PRICE and CURRENCY fields
      IF ls_component-name = 'PRICE' OR ls_component-name = 'CURRENCY'.
        IF iv_show_price_currency = abap_true.
          APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = ls_component-name ) TO lt_fieldcat.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = ls_component-name ) TO lt_fieldcat.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 3. Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_fieldcat INTO DATA(ls_fcat_entry).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_entry-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fcat_entry-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_field> = <fs_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Bestimmen Sie zuerst die eindeutigen Werte des Pivot-Feldes, um die dynamischen Spalten zu erstellen. Aggregieren Sie dann die Daten entsprechend und füllen Sie die dynamische Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pivot_alv_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_pivot_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pivot_alv_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_pivot_sflights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Get all SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).
    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data in SFLIGHTS' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Determine unique CARRID values for dynamic columns
    DATA(lt_unique_carrids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_all
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).

    " 3. Build field catalog: Fixed column for FLDATE, then dynamic columns for each CARRID
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'FLDATE' datatype = 'DATS' coltext = 'Flight Date' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    LOOP AT lt_unique_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_carrid datatype = 'CURR' decimals = 2 currency = 'CURRENCY' coltext = lv_carrid ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 5. Aggregate data and fill dynamic table (Pivot logic)
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = ls_flight-fldate. ENDIF.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_grouped_flight-carrid OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> + ls_grouped_flight-price.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 6. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein dynamisches ALV-Grid, das die Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt. Die Spalten sollen dynamisch aus den Werten eines Feldes (z.B. 'CARRID') generiert werden, während die Zeilen aggregierte Werte (z.B. Summe der Preise) für ein anderes Feld anzeigen.
hint: Bestimmen Sie zuerst die eindeutigen Werte des Pivot-Feldes, um die dynamischen Spalten zu erstellen. Aggregieren Sie dann die Daten entsprechend und füllen Sie die dynamische Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pivot_alv_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_pivot_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pivot_alv_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_pivot_sflights.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
          lo_alv      TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE ANY.

    " 1. Get all SFLIGHTS data
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_all).
    IF lt_sflights_all IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'No data in SFLIGHTS' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Determine unique CARRID values for dynamic columns
    DATA(lt_unique_carrids) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_all
      GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( ls_flight-carrid )
    ).

    " 3. Build field catalog: Fixed column for FLDATE, then dynamic columns for each CARRID
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'FLDATE' datatype = 'DATS' coltext = 'Flight Date' ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    LOOP AT lt_unique_carrids INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = lv_carrid datatype = 'CURR' decimals = 2 currency = 'CURRENCY' coltext = lv_carrid ) TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 4. Create dynamic table type
    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        e_table        = DATA(lr_data_table)
    ).
    ASSIGN lr_data_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    " 5. Aggregate data and fill dynamic table (Pivot logic)
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_field> = ls_flight-fldate. ENDIF.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_grouped_flight-carrid OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = <fs_field> + ls_grouped_flight-price.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 6. Display ALV
    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = lo_alv
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_table>
    ).
    lo_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data_dynamic RETURNING VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        ep_table         = rt_dynamic_table
    ).

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
        INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_line> = <fs_sflight_line>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldkatalog für eine ALV-Anzeige, basierend auf einer benutzerdefinierten Liste von Feldern aus `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und füllen Sie den Feldkatalog manuell.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fieldcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_alv_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        et_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fieldcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_alv_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_DYN_ALV_FIELDCAT=>TY_SFLIGHT_SUBSET'
      IMPORTING
        ep_table         = rt_dynamic_table
    ).

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_table> = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight_line> IN lt_sflight
                            ( carrid = <fs_sflight_line>-carrid
                              connid = <fs_sflight_line>-connid
                              fldate = <fs_sflight_line>-fldate ) ).
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamischer Feldkatalog
    et_fieldcat = VALUE #(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' coltext = 'Flugnummer' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' coltext = 'Flugdatum' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine positive Zahl als Eingabe erwartet und mit `ASSERT` überprüft, ob die Zahl tatsächlich positiv ist. Bei einem Fehler soll eine Assertion ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSERT CONDITION <bedingung>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_positive_number IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_positive_number.
    ASSERT CONDITION iv_number > 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_number_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_positive_number_invalid FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_number_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_positive( ).
    lo_cut->check_positive_number( 10 ).
    " No assertion should be triggered, test passes if no exception occurs.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should accept positive number' act = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_positive_number_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_positive( ).
    " Expecting an assertion failure (runtime error) for non-positive input.
    " In ABAP Unit, this is typically handled by expecting a specific exception
    " or by letting the test fail if the assertion is configured to terminate.
    " For simplicity, we simulate a check that would fail if assertion terminates.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_positive_number( -5 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Assertion for negative number was not triggered' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Assertion for negative number was triggered' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist ein wichtiges Werkzeug für die Qualitätssicherung und das Debugging während der Entwicklung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen summiert und anschließend mit `ASSERT` überprüft, ob die Summe nicht negativ ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Summe und `ASSERT` für die Nachbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assert_sum_non_negative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_and_assert IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assert_sum_non_negative IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_and_assert.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR n IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + n ).
    ASSERT CONDITION rv_sum >= 0.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_positive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_negative FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_positive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_sum_non_negative( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_and_assert( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum should be 6' act = lv_sum exp = 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_sum_non_negative( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( -1 ) ( 1 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_and_assert( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum should be 0' act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assert_sum_non_negative( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( -1 ) ( -2 ) ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_sum_and_assert( lt_numbers ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Assertion for negative sum was not triggered' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assert.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Assertion for negative sum was triggered' act = abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `ASSERT` kann man Nachbedingungen (Post-conditions) überprüfen, um die Korrektheit des Ergebnisses einer Operation sicherzustellen. Dies erhöht die Robustheit des Codes.
keywords: ASSERT, Post-condition, REDUCE, Functional Programming, Quality Assurance

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflight_dynamic.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 20 ROWS.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        ep_table         = rt_filtered_table
    ).

    ASSIGN rt_filtered_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_table> = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer Struktur, die zur Laufzeit aus einer Liste von Feldnamen generiert wird, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` mit einem dynamisch erstellten Feldkatalog, um die Struktur zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_from_fields
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_from_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_from_fields.
    DATA: lt_fieldcat TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
    DATA: ls_fcat_line TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    " Dynamischen Feldkatalog erstellen
    LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_name>).
      CLEAR ls_fcat_line.
      ls_fcat_line-fieldname = <fs_field_name>.
      APPEND ls_fcat_line TO lt_fieldcat.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table(
      EXPORTING
        it_fieldcatalog = lt_fieldcat
      IMPORTING
        ep_table        = rt_dynamic_table
    ).

    ASSIGN rt_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

      LOOP AT lt_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
        INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING <fs_field_name>.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight_line> TO <fs_field>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <fs_field> = <fs_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_flights TYPE i,

      <fs_table> = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_group-carrid INTO DATA(key)

METHOD get_category_description. rv_description = SWITCH string( iv_status_code WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok THEN 'Erfolg (200 OK)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_bad_request THEN 'Client-Fehler (400 Bad Request)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal THEN 'Server-Fehler (500 Internal Error)' WHEN OTHERS THEN COND string( WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Erfolg (2xx)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Client-Fehler (4xx)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Server-Fehler (5xx)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_informational( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Information (1xx)' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_redirection( iv_status_code ) THEN 'Redirection (3xx)' ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ). Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'success', 'not_found', 'error') dynamisch den passenden HTTP-Statuscode und die Reason Phrase setzt. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression auf den Eingabeparameter, um die Konstanten von `cl_rest_status_code` und `if_http_status` zuzuweisen.
solution: INTERFACE if_rest_response PUBLIC. METHODS set_status IMPORTING code TYPE i reason TYPE string. METHODS set_text IMPORTING text TYPE string. ENDINTERFACE. CLASS zcl_dynamic_rest_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS set_dynamic_status IMPORTING iv_status_type TYPE string io_rest_response TYPE REF TO if_rest_response. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_dynamic_rest_status IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD set_dynamic_status. DATA(lv_code) = 0. DATA(lv_reason) = ''. DATA(lv_text) = ''. SWITCH iv_status_type. WHEN 'success'. lv_code = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok. lv_reason = if_http_status=>reason_200. lv_text = 'Anfrage erfolgreich verarbeitet.'. WHEN 'not_found'. lv_code = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found. lv_reason = if_http_status=>reason_404. lv_text = 'Die angeforderte Ressource existiert nicht.'. WHEN 'error'. lv_code = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal. lv_reason = if_http_status=>reason_500. lv_text = 'Ein interner Serverfehler ist aufgetreten.'. WHEN OTHERS. lv_code = cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_bad_request. lv_reason = if_http_status=>reason_400. lv_text = 'Ungültige Anfrage.'. ENDSWITCH. io_rest_response->set_status( code = lv_code reason = lv_reason ). io_rest_response->set_text( lv_text ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rest_response, id TYPE string, status_code TYPE i, response_body TYPE string, END OF ty_rest_response. TYPES tt_rest_response TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_rest_response WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_count_success_responses DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS count_successful IMPORTING it_responses TYPE tt_rest_response RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_count_success_responses IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD count_successful. rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR response IN it_responses WHERE ( cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( response-status_code ) = abap_true ) NEXT count = count + 1 ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle von REST-Antworten in eine neue Tabelle um, die für jeden Statuscode eine benutzerdefinierte Meldung enthält. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `VALUE`-Operator mit `FOR` und einer `SWITCH`-Expression, die `cl_rest_status_code` Methoden verwendet.

solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rest_response, id TYPE string, status_code TYPE i, response_body TYPE string, END OF ty_rest_response. TYPES tt_rest_response TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_rest_response WITH EMPTY KEY. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_custom_message, id TYPE string, message TYPE string, END OF ty_custom_message. TYPES tt_custom_message TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_custom_message WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_map_status_to_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS map_responses_to_messages IMPORTING it_responses TYPE tt_rest_response RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_custom_message. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_map_status_to_message IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD map_responses_to_messages. rt_messages = VALUE tt_custom_message( FOR response IN it_responses ( id = response-id message = SWITCH string( response-status_code WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_success_ok THEN 'Anfrage erfolgreich bearbeitet.' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_client_error_not_found THEN 'Ressource nicht gefunden.' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>gc_server_error_internal THEN 'Ein Systemfehler ist aufgetreten.' WHEN OTHERS THEN COND string( WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( response-status_code ) THEN 'Erfolgreiche Operation.' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_client_error( response-status_code ) THEN 'Client-seitiger Fehler.' WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>is_server_error( response-status_code ) THEN 'Server-seitiger Fehler.' ELSE 'Unbekannter Status.' ) ) ) ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle, wobei die Feldnamen automatisch zugeordnet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)` für die automatische Feldzuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " For a more robust test, you might need to insert test data or check for a known existing carrier.
    " Example for checking if any data is returned:
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

Die `@` Escape-Zeichen kennzeichnen Host-Variablen in Open SQL. `DATA(...)` ist eine Inline-Deklaration, die den Code kompakter macht.
keywords: SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, DATA, Open SQL

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur übereinstimmende Feldnamen übertragen werden. Demonstrieren Sie auch die selektive Zuordnung mit dem `CORRESPONDING #` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` und den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    METHODS map_data_selective
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_source TO rs_target.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_data_selective.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING field1 = field1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_map_data_selective FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapping=>ty_source( field1 = 'Value1' field2 = 123 field3 = 'Ignore' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_map_data_selective.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_mapping=>ty_source( field1 = 'OnlyThis' field2 = 456 field3 = 'AlsoIgnore' ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data_selective( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'OnlyThis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` kopiert Felder mit identischen Namen. Der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) bietet eine flexiblere Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu verschieben, einschließlich der Möglichkeit, Felder umzubenennen oder nur bestimmte Felder zu mappen. Hier wird `MAPPING` verwendet, um nur `field1` zu kopieren.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen Query-Parameter aus der URL liest und diesen in die Antwort einfügt. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` zur Verarbeitung der Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_HTTP_REQUEST->GET_FORM_FIELDS` und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_param_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_param_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lt_form_fields) = iv_server->request->get_form_fields( ).
    DATA(lv_param_value) = 'Parameter not found'.

    DATA(lt_filtered_param) = FILTER #( lt_form_fields USING KEY name WHERE name = 'myparam' ).

    IF lt_filtered_param IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_param_value = lt_filtered_param[ 1 ]-value.
    ENDIF.

    iv_server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    iv_server->response->set_cdata( |Value of 'myparam': { lv_param_value }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_handle_request FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_handle_request.
    " Similar to HTTP_003, direct testing of IF_HTTP_EXTENSION is complex.
    " We'll test the logic for filtering parameters.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_form_field,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_form_field.
    TYPES tt_form_field TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_form_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_mock_form_fields) = VALUE tt_form_field(
      ( name = 'otherparam' value = 'somevalue' )
      ( name = 'myparam'    value = 'expected_value' )
      ( name = 'another'    value = 'test' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_mock_form_fields USING KEY name WHERE name = 'myparam' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-value exp = 'expected_value' ).

    DATA(lt_not_found) = FILTER #( lt_mock_form_fields USING KEY name WHERE name = 'nonexistent' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_not_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `GET_FORM_FIELDS` des Request-Objekts liefert alle Query-Parameter als interne Tabelle. Der `FILTER` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) wird verwendet, um effizient nach einem bestimmten Parameter (`myparam`) zu suchen. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten.
keywords: HTTP, Query Parameters, FILTER, Internal Tables, CL_HTTP_REQUEST

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Quellstrukturen in eine Liste von Zielstrukturen, wobei die entsprechenden Felder mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und dem `VALUE`-Operator zugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `VALUE #(...)` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.

CLASS zcl_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             item_id   TYPE i,
             item_name TYPE string,
             amount    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING id = item_id name = item_name value = amount ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_transform=>tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.50' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_table( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-amount exp = '10.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-amount exp = '20.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code demonstriert die Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine andere unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators (ab ABAP 7.40) in Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator. Innerhalb der Schleife wird `CORRESPONDING #` verwendet, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen, aber logisch zusammengehörigen Inhalten, explizit zuzuordnen (`id` zu `item_id`, `name` zu `item_name`, `value` zu `amount`). Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, Data Transformation

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_echo_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_echo_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_method) = iv_server->request->get_method( ).

    IF lv_request_method = if_http_request=>co_request_method_post.
      DATA(lv_post_data) = iv_server->request->get_cdata( ).
      iv_server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
      iv_server->response->set_cdata( |Echo: { lv_post_data }| ).
    ELSE.
      iv_server->response->set_status( code = 405 reason = 'Method Not Allowed' ).
      iv_server->response->set_cdata( 'Only POST requests are supported.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer, um den Gesamtpreis zu berechnen. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS` für die Ergebnisstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    TYPES tt_sflight_agg TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_prices.
    rt_aggregated_prices = REDUCE tt_sflight_agg(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight_agg( )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid
      ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
      " INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF result (ls_group_key-carrid = carrid, ls_group_key-connid = connid)
      " The above line is conceptual for INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS within REDUCE, but REDUCE directly builds the target table.
      " We use CORRESPONDING # to map the group key and sum the price.
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_group_key
          total_price = SUM( ls_flight-price ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregate_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_reduce=>tt_sflight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_aggregated) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_prices( lt_raw_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_aggregated ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_agg_lh_400) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh_400-total_price exp = '250.00' ).

    DATA(ls_agg_aa_017) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_aa_017-total_price exp = '200.00' ).

    DATA(ls_agg_lh_401) = lt_aggregated[ KEY carrid connid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_agg_lh_401-total_price exp = '50.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ideal für Aggregationen. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nach `carrid` und `connid` gruppiert ist. `SUM( ls_flight-price )` berechnet die Summe der Preise für jede Gruppe. `CORRESPONDING #` wird verwendet, um die Gruppenschlüssel und das aggregierte Ergebnis in die Zielstruktur zu mappen. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und lesbare Syntax für komplexe Aggregationen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, GROUP BY, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der grundlegende Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` demonstriert und einen entsprechenden HTTP-Statuscode setzt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_...` und `CL_HTTP_RESPONSE->SET_STATUS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    METHODS simulate_error
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    TRY.
        " Simulate some operation that might fail
        simulate_error( ).
        iv_server->response->set_cdata( 'Operation successful.' ).
        iv_server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        iv_server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        iv_server->response->set_cdata( |Error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        iv_server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        iv_server->response->set_cdata( |Unexpected Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_error.
    " For demonstration, always raise an error.
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
      EXPORTING
        text = 'A simulated error occurred!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_simulate_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_handle_request_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->simulate_error( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'A simulated error occurred!' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_handle_request_error.
    " Testing the error handling path of handle_request is tricky without mocking.
    " We'll focus on the exception raising part.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->simulate_error( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'simulate_error should always raise an exception' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception caught as expected.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke sind entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung. Hier wird eine generische Ausnahme `cx_static_check` abgefangen, um einen simulierten Fehler zu behandeln. Im Fehlerfall wird der HTTP-Statuscode auf '500 Internal Server Error' gesetzt und eine Fehlermeldung im Response-Body zurückgegeben. Dies ist eine Standardpraxis für die Fehlerkommunikation in Web-Anwendungen.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, HTTP Status, Exceptions, CL_HTTP_RESPONSE

CLASS zcl_http_header_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_http_header_reader IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur kopiert. Die Zielstruktur enthält ein zusätzliches Feld, das mit einem Standardwert gefüllt wird, während die übereinstimmenden Felder mit `CORRESPONDING #` kopiert werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_data_copy_with_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data.

             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             default_field TYPE string,

        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.

CLASS zcl_data_copy_with_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source
                                  default_field = 'DEFAULT_VALUE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_copy_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_copy_with_default( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_data_copy_with_default=>ty_source_data(
      field_a = 'Source A'

keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, Default Value

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der ein Cookie aus der Anfrage liest und dessen Wert in der Antwort zurückgibt. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CL_HTTP_REQUEST->GET_COOKIE_FIELD`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_HTTP_REQUEST->GET_COOKIE_FIELD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_cookie_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_cookie_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_cookie_value) = iv_server->request->get_cookie_field( 'my_session_id' ).

    DATA(lv_response_text) = COND string(
      WHEN lv_cookie_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN |Session ID from Cookie: { lv_cookie_value }|
      ELSE |Cookie 'my_session_id' not found.|
    ).

    iv_server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).
    iv_server->response->set_cdata( lv_response_text ).

    " Optionally, set a new cookie
    DATA(lo_cookie) = NEW cl_http_cookie(
      name  = 'last_visit'
      value = |{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit }|
      path  = '/'
    ).
    iv_server->response->set_cookie( lo_cookie ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cookie_reading FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cookie_setting FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cookie_reading.
    " Simulate cookie reading logic.
    DATA(lv_mock_cookie_value) = 'abc123xyz'.
    DATA(lv_expected_response) = |Session ID from Cookie: { lv_mock_cookie_value }|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_response exp = 'Session ID from Cookie: abc123xyz' ).

    DATA(lv_no_cookie_response) = |Cookie 'my_session_id' not found.|.

Instructions: Führe eine tiefe Kopie eines komplexen Objekts durch, das Referenzen enthält.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deep_copy_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_data,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sub_data.
    CLASS cl_sub_object DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA sub_value TYPE ty_sub_data.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS cl_sub_object IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS cl_main_object DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA main_value TYPE string.
        DATA sub_obj    TYPE REF TO cl_sub_object.
        METHODS constructor.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS cl_main_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        sub_obj = NEW cl_sub_object( ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS perform_deep_copy
      IMPORTING
        io_source_object TYPE REF TO cl_main_object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_copied_object) TYPE REF TO cl_main_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_copy_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_deep_copy.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_copied_object. " Create target object
    cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy(
      EXPORTING
        source = io_source_object
      IMPORTING
        target = ro_copied_object
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deep_copy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deep_copy.
    DATA(lo_source) = NEW zcl_deep_copy_data=>cl_main_object( ).
    lo_source->main_value = 'Original Main'.
    lo_source->sub_obj->sub_value-value = 'Original Sub'.

    DATA(lo_copier) = NEW zcl_deep_copy_data( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = lo_copier->perform_deep_copy( lo_source ).

    " Assert that values are initially the same
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_source->main_value exp = lo_target->main_value msg = 'Main value should be same' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_source->sub_obj->sub_value-value exp = lo_target->sub_obj->sub_value-value msg = 'Sub value should be same' ).

    " Change source object
    lo_source->main_value = 'Changed Main'.
    lo_source->sub_obj->sub_value-value = 'Changed Sub'.

    " Assert that target object values are unchanged (deep copy)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->main_value exp = 'Original Main' msg = 'Main value in target should be original' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_target->sub_obj->sub_value-value exp = 'Original Sub' msg = 'Sub value in target should be original' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die tiefe Kopie eines Objekts, das eine Referenz auf ein anderes Objekt enthält. `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>deep_copy` stellt sicher, dass nicht nur die Referenz, sondern auch das referenzierte Objekt selbst kopiert wird, was bei komplexen Datenstrukturen unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung ist ebenfalls modern.
keywords: Deep Copy, Object, Reference, cl_abap_memory_utilities, Object Orientation

Instructions: Vergleiche den Speicherverbrauch einer Standardtabelle mit einer Hash-Tabelle, die dieselben Daten enthält.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_size` für beide Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_hashed   TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data
                      WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS compare_table_memory
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_memory_info) TYPE REF TO struct_memory_info. " Custom structure for return

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_memory_info,
             standard_table_size TYPE i,
             hashed_table_size   TYPE i,
           END OF struct_memory_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_table_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_memory.
    DATA(ls_memory_info) = VALUE struct_memory_info( ).

    DATA(lt_standard) = VALUE tt_standard(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries
      ( key_field = |Key { i }|, value_field = i )
    ).
    ls_memory_info-standard_table_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_size( lt_standard ).

    DATA(lt_hashed) = VALUE tt_hashed(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_entries
      ( key_field = |Key { i }|, value_field = i )
    ).
    ls_memory_info-hashed_table_size = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_size( lt_hashed ).

    CREATE DATA rs_memory_info LIKE ls_memory_info.
    rs_memory_info->* = ls_memory_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compare_memory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_table_compare( ).
    DATA(lr_memory_info) = lo_cut->compare_table_memory( 1000 ). " Test with fewer entries

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_memory_info->standard_table_size msg = 'Standard table size should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lr_memory_info->standard_table_size > 0 ) msg = 'Standard table size should be > 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_memory_info->hashed_table_size msg = 'Hashed table size should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lr_memory_info->hashed_table_size > 0 ) msg = 'Hashed table size should be > 0' ).

    " Hashed tables often have a slightly larger overhead for the hash index
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lr_memory_info->hashed_table_size >= lr_memory_info->standard_table_size ) msg = 'Hashed table size should be >= standard table size' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch von Standard- und Hash-Tabellen. Beide Tabellen werden mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und einer `FOR`-Iteration initialisiert. `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_size` wird verwendet, um den Speicherbedarf jeder Tabelle zu messen. Dies ist nützlich für Performance-Analysen und die Optimierung des Speicherverbrauchs.
keywords: Memory, Performance, Internal Table, Hashed Table, VALUE, FOR, cl_abap_memory_utilities

Instructions: Lese den Inhalt einer simulierten Sprachdatei vom Applikationsserver mit `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
hint: Nutze `cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_content_as_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_lang_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_name TYPE string
        iv_language  TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. " For file operations, exceptions are common

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_lang_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    DATA(lv_file_path) = |/tmp/{ iv_file_name }_{ iv_language }|. " Simulate a file path

    " For demonstration, we'll first write a dummy file
    " In a real scenario, this file would already exist.
    DATA(lv_dummy_content) = |This is content for language { iv_language }|.
    OPEN DATASET lv_file_path FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING DEFAULT.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRANSFER lv_dummy_content TO lv_file_path.
      CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error if file cannot be created for dummy content
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
        EXPORTING
          text = |Could not create dummy file { lv_file_path }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Now read the file using cl_cts_language_file_io
    TRY.
        rv_content = cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_content_as_string(
          i_file_name = lv_file_path
        ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_cts_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Error reading file: { lx_cts_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_file FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_file_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_file.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_lang_file( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = lo_cut->read_language_file( iv_file_name = 'testfile' iv_language = 'D' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_content exp = 'This is content for language D' msg = 'File content should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_file_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_lang_file( ).
    " Simulate an error by trying to read a non-existent file or a file that cannot be created
    " Note: This test might be tricky to make fail reliably without specific setup.
    " For simplicity, we'll just call it and expect no dump.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking or specific file system setup.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->read_language_file( iv_file_name = 'non_existent_file' iv_language = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-existent file' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Lesen einer Datei vom Applikationsserver unter Verwendung von `cl_cts_language_file_io=>get_file_content_as_string`. Obwohl `cl_cts_language_file_io` primär für Sprachdateien im Transportwesen gedacht ist, kann es für den Dateizugriff auf dem Applikationsserver verwendet werden. Die Lösung zeigt auch die moderne String-Template-Syntax und grundlegendes Exception-Handling. Für die Demonstration wird eine temporäre Datei erstellt.
keywords: File I/O, Application Server, Language, cl_cts_language_file_io, String Template, Exception Handling

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Währung mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE s_currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_usd > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for USD should be greater than 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_dem > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for DEM should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstelle eine formatierte Nachricht mit Flugdetails (Flugnummer, Abflugort, Zielort) aus `sflights` unter Verwendung von String Templates.

solution:
CLASS zcl_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_details_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details_message.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_message = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } | &
                   |von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { ls_flight-cityto } | &
                   |am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } um { ls_flight-fltime TIME = USER } Uhr.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greife auf einen spezifischen Eintrag einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Schlüssel, und nutze dabei eine Tabellenexpression.
hint: Nutze `itab[ key_field = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data
                             WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251208' price = 1000 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = 1100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251208' price = 850 )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_price = lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid
                               connid = iv_connid
                               fldate = iv_fldate ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_price = 0. " Or raise a specific exception
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Zeilen und Spalten einer Quelltabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) enthält, unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken mit `VALUE` und `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > 100 )
                          ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                            fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
                            price  = ls_sflight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itl_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming 'AA' might not have flights > 100, adjust as needed for test data

    " To make the test more robust, insert test data or assert against known data
    " Example: If you know 'LH' has flights > 100
    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_lh[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result_lh[ 1 ]-price > 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Quelltabelle effizient.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Table Expressions, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus einer internen Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Schleife über die Tabelle und akkumulieren Sie den Wert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( ).

    " Assert that the total price is not negative (basic check)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ).

    " For a more precise test, you would need to mock SFLIGHT or insert known test data.
    " Example with known data (if SFLIGHT was mocked or pre-filled):
    " DATA(expected_sum) = 100 + 200 + 300. " Based on mock data
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iteratoren in einer funktionalen und prägnanten Weise. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP` Anweisungen mit Akkumulatorvariablen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen mit einem bestimmten Zielort unter Verwendung des `FILTER` Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE` Bedingung.

CLASS zcl_itl_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_destination
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE sflight-cityto
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_destination.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityto = iv_destination ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_by_destination FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_destination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itl_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_destination) = 'NEW YORK'. " Assuming 'NEW YORK' exists in SFLIGHTS test data
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_destination( lv_destination ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = lv_destination ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_non_existent_dest) = 'NONEXISTENT'.
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_destination( lv_non_existent_dest ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_empty_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine Variable und ein Feldsymbol inline, wenn Sie auf eine Tabellenzeile zugreifen, und verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für dynamischen Zugriff.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(lv_variable)` und `FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>)` in Kombination mit `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP AT` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dec_inline_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_first_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dec_inline_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    " Inline declaration for table read
    READ TABLE it_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_row).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Inline declaration for field symbol with dynamic component access
      FIELD-SYMBOL <fs_component> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE ls_first_row TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_first_text = <fs_component>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_inline_data_fs FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inline_data_fs_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_data_fs.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dec_inline_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dec_inline_assign=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Erster Eintrag' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Zweiter Eintrag' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_data( it_data = lt_test_data iv_component_name = 'TEXT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Erster Eintrag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inline_data_fs_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dec_inline_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_dec_inline_assign=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Erster Eintrag' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_data( it_data = lt_test_data iv_component_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen mit `DATA(...)` und `FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` reduzieren die Notwendigkeit, Variablen und Feldsymbole explizit vorab zu deklarieren. Dies führt zu kürzerem, kontextbezogenerem Code. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht weiterhin dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten, was in Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen sehr flexibel ist.
keywords: DATA, FIELD-SYMBOL, Inline Declaration, ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von einer Zeichenkodierung in eine andere (z.B. UTF-8 nach Latin-1) unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ` und ihre Methoden `CREATE` und `CONVERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_obj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_encoding
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_source_encoding TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_obj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_encoding.
    DATA: lo_conv_in  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_in_ce,
          lo_conv_out TYPE REF TO cl_abap_conv_out_ce.

    TRY.
        " Create converter for input (string to XSTRING)
        lo_conv_out = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_source_encoding
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_out->write( iv_input_string ).
        DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).

        " Create converter for output (XSTRING to string)
        lo_conv_in = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
          encoding = iv_target_encoding
          endian   = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>endian_little
        ).
        lo_conv_in->read( EXPORTING input = lv_xstring IMPORTING data = rv_converted_string ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_codepage_converter_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für eine potenzielle Division durch Null unter Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit einer klassenbasierten Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausnahme `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_try_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_try_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        " Handle division by zero or other arithmetic overflows
        MESSAGE lx_overflow->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        " Catch any other arithmetic errors
        MESSAGE lx_arith_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_line) GROUP BY ls_flight_line-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight_line-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    " Example: Assert for a specific carrier if you know its count
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>ty_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " Ensure all entries have a positive count
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50, mit erweiterten Funktionen ab 7.55) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt oft komplexe manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für Aggregationen und verbessert die Performance und Lesbarkeit erheblich.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der Tabelle `sflights` und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den um 10% erhöhten Preis enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `@` für Hostvariablen und eine `FOR` Schleife mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price_eur TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                            connid    = flight-connid
                            price_eur = flight-price * '1.1' " Preis um 10% erhöhen
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_transformation.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_sflights_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_transformer->get_transformed_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flights
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für LH gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Prüfen, ob der Preis korrekt transformiert wurde (Beispiel für den ersten Eintrag)
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      " Annahme: Ein Flug von LH hat ursprünglich Preis 400.00, Währung USD
      " Nach 10% Erhöhung sollte es 440.00 sein.
      " Dies ist ein vereinfachter Test, da sflights-Daten variieren können.
      " Ein robusterer Test würde spezifische Testdaten verwenden.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_first_flight-price_eur
        exp = '440.00' " Beispielwert, an sflights-Daten anpassen
        msg = 'Preis sollte um 10% erhöht sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax mit `@` für Hostvariablen und `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, FOR Expression, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE s_price( '0.00' ) )
                               FOR price_entry IN lt_prices
                               NEXT sum = sum + price_entry-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_reducer->get_total_price( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_reducer->get_total_price( 'AA' ).

    " Diese Werte müssen an die tatsächlichen Daten in sflights angepasst werden.
    " Für LH (Lufthansa) und AA (American Airlines) sind dies Beispielwerte.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_lh
      exp = '1200.00' " Beispielwert, an sflights-Daten anpassen
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für LH sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_aa
      exp = '1000.00' " Beispielwert, an sflights-Daten anpassen
      msg = 'Gesamtpreis für AA sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP` Schleifen mit manueller Summenbildung und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: REDUCE Expression, Aggregation, Internal Tables, sflights

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

    DATA(lt_sf_flights) = lo_filter->get_flights_by_destination( 'SAN FRANCISCO' ).

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als eine manuelle Schleife mit `IF` und `APPEND`.
keywords: FILTER Expression, Internal Tables, Filtering, sflights
