solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_propagator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

    METHODS call_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_propagator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Weitere Logik
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_action.
    TRY.
        perform_action( iv_input ).
        rv_message = |Aktion mit Wert { iv_input } erfolgreich ausgeführt.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        " Hier könnte eine detaillierte Protokollierung erfolgen
        " z.B. mit CL_ABAP_LOGGER oder einem eigenen Logging-Framework
        DATA(lv_log_message) = |Fehler in call_action: { lx_exception->get_text( ) } (Input: { iv_input })|.
        " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( lv_log_message ). " Für Demo-Zwecke
        rv_message = lv_log_message.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_exception. " Ausnahme erneut werfen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->call_action( 5 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ermöglicht es, Fehler auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Aufrufhierarchie zu behandeln, ohne die ursprüngliche Fehlerursache zu verlieren. Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine Operation ausführt, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und senden Sie eine entsprechende HTTP-Fehlerantwort (z.B. Status 500) mit einer Fehlermeldung im JSON-Format.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_http_server`, `TRY...CATCH`, `response->set_status` und `cl_abap_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS simulate_failing_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input. " Wiederverwendung der Exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = io_server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = io_server->response.
    DATA(lv_trigger) = lo_request->get_query_parameter( 'trigger_error' ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

    lo_response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    TRY.
        simulate_failing_operation( iv_trigger_error = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_trigger = 'X' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Success' message = 'Operation erfolgreich.' ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_failing_operation.
    IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Normale Operation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    if_http_extension~handle_request( io_server ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             price    TYPE s_price,

           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING

      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_flight_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = io_server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = io_server->response.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_request->get_query_parameter( 'carrid' ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

    lo_response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    TRY.
        IF lv_carrid IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(ls_flight) = get_flight_data( lv_carrid ).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = ls_flight ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH zcx_flight_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Flugdaten für Carrier { lx_not_found->mv_carrid } nicht gefunden.| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 404 reason = 'Not Found' ).

      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Ungültige Eingabe: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>default_text
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    if_http_extension~handle_request( io_server ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, soll eine Ausnahme geworfen werden. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `THROW` für eine funktionale Herangehensweise.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit `THROW` im `INIT`- oder `NEXT`-Teil.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input. " Wiederverwendung der Exception
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR number IN it_numbers
      NEXT
        sum = sum + COND i(
          WHEN number < 0 THEN THROW zcx_invalid_input(
                                   textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text
                                   previous = NEW cx_sy_arith_overflow( textid = cx_sy_arith_overflow=>default_text )
                                 )
          ELSE number
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der prüft, ob ein bestimmter HTTP-Header 'Authorization' vorhanden ist. Wenn nicht, soll eine HTTP 401 Unauthorized-Antwort mit einer JSON-Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden. Andernfalls wird eine Erfolgsmeldung gesendet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `request->get_header_field` und `response->set_status`.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = io_server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = io_server->response.
    DATA(lv_auth_header) = lo_request->get_header_field( 'Authorization' ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

    lo_response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    IF lv_auth_header IS INITIAL.
      lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = 'Authorization header missing.' ) ).
      lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
      lo_response->set_status( code = 401 reason = 'Unauthorized' ).
    ELSE.
      lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Success' message = 'Authorization header found.' ) ).
      lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
      lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    if_http_extension~handle_request( io_server ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING
        iv_email TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_email.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_email.
    IF iv_email IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_email=>default_text
          iv_email = iv_email.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_at_pos) = find( val = iv_email sub = '@' ).
    IF lv_at_pos = -1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_email=>default_text
          iv_email = iv_email.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_dot_pos) = find( val = iv_email sub = '.' off = lv_at_pos ).
    IF lv_dot_pos = -1 OR lv_dot_pos < lv_at_pos.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_email
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_email=>default_text
          iv_email = iv_email.
    ENDIF.

    " Weitere komplexe Validierungslogik hier...
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine asynchrone Operation simuliert und eine '202 Accepted'-Antwort zurückgibt, bevor die Operation abgeschlossen ist. Die eigentliche Operation soll eine Ausnahme werfen, die intern protokolliert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_server->response->set_status( 202 )` und eine separate Methode für die asynchrone Logik mit `RAISE EXCEPTION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_async_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS _perform_async_task
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_async_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = io_server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = io_server->response.
    DATA(lv_input_data) = lo_request->get_query_parameter( 'data' ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.

    " Sofortige Antwort senden
    lo_response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
    lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Accepted' message = 'Asynchrone Verarbeitung gestartet.' ) ).
    lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
    lo_response->set_status( code = 202 reason = 'Accepted' ).

    " Asynchrone Aufgabe starten (hier simuliert)
    " In einem echten Szenario würde dies über einen Hintergrundjob, Event oder RFC erfolgen
    _perform_async_task( lv_input_data ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_async_task.
    " Simulierte asynchrone Logik, die fehlschlagen kann
    TRY.
        IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        " Erfolgreiche Verarbeitung
        " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( |Asynchrone Aufgabe erfolgreich mit Daten: { iv_data }| ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        " Fehler intern protokollieren, da der HTTP-Request bereits beantwortet wurde
        " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( |Asynchrone Aufgabe Fehler: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) } (Daten: { iv_data })| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( |Asynchrone Aufgabe Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    if_http_extension~handle_request( io_server ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Auftretende Ausnahmen in dieser asynchronen Aufgabe werden intern mit `TRY...CATCH` behandelt und protokolliert, da der HTTP-Response bereits gesendet wurde. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Ressource öffnet, eine Operation durchführt, die eine Ausnahme werfen kann, und sicherstellt, dass die Ressource immer geschlossen wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resource_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input. " Wiederverwendung der Exception

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS _open_resource.
    METHODS _close_resource.
    METHODS _perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_resource.
    TRY.
        _open_resource( ).
        _perform_operation( iv_trigger_error ).
        rv_result = 'Ressource erfolgreich verarbeitet und geschlossen.'.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_result = |Fehler bei der Verarbeitung: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_invalid_input. " Ausnahme weitergeben
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        rv_result = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_other_exception. " Ausnahme weitergeben
      CLEANUP.
        _close_resource( ). " Ressource immer schließen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _open_resource.
    mv_resource_open = abap_true.
    " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( 'Ressource geöffnet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _close_resource.
    IF mv_resource_open = abap_true.
      mv_resource_open = abap_false.
      " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( 'Ressource geschlossen.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_operation.
    IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " CL_DEMO_OUTPUT=>display( 'Operation durchgeführt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `TRY...CATCH...CLEANUP`-Blocks, um eine sichere Ressourcenverwaltung zu gewährleisten. Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor die Ausnahme an den Aufrufer weitergegeben wird. Dies ist entscheidend, um sicherzustellen, dass Ressourcen (wie Dateihandles, Datenbankverbindungen oder HTTP-Sessions) ordnungsgemäß geschlossen werden, selbst wenn Fehler auftreten. Die Verwendung von `abap_bool` und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der dynamisch eine Methode basierend auf einem URL-Parameter aufruft. Wenn die Methode nicht existiert oder der Aufruf fehlschlägt, soll eine HTTP 400-Antwort mit einer Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen und `TRY...CATCH` für den Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    METHODS handle_request
      IMPORTING
        io_server TYPE REF TO if_http_server.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS _method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS _method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lo_request) = io_server->request.
    DATA(lo_response) = io_server->response.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = lo_request->get_query_parameter( 'method' ).
    DATA lv_json_output TYPE string.
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    lo_response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).

    IF lv_method_name IS INITIAL.
      lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = 'Method parameter missing.' ) ).
      lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
      lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = lv_result.
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Success' result = lv_result ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Dynamischer Methodenaufruf fehlgeschlagen: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 400 reason = 'Bad Request' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        lv_json_output = cl_abap_json=>serialize( data = VALUE #( status = 'Error' message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }| ) ).
        lo_response->set_cdata( lv_json_output ).
        lo_response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_result = 'Ergebnis von Methode A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_result = 'Ergebnis von Methode B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_request.
    if_http_extension~handle_request( io_server ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, und fügen Sie diese in eine neue interne Tabelle ein.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            connid = flight-connid
                            fldate = flight-fldate
                            price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.

    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_counts = REDUCE #( INIT r = VALUE tt_carrier_count( )
                          FOR GROUPS <key> OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
                          ( APPEND VALUE #( carrid = <key> count = GROUP SIZE ) TO r ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_append_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

      ls_summary_line-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_summary_line-connid = ls_flight-connid.

      COLLECT ls_summary_line INTO rt_summary.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_group TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_groups RETURNING VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE tt_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_groups.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS <key> OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid
                             ( carrid = <key>-carrid
                               connid = <key>-connid
                               num_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_flight_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_groups( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ]-num_flights > 0 ) OPTIONAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS ... GROUP BY` Syntax in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten und das Erstellen einer neuen Tabelle mit aggregierten Informationen pro Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Funktion für die Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: APPEND, STANDARD TABLE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, Grouping, sflights

hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_table
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_table.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + <num> ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen CSV-String aus den Flugdaten der Tabelle `sflights`, der die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthält. Jede Zeile soll durch ein Semikolon getrennt sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und String-Templates in Kombination.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_csv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_csv_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
                              |{ <fs_flight>-carrid };{ <fs_flight>-connid };{ <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = ISO }|
                            ELSE
                              |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <fs_flight>-carrid };{ <fs_flight>-connid };{ <fs_flight>-fldate DATE = ISO }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_csv FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_generator) = NEW zcl_sflights_csv( ).
    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_csv_generator->get_sflights_csv( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_csv ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND abap_bool( WHEN count( val = lv_csv regex = `\n` ) >= 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND abap_bool( WHEN count( val = lv_csv regex = `;` ) >= 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `REDUCE` und String-Templates ermöglicht eine effiziente und elegante Erstellung komplexer Strings wie CSV-Daten aus internen Tabellen, ohne explizite Schleifen und `CONCATENATE` Anweisungen. `DATE = ISO` formatiert das Datum direkt im String-Template.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, CSV

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine SQL-Abfrage basierend auf optionalen Eingabeparametern für `carrid` und `connid` aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `COND` für die bedingte Ergänzung von Teilen der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS build_where_clause
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_where_clause) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_where_clause.
    DATA(lv_conditions) = VALUE string_table(
      ( COND string( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |carrid = '{ iv_carrid }'| ELSE '' ) )
      ( COND string( WHEN iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |connid = '{ iv_connid }'| ELSE '' ) )
    ).

    DELETE lv_conditions WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.

    IF lv_conditions IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_where_clause = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = 'WHERE '
        FOR <condition> IN lv_conditions
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s = 'WHERE ' THEN |{ s }{ <condition> }| ELSE |{ s } AND { <condition> }| )
      ).
    ELSE.
      rv_where_clause = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflights_tab FROM lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Preis unter allen Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Vergleichslogik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE sflights-price(
      INIT max_p = 0
      FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price > max_p THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE max_p )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle eindeutigen Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, durch Komma und Leerzeichen getrennt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_carriers_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carriers_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_carriers_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR GROUPS <carrier_group> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <carrier_group>-carrid ELSE |{ s }, { <carrier_group>-carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      INSERT sflights FROM VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ).

CLASS zcl_sflights_daily_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_daily_revenue.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_calculate_age DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_calculate_age IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_age_in_years.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_age_calc) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).
    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4) ).
      lv_age_calc = lv_age_calc - 1.
    ENDIF.
    rv_age = lv_age_calc.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_while_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_up_to.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 1.

      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ] exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_until_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_attempts_until_threshold RETURNING VALUE(rv_attempts) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_random_until_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attempts_until_threshold.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_current_random) = 0.0F.
    rv_attempts = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_random <= 0.9F.
      lv_current_random = lo_random->get_next( ).

    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wähle einen zufälligen Flug aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` aus. Sollte die Tabelle leer sein, gib initialen Wert zurück.
hint: Lese alle Flüge in eine interne Tabelle, generiere einen zufälligen Index mit `cl_abap_random_int` (oder abgeleitet von float) und greife über den Index zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).
      DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = trunc( lo_random_float->get_next( ) * lv_num_flights ) + 1.
      rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).

    " Assert that if sflight has data, a flight is returned.
    " If sflight is empty, ls_random_flight will be initial.
    IF ls_random_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Check if the returned flight exists in sflight (basic validation)
      SELECT SINGLE FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @ls_random_flight-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_random_flight-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_random_flight-fldate
        INTO @DATA(ls_check).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_bool = ( ls_check IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
    ELSE.
      " If no flight was returned, assert sflight is empty
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_count).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dann wird mit `cl_abap_random_float` eine Zufallszahl generiert, die in einen gültigen Index für die interne Tabelle umgewandelt wird. Der Zugriff auf die Tabelle erfolgt über den Index, was eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur Auswahl eines zufälligen Elements darstellt.

Instructions: Simuliere einen Prozess, der bei jedem Schritt eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 generiert. Der Prozess stoppt, wenn die Summe der generierten Zahlen einen Wert von 5 überschreitet ODER 10 Schritte erreicht sind. Gib die finale Summe und die Anzahl der Schritte zurück.
hint: Kombiniere eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit mehreren Abbruchbedingungen und `cl_abap_random_float`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_process_simulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simulation_result,
             final_sum TYPE f,
             steps     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_simulation_result.
    METHODS simulate_process RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_simulation_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_simulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_process.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_current_sum) = 0.0F.
    DATA(lv_steps) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_sum <= 5.0F AND lv_steps < 10.
      lv_current_sum = lv_current_sum + lo_random->get_next( ).
      lv_steps = lv_steps + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rs_result-final_sum = lv_current_sum.
    rs_result-steps = lv_steps.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_simulate_process FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_process.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_simulator( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->simulate_process( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_bool = ( ls_result-steps > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_bool = ( ls_result-steps <= 10 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_bool = ( ls_result-final_sum > 0 ) ).

    " Check if one of the exit conditions was met
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_bool = ( ls_result-final_sum > 5.0F OR ls_result-steps = 10 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit komplexeren Abbruchbedingungen (`AND`-Verknüpfung). Es simuliert einen Prozess, der entweder durch das Erreichen einer Summe oder einer maximalen Schrittzahl beendet wird. Dies ist typisch für iterative Algorithmen oder Simulationen, bei denen `cl_abap_random_float` für die Generierung von zufälligen Ereignissen genutzt wird.
keywords: WHILE, RANDOM, SIMULATION, LOOP, CONDITIONAL LOGIC, STRUCTURE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT

Instructions: Generiere ein zufälliges Datum zwischen dem 01.01.2020 und dem 31.12.2023 (inklusive beider Daten).
hint: Konvertiere Start- und Enddatum in Tage seit einem Referenzdatum, generiere eine Zufallszahl für die Anzahl der Tage im Bereich und konvertiere zurück.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20200101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = '20231231'.

    DATA(lv_days_start) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = lv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_days_end)   = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = '00000000' iv_date2 = lv_end_date ).

    DATA(lv_range) = lv_days_end - lv_days_start + 1.

    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = trunc( lo_random_float->get_next( ) * lv_range ).

    DATA(lv_random_days) = lv_days_start + lv_random_offset.

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = '00000000' iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeite Elemente aus einer internen Tabelle, die als Warteschlange dient. Entferne das erste Element und füge ein neues hinzu, solange die Warteschlange nicht leer ist und weniger als 5 Elemente verarbeitet wurden. Gib die verarbeiteten Elemente zurück.
hint: Nutze `WHILE`, `DELETE TABLE INDEX 1` und `APPEND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_queue IMPORTING it_initial_queue TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_elements) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_initial_queue.
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = 0.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_processed_count < 5.
      DATA(lv_element) = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      APPEND lv_element TO rt_processed_elements.
      DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generiere einen zufälligen String der Länge 10, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben (A-Z).
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_float` (oder `cl_abap_random_int`) um zufällige ASCII-Werte zu generieren und String-Templates für die Konstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string IMPORTING iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    DATA(lo_random_float) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_char_a_ascii) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->string_to_xstring( 'A' )->get_byte( 0 ).

    rv_random_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                     FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > iv_length
                                     NEXT s = s && cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->xstring_to_string(
                                                      xstring = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->set_byte(
                                                                  byte = lv_char_a_ascii + trunc( lo_random_float->get_next( ) * 26 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.

    " Check if all characters are uppercase letters

Es demonstriert, wie man zufällige Zahlen in Zeichen umwandelt, indem man mit ASCII-Werten arbeitet. `REDUCE` ist eine moderne ABAP-Funktion (ab 7.40), die die iterative String-Konkatenation sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Führe eine einfache Monte-Carlo-Simulation durch, um die Wahrscheinlichkeit zu schätzen, dass eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 kleiner als 0.5 ist. Führe 1000 Simulationen durch und gib die geschätzte Wahrscheinlichkeit zurück.
hint: Nutze eine `WHILE`-Schleife für die Iterationen und `cl_abap_random_float` für die Zufallszahlen. Zähle die Treffer und berechne die Wahrscheinlichkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_monte_carlo_simulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_probability IMPORTING iv_num_simulations TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_probability) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_monte_carlo_simulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_probability.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_hits) = 0.
    DATA(lv_current_simulation) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_simulation < iv_num_simulations.
      IF lo_random->get_next( ) < 0.5F.
        lv_hits = lv_hits + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_simulation = lv_current_simulation + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF iv_num_simulations > 0.
      rv_probability = lv_hits / iv_num_simulations.
    ELSE.
      rv_probability = 0.0F.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_monte_carlo.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_monte_carlo_simulator( ).
    DATA(lv_probability) = lo_cut->simulate_probability( 10000 ). " More simulations for better accuracy

    " Expected probability is 0.5. Allow for a small deviation.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_float( act = lv_probability exp = 0.5F delta = 0.05F ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_simulations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_monte_carlo_simulator( ).
    DATA(lv_probability) = lo_cut->simulate_probability( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_probability exp = 0.0F ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es zeigt, wie man mit einer großen Anzahl von Zufallsexperimenten eine Wahrscheinlichkeit schätzen kann. Die `WHILE`-Schleife ist hier ideal, um eine feste Anzahl von Simulationen durchzuführen.

Instructions: Generiere 100 Zufallszahlen zwischen 0 und 1 und gruppiere sie in 10 Bins (0-0.1, 0.1-0.2, ..., 0.9-1.0). Gib die Anzahl der Zahlen in jedem Bin zurück.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_float` und `GROUP BY` in einem `FOR` Ausdruck oder eine `WHILE`-Schleife mit `COLLECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_bin_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_bin_count,
             bin_range TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_bin_count.
    METHODS count_random_bins RETURNING VALUE(rt_bin_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_bin_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_bin_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_random_bins.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_random_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF f( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100
                                                          ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).

    " Initialize bins
    DATA(lt_bins) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_bin_count(
      FOR i = 0 UNTIL i > 9
      ( bin_range = |{ i / 10.0F WIDTH = 3 DECIMALS = 1 }-{ ( i + 1 ) / 10.0F WIDTH = 3 DECIMALS = 1 }|, count = 0 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_random_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      DATA(lv_bin_index) = trunc( lv_number * 10 ).
      IF lv_bin_index = 10. " Handle 1.0 if it somehow occurs (get_next is < 1, but for safety)
        lv_bin_index = 9.
      ENDIF.
      lt_bins[ lv_bin_index + 1 ]-count = lt_bins[ lv_bin_index + 1 ]-count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_bin_counts = lt_bins.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_random_bin_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_bin_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_bin_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_bin_counts) = lo_cut->count_random_bins( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_bin_counts ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA(lv_total_count) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR bin IN lt_bin_counts NEXT s = s + bin-count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_count exp = 100 ).

    " Assert that counts are generally non-negative
    LOOP AT lt_bin_counts INTO DATA(ls_bin).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( iv_bool = ( ls_bin-count >= 0 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung einer großen Menge von Zufallszahlen mit `cl_abap_random_float` und deren anschließende Gruppierung in Bins. Es verwendet einen `FOR`-Ausdruck zur initialen Generierung der Zahlen und eine `LOOP` über die Bins zur Zählung. Die Initialisierung der Bins mit `VALUE` und String-Templates für die Bereichsbeschreibung sind moderne ABAP-Features (ab 7.40/7.50).
keywords: RANDOM, FLOAT, GROUPING, INTERNAL TABLE, FOR, VALUE, LOOP, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT

Instructions: Erstelle eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die einen String Zeichen für Zeichen verarbeitet, bis ein Leerzeichen gefunden wird oder das Ende des Strings erreicht ist. Gib den Teilstring bis zum ersten Leerzeichen zurück.
hint: Nutze `WHILE`, `sy-index` und `substring` oder `string_offset`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_word_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_first_word IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_first_word) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_word_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_first_word.
    DATA(lv_length) = strlen( iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.

    WHILE lv_index < lv_length.
      DATA(lv_char) = iv_text+lv_index(1).
      IF lv_char = ` `.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_first_word = iv_text(lv_index).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_first_word FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Flugpreis über 500 liegt. Geben Sie die Flugnummer und den Preis der gefilterten Flüge aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_origin TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, cityfrom
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE cityfrom = iv_origin.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                            connid   = flight-connid
                            fldate   = flight-fldate
                            price    = flight-price
                            currency = flight-currency ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_flights
        name  = 'Filtered Flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result_ny,
      msg = 'Expected flights for NEW YORK > 100'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'AA', "Adjust based on SFLIGHTS data
      msg = 'Expected specific carrier for first flight'
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Dies ist wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte mit `APPEND` oder `INSERT`. `cl_demo_output` wird hier zur Visualisierung der Ergebnisse verwendet.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rv_total_price
        name  = |Total Price for { iv_carrid }|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_sum) = NEW zcl_flight_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_sum->get_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_aa,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Expected a non-zero total price for carrier AA'
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_sum->get_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_total_price_lh,
      exp = 0,
      msg = 'Expected a non-zero total price for carrier LH'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ist sehr ausdrucksstark und ersetzt komplexe `LOOP`-Konstrukte mit manueller Summenbildung. Die Initialisierung des Akkumulators (`sum`) und die Iteration (`FOR`) sind klar definiert. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Ergebnis.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Nachricht, die Flugdetails (Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungs-ID, Abflugort, Zielort und Preis) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält.

CLASS zcl_flight_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info_message
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_flight_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_message.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_message = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } von { ls_sflight-cityfrom } nach { ls_sflight-cityto } kostet { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = rv_message
        name = 'Flight Info Message'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      needle   = 'Flug AA 0017 von NEW YORK nach SAN FRANCISCO kostet', "Adjust if SFLIGHTS data changes

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie Variablen und Feldsymbole inline, um den Code kompakter und lesbarer zu gestalten. Demonstrieren Sie dies beim Lesen von Flugdaten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA()` für Variablen und `FIELD-SYMBOL()` für Feldsymbole direkt an der Verwendungsstelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    " Inline-Deklaration für eine interne Tabelle und eine Arbeitszeile
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Inline-Deklaration für ein Feldsymbol in einer LOOP-Anweisung
      LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
        rv_result_message = |Flug { <fs_flight>-carrid } { <fs_flight>-connid } gefunden. Preis: { <fs_flight>-price } { <fs_flight>-currency }|.
        EXIT. " Nur den ersten Eintrag verarbeiten
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = rv_result_message
        name = 'Inline Declaration Demo'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inline_data_fs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inline_data_fs.
    DATA(lo_declarations) = NEW zcl_inline_declarations( ).
    DATA(lv_message_found) = lo_declarations->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    DATA(lv_message_not_found) = lo_declarations->process_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_message_found,
      needle   = 'Flug AA 0017 gefunden.',
      msg      = 'Expected message for existing flight with inline declarations'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_message_not_found,
      needle   = 'Flug XX 9999 nicht gefunden.',
      msg      = 'Expected "not found" message for non-existing flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA()` und `FIELD-SYMBOL()`) ermöglichen die Deklaration von Variablen und Feldsymbolen direkt an der Stelle ihrer ersten Verwendung. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, alle Variablen am Anfang einer Methode zu deklarieren, was den Code kompakter, lesbarer und leichter verständlich macht, da der Typ oft aus dem Kontext abgeleitet wird. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Ergebnis der Verarbeitung.
keywords: Inline Declaration, DATA(), FIELD-SYMBOL(), cl_demo_output, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Abhängigkeit (z.B. einen Service zur Datenbeschaffung) über ihren Konstruktor erhält. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung dieser Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CONSTRUCTOR` und den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_data_provider.
  METHODS get_flight_price
    IMPORTING
      iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_provider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_data_provider~get_flight_price.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflight INTO @rv_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
    METHODS process_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_data_provider TYPE REF TO zif_flight_data_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_provider = io_data_provider.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight.
    DATA(lv_price) = mo_data_provider->get_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = iv_carrid
      iv_connid = iv_connid
    ).
    IF lv_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_processed_value = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } has price { lv_price }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_processed_value = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } not found or no price.|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = rv_processed_value
        name = 'Constructor Injection Demo'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_constructor_injection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_constructor_injection.
    " Create the concrete data provider
    DATA(lo_sflight_provider) = NEW zcl_sflight_provider( ).

    " Inject the provider into the processor's constructor
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( io_data_provider = lo_sflight_provider ).

    DATA(lv_result_found) = lo_processor->process_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    DATA(lv_result_not_found) = lo_processor->process_flight( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_result_found,
      needle   = 'Flight AA 0017 has price',
      msg      = 'Expected processed message for existing flight'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      haystack = lv_result_not_found,
      needle   = 'Flight XX 9999 not found or no price.',
      msg      = 'Expected "not found" message for non-existing flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection ist ein Designprinzip, bei dem Abhängigkeiten einer Klasse über ihren Konstruktor bereitgestellt werden. Dies fördert lose Kopplung, erleichtert das Testen (durch Mocking von Abhängigkeiten) und verbessert die Wartbarkeit. Der `NEW`-Operator wird für die Instanziierung verwendet. `cl_demo_output` zeigt das Ergebnis der Verarbeitung.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, NEW, Interface, cl_demo_output, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entspricht, aber passende Feldnamen hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` mit Inline-Deklaration.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                              connid   = flight-connid
                              fldate   = flight-fldate
                              price    = flight-price
                              currency = flight-currency ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_summaries
        name  = 'Flight Summaries (Corresponding Fields)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding_fields.
    DATA(lo_sql) = NEW zcl_open_sql_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_sql->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summaries,
      msg = 'Expected flight summaries to be filled'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_summaries ),
      exp = 20, "Adjust based on SFLIGHTS data, assuming at least 20 entries
      msg = 'Expected a certain number of flight summaries'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrid,
      msg = 'Expected carrid to be filled'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` in Open SQL ermöglicht das flexible Einlesen von Daten in eine interne Tabelle, deren Struktur nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entsprechen muss, solange die Feldnamen übereinstimmen. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lt_sflights)`) führt dies zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code. `cl_demo_output` zeigt die gelesenen Daten.
keywords: Open SQL, SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Inline Declaration, cl_demo_output, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Filtern Sie nur Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `HAVING` in einer Open SQL `SELECT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_stats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_stats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_statistics
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_stats) TYPE tt_carrier_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
      INTO TABLE @rt_stats.

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_stats
        name  = 'Carrier Statistics'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_group_by_having.
    DATA(lo_sql) = NEW zcl_open_sql_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_stats) = lo_sql->get_carrier_statistics( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_stats,
      msg = 'Expected carrier statistics to be filled'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum und die Uhrzeit, die 3 Stunden und 30 Minuten nach einem gegebenen Startzeitpunkt liegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die neuen Datums- und Zeit-Typen (`dats`, `tims`) und arithmetische Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_future_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE dats
        iv_start_time TYPE tims
        iv_hours      TYPE i
        iv_minutes    TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_future_date TYPE dats
        ev_future_time TYPE tims.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_future_datetime.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>combine_date_time(
                            iv_date = iv_start_date
                            iv_time = iv_start_time ).

    DATA(lv_add_seconds) = ( iv_hours * 3600 ) + ( iv_minutes * 60 ).

    DATA(lv_future_timestamp) = lv_timestamp + lv_add_seconds.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>separate_tstmp(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp = lv_future_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        ev_date  = ev_future_date
        ev_time  = ev_future_time
    ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = |Start: { iv_start_date DATE = USER } { iv_start_time TIME = USER }, Future: { ev_future_date DATE = USER } { ev_future_time TIME = USER }|
        name = 'Date/Time Calculation'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CLASS-METHODS display_splitter_screen.

CLASS zcl_splitter_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_splitter_screen.

    CREATE OBJECT go_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        rows    = 2

    DATA(lo_top_container) = go_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
    DATA(lo_bottom_container) = go_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

      EXPORTING
        text = 'Dies ist der obere Bereich des Splitter-Controls.'

      EXPORTING

        name = 'Splitter Demo'
    ).

    " In a real scenario, you would call a screen here:
    " CALL SCREEN 9000.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_pbo.
    " PBO logic for the screen, e.g., setting data for controls
  ENDMETHOD.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und gleichzeitig die Struktur der Zeilen transformieren. Verwenden Sie eine kompakte Syntax.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             flag TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_original_data.
    TYPES tt_original_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_data,
             new_id   TYPE i,
             new_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_data.
    TYPES tt_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        it_original_data TYPE tt_original_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_transformed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN it_original_data
                                   WHERE ( flag = abap_true )
                                   ( new_id   = ls_data-id * 10
                                     new_text = |Transformed: { ls_data-text }| ) ).

    cl_demo_output=>write_data(
      EXPORTING
        value = rt_transformed_data
        name  = 'Transformed and Filtered Data'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_filter.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_transform=>tt_original_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' flag = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_output) = lo_transformer->transform_and_filter( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_output ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Expected 2 transformed items after filtering'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output[ 1 ]-new_id,
      exp = 10
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output[ 1 ]-new_text,
      exp = 'Transformed: Item A'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output[ 2 ]-new_id,
      exp = 30
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_output[ 2 ]-new_text,
      exp = 'Transformed: Item C'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Ausdruck, `VALUE`-Operator und `WHERE`-Klausel ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP. Es erlaubt das Filtern und gleichzeitige Transformieren von Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle mit einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle Schleifen mit bedingten Zuweisungen. `cl_demo_output` zeigt die transformierten Daten.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filtering, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt und entfernen Sie dieses Präfix, falls vorhanden. Verwenden Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `starts_with` und `replace` mit `regex` oder `substring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string_with_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_prefix       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_with_prefix.
    IF iv_input_string CP |{ iv_prefix }*|.
      " Modern way to remove prefix using substring
      rv_processed_string = substring( val = iv_input_string off = strlen( iv_prefix ) ).
    ELSE.
      rv_processed_string = iv_input_string.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = |Original: '{ iv_input_string }', Prefix: '{ iv_prefix }', Processed: '{ rv_processed_string }'|
        name = 'String Prefix Processing'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prefix_removal FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prefix_removal.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_string_prefix( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_processor->process_string_with_prefix( iv_input_string = 'PREFIX_MyText' iv_prefix = 'PREFIX_' ),
      exp = 'MyText'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_processor->process_string_with_prefix( iv_input_string = 'AnotherText' iv_prefix = 'PREFIX_' ),
      exp = 'AnotherText'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_processor->process_string_with_prefix( iv_input_string = 'Test' iv_prefix = 'T' ),
      exp = 'est'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_processor->process_string_with_prefix( iv_input_string = '' iv_prefix = 'P' ),
      exp = ''
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Überprüfung eines Präfixes kann effizient mit dem `CP`-Operator (Contains Pattern) erfolgen. Das Entfernen des Präfixes gelingt modern und performant mit der `substring`-Funktion, die den String ab einem bestimmten Offset zurückgibt. Dies ist eine saubere Alternative zu älteren `SHIFT`- oder `REPLACE`-Anweisungen. `cl_demo_output` zeigt die Ergebnisse der String-Manipulation.
keywords: String Processing, starts_with, substring, CP operator, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellentyp sortiert. Der Sortierschlüssel soll ebenfalls dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `SORT` mit dynamischen Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_sort_field TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      cl_demo_output=>write_text(
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler: Referenz auf Tabelle konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.'
          name = 'Dynamic Sort Error'
      ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamische Sortierung
    SORT <lt_table> BY (iv_sort_field).

    cl_demo_output=>write_text(
      EXPORTING
        text = |Tabelle dynamisch nach '{ iv_sort_field }' sortiert.|
        name = 'Dynamic Sort Result'
    ).

    " Optional: Ausgabe der sortierten Tabelle (nur für einfache Strukturen)
    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      cl_demo_output=>write_data(
        EXPORTING
          value = <ls_line>
          name  = 'Sorted Line'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sort FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sort.
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             key   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA: lt_test_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( key = 'C' value = 3 ) TO lt_test_table.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( key = 'A' value = 1 ) TO lt_test_table.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( key = 'B' value = 2 ) TO lt_test_table.

    DATA(lr_table) = REF #( lt_test_table ).

    lo_sorter->sort_dynamic_table( ir_table = lr_table iv_sort_field = 'KEY' ).

    " Check if sorted by KEY
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 1 ]-key,
      exp = 'A'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 2 ]-key,
      exp = 'B'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 3 ]-key,
      exp = 'C'
    ).

    lo_sorter->sort_dynamic_table( ir_table = lr_table iv_sort_field = 'VALUE' ).

    " Check if sorted by VALUE
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 1 ]-value,
      exp = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 2 ]-value,
      exp = 2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_table[ 3 ]-value,
      exp = 3
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung ermöglicht es, den Sortierschlüssel einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies wird durch die Verwendung von Feldsymbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und der `SORT`-Anweisung mit einem in Klammern gesetzten Feldnamen (`(iv_sort_field)`) erreicht. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Funktionen, die mit verschiedenen Tabellen und Sortierkriterien arbeiten müssen. `cl_demo_output` wird verwendet, um den Sortiervorgang zu protokollieren und die sortierten Zeilen auszugeben.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Field-Symbols, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_demo_output

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer in Sekunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_timefm=>get_instance` und `get_diff_in_seconds`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timefm_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_duration_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp_from TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp_to   TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_duration_in_seconds.
    DATA(lo_timefm) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_instance( ).
    lo_timefm->get_diff_in_seconds(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp_from = iv_tstmp_from

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Wochentag (als Zahl und als Text) für ein gegebenes Datum.

solution:
CLASS zcl_timefm_day_of_week DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_of_week_num
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_num) TYPE i. " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timefm_day_of_week IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_of_week_num.
    DATA(lo_timefm) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_instance( ).
    lo_timefm->get_day_of_week(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date = iv_date
      RECEIVING

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_day_of_week_text.
    DATA(lo_timefm) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_day_num) = 0.
    lo_timefm->get_day_of_week(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date = iv_date
      RECEIVING
        rv_day  = lv_day_num
    ).
    CASE lv_day_num.
      WHEN 1. rv_day_text = 'Montag'.
      WHEN 2. rv_day_text = 'Dienstag'.
      WHEN 3. rv_day_text = 'Mittwoch'.
      WHEN 4. rv_day_text = 'Donnerstag'.
      WHEN 5. rv_day_text = 'Freitag'.
      WHEN 6. rv_day_text = 'Samstag'.
      WHEN 7. rv_day_text = 'Sonntag'.
      WHEN OTHERS. rv_day_text = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_salv_ida_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA: lo_salv_ida TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_table_ida.
    DATA: lo_columns  TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_columns_ida.
    DATA: lo_column   TYPE REF TO if_salv_gui_column_ida.

    TRY.
        lo_salv_ida = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_table( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' ).

        lo_columns = lo_salv_ida->get_columns( ).

        " Spalte 'CARRID' als Gruppierungsfeld setzen
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_group_level( 1 ).

        " Spalte 'SEATSMAX' für Summenaggregation setzen
        lo_column = lo_columns->get_column( 'SEATSMAX' ).
        lo_column->set_aggregation( if_salv_gui_column_ida=>c_aggregation_sum ).

        lo_salv_ida->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugsegmenten (SFLIGHT) nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und mehr als 100 freie Sitze haben. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit der Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und der Anzahl der freien Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`, `FILTER` und `VALUE` für eine kompakte Lösung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             freesets TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflight WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 100 ) 
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        freesets = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_first_flight-freesets > 100 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FILTER` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr kompakte Filterung und Transformation interner Tabellen. `FOR` iteriert über die gefilterten Einträge und `VALUE` konstruiert die neue Tabelle.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, VALUE, FOR, Deklarativ

CLASS zcl_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
