Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `seatsocc` aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_occupied) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_occupied = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Methode soll einen String als Parameter akzeptieren und einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit `(lv_method_name)` und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter TYPE abap_parmbind.
    DATA lv_result_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Annahme: Der Methodenparameter heißt IV_INPUT
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_input_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CREATE DATA lv_result_ref TYPE string.

    CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
      RECEIVING
        RESULT lv_result_ref.

    rv_result = lv_result_ref->*.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrid_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrid_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats_for_carrier) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR group_member IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + group_member-seatsocc
      ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_summary(
        carrid      = ls_flight-carrid
        total_seats = lv_total_seats_for_carrier
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_grouped_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) > 0 ).

    " Beispiel: Überprüfen, ob 'LH' in der Zusammenfassung enthalten ist
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator können Aggregationen pro Gruppe sehr kompakt formuliert werden.
keywords: Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für die Behandlung einer statisch prüfbaren Ausnahme (z.B. Division durch Null).
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Fehlerbehandlung für Division durch Null
        rv_result = 0. " Oder einen anderen Standardwert setzen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_handled FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_raises FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_handled.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->safe_divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ). " Erwarteter Standardwert
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_raises.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_demo( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Expected exception CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE was raised.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `TRY...CATCH` ist der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Das gezielte Abfangen von Ausnahmen wie `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE` ermöglicht eine robuste und kontrollierte Reaktion auf unerwartete Situationen, anstatt Programmabbrüche zu riskieren.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit den Namen aller Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse und deren Typen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rtti_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
      DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_attribute-type_descr ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_attribute_info(
        name = ls_attribute-name
        type = lo_type_descr->get_absolute_name( )
      ) TO rt_attributes.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oxml_create_xlsx IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_from_sflights.
    DATA(lo_package) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_package( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_package->create_worksheet( 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Header schreiben
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Flugnr.' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Datum' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Preis' ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Währung' ).

    " Daten schreiben
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-price ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_package->save_package( ).

    " Optional: Datei auf dem Applikationsserver speichern
    " cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download( EXPORTING filename = iv_filename filetype = 'BIN' CHANGING data_xstr = rv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    lo_ws_flights->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Datum' ).

    LOOP AT it_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).

      lo_ws_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_carrier-carrid ).

      lo_ws_carriers->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_carrier-carrname ).

    rv_xstring = lo_package->save_package( ).

      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).

      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).

CLASS zcl_oxml_xlsx_bgcolor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_xlsx_with_bgcolor.
    DATA(lo_package) = cl_openxml_helper=>create_package( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_package->create_worksheet( 'Flugdaten' ).

    " Stil für fette Schrift und Hintergrundfarbe erstellen
    DATA(lo_header_style) = lo_package->create_style( ).
    lo_header_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).
    lo_header_style->set_fill_pattern( cl_openxml_helper=>fill_pattern_solid ).
    lo_header_style->set_background_color( 'FFC0C0C0' ). " Grau

    " Header schreiben und formatieren
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Airline' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Flugnr.' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_style = lo_header_style ).
    lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'Datum' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_style( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_style = lo_header_style ).

    " Daten schreiben
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_package->save_package( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_salv_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.

CLASS zcl_salv_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS zu berechnen, und überprüfen Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals`.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                       INIT sum_price = 0
                       FOR  ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                       NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_sflight-price
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_reduce_sum_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA lv_expected_price TYPE s_price.

    " Calculate expected value manually or with a simple loop for comparison
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO @lv_expected_price WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'AA' ) exp = lv_expected_price ).

    " Test for a carrier with no flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem über die Elemente iteriert und ein Akkumulator aktualisiert wird. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code. `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals` verifiziert die korrekte Summenbildung.

CLASS zcl_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_expected_count WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'.

Instructions: Greifen Sie mit Tabellenausdrücken auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu und überprüfen Sie die Existenz und den Index der Zeile mit `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true` und `assert_equals`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `itab[ key_field = value ]` für den Zugriff und `LINE_EXISTS` sowie `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index  TYPE i
        es_flight TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF line_exists( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
      ev_exists = abap_true.
      es_flight = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      ev_index  = line_index( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_exists = abap_false.
      CLEAR es_flight.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_lookup FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_lookup.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expressions( ).
    DATA lv_exists TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lv_index TYPE i.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    " Test existing flight
    lo_cut->get_flight_info( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017'
                              IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index es_flight = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    lo_cut->get_flight_info( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999'
                              IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index es_flight = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ ... ]`) sind ein Kernfeature des modernen ABAP für den direkten und typsicheren Zugriff auf Zeilen in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` ermöglichen sie eine sehr kompakte und performante Abfrage von Tabellendaten. Dies ist eine bevorzugte Methode gegenüber `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC`-Prüfung. `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true` und `assert_equals` werden verwendet, um die korrekte Funktionalität zu bestätigen.
keywords: Table Expression, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, ASSERT

Sie ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken in einen String. `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals` stellt sicher, dass der erzeugte String korrekt ist.
keywords: String Templates, String Processing, CONCATENATE, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle mit dem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `VALUE` transformieren (z.B. nur bestimmte Felder auswählen), und überprüfen Sie das Ergebnis mit `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_value_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_flight_short.
    TYPES tt_flight_short TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_short WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_short_flight_list
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_short_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_value_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_short_flight_list.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_short_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                                  connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                                  cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_value_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_short_flights) = lo_cut->get_short_flight_list( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_short_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_short_flights ) exp = 10 ).

    DATA ls_first_entry LIKE LINE OF lt_short_flights.
    READ TABLE lt_short_flights INDEX 1 INTO ls_first_entry.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_entry-cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und Zeile für Zeile zu verarbeiten, kann man direkt eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Feldern oder transformierten Werten erstellen. Dies ist sehr effizient und verbessert die Code-Qualität erheblich. `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals` und `assert_not_initial` überprüfen die korrekte Transformation und die Anzahl der Zeilen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming, ASSERT

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger (TO, CC, BCC).
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Tabelle von Empfänger-E-Mails und iterieren Sie diese mit `add_recipient`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_multi_recip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_multi_recipients
      IMPORTING
        it_to_recipients  TYPE string_table
        it_cc_recipients  TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_recipients TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        iv_subject        TYPE so_obj_des
        iv_body           TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_multi_recip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_multi_recipients.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_document(
      i_document_type = 'RAW'
      i_subject       = iv_subject
      i_text          = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
    ).

    " Add TO recipients
    LOOP AT it_to_recipients INTO DATA(lv_to_email).
      DATA(lo_to_recipient) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( lv_to_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to_recipient i_express = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add CC recipients
    LOOP AT it_cc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_cc_email).
      DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add BCC recipients
    LOOP AT it_bcc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_bcc_email).
      DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( sy-uname ).
    lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email_multi FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email_multi.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_email_multi_recip( ).
    DATA(lt_to) = VALUE string_table( ( 'to1@example.com' ) ( 'to2@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lt_cc) = VALUE string_table( ( 'cc@example.com' ) ).

    TRY.

          it_cc_recipients  = lt_cc

explanation: Die Empfänger werden in einer Schleife hinzugefügt, wobei die Parameter `i_copy` und `i_blind_copy` für CC- bzw. BCC-Empfänger verwendet werden. `VALUE` Operator wird für die Initialisierung der Tabellen verwendet.
keywords: cl_bcs_utilities, Email, Recipients, LOOP, VALUE

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit dynamischem Betreff und Textkörper, der Informationen aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und String-Templates, um die Daten in den E-Mail-Text einzubetten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_email_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_flight_info_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid          TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate          TYPE s_date
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_email_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_flight_info_email.
    DATA: lv_subject TYPE so_obj_des,
          lv_body    TYPE string.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_subject = |Fluginformationen für Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|.
      lv_body = |Sehr geehrte/r Kunde/in,\n\n| &&
                |hier sind die Details zu Ihrem Flug:\n| &&
                |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }\n| &&
                |Flugnummer: { ls_flight-connid }\n| &&
                |Datum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }\n| &&
                |Abflugort: { ls_flight-cityfrom }\n| &&
                |Zielort: { ls_flight-cityto }\n| &&
                |Preis: { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency }\n\n| &&
                |Mit freundlichen Grüßen,\nIhr ABAP-System|.
    ELSE.
      lv_subject = |Fehler: Fluginformationen nicht gefunden|.
      lv_body = |Die angeforderten Fluginformationen für Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } konnten nicht gefunden werden.|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_document(
      i_document_type = 'RAW'
      i_subject       = lv_subject
      i_text          = cl_bcs_utilities=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
    ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_bcs_utilities=>create_internet_address( sy-uname ).
    lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und lesen Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_component_name) OF STRUCTURE (ls_structure) TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data         TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|. " Convert to string for generic return
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_component_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_field_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = sy-datum ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Hello' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).

    DATA(lv_value3) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value3 exp = |{ sy-datum DATE = USER }| ). " Date format depends on user settings
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_component_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_access( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_field_access=>ty_data( field1 = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Component not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Der Wert wird über ein Feldsymbol `<fs_value>` gelesen und mit einem String-Template in einen String umgewandelt.
keywords: ASSIGN, Field-Symbol, Dynamic Programming, Structure, String Templates

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Index.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD (lv_table_name)[lv_index] TO <fs_line>` oder `ASSIGN it_table[iv_index] TO <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_row_value
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_row_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE string.

    " Modern way to access a table line with index and assign to field symbol
    ASSIGN it_table[ iv_index ] TO <fs_line>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_line>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Row not found or index out of bounds'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_table_row_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_table_row_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_table_row_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_row_access( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_row_access=>ty_string_table( ( 'First' ) ( 'Second' ) ( 'Third' ) ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_table_row_value( it_table = lt_data iv_index = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Second' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_table_row_value( it_table = lt_data iv_index = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'First' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_table_row_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_row_access( ).

CLASS zif_dynamic_action DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS execute_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <l_if_dynamic_action> TYPE zif_dynamic_action.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    " Cast to a known interface if possible, or use generic object
    TRY.
        ASSIGN lo_object TO <l_if_dynamic_action>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_output = <l_if_dynamic_action>->execute_action( ).
        ELSE.
          " Fallback to generic method call if interface cast fails
          CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULT rv_output = rv_output.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " If cast fails, try generic method call directly
        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULT rv_output = rv_output.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle, wobei das zu verarbeitende Feld dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Aktualisieren Sie den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_field_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        io_sflight_table  TYPE ty_sflight_table
        iv_field_name     TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_table) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_field_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_updated_table = io_sflight_table.

    LOOP AT rt_updated_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Assign the new value, assuming type compatibility or implicit conversion
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf die dynamische Tabelle und deren Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def,
           ty_field_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_defs TYPE ty_field_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_data_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " 1. Define components for the dynamic structure
    LOOP AT it_field_defs INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int( ).
        WHEN 'DATE'.
          ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_date( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_data_error EXPORTING text = 'Unsupported field type'.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 2. Create dynamic structure type
    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " 3. Create dynamic table type based on the structure
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
      p_unique = abap_false
    ).

    " 4. Create data reference for the dynamic table
    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " 5. Assign table to field symbol and fill with some data
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_line_ref) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lo_line_ref->* TO <fs_line>.

      " Example: Add two rows
      DO 2 TIMES.
        CLEAR <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp1>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_comp1> = |Value { sy-index }|. ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp2>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_comp2> = sy-index * 10. ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD3' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_comp3>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_comp3> = sy-datum. ENDIF.

        APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_invalid_type FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_creation=>ty_field_defs(
      ( name = 'FIELD1' type = 'STRING' length = 20 )
      ( name = 'FIELD2' type = 'INT' length = 4 )
      ( name = 'FIELD3' type = 'DATE' length = 8 )
    ).

    DATA lo_data_ref TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_data_ref = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_field_defs ).
        ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' ).

        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'First row should be assigned' ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value 1' ).

        READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc msg = 'Second row should be assigned' ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLO(<fs_field2>).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 20 ).

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_table_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creation( ).
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_creation=>ty_field_defs(
      ( name = 'FIELD1' type = 'UNSUPPORTED' length = 10 )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception for unsupported field type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'Unsupported field type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene dynamische Programmierung in ABAP. Es verwendet RTTI-Klassen (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) zur Definition von Typen zur Laufzeit und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` zur Erzeugung von Datenobjekten. Feldsymbole (`ASSIGN`) sind unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erzeugten Daten zuzugreifen und diese zu manipulieren.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Status von Flügen in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer internen Tabelle von Flugnummern und neuen Statuswerten. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle und die moderne UPDATE-Syntax mit FROM TABLE.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE sflight-planetype, " Using planetype as a placeholder for status
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES ty_flight_update_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE ty_flight_update_tt
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    " Modern ABAP: UPDATE FROM TABLE
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @it_flight_updates.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " In a real scenario, more specific error handling would be needed.
      " For simplicity, we just raise an exception here.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Prepare test data in SFLIGHTS
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'LH'
      connid   = '0400'
      fldate   = sy-datum
      planetype = 'A320' " Initial status
      price    = '100.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
      seatsocc = 0
      seatsmax = 100
    ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'AA'
      connid   = '0017'
      fldate   = sy-datum
      planetype = 'B747' " Initial status
      price    = '200.00'
      currency = 'USD'
      seatsocc = 0
      seatsmax = 200
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK. " Ensure data is visible for update
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Clean up test data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_flight_updater=>ty_flight_update_tt.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum status = 'A380' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum status = 'B787' ) TO lt_updates.

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    lo_updater->update_flight_status( it_flight_updates = lt_updates ).

    " Verify update
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_status_lh)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_lh exp = 'A380' msg = 'LH status not updated correctly' ).

    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_status_aa)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_aa exp = 'B787' msg = 'AA status not updated correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_no_data.
    DATA(lt_empty_updates) = VALUE zcl_flight_updater=>ty_flight_update_tt( ).
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_updater( ).
    " No exception should be raised for empty table, sy-subrc will be 0
    lo_updater->update_flight_status( it_flight_updates = lt_empty_updates ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'sy-subrc should be 0 for empty update' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne UPDATE-Syntax mit FROM TABLE, die es ermöglicht, mehrere Zeilen einer Datenbanktabelle effizient basierend auf einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Die Inline-Deklaration von Daten (DATA(...)) und die Verwendung von Konstruktor-Ausdrücken (VALUE #(...)) sind weitere Merkmale modernen ABAP-Codes.
keywords: UPDATE, OPEN SQL, Internal Tables, DATA, VALUE, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die es dem Benutzer ermöglicht, eine Textdatei vom Frontend hochzuladen und deren Inhalt als interne Tabelle von Strings zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>FILE_OPEN_DIALOG und CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>GUI_UPLOAD.
solution:
CLASS zcl_frontend_uploader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_text_file
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE string_table
      RAISING   cx_gui_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_uploader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title    = 'Datei zum Hochladen auswählen'
        default_filename = '*.txt'
        file_filter     = 'Textdateien (*.txt)|*.txt|Alle Dateien (*.*)|*.*'
      CHANGING
        file_table      = DATA(lt_file_table)
        rc              = DATA(lv_rc)
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS          = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_rc = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_file_table INDEX 1 INTO lv_filepath.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Keine Datei ausgewählt'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = rt_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp (PLANETYPE) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von belegten Sitzen überschreiten. Der neue Flugzeugtyp soll basierend auf der aktuellen Fluggesellschaft und der Anzahl der Sitze dynamisch bestimmt werden. Verwenden Sie eine CASE-Expression im UPDATE-Statement.
hint: Nutzen Sie die CASE-Expression direkt im SET-Teil des UPDATE-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_conditional_upd DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_planetype_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_conditional_upd IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_planetype_conditionally.
    " Modern ABAP: UPDATE with CASE expression in SET clause
    UPDATE sflight
       SET planetype = CASE carrid
                         WHEN 'LH' THEN 'A380'
                         WHEN 'AA' THEN 'B747'
                         ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
                       END
     WHERE seatsocc > @iv_min_seats_occ.

    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt. " Number of updated rows
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(

    ) ).

    ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'CRJ'
      price    = '50.00' currency = 'USD' seatsocc = 30 seatsmax = 50
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA') AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_conditional_upd( ).
    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_updater->update_planetype_conditionally( iv_min_seats_occ = 70 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen aktualisiert werden' ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_new_flight.
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'XX'
      connid   = '9999'
      fldate   = sy-datum
      planetype = 'A300'
      price    = '500.00'
      currency = 'USD'
      seatsocc = 50
      seatsmax = 200
    ).

    DATA(lo_upserter) = NEW zcl_flight_upserter( ).
    lo_upserter->upsert_flight_data( is_flight_data = ls_new_flight ).

    " Verify insert
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_check msg = 'Flug sollte eingefügt worden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-planetype exp = 'A300' msg = 'Flugzeugtyp nicht korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    " First, insert a flight
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'XX'
      connid   = '9999'
      fldate   = sy-datum
      planetype = 'A300'
      price    = '500.00'
      currency = 'USD'
      seatsocc = 50
      seatsmax = 200
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Now, update it
    DATA(ls_update_flight) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'XX'
      connid   = '9999'
      fldate   = sy-datum
      planetype = 'B777' " New planetype
      price    = '600.00' " New price
      currency = 'USD'
      seatsocc = 60
      seatsmax = 200
    ).

    DATA(lo_upserter) = NEW zcl_flight_upserter( ).
    lo_upserter->upsert_flight_data( is_flight_data = ls_update_flight ).

    " Verify update
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_check msg = 'Flug sollte existieren' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-planetype exp = 'B777' msg = 'Flugzeugtyp nicht korrekt aktualisiert' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-price exp = '600.00' msg = 'Preis nicht korrekt aktualisiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und Konstruktor-Ausdrücken macht den Code kompakt und lesbar.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Flug in SFLIGHTs aktualisiert, aber zuvor eine optimistische Sperre auf den Datensatz setzt, um Konflikte bei gleichzeitigen Zugriffen zu vermeiden. Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE und die moderne UPDATE-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE, um den Datensatz zu sperren, und UPDATE mit einer Arbeitsbereichs-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_optimistic_lock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_with_lock
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error
        zcx_flight_locked.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS zcx_flight_locked DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS zcx_flight_locked IMPLEMENTATION.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_optimistic_lock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_lock.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflight.

    " Optimistic lock: SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE
    SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE *
      FROM sflight
      INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Flight not found or already locked by another user
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_locked EXPORTING text = 'Flug nicht gefunden oder bereits gesperrt'.
    ENDIF.

    " Update the field
    ls_flight-planetype = iv_new_planetype.

    " Update the database record
    UPDATE sflight FROM @ls_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.

    COMMIT WORK. " Release the lock and make changes permanent
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320'
      price    = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_optimistic_lock( ).
    lo_updater->update_flight_with_lock(
      iv_carrid        = 'LH'
      iv_connid        = '0400'
      iv_fldate        = sy-datum
      iv_new_planetype = 'A380'
    ).

    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_status)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'A380' msg = 'Flugzeugtyp nicht korrekt aktualisiert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_flight_optimistic_lock( ).
    TRY.
        lo_updater->update_flight_with_lock(
          iv_carrid        = 'XX' " Non-existent flight
          iv_connid        = '9999'
          iv_fldate        = sy-datum
          iv_new_planetype = 'TEST'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'ZCX_FLIGHT_LOCKED sollte ausgelöst werden' ).
      CATCH zcl_flight_optimistic_lock=>zcx_flight_locked.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'ZCX_FLIGHT_LOCKED korrekt ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unerwartete cx_sy_open_sql_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Implementierung einer optimistischen Sperre mit SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE. Bevor ein Datensatz aktualisiert wird, wird er mit dieser Anweisung exklusiv für die aktuelle Datenbanktransaktion gesperrt. Dies verhindert, dass andere Benutzer oder Prozesse den Datensatz gleichzeitig ändern. Nach der Aktualisierung wird die Sperre mit COMMIT WORK freigegeben. Dies ist eine wichtige Technik für die Datenkonsistenz in Mehrbenutzersystemen.
keywords: UPDATE, SELECT FOR UPDATE, Optimistic Lock, SFLIGHTS, COMMIT WORK, Exception Handling

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Flugdatensatz in SFLIGHTs, indem Sie nur bestimmte Felder aus einer Quellstruktur übernehmen, während andere Felder unverändert bleiben. Verwenden Sie die moderne UPDATE-Syntax mit CORRESPONDING und BASE.
hint: Nutzen Sie UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING #( BASE <original_data> <new_data> ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_partial_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_partial_flight_data,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_partial_flight_data.

    METHODS update_flight_partial
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE sflight
        is_partial_data TYPE ty_partial_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_partial_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_partial.
    DATA: ls_original_flight TYPE sflight.

    " Read original data to use as base
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_original_flight
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error EXPORTING text = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.

    " Modern ABAP: UPDATE with CORRESPONDING and BASE
    " Create a new structure based on original, then overlay partial data
    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = CORRESPONDING sflight(
                                 BASE ( ls_original_flight )
                                 is_partial_data ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM @ls_updated_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    ) ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Prozess, der es dem Benutzer ermöglicht, eine CSV-Datei vom Frontend hochzuladen. Die CSV-Datei enthält Flugaktualisierungen (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum, neuer Flugzeugtyp). Lesen Sie die Datei, verarbeiten Sie die Daten und aktualisieren Sie die entsprechenden Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES für den Upload und moderne UPDATE-Syntax.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILE_OPEN_DIALOG, GUI_UPLOAD, String-Splitting und UPDATE FROM TABLE.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_update_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_gui_error
                cx_sy_open_sql_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update_csv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_update_csv.
    TYPES ty_flight_update_csv_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS upload_csv_file
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_csv_content) TYPE string_table
      RAISING   cx_gui_error.

    METHODS parse_csv_content
      IMPORTING
        it_csv_content TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_updates) TYPE ty_flight_update_csv_tt
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.

    METHODS update_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE ty_flight_update_csv_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_update_flights.
    DATA(lt_csv_content) = upload_csv_file( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_updates) = parse_csv_content( lt_csv_content ).
    rv_updated_rows = update_sflight_table( lt_flight_updates ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD upload_csv_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title    = 'CSV-Datei mit Flugdaten auswählen'
        default_filename = '*.csv'
        file_filter     = 'CSV-Dateien (*.csv)|*.csv|Alle Dateien (*.*)|*.*'
      CHANGING
        file_table      = DATA(lt_file_table)
        rc              = DATA(lv_rc)
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS          = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_rc = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_file_table INDEX 1 INTO lv_filepath.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Keine Datei ausgewählt'.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
        field_separator         = ';' " Assuming semicolon as separator
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = rt_csv_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_error EXPORTING text = 'Fehler beim Hochladen der CSV-Datei'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD parse_csv_content.
    LOOP AT it_csv_content INTO DATA(lv_line) WHERE table_line IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Skip header line if present (simple check)
      IF sy-tabix = 1 AND lv_line CS 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PLANETYPE'.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
      SPLIT lv_line AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_parts.

      IF lines( lt_parts ) = 4.
        TRY.
            APPEND VALUE #( 
              carrid    = lt_parts[ 1 ]
              connid    = lt_parts[ 2 ]
              fldate    = cl_abap_conv_gdat=>create_from_string( lt_parts[ 3 ] )->get_date( )
              planetype = lt_parts[ 4 ]
            ) TO rt_flight_updates.
          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING text = |Fehler bei Datums-Konvertierung in Zeile { sy-tabix }: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_sflight_table.
    " Modern ABAP: UPDATE FROM TABLE
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @it_flight_updates.
    rv_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_modify_from_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             mandt  TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_db_modify_from_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_sflight_prices.
    LOOP AT it_updates ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_update>).
      <fs_update>-mandt = sy-mandt.
    ENDLOOP.

    MODIFY sflight FROM TABLE it_updates.
    rv_rows_modified = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in kleinen Paketen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren. Nutzen Sie OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR und CLOSE CURSOR.
hint: Verwenden Sie OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD und FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_flights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flights_chunk PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_chunk TO rt_all_flights.
      CLEAR lt_flights_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_sflight_in_chunks FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_sflight_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_sflight_in_chunks.
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '110.00' )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250101' price = '210.00' )
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_in_chunks( iv_package_size = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'All 5 flights should be read' ).

    READ TABLE lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price of AA 0002 should match' ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE mandt = sy-mandt AND carrid IN ('AA', 'LH').
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_sflight_empty.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_cursor( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->read_sflight_in_chunks( iv_package_size = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_all_flights msg = 'No flights should be read from empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: OPEN CURSOR mit FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE ist eine leistungsstarke Technik, um sehr große Datenmengen aus der Datenbank zu lesen, ohne den Arbeitsspeicher zu überlasten. Die Daten werden in verwaltbaren Blöcken (Paketen) gelesen, was besonders bei der Verarbeitung großer Tabellen vorteilhaft ist. WITH HOLD stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch nach einem impliziten Commit (z.B. durch eine andere DB-Operation) offen bleibt.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Operations, Performance, Memory Management

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_dyn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

  METHOD read_sflight_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_flights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.

      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_flights_chunk TO rt_filtered_flights.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_modify_flights.
    rt_filtered_modified_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER tt_sflight( it_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price )
      ( VALUE #( ls_flight WITH carrid = 'XX' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der PRICE aller Flüge und aktualisieren Sie dann den PRICE jedes Fluges, indem Sie ihn durch diese Summe teilen (Normalisierung). Nutzen Sie REDUCE für die Summenberechnung und anschließend eine LOOP für die Modifikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE für die Aggregation und LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL für die Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS normalize_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_normalized_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_prices.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = '0.00'
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price IS INITIAL OR lv_total_price = '0.00'.
      rt_normalized_flights = it_flights.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_normalized_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_normalized_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price / lv_total_price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten direkt. Für Flüge mit CARRID 'AA' soll der PRICE um 10% erhöht werden, für Flüge mit CARRID 'LH' um 5%. Alle anderen Flüge bleiben unverändert. Nutzen Sie FOR und COND für die In-Place-Modifikation.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL und innerhalb der Schleife COND für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_cond_inplace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_prices_inplace
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_cond_inplace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_prices_inplace.
    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_modified_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = COND #(
                              WHEN <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA' THEN <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'
                              WHEN <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' THEN <fs_flight>-price * '1.05'
                              ELSE <fs_flight>-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittlichen Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT unter Verwendung von OPEN CURSOR und GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie OPEN CURSOR ... FOR SELECT ... GROUP BY ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_avg_price TYPE ty_avg_price.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE mandt = sy-mandt
        GROUP BY carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_avg_price.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_avg_price TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine paginierte Liste von Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT, sortiert nach FLDATE und CONNID, unter Verwendung von OPEN CURSOR und OFFSET/LIMIT.
hint: Verwenden Sie OPEN CURSOR ... FOR SELECT ... ORDER BY ... OFFSET ... ROWS FETCH NEXT ... ROWS ONLY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_page DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_page
      IMPORTING
        iv_offset TYPE i
        iv_limit  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_page_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_cursor_page IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_page.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE mandt = sy-mandt
        ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING, connid ASCENDING
        OFFSET iv_offset ROWS
        FETCH NEXT iv_limit ROWS ONLY.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE rt_page_flights.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_date    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_modify_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_modified_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         WHERE fldate > iv_date.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0019' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_modify_for( ).
    DATA(lv_cutoff_date) = '20250101'.
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->increase_prices(
                                    it_flights = lt_initial_flights
                                    iv_date    = lv_cutoff_date ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WITH KEY connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Price for 0017 should be unchanged' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO ls_flight WITH KEY connid = '0018'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Price for 0018 should be increased' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INTO ls_flight WITH KEY connid = '0019'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = '330.00' msg = 'Price for 0019 should be increased' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE ... ist die moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zeilenweise zu verarbeiten und direkt zu modifizieren. Dies vermeidet die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten MODIFY Anweisung innerhalb der Schleife.
keywords: LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL, WHERE, Internal Tables, In-Place Modification
